data.clinical_result_summary: TP neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy did not significantly improve pathological complete response compared with PF neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in patients with locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Although TP was associated with fewer grade 3-4 adverse events during neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, the primary efficacy endpoint was not met.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Paclitaxel/cisplatin (TP) vs cisplatin/5-fluorouracil (PF) neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC): A randomized trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with PD-1 monotherapy was associated with improved outcomes compared with PD-L1 monotherapy in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer. The authors noted that further prospective studies are needed to confirm and define this difference.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with metastatic colorectal cancer who received immunotherapy between 2013 and 2025 were evaluated, and patients treated with CTLA-4 inhibitors were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative efficacy of PD-1 versus PD-L1 inhibitors in metastatic colorectal cancer: A real-world propensity score–matched study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Delivering all eight cycles of FLOT exclusively in the neoadjuvant setting was feasible and safe in this Brazilian real-world cohort, with high adherence and encouraging survival outcomes. This strategy may represent a pragmatic alternative in scenarios of low compliance with adjuvant treatment or limited access to postoperative chemotherapy, warranting prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 32 consecutive patients at a Brazilian reference center with resectable gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma (≥cT2 and/or cN+) who were treated between 2019 and 2024 with neoadjuvant FLOT followed by surgery.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Exclusive neoadjuvant chemotherapy with the FLOT regimen protocol in resectable gastric cancer: A retrospective cohort study in a Brazilian reference center.

data.clinical_result_summary: BL-M14D1 demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a tolerable safety profile at dose levels of 4.0 mg/kg and 4.5 mg/kg every 3 weeks in heavily pretreated patients with small-cell lung cancer and neuroendocrine carcinoma. These findings support further clinical development of BL-M14D1 in small-cell lung cancer and other less common neuroendocrine carcinomas, with phase III studies in preparation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic NEC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic SCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of BL-M14D1, a novel DLL3-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with locally advanced or metastatic small-cell lung cancer (SCLC), neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC), and other solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results from the LINCH study suggest that linperlisib combined with CHOP as first-line treatment for peripheral T-cell lymphoma achieved promising efficacy and manageable safety. A randomized controlled trial evaluating linperlisib plus CHOP versus CHOP in patients with newly diagnosed peripheral T-cell lymphoma has been initiated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients aged ≥ 18 yearswith histologically confirmed, newly diagnosed PTCL
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Linperlisib plus CHOP for newly diagnosed peripheral T-cell lymphoma: A single-arm, phase Ib/II study (LINCH trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of atezolizumab to mFOLFOX6 slightly increased patient-reported adverse events, but its effect on health-related quality of life was minimal and not clinically meaningful. The results support tolerability of atezolizumab plus mFOLFOX6 as standard-of-care adjuvant treatment for patients with deficient DNA mismatch repair stage III colon cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with surgically resected stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair colon cancer were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Health-related quality of life (HRQOL) in the phase 3 trial of standard chemotherapy alone or combined with atezolizumab as adjuvant therapy for patients with stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) colon cancer (Alliance A021502, ATOMIC).

data.clinical_result_summary: BGB-A3055 with or without tislelizumab demonstrated a safety profile consistent with selective CCR8 on-target effects in patients with advanced solid tumors. The regimen also showed preliminary antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1 study of BGB-A3055 (anti-CCR8) with or without tislelizumab (anti–PD-1) in patients with solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: For patients with metastatic nasopharyngeal cancer, receiving stereotactic radiotherapy for metastatic lesions along with chemotherapy and tislelizumab immunotherapy holds excellent prospects for local disease control.
clinical_result_indication_detail: metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II clinical study of stereotactic radiotherapy (SRT) combined with chemotherapy and tislelizumab for the treatment of metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral DC1 plus trastuzumab/pertuzumab before neoadjuvant paclitaxel plus trastuzumab/pertuzumab was well tolerated with manageable toxicities in patients with HER2-positive breast cancer. The regimen was associated with immune cell infiltration, ctDNA clearance, and improved pathologic tumor response rates, particularly in HR-negative/HER2-positive disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER-2 positive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intratumoral dendritic cell (DC1) therapy prior to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in HER2-positive breast cancer (NATASHA trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: Alrizomadlin alone or in combination with lisaftoclax showed a manageable safety profile, with preliminary antitumor activity in heavily pretreated relapsed/refractory rhabdomyosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, and neuroblastoma. The potential mechanisms, safety, and efficacy of alrizomadlin combined with lisaftoclax for pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma and other soft-tissue sarcomas warrant further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma or other soft-tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Alrizomadlin (APG-115) alone or in combination with lisaftoclax (APG-2575) for the treatment of pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) or other soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs).

data.clinical_result_summary: In unselected patients with advanced CPI-resistant non-small cell lung cancer, the combination of anti-PD-L1, high-dose anti-CTLA-4, and radiotherapy did not demonstrate a meaningful response rate. Toxicity from high-dose anti-CTLA-4 was not negligible, and better patient selection might improve efficacy and reduce toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced CPI-resistant non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Concomitant radiotherapy, tremelimumab, and durvalumab for advanced NSCLC patients progressing on first-line immunotherapy: A phase 2 study (CORAL-Lung).

data.clinical_result_summary: Recombinant human thrombopoietin therapy for cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia showed a threshold effect, with early intervention at platelet counts ≥50×109/L providing greater clinical benefit than salvage therapy. Initiation at 50-<75×109/L preserved chemotherapy continuity and reduced transfusion burden, while initiation at 75-<100×109/L optimized platelet recovery kinetics and cost-effectiveness.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled solid tumor patients with cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia receiving recombinant human thrombopoietin therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluating the impact of treatment timing with recombinant human thrombopoietin for cancer treatment–induced thrombocytopenia: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: One year of pembrolizumab treatment in patients with unresectable stage III-IV melanoma was feasible and appeared to provide outcomes comparable to a standard 24-month strategy. The approach may also reduce costs and improve access to immunotherapy in resource-constrained public health systems.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable stage III-IV melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Optimization of immunotherapy duration for advanced melanoma: The prospective OTIMAS trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world ES-SCLC cohort treated with first-line chemoimmunotherapy, ECOG PS and metastatic burden remained key prognostic factors. Concomitant PPIs, corticosteroids, and antibiotics were not independently associated with OS. The association between irAEs and OS was not confirmed by landmark analysis, highlighting the importance of time-dependent methods.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective multicenter cohort from 9 Spanish centers included patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated with first-line platinum-etoposide plus anti-PD-L1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prognostic factors and impact of concomitant medication in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) treated with first-line chemotherapy plus anti-PD-L1: A Spanish multicenter real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of fruquintinib and cadonilimab demonstrated promising clinical activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with refractory MSS/pMMR metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MSS/pMMR metastatic colorectal cancer presenting pulmonary metastases and no liver metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial of fruquintinib combined with cadonilimab in refractory MSS/pMMR colorectal cancer with pulmonary metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: The CAPCET study met its primary endpoint. mCapOX plus cetuximab demonstrated higher ORR/DCR and 2-year OS, with reduced toxicity, compared with mFOLFOX6 plus cetuximab. These findings support mCapOX plus cetuximab as a clinically effective, better-tolerated, and cost-effective first-line treatment for left-sided RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer within the Chinese economic framework.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients from China with left-side unresectable RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter randomized phase II trial assessing the efficacy and safety of mCapOX plus cetuximab with mFOLFOX6 plus cetuximab as first-line treatment for RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer: Updated results from the CAPCET study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Inhaled KB707 delivering IL-12/IL-2 in combination with pembrolizumab was well tolerated in heavily treated advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Encouraging antitumor effects were observed, with an objective response rate of 31.3% and disease control rate of 75%, and the study is continuing with an additional cohort evaluating inhaled KB707 plus docetaxel.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with at least one measurable lung lesion at screening and histological confirmation of stage 3 or 4 NSCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Inhaled delivery of KB707, a novel HSV-based immunotherapy, in combination with pembrolizumab in advanced non–small cell lung cancer: A phase 1/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The current results support a potential HER2 expression-guided option for second-line treatment of recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer. Cadonilimab plus disitamab vedotin demonstrated favorable efficacy and a manageable safety profile and may emerge as a novel effective combination for HER2-positive cervical cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of cadonilimab (CD) in combination with disitamab vedotin (RC48) or nab-paclitaxel (NP) in the treatment of recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer (r/mCC): A prospective, double-cohort, multicenter, open-label, phase II clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Subcutaneous amivantamab monotherapy demonstrated a confirmed objective response rate of 47% with rapid and durable responses in patients with HPV-unrelated recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell cancer after progression on immune checkpoint inhibitor and chemotherapy. The safety profile and tolerability were consistent with prior reports.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: HPV-unrelated R/M HNSCC after progression on platinum-based chemotherapy and a PD-(L)1 inhibitor - Cohort 1
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Amivantamab in HPV-unrelated recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell cancer after disease progression on immune checkpoint inhibitor and chemotherapy: Pivotal results from the phase 1b/2 OrigAMI-4 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patient-reported health-related quality of life was maintained with T-DXd in patients with HER2-positive unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Time to first deterioration was not negatively impacted with T-DXd, and mean change from baseline in all FACT-Ga subscales showed that patient symptoms and functioning remained stable, with some subscales favoring T-DXd versus RAM + PTX.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–positive unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including HER2+ disease defined as IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+ by local or central testing, were treated in the second-line setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Additional health-related quality of life (HRQoL) analysis from DESTINY-Gastric04 (DG-04), a randomized phase 3 study of trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) vs ramucirumab (RAM) + paclitaxel (PTX) in patients (pts) with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–positive (HER2+) unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer (GC)/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA).

data.clinical_result_summary: Among individuals experiencing taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy at the end of taxane treatment, nearly half experienced clinically meaningful improvement, but almost one fifth had worsening by the final 3-year assessment. Identifying clinical and correlative risk factors for persistent or worsening taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy after taxane treatment may support more informed decision-making about long-term taxane risks and help prioritize patients for prevention and treatment intervention studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants older than 18 years with Stage I-III primary lung, breast, or ovarian cancer who were starting treatment with a taxane-based regimen for a planned duration of 8 to 18 weeks were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-treatment recovery patterns among patients with early-stage cancer who develop taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy (TIPN): SWOG S1714 (NCT03939481).

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with resectable colorectal liver metastases and a low clinical risk score, adjuvant HAIP chemotherapy with floxuridine did not demonstrate an improvement in progression-free survival compared with resection alone. Mature overall survival results are expected in 2029.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable colorectal liver metastases and a low clinical risk score
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant hepatic arterial infusion pump chemotherapy with floxuridine for patients with resectable colorectal liver metastases and a low clinical risk score: A randomized controlled trial—The PUMP trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Recombinant human thrombopoietin therapy for cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia showed a threshold effect, with early intervention at platelet counts ≥50×109/L providing greater clinical benefit than salvage therapy. Initiation at 50-<75×109/L preserved chemotherapy continuity and reduced transfusion burden, while initiation at 75-<100×109/L optimized platelet recovery kinetics and cost-effectiveness.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled solid tumor patients with cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia receiving recombinant human thrombopoietin therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluating the impact of treatment timing with recombinant human thrombopoietin for cancer treatment–induced thrombocytopenia: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Analysis of safety and dosing data from BOLD-100-001 suggests a potential neuroprotective effect of BOLD-100 against FOLFOX-induced peripheral neuropathy. Further investigations are ongoing in a randomized arm of the BOLD-100-001 clinical trial to characterize this effect using health-related and neuropathy-related quality-of-life measures.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, biliary tract cancer, and pancreatic cancer with measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and BRAF wildtype tumor status were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neuroprotective potential of BOLD-100 when utilized in combination with FOLFOX for the treatment of advanced gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective cohort study, neither intravenous immunoglobulin nor prophylactic antibiotics showed superiority for preventing serious infections in patients with hypogammaglobulinemia receiving modern systemic therapy. Neither strategy improved outcomes compared with no prophylaxis, and the higher infection rate seen with IVIG likely reflects confounding by indication rather than a causal harm.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia or non-Hodgkin lymphoma initiating systemic therapy, including those with secondary hypogammaglobulinemia during systemic therapy and receiving Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors, venetoclax-based regimens, or anti-CD20 monoclonal antibodies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rethinking infection prevention after modern CLL and NHL therapy: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Analysis of safety and dosing data from BOLD-100-001 suggests a potential neuroprotective effect of BOLD-100 against FOLFOX-induced peripheral neuropathy. Further investigations are ongoing in a randomized arm of the BOLD-100-001 clinical trial to characterize this effect using health-related and neuropathy-related quality-of-life measures.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, biliary tract cancer, and pancreatic cancer with measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and BRAF wildtype tumor status were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neuroprotective potential of BOLD-100 when utilized in combination with FOLFOX for the treatment of advanced gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: This was the first trial to combine intravesical recombinant BCG with chemo-immunotherapy in muscle-invasive bladder cancer. The combination was feasible and safe without unexpected toxicities, and centrally assessed pCR and PaR rates were among the highest reported in an unselected MIBC population. Integration of intravesical recombinant BCG into novel MIBC treatment regimens appears highly promising, particularly for bladder-preservation approaches.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with cT2-T4a N0-1 muscle-invasive bladder cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intravesical recombinant BCG combined with chemo-immunotherapy (chemo-IO) as perioperative therapy for patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC): Primary analysis of SAKK 06/19.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world propensity-matched analysis, CAR-T therapy for B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia was associated with significantly higher short- and long-term mortality than blinatumomab. CAR-T also carried markedly increased risks of cytokine release syndrome and neurotoxicity in routine clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia treated with either CAR-T therapy or blinatumomab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative effectiveness and toxicity of CAR-T therapy versus blinatumomab in adult B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia: A real-world propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: PET imaging can quantitate CD8 T cells with sufficient specificity and sensitivity. These findings support further study of CD8 PET imaging for selecting patients for treatment regimens and assessing early response to therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with melanoma or Merkel cell cancer, renal cell cancer, or lung cancer/non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: iPREDICT: Phase II study of CD8 PET in patients with immunoresponsive solid tumors—Imaging characteristics and correlation with RECIST response.

data.clinical_result_summary: PRTH-101 shows evidence of activity in this early phase clinical trial, with outcomes correlating with DDR1 expression. Analysis by monotherapy and combination therapy in the context of PD-L1 expression suggests that PRTH-101 contributes to or is responsible for PFS in these patients. Further clinical evaluation of PRTH-101 alone and with pembrolizumab in patients with TEC and NSCLC is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced thymic epithelial cancers and non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PRTH-101: An investigational treatment for thoracic solid tumors targeting discoidin domain receptor (DDR1) and the tumor microenvironment (TME).

data.clinical_result_summary: Iber-DVd is an active and safe regimen for both transplant-eligible and transplant-ineligible patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. Response rates improved over time, and nearly half of patients achieved MRD negativity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of iberdomide, daratumumab, bortezomib, and dexamethasone in patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Chiauranib plus weekly paclitaxel significantly prolonged progression-free survival in patients with platinum-resistant or refractory ovarian cancer, with a manageable and predictable safety profile. Significant benefit was also observed in the subgroup previously treated with anti-angiogenic agents, supporting this regimen as a promising new treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant or refractory ovarian cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior lines of chemotherapy (1-2 vs ≥3) and platinum-free interval (≥6 months vs <6 months)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase III CHIPRO study of chiauranib plus weekly paclitaxel for platinum-resistant or refractory ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intra-arterial administration of high-dose rh-endostatin and cisplatin combined with systemic chemotherapy in osteosarcoma appeared safe in this preliminary phase II study. The regimen achieved a good histologic response rate of 50%, compared with a historical rate of 30% with intravenous chemotherapy alone.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed primary localized extremity conventional osteosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of continuous intra-arterial cisplatin and recombinant human endostatin combined with systemic chemotherapy in osteosarcoma: A phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant prolgolimab monotherapy achieved MPR rates above the historical benchmark with encouraging early event-free survival in resectable high-risk melanoma. MPR, especially pCR, was strongly associated with improved EFS, and no progressions were observed among patients with pCR. Exploratory analyses suggested that neither time from neoadjuvant treatment start to surgery nor receipt of adjuvant therapy materially affected EFS.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable high-risk melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant anti–PD-1 prolgolimab monotherapy in resectable high-risk melanoma: Pathologic response and early event-free survival in a prospective single-arm phase II CRISTINA study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preclinical studies demonstrated potent anti-tumor efficacy and a favorable pharmacokinetics and safety profile for T320. Early clinical data indicate manageable toxicity and promising activity, highlighted by durable stable disease in a patient with ovarian cancer. Further evaluation is ongoing in the Phase I clinical study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: T320 tissue factor-targeted ADC from pre-clinical research to phase I clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this ongoing phase 1 study, TQB6411 showed an impressive safety profile, with a lower incidence of higher-grade treatment-related adverse events, especially lower hematological toxicities. The study also showed encouraging efficacy, with tumor responses observed even in the relatively lower dose group.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase 1 study of TQB6411, an EGFR/c-Met bispecific antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: [68Ga]Ga-OncoCAIX showed an excellent safety profile and favourable biodistribution, with promising tumour-targeting properties in clear cell renal cell carcinoma lesions. These preliminary findings support its potential role for the detection and characterisation of clear cell renal cell carcinoma, with complete histopathology data needed to confirm diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with suspected primary or recurrent clear cell renal cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Diagnostic performance, safety, and biodistribution of [68Ga]Ga-OncoCAIX for PET/CT imaging: A first-in-human phase I clinical trial in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large, propensity-matched real-world study, T-DXd was associated with a significantly increased real-world risk of ILD and pneumonitis compared with trastuzumab. The findings underscore the need for heightened clinical vigilance when using T-DXd, including early recognition and management of respiratory symptoms.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer or malignant breast neoplasms from the TriNetX Dataworks–USA network who were treated with T-DXd or trastuzumab were included, while patients with prior ILD or pneumonitis were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world risk of interstitial lung disease and pneumonitis with trastuzumab deruxtecan vs trastuzumab in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer: A propensity score–matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: PET imaging can quantitate CD8 T cells with sufficient specificity and sensitivity. These findings support further study of CD8 PET imaging for selecting patients for treatment regimens and assessing early response to therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with melanoma or Merkel cell cancer, renal cell cancer, or lung cancer/non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: iPREDICT: Phase II study of CD8 PET in patients with immunoresponsive solid tumors—Imaging characteristics and correlation with RECIST response.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, BiTE therapy in multiple myeloma was associated with increased healthcare utilization and heart failure exacerbations without a statistically significant increase in mortality or thrombotic events. These findings emphasize the need for cardiovascular risk surveillance and multidisciplinary management in patients receiving BiTE therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with multiple myeloma treated with BiTE agents or BiTE-naive multiple myeloma controls.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cardiovascular outcomes after bispecific T-cell-engager therapy in multiple myeloma: A propensity-matched real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Recombinant human thrombopoietin therapy for cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia showed a threshold effect, with early intervention at platelet counts ≥50×109/L providing greater clinical benefit than salvage therapy. Initiation at 50-<75×109/L preserved chemotherapy continuity and reduced transfusion burden, while initiation at 75-<100×109/L optimized platelet recovery kinetics and cost-effectiveness.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled solid tumor patients with cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia receiving recombinant human thrombopoietin therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluating the impact of treatment timing with recombinant human thrombopoietin for cancer treatment–induced thrombocytopenia: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Carmustine wafer implantation added to standard temozolomide chemoradiotherapy did not significantly improve overall survival in newly diagnosed glioblastoma after ≥90% resection. Based on these findings, carmustine wafer implantation does not provide significant therapeutic or survival benefit when standard temozolomide chemoradiotherapy is feasible in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma considered resectable at ≥90%
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter randomized phase III study for newly diagnosed, maximally resected glioblastoma comparing carmustine wafer implantation followed by chemoradiotherapy with temozolomide versus chemoradiotherapy alone: Japan Clinical Oncology Group study JCOG1703 (MACS study).

data.clinical_result_summary: NCT04780568 showed that the combination of osimertinib and tegavivint was safe and tolerable as first-line therapy in patients with metastatic EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer. This novel combination has the potential to improve the depth and durability of response to EGFR TKIs without significantly increasing toxicity by targeting drug-tolerant persistence.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic EGFR-mutated NSCLC who had not received prior treatment with an EGFR TKI
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib study of osimertinib and tegavivint as first-line therapy in patients with metastatic EGFR-mutated non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Patient-reported health-related quality of life was maintained with T-DXd in patients with HER2-positive unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Time to first deterioration was not negatively impacted with T-DXd, and mean change from baseline in all FACT-Ga subscales showed that patient symptoms and functioning remained stable, with some subscales favoring T-DXd versus RAM + PTX.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–positive unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including HER2+ disease defined as IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+ by local or central testing, were treated in the second-line setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Additional health-related quality of life (HRQoL) analysis from DESTINY-Gastric04 (DG-04), a randomized phase 3 study of trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) vs ramucirumab (RAM) + paclitaxel (PTX) in patients (pts) with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–positive (HER2+) unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer (GC)/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA).

data.clinical_result_summary: Elacestrant plus capivasertib showed a manageable safety profile and clinically important efficacy in patients with AKT-pathway altered ER-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer with progressive disease. Enrollment in Phase 2 is ongoing, and the all-oral combination may provide potential extended clinical benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer and 1-2L of prior endocrine therapy with or without CDK4/6 inhibitor
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Elacestrant in combination with capivasertib in patients with ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer: Update from ELEVATE, a phase 1b/2, open-label, umbrella study.

data.clinical_result_summary: With approximately 4 years of median follow-up, preoperative tislelizumab combined with low-dose nab-paclitaxel continued to demonstrate robust and durable survival benefits for patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer. No new safety signals or late-onset immune-related adverse events were observed with extended follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: muscle-invasive urothelial bladder carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term survival update of TRUCE-01: A phase 2 study of preoperative tislelizumab combined with low-dose nab-paclitaxel for muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients treated with etentamig achieved durable responses, with higher response rates in patients who received CAR-T as the last line of therapy. No new safety signals were observed, and only low-grade cytokine release syndrome was seen despite no step-up dosing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with prior exposure to B-cell maturation antigen-targeted therapy- Arm B
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Etentamig in patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM) with prior exposure to B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA)–targeted therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of fruquintinib, camrelizumab, paclitaxel liposome, and nedaplatin demonstrated encouraging anti-tumor activity with a manageable toxicity profile as a first-line treatment for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Further investigation in larger, randomized studies is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fruquintinib in combination with camrelizumab, paclitaxel liposome, and nedaplatin as first-line treatment for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC): Updated results from a single-arm, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a large real-world cohort of patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer treated with osimertinib, smoking history was not associated with differences in overall survival or time to next treatment when smoking-related comorbidities were balanced. When real-world comorbidity burden was retained, smokers experienced significantly worse survival, suggesting that smoking-related comorbidities rather than smoking history alone may drive inferior outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged 18 years or older with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer who initiated osimertinib between 2015 and 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cigarette smoking on outcomes with osimertinib in EGFR-mutated non–small cell lung cancer: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity-matched real-world multiple myeloma cohort receiving BCMA CAR-T, pre-index severe cytopenia was associated with higher subsequent rates and earlier onset of anemia and prolonged cytopenia beginning 30 days post-index. There was no detectable increase in hospitalization or CRS/HLH/ICANS, supporting enhanced cytopenia monitoring and proactive supportive care in patients with severe cytopenia before CAR-T.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with multiple myeloma who received BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy with idecabtagene vicleucel or ciltacabtagene autoleucel between January 1, 2021 and January 1, 2025, stratified by the presence or absence of severe cytopenia within 3 months on or before multiple myeloma diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of baseline severe cytopenia on post–BCMA CAR T-cell therapy outcomes in multiple myeloma: A propensity-matched multicenter study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter, real-world analysis, first-line treatment with ipilimumab/nivolumab and durvalumab/tremelimumab demonstrated similar survival benefits at 1, 2, and 3 years. However, ipilimumab/nivolumab demonstrated a significantly superior gastrointestinal safety profile, with reductions in hepatic encephalopathy, portal vein thrombosis, and ascites compared with durvalumab/tremelimumab at 3 years. Future prospective head-to-head comparisons are warranted to better understand these associations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 18-90 years with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma who were treated with first-line ipilimumab/nivolumab or durvalumab/tremelimumab were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative survival and long-term gastrointestinal outcomes of ipilimumab/nivolumab vs durvalumab/tremelimumab in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this small preliminary study, T-DM1 plus ribociclib achieved an ORR of 41.7% in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer. No clear PFS benefit was observed regardless of ER status, and overlapping hematologic toxicities, especially thrombocytopenia, were notable and warrant consideration in future combination strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) combined with ribociclib in patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (RibHER).

data.clinical_result_summary: PRTH-101 shows evidence of activity in this early phase clinical trial, with outcomes correlating with DDR1 expression. Analysis by monotherapy and combination therapy in the context of PD-L1 expression suggests that PRTH-101 contributes to or is responsible for PFS in these patients. Further clinical evaluation of PRTH-101 alone and with pembrolizumab in patients with TEC and NSCLC is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced thymic epithelial cancers and non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PRTH-101: An investigational treatment for thoracic solid tumors targeting discoidin domain receptor (DDR1) and the tumor microenvironment (TME).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination therapy of transarterial embolization plus hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy with camrelizumab and rivoceranib significantly improved objective response rate and progression-free survival in patients with initially unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma with high tumor burden. The regimen showed a manageable safety profile, and further large-scale randomized trials are warranted to validate these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with initially unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma with high tumor burden
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Transarterial embolization plus hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy combined with rivoceranib and camrelizumab for initially unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma with high tumor burden: A single-arm, prospective, multicenter study.

data.clinical_result_summary: [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT demonstrated the strongest agreement with surgico-pathological PCI and maintained good agreement after recent chemotherapy. It showed higher detectability than MRI and [18F]FDG PET/CT, although with lower specificity, supporting [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT as a promising modality for preoperative peritoneal carcinomatosis mapping.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with colorectal or ovarian cancer with known or suspected peritoneal carcinomatosis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preoperative assessment of peritoneal carcinomatosis with [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT.

data.clinical_result_summary: EIK1005 had a favorable safety profile at the 50 and 100 mg single doses evaluated in healthy participants. PK and safety data support a starting dose of 50 mg in patients in EIK1005-002.
clinical_result_indication_detail: healthy participants
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and PK of EIK1005, a novel WRN inhibitor in healthy participants.

data.clinical_result_summary: Analysis of safety and dosing data from BOLD-100-001 suggests a potential neuroprotective effect of BOLD-100 against FOLFOX-induced peripheral neuropathy. Further investigations are ongoing in a randomized arm of the BOLD-100-001 clinical trial to characterize this effect using health-related and neuropathy-related quality-of-life measures.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, biliary tract cancer, and pancreatic cancer with measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and BRAF wildtype tumor status were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neuroprotective potential of BOLD-100 when utilized in combination with FOLFOX for the treatment of advanced gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ori-C101 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and compelling, durable anti-tumor activity in GPC3-positive advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. The high objective response rate and prolonged survival benefit suggest Ori-C101 may be a potential paradigm-shifting therapy for patients who have failed standard-of-care treatments.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with GPC3+ advanced hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Objective response rates with Ori-C101, an armored GPC3-directed CAR-T, in heavily pretreated advanced HCC: Updated results from the phase Ib BEACON study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pembrolizumab-based neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy was associated with significantly higher rates of pathologic complete response compared with other neoadjuvant regimens, despite more advanced disease at presentation. Achievement of pathologic complete response was strongly prognostic and associated with lower mortality risk. Survival differences by treatment strategy were not observed, likely due to limited follow-up and sample size, but the findings support the use of pembrolizumab-based neoadjuvant therapy in this safety-net setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with stage II–III triple-negative breast cancer at JPS Health Network between 01/01/2019 and 12/31/2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant systemic therapy for triple-negative breast cancer: A safety-net health system’s experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: QLS31905 plus chemotherapy in first-line treatment for Claudin18.2-positive patients with pancreatic cancer and gastric cancer showed manageable safety and potential efficacy. A phase 3 trial is ongoing to further confirm the efficacy and safety of QLS31905 in patients with pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Claudin 18.2-positive patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic pancreatic cancer (Cohort 1)
Claudin 18.2-positive patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic gastric cancer (Cohort 2)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line treatment of QLS31905 plus chemotherapy in patients with pancreatic cancer and gastric cancer: Data from a phase 1b/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prior immunotherapy was associated with a near three-fold increase in sotorasib-induced hepatotoxicity risk, independent of washout interval. Initiating sotorasib within 6 weeks of ICI was associated with an approximately two-fold increase in colitis/diarrhea risk, supporting a 6-week washout to minimize severe gastrointestinal adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with KRAS G12C-mutated advanced NSCLC treated with sotorasib following immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, with baseline AST/ALT ≤120 U/L required.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of immunotherapy on sotorasib toxicity in NSCLC: A real-world matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: At the interim analysis, ORR and DoR results from the prospective TRITON study support a role for adding anti-CTLA-4 tremelimumab to first-line anti-PD-L1 durvalumab plus chemotherapy in patients with STK11, KEAP1 and/or KRAS-mutated metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Safety was similar between the two arms and consistent with known safety profiles.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-naïve, EGFR/ALK wild-type, non-squamous metastatic non-small cell lung cancer and STK11, KEAP1 and/or KRAS mutations
clinical_result_layer_factor: mut type and tumor PD-L1 expression (≥1% vs <1%)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tremelimumab (T) + durvalumab (D) + chemotherapy (CT) vs pembrolizumab (P) + CT in 1L non-squamous (NSQ) metastatic NSCLC (mNSCLC) with STK11, KEAP1, and/or KRAS mutations (mut): Interim analysis (IA) of the phase 2b TRITON study.

data.clinical_result_summary: ANK-101, the first anchored immunotherapy, was associated with QOL scores that were not significantly diminished in heavily pre-treated advanced cancer patients, with a non-significant decrease in social and physical well-being among those who developed grade 2 or greater adverse events. Patients with visceral tumors had no difference in QOL compared with those with superficial lesions. Early implementation of QOL data is feasible in phase 1 trials and may help identify drug impact on clinical and safety measures.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled heavily pre-treated patients with advanced/metastatic solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Quality of life in cancer patients treated with anchored interleukin-12 (IL-12) immunotherapy: Results from a first-in-human phase 1 trial of tolododekin alfa (ANK-101).

data.clinical_result_summary: Among individuals experiencing taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy at the end of taxane treatment, nearly half experienced clinically meaningful improvement, but almost one fifth had worsening by the final 3-year assessment. Identifying clinical and correlative risk factors for persistent or worsening taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy after taxane treatment may support more informed decision-making about long-term taxane risks and help prioritize patients for prevention and treatment intervention studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants older than 18 years with Stage I-III primary lung, breast, or ovarian cancer who were starting treatment with a taxane-based regimen for a planned duration of 8 to 18 weeks were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-treatment recovery patterns among patients with early-stage cancer who develop taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy (TIPN): SWOG S1714 (NCT03939481).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective cohort study, neither intravenous immunoglobulin nor prophylactic antibiotics showed superiority for preventing serious infections in patients with hypogammaglobulinemia receiving modern systemic therapy. Neither strategy improved outcomes compared with no prophylaxis, and the higher infection rate seen with IVIG likely reflects confounding by indication rather than a causal harm.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia or non-Hodgkin lymphoma initiating systemic therapy, including those with secondary hypogammaglobulinemia during systemic therapy and receiving Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors, venetoclax-based regimens, or anti-CD20 monoclonal antibodies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rethinking infection prevention after modern CLL and NHL therapy: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fasting-state metabolic modulation during neoadjuvant chemoradiation was associated with a striking increase in pathological complete response rates in locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma. Glucose restriction may enhance tumor radiosensitivity through mitochondrial stress, increased reactive oxygen species, and impaired metabolic compensation. Precision-guided fasting represents a promising, low-cost therapeutic strategy warranting prospective larger cohort validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma and cT3N+ disease were analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Targeting the Warburg effect: Mitochondrial metabolic modulation with intermittent fasting during neoadjuvant chemoradiation in rectal cancer compared with standard neoadjuvant chemoradiation and total neoadjuvant therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Delivering all eight cycles of FLOT exclusively in the neoadjuvant setting was feasible and safe in this Brazilian real-world cohort, with high adherence and encouraging survival outcomes. This strategy may represent a pragmatic alternative in scenarios of low compliance with adjuvant treatment or limited access to postoperative chemotherapy, warranting prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 32 consecutive patients at a Brazilian reference center with resectable gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma (≥cT2 and/or cN+) who were treated between 2019 and 2024 with neoadjuvant FLOT followed by surgery.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Exclusive neoadjuvant chemotherapy with the FLOT regimen protocol in resectable gastric cancer: A retrospective cohort study in a Brazilian reference center.

data.clinical_result_summary: This long-term retrospective study suggests comparable systemic disease control, including PFS and OS, between THP and PyHT in first-line treatment of HER2-positive advanced breast cancer. PyHT was associated with a higher response rate and a signal toward delayed CNS evolution, reflected by longer BMFS, but caused increased gastrointestinal toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients in China with HER2-positive advanced breast cancer treated with first-line THP or PyHT.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pyrotinib versus pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and taxane as first-line therapy for HER2-positive advanced breast cancer: A retrospective cohort study using propensity score overlap weighting.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of Medicare beneficiaries aged 65 years or older with CLL/SLL, first-line zanubrutinib monotherapy was associated with better survival and treatment outcomes than ibrutinib or acalabrutinib. Similar results were observed across age subgroups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were aged 65 years or older with a CLL/SLL diagnosis, had at least 12 months of enrollment before first-line therapy, and started first-line BTKi monotherapy between 01/01/2020 and 06/30/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes among Medicare beneficiaries treated with first-line (1L) Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors (BTKis) for chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL).
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: Localized (Z)-n-butylidenephthalide wafers were associated with a median overall survival of 14.5 months in heavily pretreated patients with recurrent glioblastoma, exceeding historical controls by 6-9 months. Favorable tolerability, preserved performance status, and an observed epigenetic methylation change support further investigation in a randomized trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients With Recurrent High Grade Glioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Localized (Z)-n-butylidenephthalide biodegradable wafer as surgical adjuvant in recurrent glioblastoma for extending survival and re-sensitizing chemotherapy: A compassionate use study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study initially confirms that liposomal irinotecan combined with oxaliplatin plus 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin with or without camrelizumab as preoperative chemotherapy for borderline resectable pancreatic cancer effectively controls tumor progression and improves the R0 resection rate with good safety. The regimen provides a potential preoperative chemotherapy option for patients with borderline resectable pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients had histologically/cytologically confirmed BRPC, ECOG PS 0-1, and no prior systemic antineoplastic therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Liposomal irinotecan combined with oxaliplatin, 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin with or without camrelizumab as preoperative chemotherapy for borderline resectable pancreatic cancer: Preliminary results of a single-center phase II exploratory study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Luvometinib achieved a statistically significant confirmed objective response rate per Blinded Independent Review Committee compared with placebo in adults with NF1 and symptomatic, inoperable plexiform neurofibromas. Responses were rapid and durable, pain severity was significantly reduced, and the safety profile was overall manageable, suggesting luvometinib may become a new standard treatment for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with neurofibromatosis type 1 and symptomatic, inoperable plexiform neurofibromas
clinical_result_layer_factor: baseline NRS-11 tumor pain score (≥2 or <2)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Luvometinib in adults with neurofibromatosis type 1 and symptomatic, inoperable plexiform neurofibromas: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Analysis of safety and dosing data from BOLD-100-001 suggests a potential neuroprotective effect of BOLD-100 against FOLFOX-induced peripheral neuropathy. Further investigations are ongoing in a randomized arm of the BOLD-100-001 clinical trial to characterize this effect using health-related and neuropathy-related quality-of-life measures.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, biliary tract cancer, and pancreatic cancer with measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and BRAF wildtype tumor status were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neuroprotective potential of BOLD-100 when utilized in combination with FOLFOX for the treatment of advanced gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this cohort, Y-90 selective internal radiation therapy plus atezolizumab and bevacizumab achieved a 61.9% objective response rate with manageable toxicity in patients with unresectable huge hepatocellular carcinoma. These findings warrant prospective trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with unresectable huge hepatocellular carcinoma with maximum diameter >10 cm, Child-Pugh class A/B, ECOG performance status 0/1, and completion of at least 2 treatment cycles.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Yttrium-90 SIRT plus atezolizumab/bevacizumab in unresectable huge HCC (>10 cm): A multicenter retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Persistent PSMA-avid disease was seen in all patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer after 6 months of ADT+ARPI with or without docetaxel, regardless of PSA at 6 months. Patients with 6-month PSA >0.2 ng/mL had significantly higher TTV and SUVmax on 6-month PSMA-PET, and TTV best correlated with PSA levels at baseline and 6 months. Six-month PSMA-PET could identify patients with suboptimal initial response to standard therapy for potential consolidative therapeutic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer by conventional imaging and planned to start androgen deprivation therapy plus an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor with or without docetaxel; primary or metastasis-directed radiotherapy was not permitted during the first 6 months.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Quantitative results from PSMAtrack: A prospective study evaluating changes in PSMA-PET during initial systemic therapy for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: PET imaging can quantitate CD8 T cells with sufficient specificity and sensitivity. These findings support further study of CD8 PET imaging for selecting patients for treatment regimens and assessing early response to therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with melanoma or Merkel cell cancer, renal cell cancer, or lung cancer/non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: iPREDICT: Phase II study of CD8 PET in patients with immunoresponsive solid tumors—Imaging characteristics and correlation with RECIST response.

data.clinical_result_summary: SEQ1 did not improve the 36-month progression-free survival rate versus SEQ2. However, starting with SEQ1 yielded superior early efficacy, including higher objective response rate and longer PFS1, which may be clinically relevant in a subset of patients. Molecular profiling, genomic correlation analyses, and longer follow-up for total PFS and overall survival are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated RAS wild-type, left-sided, unresectable metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase III CR-SEQUENCE trial of FOLFOX+panitumumab followed by FOLFIRI+bevacizumab (SEQ1) versus FOLFOX + bevacizumab followed by FOLFIRI + panitumumab (SEQ2) in previously untreated RAS wild-type, left-sided, unresectable metastatic colorectal cancer.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: ALK201 demonstrated a favorable safety profile in patients with pretreated advanced solid tumors. Promising anti-cancer activity was observed at doses of 7.2 mg/kg and above, warranting further investigation at those effective dose levels.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of ALK201, a FGFR2b-targeting antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) for patients (pts) with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative tislelizumab plus neoadjuvant chemotherapy improved event-free survival in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer across surgically relevant subgroups regardless of disease stage or surgery type. These results support tislelizumab plus chemotherapy as an efficacious and safe treatment option that may reduce the burden of invasive surgery.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resectable stage II-IIIA non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RATIONALE-315: Post hoc analysis of event-free survival by surgically relevant subgroups treated with perioperative tislelizumab and neoadjuvant chemotherapy vs neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: [68Ga]Ga-OncoCAIX showed an excellent safety profile and favourable biodistribution, with promising tumour-targeting properties in clear cell renal cell carcinoma lesions. These preliminary findings support its potential role for the detection and characterisation of clear cell renal cell carcinoma, with complete histopathology data needed to confirm diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with suspected primary or recurrent clear cell renal cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Diagnostic performance, safety, and biodistribution of [68Ga]Ga-OncoCAIX for PET/CT imaging: A first-in-human phase I clinical trial in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this randomized, placebo-controlled trial, avatrombopag demonstrated safety, tolerability, and efficacy in the treatment and prevention of persistent chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in gastrointestinal cancers. These findings are promising for a common, serious condition that prevents delivery of full-dose, on-time cancer-directed therapy.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的血小板减少
clinical_result_indication_detail: GI cancer patients with persistent chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Avatrombopag for chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in gastrointestinal malignancies (ACT-GI): A multicenter, U.S., randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This long-term retrospective study suggests comparable systemic disease control, including PFS and OS, between THP and PyHT in first-line treatment of HER2-positive advanced breast cancer. PyHT was associated with a higher response rate and a signal toward delayed CNS evolution, reflected by longer BMFS, but caused increased gastrointestinal toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients in China with HER2-positive advanced breast cancer treated with first-line THP or PyHT.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pyrotinib versus pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and taxane as first-line therapy for HER2-positive advanced breast cancer: A retrospective cohort study using propensity score overlap weighting.

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with GnRH agonists was associated with significantly higher rates of major adverse cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality compared with GnRH antagonists among patients with prostate cancer. Prospective randomized studies are needed to inform individualized treatment decisions.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with prostate cancer, including Stage I to IV disease, were identified and separated into cohorts based on initiation of leuprolide or degarelix or relugolix within 1 year of the index diagnosis event.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A retrospective analysis of cardiovascular outcomes in patients with prostate cancer treated with upfront gonadotropin-releasing agonist versus antagonists utilizing real-world data.

data.clinical_result_summary: Early data from this cohort are highly encouraging, with ORR 24% and DCR 65%. BI-1808 plus pembrolizumab demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising activity in advanced heavily pretreated ovarian cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent ovarian cancer who have progressed following platinum-based therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BI‑1808 + pembrolizumab: Responses to a chemotherapy‑free regimen in advanced ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Olomorasib plus pembrolizumab demonstrated promising efficacy as first-line treatment for KRAS G12C-mutant advanced NSCLC with PD-L1 expression below 50%. Response rates compared favorably with historical outcomes for pembrolizumab and chemo-immunotherapy in unselected advanced NSCLC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with KRAS G12C–mutant advanced NSCLC, and PD-L1 expression 0-49%
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) olomorasib + pembrolizumab in patients with KRAS G12C–mutant advanced NSCLC, and PD-L1 expression 0-49%, from the dose optimization cohorts of LOXO-RAS-20001 and SUNRAY-01.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with metastatic uveal melanoma, IPI+PD1 demonstrated a higher objective response rate but did not improve survival compared with PD1 alone. IPI+PD1 was more toxic, leading to early treatment discontinuation in one-quarter of patients. These findings may help guide treatment selection in metastatic uveal melanoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic uveal melanoma treated with PD1 or IPI+PD1 at 15 major melanoma centres from Australia, Europe, United States and Israel were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Anti–PD-1 (PD-1) monotherapy versus combination with anti–CTLA-4 for metastatic uveal melanoma (MUM) patients (pts).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 主要/特别关注的不良事件（AEPIs）
主要/特别关注的不良事件
data.clinical_result_summary: In this interim analysis, TACE in combination with ablation followed by durvalumab showed a manageable safety profile without unexpected toxicity and demonstrated promising early efficacy in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma. Further follow-up is needed to determine overall survival benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma who are unsuitable for surgical resection
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 主要/特别关注的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Interim analysis of TAD: A phase 2 single-arm open-label study of combination therapy of transarterial chemoembolization and ablation with durvalumab in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of penpulimab and cetuximab demonstrated favorable clinical efficacy and a manageable safety profile in patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, supporting its potential as a first-line treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Penpulimab (AK105) combined with cetuximab as first-line treatment in recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC): A phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first report in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma for the combination of belantamab mafodotin with a CD38 monoclonal antibody showed promising preliminary activity. The ISABELA regimen achieved an ORR of 86% and 16-month PFS of 73%, including in quad-class-exposed patients treated with anti-BCMA therapy, with manageable and reversible adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ISABELA: A phase 2 study of isatuximab, belantamab mafodotin, pomalidomide, and dexamethasone in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large, propensity-matched real-world study, T-DXd was associated with a significantly increased real-world risk of ILD and pneumonitis compared with trastuzumab. The findings underscore the need for heightened clinical vigilance when using T-DXd, including early recognition and management of respiratory symptoms.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer or malignant breast neoplasms from the TriNetX Dataworks–USA network who were treated with T-DXd or trastuzumab were included, while patients with prior ILD or pneumonitis were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world risk of interstitial lung disease and pneumonitis with trastuzumab deruxtecan vs trastuzumab in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer: A propensity score–matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccination within 100 days of ICI therapy was associated with improved survival across solid tumors. These results suggest off-the-shelf RNA therapeutics may be scalable, cost-effective enhancers of cancer immunotherapy, but prospective studies are needed to confirm these findings and define the impact of universal mRNA strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with solid tumors, including NSCLC, melanoma, colorectal, hepatobiliary, gallbladder, gastric, bladder, pancreatic, renal, breast, head and neck, and esophageal tumors, who received ICI treatment were included; patients with COVID-19 infection within 100 days and through the follow-up period were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of COVID-19 mRNA vaccines on survival outcomes in patients with solid tumors receiving immunotherapy: A large-scale retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Alrizomadlin alone or in combination with lisaftoclax showed a manageable safety profile, with preliminary antitumor activity in heavily pretreated relapsed/refractory rhabdomyosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, and neuroblastoma. The potential mechanisms, safety, and efficacy of alrizomadlin combined with lisaftoclax for pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma and other soft-tissue sarcomas warrant further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma or other soft-tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Alrizomadlin (APG-115) alone or in combination with lisaftoclax (APG-2575) for the treatment of pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) or other soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of fruquintinib and cadonilimab demonstrated promising clinical activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with refractory MSS/pMMR metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MSS/pMMR metastatic colorectal cancer presenting pulmonary metastases and no liver metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial of fruquintinib combined with cadonilimab in refractory MSS/pMMR colorectal cancer with pulmonary metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adebelimab combined with molecularly stratified targeted therapy and liposomal irinotecan-based chemotherapy showed substantial efficacy and favorable safety for unresectable microsatellite stable colorectal cancer liver metastases, with excellent hepatic metastasis control. The high conversion-to-resection rate and 35.7% hepatic TRG 0 rate suggest potential for deep pathological response, warranting further investigation as a promising conversion therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable microsatellite stable colorectal cancer liver metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The CONVERGE study: A phase II, single-arm trial of adebelimab combined with targeted therapy and liposomal irinotecan-based chemotherapy for conversion surgery in unresectable MSS colorectal cancer liver metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: The PERFORM IA5 supports treatment-free interval as a relevant prognostic factor in patients treated with palbociclib plus endocrine therapy in the first-line real-world setting. Quality of life was maintained across treatment-free interval subgroups, and the longest clinical benefit was observed in patients with treatment-free interval >12 months and those with de novo disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HR+/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer across Germany and Austria receiving first-line palbociclib plus endocrine therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effectiveness outcomes by treatment-free interval among patients receiving palbociclib plus endocrine therapy in HR+/HER2− advanced breast cancer in the real-world setting: Results from the PERFORM study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Weekly intratumoral ipilimumab plus AS01B and bi-weekly low-dose intravenous nivolumab, with or without a single intratumoral injection of autologous myDC, was safe and resulted in durable tumor responses in a meaningful subset of advanced pretreated melanoma patients. Additional follow-up is needed to estimate the added value of intratumoral myDC in this investigational intratumoral immunotherapy regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced pretreated melanoma patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase II clinical trial on intratumoral autologous CD1c (BDCA-1)+/CD141 (BDCA-3)+ myeloid dendritic cells (myDC) plus ipilimumab (IPI) and synthetic adjuvant AS01B combined with low-dose intravenous (IV) nivolumab (NIVO) in advanced pretreated melanoma patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: BTN1A1 is consistently and highly expressed in refractory colorectal cancer and is closely integrated with key immune checkpoints and tumor markers within the tumor microenvironment. Initial clinical results showed disease control in the majority of patients, particularly within the TPS ≥50 population, supporting BTN1A1 as a predictive biomarker for nelmastobart combination therapy and justifying the ongoing biomarker-driven Phase 2 portion of STCUBE-003.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic or recurrent colorectal cancer refractory or intolerant to oxaliplatin- and irinotecan-based therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Multiplexed immunohistochemistry (mIHC) analysis and clinical outcomes of nelmastobart in combination with trifluridine/tipiracil and bevacizumab in patients with refractory colorectal cancer (phase 1b/2).

data.clinical_result_summary: NP137 in combination with mFOLFIRINOX showed a favorable safety profile, promising clinical activity, and a mechanistically distinct mode of action supported by translational analyses. These findings support further investigation of netrin-1 blockade in randomized trials and biomarker-driven development of NP137 in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with naive locally advanced unresectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: LAP-NET1: Results of a phase 1b evaluating NP137, an inhibitor of the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, in combination with mFOLFIRINOX for the first-line treatment of locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: CONV01-α at the recommended phase 2 dose of DL45 was well tolerated and showed promising activity in a heavily pretreated Lu-PSMA-exposed metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer population with limited therapeutic options. Subsequent expansion is continuing at DL45, and a pivotal study is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with Lu-PSMA-pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (part 3)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CONVERGE-01 part 3: Ac-225 rosopatamab tetraxetan (CONV01-α) in Lu-PSMA-pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity-matched real-world multiple myeloma cohort receiving BCMA CAR-T, pre-index severe cytopenia was associated with higher subsequent rates and earlier onset of anemia and prolonged cytopenia beginning 30 days post-index. There was no detectable increase in hospitalization or CRS/HLH/ICANS, supporting enhanced cytopenia monitoring and proactive supportive care in patients with severe cytopenia before CAR-T.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with multiple myeloma who received BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy with idecabtagene vicleucel or ciltacabtagene autoleucel between January 1, 2021 and January 1, 2025, stratified by the presence or absence of severe cytopenia within 3 months on or before multiple myeloma diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of baseline severe cytopenia on post–BCMA CAR T-cell therapy outcomes in multiple myeloma: A propensity-matched multicenter study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Spatial omics analyses identified transcriptional programs associated with sunitinib response and resistance in metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma. These findings may help stratify patients and inform combination treatment strategies to mitigate TKI resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma received sunitinib pre- and post-cytoreductive nephrectomy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Spatial transcriptomic profiling of the tumor microenvironment associated with sunitinib response in metastatic renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Chidamide in combination with CHOP demonstrated promising efficacy with a manageable safety profile in previously untreated peripheral T-cell lymphoma with T-follicular helper phenotype patients. A randomized controlled trial is currently ongoing to further validate these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: previously untreated PTCL-TFH patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chidamide in combination with CHOP in previously untreated peripheral T-cell lymphoma with T follicular helper phenotype: Results of the phase II SWIFT trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of Medicare beneficiaries aged 65 years or older with CLL/SLL, first-line zanubrutinib monotherapy was associated with better survival and treatment outcomes than ibrutinib or acalabrutinib. Similar results were observed across age subgroups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were aged 65 years or older with a CLL/SLL diagnosis, had at least 12 months of enrollment before first-line therapy, and started first-line BTKi monotherapy between 01/01/2020 and 06/30/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes among Medicare beneficiaries treated with first-line (1L) Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors (BTKis) for chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL).
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: Patient-reported health-related quality of life was maintained with T-DXd in patients with HER2-positive unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Time to first deterioration was not negatively impacted with T-DXd, and mean change from baseline in all FACT-Ga subscales showed that patient symptoms and functioning remained stable, with some subscales favoring T-DXd versus RAM + PTX.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–positive unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including HER2+ disease defined as IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+ by local or central testing, were treated in the second-line setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Additional health-related quality of life (HRQoL) analysis from DESTINY-Gastric04 (DG-04), a randomized phase 3 study of trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) vs ramucirumab (RAM) + paclitaxel (PTX) in patients (pts) with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–positive (HER2+) unresectable/metastatic gastric cancer (GC)/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, chemo-immunotherapy significantly improved 1- and 2-year overall survival compared with chemotherapy in patients with cholangiocarcinoma. Hematologic toxicity was manageable and immune-related adverse events were infrequent, supporting chemo-immunotherapy as first-line therapy in diverse patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with intrahepatic or extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma treated between January 1, 2000, and December 31, 2024 were included, excluding those with prior malignancies or pre-index treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world survival outcomes of patients with cholangiocarcinoma receiving chemotherapy versus chemo‑immunotherapy: A TriNetX database analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective cohort study, neither intravenous immunoglobulin nor prophylactic antibiotics showed superiority for preventing serious infections in patients with hypogammaglobulinemia receiving modern systemic therapy.
