Neither strategy improved outcomes compared with no prophylaxis, and the higher infection rate seen with IVIG likely reflects confounding by indication rather than a causal harm.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia or non-Hodgkin lymphoma initiating systemic therapy, including those with secondary hypogammaglobulinemia during systemic therapy and receiving Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors, venetoclax-based regimens, or anti-CD20 monoclonal antibodies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rethinking infection prevention after modern CLL and NHL therapy: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: BL-M14D1 demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a tolerable safety profile at dose levels of 4.0 mg/kg and 4.5 mg/kg every 3 weeks in heavily pretreated patients with small-cell lung cancer and neuroendocrine carcinoma. These findings support further clinical development of BL-M14D1 in small-cell lung cancer and other less common neuroendocrine carcinomas, with phase III studies in preparation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic NEC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic SCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of BL-M14D1, a novel DLL3-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with locally advanced or metastatic small-cell lung cancer (SCLC), neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC), and other solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: PRAME-directed TCR T-cell therapies showed a safety profile consistent with previous observations and demonstrated promising antitumor activity in patients with synovial sarcoma despite low doses. The responses appeared durable and deepened over time, supporting further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced or recurrent synovial sarcoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 study results with PRAME-directed T-cell receptor (TCR) T-cell therapies in synovial sarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: FRPV following oral cyclophosphamide was safe, with no vaccine-related high-grade adverse events. However, no significant improvement in disease-free survival or overall survival was observed in the overall study population, although a numerical trend toward improved DFS was seen in patients with stage III triple-negative breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: women ≥18 years with triple-negative breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: chemotherapy setting (adjuvant only vs neoadjuvant) and stage (I/II vs III)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase II trial of folate receptor alpha peptide vaccine in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective cohort study, neither intravenous immunoglobulin nor prophylactic antibiotics showed superiority for preventing serious infections in patients with hypogammaglobulinemia receiving modern systemic therapy. Neither strategy improved outcomes compared with no prophylaxis, and the higher infection rate seen with IVIG likely reflects confounding by indication rather than a causal harm.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia or non-Hodgkin lymphoma initiating systemic therapy, including those with secondary hypogammaglobulinemia during systemic therapy and receiving Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors, venetoclax-based regimens, or anti-CD20 monoclonal antibodies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rethinking infection prevention after modern CLL and NHL therapy: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: PET imaging can quantitate CD8 T cells with sufficient specificity and sensitivity. These findings support further study of CD8 PET imaging for selecting patients for treatment regimens and assessing early response to therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with melanoma or Merkel cell cancer, renal cell cancer, or lung cancer/non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: iPREDICT: Phase II study of CD8 PET in patients with immunoresponsive solid tumors—Imaging characteristics and correlation with RECIST response.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary data from DDRiver 501 Module 3 demonstrate that M9466 with abiraterone acetate and prednisone/prednisolone is generally well tolerated and shows antitumor activity in androgen receptor pathway inhibitor-pretreated patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer or metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) or metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC) (Module 3)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and preliminary efficacy of M9466 (HRS-1167) in combination with abiraterone acetate and prednisone/prednisolone (AA-P) in patients (pts) with metastatic prostate cancer in the phase 1 DDRiver 501 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: PRTH-101 shows evidence of activity in this early phase clinical trial, with outcomes correlating with DDR1 expression. Analysis by monotherapy and combination therapy in the context of PD-L1 expression suggests that PRTH-101 contributes to or is responsible for PFS in these patients. Further clinical evaluation of PRTH-101 alone and with pembrolizumab in patients with TEC and NSCLC is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced thymic epithelial cancers and non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PRTH-101: An investigational treatment for thoracic solid tumors targeting discoidin domain receptor (DDR1) and the tumor microenvironment (TME).

data.clinical_result_summary: Durvalumab plus lurbinectedin demonstrated manageable toxicity in platinum-resistant extensive-stage small cell lung cancer after chemoimmunotherapy. However, the regimen did not meet the prespecified 6-month progression-free survival efficacy threshold, supporting the need for alternative strategies in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant relapsed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer after prior chemoimmunotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: MC1923: Phase II durvalumab plus lurbinectedin in platinum-resistant relapsed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer after prior chemoimmunotherapy (cohort B).

data.clinical_result_summary: The PERFORM IA5 supports treatment-free interval as a relevant prognostic factor in patients treated with palbociclib plus endocrine therapy in the first-line real-world setting. Quality of life was maintained across treatment-free interval subgroups, and the longest clinical benefit was observed in patients with treatment-free interval >12 months and those with de novo disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HR+/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer across Germany and Austria receiving first-line palbociclib plus endocrine therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effectiveness outcomes by treatment-free interval among patients receiving palbociclib plus endocrine therapy in HR+/HER2− advanced breast cancer in the real-world setting: Results from the PERFORM study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Alrizomadlin alone or in combination with lisaftoclax showed a manageable safety profile, with preliminary antitumor activity in heavily pretreated relapsed/refractory rhabdomyosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, and neuroblastoma. The potential mechanisms, safety, and efficacy of alrizomadlin combined with lisaftoclax for pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma and other soft-tissue sarcomas warrant further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma or other soft-tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Alrizomadlin (APG-115) alone or in combination with lisaftoclax (APG-2575) for the treatment of pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) or other soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs).

data.clinical_result_summary: In Simon's stage 1, three patients achieved confirmed partial response, meeting criteria to proceed to stage 2. VV1 plus cemiplimab showed promise as a first-line chemotherapy-free regimen in recurrent or metastatic HNSCC.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma from primary oropharynx, oral cavity, hypopharynx, or larynx sites with CPS ≥1
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 study of intratumoral oncolytic VV1 plus cemiplimab: Simon's stage 1 results from head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW27011 showed a manageable safety profile and encouraging survival outcome in patients with PDAC expressing CLDN18.2. These findings support further clinical development of XNW27011 as a promising therapeutic option for patients with PDAC expressing CLDN18.2.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma expressing CLDN18.2
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of XNW27011, a Claudin-18.2 targeted (CLDN18.2) ADC, in advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: A phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: A2B694 showed manageable safety and tolerability in patients with advanced solid MSLN-expressing tumors with tumor-associated HLA-A*02 loss of heterozygosity. The maximum tolerated dose has not yet been reached, and dose escalation is continuing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic cancers with MSLN expression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial safety and efficacy of A2B694, a logic-gated mesothelin (MSLN)–targeted Tmod chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR T) therapy in patients with advanced solid tumors with HLA-A*02 loss of heterozygosity (LOH).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of CABO + MAP was feasible, with no protocol-specified dose-limiting toxicities during the evaluation period. Generalizability is limited by the small cohort size, and further evaluation of CABO + MAP is ongoing in a phase II/III randomized efficacy study in newly diagnosed standard- and high-risk patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed high-risk osteosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and feasibility of cabozantinib (CABO) in combination with cisplatin, doxorubicin, and high-dose methotrexate (MAP) in patients with newly diagnosed high-risk osteosarcoma (OS).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy, adebrelimab, and bevacizumab showed promising efficacy and manageable toxicity as first-line treatment for locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hepatic artery infusion chemotherapy plus adebrelimab and bevacizumab as first-line treatment for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the real-world post-immunotherapy setting, lenvatinib provided a significant 1-year survival benefit and a more favorable hepatic safety profile than cabozantinib in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. Cabozantinib was associated with higher rates of new hepatic decompensation and a trend toward greater healthcare resource utilization.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Advanced hepatocellular carcinoma patients who received first-line atezolizumab/bevacizumab followed by second-line lenvatinib or cabozantinib within 6 months.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sequencing in the post-immunotherapy era: Does second-line tyrosine kinase inhibitor choice impact survival and safety in advanced HCC?

data.clinical_result_summary: Persistent PSMA-avid disease was seen in all patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer after 6 months of ADT+ARPI with or without docetaxel, regardless of PSA at 6 months. Patients with 6-month PSA >0.2 ng/mL had significantly higher TTV and SUVmax on 6-month PSMA-PET, and TTV best correlated with PSA levels at baseline and 6 months. Six-month PSMA-PET could identify patients with suboptimal initial response to standard therapy for potential consolidative therapeutic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer by conventional imaging and planned to start androgen deprivation therapy plus an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor with or without docetaxel; primary or metastasis-directed radiotherapy was not permitted during the first 6 months.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Quantitative results from PSMAtrack: A prospective study evaluating changes in PSMA-PET during initial systemic therapy for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The study met its primary endpoint and demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising efficacy for docetaxel, ramucirumab, and pembrolizumab in patients with metastatic or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer after progression on platinum and immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with metastatic or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who progressed on platinum-doublet and PD-1/PD-L1 blockade
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of docetaxel (D), ramucirumab (R), and pembrolizumab (P) for patients with metastatic or recurrent non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who progressed on platinum-doublet and PD-1/PD-L1 blockade.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nimotuzumab combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy showed promising objective response rate and survival outcomes in patients with postoperative loco-regional recurrent esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Toxicity was described as tolerable, and no nimotuzumab-related serious adverse events occurred.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with postoperative loco-regional recurrent esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of nimotuzumab combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy for patients with postoperative loco‑regional recurrent esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: FID-007 administered in combination with cetuximab demonstrated clinically encouraging and durable anticancer activity at both tested doses in pre-treated patients with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The absence of infusion-related reactions, lack of grade ≥ 3 peripheral neuropathy, and tolerable safety profile may compare favorably with other taxanes and potentially enable longer treatment duration and improved outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma who have disease progression after 1 line of prior therapy including an immune checkpoint inhibitor.
clinical_result_layer_factor: p16 status and prior taxane exposure
data.clinical_result_paper_title: FID-007 in combination with cetuximab in recurrent or metastatic (R/M) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: Updated data confirm that CEB-01 at 18 mg has an acceptable safety profile and promising local control in retroperitoneal sarcoma. Prolonged loco-regional delivery of SN-38 may represent a novel strategy to reduce post-surgical local recurrence, and further phase 2/3 clinical investigation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with retroperitoneal sarcoma after tumor resection
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I study of CEB-01, a biodegradable SN-38–releasing membrane, to prevent local recurrence after resection of retroperitoneal sarcoma: Updated results.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of older or unfit patients with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia, decitabine/cedazuridine plus venetoclax was associated with significantly improved survival and a favorable toxicity profile compared with azacitidine plus venetoclax. These findings suggest that decitabine/cedazuridine plus venetoclax may have a clinically meaningful advantage over azacitidine plus venetoclax in this high-risk population, although prospective studies are warranted to confirm the observations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults older than 50 years and older or unfit patients with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia receiving first-line decitabine/cedazuridine plus venetoclax or azacitidine plus venetoclax, excluding patients with acute promyelocytic leukemia or prior stem cell transplantation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparative effectiveness of decitabine/cedazuridine plus venetoclax versus azacitidine plus venetoclax in older or unfit patients with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 急性早幼粒细胞白血病

data.clinical_result_summary: [18F] F-NYM124 showed exceptional tumor uptake in patients with clear cell renal cell carcinoma, with high tumor-to-background ratios and no significant adverse events. Together with its reassuring dosimetry profile, the findings suggest potential diagnostic and patient selection applications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with indeterminate renal masses and clear cell renal cell carcinoma were assessed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: [18F] F-NYM124 for safety, imaging, and dosimetry in patients with indeterminate renal masses.

data.clinical_result_summary: [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT demonstrated the strongest agreement with surgico-pathological PCI and maintained good agreement after recent chemotherapy. It showed higher detectability than MRI and [18F]FDG PET/CT, although with lower specificity, supporting [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT as a promising modality for preoperative peritoneal carcinomatosis mapping.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with colorectal or ovarian cancer with known or suspected peritoneal carcinomatosis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preoperative assessment of peritoneal carcinomatosis with [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT.

data.clinical_result_summary: PET imaging can quantitate CD8 T cells with sufficient specificity and sensitivity. These findings support further study of CD8 PET imaging for selecting patients for treatment regimens and assessing early response to therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with melanoma or Merkel cell cancer, renal cell cancer, or lung cancer/non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: iPREDICT: Phase II study of CD8 PET in patients with immunoresponsive solid tumors—Imaging characteristics and correlation with RECIST response.

data.clinical_result_summary: In an elderly, frail real-world population with non-melanoma skin cancer and high supportive-care needs, cemiplimab was associated with rapid, meaningful early clinical benefit after two doses. Early burden endpoints may complement radiologic response to better capture patient-centered benefit and inform supportive-care planning in routine pathways.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Older and frail patients with locally advanced/metastatic non-melanoma skin cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early burden reduction after two doses of cemiplimab in advanced non-melanoma skin cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: QLS31905 plus chemotherapy in first-line treatment for Claudin18.2-positive patients with pancreatic cancer and gastric cancer showed manageable safety and potential efficacy. A phase 3 trial is ongoing to further confirm the efficacy and safety of QLS31905 in patients with pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Claudin 18.2-positive patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic pancreatic cancer (Cohort 1)
Claudin 18.2-positive patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic gastric cancer (Cohort 2)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line treatment of QLS31905 plus chemotherapy in patients with pancreatic cancer and gastric cancer: Data from a phase 1b/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large propensity-matched real-world cohort, IV iron was not associated with worse overall survival in patients with cancer and iron deficiency. The findings support the survival safety of IV iron while highlighting iron indices, anemia, and cancer type as key prognostic markers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with solid malignancies and laboratory-defined iron deficiency, defined as transferrin saturation ≤ 20% and ferritin ≤ 500 ng/mL, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival after intravenous iron use in patients with cancer and iron deficiency: A propensity-matched real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Trastuzumab deruxtecan demonstrated durable and clinically meaningful antitumor activity in pretreated patients in China with HER2 IHC 3+ advanced solid tumors. Safety was generally consistent with the established trastuzumab deruxtecan profile. Results from DESTINY-PanTumor03 Part 1 support trastuzumab deruxtecan as a tumor-agnostic treatment for patients in China with HER2 IHC 3+ solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pretreated patients in China with HER2 IHC 3+ advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) for pretreated patients in China with HER2 IHC 3+ solid tumors: DESTINY-PanTumor03 Part 1 primary analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Analysis of safety and dosing data from BOLD-100-001 suggests a potential neuroprotective effect of BOLD-100 against FOLFOX-induced peripheral neuropathy. Further investigations are ongoing in a randomized arm of the BOLD-100-001 clinical trial to characterize this effect using health-related and neuropathy-related quality-of-life measures.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, biliary tract cancer, and pancreatic cancer with measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and BRAF wildtype tumor status were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neuroprotective potential of BOLD-100 when utilized in combination with FOLFOX for the treatment of advanced gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adebelimab combined with molecularly stratified targeted therapy and liposomal irinotecan-based chemotherapy showed substantial efficacy and favorable safety for unresectable microsatellite stable colorectal cancer liver metastases, with excellent hepatic metastasis control. The high conversion-to-resection rate and 35.7% hepatic TRG 0 rate suggest potential for deep pathological response, warranting further investigation as a promising conversion therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable microsatellite stable colorectal cancer liver metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The CONVERGE study: A phase II, single-arm trial of adebelimab combined with targeted therapy and liposomal irinotecan-based chemotherapy for conversion surgery in unresectable MSS colorectal cancer liver metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: PK/PD evaluation of HC-7366 showed a favorable PK profile, with dose-proportional exposure and a half-life suitable for once-daily dosing. Drug exposure, pathway engagement, and mechanistic biomarkers suggested 40-75 mg as the optimal dose range, and the metabolic effects suggested suitability for development in metabolically rewired cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: US patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of the GCN2 activator HC-7366 in a phase 1a study in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large propensity-matched real-world cohort, IV iron was not associated with worse overall survival in patients with cancer and iron deficiency. The findings support the survival safety of IV iron while highlighting iron indices, anemia, and cancer type as key prognostic markers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with solid malignancies and laboratory-defined iron deficiency, defined as transferrin saturation ≤ 20% and ferritin ≤ 500 ng/mL, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival after intravenous iron use in patients with cancer and iron deficiency: A propensity-matched real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The integration of chronotherapy with intensity-modulated radiotherapy significantly reduced adverse reactions and improved quality of life in patients with locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma. These benefits occurred without compromising long-term survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective phase II clinical study of different time-delivered drugs combined with intensity-modulated radiotherapy for locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: PK/PD evaluation of HC-7366 showed a favorable PK profile, with dose-proportional exposure and a half-life suitable for once-daily dosing. Drug exposure, pathway engagement, and mechanistic biomarkers suggested 40-75 mg as the optimal dose range, and the metabolic effects suggested suitability for development in metabolically rewired cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: US patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of the GCN2 activator HC-7366 in a phase 1a study in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Spleen-directed PD-1 blockade using erythrocyte–antibody conjugates induced durable clinical benefit with an acceptable safety profile in patients with PD-1/PD-L1-resistant solid tumors. The findings support further clinical development of αPD-1-Ery.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with Unresectable or Metasta Atic Advanced Solid Tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Erythrocyte–anti–PD-1 conjugates in patients with advanced solid tumors resistant to anti–PD-1/PD-L1 therapy: Long-term follow-up of a phase I trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of metastatic colorectal cancer patients treated with pembrolizumab, patients who developed immune-related thyroid dysfunction experienced longer overall survival than those who did not. These findings support thyroid immune-related adverse events as a potential on-treatment biomarker of benefit in MSI-H/dMMR colorectal cancer and warrant further validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with metastatic colorectal cancer treated with pembrolizumab from 2014–2024 were included, excluding patients with pre-existing thyroid disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune-related thyroid dysfunction and overall survival in metastatic colorectal cancer treated with pembrolizumab: A real-world TriNetX analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Analysis of safety and dosing data from BOLD-100-001 suggests a potential neuroprotective effect of BOLD-100 against FOLFOX-induced peripheral neuropathy. Further investigations are ongoing in a randomized arm of the BOLD-100-001 clinical trial to characterize this effect using health-related and neuropathy-related quality-of-life measures.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, biliary tract cancer, and pancreatic cancer with measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and BRAF wildtype tumor status were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neuroprotective potential of BOLD-100 when utilized in combination with FOLFOX for the treatment of advanced gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with advanced melanoma who had confirmed progression on prior anti–PD-1-based therapy, RP1 plus nivolumab produced durable long-term survival, with a 3-year overall survival rate of 45.5% in the overall population and 81.8% among responders. The safety profile remained consistent with prior reports, with no new safety signals observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: anti–PD-1–failed melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A 3-year landmark overall survival analysis of RP1 plus nivolumab in patients with anti–PD-1–failed melanoma from the IGNYTE clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This evaluation demonstrates the feasibility and clinical benefit of providing Crizotinib to patients with ALK and ROS1-positive metastatic non-small cell lung cancer in a resource-limited setting. Timely initiation enabled sustained treatment for many patients, with some achieving long-term benefit beyond two years, comparable to outcomes reported in high-income settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included patients with ALK- or ROS1-positive metastatic non-small cell lung cancer treated with Crizotinib at Patan Academy of Health Sciences in Nepal and enrolled in the Max Access Solutions program between January 1, 2018, and June 30, 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of crizotinib treatment for ALK+ and ROS1+ metastatic non-small cell lung cancer in Nepal.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis of patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, first-line daratumumab-based therapy was associated with a higher prevalence of documented remission compared with bortezomib-based therapy. These findings highlight meaningful differences in disease status between frontline treatment strategies in routine clinical practice, and further studies incorporating longitudinal outcomes and time-to-event analyses are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma were identified using ICD-10-CM codes and stratified by first-line treatment exposure to either daratumumab-based or bortezomib-based regimens, excluding patients who received both agents.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparison of remission status in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with daratumumab-based versus bortezomib-based first-line therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative HAIC plus tislelizumab demonstrated favorable safety and promising antitumor activity in patients with high-risk hepatocellular carcinoma. Comprehensive long-term outcome, safety, pathological, and clinical response data will be provided.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk resectable hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy (HAIC) plus tislelizumab (Tisle) combined with adjuvant tisle as a perioperative therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) at high-risk of recurrence: A single-arm, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among individuals experiencing taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy at the end of taxane treatment, nearly half experienced clinically meaningful improvement, but almost one fifth had worsening by the final 3-year assessment. Identifying clinical and correlative risk factors for persistent or worsening taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy after taxane treatment may support more informed decision-making about long-term taxane risks and help prioritize patients for prevention and treatment intervention studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants older than 18 years with Stage I-III primary lung, breast, or ovarian cancer who were starting treatment with a taxane-based regimen for a planned duration of 8 to 18 weeks were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-treatment recovery patterns among patients with early-stage cancer who develop taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy (TIPN): SWOG S1714 (NCT03939481).

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line RCIT yielded promising long-term survival in advanced oligometastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, particularly in patients completing the full radiotherapeutic course, achieving a 2-year OS of 61.5%. However, high rates of in-field recurrence suggest a need for further optimization of local control strategies, and baseline immune infiltrates and cytokine profiles may have predictive value for patient stratification.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients aged 18–75 years with previously untreated stage IV ESCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Toripalimab plus chemotherapy and radiotherapy for treatment-naïve advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: Long-term survival and recurrence patterns.

data.clinical_result_summary: [18F] F-NYM124 showed exceptional tumor uptake in patients with clear cell renal cell carcinoma, with high tumor-to-background ratios and no significant adverse events. Together with its reassuring dosimetry profile, the findings suggest potential diagnostic and patient selection applications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with indeterminate renal masses and clear cell renal cell carcinoma were assessed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: [18F] F-NYM124 for safety, imaging, and dosimetry in patients with indeterminate renal masses.

data.clinical_result_summary: Rapid infusion of dinutuximab was feasible and well tolerated, including in the outpatient setting. Pain control was achieved with standard premedication, and opioid requirements were significantly reduced compared with standard infusion. These data support planned multi-institutional evaluation of rapid infusion of dinutuximab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory high-risk neuroblastoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RAPID: A pilot feasibility study of rapid dinutuximab infusion in patients with relapsed/refractory (RR) high-risk neuroblastoma (HRNBL).

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy might be a useful treatment option for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, with highly promising efficacy and manageable safety.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable, locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A prospective, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pemetrexed and pembrolizumab showed modest activity in patients with recurrent and/or metastatic adenoid cystic carcinoma, with a clinical benefit rate of 75% and prolonged benefit for some patients. No treatment-related deaths were reported, although grade 3 or higher adverse events occurred in 80% of patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent adenoid cystic
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of pemetrexed and pembrolizumab in patients (pts) with recurrent and/or metastatic (R/M) salivary gland cancer (SGC): Results from the adenoid cystic cohort.

clinical_result_indication_detail: subjects with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I/IIa dose-escalation, dose-optimization, and dose-expansion study to evaluate the safety and preliminary efficacy of tri-specific antibody (SOA101) in subjects with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Alrizomadlin alone or in combination with lisaftoclax showed a manageable safety profile, with preliminary antitumor activity in heavily pretreated relapsed/refractory rhabdomyosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, and neuroblastoma. The potential mechanisms, safety, and efficacy of alrizomadlin combined with lisaftoclax for pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma and other soft-tissue sarcomas warrant further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma or other soft-tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Alrizomadlin (APG-115) alone or in combination with lisaftoclax (APG-2575) for the treatment of pediatric patients with relapsed/metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) or other soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs).

data.clinical_result_summary: Although the primary end point has not been reached, 2 partial responses were observed and patients with stable disease and any tumor reduction had longer progression-free survival. Translational and patient-reported outcome analyses are ongoing to better define biological predictors of cetuximab activity in chordoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced/metastatic chordoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 trial of cetuximab for patients with locally advanced/metastatic chordoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: The PERFORM IA5 supports treatment-free interval as a relevant prognostic factor in patients treated with palbociclib plus endocrine therapy in the first-line real-world setting. Quality of life was maintained across treatment-free interval subgroups, and the longest clinical benefit was observed in patients with treatment-free interval >12 months and those with de novo disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HR+/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer across Germany and Austria receiving first-line palbociclib plus endocrine therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effectiveness outcomes by treatment-free interval among patients receiving palbociclib plus endocrine therapy in HR+/HER2− advanced breast cancer in the real-world setting: Results from the PERFORM study.

data.clinical_result_summary: GLP-1RA use was not associated with increased toxicity, inflammatory complications, or mortality in patients undergoing CAR-T or BiTE therapy. These findings support the short-term clinical safety of GLP-1RA exposure in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with hematologic malignancies receiving FDA-approved chimeric antigen receptor T-cell or bispecific T-cell engager therapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in patients receiving chimeric antigen receptor T cell or bispecific T cell engager therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: CABO monotherapy showed efficacy in some high-grade neuroendocrine neoplasm patients with not just well differentiated but also very aggressive poorly differentiated histology. No new side effects beyond those previously described for this agent were noted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-grade neuroendocrine neoplasms
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cabozantinib in high-grade neuroendocrine neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with resectable colorectal liver metastases and a low clinical risk score, adjuvant HAIP chemotherapy with floxuridine did not demonstrate an improvement in progression-free survival compared with resection alone. Mature overall survival results are expected in 2029.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable colorectal liver metastases and a low clinical risk score
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant hepatic arterial infusion pump chemotherapy with floxuridine for patients with resectable colorectal liver metastases and a low clinical risk score: A randomized controlled trial—The PUMP trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of predominantly elderly North American patients with gemcitabine-refractory metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, nal-IRI plus 5-fluorouracil and leucovorin demonstrated clinically meaningful effectiveness in overall survival and progression-free survival comparable to those reported in the NAPOLI-1 trial. The findings support nal-IRI plus 5-fluorouracil and leucovorin as a viable second-line treatment option for this underrepresented elderly North American population. Advanced age and baseline anemia were identified as independent predictors of mortality.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included a mostly elderly North American population of patients with gemcitabine-refractory metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who received nal-IRI plus 5-fluorouracil and leucovorin after progression on gemcitabine-based therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy profile of nanoliposomal irinotecan + fluorouracil and leucovorin (nal-IRI+5-FU/LV) in gemcitabine-refractory metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma in elderly North American patients: A real-word experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world Chinese cohort characterized by predominantly high-volume and high-risk disease, Darolutamide-based triplet therapy yielded rapid and deep PSA responses with acceptable toxicity. These findings support the feasibility and clinical utility of this regimen in Chinese patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, while underscoring the importance of vigilant monitoring for chemotherapy-related adverse events, particularly neutropenia.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Chinese patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer treated with androgen deprivation therapy, Darolutamide, and Docetaxel across 18 centers in Zhejiang Province, China, all of whom had metastatic disease at baseline.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of darolutamide-based triplet therapy in Chinese patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC): A multicenter analysis from Zhejiang province (YHCG-006 study).

data.clinical_result_summary: Alternative 350 mg twice-daily dosing of vabametkib was selected to continue clinical development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MET exon 14 skipping non-small-cell lung cancer (cohort 1)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 multicenter, open-label, parallel cohort study to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetic profile of ABN401 in patients with advanced solid tumors harboring c-MET dysregulation.

data.clinical_result_summary: Surufatinib demonstrated promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. Further studies in broader populations are warranted to validate these findings, and follow-up is ongoing with additional data anticipated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients aged 18-75 years with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma, BCLC stage B or C, and Child-Pugh class A or B liver function - Cohort 2
patients aged 18-75 with unresectable HCC, BCLC Stage B or C, and Child-Pugh A or B classification (cohort 1)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Surufatinib combined with anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody in the second line or monotherapy in third line treatment of advanced hepatocellular carcinoma: A single-arm, open-label, multi-center phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world Peruvian cohort, adjuvant pembrolizumab was associated with significantly longer overall survival and numerically longer recurrence-free survival compared with observation in resected stage III melanoma. The RFS benefit appeared more pronounced in BRAF wild-type tumors and in the absence of ulceration. These findings support the effectiveness of adjuvant anti-PD-1 therapy in routine clinical practice within resource-limited settings such as LATAM.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients in a real-world Peruvian cohort with resected AJCC stage III melanoma treated between 2021 and 2024, addressing Latin American populations.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Role of adjuvant pembrolizumab in resected stage III melanoma: Real-world evidence from a Peruvian reference center.

data.clinical_result_summary: TFX06 showed promising clinical activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer who progressed from prior fulvestrant treatments, including combination with CDK4/6 inhibitors, including those with ESR1 mutations. These findings support further development of TFX06 as a potential therapeutic option in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ER+/HER2- locally advanced and/or metastatic breast cancer (dose expasion)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical efficacy of a novel oral SERD TFX06 in prior fulvestrant-treated ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer patients in a dose expansion study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant tislelizumab plus nab-paclitaxel achieved a high pathologic complete response rate and downstaging rate with no grade 3-4 adverse events in patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer undergoing radical cystectomy. Multimodal imaging and circulating/transcriptomic biomarkers may help evaluate response and warrant confirmation in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with muscle-invasive urothelial bladder carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: TRUCE-11: An open-label, single-arm, multicenter phase II study of tislelizumab combined with nab-paclitaxel for muscle-invasive urothelial bladder carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective analysis, enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab efficacy was maintained despite dose reductions and dose holds. Survival differences observed in time-dependent analyses were not consistently reproduced in landmark analyses, suggesting exposure-related selection bias rather than a causal effect. Prospective studies are warranted to validate these hypothesis-generating findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma treated with enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab in the multisite UNITE study were analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effect of on-treatment dose adjustments on the efficacy of enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab (EVP) in advanced urothelial carcinoma (aUC): A UNITE analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In metastatic hormone receptor-positive and HER-2-negative breast cancer, switching from ribociclib to palbociclib should be considered when toxicity develops, rather than reducing the dose or discontinuing treatment. The authors concluded that toxicity would not continue after the switch.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients from nine centers with metastatic hormone receptor-positive and HER-2-negative breast cancer who developed toxicity during ribociclib treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The effect of switching from ribociclib to palbociclib due to toxicity in hormone receptor–positive, HER-2–negative metastatic breast cancer: A real-world, multicenter, retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: AK130 plus ivonescimab demonstrated potential anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile as a post-line option for advanced biliary tract cancer. These findings support further development of this combination in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1b/2 study of AK130 (TIGIT/TGF-β bispecific fusion protein) combined with ivonescimab in advanced biliary tract cancer (BTC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant NASOX demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with pancreatic cancer. These findings support further prospective evaluation of the regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk resectable, borderline resectable, or locally advanced pancreatic cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant NASOX for pancreatic cancer: A prospective multicenter study.

data.clinical_result_summary: GT801 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and early signs of antitumor activity in heavily pretreated B-NHL patients. Its ability to generate functional CAR-T cells in vivo without lymphodepletion supports further clinical evaluation as a promising therapeutic approach.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell hematologic malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of in vivo CAR-T therapy GT801 in adults with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of chronic lymphocytic leukemia, sequencing venetoclax in first line followed by Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitors in second line was associated with a significant long-term overall survival advantage compared with second-line venetoclax-based therapy. The findings support preferential sequencing of Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitors after venetoclax, although prospective studies are needed for confirmation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included adult patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia identified by treatment sequencing of first-line Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitors followed by second-line venetoclax or first-line venetoclax followed by second-line Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitors, while excluding patients receiving traditional chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world overall survival outcomes of BTK inhibitors vs. venetoclax-based therapy as second-line treatment for chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pembrolizumab plus trastuzumab and chemotherapy continued to show improved overall survival, progression-free survival, and objective response rate versus placebo plus trastuzumab and chemotherapy after a median study follow-up of 70 months, especially in patients with PD-L1 CPS ≥1. No new safety signals were seen, and the findings continue to support this regimen as the preferred first-line treatment for advanced or metastatic HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Locally Advanced Unresectable or Metastatic HER2-Positive Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: KEYNOTE-811: 6-year median follow-up of pembrolizumab plus trastuzumab and chemotherapy for previously untreated advanced HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant therapy with S-1 combined with either durvalumab or tislelizumab showed promising efficacy with an acceptable safety profile in patients with resected biliary tract cancer at high risk of recurrence. Further validation in larger multicenter trials is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant durvalumab or tislelizumab combined with S-1 for resected high-risk biliary tract cancers in China: A multicenter, two-cohort, single-arm, open-label, phase 2 trial preliminary analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The development of grade 2 or higher hypertension was associated with a significant overall survival benefit in patients treated with paclitaxel plus ramucirumab in the ARMANI trial. These findings support further research to identify biomarkers predictive of hypertension onset to refine patient selection for switch maintenance strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced HER2-negative gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer who had disease control after a 3-month first-line fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin induction chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes according to ramucirumab (RAM)-related hypertension (HTN) in patients (pts) with advanced HER2-negative gastric (G) or gastro-esophageal junction (GEJ) cancer: An exploratory analysis of the phase III ARMANI trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Rilvegostomig plus chemotherapy demonstrated promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced biliary tract cancer. This study and phase 3 studies of rilvegostomig in biliary tract cancer are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated unresectable/metastatic biliary tract cancer - Cohort A in substudy 2
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line rilvegostomig (R) + chemotherapy (CTx) in advanced biliary tract cancer (BTC): Updated analysis of GEMINI-Hepatobiliary substudy 2 cohort A.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with treatment-refractory bone sarcomas treated with Mec-V monotherapy achieved a median overall survival of 17.6 months, which compared favorably with reported outcomes for other therapies, including combination therapies. Mec-V monotherapy holds considerable promise for these high unmet-need indications, with potential increased benefit when used in combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic chordoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, chondrosarcoma, and chordoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic chondrosarcoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic Ewing sarcoma
refractory osteosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival analysis of a heavily pretreated population of patients with bone sarcomas treated with mecbotamab vedotin, a conditionally binding ADC targeting AXL.

data.clinical_result_summary: The development of grade 2 or higher hypertension was associated with a significant overall survival benefit in patients treated with paclitaxel plus ramucirumab in the ARMANI trial. These findings support further research to identify biomarkers predictive of hypertension onset to refine patient selection for switch maintenance strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced HER2-negative gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer who had disease control after a 3-month first-line fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin induction chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes according to ramucirumab (RAM)-related hypertension (HTN) in patients (pts) with advanced HER2-negative gastric (G) or gastro-esophageal junction (GEJ) cancer: An exploratory analysis of the phase III ARMANI trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a heavily pretreated, platinum-exposed real-world population, mirvetuximab soravtansine demonstrated a small but statistically significant survival advantage over standard chemotherapy. The findings support its clinical benefit in later-line practice and highlight frequent post-mirvetuximab soravtansine bevacizumab use. Further studies are warranted to define optimal sequencing and combination strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who had received at least three prior platinum therapies and a subsequent platinum agent within 7–180 days of initial platinum therapy before index treatment; included patients were subsequently treated with mirvetuximab soravtansine or investigator’s choice chemotherapy, and FRα status was unknown.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world overall survival with mirvetuximab soravtansine compared with chemotherapy after multiple lines of platinum therapy in gynecologic cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Results from this post hoc analysis of the KEYNOTE-412 trial with over 2 years of additional follow-up were consistent with the end-of-trial analysis in the overall population. In participants whose tumors expressed PD-L1 with CPS ≥10, pembrolizumab plus chemoradiotherapy showed clinically meaningful EFS and OS benefit over placebo plus chemoradiotherapy, with a numerically lower hazard ratio than reported for the overall population.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with high-risk unresected locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, including T3-4 N0-3 or T1-4 N2a-3 laryngeal, hypopharyngeal, oral cavity, or p16-negative oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma, or T4 or N3 p16-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma, were evaluated in the PD-L1 CPS ≥10 population.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PD-L1 CPS ≥10 population subgroup analysis of KEYNOTE-412: Pembrolizumab plus chemoradiotherapy versus placebo plus chemoradiotherapy for unresected locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: BA1301 was well tolerated with a manageable safety profile and demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity in patients with CLDN18.2 moderate to high expression. The findings support further development of BA1301 as a new therapeutic approach to treat CLDN18.2-positive solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pre-treated advanced solid tumors, particularly those with CLDN18.2 medium or high expression.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CLDN18.2–targeting antibody-drug conjugate BA1301 in advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Markedly distinct patterns of organ-specific metastasis were observed between atezolizumab and pembrolizumab in stage IV metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Atezolizumab was associated with elevated risk of progression in the CNS and visceral organs, whereas pembrolizumab showed a greater propensity for cutaneous progression, suggesting that PD-1 versus PD-L1 inhibitor selection may influence subsequent sites of disease progression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with stage IV metastatic non-small cell lung cancer receiving initial pembrolizumab or atezolizumab monotherapy were included, while patients with pre-existing metastases at the specific organ site of interest were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Organ-specific metastatic progression in non-small cell lung cancer treated with pembrolizumab versus atezolizumab: A TrinetX network analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Efbemalenograstim alfa significantly reduces the incidence and duration of grade 3/4 neutropenia in patients undergoing definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy. The benefit was consistent across different chemotherapy regimens and was accompanied by a favorable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的中性粒细胞减少症
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with malignancies receiving definitive concurrent chemo-radiotherapy
clinical_result_layer_factor: chemotherapy regimen
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Guard-01: A randomized, open-label trial of efbemalenograstim alfa as primary prophylaxis for neutropenia during definitive concurrent chemo-radiotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: DXC006 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and adequate tolerability, and showed encouraging efficacy in pretreated advanced solid tumors, especially in small cell lung cancer. The recommended phase 2 dose was 6.0 mg/kg every 3 weeks.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic/locally advanced solid tumors after at least one line of systemic standard therapy
patients with metastatic/locally advanced SCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DXC006, a first-in-class CD56-targeting antibody-drug conjugate, in advanced solid tumors: A first-in-human, phase I dose escalation clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, adjuvant abemaciclib was associated with higher rates of dose modifications and treatment discontinuation compared with monarchE. Adverse events were consistent with prior reports, with lower rates of common toxicities and no observed neutropenia. Longer follow-up and larger cohorts are needed to better characterize recurrence and survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer treated with adjuvant abemaciclib between 2021 and 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world analysis of adjuvant abemaciclib in high-risk HR+/HER2− early breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fruquintinib plus sintilimab and CAPEOX showed encouraging clinical outcomes and manageable safety for untreated advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. The trial is still recruiting, and more data including subgroup analysis and potential predictive response biomarkers will be further analyzed and reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fruquintinib in combination with sintilimab and CAPEOX as first-line treatment for advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: A single-arm, open-label, multicenter phase Ib/II study (FUNCTION).

data.clinical_result_summary: In Krascendo 170, divarasib 400 mg once daily plus pembrolizumab had a manageable safety profile. Promising efficacy was observed in patients with advanced KRAS G12C-positive non-small cell lung cancer in both PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated advanced or metastatic KRAS G12C-positive non-small cell lung cancer (cohort A2)
patients with untreated advanced or metastatic KRAS G12C-positive non-small cell lung cancer (cohort A1)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) divarasib plus pembrolizumab (pembro) in advanced or metastatic KRAS G12C+ non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Results from the Krascendo-170 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: DXC006 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and adequate tolerability, and showed encouraging efficacy in pretreated advanced solid tumors, especially in small cell lung cancer. The recommended phase 2 dose was 6.0 mg/kg every 3 weeks.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic/locally advanced solid tumors after at least one line of systemic standard therapy
patients with metastatic/locally advanced SCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DXC006, a first-in-class CD56-targeting antibody-drug conjugate, in advanced solid tumors: A first-in-human, phase I dose escalation clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: HIPEC combined with camrelizumab, paclitaxel, and S-1 demonstrated promising conversion surgery and R0 resection rates, with significantly improved survival outcomes in surgical patients. The regimen was generally tolerable, with manageable toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer with peritoneal metastasis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HIPEC combined with PD-1 inhibitor, chemotherapy in conversion therapy for advanced gastric cancer with peritoneal metastasis: Results from a single-arm phase II clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pembrolizumab plus trastuzumab and chemotherapy continued to show improved overall survival, progression-free survival, and objective response rate versus placebo plus trastuzumab and chemotherapy after a median study follow-up of 70 months, especially in patients with PD-L1 CPS ≥1. No new safety signals were seen, and the findings continue to support this regimen as the preferred first-line treatment for advanced or metastatic HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Locally Advanced Unresectable or Metastatic HER2-Positive Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: KEYNOTE-811: 6-year median follow-up of pembrolizumab plus trastuzumab and chemotherapy for previously untreated advanced HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world propensity-matched analysis, Lu-PSMA-617 was associated with superior survival and fewer hospitalizations compared with Ra-223 in bone-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The findings suggest that when PSMA-avid disease is present, Lu-PSMA-617 should be prioritized as the radiopharmaceutical of choice, although prospective studies are warranted to confirm optimal sequencing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult men with prostate cancer and bone metastases who received Lu-PSMA-617 or Ra-223, with castration resistance approximated by ongoing ADT and prior ARPI, and excluded patients with visceral metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of [^177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 versus radium-223 in bone-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: A real-world propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: A moderate, time-limited early corticosteroid approach after anti-CD19 CAR-T reduced severe immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome without loss of efficacy. In contrast, high-dose or prolonged corticosteroid use was associated with poorer survival and earlier relapse. The findings support standardized moderate early dosing and avoiding routine high-dose regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults receiving commercial anti-CD19 CAR-T therapy for large B-cell lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early corticosteroid dosing after anti-CD19 CAR-T therapy for large B-cell lymphoma: Multicenter associations with neurotoxicity, cytokine release syndrome, and survival.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this matched real-world cohort of ICI-treated metastatic renal cell carcinoma, higher BMI was associated with lower 1-year mortality, though this effect was not maintained at 3 years. Among patients with BMI ≥25 kg/m2, obesity was associated with better survival than overweight status, while healthcare utilization was similar across BMI groups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients diagnosed after January 2015 with metastatic renal cell carcinoma, a recorded baseline body mass index within six months of diagnosis, and receipt of first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy with nivolumab, ipilimumab, or pembrolizumab within six months of diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Body mass index–stratified outcomes with first-line immunotherapy in metastatic RCC: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: GT801 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and early signs of antitumor activity in heavily pretreated B-NHL patients. Its ability to generate functional CAR-T cells in vivo without lymphodepletion supports further clinical evaluation as a promising therapeutic approach.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell hematologic malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of in vivo CAR-T therapy GT801 in adults with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: The validated shared neoantigen peptide library provides a novel platform for rapid neoantigen discovery. The shared neoantigen vaccine combined with chemotherapy and PD-1 blockade represents a safe and effective combination therapy strategy for non-small cell lung cancer patients with acquired TKI resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: NSCLC patients with acquired TKI resistance.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Development of a shared neoantigen peptide library to promote personalized vaccine strategy in patients with non–small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: CTS3497 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and promising efficacy in heavily pretreated patients with MTAP-deficient advanced solid tumors, including gastrointestinal cancers and non-small cell lung cancer. No dose-limiting toxicity was observed, the maximum tolerated dose was not reached, and objective responses were reported in the efficacy-evaluable population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with homozygous MTAP deletion (by next generation sequencing), or MTAP protein loss (by immunohistochemistry [IHC]) and advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human phase I/II study evaluating CTS3497, an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in advanced or metastatic MTAP-deficient solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy for Merkel cell carcinoma at a single institution achieved an overall response rate of 75% and a major pathologic response/pathologic complete response rate of 60%. Earlier incorporation of regional therapy after neoadjuvant immunotherapy appeared to improve outcomes, suggesting the importance of multimodal management for resectable Merkel cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resectable Merkel cell carcinoma who received neoadjuvant immunotherapy with intent to offer surgery or radiation were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes of neoadjuvant immunotherapy (NeoIO) in Merkel cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: BA1301 was well tolerated with a manageable safety profile and demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity in patients with CLDN18.2 moderate to high expression. The findings support further development of BA1301 as a new therapeutic approach to treat CLDN18.2-positive solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pre-treated advanced solid tumors, particularly those with CLDN18.2 medium or high expression.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CLDN18.2–targeting antibody-drug conjugate BA1301 in advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The fully non-intravenous neoadjuvant regimen combining pyrotinib, subcutaneous trastuzumab, and capecitabine was reported as efficacious and safe for patients with low- to intermediate-risk HER2-positive early breast cancer. The regimen may offer a more convenient and less burdensome treatment option that could improve quality of life and treatment adherence.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naïve adults with stage I-II, T1c-2N0-1 HER2-positive EBC (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/FISH+)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early results of neoadjuvant therapy with pyrotinib, subcutaneous trastuzumab, and capecitabine for HER2-positive early breast cancer from a prospective, single-arm, multicenter trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: ALK-Vac was well tolerated and induced vaccine-specific T cell responses in a minimal residual disease setting. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of prophylactic targeting of ALK resistance mutations as an adjunct to TKI therapy and support a broader immune-interception framework potentially applicable to other oncogene-driven non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer patients without progression on standard-of-care tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prophylactic peptide vaccine targeting resistance mutations in advanced ALK-positive lung cancer: Primary analysis from the ARCHER trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: CAR-T cell therapy showed a favorable safety and efficacy profile for relapsed/refractory systemic lupus erythematosus children. The data suggest that CAR-T cell therapy may mitigate growth and development toxicity associated with conventional immunosuppressive therapy in pediatric systemic lupus erythematosus patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: SLE children
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary observation of growth and pubertal development following CAR-T cell therapy for children with systemic lupus erythematosus.

data.clinical_result_summary: Underlying lung conditions, including prior drug-induced pneumonitis, prior radiation pneumonitis, lung cancer, and malignant pleural effusion, were associated with a higher risk of developing T-DXd-induced pneumonitis. Patients with pre-existing lung conditions and compromised lung reserve may be more susceptible to potential off-target pulmonary toxicity effects of T-DXd and may warrant closer monitoring during treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced HER2-positive solid malignancies, including breast, lung, gastrointestinal, uterine, ovarian, bladder, and salivary gland cancers, who received at least one dose of T-DXd.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Risk factors for drug-induced pneumonitis from trastuzumab deruxtecan in patients with advanced HER2-positive solid malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: This updated post hoc analysis confirms a significantly more favorable overall survival benefit with imetelstat versus best available therapy in patients with relapsed/refractory myelofibrosis and poor prognosis. Overall survival in real-world patients also improved over the last decade, potentially due to earlier ruxolitinib initiation and earlier switching to next-line Janus kinase inhibitor therapy or clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included patients with Janus kinase inhibitor relapsed/refractory intermediate-2-risk or high-risk myelofibrosis, including patients diagnosed before 2016 who had received ruxolitinib but were relapsed/refractory, and real-world patients who discontinued ruxolitinib and were subsequently treated with best available therapy at Moffitt Cancer Center between 2010 and 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated analysis of overall survival (OS) with imetelstat (IME) in relapsed/refractory (R/R) myelofibrosis (MF) versus real-world (RW) data, and assessment of RW treatment (tx) patterns.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy with chemotherapy and lenvatinib may delay recurrence after curative resection of biliary tract cancer. The regimen showed a favorable safety and tolerability profile, and further prospective studies are warranted to confirm these findings and optimize adjuvant strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with biliary tract cancer who underwent curative surgery with R0/R1 resection and received adjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitors in combination with chemotherapy and lenvatinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitors combined with chemotherapy and lenvatinib for biliary tract cancer after curative resection: A single-center retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: CTS3497 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and promising efficacy in heavily pretreated patients with MTAP-deficient advanced solid tumors, including gastrointestinal cancers and non-small cell lung cancer. No dose-limiting toxicity was observed, the maximum tolerated dose was not reached, and objective responses were reported in the efficacy-evaluable population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with homozygous MTAP deletion (by next generation sequencing), or MTAP protein loss (by immunohistochemistry [IHC]) and advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human phase I/II study evaluating CTS3497, an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in advanced or metastatic MTAP-deficient solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, adjuvant abemaciclib was associated with higher rates of dose modifications and treatment discontinuation compared with monarchE. Adverse events were consistent with prior reports, with lower rates of common toxicities and no observed neutropenia. Longer follow-up and larger cohorts are needed to better characterize recurrence and survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer treated with adjuvant abemaciclib between 2021 and 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world analysis of adjuvant abemaciclib in high-risk HR+/HER2− early breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: GT201 combined with toripalimab demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging antitumor activity in heavily pretreated recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck cancer. These findings support further clinical development of this combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of autologous tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (GT201) plus toripalimab in recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: TPF chrono-chemotherapy combined with cisplatin concurrent chemoradiotherapy reduced the incidence of toxic side effects while maintaining survival in patients with de novo metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma. The authors concluded that this approach can benefit patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with de novo metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma who were treated with TPF chemotherapy at the hospital from January 1, 2012, to December 31, 2018.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long term follow-up results and prognosis analysis of TPF regimen chrono-chemotherapy combined with cisplatin concurrent chemoradiotherapy for the treatment of distant nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant pyrotinib combined with nab-paclitaxel showed promising 3-year invasive disease-free survival and a manageable safety profile in patients with low-risk, HER2-positive early breast cancer. This regimen represents a potential oral de-escalation strategy for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with low-risk, HER2-positive early breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pyrotinib plus nab-paclitaxel as adjuvant therapy for patients with N0/N1mi, HER2-positive early-stage breast cancer: 3-year iDFS results of the phase II PHAEDRA trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: LY4101174 demonstrated clinical activity at Q3W dose levels, including in enfortumab vedotin-pretreated metastatic urothelial carcinoma, suggesting that Nectin-4 remains an important therapeutic target. Dose and treatment duration were mainly limited by grade ≥3 hematologic toxicity requiring prophylactic G-CSF.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with locally advanced / metastatic urothelial carcinoma or other selected solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial results from EXCEED, a phase 1 study of LY4101174, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4, in participants with advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: BA1301 was well tolerated with a manageable safety profile and demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity in patients with CLDN18.2 moderate to high expression. The findings support further development of BA1301 as a new therapeutic approach to treat CLDN18.2-positive solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pre-treated advanced solid tumors, particularly those with CLDN18.2 medium or high expression.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CLDN18.2–targeting antibody-drug conjugate BA1301 in advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of HB0025 and chemotherapy demonstrated promising efficacy and favorable safety as first-line treatment for patients with locally advanced unresectable, recurrent or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Multi-center, randomized, double-blind, controlled phase III trials in both squamous and non-squamous NSCLC have been initiated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Cohort 2 (non-squamous NSCLC):
Cohort 1 (squamous NSCLC):
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of HB0025 (a PD-L1/VEGF bispecific antibody) in combination with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 下一线治疗的无进展生存期（PFS2）
首次后线治疗后无疾病进展生存时间（PFS2）
