data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results indicate that ripretinib dose escalation demonstrated superior efficacy and a more favorable safety profile compared with combination therapy involving sunitinib. These findings support ripretinib dose escalation as the preferred treatment option for patients with advanced GIST who have progressed after four lines of standard therapy, although the small sample size means further research is needed to validate this conclusion.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor who had progressed after four prior lines of therapy, including imatinib, sunitinib, regorafenib, and ripretinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Standard-dose ripretinib plus sunitinib versus ripretinib dose escalation in advanced GIST after progression on four prior therapies: Preliminary results of a multicenter cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients treated with definitive chemoradiation and durvalumab, taxane-based chemotherapy was not associated with increased pneumonitis risk or worse survival. Mean lung dose and former smoking status were key predictors of pneumonitis, emphasizing the importance of radiation optimization and individualized risk assessment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with NSCLC treated with concurrent chemoradiation followed by durvalumab, including unresectable and select oligometastatic cases treated with definitive intent between 2017-2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world analysis of pneumonitis risk after chemoradiation and durvalumab by chemotherapy regimen in NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective study of real-world data, first-line lenvatinib demonstrated longer real-world progression-free survival and real-world overall survival compared with first-line dabrafenib plus trametinib in patients with differentiated thyroid cancer harboring BRAF mutations. The study suggests implications for sequencing agents used to treat patients with BRAF-mutated radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer, while acknowledging limitations inherent to real-world data.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with differentiated thyroid cancer harboring BRAF V600E and/or K601E mutations who received first-line lenvatinib monotherapy or dabrafenib plus trametinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line lenvatinib versus dabrafenib plus trametinib (D+T) in BRAF-mutated differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC): Insights from real-world data.

data.clinical_result_summary: PQ203 is being evaluated in an ongoing first-in-human dose-escalation and expansion study in patients with advanced solid tumor malignancies. The first two dose cohorts were completed without dose-limiting toxicities, and enrollment into the third cohort began in January 2026; efficacy results were not yet reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumor malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1, multi-center clinical trial evaluating the safety, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and anti-cancer activity of PQ203, a first-in-class peptide drug conjugate targeting SORT1 in patients with advanced solid tumor malignancies (NCT07190469).

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of thoracic radiotherapy after the first cycle of chemoimmunotherapy did not improve treatment outcomes in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. Enrollment was prematurely discontinued due to more serious adverse events in the thoracic radiotherapy group and futility.
clinical_result_indication_detail: extensive-stage (ES) small cell lung cancer (SCLC):
clinical_result_layer_factor: presence of liver and brain metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Concurrent thoracic radiotherapy (TRT), platinum/etoposide chemotherapy, and durvalumab immunotherapy in extensive-stage (ES) small cell lung cancer (SCLC): A phase III trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lorlatinib was associated with early, clinically meaningful increases in atherogenic lipids, particularly LDL, with delayed vascular and cardiac complications. These lipid derangements may contribute to downstream cerebrovascular risk, supporting early and systematic lipid monitoring with proactive cardio-oncology-guided risk mitigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ALK-rearranged non-small cell lung cancer treated with lorlatinib at Rush University Medical Center from 2017 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world patterns of hyperlipidemia and cardiometabolic toxicity in patients with ALK-fusion– positive NSCLC treated with lorlatinib.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with treatment-refractory bone sarcomas treated with Mec-V monotherapy achieved a median overall survival of 17.6 months, which compared favorably with reported outcomes for other therapies, including combination therapies. Mec-V monotherapy holds considerable promise for these high unmet-need indications, with potential increased benefit when used in combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic chordoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, chondrosarcoma, and chordoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic chondrosarcoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic Ewing sarcoma
refractory osteosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival analysis of a heavily pretreated population of patients with bone sarcomas treated with mecbotamab vedotin, a conditionally binding ADC targeting AXL.

data.clinical_result_summary: The NEO approach of neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by transanal endoscopic surgery combined with selective adjuvant chemoradiation demonstrated promising organ-preservation outcomes in early-stage rectal cancer, with high total mesorectal excision-free survival. This strategy may provide a meaningful alternative to routine total mesorectal excision and potentially reduce the risk of permanent ostomy and low anterior resection syndrome.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with early-stage rectal cancer were treated with the NEO approach and selective adjuvant chemoradiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by transanal endoscopic surgery (TES) and selective chemoradiation or total mesorectal excision (TME) for early-stage rectal cancer: The Ottawa Hospital experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this clinical utility study, ctDNA% to guide enzalutamide or docetaxel selection in patients previously treated with abiraterone plus prednisone led to superior progression-free survival and overall survival compared with patient/clinician-selected therapy. These hypothesis-generating results illustrate the potential for ctDNA% as a predictive biomarker to assist clinical decision making and support further studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer progressing after abiraterone plus prednisone
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PROTRACT: A randomized phase II trial comparing ctDNA-guided biomarker directed therapy vs patient/clinician’s choice for metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) progressing after abiraterone plus prednisone (AAP).

data.clinical_result_summary: PRRT with ^177Lu-DOTATATE was feasible and well tolerated in pediatric, adolescent, and young adult patients with somatostatin receptor–positive neuroendocrine tumors. It achieved meaningful disease control with minimal toxicity, supporting PRRT as a valuable option in selected cases while highlighting the need for prospective studies and age-specific guidelines.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients younger than 20 years at Bambino Gesù Children’s Hospital with metastatic or unresectable somatostatin receptor–positive neuroendocrine tumors were eligible if somatostatin receptor expression was confirmed by PET-DOTA imaging with Krenning score ≥2.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Peptide receptor radionuclide therapy with 177Lu-DOTATATE in pediatric, adolescent, and young adult neuroendocrine tumors: A single-center experience from Bambino Gesù Children’s Hospital.

data.clinical_result_summary: HIPEC combined with camrelizumab, paclitaxel, and S-1 demonstrated promising conversion surgery and R0 resection rates, with significantly improved survival outcomes in surgical patients. The regimen was generally tolerable, with manageable toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer with peritoneal metastasis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HIPEC combined with PD-1 inhibitor, chemotherapy in conversion therapy for advanced gastric cancer with peritoneal metastasis: Results from a single-arm phase II clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study preliminarily demonstrates that the decitabine combination regimen has favorable efficacy and safety in first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic cancer. Larger future clinical studies are needed for validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients (pts) were prior untreated mPC or pts who had experienced disease progression more than six months after the end of postoperative adjuvant therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase Ib/II clinical study of adebrelimab combined with decitabine, nab-paclitaxel, and gemcitabine as first-line (IL) treatment for metastatic pancreatic cancer (mPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this exploratory analysis of DESTINY-Breast09, achieving a durable complete response or partial response was associated with favorable progression-free survival outcomes and prolonged treatment duration. Complete response or maximum tumor reduction was achieved with sustained trastuzumab deruxtecan plus pertuzumab treatment. Safety findings were consistent with previously reported profiles of trastuzumab deruxtecan and pertuzumab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer had no prior systemic therapy for advanced/metastatic breast cancer, although 1 line of endocrine therapy was allowed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A DESTINY-Breast09 analysis of treatment duration and clinical outcomes by best response to trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) + pertuzumab (P).

adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, chondrosarcoma, and chordoma

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab plus chemotherapy and bevacizumab showed encouraging clinical efficacy and tolerable safety as second-line treatment among patients with pMMR/MSS, RAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with RAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of cadonilimab plus chemotherapy and bevacizumab as second-line treatment in patients with RAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer: Preliminary findings of a multi-center, single-arm study.

The findings suggest that when PSMA-avid disease is present, Lu-PSMA-617 should be prioritized as the radiopharmaceutical of choice, although prospective studies are warranted to confirm optimal sequencing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult men with prostate cancer and bone metastases who received Lu-PSMA-617 or Ra-223, with castration resistance approximated by ongoing ADT and prior ARPI, and excluded patients with visceral metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of [^177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 versus radium-223 in bone-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: A real-world propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fruquintinib plus sintilimab and CAPEOX showed encouraging clinical outcomes and manageable safety for untreated advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. The trial is still recruiting, and more data including subgroup analysis and potential predictive response biomarkers will be further analyzed and reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fruquintinib in combination with sintilimab and CAPEOX as first-line treatment for advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: A single-arm, open-label, multicenter phase Ib/II study (FUNCTION).

data.clinical_result_summary: Consistent with the primary analysis, fruquintinib plus sintilimab showed superior efficacy compared with axitinib or everolimus for second-line treatment of advanced renal cell carcinoma. The benefit was observed for PFS and ORR regardless of baseline target lesion or metastatic site burden.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled eligible Chinese patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma who had failed prior tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy with fruquintinib plus sintilimab versus axitinib or everolimus in advanced renal cell carcinoma: A post-hoc analysis from FRUSICA-2 trial by baseline tumor burden.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lanreotide provided robust disease control and a manageable safety profile in Asian patients with advanced gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors. The observed efficacy, including a favorable objective response rate, supports lanreotide as a standard of care in this population.
clinical_result_indication_name: 胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Korean or Asian patients with unresectable or metastatic advanced gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors treated with lanreotide.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Lanreotide for advanced gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) in a Korean population: A multicenter prospective observational study (AIM-NETs).

data.clinical_result_summary: Obrixtamig plus standard of care demonstrated encouraging efficacy, supporting obrixtamig as a combination partner for first-line standard of care in extensive-stage small cell lung carcinoma. The combination showed a safety profile consistent with the individual agents and favorable tolerability, warranting further development in Phase III trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with extensive-stage small cell lung carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DAREON-8: Updated efficacy and safety from a phase I dose-escalation/expansion trial of first-line (1L) obrixtamig plus chemotherapy and atezolizumab in extensive-stage small cell lung carcinoma (ES-SCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Intrapleural JMKX000197 exhibited a manageable safety profile and promising preliminary efficacy in patients with malignant pleural effusion, with better efficacy at the 300 μg dose. JMKX000197 may induce the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and subsequently activate the tumor microenvironment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors with moderate-to-large malignant pleural effusion
data.clinical_result_paper_title: STING agonist JMKX000197 infusion in patients with malignant pleural effusion: Preliminary results from a prospective phase Ib study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The primary endpoint of 6-month progression-free survival was met in this phase 2 study, with 69% of patients achieving PFS-6 and surpassing established historical benchmarks. [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE was generally well tolerated and deserves further study in patients with advanced meningiomas. Exploratory [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE PET studies showed decreased uptake in a subset of lesions and showed promise as an imaging biomarker to assess treatment response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced and treatment-refractory intracranial meningiomas.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of a single-arm, open-label, multicenter phase 2 study of the radiopharmaceutical [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE and [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE in adults with advanced intracranial meningioma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, earlier use of peptide receptor radionuclide therapy after progression on somatostatin analogues was associated with improved clinical outcomes and a favorable toxicity profile. The findings support consideration of peptide receptor radionuclide therapy as a preferred second-line option in appropriately selected patients and highlight the importance of treatment sequencing in optimizing long-term outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic G1-G2 well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors of gastroenteropancreatic origin who received somatostatin analogues as first-line therapy, comparing those who received peptide receptor radionuclide therapy as second-line therapy without prior systemic treatment with those who received other systemic therapies followed by peptide receptor radionuclide therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Optimizing PRRT sequencing after progression on somatostatin analogue in neuroendocrine tumors: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of gabapentin and ketamine was safe and feasible in patients undergoing radiotherapy for head and neck cancer. Preliminary data indicated that most patients experienced low to moderate levels of pain with minimal opioid use, and larger randomized studies are warranted to confirm the benefit of this combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pain in patients undergoing radiotherapy for head and neck cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Gabapentin plus intranasal ketamine for the prevention and treatment of pain in patients undergoing radiotherapy for head and neck cancer: Phase II trial results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Debio 0123 combined with carboplatin had a manageable safety profile at the tested 520 mg dose. The combination showed signals of antitumor activity in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, or fallopian tube cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with platinum-resistant, high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, or fallopian tube cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Debio 0123 (zedoresertib), a selective WEE1 inhibitor, in combination with carboplatin in adult patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: Expansion part of the Debio0123-101 phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Survival outcomes were similar across carboplatin-paclitaxel dosing schedules in patients with metastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma. Q3-week carboplatin-paclitaxel may be a reasonable alternative to standard dosing, with the potential to reduce treatment-related burden.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma treated with first-line carboplatin-paclitaxel between 2020 and 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line carboplatin-paclitaxel (CP) for metastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma (ASCC): An analysis of dosing schedules.

data.clinical_result_summary: TBRT improved surgical bed control and overall survival compared with SRT for patients with a newly diagnosed resectable brain metastasis. Safety was equivalent, and faster completion of total cranial treatment with TBRT, together with fewer surgical bed recurrences, may have contributed to the observed overall survival benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The trial included patients with newly diagnosed resectable brain metastases who required resection of one newly diagnosed brain metastasis, with up to 5 additional unresected brain metastases allowed and treated with stereotactic radiation in both arms.
clinical_result_layer_factor: stratification factors as covariates
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of a randomized, controlled, phase 3 trial comparing resection and post-operative stereotactic radiation versus resection and cesium-131 tile-based radiation for treatment of newly diagnosed brain metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world propensity-matched study, intensive chemotherapy was associated with significantly better short-term survival than venetoclax plus hypomethylating agent therapy in adults with acute myeloid leukemia. However, intensive chemotherapy also carried slightly higher risks of sepsis and acute kidney injury, suggesting that venetoclax-hypomethylating agent therapy remains an option for patients unfit for intensive treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with acute myeloid leukemia receiving either intensive chemotherapy or venetoclax plus a hypomethylating agent as initial therapy, excluding patients with acute promyelocytic leukemia.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intensive chemotherapy versus venetoclax–hypomethylating agents therapy for acute myeloid leukemia: A large real-world propensity-matched study.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 急性早幼粒细胞白血病

data.clinical_result_summary: In this exploratory analysis of DESTINY-Breast09, achieving a durable complete response or partial response was associated with favorable progression-free survival outcomes and prolonged treatment duration. Complete response or maximum tumor reduction was achieved with sustained trastuzumab deruxtecan plus pertuzumab treatment. Safety findings were consistent with previously reported profiles of trastuzumab deruxtecan and pertuzumab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer had no prior systemic therapy for advanced/metastatic breast cancer, although 1 line of endocrine therapy was allowed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A DESTINY-Breast09 analysis of treatment duration and clinical outcomes by best response to trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) + pertuzumab (P).

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative chemotherapy plus RC48 and toripalimab had controllable safety and showed encouraging efficacy in patients with HER2-overexpressed gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-overexpressed locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative chemotherapy plus disitamab vedotin (RC48) and toripalimab in HER2-overexpressed locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer (PERISCOPE-02): An open-label, single-arm, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative chemotherapy plus RC48 and toripalimab had controllable safety and showed encouraging efficacy in patients with HER2-overexpressed gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-overexpressed locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative chemotherapy plus disitamab vedotin (RC48) and toripalimab in HER2-overexpressed locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer (PERISCOPE-02): An open-label, single-arm, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: These analyses further support the superior investigator-assessed progression-free survival of giredestrant plus everolimus over standard-of-care endocrine therapy plus everolimus in patients with ER-positive advanced breast cancer, including the ESR1m population. Improvements in PFS2 and chemotherapy-free survival regardless of ESR1m status suggest that the clinical benefit of giredestrant plus everolimus is sustained beyond initial progression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer who had disease progression or relapse during or after treatment with a CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-progression treatment (tx) analyses of evERA Breast Cancer (BC): A phase III trial of giredestrant (GIRE) + everolimus (E) in patients (pts) with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative advanced BC (ER+, HER2– aBC) previously treated with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (i).

data.clinical_result_summary: LY4101174 demonstrated clinical activity at Q3W dose levels, including in enfortumab vedotin-pretreated metastatic urothelial carcinoma, suggesting that Nectin-4 remains an important therapeutic target. Dose and treatment duration were mainly limited by grade ≥3 hematologic toxicity requiring prophylactic G-CSF.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with locally advanced / metastatic urothelial carcinoma or other selected solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial results from EXCEED, a phase 1 study of LY4101174, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4, in participants with advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Surufatinib monotherapy demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with previously treated, advanced recurrent or metastatic thymic epithelial tumors. These findings support further investigation of surufatinib in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed, unresectable or radiotherapy-ineligible, advanced recurrent or metastatic B2/B3 thymoma or thymic carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Surufatinib for advanced or metastatic chemotherapy-refractory thymic epithelial tumor: A single-arm, single-center, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: BA1301 was well tolerated with a manageable safety profile and demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity in patients with CLDN18.2 moderate to high expression. The findings support further development of BA1301 as a new therapeutic approach to treat CLDN18.2-positive solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pre-treated advanced solid tumors, particularly those with CLDN18.2 medium or high expression.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CLDN18.2–targeting antibody-drug conjugate BA1301 in advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective cohort, simultaneous anthracycline-based chemotherapy and dual HER2 blockade in early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer was effective, with a pathological complete response rate of 81.1%. The regimen also showed excellent cardiac safety.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included 164 consecutive patients with early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer treated at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Medical University of Innsbruck between April 2013 and February 2022.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Simultaneous anthracycline-based chemotherapy and dual HER2 blockade in early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer: A retrospective analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: STR-P004, an off-the-shelf and repeatable in vivo CD19 CAR T-cell therapy, demonstrated favorable safety and initial efficacy in patients with autoimmune diseases. The findings were particularly notable for patients requiring continuous immunosuppression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with autoimmune diseases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: In vivo CD19 CAR T-cell therapy (STR-P004) to induce remission in patients with autoimmune diseases (AID).

data.clinical_result_summary: GLP-1RA use was associated with a significant reduction in lymphangitis and healthcare utilization for post mastectomy lymphedema syndrome in breast cancer patients. The protective signal remained consistent across non-obese and non-diabetic subgroups, suggesting a potential disease-modifying effect driven by improved lymphatic flow and reduced inflammation. These findings warrant prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included breast cancer patients aged 18-90 years with a diagnosis of post mastectomy lymphedema syndrome between January 1, 2000, and January 1, 2025, comparing those on GLP-1RA therapy for at least 2 months with matched non-users.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A real-world analysis on the management of post-mastectomy lymphedema in breast cancer patients: The therapeutic promise of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist.

data.clinical_result_summary: Clinical outcomes following IL13-PE38QQR therapy were strongly associated with delivery efficiency and treatment-team experience. Radiolabeled distribution studies, experience-dependent survival effects, and recurrence patterns suggested that outcome variability was driven primarily by technical limitations in drug delivery rather than tumor biology. The findings highlight the need for standardized procedures, specialized training, and purpose-built delivery platforms to optimize IL13-PE38QQR therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated patients with recurrent glioblastoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Recurrence patterns and site-level survival in the previous phase III study of IL13-PE38QQR: Implications for drug distribution variability.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant cadonilimab plus CapeOX appears safe and effective in patients with clinical stage III gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma. The regimen achieved a moderate pathologic complete response rate and warrants further exploration of neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy combination strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with clinical stage III gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant cadonilimab plus CapeOX in patients with clinical stage III gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma (GC/EGJC): A prospective, single-arm phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world study suggests that donafenib, either as monotherapy or in combination with chemotherapy, is effective and well tolerated in patients with locally advanced or metastatic thyroid cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with locally advanced thyroid cancer or metastatic thyroid cancer, with donafenib plus chemotherapy considered for cases of high tumor burden, such as causing dyspnea, or for patients who had previously received combination chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Locally advanced or metastatic thyroid cancer treated with donafenib with or without chemotherapy: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Surufatinib monotherapy demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with previously treated, advanced recurrent or metastatic thymic epithelial tumors. These findings support further investigation of surufatinib in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed, unresectable or radiotherapy-ineligible, advanced recurrent or metastatic B2/B3 thymoma or thymic carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Surufatinib for advanced or metastatic chemotherapy-refractory thymic epithelial tumor: A single-arm, single-center, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with high-risk penile squamous carcinoma, TIP showed numerically longer disease-free survival and overall survival but higher hematologic toxicity. Platinum doublets appeared more feasible and better tolerated, underscoring the need for prospective studies in this rare disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk penile squamous carcinoma, including clinical N2-N3 disease and high-risk features such as bulky, bilateral, or pelvic nodes, were treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy at Tata Memorial Centre between January 2016 and June 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Is more always better?: Outcomes of TIP versus platinum doublet neoadjuvant chemotherapy in high-risk penile cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: At this early stage, emavusertib in combination with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel as second-line therapy for metastatic or unresectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma showed a manageable toxicity profile and encouraging preliminary antitumor activity. The observed objective response rate was 20% and disease control rate was 60%, and escalation to DL4 is ongoing before dose expansion at the recommended phase 2 dose.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic or unresectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial of emavusertib (CA-4948) in combination with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel in metastatic or unresectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).

data.clinical_result_summary: These analyses further support the superior investigator-assessed progression-free survival of giredestrant plus everolimus over standard-of-care endocrine therapy plus everolimus in patients with ER-positive advanced breast cancer, including the ESR1m population. Improvements in PFS2 and chemotherapy-free survival regardless of ESR1m status suggest that the clinical benefit of giredestrant plus everolimus is sustained beyond initial progression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer who had disease progression or relapse during or after treatment with a CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-progression treatment (tx) analyses of evERA Breast Cancer (BC): A phase III trial of giredestrant (GIRE) + everolimus (E) in patients (pts) with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative advanced BC (ER+, HER2– aBC) previously treated with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (i).

data.clinical_result_summary: HIPEC combined with camrelizumab, paclitaxel, and S-1 demonstrated promising conversion surgery and R0 resection rates, with significantly improved survival outcomes in surgical patients. The regimen was generally tolerable, with manageable toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer with peritoneal metastasis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HIPEC combined with PD-1 inhibitor, chemotherapy in conversion therapy for advanced gastric cancer with peritoneal metastasis: Results from a single-arm phase II clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Gabapentinoids were reported as a safe and effective way to treat oncologic pruritus stemming from malignancy, cancer therapies, or cutaneous graft-versus-host disease. Prospective trials would further establish the safety and efficacy profile of gabapentinoids in the oncologic population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients prescribed gabapentinoids for oncologic pruritus were included, with oncologic pruritus defined as pruritus originating from malignancy, oncologic therapies, or other cancer-associated toxicities such as cutaneous graft-versus-host disease; patients taking gabapentinoids for indications other than pruritus were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical outcomes of gabapentinoids for oncologic pruritus: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: B7H3/IL13Rα2 bispecific CAR-T exhibited favorable safety in recurrent/refractory glioblastoma. Low-dose, pharmacokinetic-guided multiple infusions avoided dose-limiting toxicities, with all adverse events reversible via standard interventions, and showed robust in vivo expansion and persistence supporting subsequent dose-escalation trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: 18-75 years old with recurrent/refractory GBM
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of B7H3/IL13Rα2 bispecific armored CAR-T for treatment of recurrent/refractory glioblastoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Integrating Tα-1 into the PRaG regimen is a promising therapeutic strategy for advanced refractory solid tumors, offering enhanced efficacy and a favorable safety profile. Detailed immune profiling identified distinct T-cell dynamics associated with treatment response, highlighting potential biomarkers for clinical application, and further validation in larger cohorts is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced solid tumors who had progressed after prior systemic therapy
clinical_result_layer_factor: baseline T-lymphocyte counts
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PRaG 5.0: Personalized thymosin alpha-1 and radioimmunotherapy for advanced refractory solid tumors—Data from an expanded cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with treatment-refractory bone sarcomas treated with Mec-V monotherapy achieved a median overall survival of 17.6 months, which compared favorably with reported outcomes for other therapies, including combination therapies. Mec-V monotherapy holds considerable promise for these high unmet-need indications, with potential increased benefit when used in combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic chordoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, chondrosarcoma, and chordoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic chondrosarcoma
adult and adolescent patients with AXL-expressing locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic Ewing sarcoma
refractory osteosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival analysis of a heavily pretreated population of patients with bone sarcomas treated with mecbotamab vedotin, a conditionally binding ADC targeting AXL.

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal curcumin combined with standard chemoradiation was safe and well tolerated in newly diagnosed glioblastoma. The study identified 350 mg/m2 as the recommended Phase II dose and reported encouraging exploratory signals of disease control, supporting further evaluation in an expanded Phase II/III study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed high-grade glioma (WHO grade 3 or 4)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/II study of liposomal curcumin in combination with standard radiation and temozolomide in patients with newly diagnosed high-grade gliomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: GLP-1RA use was associated with a significant reduction in lymphangitis and healthcare utilization for post mastectomy lymphedema syndrome in breast cancer patients. The protective signal remained consistent across non-obese and non-diabetic subgroups, suggesting a potential disease-modifying effect driven by improved lymphatic flow and reduced inflammation. These findings warrant prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included breast cancer patients aged 18-90 years with a diagnosis of post mastectomy lymphedema syndrome between January 1, 2000, and January 1, 2025, comparing those on GLP-1RA therapy for at least 2 months with matched non-users.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A real-world analysis on the management of post-mastectomy lymphedema in breast cancer patients: The therapeutic promise of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist.

data.clinical_result_summary: Anetumab ravtansine had an acceptable safety profile in pancreatic adenocarcinoma, and 6.5 mg/kg was identified as the RP2D. Evidence of clinical benefit was observed, including prolonged disease stabilization in some patients and one complete response in a setting of limited therapeutic options. Correlative analysis to identify predictive biomarkers for treatment benefit is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts with advanced PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results and preliminary correlative analysis of a phase I study of anetumab ravtansine in combination with checkpoint inhibitors and gemcitabine in mesothelin-positive advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma (NCI10208).

data.clinical_result_summary: BA1301 was well tolerated with a manageable safety profile and demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity in patients with CLDN18.2 moderate to high expression. The findings support further development of BA1301 as a new therapeutic approach to treat CLDN18.2-positive solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pre-treated advanced solid tumors, particularly those with CLDN18.2 medium or high expression.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CLDN18.2–targeting antibody-drug conjugate BA1301 in advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with PIK3CA-mutant advanced breast cancer after progression on CDK4/6 inhibitor plus aromatase inhibitor therapy, alpelisib plus fulvestrant was not superior to standard chemotherapy with capecitabine. Capecitabine was better tolerated and resulted in longer progression-free survival compared with the targeted therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced breast cancer patients with PIK3CA-mutant circulating DNA following CDK4/6 inhibition
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior chemo for ABC and visceral disease
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CAPTURE: A phase II trial evaluating alpelisib + fulvestrant vs capecitabine in advanced breast cancer patients with PIK3CA-mutant circulating DNA following CDK4/6 inhibition.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer and high-volume disease, ARPI-based triplet therapy induced rapid and deep PSA responses, consistent with clinical trial data. Darolutamide was associated with numerically faster and deeper PSA decline than abiraterone, supporting the clinical activity of triplet regimens in practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer who initiated darolutamide- or abiraterone-based triplet therapy and had serial PSA measurements, with high-volume disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world PSA kinetics and depth of response with ARPI-based triplet therapy in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer: A single-center retrospective cohort analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Aspirin use at the time of endometrial cancer diagnosis was associated with a significant improvement in disease-specific survival in this retrospective cohort. The authors concluded that the data are promising as a potential improvement in therapy for patients with endometrial cancer, but prospective data are needed to further evaluate the effect of aspirin on outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included all patients with endometrial cancer treated at a single academic institution between 2014 and 2017.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Aspirin use and survival outcomes in endometrial cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Surufatinib plus gemcitabine and cisplatin combined with an immune checkpoint inhibitor showed preliminary anti-tumor activity and manageable toxicity in the first-line treatment of unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The authors suggest it may provide an additional treatment option for patients with intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of surufatinib combined with gemcitabine and cisplatin and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) for unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study met both dual primary endpoints at the prespecified interim analysis. Iza-bren demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in overall survival and progression-free survival compared with chemotherapy in patients with recurrent or metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma who had progressed after first-line PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor plus platinum-based chemotherapy. The safety profile was manageable, and the results support iza-bren as a new second-line standard of care for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients With Recurrent or Metastatic Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma After Failure of PD-1/PD-L1 Monoclonal Antibody in Combination With Platinum-based Chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Izalontamab brengitecan (iza-bren) versus chemotherapy in patients with recurrent or metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC): A multicenter, randomized, open-label, phase III study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This retrospective comparison of once-daily versus twice-daily zanubrutinib dosing in frontline CLL/SLL found overlapping PFS and OS Kaplan-Meier curves with 2 years of follow-up, although few progression and death events limited definitive conclusions. Once-daily dosing was associated with a lower treatment discontinuation rate and may improve tolerability while maintaining comparable efficacy. Further research is needed to confirm real-world non-inferiority of these safety and survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma treated with frontline zanubrutinib once daily or twice daily at Weill Cornell Medical Center were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcome comparison of once versus twice daily dosing of zanubrutinib.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤

The regimen also showed excellent cardiac safety.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included 164 consecutive patients with early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer treated at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Medical University of Innsbruck between April 2013 and February 2022.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Simultaneous anthracycline-based chemotherapy and dual HER2 blockade in early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer: A retrospective analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The development of grade 2 or higher hypertension was associated with a significant overall survival benefit in patients treated with paclitaxel plus ramucirumab in the ARMANI trial. These findings support further research to identify biomarkers predictive of hypertension onset to refine patient selection for switch maintenance strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced HER2-negative gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer who had disease control after a 3-month first-line fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin induction chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes according to ramucirumab (RAM)-related hypertension (HTN) in patients (pts) with advanced HER2-negative gastric (G) or gastro-esophageal junction (GEJ) cancer: An exploratory analysis of the phase III ARMANI trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal mitoxantrone combined with PD-1 inhibitors demonstrated promising antitumor activity with manageable toxicities in patients with pretreated recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Long-term survival data are pending because follow-up is still ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pretreated recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An open-label, single-center phase II trial of mitoxantrone hydrochloride liposome combined with programmed death-1 (PD-1) inhibitors for pretreated recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In RAMPART, durvalumab plus tremelimumab was associated with a statistically significant improvement in disease-free survival. This improvement was not observed with durvalumab monotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resected primary renal cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Durvalumab monotherapy versus active monitoring for resected primary renal cell carcinoma in RAMPART: An international, phase 3, randomized controlled trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Overall adverse events were comparable, but a higher incidence of grade ≥3 adverse events versus standard of care was observed. NIS793-containing arms showed a deleterious progression-free survival outcome in patients with microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: daNIS-3: A phase II platform study of NIS793 and anti–PD-1 combined with standard of care (SoC) anti-cancer therapy for the second-line (2L) treatment (tx) of microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer (MSS CRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: This study demonstrated excellent efficacy of UTD2 plus capecitabine in patients with metastatic breast cancer. The regimen showed a safety profile with significantly decreased peripheral neuropathy and low hematological toxicity, and utidelone capsule may improve medication convenience and patient compliance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: metastatic BC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of a phase II study of utidelone capsule, the first solid oral microtubule stabilizer, in metastatic breast cancer patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tislelizumab, bevacizumab, and switched chemotherapy showed promising efficacy and manageable safety as second-line therapy in RAS-mutant, PD-L1-positive metastatic colorectal cancer. This combination regimen may provide a potential therapeutic option for this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: RAS-mutant, PD-L1-positive metastatic colorectal cancer patients who progressed after first-line fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tislelizumab, bevacizumab, and chemotherapy as second-line therapy in PD-L1-positive, RAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer: A single-arm, phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: CTS3497 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and promising efficacy in heavily pretreated patients with MTAP-deficient advanced solid tumors, including gastrointestinal cancers and non-small cell lung cancer. No dose-limiting toxicity was observed, the maximum tolerated dose was not reached, and objective responses were reported in the efficacy-evaluable population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with homozygous MTAP deletion (by next generation sequencing), or MTAP protein loss (by immunohistochemistry [IHC]) and advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human phase I/II study evaluating CTS3497, an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in advanced or metastatic MTAP-deficient solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Abemaciclib demonstrated a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival versus placebo in patients with dedifferentiated liposarcoma, with an encouraging overall survival trend. These results support abemaciclib as a new treatment option for dedifferentiated liposarcoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced dedifferentiated liposarcoma
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior lines of therapy (0 vs 1 or more)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SARC041: A phase 3 randomized double-blind study of abemaciclib versus placebo in patients with advanced dedifferentiated liposarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: QLC5508 showed prolonged radiological progression-free survival and a manageable safety profile in heavily treated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. A phase 3 study is currently being planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: heavily-treated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of QLC5508 (MHB088C) in heavily-treated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: Updated data from a phase 1/2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This retrospective analysis supports the use of durvalumab, atezolizumab, lurbinectedin, and tarlatamab regimens in rare neuroendocrine neoplasms other than small cell lung cancer. Larger observational trials are needed to identify sequencing data and differences in overall survival between these regimens and other commonly used treatments.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with high-grade neuroendocrine neoplasms, specifically any high-grade neuroendocrine neoplasm other than small cell lung cancer, including high-grade extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of atezolizumab, durvalumab, lurbinectedin, and tarlatamab in high-grade extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma: A multicenter retrospective comparative analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with symptomatic metastatic triple-negative breast cancer requiring radiotherapy represent a high-risk population with poor outcomes despite combined pembrolizumab and chemotherapy. Radiotherapy provided effective local control with acceptable toxicity, but prospective studies are needed to determine whether greater integration of stereotactic radiotherapy with antibody–drug conjugates can improve outcomes in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Female patients with histologically confirmed metastatic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy outside clinical trials in Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia between September 2022 and June 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Radiotherapy in symptomatic metastatic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab and chemotherapy: A multinational real-world study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: GFS202A demonstrated favorable safety and encouraging efficacy, with systemic inflammation alleviated and weight gain observed. The data support dual-targeting GDF15 and IL-6 as a feasible approach to mitigate cancer cachexia clinically, and further studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced cancer patients with pre-cachexia or cachexia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human (FiH) phase I study of GFS202A, a GDF15/IL-6 bispecific antibody, in advanced cancer patients (pts) with pre-cachexia or cachexia.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer and high-volume disease, ARPI-based triplet therapy induced rapid and deep PSA responses, consistent with clinical trial data. Darolutamide was associated with numerically faster and deeper PSA decline than abiraterone, supporting the clinical activity of triplet regimens in practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer who initiated darolutamide- or abiraterone-based triplet therapy and had serial PSA measurements, with high-volume disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world PSA kinetics and depth of response with ARPI-based triplet therapy in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer: A single-center retrospective cohort analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: GT801 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and early signs of antitumor activity in heavily pretreated B-NHL patients. Its ability to generate functional CAR-T cells in vivo without lymphodepletion supports further clinical evaluation as a promising therapeutic approach.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell hematologic malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of in vivo CAR-T therapy GT801 in adults with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of HB0025 and chemotherapy demonstrated promising efficacy and favorable safety as first-line treatment for patients with locally advanced unresectable, recurrent or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Multi-center, randomized, double-blind, controlled phase III trials in both squamous and non-squamous NSCLC have been initiated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Cohort 2 (non-squamous NSCLC):
Cohort 1 (squamous NSCLC):
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of HB0025 (a PD-L1/VEGF bispecific antibody) in combination with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: SGLT2 inhibitors may lower mean PSA levels and reduce the risk of prostate cancer and osseous metastases in males with type two diabetes mellitus compared with matched controls. SGLT2 inhibitors appeared to have superior effects on these outcomes compared with GLP1 receptor agonists, while GLP1 receptor agonists may reduce mean PSA scores and osseous metastasis risk compared with matched controls. More prospective studies are needed to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included males aged 18 to 90 with type two diabetes mellitus and excluded patients with type one diabetes mellitus from all cohorts.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of SGLT2i and GLP1 agonists on prostate cancer incidence and outcomes: A real-world propensity score–matched cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: TUB-040 was well tolerated and showed promising clinical activity at low doses in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. The results suggest TUB-040 may offer a potential new treatment option with a differentiated, favorable benefit-risk profile and a wide therapeutic window; dose optimization is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant ovarian (PROC) high grade serous carcinoma (HGSC).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: NAPISTAR 1-01: Results of phase 1 dose escalation of monotherapy with TUB-040, a novel NaPi2b-targeting exatecan ADC, in patients (pts) with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant combination immunotherapy, targeted therapy, and SBRT showed excellent efficacy and tolerable toxicity in patients with locally advanced laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma. Dose reduction of sequential IMRT appeared to reduce severe toxicity without compromising laryngeal preservation, suggesting a promising de-escalation strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Larynx preservation via chemotherapy-free neoadjuvant sintilimab-cetuximab-SBRT and response-adapted treatment in locally advanced laryngeal cancer: A phase II, single-arm clinical trial (the NeoVOICE study).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 药物相关严重不良事件
data.clinical_result_summary: NXL-004 showed favorable safety and encouraging efficacy in patients with recurrent malignant glioma. The authors concluded that this is the first clinical evidence of in vivo AAV-based trans-differentiation gene therapy for cancer treatment and that AAV-based cell reprogramming may represent a new modality for the treatment of glioma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Malignant glioma
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 药物相关严重不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of AAV6-NeuroD1 trans-differentiation therapy in recurrent malignant glioma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In metastatic hormone receptor-positive and HER-2-negative breast cancer, switching from ribociclib to palbociclib should be considered when toxicity develops, rather than reducing the dose or discontinuing treatment. The authors concluded that toxicity would not continue after the switch.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients from nine centers with metastatic hormone receptor-positive and HER-2-negative breast cancer who developed toxicity during ribociclib treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The effect of switching from ribociclib to palbociclib due to toxicity in hormone receptor–positive, HER-2–negative metastatic breast cancer: A real-world, multicenter, retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: MET expression levels did not correlate with response and outcomes to cabozantinib in patients with relapsed, refractory germ-cell tumor.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with relapsed, refractory germ-cell tumor were enrolled in the phase II clinical trial of cabozantinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: c-MET expression by IHC and response to cabozantinib in patients with relapsed, refractory germ-cell tumor: A single-arm phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a cohort of heavily treated patients with advanced soft tissue and bone sarcoma, cabozantinib alone or with immune checkpoint inhibition showed durable clinical benefit in nearly 50% of patients. These findings suggest that cabozantinib alone or with immune checkpoint inhibition could provide substantial benefit to certain sarcoma patients with very limited remaining treatment options.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were heavily pretreated patients with locally advanced or metastatic sarcoma who received cabozantinib with or without immune checkpoint inhibition for at least one day; patients who participated in the randomized phase II trial of cabozantinib combined with PD-1 and CTLA-4 inhibition versus cabozantinib in metastatic soft tissue sarcoma were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes of cabozantinib treatment with and without immune checkpoint inhibition in patients with heavily pretreated advanced sarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with symptomatic metastatic triple-negative breast cancer requiring radiotherapy represent a high-risk population with poor outcomes despite combined pembrolizumab and chemotherapy. Radiotherapy provided effective local control with acceptable toxicity, but prospective studies are needed to determine whether greater integration of stereotactic radiotherapy with antibody–drug conjugates can improve outcomes in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Female patients with histologically confirmed metastatic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy outside clinical trials in Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia between September 2022 and June 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Radiotherapy in symptomatic metastatic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab and chemotherapy: A multinational real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: THP plus pembrolizumab was associated with 100% event-free survival after a median follow-up of 37 months, while recurrences occurred in the THP arm. Although the trial was not powered for EFS, the findings support definitive evaluation of THP with or without pembrolizumab in a phase 3 trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naive patients with stage II-III HER2+ breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: hormone receptor status and nodal status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Event-free survival from the randomized phase 2 neoHIP trial evaluating neoadjuvant taxane, HER2-targeted therapy, +/- pembrolizumab in early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Selinexor plus ruxolitinib significantly improved spleen response compared with ruxolitinib alone, with earlier, deeper, and sustained response rates, comparable symptom improvement from baseline, and a manageable safety profile. The improved spleen response, early overall survival signal, and variant allele frequency reductions observed in SENTRY position selinexor plus ruxolitinib as a novel combination approach for frontline treatment of myelofibrosis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with JAKi-naïve myelofibrosis.
clinical_result_layer_factor: DIPSS risk, spleen volume, and baseline platelet count
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Selinexor plus ruxolitinib in JAK inhibitor–naïve myelofibrosis: Phase 3 SENTRY trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: A single dose of partial breast irradiation 8 Gy to the primary tumor before neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy yielded a promising pathological complete response rate, supporting the hypothesis that radiotherapy modulates the tumor microenvironment and enhances local antitumor immunity. This approach was particularly beneficial for patients with immune-cold tumor microenvironment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively analyzed patients aged ≥ 20 years with early triple-negative breast cancer who had ER and PR expression < 1%, HER2-negative invasive carcinoma, and clinical stage II-III disease (cT2-4N0-3 or cT1N1-3), and who received partial breast irradiation to the primary tumor before neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy with pembrolizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Partial breast irradiation followed by neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy in early TNBC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Debio 0123 combined with carboplatin had a manageable safety profile at the tested 520 mg dose. The combination showed signals of antitumor activity in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, or fallopian tube cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with platinum-resistant, high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, or fallopian tube cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Debio 0123 (zedoresertib), a selective WEE1 inhibitor, in combination with carboplatin in adult patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: Expansion part of the Debio0123-101 phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This retrospective comparison of once-daily versus twice-daily zanubrutinib dosing in frontline CLL/SLL found overlapping PFS and OS Kaplan-Meier curves with 2 years of follow-up, although few progression and death events limited definitive conclusions. Once-daily dosing was associated with a lower treatment discontinuation rate and may improve tolerability while maintaining comparable efficacy. Further research is needed to confirm real-world non-inferiority of these safety and survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma treated with frontline zanubrutinib once daily or twice daily at Weill Cornell Medical Center were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcome comparison of once versus twice daily dosing of zanubrutinib.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients treated with TIL therapy, baseline visceral disease burden was strongly associated with survival outcomes, while bridging therapy did not compromise post-infusion efficacy among patients proceeding to infusion. Post-infusion IL-2 exposure correlated with OS and likely reflects early treatment tolerance. These clinical features may inform patient counseling, referral timing, and sequencing decisions as TIL therapy enters broader clinical use.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with metastatic melanoma treated with TIL therapy across Mayo Clinic sites.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Baseline visceral disease burden and treatment delivery factors association with outcomes after tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte therapy for metastatic melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preclinical findings showed that NICE-TIL had potent and sustained activity across multiple solid-tumor models through dual TCR-HLA and NKG2D-NKG2DL killing pathways, with an effective tEGFR safety switch. The first patient with advanced treatment-resistant melanoma achieved a confirmed partial response, suggesting that NICE-TIL may be an effective treatment for late-stage solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Advanced Solid Tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: NICE-TIL (NKG2D-CAR/mbIL15/tEGFR-transduced TILs) and antitumor activity via dual TCR-HLA and NKG2D-NKG2DL killing pathways.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a heavily pretreated, platinum-exposed real-world population, mirvetuximab soravtansine demonstrated a small but statistically significant survival advantage over standard chemotherapy. The findings support its clinical benefit in later-line practice and highlight frequent post-mirvetuximab soravtansine bevacizumab use. Further studies are warranted to define optimal sequencing and combination strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who had received at least three prior platinum therapies and a subsequent platinum agent within 7–180 days of initial platinum therapy before index treatment; included patients were subsequently treated with mirvetuximab soravtansine or investigator’s choice chemotherapy, and FRα status was unknown.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world overall survival with mirvetuximab soravtansine compared with chemotherapy after multiple lines of platinum therapy in gynecologic cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Axi-cel and liso-cel demonstrated comparable effectiveness in terms of overall survival and event-free survival in large B-cell lymphoma. Safety profiles differed primarily in early neurotoxicity risk, while cytokine release syndrome incidence was similar between products, providing real-world comparative evidence to inform CAR T-cell therapy selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with large B-cell lymphoma who received axi-cel or liso-cel, excluding patients with active severe infections at the index date or a history of cardiovascular and central nervous system involvement.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative effectiveness and safety of axicabtagene ciloleucel versus lisocabtagene maraleucel in large B-cell lymphoma: A real-world target trial emulation.

data.clinical_result_summary: Manufacturing and treatment with autologous NT-175 eTCR T cells was safe and feasible in patients with heavily pre-treated metastatic TP53-mutated malignancies. NT-175 showed encouraging preliminary antitumor activity across multiple histologies, with the most notable early signals in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and may offer a prolonged treatment-free interval in patients with refractory solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HLA-A*02:01-positive adults with advanced/metastatic TP53 R175H-mutated solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial phase 1 study results of NT-175 engineered T-cell therapy in TP53 R175H–mutated unresectable advanced solid tumors.

clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced cancer patients with pre-cachexia or cachexia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human (FiH) phase I study of GFS202A, a GDF15/IL-6 bispecific antibody, in advanced cancer patients (pts) with pre-cachexia or cachexia.

data.clinical_result_summary: For cervical squamous cell carcinoma patients receiving radical concurrent chemoradiotherapy, early intervention with recombinant human thrombopoietin was a substantial factor for decreasing the incidence of Grade 3-5 cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia. It significantly improved nadir platelet count, shortened platelet recovery time, and reduced the incidence of Grade 3-5 cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia, thereby helping ensure uninterrupted treatment continuation.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的血小板减少
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage I-IVa cervical squamous cell carcinoma who developed cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia during radical concurrent chemoradiotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective study of the early treatment of recombinant human thrombopoietin for chemoradiation-induced thrombocytopenia in cervical squamous cell carcinoma patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant cadonilimab plus CapeOX appears safe and effective in patients with clinical stage III gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma. The regimen achieved a moderate pathologic complete response rate and warrants further exploration of neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy combination strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with clinical stage III gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant cadonilimab plus CapeOX in patients with clinical stage III gastric or esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma (GC/EGJC): A prospective, single-arm phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world Chinese cohort characterized by predominantly high-volume and high-risk disease, Darolutamide-based triplet therapy yielded rapid and deep PSA responses with acceptable toxicity. These findings support the feasibility and clinical utility of this regimen in Chinese patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, while underscoring the importance of vigilant monitoring for chemotherapy-related adverse events, particularly neutropenia.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Chinese patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer treated with androgen deprivation therapy, Darolutamide, and Docetaxel across 18 centers in Zhejiang Province, China, all of whom had metastatic disease at baseline.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of darolutamide-based triplet therapy in Chinese patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC): A multicenter analysis from Zhejiang province (YHCG-006 study).

data.clinical_result_summary: Olverembatinib showed good tolerability and led to high major molecular response and complete cytogenetic response rates in patients with chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia without the T315I mutation who were resistant or intolerant to first-line tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult CP-CML pts who were resistant/intolerant to prior 1L TKIs without the T315I mutation in China
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy and safety of olverembatinib (HQP1351) as second-line therapy in patients with chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia (CP-CML).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, treatment beyond progression after ipilimumab/nivolumab induction was common, with 38% of patients achieving disease control and over half remaining on therapy for at least 1 year. However, outcomes with treatment beyond progression were inferior to outcomes in patients with clear radiographic disease control, and long-term benefits were rarely observed in treatment-beyond-progression patients. These findings support prospective refinement of patient selection for treatment beyond progression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma who completed four doses of first-line ipilimumab/nivolumab at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center were analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Treatment beyond progression after early radiographic changes on first-line ipilimumab/nivolumab in metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Safety outcomes and elranatamab administration patterns were comparable across weight groups in Japanese patients with multiple myeloma. Further investigation in larger samples of this population is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult Japanese patients with multiple myeloma who first received elranatamab from March 26, 2024, to March 31, 2025 outside of clinical trials.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world safety of elranatamab in low-weight patients: Findings from the SUMMIT study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Debio 0123 combined with carboplatin had a manageable safety profile at the tested 520 mg dose. The combination showed signals of antitumor activity in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, or fallopian tube cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with platinum-resistant, high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, or fallopian tube cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Debio 0123 (zedoresertib), a selective WEE1 inhibitor, in combination with carboplatin in adult patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: Expansion part of the Debio0123-101 phase 1 study.
