data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world overall survival with mirvetuximab soravtansine compared with chemotherapy after multiple lines of platinum therapy in gynecologic cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study showed remarkable preliminary efficacy of BFv plus toripalimab in perioperative patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer. The combination may offer a new choice for patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer and deserves further investigation, with no new safety signals observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with perioperative MIBC (cohort A)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Bulumtatug fuvedotin (BFv; 9MW2821) plus toripalimab in perioperative patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC): Results of cohort A from a phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib or coformulated pembrolizumab/vibostolimab had a manageable safety profile in patients with neuroendocrine prostate cancer. Both regimens showed only modest antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic neuroendocrine prostate cancer - cohort F or cohort H
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1b/2 study of pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib or pembrolizumab coformulated with vibostolimab in participants (pts) with metastatic neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC): KEYNOTE-365 cohorts F and H.

data.clinical_result_summary: Higher early tacrolimus exposure, particularly mean levels greater than 11 ng/mL, was independently associated with inferior overall survival after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Other measures of tacrolimus variability were not significantly associated with survival, and future studies are warranted to clarify the mechanisms underlying these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients who underwent matched related, matched unrelated, or haploidentical allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation between January 2024 and May 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of early tacrolimus levels on survival outcomes following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a propensity-matched real-world cohort receiving contemporary dual HER2 blockade plus endocrine therapy, a chemotherapy-free strategy demonstrated similar 3-year overall survival compared with taxane induction, with a clinically meaningful reduction in neutropenia and no signal for higher sepsis, heart failure, or acute care utilization. These data support the feasibility of chemotherapy de-escalation in selected HR+/HER2+ metastatic breast cancer patients and motivate prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with incident hormone receptor-positive/HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer treated with dual HER2 blockade using trastuzumab plus pertuzumab and endocrine therapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dual HER2 blockade with or without taxane induction in HR+/HER2+ metastatic breast cancer: A comparative analysis of clinical outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: IMA401 demonstrated overall favorable tolerability without reaching a formal maximum tolerated dose and showed encouraging antitumor activity in patients with head and neck cancer, melanoma, and squamous non-small cell lung cancer at the recommended phase 2 dose range. Further development steps are being evaluated, including a potentially synergistic combination with the PRAME-directed bispecific IMA402 in squamous non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumor indications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts were ≥18 y, HLA-A*02:01+, MAGEA4+ and/or MAGEA8+, have R/R solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human results with IMA401, a MAGEA4/8-targeted T-cell receptor–based bispecific T-cell engager (TCER) in recurrent or refractory solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The high clinical activity of induction immunochemotherapy observed in this cohort could not be explained by tumor mutational burden as a predictive biomarker. Alternative biomarkers are required to better predict benefit from induction immunochemotherapy in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients enrolled in the prospective phase II study had locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, specifically squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx, larynx, and hypopharynx.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Predictive value of genomic mutation signatures and tumor mutational burden for induction immunochemotherapy in locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx, larynx, and hypopharynx.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, leukapheresis provided no overall survival benefit over pharmacologic cytoreduction alone. Given its high cost, resource intensity, and limited accessibility, the findings support selective rather than routine use, prioritizing prompt medical cytoreduction and supportive care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged 18 years or older with acute or chronic leukemia and hyperleukocytosis, defined as WBC ≥100 × 109/L, between January 2010 and December 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of leukapheresis and pharmacologic cytoreduction in hyperleukocytosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: With a minimum of 4 years of follow-up, updated PFS analyses demonstrated that the majority of patients remained alive and progression-free, illustrating durable disease control. Model-based predictions indicated the potential for cure in the dMMR/MSI-H primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer population receiving dostarlimab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with dMMR/MSI-H primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer from RUBY Part 1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term survival rates and cure modeling with dostarlimab plus chemotherapy in mismatch repair deficient/microsatellite instability-high (dMMR/MSI-H) primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer in the ENGOT-EN6-NSGO/GOG-3031/RUBY trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with stage IA HER2-positive breast cancer, adjuvant capecitabine plus trastuzumab was associated with an excellent 5-year invasive disease-free survival rate of 97.9%. No adverse events that influenced treatment continuity were observed, and the regimen may be an alternative for patients with small HER2-positive tumors with fewer toxic effects than established regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage IA HER2-positive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant capecitabine and trastuzumab for stage IA HER2-positive breast cancer (IRIS-A): A phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with chronic myeloid leukemia transformed to acute myeloid leukemia, azacitidine plus venetoclax achieved comparable 1-year survival and early infectious outcomes to intensive 7+3 induction despite being used in a frailer population. Larger multicenter studies are needed to confirm comparative effectiveness and refine patient selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with chronic myeloid leukemia transformed to acute myeloid leukemia who received induction therapy between January 1, 2010, and June 1, 2025, and were classified by receipt of 7+3 or azacitidine plus venetoclax within one year before or after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of 7+3 versus azacitidine/venetoclax in CML transformed to AML.

data.clinical_result_summary: IMA401 demonstrated overall favorable tolerability without reaching a formal maximum tolerated dose and showed encouraging antitumor activity in patients with head and neck cancer, melanoma, and squamous non-small cell lung cancer at the recommended phase 2 dose range. Further development steps are being evaluated, including a potentially synergistic combination with the PRAME-directed bispecific IMA402 in squamous non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumor indications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts were ≥18 y, HLA-A*02:01+, MAGEA4+ and/or MAGEA8+, have R/R solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human results with IMA401, a MAGEA4/8-targeted T-cell receptor–based bispecific T-cell engager (TCER) in recurrent or refractory solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: HA131 administered via hepatic arterial infusion in combination with systemic therapy demonstrated manageable safety and notable preliminary efficacy in patients with gastrointestinal cancer and liver metastases. The findings warrant further exploration of this regimen in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: gastrointestinal cancer with liver metastases
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HA131 (hepatic arterial infusion) in combination with systemic therapy (XELOX with or without bevacizumab) as first-line treatment in gastrointestinal cancer with liver metastases: A prospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Spatial immune profiling identified distinct tumor-immune interaction patterns associated with pathological complete response in high-risk ER-positive/HER2-negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and immune checkpoint inhibition. These findings suggest that spatial tumor-immune interactions may help refine patient selection for adding immune checkpoint inhibitors to neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Premenopausal patients with stage II–IIIA ER-positive/HER2-negative Luminal B-like breast cancer, defined by Ki67 ≥ 20% and/or grade 3 disease, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Spatial interactions between immune cells as a predictor of pCR to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) and nivolumab for ER+/HER2− breast cancer (BC): Analysis of the phase II GIADA trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The final analysis demonstrated that trifluridine/tipiracil plus ramucirumab did not provide a significant overall survival benefit compared with trifluridine/tipiracil alone in third- or later-line treatment for advanced gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Updated results for progression-free survival, tumor response, and safety were consistent with the primary analysis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable or recurrent gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma refractory or intolerant to fluoropyrimidine, taxane, or irinotecan, and refractory to ramucirumab
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Randomized phase II trial of trifluridine/tipiracil (FTD/TPI) plus ramucirumab (RAM) versus FTD/TPI for previously treated patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: Final analysis of RETRIEVE study (WJOG 15822G).

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of HLX07 to serplulimab and chemotherapy showed encouraging efficacy and a manageable safety profile in treatment-naïve patients with recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Further investigation of this treatment regimen is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with pathohistologically confirmed, unresectable, recurrent or metastatic NPC that is not amenable to local or radical treatment and had no prior systemic therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line HLX07 vs placebo combined with serplulimab and chemotherapy for nasopharyngeal carcinoma: A randomized, double-blind, multicenter phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with L-type sarcomas receiving trabectedin, totally implantable venous access ports were associated with a low frequency of clinically meaningful complications and supported safe drug administration. Complication, removal, and reimplantation rates were comparable to, or below, those reported in broader oncology populations using TIVAPs, and no extravasation events occurred. Implantation-related delays greater than 2 weeks were uncommon, supporting early planning of central venous access to prevent treatment postponements.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were patients with advanced L-type sarcomas who started trabectedin between August 2011 and September 2025 and had available information on totally implantable venous access port use.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and clinical impact of totally implantable venous access ports during trabectedin therapy in advanced L-type sarcomas: A multicenter SEPSaC-01 analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sunvozertinib demonstrated significantly superior antitumor efficacy compared with chemotherapy and had a manageable safety profile. These results support sunvozertinib as a first-line treatment for advanced non-small cell lung cancer harboring EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with newly diagnosed advanced non-small cell lung cancer with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations.
clinical_result_layer_factor: baseline brain metastasis status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sunvozertinib monotherapy versus platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced NSCLC with EGFR exon20ins: Primary analysis of a multinational phase 3 randomized study (WU-KONG28).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world EGFR-mutant NSCLC cohort, first-line EGFR TKI dose reduction was not associated with inferior survival, reduced treatment durability, or diminished access to subsequent therapy. These findings support individualized dose adjustments during EGFR TKI therapy when clinically indicated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with EGFR-mutated metastatic non-small cell lung cancer treated with first-line EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of first-line EGFR TKI dose reduction on survival and treatment sequencing in metastatic EGFR-mutant non–small cell lung cancer: A real-world cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a propensity-matched real-world cohort receiving contemporary dual HER2 blockade plus endocrine therapy, a chemotherapy-free strategy demonstrated similar 3-year overall survival compared with taxane induction, with a clinically meaningful reduction in neutropenia and no signal for higher sepsis, heart failure, or acute care utilization. These data support the feasibility of chemotherapy de-escalation in selected HR+/HER2+ metastatic breast cancer patients and motivate prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with incident hormone receptor-positive/HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer treated with dual HER2 blockade using trastuzumab plus pertuzumab and endocrine therapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dual HER2 blockade with or without taxane induction in HR+/HER2+ metastatic breast cancer: A comparative analysis of clinical outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: Delayed intravenous sodium thiosulfate was associated with preservation of clinically significant hearing in adults with head and neck cancer receiving curative-intent cisplatin, despite measurable changes on extended high-frequency audiometry and distortion product otoacoustic emissions. The findings support comprehensive audiometric monitoring and suggest that sodium thiosulfate is a feasible otoprotective strategy during platinum-based therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with head and neck cancer treated for cure, with a planned cumulative cisplatin dose of at least 150 mg/m2, treated between 11/2024 and 9/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Audiometric outcomes for intravenous sodium thiosulfate for cisplatin-induced ototoxicity prevention in adults with head and neck cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic malignancies receiving GLP1 therapy demonstrated superior survival outcomes. The observed survival benefit may be related to the anti-inflammatory properties of GLP1, including immunomodulatory effects and attenuation of oncogenic signaling and proliferation. Further investigation into the broader oncologic effects of GLP1 therapy is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with hepatocellular carcinoma, fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder cancer, or pancreatic cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival in patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic cancers taking GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with PD1-refractory head and neck cancer and lung cancers, pexmetinib plus nivolumab demonstrated an acceptable safety profile and durable clinical benefit. Multimodal translational profiling revealed increased inflammatory cytokine signaling and radiomic and molecular features consistent with enhanced CD8+ T-cell engagement in responders, suggesting that targeting tumor-intrinsic p38 MAPK may help overcome immunotherapy resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with PD-1 refractory head and neck (HN) cancer and lung cancers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical and translational study of p38 inhibitor pexmetinib plus nivolumab following anti–PD-1/L1 failure in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: HCB101 demonstrated durable monotherapy antitumor activity and a wide therapeutic window up to 36 mg/kg, addressing key limitations of earlier CD47-directed therapies. Early combination activity was observed across multiple solid tumors, including gastric cancer, HER2-positive gastric cancer, and triple-negative breast cancer, with manageable safety supporting further combination-based development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors or relapsed/refractory hematologic malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The differentiated SIRPα–IgG4 Fc fusion protein HCB101 in monotherapy and combination therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: GRWD5769 with cemiplimab demonstrated broad, durable activity across all 6 phase 1b expansion cohorts in patients with at least 2 prior lines of therapy and secondary anti-PD-1 resistance, or MSS-CRC. Therapy was well tolerated with no observed safety signals, and translational analyses suggested that GRWD5769 may reprogram antigen-experienced T cells and induce de novo T cell responses.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: MSS-CRC without liver metastases
NSCLC
pts with urothelial carcinoma
SCCHN
HCC
cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EMITT-1: Clinical and pharmacodynamic activity with the oral ERAP1 inhibitor GRWD5769 and cemiplimab in 6 completed phase 1b expansion cohorts in solid tumors with anti–PD-1 resistance or MSS-CRC.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, leukapheresis provided no overall survival benefit over pharmacologic cytoreduction alone. Given its high cost, resource intensity, and limited accessibility, the findings support selective rather than routine use, prioritizing prompt medical cytoreduction and supportive care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged 18 years or older with acute or chronic leukemia and hyperleukocytosis, defined as WBC ≥100 × 109/L, between January 2010 and December 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of leukapheresis and pharmacologic cytoreduction in hyperleukocytosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: CTS2190 showed superior safety and promising efficacy in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors, achieving clinical proof-of-concept. More patients are being enrolled at recommended phase 2 doses in a current phase 2a cohort expansion study, and studies combining CTS2190 with standards of care in solid tumors are being planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety results of a first-in-class PRMT1 inhibitor CTS2190 in patients (pts) with immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)–insensitive advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective cohort of patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, cetuximab plus immune checkpoint inhibitor was associated with longer progression-free survival than cetuximab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel. This effect remained significant in patients who previously received first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor plus chemotherapy, and longer follow-up is planned to evaluate differences in overall survival.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma treated at the institution between 2018 and 2025 were included if they received cetuximab combination therapy after progressing on first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor alone or immune checkpoint inhibitor with chemotherapy and had ECOG 0-2.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Second-line cetuximab plus immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) versus cetuximab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel following ICI-containing regimen in recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The high clinical activity of induction immunochemotherapy observed in this cohort could not be explained by tumor mutational burden as a predictive biomarker. Alternative biomarkers are required to better predict benefit from induction immunochemotherapy in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients enrolled in the prospective phase II study had locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, specifically squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx, larynx, and hypopharynx.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Predictive value of genomic mutation signatures and tumor mutational burden for induction immunochemotherapy in locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx, larynx, and hypopharynx.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter propensity score-matched analysis, adding locoregional therapy to first-line chemoimmunotherapy was associated with improved progression-free and overall survival in advanced biliary tract cancer. The findings should be interpreted cautiously because of the retrospective design and potential biases, and prospective studies are warranted to define the role, patient selection, modality, and timing of concurrent locoregional therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer, including patients with advanced biliary tract cancer, treated with first-line chemoimmunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chemoimmunotherapy with or without locoregional therapy for biliary tract cancer: A propensity score–matched study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world, propensity score-matched analysis of patients with cholangiocarcinoma, statin exposure was not associated with improved 30-day survival and was associated with higher 90-day mortality and hospitalization. Although causality cannot be inferred, the findings suggest that commonly prescribed cardiovascular medications may identify patients with increased baseline vulnerability around the time of cancer diagnosis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients aged 18 years or older diagnosed with intrahepatic bile duct carcinoma, extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma, or ampullary carcinoma between January 1, 2010, and December 11, 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early mortality and hospitalization following cholangiocarcinoma diagnosis by statin exposure: A TriNetX real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Precem-TcT, the first anti-CEACAM5 antibody-drug conjugate with a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor payload reporting clinical data in patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal carcinoma, showed a predictable safety profile consistent with data from patients with metastatic colorectal cancer. Efficacy data in this highly refractory, mostly irinotecan-pretreated second-line/third-line population benchmark favorably with the current standard of care for second-line metastatic pancreatic ductal carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pretreated metastatic pancreatic ductal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Precemtabart tocentecan (Precem-TcT, M9140), an anti-CEACAM5 antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal carcinoma (mPDAC): Results from the phase 1b/2 PROCEADE-PanTumor PDAC substudy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant serplulimab, SOX, and thymalfasin produced encouraging pathological response, substantial nodal clearance, and an acceptable safety profile in stage III gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Peripheral immune and transcriptomic profiling were consistent with the hypothesis that thymalfasin may help preserve and coordinate systemic antitumor immunity without excessive toxicity. These findings warrant confirmation in larger randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients aged 18–75 with cStage III gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy plus thymalfasin in locally advanced gastric cancer: A prospective clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: SMP-3124LP was generally well tolerated and had a manageable safety profile. Dose-proportional increases in pharmacokinetics were observed, and promising antitumor activity signals were reported, including 5 RECIST v1.1 partial responses and a 49% disease control rate in heavily pretreated patients with cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with selected advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First data disclosure from the first-in-human phase 1/2 trial of SMP-3124LP, the first investigational pegylated liposome CHK1 inhibitor, in patients with selected advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: NTQ1062 combined with fulvestrant demonstrated a favorable and manageable safety profile and encouraging clinical activity in patients with hormone receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer who had progressed on prior endocrine therapy. Based on superior efficacy and a more favorable tolerability profile observed across dose levels, 200 mg twice daily was determined to be the optimal biological dose of NTQ1062 for the combination with fulvestrant.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with hormone receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of AKT inhibitor NTQ1062 combined with fulvestrant in patients with HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer：a proof-of-concept, multicenter, open-label, nonrandomized, phase Ib/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with HER2-positive breast cancer who achieved pathologic complete response after neoadjuvant dual HER2-targeted therapy and chemotherapy, long-term recurrence outcomes were excellent and comparable between adjuvant trastuzumab alone and continued dual HER2 blockade. These findings suggest that the absolute benefit of adjuvant pertuzumab may be limited in this population and support prospective evaluation of de-escalation strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-positive invasive breast cancer who achieved pCR after neoadjuvant dual anti-HER2 therapy and chemotherapy followed by definitive surgery, and subsequently received adjuvant anti-HER2 therapy for a total of one year.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant trastuzumab with or without pertuzumab after pathologic complete response to neoadjuvant HER2-targeted therapy and chemotherapy in HER2-positive breast cancer: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with early-stage triple-negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant pembrolizumab, favorable 3-year event-free survival outcomes were observed. Real-world event-free survival was significantly improved among patients who achieved pathological complete response, highlighting the importance of timely access to neoadjuvant pembrolizumab after diagnosis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients in a US community oncology setting with Stage II-III early-stage triple-negative breast cancer, documented surgery between 07/01/2021 and 08/31/2022, and receipt of pembrolizumab in the neoadjuvant setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world clinical outcomes of neoadjuvant pembrolizumab among patients with early-stage triple-negative breast cancer (esTNBC) in a US community oncology setting.

clinical_result_biomarker_cn: 同源重组修复基因突变

无影像学疾病进展生存期（rPFS）

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with talazoparib plus enzalutamide led to a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in the primary endpoint of radiographic progression-free survival, with a trend toward improved overall survival versus standard-of-care enzalutamide in patients with homologous recombination repair-deficient metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer. The safety profile was generally manageable and consistent with those for talazoparib and enzalutamide.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene-mutated metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC).
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位影像学无进展生存期
clinical_result_layer_factor: de novo vs relapsed mCSPC, high- vs low-volume disease, and BRCA vs non-BRCA mutational status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: TALAPRO-3: Talazoparib (TALA) + enzalutamide (ENZA) compared with placebo (PBO) + ENZA for the treatment of patients (pts) with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC) harboring homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene alterations.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with multiple myeloma who received both CAR-T and BiTE therapies, CAR-T-first sequencing was associated with significantly improved long-term survival. The lack of survival differences by specific BiTE used suggests that treatment order, rather than product selection, may be the primary determinant of long-term outcomes, supporting consideration of earlier CAR-T deployment when feasible.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with relapsed multiple myeloma who received both CAR-T therapy, either idecel or ciltacel, and a BiTE therapy, either teclistamab, talquetamab, or elranatamab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes comparing sequencing of CAR-T followed by BiTE versus BiTE followed by CAR-T in patients with relapsed multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: IMA401 demonstrated overall favorable tolerability without reaching a formal maximum tolerated dose and showed encouraging antitumor activity in patients with head and neck cancer, melanoma, and squamous non-small cell lung cancer at the recommended phase 2 dose range. Further development steps are being evaluated, including a potentially synergistic combination with the PRAME-directed bispecific IMA402 in squamous non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumor indications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts were ≥18 y, HLA-A*02:01+, MAGEA4+ and/or MAGEA8+, have R/R solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human results with IMA401, a MAGEA4/8-targeted T-cell receptor–based bispecific T-cell engager (TCER) in recurrent or refractory solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this prospective real-world cohort of patients with non-small cell lung cancer and cancer cachexia receiving first-line chemoimmunotherapy, anamorelin had a manageable safety profile but did not achieve the primary endpoint of progression-free survival prolongation. Cachexia improvement at week 12 was observed in a substantial proportion of patients and was associated with longer overall survival, suggesting that anamorelin may have clinical value in facilitating cachexia improvement in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer and cancer cachexia in Japan were enrolled if they were scheduled to initiate anamorelin together with chemoimmunotherapy; cachexia eligibility included body weight loss of ≥5% within the previous 6 months, anorexia, and at least two of fatigue or malaise, generalized muscle weakness, C-reactive protein level >0.5 mg/dL, albumin level <3.2 g/dL, or hemoglobin level <12 g/dL.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of anamorelin in patients with non–small cell lung cancer and cancer cachexia undergoing chemoimmunotherapy: A real-world prospective cohort study (SPIRAL-ANA).

data.clinical_result_summary: HCB101 demonstrated durable monotherapy antitumor activity and a wide therapeutic window up to 36 mg/kg, addressing key limitations of earlier CD47-directed therapies. Early combination activity was observed across multiple solid tumors, including gastric cancer, HER2-positive gastric cancer, and triple-negative breast cancer, with manageable safety supporting further combination-based development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors or relapsed/refractory hematologic malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The differentiated SIRPα–IgG4 Fc fusion protein HCB101 in monotherapy and combination therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Incorporating ibrutinib 560 mg daily with R-da-EPOCH in HIV-related diffuse large B-cell lymphoma resulted in manageable toxicities typical of R-da-EPOCH. Although the confirmed complete response rate was lower, 3-year event-free survival and overall survival were comparable or higher than prior studies of R-da-EPOCH in HIV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants age 18-64 years with stage II-IV HIV-DLBCL.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Integrating BTK inhibition into R-da-EPOCH for HIV-related DLBCL.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant serplulimab, SOX, and thymalfasin produced encouraging pathological response, substantial nodal clearance, and an acceptable safety profile in stage III gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Peripheral immune and transcriptomic profiling were consistent with the hypothesis that thymalfasin may help preserve and coordinate systemic antitumor immunity without excessive toxicity. These findings warrant confirmation in larger randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients aged 18–75 with cStage III gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy plus thymalfasin in locally advanced gastric cancer: A prospective clinical trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: In these first global data for a PD-(L)1 × VEGF-A bispecific antibody in first-line NSCLC regardless of PD-L1 status, pumitamig plus chemotherapy showed encouraging efficacy with a manageable safety profile. The lower dose plus chemotherapy appeared particularly promising and is being evaluated against pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in the ongoing phase 3 part of the trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naive advanced non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 data from ROSETTA Lung-02, a global randomized phase 2/3 trial of pumitamig (PD-L1 × VEGF-A bsAb) + chemotherapy in 1L NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: HA131 administered via hepatic arterial infusion in combination with systemic therapy demonstrated manageable safety and notable preliminary efficacy in patients with gastrointestinal cancer and liver metastases. The findings warrant further exploration of this regimen in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: gastrointestinal cancer with liver metastases
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HA131 (hepatic arterial infusion) in combination with systemic therapy (XELOX with or without bevacizumab) as first-line treatment in gastrointestinal cancer with liver metastases: A prospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In routine clinical practice, first-line tivozanib provides durable disease control and long-term survival in IMDC favorable-risk metastatic renal cell carcinoma, particularly in very favorable-risk patients. ICI and cabozantinib remain effective salvage options in this setting upon disease progression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with clear-cell metastatic renal cell carcinoma treated with first-line tivozanib between 2017 and 2024 across 14 Spanish centers, including favorable-risk patients defined by IMDC criteria as having 0 risk factors and a very favorable-risk subgroup defined by time from diagnosis to systemic therapy >3 years, Karnofsky performance status 90–100%, and absence of brain, liver, or bone metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line tivozanib in favorable- and very favorable–risk metastatic renal cell carcinoma: Real-world evidence from the TIVOREAL-SOGUG study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with chronic myeloid leukemia transformed to acute myeloid leukemia, azacitidine plus venetoclax achieved comparable 1-year survival and early infectious outcomes to intensive 7+3 induction despite being used in a frailer population. Larger multicenter studies are needed to confirm comparative effectiveness and refine patient selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with chronic myeloid leukemia transformed to acute myeloid leukemia who received induction therapy between January 1, 2010, and June 1, 2025, and were classified by receipt of 7+3 or azacitidine plus venetoclax within one year before or after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of 7+3 versus azacitidine/venetoclax in CML transformed to AML.

data.clinical_result_summary: AWT020 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising early antitumor activity in adults with advanced or metastatic cancers, including patients with acquired resistance to anti-PD-(L)1 therapies and patients with pMMR tumors. Dose escalation is ongoing to establish the MTD/RP2D.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic cancers who have failed or were intolerant to standard therapies and are resistant to anti-PD-1 therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary results of safety and antitumor activity from a first-in-human phase 1 study of AWT020, a bifunctional anti–PD-1/IL-2 fusion protein, in patients with advanced tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia who received chemotherapy, cannabis use was associated with significantly lower odds of remission and higher odds of relapse, chronic pain, and anxiety disorders. Cannabis use was not associated with all-cause mortality, depression, or respiratory failure.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients aged 18 years or older diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia who received chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Influence of cannabis use on relapse and remission rates in patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL).

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world case series demonstrates that Pedmark can be feasibly incorporated into adult oncology workflows and does not interfere with cisplatin-based treatment. These findings support the routine adoption of Pedmark for young adults to reduce the risk of cisplatin-induced hearing loss and enhance survivorship outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective case series included young adults aged 18–39 years with localized and disseminated solid tumors receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy at a cancer center in 2024–2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world feasibility and tolerability of Pedmark for otoprotection in young adults receiving cisplatin for solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: No significant survival benefit was observed in the overall GPB group compared with the G-based group. However, a clinically meaningful improvement in median progression-free survival was identified in the PTEN-loss subgroup, suggesting that PTEN status may help identify patients more likely to benefit from GPB therapy and warranting further prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced biliary tract cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Bortezomib plus gemcitabine-cisplatin versus gemcitabine-cisplatin as first-line treatment for advanced biliary tract cancers: A randomized phase II clinical trial with exploratory analysis of PTEN status.

data.clinical_result_summary: MVR-T3011 demonstrated suitability for intravesical administration, with promising efficacy and a favorable safety profile in BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer. Durable complete responses were observed in CIS patients, and encouraging 12-month recurrence-free survival rates were observed in papillary disease, supporting its potential as a bladder-sparing option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: high risk NMIBC patients after BCG treatment failure
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Progress of phase II study of MVR-T3011, an IL-12/anti-PD-1 armed oncolytic HSV-1, in high-risk BCG-unresponsive CIS and papillary NMIBC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Front-line third-generation EGFR-TKI combined with ablation for oligo-residual disease led to significantly longer progression-free survival than EGFR-TKIs alone in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer. The findings suggest this approach may provide an alternative front-line strategy, although further prospective validation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with EGFR-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer who achieved oligo-residual disease after first-line third-generation EGFR-TKI therapy at Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, Tongji University, were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Ablation of oligo-residual disease to prolong progression-free survival in EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC patients treated with third-generation EGFR-TKIs.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sone-Ve 2.2 mg/kg demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy and a manageable safety profile consistent with the first-in-human study in patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancers. Circulating tumor DNA molecular responses were observed in over half of evaluable patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sonesitatug vedotin (Sone-Ve) monotherapy in patients (pts) with claudin 18.2–positive (CLDN18.2+) advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancers: Data from CLARITY-PanTumor01.

data.clinical_result_summary: Firmonertinib combined with chemotherapy showed promising antitumor activity in patients with EGFR-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer following disease progression on first-line 3rd-generation EGFR-TKIs. The regimen had a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with EGFR-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer who failed first-line 3rd-generation EGFR-TKIs
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Firmonertinib combined with platinum-based chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC following disease progression on first-line third-generation EGFR-TKI.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nearly three-quarters of patients with advanced cancer receiving outpatient palliative care experienced fatigue, yet few were treated with psychostimulants. Most patients reported improvement in fatigue with low-dose methylphenidate. Future studies should address knowledge gaps in assessment and management of cancer-related fatigue and the role of psychostimulants.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included new consultations in the Princess Margaret Cancer Centre oncology palliative care clinic from January 1, 2018 to July 30, 2025, comprising patients with advanced cancer receiving outpatient palliative care.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fatigue and psychostimulant use in patients with advanced cancer in an oncology palliative care clinic: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Although survival outcomes were comparable to those described in younger adults, adverse events were common and impactful in older adults. Starting dose optimization and close monitoring based on individual risk factors for adverse events and emergency department visits should be considered, and treatment recommendations should be guided by patient values and preferences.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 65 years or older with advanced thyroid cancer were referred to medical oncology at the institution for consideration of systemic therapy between 2015 and 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical outcomes in older adults with advanced thyroid cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with MARIPOSA, subcutaneous amivantamab with dermatologic and venous thromboembolism prophylaxis in COPERNICUS substantially reduced administration-related reactions, dermatologic adverse events, venous thromboembolism, and amivantamab discontinuations. These early safety data support wider use of subcutaneous amivantamab every 4 weeks plus lazertinib in a diverse population, although follow-up remains limited.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with first-line EGFR-mutated advanced non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: COPERNICUS, a pragmatic phase 2b study of first-line (1L) subcutaneous (SC) amivantamab (ami) + lazertinib (laz) with supportive care in EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC: Early safety results.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world propensity-matched relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma cohort, talquetamab and teclistamab had comparable 1-year mortality and remission, with differing toxicity profiles. Talquetamab was associated with higher grade 3 neutropenia and numerically higher cytokine release syndrome, whereas teclistamab showed a signal toward more acute kidney injury and higher infection rates. These data may support individualized treatment selection based on toxicity risk.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma treated with talquetamab or teclistamab from October 2022 to November 2025 were included, while patients with solitary plasmacytoma, plasma cell leukemia, or clinical trial–only monitoring codes were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative real-world outcomes with talquetamab and teclistamab in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma: A TriNetX observational study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative aDCF resulted in long-term survival in the majority of patients treated in this trial, supporting evidence that chemoimmunotherapy improves outcomes in patients with locally advanced gastro-esophageal adenocarcinoma. Outcomes appeared enhanced among patients with major pathological response, and no new safety signals were reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term survival results of perioperative chemoimmunotherapy with DCF and avelumab in locally advanced gastro-esophageal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Olverembatinib showed sustained clinical efficacy in SDH-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumor and paraganglioma. Mechanistically, it inhibited fatty acid-promoted invasion and migration of SDH-deficient GIST by targeting the p38-CD36 signaling pathway.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with TKI-resistant SDH-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumor
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated clinical and translational results of olverembatinib (HQP1351) in patients with succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)–deficient tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world Brazilian cohort, PD-L1 expression played a central role in guiding first-line immunotherapy selection for metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, supporting its continued clinical relevance in routine practice. The heterogeneity of outcomes across PD-L1 subgroups underscores the need for additional predictive biomarkers to further refine patient selection and optimize immunotherapy-based treatment strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients aged ≥18 years with unresectable or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer treated with first-line systemic therapy between January 2021 and December 2023 at seven Brazilian cancer centers, focusing on those receiving first-line immunotherapy with or without chemotherapy; patients with non-epithelial histology and neuroendocrine tumors were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world patterns and temporal trends of first-line immunotherapy use in metastatic NSCLC in Brazil according to PD-L1 expression.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study demonstrates the preliminary efficacy and tolerability of toripalimab combined with temozolomide as neoadjuvant treatment for patients with resectable stage IIIB-IIID acral and cutaneous melanoma. Further studies are warranted, given the limited response rate of immune checkpoint inhibitors alone in acral melanoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Chinese patients with resectable stage IIIB-IIID acral or cutaneous melanoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant toripalimab combined with temozolomide in resectable stage III melanoma: A prospective, single-center, phase 2 trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: LB1410 showed an excellent safety profile and promising antitumor efficacy in patients with immune-oncology-resistant/refractory cervical cancer. Further studies of LB1410 as monotherapy and in combination with lenvatinib in patients with immune-oncology-resistant/refractory cervical cancer are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors who were heavily pretreated and resistant or refractory to anti-PD-1/PD-L1 treatments.
pts with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma
pts with SoC-failed, immunotherapy-experienced/refractory cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of LB1410, a bivalent TIM-3/PD-1 bispecific antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic malignancies receiving GLP1 therapy demonstrated superior survival outcomes. The observed survival benefit may be related to the anti-inflammatory properties of GLP1, including immunomodulatory effects and attenuation of oncogenic signaling and proliferation. Further investigation into the broader oncologic effects of GLP1 therapy is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with hepatocellular carcinoma, fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder cancer, or pancreatic cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival in patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic cancers taking GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: GRWD5769 with cemiplimab demonstrated broad, durable activity across all 6 phase 1b expansion cohorts in patients with at least 2 prior lines of therapy and secondary anti-PD-1 resistance, or MSS-CRC. Therapy was well tolerated with no observed safety signals, and translational analyses suggested that GRWD5769 may reprogram antigen-experienced T cells and induce de novo T cell responses.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: MSS-CRC without liver metastases
NSCLC
pts with urothelial carcinoma
SCCHN
HCC
cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EMITT-1: Clinical and pharmacodynamic activity with the oral ERAP1 inhibitor GRWD5769 and cemiplimab in 6 completed phase 1b expansion cohorts in solid tumors with anti–PD-1 resistance or MSS-CRC.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first-in-human phase 1 study is designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, immunogenicity, and preliminary antitumor activity of SBO-154 in subjects with locally recurrent or metastatic solid tumors who have exhausted or are intolerant to available therapies. Enrollment began in August 2025; cohorts 1 and 2 were completed without dose-limiting toxicities, and enrollment in cohort 3 was ongoing as of December 2025.
clinical_result_indication_detail: subjects with locally recurrent or metastatic solid tumors who have exhausted or are intolerant to available therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, multicenter, open-label, dose-escalation and expansion study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary efficacy of SBO-154 in subjects with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results suggest that induction chemotherapy can allow more advanced T3/T4 HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancers, which are typically excluded from de-escalation studies, to be de-escalated and may eliminate tumor hypoxia in a substantial proportion of cases. This small pilot study showed results similar to those seen in larger ROC studies, but a larger study is needed for confirmation and is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced (T3-T4) HPV+OPC to down-stage patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Induction chemotherapy response–guided selection for hypoxia-directed major radiation de-escalation in T3–T4 HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Mosun-Pola continues to show notable efficacy with manageable safety in patients with ASCT-ineligible relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma, particularly in the second-line setting. The updated analysis showed sustained PFS and response benefits versus R-GemOx, with an acceptable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: people with relapsed or refractory (R/R) large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL) who are not eligible for autologous stem cell transplant
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Mosunetuzumab plus polatuzumab vedotin (Mosun-Pola) versus rituximab, gemcitabine and oxaliplatin (R-GemOx) in patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma (R/R LBCL): Updated efficacy and safety from the phase 3 SUNMO study including in second-line (2L) versus third-line plus (3L+) patient subgroups.

data.clinical_result_summary: TACE combined with donafenib showed significant efficacy in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma with rupture and bleeding compared with TACE monotherapy. Safety was controllable, with no grade ≥3 treatment-related adverse events reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients at Qinghai University Affiliated Hospital with a definitive diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma with rupture and bleeding by imaging and laboratory examination, Child-Pugh class A or B, and no previous systemic therapy, who received TACE combined with donafenib or TACE monotherapy from January 2022 to August 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of transarterial chemoembolization combined with donafenib for hepatocellular carcinoma with rupture and bleeding: A retrospective, cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Olutasidenib enabled long-term complete remission/complete remission with partial hematologic recovery in about half of patients with relapsed/refractory mutant IDH1 acute myeloid leukemia without transplant. Relapsed disease and female sex were associated with a better long-term response, while baseline transfusion independence and molecular factors were not significant predictors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with relapsed/refractory mutant IDH1 acute myeloid leukemia treated with olutasidenib 150 mg twice daily who had a complete remission/complete remission with partial hematologic recovery and a duration of response greater than 12 months were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patient, disease, and molecular characteristics with a long-term (LT) response to olutasidenib.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma progressing on PD-1 ICI, lenvatinib plus everolimus was associated with greater reductions in BMI, skeletal muscle mass, and subcutaneous adiposity than cabozantinib at 4 months. The study did not show a clear difference in QOL at day 60.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic ccRCC progressing on PD-1 ICI after 1-2 prior lines of treatment, including a PD-1 ICI.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Body composition and quality of life (QOL) with lenvatinib + everolimus (len + eve) versus cabozantinib (cabo) in metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) after PD-1 inhibitor progression: Results from the randomized phase II LenCabo trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adding low-dose pembrolizumab to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in triple-negative breast cancer did not worsen patient quality of life. The trajectory of functioning and symptom scores was nearly identical to chemotherapy alone, suggesting that reduced-dose immunotherapy does not add to treatment burden from the patient perspective.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Stage II–III patients with early triple-negative breast cancer.
clinical_result_layer_factor: nodal status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Health-related quality of life with low-dose pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in early triple-negative breast cancer: Findings from the PLANeT trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: HCB101 showed early combination antitumor activity in first-line triple-negative breast cancer, with disease control in all 6 subjects and partial responses in 3 subjects. Across the broader combination study, HCB101 had manageable safety with reversible cytopenias and no unexpected immune-mediated toxicities, supporting further cohort expansion and development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with second-line gastric cancer
1L GC (HER2+ backbone):
first-line (1L) TNBC
patients with advanced solid tumors or relapsed/refractory hematologic malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The differentiated SIRPα–IgG4 Fc fusion protein HCB101 in monotherapy and combination therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Zelenectide pevedotin at 5 mg/m2 on Days 1/8/15 plus pembrolizumab and 6 mg/m2 on Days 1/8 plus pembrolizumab on a 21-day cycle demonstrated encouraging response rates and safety profiles in previously untreated patients with locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma. The 6 mg/m2 Days 1/8 regimen showed a more favorable benefit-risk profile, with reduced toxicity, better tolerability, improved potential for combinability, enhanced convenience, and fewer discontinuations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma（Cohort 1）
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Interim analysis results from Duravelo-2: Zelenectide pevedotin (zele; BT8009) + pembrolizumab in patients (pts) with previously untreated locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma (la/mUC).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Rate of Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) negativity
data.clinical_result_summary: After a median follow-up of more than 6 years, DVRd produced deeper and more durable responses than VRd in transplant-ineligible patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. The final analysis supports DVRd as a standard-of-care option in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed MM -transplant-ineligible (TIE) pts
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Daratumumab plus bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone (DVRd) in patients (pts) with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM): Final analysis of transplant-ineligible (TIE) pts in the phase 3 CEPHEUS study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prospective deep immune repertoire profiling detected profound differences in the tumor microenvironment according to dissemination patterns, which might explain differences in treatment outcomes. Despite low overall efficacy with durvalumab and tremelimumab in microsatellite stable patients, a trend toward better response rate and disease control rate was observed in patients without liver metastases. The authors propose immune cell tracking as a tool to quantify the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in real time.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with refractory microsatellite stable colorectal cancer, including patients with microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer with and without liver metastases, were treated in the study.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The SERPENTINE trial: A phase II clinical study decoding immune responses by scRNA-seq and TCR-seq analysis in patients with MSS metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) with and without liver metastases treated with durvalumab and tremelimumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world, propensity score-matched analysis of patients with cholangiocarcinoma, statin exposure was not associated with improved 30-day survival and was associated with higher 90-day mortality and hospitalization. Although causality cannot be inferred, the findings suggest that commonly prescribed cardiovascular medications may identify patients with increased baseline vulnerability around the time of cancer diagnosis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients aged 18 years or older diagnosed with intrahepatic bile duct carcinoma, extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma, or ampullary carcinoma between January 1, 2010, and December 11, 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early mortality and hospitalization following cholangiocarcinoma diagnosis by statin exposure: A TriNetX real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this prospective real-world cohort of patients with non-small cell lung cancer and cancer cachexia receiving first-line chemoimmunotherapy, anamorelin had a manageable safety profile but did not achieve the primary endpoint of progression-free survival prolongation. Cachexia improvement at week 12 was observed in a substantial proportion of patients and was associated with longer overall survival, suggesting that anamorelin may have clinical value in facilitating cachexia improvement in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer and cancer cachexia in Japan were enrolled if they were scheduled to initiate anamorelin together with chemoimmunotherapy; cachexia eligibility included body weight loss of ≥5% within the previous 6 months, anorexia, and at least two of fatigue or malaise, generalized muscle weakness, C-reactive protein level >0.5 mg/dL, albumin level <3.2 g/dL, or hemoglobin level <12 g/dL.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of anamorelin in patients with non–small cell lung cancer and cancer cachexia undergoing chemoimmunotherapy: A real-world prospective cohort study (SPIRAL-ANA).

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic malignancies receiving GLP1 therapy demonstrated superior survival outcomes. The observed survival benefit may be related to the anti-inflammatory properties of GLP1, including immunomodulatory effects and attenuation of oncogenic signaling and proliferation. Further investigation into the broader oncologic effects of GLP1 therapy is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with hepatocellular carcinoma, fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder cancer, or pancreatic cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival in patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic cancers taking GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Integrated post-treatment assessment using ctDNA-based minimal residual disease detection, PET-CT, and endoscopy showed predictive potential for survival in locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma following induction chemotherapy and concurrent radiotherapy with anlotinib and camrelizumab. These results require prospective validation in larger cohorts with longer follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or oligometastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Predictive value of ctDNA-based MRD combined with PET-CT and gastroscopy for treatment efficacy in locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A phase II exploratory clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of bevacizumab, TAS-102, and irinotecan showed promising clinical activity and manageable toxicity as second-line therapy for patients with RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer who progressed on prior anti-EGFR-based treatment. These results support further evaluation of this regimen in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of bevacizumab plus trifluridine/tipiracil and irinotecan as second-line therapy for RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: BAT8008 demonstrated promising and durable anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in heavily pre-treated patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer. These findings support the continued development of BAT8008 in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy results from the phase I cervical cancer cohort of BAT8008, a TROP-2–directed antibody-drug conjugate, in patients with advanced cervical cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: SBRT plus cadonilimab and lenvatinib showed encouraging efficacy and manageable toxicity as a conversion strategy for potentially resectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with potentially resectable HCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Stereotactic body radiotherapy plus cadonilimab and lenvatinib as conversion therapy for potentially resectable hepatocellular carcinoma (UniRTX): A phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade yields high major pathological response rates in stage III melanoma. Early metabolic response on FDG PET/CT, defined as a ΔSUVmax ≥50% decline, is a strong and readily implementable imaging biomarker for predicting major pathological response following neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade, enabling early treatment adaptation and personalized surgical decision-making.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resectable stage IIIB-D melanoma were treated with neoadjuvant pembrolizumab or nivolumab plus ipilimumab at Peter Mac from March 2022 to Dec 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real world outcomes of neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) for resectable stage III melanoma: Pathologic response and FDG PET/CT correlates.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a real-world retrospective cohort, ABCP and PPC showed similar effectiveness with respect to progression-free survival and tumor response in advanced non-squamous non-small-cell lung cancer. These findings support individualized first-line regimen selection based on patient-specific clinical and molecular considerations rather than expected efficacy differences. Prospective randomized studies are warranted to validate these results.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed adult patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced, metastatic, or recurrent non-squamous non-small-cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line real-world outcomes of atezolizumab- and pembrolizumab-based regimens in non-squamous non–small-cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The high clinical activity of induction immunochemotherapy observed in this cohort could not be explained by tumor mutational burden as a predictive biomarker. Alternative biomarkers are required to better predict benefit from induction immunochemotherapy in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients enrolled in the prospective phase II study had locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, specifically squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx, larynx, and hypopharynx.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Predictive value of genomic mutation signatures and tumor mutational burden for induction immunochemotherapy in locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx, larynx, and hypopharynx.

data.clinical_result_summary: In BRCA1/2-associated triple-negative breast cancer, the MCbP-T regimen demonstrated efficacy comparable to standard anthracycline-based chemotherapy with platinum agents. It also provided a more favorable safety profile and a lower incidence of adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with BRCA1/2-associated triple-negative breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant mitomycin C plus carboplatin followed by paclitaxel vs. standard doxorubicin–cyclophosphamide followed by paclitaxel–carboplatin in BRCA1/2-associated breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: With 7.3 months of follow-up, ivonescimab plus mFOLFOX6 showed encouraging efficacy and a manageable safety profile in patients with untreated metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients in China and the US with confirmed metastatic colorectal cancer
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Ivonescimab (ivo) with oxaliplatin + fluorouracil (5-FU) + leucovorin calcium (mFOLFOX6) for patients (pts) with unresectable metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): A phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: These real-world findings augment clinical trial results and reinforce that ribociclib provides consistent and substantial post-progression survival benefits in patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer. Benefits were also observed in patients aged 65 years or older.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included US female patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer who initiated first-line ribociclib in combination with an aromatase inhibitor or aromatase inhibitor monotherapy between January 1, 2020 and January 31, 2025, including patients aged 65 years or older.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: (RW) post-progression outcomes after first-line (1L) treatment with ribociclib + an aromatase inhibitor (AI) vs AI alone in US patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HR+/HER2–) metastatic breast cancer (MBC).

Further studies of LB1410 as monotherapy and in combination with lenvatinib in patients with immune-oncology-resistant/refractory cervical cancer are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors who were heavily pretreated and resistant or refractory to anti-PD-1/PD-L1 treatments.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of LB1410, a bivalent TIM-3/PD-1 bispecific antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ad5.F35-GUCY2C-PADRE was safe, overcame pre-existing Ad5 immunity, and induced robust, dose-dependent GUCY2C-specific T-cell responses in patients with resected high-risk gastrointestinal cancers. Vaccine-induced immunity was associated with improved recurrence-free survival in colorectal cancer, supporting further development of Ad5.F35-GUCY2C-PADRE for colorectal cancer recurrence prevention.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resected, high-risk gastrointestinal adenocarcinomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy of Ad5.F35-GUCY2C-PADRE vaccine in patients with GI cancers at high risk of relapse: Results from a phase 2A trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The chemotherapy-free combination of gotistobart and pembrolizumab demonstrated clinically meaningful objective response rate and overall survival, with a manageable safety profile, in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. Most patients were heavily pretreated and had no further standard-of-care treatment options.
clinical_result_indication_detail: platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival for patients with pre-treated platinum-resistant ovarian cancer receiving gotistobart in combination with pembrolizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab provided meaningful disease control with modest antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal cancer after progression on prior anti-PD-(L)1 therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal cancer after progression on anti-PD-(L)1 therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cadonilimab, a bispecific anti–PD-1/CTLA-4 antibody, for patients with dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal cancer after progression on anti–PD-(L)1 therapy: A multicenter, single-arm, phase 2 trial (CSWOG-C03).
