data.clinical_result_paper_title: EMITT-1: Clinical and pharmacodynamic activity with the oral ERAP1 inhibitor GRWD5769 and cemiplimab in 6 completed phase 1b expansion cohorts in solid tumors with anti–PD-1 resistance or MSS-CRC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Camrelizumab combined with liposomal doxorubicin and dacarbazine showed promising antitumor activity with durable responses and manageable safety as first-line therapy for advanced, recurrent and metastatic undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma. Exploratory analyses suggested that patients with higher PD-L1 expression may derive greater benefit, supporting further evaluation in larger controlled studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced, recurrent and metastatic undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Camrelizumab combined with liposomal doxorubicin and dacarbazine as first-line therapy for advanced, recurrent, and metastatic undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma: A phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Niraparib plus trastuzumab demonstrated a favorable safety profile and durable clinical benefit in heavily pretreated HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer. Integrated tumor and blood-based analyses identified immune-organized tumor microenvironments and systemic immune normalization as key correlates of prolonged response, supporting further investigation of PARP inhibition strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with refractory HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: TBCRC 050: A phase 1b/2 trial of niraparib and trastuzumab in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (MBC): Efficacy and correlative analyses.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic dexamethasone mouthwash did not significantly reduce all-grade oral mucositis at 8 weeks in patients with breast cancer receiving chemotherapy. Overall safety was comparable between groups, but oral candidiasis occurred more frequently in the dexamethasone mouthwash group.
clinical_result_indication_name: 放化疗引起的口腔溃疡
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with early breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: chemotherapy regimen, smoking status, and institution
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase III trial of dexamethasone mouthwash to prevent chemotherapy-induced oral mucositis in patients with breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In real-world practice, the incidence of thromboembolic events in patients with non-small cell lung cancer receiving palliative pembrolizumab-based chemoimmunotherapy was higher than that reported in phase III trials. Careful surveillance for thromboembolic events during chemoimmunotherapy, with consideration of anticoagulation in high-risk patients, may be warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective, single-center study included patients with non-small cell lung cancer who initiated palliative pembrolizumab-based chemoimmunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Thromboembolic events in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer receiving palliative chemoimmunotherapy with pembrolizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose fed nilotinib improved early molecular response and showed superior tolerability compared with imatinib. The authors suggest this as a cost-effective frontline strategy for chronic myeloid leukemia in low-resource settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Indian patients with newly diagnosed chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Upfront low-dose diet-modified nilotinib versus standard imatinib in Indian patients with newly diagnosed chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia: The NILLOW phase II randomised trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sone-Ve 2.2 mg/kg demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy and a manageable safety profile consistent with the first-in-human study in patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancers. Circulating tumor DNA molecular responses were observed in over half of evaluable patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sonesitatug vedotin (Sone-Ve) monotherapy in patients (pts) with claudin 18.2–positive (CLDN18.2+) advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancers: Data from CLARITY-PanTumor01.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nearly three-quarters of patients with advanced cancer receiving outpatient palliative care experienced fatigue, yet few were treated with psychostimulants. Most patients reported improvement in fatigue with low-dose methylphenidate. Future studies should address knowledge gaps in assessment and management of cancer-related fatigue and the role of psychostimulants.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included new consultations in the Princess Margaret Cancer Centre oncology palliative care clinic from January 1, 2018 to July 30, 2025, comprising patients with advanced cancer receiving outpatient palliative care.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fatigue and psychostimulant use in patients with advanced cancer in an oncology palliative care clinic: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Onvansertib plus FOLFIRI and bevacizumab demonstrated improved antitumor activity and manageable safety in first-line RAS-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer. These results support further clinical development and planned confirmatory Phase 3 evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with mCRC who have a documented KRAS or NRAS mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Onvansertib plus standard-of-care chemotherapy plus bevacizumab in first-line RAS-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): Interim results from the phase 2 randomized CRDF-004 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Despite universal acute immune activation in circulation following ATR inhibitor plus immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment, resistant tumors displayed high CNV heterogeneity, cancer-associated fibroblasts, and increased immunosuppressive pathways, in contrast to responder tissue. Co-clinical studies will further elucidate targetable mechanisms of resistance and guide further DNA damage response inhibitor and immune checkpoint inhibitor combinations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The trial enrolled patients with advanced cancers with pathogenic mutations or alterations in select DNA damage response genes.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1/2 trial of ATR inhibitor berzosertib plus immune checkpoint inhibitor avelumab in patients with advanced cancers with DNA damage response (DDR) gene alterations: Tumor microenvironment–mediated pathways of resistance from correlative data.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ferric carboxymaltose achieved a hemoglobin improvement rate of 72.5% and improved quality of life in patients with gastric or colorectal cancer and iron deficiency anemia receiving chemotherapy. Treatment was feasible, with high protocol completion and no treatment-related serious adverse events, supporting FCM for managing iron deficiency anemia during chemotherapy without erythropoiesis-stimulating agents.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with gastric or colorectal cancer and iron deficiency anemia receiving chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ASTRON (OGSG 2401): A multicenter prospective trial of ferric carboxymaltose without erythropoiesis-stimulating agents for iron deficiency anemia in patients with gastric/colorectal cancer receiving chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first international real-world series evaluated pembrolizumab in combination with chemotherapy in patients with metastatic metaplastic triple-negative breast cancer. Median progression-free survival and median overall survival in this real-world cohort were markedly shorter than those reported in the phase III KEYNOTE-355 trial, likely reflecting the aggressive clinical course of metaplastic triple-negative breast cancer. The safety profile was acceptable, and further prospective studies and international collaboration are needed in rare breast cancer subtypes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study population consisted of patients in Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia with histologically confirmed metaplastic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in routine practice.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Treatment outcomes with pembrolizumab and chemotherapy in metastatic metaplastic triple-negative breast cancer: Data from a central European cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Butaselen combined with standard radiotherapy was well tolerated in patients with primary H3K27M-mutant spinal diffuse midline glioma. The combination exhibited meaningful prolongation of survival period, durable objective responses, and neurological function improvements.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed H3K27M-mutant spinal diffuse midline glioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Butaselen combined with radiotherapy for newly diagnosed H3K27M-mutant spinal diffuse midline glioma: A single-arm phase Ib trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative aDCF resulted in long-term survival in the majority of patients treated in this trial, supporting evidence that chemoimmunotherapy improves outcomes in patients with locally advanced gastro-esophageal adenocarcinoma. Outcomes appeared enhanced among patients with major pathological response, and no new safety signals were reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term survival results of perioperative chemoimmunotherapy with DCF and avelumab in locally advanced gastro-esophageal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ad5.F35-GUCY2C-PADRE was safe, overcame pre-existing Ad5 immunity, and induced robust, dose-dependent GUCY2C-specific T-cell responses in patients with resected high-risk gastrointestinal cancers. Vaccine-induced immunity was associated with improved recurrence-free survival in colorectal cancer, supporting further development of Ad5.F35-GUCY2C-PADRE for colorectal cancer recurrence prevention.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resected, high-risk gastrointestinal adenocarcinomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy of Ad5.F35-GUCY2C-PADRE vaccine in patients with GI cancers at high risk of relapse: Results from a phase 2A trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Higher early tacrolimus exposure, particularly mean levels greater than 11 ng/mL, was independently associated with inferior overall survival after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Other measures of tacrolimus variability were not significantly associated with survival, and future studies are warranted to clarify the mechanisms underlying these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients who underwent matched related, matched unrelated, or haploidentical allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation between January 2024 and May 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of early tacrolimus levels on survival outcomes following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ferric carboxymaltose achieved a hemoglobin improvement rate of 72.5% and improved quality of life in patients with gastric or colorectal cancer and iron deficiency anemia receiving chemotherapy. Treatment was feasible, with high protocol completion and no treatment-related serious adverse events, supporting FCM for managing iron deficiency anemia during chemotherapy without erythropoiesis-stimulating agents.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with gastric or colorectal cancer and iron deficiency anemia receiving chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ASTRON (OGSG 2401): A multicenter prospective trial of ferric carboxymaltose without erythropoiesis-stimulating agents for iron deficiency anemia in patients with gastric/colorectal cancer receiving chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sone-Ve 2.2 mg/kg demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy and a manageable safety profile consistent with the first-in-human study in patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancers. Circulating tumor DNA molecular responses were observed in over half of evaluable patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sonesitatug vedotin (Sone-Ve) monotherapy in patients (pts) with claudin 18.2–positive (CLDN18.2+) advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancers: Data from CLARITY-PanTumor01.

data.clinical_result_summary: HCB101 showed early combination antitumor activity in first-line triple-negative breast cancer, with disease control in all 6 subjects and partial responses in 3 subjects. Across the broader combination study, HCB101 had manageable safety with reversible cytopenias and no unexpected immune-mediated toxicities, supporting further cohort expansion and development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with second-line gastric cancer

patients with advanced solid tumors or relapsed/refractory hematologic malignancies

data.clinical_result_summary: Imatinib mesylate appears to be a tolerable treatment option for patients with gastrointestinal stromal tumors in Nigeria. However, the objective response rate was low, and defaulting from regular clinic visits was the most common reason for poor drug adherence.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective cohort study included patients diagnosed with gastrointestinal stromal tumors in Nigeria.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Imatinib-related toxicity profile in patients with gastrointestinal stromal tumors seen over a twenty-year period in Ile-Ife, Nigeria.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic malignancies receiving GLP1 therapy demonstrated superior survival outcomes. The observed survival benefit may be related to the anti-inflammatory properties of GLP1, including immunomodulatory effects and attenuation of oncogenic signaling and proliferation. Further investigation into the broader oncologic effects of GLP1 therapy is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with hepatocellular carcinoma, fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder cancer, or pancreatic cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival in patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic cancers taking GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Spatial immune profiling identified distinct tumor-immune interaction patterns associated with pathological complete response in high-risk ER-positive/HER2-negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and immune checkpoint inhibition. These findings suggest that spatial tumor-immune interactions may help refine patient selection for adding immune checkpoint inhibitors to neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Premenopausal patients with stage II–IIIA ER-positive/HER2-negative Luminal B-like breast cancer, defined by Ki67 ≥ 20% and/or grade 3 disease, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Spatial interactions between immune cells as a predictor of pCR to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) and nivolumab for ER+/HER2− breast cancer (BC): Analysis of the phase II GIADA trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of nivolumab to encorafenib plus cetuximab did not improve survival outcomes in patients with pretreated microsatellite stable BRAF V600E metastatic colorectal cancer. Ongoing correlative studies seek to identify biomarkers associated with treatment benefit for future personalized treatment approaches in this biologically heterogeneous population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously treated MSS, BRAF V600E metastatic colorectal cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior lines of therapy (1 vs 2) and Zubrod PS (0 vs 1)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SWOG S2107: Randomized phase II trial of encorafenib and cetuximab with or without nivolumab for patients with previously treated MSS, BRAFV600E metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In cohort J of the KEYNOTE-365 trial, belzutifan monotherapy had a manageable safety profile but did not show meaningful antitumor activity in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Future research is needed to determine effective treatments for patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (cohort J)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Belzutifan in docetaxel-pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC): Phase 1b/2 KEYNOTE-365 cohort J.

data.clinical_result_summary: This prospective trial demonstrates that neoadjuvant tislelizumab plus CAPOX provides a promising treatment strategy with encouraging antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile for microsatellite stable/mismatch repair proficient locally advanced colon cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: MSS/pMMR pts aged 18-75 years, with high-risk locally advanced (T3N+ or T4N+) colon cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant tislelizumab plus chemotherapy in MSS/pMMR high-risk locally advanced colon cancer: Updated analysis results from a phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: FOLFOXIRI/bevacizumab may be the preferred first-line option for clinically fit pMMR/MSS RAS and BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer patients harbouring at least one genomic alteration of potential resistance to anti-EGFRs. This potential preference was reported regardless of primary tumor sidedness while awaiting efficacy results for upfront targeted treatments directed against specific molecular subgroups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included clinically fit metastatic colorectal cancer patients in 11 Italian centres with pMMR/MSS, RAS and BRAF wild-type tumors harbouring at least one genomic alteration potentially associated with resistance to anti-EGFR therapy, treated upfront with FOLFOXIRI/bevacizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: FOLFOXIRI/bevacizumab in microsatellite stable (pMMR/MSS) RAS and BRAF wild-type “gene-altered” metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): The HYPERTRIBE study.

These results support further investigation of HMA/venetoclax as a frontline alternative in fit patients with acute myeloid leukemia and the intention to proceed to transplant.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia treated at the University of Kentucky from 2016 to 2025 with either 7+3 or HMA/venetoclax were included.

data.clinical_result_summary: Updated data on fixed-duration glofitamab monotherapy in heavily pretreated patients with relapsed/refractory mantle cell lymphoma show robust efficacy and manageable safety, including in BTKi-exposed patients. Glofitamab monotherapy is a suitable treatment for patients with relapsed/refractory mantle cell lymphoma in need of rapid disease control and is under investigation in the Phase 3 GLOBRYTE trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with heavily pretreated relapsed/refractory (R/R) mantle cell lymphoma (MCL)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fixed-duration glofitamab monotherapy in relapsed/refractory (R/R) mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) with/without prior Bruton's tyrosine kinase inhibitor (BTKi) exposure: Updated data after a 3.5-year follow-up.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prospective deep immune repertoire profiling detected profound differences in the tumor microenvironment according to dissemination patterns, which might explain differences in treatment outcomes. Despite low overall efficacy with durvalumab and tremelimumab in microsatellite stable patients, a trend toward better response rate and disease control rate was observed in patients without liver metastases. The authors propose immune cell tracking as a tool to quantify the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in real time.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with refractory microsatellite stable colorectal cancer, including patients with microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer with and without liver metastases, were treated in the study.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The SERPENTINE trial: A phase II clinical study decoding immune responses by scRNA-seq and TCR-seq analysis in patients with MSS metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) with and without liver metastases treated with durvalumab and tremelimumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this small-sample cohort of patients with locally advanced gastric cancer who achieved pathologic complete response after neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy, the recurrence rate was low. The survival benefit observed with adjuvant therapy appeared limited.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 65 consecutive patients diagnosed with cT3-4bN0-3M0 locally advanced gastric cancer who received neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy, underwent gastrectomy, and achieved pathologic complete response (ypT0N0).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The effect of adjuvant therapy on survival in gastric cancer patients achieving pathologic complete response after neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: CTS2190 showed superior safety and promising efficacy in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors, achieving clinical proof-of-concept. More patients are being enrolled at recommended phase 2 doses in a current phase 2a cohort expansion study, and studies combining CTS2190 with standards of care in solid tumors are being planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety results of a first-in-class PRMT1 inhibitor CTS2190 in patients (pts) with immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)–insensitive advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: GRWD5769 with cemiplimab demonstrated broad, durable activity across all 6 phase 1b expansion cohorts in patients with at least 2 prior lines of therapy and secondary anti-PD-1 resistance, or MSS-CRC. Therapy was well tolerated with no observed safety signals, and translational analyses suggested that GRWD5769 may reprogram antigen-experienced T cells and induce de novo T cell responses.

data.clinical_result_summary: This initial analysis from the biomarker-oriented MGC-FLORA study suggests that adding fruquintinib to first-line immunochemotherapy may improve clinical efficacy in advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Trends toward prolonged progression-free survival were observed in both the overall and propensity score-matched populations, supporting a potential therapeutic benefit that warrants further validation in randomized trials and integrated biomarker analyses.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Biomarker-driven assessment of immunochemotherapy with or without fruquintinib as first-line treatment for advanced gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma: Initial clinical results and subgroup analysis from the MGC-FLORA study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of liposomal irinotecan, Sintilimab, and Lenvatinib demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile as a second-line therapy for advanced HER2-negative gastric/gastro-esophageal junction adenocarcinoma. These encouraging results warrant further validation in larger randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with histologically confirmed advanced HER2-negative gastric/gastro-esophageal junction adenocarcinoma who progressed on or after first-line therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Liposomal irinotecan plus sintilimab and lenvatinib for second-line advanced HER2-negative gastric/gastro-esophageal junction adenocarcinoma: A phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Induction EC/EP plus camrelizumab followed by maintenance camrelizumab plus apatinib showed encouraging activity and manageable safety in treatment-naive advanced or metastatic EP-NEC. Further studies are warranted to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naive patients with advanced or metastatic extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter single-arm study of induction EC/EP plus camrelizumab followed by maintenance camrelizumab plus apatinib in treatment-naive advanced or metastatic extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a propensity-matched real-world cohort receiving contemporary dual HER2 blockade plus endocrine therapy, a chemotherapy-free strategy demonstrated similar 3-year overall survival compared with taxane induction, with a clinically meaningful reduction in neutropenia and no signal for higher sepsis, heart failure, or acute care utilization. These data support the feasibility of chemotherapy de-escalation in selected HR+/HER2+ metastatic breast cancer patients and motivate prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with incident hormone receptor-positive/HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer treated with dual HER2 blockade using trastuzumab plus pertuzumab and endocrine therapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dual HER2 blockade with or without taxane induction in HR+/HER2+ metastatic breast cancer: A comparative analysis of clinical outcomes.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of BB-1701 in combination with sintilimab in patients with HER2 expression or mutation in locally advanced/metastatic breast cancer or NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: After a median follow-up of 7.8 years, neoadjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy followed by adjuvant pembrolizumab continued to show a clinically meaningful survival benefit compared with neoadjuvant chemotherapy alone in participants with high-risk early-stage TNBC. Safety findings included higher rates of any grade immune-mediated adverse events with pembrolizumab.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab or placebo plus chemotherapy followed by adjuvant pembrolizumab or placebo for high-risk early-stage TNBC: Final analysis results from the phase 3 KEYNOTE-522 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, recurrent metastatic presentation was associated with significantly longer progression-free survival and a consistent trend toward longer treatment durability on first-line EGFR TKI, independent of mutation subtype and TKI agent. As early discontinuation rates were similar, the differences in time to treatment discontinuation and progression-free survival in recurrent disease appear to reflect differences in tumor biology rather than early treatment failure.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with EGFR-mutant metastatic non-small cell lung cancer treated with first-line EGFR TKI from 2012 to 2025 at Northwell Health.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: De novo vs recurrent metastatic presentation and outcomes with first-line EGFR TKI in EGFR-mutant NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world case series demonstrates that Pedmark can be feasibly incorporated into adult oncology workflows and does not interfere with cisplatin-based treatment. These findings support the routine adoption of Pedmark for young adults to reduce the risk of cisplatin-induced hearing loss and enhance survivorship outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective case series included young adults aged 18–39 years with localized and disseminated solid tumors receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy at a cancer center in 2024–2025.

data.clinical_result_summary: This large real-world cohort analysis evaluated pembrolizumab-lenvatinib beyond immunotherapy progression in advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer. Pembrolizumab-lenvatinib did not improve overall survival compared with chemotherapy in patients previously exposed to immune checkpoint inhibitors, suggesting it may not be the optimal choice in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer who had received an immune checkpoint inhibitor-based regimen within the previous three years were included, while patients with any other malignancy were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pembrolizumab–lenvatinib beyond immunotherapy progression in endometrial cancer: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant dual-target PD-1/VEGF immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy showed a higher pathological complete response rate than dual-target PD-1/CTLA-4 and single-target PD-1 regimens in resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The treatment was well tolerated, with common toxicities consistent with expected chemotherapy and radiotherapy profiles.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy in combination with chemotherapy in resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: Updated efficacy and safety data from a randomized phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: IO102-IO103 in combination with nivo-rela was associated with a higher objective response rate compared with historical data for nivo-rela alone, meeting the trial’s primary endpoint. No unexpected safety signals were observed, supporting further clinical investigation of this combination as an initial treatment for unresectable melanoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable, previously untreated non-uveal melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 trial of IO102-IO103 and nivolumab-relatlimab in previously untreated, unresectable melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: These real-world findings augment clinical trial results and reinforce that ribociclib provides consistent and substantial post-progression survival benefits in patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer. Benefits were also observed in patients aged 65 years or older.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included US female patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer who initiated first-line ribociclib in combination with an aromatase inhibitor or aromatase inhibitor monotherapy between January 1, 2020 and January 31, 2025, including patients aged 65 years or older.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: (RW) post-progression outcomes after first-line (1L) treatment with ribociclib + an aromatase inhibitor (AI) vs AI alone in US patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HR+/HER2–) metastatic breast cancer (MBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: This study was the first to evaluate adjuvant ADC plus radiotherapy in upper tract urothelial carcinoma. The combination of RC48-ADC and radiotherapy demonstrated a tolerable safety profile in patients with HER2-overexpressing upper tract urothelial carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-overexpressing upper tract urothelial carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary results of a phase II study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of disitamab vedotin (RC48-ADC) in combination with radiotherapy for adjuvant therapy in upper tract urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In Chinese patients with locally advanced basal cell carcinoma, sonidegib demonstrated robust efficacy, consistent with previous reports in global study populations. The safety profile of sonidegib was manageable, and no new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Chinese patients with locally advanced basal cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective, single-arm, multicenter, phase IV study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of sonidegib in Chinese patients with locally advanced basal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with stage IA HER2-positive breast cancer, adjuvant capecitabine plus trastuzumab was associated with an excellent 5-year invasive disease-free survival rate of 97.9%. No adverse events that influenced treatment continuity were observed, and the regimen may be an alternative for patients with small HER2-positive tumors with fewer toxic effects than established regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage IA HER2-positive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant capecitabine and trastuzumab for stage IA HER2-positive breast cancer (IRIS-A): A phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Azenosertib plus paclitaxel showed promising clinical activity and tolerability in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. ORR and median duration of response were improved compared with historical paclitaxel monotherapy, supporting continued evaluation of this regimen in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer and other indications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant or -refractory ovarian cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Azenosertib plus paclitaxel for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: Results from a phase 1b study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The final analysis demonstrated that trifluridine/tipiracil plus ramucirumab did not provide a significant overall survival benefit compared with trifluridine/tipiracil alone in third- or later-line treatment for advanced gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Updated results for progression-free survival, tumor response, and safety were consistent with the primary analysis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable or recurrent gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma refractory or intolerant to fluoropyrimidine, taxane, or irinotecan, and refractory to ramucirumab
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Randomized phase II trial of trifluridine/tipiracil (FTD/TPI) plus ramucirumab (RAM) versus FTD/TPI for previously treated patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: Final analysis of RETRIEVE study (WJOG 15822G).

data.clinical_result_summary: RICE demonstrates safety and feasibility of adding anti-PD-L1 therapy to neoadjuvant CROSS in esophageal adenocarcinoma and shows promising response rates. The results support the efficacy of durvalumab, while addition of tremelimumab to durvalumab is not supported by this study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with locally advanced (≥ uT3/Nx or uT2/N+) non-metastatic Esophageal Adenocarcinoma (including EGJ-I and EGJ-II)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative durvalumab plus neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (CROSS) with and without tremelimumab in esophageal adenocarcinoma: The prospective phase II RICE trial (NCT04159974).

data.clinical_result_summary: GRWD5769 with cemiplimab demonstrated broad, durable activity across all 6 phase 1b expansion cohorts in patients with at least 2 prior lines of therapy and secondary anti-PD-1 resistance, or MSS-CRC. Therapy was well tolerated with no observed safety signals, and translational analyses suggested that GRWD5769 may reprogram antigen-experienced T cells and induce de novo T cell responses.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic malignancies receiving GLP1 therapy demonstrated superior survival outcomes. The observed survival benefit may be related to the anti-inflammatory properties of GLP1, including immunomodulatory effects and attenuation of oncogenic signaling and proliferation. Further investigation into the broader oncologic effects of GLP1 therapy is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with hepatocellular carcinoma, fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder cancer, or pancreatic cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival in patients with hepatobiliary and pancreatic cancers taking GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: The primary results indicated that carboplatin-based induction-concurrent chemoradiotherapy represents an alternative doublet treatment strategy to cisplatin-based induction-concurrent chemoradiotherapy for patients with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma. A longer follow-up is needed to confirm the promising regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with non-keratinizing nasopharyngeal carcinoma and stage III-IVa
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Carboplatin-based versus cisplatin-based induction-concurrent chemoradiotherapy with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma: A multicenter, parallel-group, non-inferiority, randomized, phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Heparinoid, but not DOAC, exposure was associated with cytokine release syndrome and poor overall survival in patients receiving CAR-T/BITE therapies. The findings suggest a need for confirmatory studies to establish safer anticoagulation strategies in at-risk individuals.
clinical_result_indication_name: 噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients receiving the first treatment of CAR-T/BITE or patients with HLH as index events from 09/2017 to 12/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of heparinoids exposure with cytokine release syndrome–related morbidity and mortality in patients receiving CAR-T or BITE therapies.

data.clinical_result_summary: LB1410 showed an excellent safety profile and promising antitumor efficacy in patients with immune-oncology-resistant/refractory cervical cancer. Further studies of LB1410 as monotherapy and in combination with lenvatinib in patients with immune-oncology-resistant/refractory cervical cancer are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors who were heavily pretreated and resistant or refractory to anti-PD-1/PD-L1 treatments.
pts with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma
pts with SoC-failed, immunotherapy-experienced/refractory cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of LB1410, a bivalent TIM-3/PD-1 bispecific antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tislelizumab with standard GP chemotherapy followed by cisplatin concurrent chemoradiotherapy and adjuvant tislelizumab with capecitabine achieved a potential complete response rate and manageable toxicity in patients with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Treatment is continued and long-term follow-up is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of tislelizumab combined with chemoradiotherapy in high-risk locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: IMA401 demonstrated overall favorable tolerability without reaching a formal maximum tolerated dose and showed encouraging antitumor activity in patients with head and neck cancer, melanoma, and squamous non-small cell lung cancer at the recommended phase 2 dose range. Further development steps are being evaluated, including a potentially synergistic combination with the PRAME-directed bispecific IMA402 in squamous non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumor indications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts were ≥18 y, HLA-A*02:01+, MAGEA4+ and/or MAGEA8+, have R/R solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human results with IMA401, a MAGEA4/8-targeted T-cell receptor–based bispecific T-cell engager (TCER) in recurrent or refractory solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective cohort of localized high-grade soft tissue sarcoma, epirubicin-ifosfamide-based neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy was feasible and associated with encouraging surgical and disease-control outcomes. These data support prospective evaluation and may help refine patient selection for intensified multimodality treatment strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients with localized high-grade soft tissue sarcoma treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with radiotherapy at Hospital Gregorio Marañon from 2014 to 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of neoadjuvant concurrent chemoradiotherapy with epirubicin–ifosfamide in localized high-grade soft tissue sarcoma: A single-center retrospective series (N=57).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Atezolizumab plus PHESGO did not demonstrate sufficient antitumor activity in patients with ERBB2-altered solid tumors to warrant further study. The cohort did not reach its planned accrual, limiting statistical power for demonstrating efficacy, and other treatments, including clinical trial options, should be considered.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with solid tumors with ERBB2 alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Atezolizumab (A) plus pertuzumab/trastuzumab/hyaluronidase (PHESGO) in patients (pts) with solid tumors with ERBB2 alterations (alt): Results from the Targeted Agent and Profiling Utilization Registry (TAPUR) study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Add-on ruxolitinib with glucocorticoids showed higher resolution rates and earlier response trends than glucocorticoids alone in malignant patients with severe checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis. Adverse events were not different between groups, suggesting that add-on ruxolitinib with glucocorticoids might be a promising treatment for patients with severe checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with severe checkpoint inhibitor-associated pneumonitis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of add-on ruxolitinib for patients with severe checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis management with corticosteroids: A multicenter, open-label, randomised phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: ACE demonstrated encouraging activity in metastatic inflammatory breast cancer with durable benefit in two patients and no grade 4/5 toxicities reported. Resistance was associated with metabolic reprogramming and stromal immune exclusion, supporting rational development of metabolism-targeting, stroma-modifying, or T-reg/macrophage-directed combinations in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic/recurrent inflammatory breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical and translational analysis of a phase Ib/II combination of atezolizumab, cobimetinib, and eribulin (ACE) to demonstrate inflammatory and metabolic programs define divergent response states.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study met its primary endpoint, demonstrating the highest reported rates of EFS, PFS, and OS after treatment of locally advanced and unresectable cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. The data suggest that integrating cemiplimab-rwlc with definitive radiotherapy may benefit appropriate patients, and future studies should identify patients best served by this approach.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with T3-4/N+/M0 locally advanced and unresectable cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II, multicenter, single-arm clinical trial of response-adapted definitive radiotherapy and cemiplimab-rwlc immunotherapy for locally advanced, unresectable cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma: RAMPART.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: MRG006A demonstrated manageable safety and promising anti-tumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with GPC3-expressing advanced HCC. These findings support the therapeutic potential of this GPC3-directed ADC and warrant further clinical investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with intermediate or high GPC3 expression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I/II study of MRG006A, a first-in-class Glypican-3 (GPC3)–targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients (pts) with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up, the overall safety profile of epcoritamab remained consistent with the previous report, with no new safety signals identified. Responses were durable, median overall survival was 27.2 months, and higher complete response rates in the 2L group suggested enhanced benefit when epcoritamab was used in earlier lines of therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with relapsed/refractory (R/R) diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) who have received at least one prior line of systemic therapy
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性综合征
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EPCORE NHL-6: Phase 2 study of subcutaneous (SC) epcoritamab as outpatient treatment for 2L+ relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (R/R DLBCL).

data.clinical_result_summary: GLP-1RA use was not associated with increased risks of serious gastrointestinal or biliary adverse events among patients with breast cancer receiving systemic therapy. Nausea/vomiting and GERD were more frequent, but GLP-1RA use was associated with significant reductions in major adverse cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality. Prospective studies are warranted to confirm long-term safety and oncologic outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with breast cancer and coexisting type 2 diabetes mellitus who received breast cancer-directed systemic therapy and antidiabetic medications were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in patients with breast cancer: A real-world multicenter cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The totality of efficacy, safety, and exposure-response analyses supported advancement of a talquetamab plus teclistamab regimen for further clinical development in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients with extramedullary disease who have received a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory drug, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody. The regimen also offers flexibility of switching to every-4-week dosing for responders.
clinical_result_indication_detail: RRMM pts with EMD
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RP2R dose selection of Tal + Tec for the treatment of EMD patients in the RedirecTT-1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with active solid tumors and cancer-associated venous thromboembolism, full-dose apixaban and rivaroxaban had similar 1-year risks of recurrent pulmonary embolism, gastrointestinal bleeding, and intracranial hemorrhage. Rivaroxaban was associated with lower rates of recurrent deep vein thrombosis, all-cause mortality, anemia, and transfusion. Given the observational design and potential residual confounding, these results are hypothesis-generating and highlight the need for prospective head-to-head trials.
clinical_result_indication_name: 癌症相关静脉血栓栓塞症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with colon, breast, lung, prostate, head and neck, or pancreatic cancer and active disease, defined by receipt of chemotherapy, radiation, or cancer surgery within 6 months of cancer diagnosis, who had acute deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism within 30 days of the cancer index date.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of full-dose apixaban vs rivaroxaban for cancer-associated venous thromboembolism in patients with solid tumors: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: VT-EBV-N demonstrated a clinically meaningful improvement in disease-free survival with a favorable safety profile in patients with EBV-positive extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in complete remission and at high risk of relapse. These findings support VT-EBV-N as a promising post-remission therapeutic option for this rare and aggressive lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with EBV-positive extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in complete remission and at high risk of relapse
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of VT-EBV-N on disease-free survival as post-remission therapy in EBV-positive extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large propensity score–matched real-world cohort of immune checkpoint inhibitor–treated patients, COVID-19 vaccination within 100 days of immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation was associated with significant improvements in real-world overall survival and real-world progression-free survival, particularly in non-small cell lung cancer. Prospective validation and randomized clinical trials are warranted to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years at diagnosis with advanced/metastatic bladder cancer, melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, or renal cell carcinoma who initiated an immune checkpoint inhibitor between January 2021 and March 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination near immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation with outcomes: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Exercise plus methylphenidate was not superior to exercise plus placebo in improving cancer-related fatigue. Methylphenidate-containing arms significantly improved cancer-related fatigue compared with their placebo arms, while all four treatment arms showed improvement over time, suggesting a strong placebo response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with prostate cancer receiving androgen deprivation therapy and/or radiation therapy and had cancer-related fatigue
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase III placebo controlled randomized controlled trial using combination therapy for treatment-related fatigue in patients with prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: SURE-01 was reported as the first study of antibody-drug conjugate monotherapy targeting TROP2 in the neoadjuvant setting for patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer. Neoadjuvant sacituzumab govitecan at the reduced dose of 7.5 mg/kg demonstrated compelling activity and survival estimates with a manageable safety profile, supporting TROP2 as a suitable target for muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts with cT2-4N0M0 MIBC who were ineligible for or refused cisplatin-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant sacituzumab govitecan in patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer: Final results and biomarker analyses of the SURE-01 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: GEMOX plus tislelizumab and donafenib as a first-line treatment option for patients with advanced biliary tract cancer showed favorable efficacy and tolerability.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tislelizumab combined with donafenib and GEMOX as first-line treatment for advanced biliary tract cancer: A single-arm, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance, GLP-1RA use was associated with significantly lower all-cause mortality compared with sulfonylureas, whereas DPP-4i use was associated with increased mortality compared with SGLT2 inhibitors and thiazolidinediones. No significant effect on progression to multiple myeloma was observed, and the findings should be validated in future prospective studies.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Incretin-based therapies and all-cause mortality and progression to multiple myeloma in patients with MGUS and type 2 diabetes: A real-world cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This patient-centric short-course backbone combined with chemotherapy and PD-L1 blockade showed promise in MSS locally advanced rectal cancer. It achieved a higher pCR rate and favorable tumor regression without compromising surgical safety, suggesting a potential option for organ preservation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable, stage II/III (cT3-4a/N+) microsatellite stable locally advanced rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Short-course radiotherapy and chemotherapy with or without PD-L1 blockade (envafolimab) for MSS locally advanced rectal cancer: Interim analysis of the randomized phase III PRECAM-R trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nimotuzumab plus S-1 and concurrent radiotherapy showed a favorable efficacy and safety profile. This combination might be a treatment choice for older patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 clinical study of nimotuzumab plus S-1 and concurrent radiotherapy in 75 years and older patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Hetrombopag was safe and may reduce recurrence and severity of chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gynecologic malignancies. It may decrease platelet transfusion requirements and facilitate timely chemotherapy, representing a convenient option for secondary prevention of chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of hetrombopag for secondary prevention of chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gynecologic malignancies: A single-arm phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results from the ZAMA study show that frontline zanubrutinib plus rituximab provides encouraging efficacy with manageable safety in MALT lymphoma. The study is ongoing, and patient enrollment is continuing.

data.clinical_result_summary: SHR-1701 plus fuzuloparib and chemotherapy as first-line therapy demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced lung squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naïve patients with advanced lung squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SHR-1701 combined with fuzuloparib and chemotherapy as first-line therapy for advanced lung squamous cell carcinoma: Efficacy and safety results from a phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of adults with primary brain malignancy and venous thromboembolism, DOAC treatment was associated with a lower intracranial hemorrhage risk and reduced mortality at 180 days compared with LMWH after propensity score matching. These findings support the safety of DOACs in patients with primary brain tumors and warrant further prospective evaluation of anticoagulant selection in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with primary malignant brain tumors who developed venous thromboembolism within one year of tumor diagnosis were included, while patients with secondary malignant neoplasms were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Direct oral anticoagulants versus low-molecular-weight heparin for venous thromboembolism in primary brain tumors: A TriNetX real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Obe-cel treatment demonstrated favorable efficacy and safety outcomes in patients with and without extramedullary disease in the FELIX trial. Among responders, duration of response in patients with extramedullary disease was comparable with that observed in patients without extramedullary disease. Overall, these findings support a positive benefit-risk profile for obe-cel, irrespective of extramedullary disease status at lymphodepletion.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: The effect of obecabtagene autoleucel (obe-cel) on adult patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (R/R B-ALL) and extramedullary disease (EMD).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this randomized phase II study, adding selinexor to standard induction and consolidation chemotherapy was associated with numerically higher response rates and longer median overall survival than chemotherapy alone. However, the study was small and terminated early, so definitive conclusions cannot be drawn; further evaluation of selinexor-containing combinations in AML is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with newly diagnosed non-APL acute myeloid leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase II study of selinexor added to standard induction and consolidation chemotherapy in adults with acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

data.clinical_result_summary: SYS6010 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in patients with advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, especially in TOPOi-naive patients. These findings support further development, and a phase 3 study is planned to compare SYS6010 with standard of care in TOPOi-naive ESCC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II trial of SYS6010, an EGFR antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) in patients with advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Early serum albumin change was independently associated with overall survival in cancer patients receiving antibody-drug conjugates, suggesting it may serve as an early indicator of mechanisms underlying IgG-based therapy resistance. Further investigation into clearance patterns, toxicities, and outcomes of patients treated with antibody-drug conjugates is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Cancer patients who received antibody-drug conjugates and had at least one pretreatment and one on-treatment cycle 1 serum albumin value were included; a subset had pretreatment serum albumin measured within 30 days before starting antibody-drug conjugate therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Serum albumin as an early predictor of survival in patients receiving antibody-drug conjugates.

data.clinical_result_summary: The preservation of tumor-draining lymph nodes in patients achieving clinical complete response after neoadjuvant therapy with tislelizumab is safe. This approach provides novel insights and methods for lymph node management and presents a potential new treatment option for the clinical management of clinically node-positive urothelial carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with clinically node-positive urothelial carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of perioperative use of tislelizumab in treating clinically node-positive urothelial carcinoma: A prospective clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large propensity score–matched real-world cohort of immune checkpoint inhibitor–treated patients, COVID-19 vaccination within 100 days of immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation was associated with significant improvements in real-world overall survival and real-world progression-free survival, particularly in non-small cell lung cancer. Prospective validation and randomized clinical trials are warranted to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years at diagnosis with advanced/metastatic bladder cancer, melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, or renal cell carcinoma who initiated an immune checkpoint inhibitor between January 2021 and March 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination near immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation with outcomes: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Efbemalenograstim alfa offers longer-lasting neutropenia protection than PEG-rhG-CSF in patients with locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma, resulting in shorter severe neutropenia, higher treatment compliance, and a better safety profile with less bone pain. These findings support its role as an effective and well-tolerated prophylactic option.

clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included stage III–IVa locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients treated between July 2023 and April 2025 who were undergoing induction chemotherapy followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of efbemalenograstim alfa versus PEG-rhG-CSF in preventing neutropenia in patients with locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma undergoing induction chemotherapy followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world study enriched the efficacy and safety data for donafenib in the treatment of radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer patients in clinical practice in China. The efficacy and safety results were consistent with those of the phase III DIRECTION study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with progressive locally advanced or metastatic radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer who were treated with donafenib monotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Progressive locally advanced or metastatic radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer (RAI-R DTC) patients treated with donafenib: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Although the primary PFS endpoint was not met in the ITT population, exploratory analysis showed clinically meaningful and consistent efficacy improvements among ECOG 0 patients treated with ibrilatazar plus FOLFIRINOX. The safety profile was consistent with known FOLFIRINOX toxicities, and the findings support further investigation in selected metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma populations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had histologically confirmed metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, ECOG performance status 0–1, and no prior systemic treatment for metastatic disease, receiving first-line therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase IIb randomized trial of FOLFIRINOX plus ibrilatazar (ABTL0812) versus placebo as first-line treatment in metastatic pancreatic cancer: An analysis from the PanC-ASAP study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a predominantly Hispanic, heavily pretreated real-world small cell lung cancer population with a high prevalence of brain metastases, tarlatamab demonstrated feasible administration, manageable immune-mediated toxicity, and clinically meaningful antitumor activity. These findings support the effectiveness of tarlatamab beyond clinical trial populations and highlight the importance of real-world evidence in informing care for underrepresented patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab at Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center between January 2024 and October 31, 2025, representing a predominantly Hispanic, heavily pretreated real-world population with a high prevalence of brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tarlatamab in small cell lung cancer with brain metastases: A real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: BL-M05D1 demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a tolerable safety profile in pretreated Claudin18.2-positive pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer, and biliary tract cancer. The 4.0 mg/kg Day 1 every 3 weeks dose was selected as the recommended phase 2 dose, supporting further development of BL-M05D1 in these tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing pancreatic cancer
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing BTC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing Gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJ)
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of BL-M05D1, a novel Claudin18.2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2–expressing solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with multiple rare cancer types derived meaningful response to ipilimumab plus nivolumab. Characterization of biologically defined subsets is underway to optimize therapeutic selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with refractory rare cancers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DART (NCI/SWOG S1609): Comprehensive results from dual checkpoint inhibition with CTLA-4 and PD-1 blockade in rare cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: No new safety signals were observed for zongertinib in combination with T-DXd, and further dose escalation is ongoing. Encouraging clinical activity was observed in pretreated patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma who had disease progression following prior trastuzumab-based therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma (Cohort C)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zongertinib combined with T-DXd in HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma (mGEAC): First results from a phase Ib/II dose-escalation trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: These findings suggest that PD-1 blockade may represent a feasible preventive approach for high-risk oral premalignant lesions and warrants further investigation as a preventive option. Biomarker evaluation of pre-treatment and on-treatment biopsies is ongoing to inform predictors of response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with oral leukoplakia, erythroleukoplakia, or proliferative verrucous leukoplakia with moderate dysplasia, severe dysplasia, or carcinoma in situ
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II open-label, single-arm study to evaluate the efficacy of pembrolizumab for leukoplakia.

data.clinical_result_summary: PF-07799544 plus PF-07799933 showed manageable safety and promising systemic and intracranial antitumor activity in heavily pretreated BRAF-mutant advanced melanoma. Evaluation of dose expansion cohorts is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with BRAF-mutant advanced melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1b study of a brain-penetrant MEK inhibitor, PF-07799544, plus next-generation BRAF dimer inhibitor, PF-07799933, in advanced BRAF-mutant melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant adebrelimab plus concurrent chemoradiotherapy demonstrated remarkable efficacy in locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, with high pathological complete response and major pathological response rates and significant pathological downstaging. Hematologic toxicity requires vigilant management, but the tumor regression achieved suggests a promising new strategy that warrants further validation in a phase III randomized controlled trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable thoracic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adebrelimab combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy as neoadjuvant therapy for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A prospective, single-arm clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lenvatinib-based salvage therapy was not associated with improved overall survival compared with chemotherapy in anti-PD-1-refractory melanoma. Effect estimates were time-dependent and uncertain amid strong confounding by therapy line, and the data do not justify prioritizing a lenvatinib-versus-chemotherapy prospective trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced cutaneous melanoma progressing after anti-PD-1 therapy were identified, with non-cutaneous primaries manually excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post–PD-1 failure in advanced melanoma: Real-world outcomes with lenvatinib-based versus non-lenvatinib-based therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary interim results indicate that neoadjuvant camrelizumab plus chemotherapy shows promising antitumor activity, excellent surgical feasibility, and acceptable safety in PD-L1-negative locally advanced cervical cancer. These findings support further investigation of chemo-immunotherapy as a neoadjuvant strategy for low-risk LACC regardless of PD-L1 expression status.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naïve patients with PD-L1-negative cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant camrelizumab with chemotherapy (NACI) in PD-L1-negative locally advanced cervical cancer: An open-label, multi-center, single-arm, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Long-term imatinib therapy was associated with a gradual but clinically meaningful decline in renal function in a subset of patients with chronic myeloid leukaemia. Dose modification, switching tyrosine kinase inhibitors, or attempting treatment-free remission may result in partial reversibility without compromising disease control, highlighting the need for long-term renal monitoring and treatment optimisation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with chronic myeloid leukaemia treated with imatinib for at least 10 years at a single tertiary care centre, excluding patients with pre-existing chronic kidney disease, those receiving chemotherapy, those diagnosed with a second malignancy, and patients in treatment-free remission.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Beyond haematological control: Long-term renal outcomes of imatinib therapy in chronic myeloid leukaemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with previously treated primary CNS tumors, ABBV-706 had a safety profile comparable to that observed in other tumors and showed encouraging antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically/cytologically confirmed advanced relapsed/refractory glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype, Grade 4) or astrocytoma (IDH-mutant, Grade 3/4)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1, first-in-human (FIH) study evaluating safety and efficacy of ABBV-706: Results from patients with high-grade central nervous system (CNS) tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among women with operable stage II–III HER2-positive breast cancer, neoadjuvant treatment with nab-PHPy was noninferior to TCHP with respect to pathological complete response. The regimen was associated with a distinct toxicity profile, supporting its role as an alternative neoadjuvant strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Women with previously untreated, operable stage II–III HER2-positive breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant pyrotinib vs pertuzumab therapy for HER2-positive early breast cancer: The HELEN HER-013 randomized clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of enzalutamide plus ribociclib was well tolerated; however, no significant difference in PSA50 response was observed, and the primary endpoint was not met. A disease-stabilizing effect was observed in a subset of patients treated with the combination, with evidence of prolonged survival. Further investigation into this disease-stabilizing effect and refinement of patient selection criteria beyond RB expression may be warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: taxane-naïve patients with metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer that retains RB expression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase Ib/II study of enzalutamide (Enza) with and without ribociclib (Rib) in patients with metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) that retains RB expression: RiboX study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the context of standard first-line EGFR-TKI therapy, patients with malignant pleural effusion had significantly reduced survival benefits. Even with first-line third-generation EGFR-TKIs, survival remained markedly inferior to that of patients without malignant pleural effusion, suggesting that MPE alone may be insufficient for prognostic stratification and should be interpreted together with other clinical subgroup characteristics.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Histologically or cytologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer patients with confirmed EGFR mutations, including patients with malignant pleural effusion at diagnosis who underwent Indwelling Pleural Catheter drainage with cytological confirmation, and who received first-line EGFR-TKI therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical characteristics and prognostic analysis of epidermal growth factor receptor–mutated non–small cell lung cancer patients with malignant pleural effusion.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world experience, systematic discussion within a standard weekly multidisciplinary team integrating molecular profiling was associated with optimized treatment allocation and favorable clinical outcomes in both localized and metastatic gastric cancer. These findings support the role of structured multidisciplinary discussion in routine clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated 172 consecutive patients with gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including 96 with localized disease managed in a neoadjuvant setting and 76 with metastatic disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of biomarker-guided multidisciplinary management in localized and metastatic gastric cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Latin American patients in LIBERTAS were younger on average and had more advanced disease than the overall study population. Despite higher baseline PSA levels, Latin American patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer demonstrated rapid and deep PSA responses to apalutamide plus androgen deprivation therapy, consistent with the global analysis. The safety profile of apalutamide was consistent with previous studies, and the study remains on track for the primary readout.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Latin American patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer were eligible if they had ≤3 months of prior androgen deprivation therapy, ECOG performance status 0–1, and confirmed metastases by conventional or next-generation imaging; patients who achieved an undetectable PSA (<0.2 ng/mL) after 6 months on apalutamide plus androgen deprivation therapy could enter the main randomized treatment phase.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Validation of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) decline among the Latin American subgroup of LIBERTAS: A phase 3 study of apalutamide (APA) plus continuous versus intermittent androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) in metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC).

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pemivibart for prevention of COVID-19: Subset analysis of CANOPY participants with solid tumor or hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: Efbemalenograstim alfa offers longer-lasting neutropenia protection than PEG-rhG-CSF in patients with locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma, resulting in shorter severe neutropenia, higher treatment compliance, and a better safety profile with less bone pain. These findings support its role as an effective and well-tolerated prophylactic option.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的中性粒细胞减少症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included stage III–IVa locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients treated between July 2023 and April 2025 who were undergoing induction chemotherapy followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of efbemalenograstim alfa versus PEG-rhG-CSF in preventing neutropenia in patients with locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma undergoing induction chemotherapy followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy.
