data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world study showed that irinotecan liposome (II)-based combination regimens had a manageable safety profile and encouraging effectiveness signals in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Follow-up and patient enrollment are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with pathologically or radiologically confirmed pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who were considered eligible by investigators for irinotecan liposome (II)-based combination regimens incorporating chemotherapy, chemoradiation, radiotherapy, immunotherapy, or targeted therapy.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter, prospective real-world study of irinotecan liposome (II)–based combination regimens in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cetuximab monotherapy following PD-1 inhibitor therapy demonstrated encouraging clinical activity in patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell cancer, with improved outcomes compared with historical cetuximab monotherapy. These findings suggest that sequential targeting of immune-mediated pathways may provide clinical benefit after immunotherapy failure, and larger prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell cancer who experienced disease progression or intolerance to PD-1 inhibitor therapy, with or without chemotherapy, and were subsequently treated with cetuximab monotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Second-line cetuximab monotherapy following PD-1 inhibitor treatments in patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of prostate cancer patients treated with Lu177 vipivotide tetraxetan, overall survival was strongly influenced by tobacco use, comorbidity burden, and baseline laboratory markers reflecting nutritional status, hematological reserves, and immunity. The findings highlight the importance of physiologic reserve and inflammatory state in shaping outcomes with this radioligand therapy and may inform risk stratification and care strategies in routine clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with prostate cancer who initiated lutetium Lu177 vipivotide tetraxetan after FDA approval through Dec 20, 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world overall survival outcomes of lutetium (Lu177) vipivotide tetraxetan treatment in prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Revumenib exposure increases approximately 2-fold with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, supporting dose reduction in this setting, while M1 exposure remains unaffected. Low-fat meals do not cause clinically meaningful changes in revumenib or M1 pharmacokinetics, and antacids, H2 blockers, and proton pump inhibitors had no impact on revumenib or M1 pharmacokinetics. These findings reinforce the flexible administration of revumenib, which may support treatment adherence and patient convenience.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled adult (≥18 years) and pediatric (<18 years) patients with relapsed/refractory acute leukemias harboring a KMT2A rearrangement or NPM1 mutation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pharmacokinetic (PK) assessment of revumenib in patients with relapsed/refractory (R/R) acute leukemias harboring a KMT2A rearrangement (KMT2Ar) or NPM1 mutation (NPM1m): Impact of food and concomitant medications.

data.clinical_result_summary: Efbemalenograstim alfa effectively reduced the incidence of chemotherapy-induced neutropenia in non-small cell lung cancer patients receiving intermediate-risk febrile neutropenia chemotherapy with additional risk factors. The treatment presented a favorable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的中性粒细胞减少症
clinical_result_indication_detail: NSCLC patients receiving intermediate risk FN chemotherapy with additional risk factors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efbemalenograstim alfa for prophylaxis in non–small cell lung cancer patients patients with chemotherapy-induced febrile neutropenia: A randomized, multicenter, exploratory clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with previously treated primary CNS tumors, ABBV-706 had a safety profile comparable to that observed in other tumors and showed encouraging antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically/cytologically confirmed advanced relapsed/refractory glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype, Grade 4) or astrocytoma (IDH-mutant, Grade 3/4)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1, first-in-human (FIH) study evaluating safety and efficacy of ABBV-706: Results from patients with high-grade central nervous system (CNS) tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: SCRT followed by Ivonescimab and CAPOX as neoadjuvant therapy in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer seemed to demonstrate safety and promising efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: LARC patients who met at least one of the following high-risk criteria—cT4, cN2, EMVI (+), MRF (+) or lateral lymph node (+).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Short-course radiotherapy followed by ivonescimab and CAPOX as neoadjuvant therapy for locally advanced rectal cancer: A single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lucicebtide was well tolerated as monotherapy and in combination with standard of care. Improvements in PFS and OS were observed in patients with glioblastoma following lucicebtide exposure, with evidence of BBB penetration, target engagement, on-target pharmacodynamic activity, reduction in mesenchymal gene signature, and remodeling toward a more permissive immune tumor microenvironment. These data support continued clinical evaluation of lucicebtide as a novel approach for patients with glioblastoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent and newly diagnosed GBM, window-of-opportunity (WoO) cohorts
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Lucicebtide (ST101) plus chemoradiation in newly diagnosed GBM patients: Efficacy, pharmacodynamics, and safety from phase 2 window-of-opportunity study.

data.clinical_result_summary: I-124 PET identified persistent, iodine-avid disease in patients who would not routinely receive adjuvant radioiodine therapy pursuant to ATA Guidelines, while enabling individualized selection in others to minimize secondary malignancy risk. The impact on long-term oncological outcomes has yet to be determined, and three-year follow-up analyses evaluating recurrence rates and overall oncological safety are in progress.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled adult patients with differentiated thyroid carcinoma, excluding those with unifocal papillary microcarcinomas ≤ 10 mm limited to the thyroid.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CLERAD-PROBE: Dosimetric analysis of I-124 PET–guided remnant radioiodine ablation in differentiated thyroid carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of US health claims data, zanubrutinib monotherapy demonstrated significantly longer time to next treatment and improved overall survival compared with acalabrutinib in patients receiving second-line or later therapy for mantle cell lymphoma. These findings support zanubrutinib as an effective BTK inhibitor for relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were US adults aged ≥18 years with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma, at least 2 mantle cell lymphoma diagnoses, continuous enrollment or activities within 1 year prior to and 3 months following the index date, and initiation of zanubrutinib or acalabrutinib monotherapy as second-line or later treatment; patients with evidence of clinical trial participation, end stage renal disease, or prior stem cell transplant were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A real-world comparison of treatment and survival outcomes with zanubrutinib (zanu) and acalabrutinib (acala) monotherapy among patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) in the United States.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant therapy with tislelizumab plus gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel demonstrated clinical feasibility and encouraging antitumor activity in patients with borderline resectable pancreatic cancer, with a favorable safety profile. NT5DC2, FAM3D, CXCL5 and TMT1B may be biomarkers for preoperative drug resistance in pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with borderline resectable pancreatic cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical efficacy of tislelizumab in combination with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel and chemoresistance analysis in borderline resectable pancreatic cancer: A prospective pilot study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The triplet combination of anlotinib plus nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine demonstrated unprecedented survival benefits and a manageable safety profile in advanced primary cardiac angiosarcoma. With median overall survival exceeding twice the historical data, this regimen represents a potent new treatment strategy. Liver involvement was identified as a critical prognostic indicator, while the clinical significance of baseline D-dimer levels warrants further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with metastatic or unresectable primary cardiac angiosarcoma treated at Zhongshan Hospital, Fudan University.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Triplet combination of anlotinib plus nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine (AG) as a first-line strategy for advanced primary cardiac angiosarcoma: A high-volume center experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: The Phase I/II studies provided clinical evidence of a favorable benefit-risk profile for EN002-gel as a novel topical therapy in patients with Bowen's disease, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, or actinic keratosis. Phase II drug treatment for actinic keratosis is expected to be completed in May 2026, and new results will be presented at the meeting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with actinic keratosis or non-melanoma skin cancer including basal cell carcinoma, Bowen's disease, and low-risk squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I/II study of EN002-gel, a first-in-class drip inhibitor, in non-melanoma skin cancer and actinic keratosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose apatinib combined with previously resistant first-line chemotherapy showed promising efficacy. This combination provided a feasible therapeutic strategy for patients with osteosarcoma lacking effective second-line choices, with adverse events described as manageable.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with advanced osteosarcoma who had tumor progression after first-line chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose apatinib combination with first-line chemotherapy rechallenge in advanced osteosarcoma: A single-center ambispective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nivo/Tem improved overall survival compared with temozolomide alone in immunotherapy-refractory metastatic melanoma, with benefits in both OS and PFS particularly pronounced in patients with elevated LDH. Although the improvement in ORR did not reach statistical significance, the findings suggest chemo-immunotherapy may be a viable salvage strategy for aggressive refractory disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic melanoma with documented disease progression on prior anti-PD-1+/- ipilimumab or relatlimab and other available systemic treatments were eligible, while patients with prior chemotherapy or uveal melanoma were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab plus temozolomide (Nivo/Tem) vs. temozolomide monotherapy in refractory melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with active solid tumors and cancer-associated venous thromboembolism, full-dose apixaban and rivaroxaban had similar 1-year risks of recurrent pulmonary embolism, gastrointestinal bleeding, and intracranial hemorrhage. Rivaroxaban was associated with lower rates of recurrent deep vein thrombosis, all-cause mortality, anemia, and transfusion. Given the observational design and potential residual confounding, these results are hypothesis-generating and highlight the need for prospective head-to-head trials.
clinical_result_indication_name: 癌症相关静脉血栓栓塞症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with colon, breast, lung, prostate, head and neck, or pancreatic cancer and active disease, defined by receipt of chemotherapy, radiation, or cancer surgery within 6 months of cancer diagnosis, who had acute deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism within 30 days of the cancer index date.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of full-dose apixaban vs rivaroxaban for cancer-associated venous thromboembolism in patients with solid tumors: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of neoadjuvant and adjuvant enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab did not decrease health-related quality of life 18 weeks post-surgery relative to radical cystectomy plus pelvic lymph node dissection alone. Given the superior efficacy and manageable safety, these results support the benefit-risk profile of enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab and radical cystectomy plus pelvic lymph node dissection as treatment for patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer who are ineligible for or decline cisplatin.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants with muscle-invasive bladder cancer who were ineligible for or declined cisplatin therapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Health-related quality of life (HRQoL) with neoadjuvant and adjuvant (neoadj-adj) enfortumab vedotin (EV) plus pembrolizumab (pembro) in participants (pts) with muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) who are cisplatin ineligible: Phase 3 KEYNOTE-905 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tumor-immune microenvironment remodeling was heterogeneous in patients with hormone receptor positive early breast cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy. Findings trended toward greater cytotoxic T-cell and antigen-presenting cell density and proximity to the tumor area in patients with residual cancer burden 0/I.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with hormone receptor positive early breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Spatial remodeling of the tumor-immune microenvironment (TIME) on neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy (NCIT) in patients (pts) with hormone receptor positive (HR+) early breast cancer (eBC) by multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF).

data.clinical_result_summary: DZD6008 demonstrated promising and durable antitumor activity in patients with EGFR C797X-positive NSCLC and had a manageable safety profile. These findings support its potential as a later-line treatment option after failure of a third-generation EGFR TKI.
clinical_result_indication_detail: NSCLC patients with EGFR C797X mutations (C797X+)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DZD6008, a fourth-generation EGFR TKI, in pretreated NSCLC patients with EGFR C797X mutations: Results from phase 1/2 studies.

data.clinical_result_summary: In real-world practice in Peru, abiraterone demonstrated efficacy and survival comparable to pivotal trials, with superior outcomes in metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer. Despite 44% high-risk disease, triplet therapy was rarely used and most patients received ADT alone or with bicalutamide, limiting its population-level benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic prostate cancer treated with abiraterone at 4 oncology centers in Peru, including both metastatic castration-sensitive and castration-resistant prostate cancer settings.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of abiraterone in metastatic prostate cancer: A multicenter study in Peru.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of benmelstobart, anlotinib, and chemotherapy showed promising efficacy as neoadjuvant therapy for resectable locally advanced HNSCC, with high ORR and MPR rates and an acceptable safety profile. These updated results support further evaluation of this regimen in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage III/IVA head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of benmelstobart combined with anlotinib and chemotherapy as neoadjuvant therapy for locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: A single-arm, open-label phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I/II study of EN002-gel, a first-in-class drip inhibitor, in non-melanoma skin cancer and actinic keratosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: BL-M05D1 demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a tolerable safety profile in pretreated Claudin18.2-positive pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer, and biliary tract cancer. The 4.0 mg/kg Day 1 every 3 weeks dose was selected as the recommended phase 2 dose, supporting further development of BL-M05D1 in these tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing pancreatic cancer
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing BTC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing Gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJ)
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of BL-M05D1, a novel Claudin18.2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2–expressing solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched analysis of real-world data, mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccination was associated with significantly superior long-term survival among CAR T-cell recipients. The results provide early real-world clinical evidence and support prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with hematologic malignancies who received CAR T-cell therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccination on CAR T-cell therapy outcomes in hematologic malignancies: A multi-center real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial showed that MeiLianFuXin Liquid reduced severe oral mucositis incidence versus placebo in patients with radiation-induced oral mucositis and had a favorable safety profile. These findings support MeiLianFuXin Liquid as a promising treatment strategy to mitigate radiation-induced oral mucositis.
clinical_result_indication_name: 放化疗引起的口腔溃疡
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with non-metastatic head and neck cancer planned for radiotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of Meilian Fuxin liquid for radiation-induced oral mucositis in head and neck cancer: A multicenter randomized clinical trial.

grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events
data.clinical_result_summary: BAT8006 in combination with BAT1308 may represent an effective therapeutic strategy for advanced endometrial cancer, with a manageable safety profile. Further prospective studies are warranted to validate the efficacy and safety of this combination regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced endometrial cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of BAT8006 in combination with BAT1308 in patients with advanced endometrial cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Survival after leptomeningeal metastases diagnosis is increasing with novel therapy, and the findings highlight the role of trastuzumab-deruxtecan even in the setting of low HER2. This report provides a single-center experience using trastuzumab-deruxtecan for leptomeningeal metastases in breast cancer patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with breast cancer and cytology-proven leptomeningeal metastases who were treated with trastuzumab-deruxtecan after their leptomeningeal metastases diagnosis was made.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab-deruxtecan for the management of leptomeningeal metastases from breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: HSK46575 showed a manageable safety profile and preliminary antitumor activity in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, especially in the population with AR-LBD mutations. These findings support further exploration of HSK46575 in the mCRPC population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1, multicenter, open-label study of HSK46575 in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer progressing after next-generation hormonal agents and chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Initial findings support the feasibility and tolerability of [225Ac]Ac-FL-020 administration in heavily pretreated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, with a few notable prostate-specific antigen responses. The recommended Phase 2 dose has not yet been reached, and dose escalation continues.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ProTACT: Preliminary data from a first-in-human, phase 1 study evaluating the safety, tolerability, and anti-tumor activity of [225Ac]Ac-FL-020, a PSMA-targeted radioconjugate, in patients with mCRPC.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of relugolix and darolutamide was safe and well tolerated during the first 6 treatment cycles, with pharmacokinetic parameters similar to historical monotherapy comparators. Appropriate initial testosterone and PSA reductions were observed, and patients will continue to be followed after end-of-treatment for the primary endpoint of testosterone recovery.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high risk localized, lymph node-positive or low volume metastatic prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comeback from long-course ADT with relugolix (rel) and darolutamide (daro) in hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (PC) (CLEARED).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched analysis of real-world data, mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccination was associated with significantly superior long-term survival among CAR T-cell recipients. The results provide early real-world clinical evidence and support prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with hematologic malignancies who received CAR T-cell therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccination on CAR T-cell therapy outcomes in hematologic malignancies: A multi-center real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: GLP-1RA use was not associated with increased risks of serious gastrointestinal or biliary adverse events among patients with breast cancer receiving systemic therapy. Nausea/vomiting and GERD were more frequent, but GLP-1RA use was associated with significant reductions in major adverse cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality. Prospective studies are warranted to confirm long-term safety and oncologic outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with breast cancer and coexisting type 2 diabetes mellitus who received breast cancer-directed systemic therapy and antidiabetic medications were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in patients with breast cancer: A real-world multicenter cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study represents the largest real-world analysis to date of cholangiocarcinoma patients treated with FGFR inhibitors. Patient characteristics and medical events of interest were similar in the futibatinib and pemigatinib groups, and clinical outcomes were also similar, suggesting that futibatinib is a promising alternative in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients diagnosed with cholangiocarcinoma and with evidence of initial treatment with futibatinib or pemigatinib in 2023 or later were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world treatment patterns and clinical outcomes among cholangiocarcinoma patients treated with futibatinib or pemigatinib.

data.clinical_result_summary: No new safety signals were observed for zongertinib in combination with T-DXd, and further dose escalation is ongoing. Encouraging clinical activity was observed in pretreated patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma who had disease progression following prior trastuzumab-based therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma (Cohort C)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zongertinib combined with T-DXd in HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma (mGEAC): First results from a phase Ib/II dose-escalation trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: TSN1611 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and clinically meaningful antitumor activity in patients with KRAS G12D-mutated non-small cell lung cancer. Further development of TSN1611 as monotherapy and in combination regimens is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients
patients with advanced solid tumors harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of TSN1611, a highly selective oral KRAS G12D inhibitor, in solid tumors: Efficacy and safety in KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: BCD-201 demonstrated equivalent efficacy to reference pembrolizumab with comparable safety, pharmacokinetics, and immunogenicity in patients with advanced melanoma. These data support BCD-201 as a pembrolizumab biosimilar and highlight its potential to expand access to anti-PD-1 therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced melanoma
clinical_result_layer_factor: ECOG (0 vs 1), PD-L1 expression (<5% vs ≥5%), and disease stage (AJCC 7th edition M0/M1a/M1b vs M1c)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: А phase III randomized study comparing BCD-201, a pembrolizumab biosimilar candidate, and reference pembrolizumab in patients with advanced melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of metastatic non-small cell lung cancer restricted to first-line immunotherapy, initiating immune checkpoint inhibitors within 30 days versus 30 to 90 days of diagnosis was not associated with improved overall survival when survival was indexed to metastatic diagnosis. Earlier initiation was associated with increased ICU utilization shortly after treatment start, suggesting greater clinical instability at treatment initiation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults (≥18 years) with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer who received first-line immunotherapy, with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer restricted to first-line immunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early versus delayed initiation of first-line immune checkpoint inhibitors in metastatic non–small cell lung cancer: A real-world analysis of treatment timing and care context.

data.clinical_result_summary: Oleogel-S10 did not improve the primary endpoint of wound surface area compared with standard-of-care triamcinolone, but treatment was associated with trends toward improvement in skin pain and hyperpigmentation. Interpretation was limited by early study closure related to COVID-19-associated recruitment challenges and small sample size, and larger studies are warranted to evaluate Oleogel-S10 in grade 2-3 acute radiation dermatitis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: breast cancer patients with grade 2/3 radiation dermatitis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized, phase II, double-blinded study of the efficacy of oleogel-S10 (AP101) gel for the treatment of grade 2/3 radiation dermatitis in breast cancer patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: Subcutaneous envafolimab induced significant tumor regression with a favorable safety profile in patients with locally advanced colon cancer. The combination of envafolimab and XELOX showed encouraging efficacy and a high treatment completion rate as neoadjuvant therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: newly diagnosed patients with locally advanced colon cancer (cT4 N0 M0 or cTx N+ M0).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective, single-arm, single-center observational clinical study on envafolimab (PD-L1 inhibitor) in combination with XELOX for neoadjuvant treatment of locally advanced colon cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a large real-world cohort of patients with gastric adenocarcinoma treated with first-line immunotherapy, concomitant PPI use was associated with significantly worse overall survival after adjustment for PPI indications and comorbidity burden. The findings suggest that acid-suppressive therapy may impair the effectiveness of immunotherapy, and careful evaluation of the need for PPIs and prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with gastric adenocarcinoma who initiated nivolumab- or pembrolizumab-based first-line treatment between 2016 and 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Proton pump inhibitor use and overall survival in patients with gastric adenocarcinoma treated with first-line immunotherapy: A real-world pharmacoepidemiologic study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Based on the second safety assessment, durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide showed a manageable safety profile in patients with extensive-stage extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma. These findings supported continuation of the DURVASCC trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with extensive-stage extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide in extensive-stage extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma (ES-EPSCC): Second safety assessment of the DURVASCC trial (GOIRC-01-2021).

data.clinical_result_summary: BL-M05D1 demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a tolerable safety profile in pretreated Claudin18.2-positive pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer, and biliary tract cancer. The 4.0 mg/kg Day 1 every 3 weeks dose was selected as the recommended phase 2 dose, supporting further development of BL-M05D1 in these tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing pancreatic cancer
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing BTC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing Gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJ)
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of BL-M05D1, a novel Claudin18.2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2–expressing solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: BL-M05D1 demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a tolerable safety profile in pretreated Claudin18.2-positive pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer, and biliary tract cancer. The 4.0 mg/kg Day 1 every 3 weeks dose was selected as the recommended phase 2 dose, supporting further development of BL-M05D1 in these tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing pancreatic cancer
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing BTC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing Gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJ)
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of BL-M05D1, a novel Claudin18.2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2–expressing solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients treated with FLOT compared with CROSS reported better patient-reported outcomes following neoadjuvant therapy and before surgery. However, sensory problems were higher with FLOT versus CROSS throughout the treatment trajectory and follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resectable esophageal adenocarcinoma, specifically cT1 cN+ cM0 or cT2-4a cNany cM0 esophageal adenocarcinoma, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Patient reported outcomes (PRO) during and after multimodal treatment for resectable esophageal adenocarcinoma in the prospective, randomized, controlled, multicenter phase III ESOPEC trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In routine clinical practice, lisocabtagene maraleucel demonstrated response rates higher than in clinical trials, with a consistent safety profile. These real-world data support lisocabtagene maraleucel as an effective option for patients with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia, including heavily pretreated or high-risk patients, and suggest potential for outpatient administration.
clinical_result_indication_detail: US patients with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia who received commercial lisocabtagene maraleucel from 05/2024 to 09/2025 and had at least 1 postinfusion assessment reported to CIBMTR were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of lisocabtagene maraleucel (liso-cel) in patients (pt) with relapsed or refractory (R/R) chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL): First results from CIBMTR.

data.clinical_result_summary: At final analysis, first-line necitumumab plus pembrolizumab demonstrated durable antitumor activity and encouraging long-term survival as a chemotherapy-free regimen in patients with PD-L1–high advanced NSCLC. Toxicities were consistent with the known profiles of EGFR-targeted antibodies and PD-1 inhibitor therapy, underscoring the need for careful monitoring. These findings warrant further confirmation in a randomized phase III clinical trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated advanced NSCLC with PD-L1 expression of 50% or higher
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Durable efficacy of first-line necitumumab plus pembrolizumab in PD-L1–high advanced NSCLC: Final results of the phase II K-TAIL-202 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab combined with gemcitabine-cisplatin showed promising anti-tumor activity and manageable safety in patients with unresectable or systemic treatment-failed biliary tract cancer. Longer follow-up is required to further evaluate efficacy and safety.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable or systemic treatment-failed biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II, exploratory trial of cadonilimab (AK104) plus gemcitabine-cisplatin (GC) as a conversion therapy for patients (pts) with unresectable or systemic treatment–failed biliary tract cancer (BTC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Nesuparib combined with GemAbraxane demonstrated acceptable tolerability and encouraging antitumor activity in advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. These findings support further evaluation of nesuparib using a 12.5 mg intermittent dosing schedule in the first-line treatment setting, and a Phase II trial is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of nesuparib (JPI-547) with gemcitabine-nab-paclitaxel (GemAbraxane) or modified FOLFIRINOX (mFOLFIRINOX) in patients with locally advanced or metastatic PDAC: Results from an ongoing phase Ib/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large propensity score–matched real-world cohort of immune checkpoint inhibitor–treated patients, COVID-19 vaccination within 100 days of immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation was associated with significant improvements in real-world overall survival and real-world progression-free survival, particularly in non-small cell lung cancer. Prospective validation and randomized clinical trials are warranted to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years at diagnosis with advanced/metastatic bladder cancer, melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, or renal cell carcinoma who initiated an immune checkpoint inhibitor between January 2021 and March 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination near immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation with outcomes: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: This trial demonstrated a significant improvement in progression-free survival with the combination of the neo-epitope vaccine OSE2101 and the anti-PD1 pembrolizumab as maintenance after platinum therapy for patients with platinum-sensitive relapsed ovarian cancer progressing post-PARP inhibitor and bevacizumab. Treatment-emergent adverse events were increased with the combination compared with OSE2101 alone.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian cancer (PSOC)
clinical_result_layer_factor: best response to platinum (CR/PR vs SD)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The neo-epitope-based vaccine OSE2101 with or without pembrolizumab versus best supportive care as maintenance in platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian cancer patients with controlled disease after platinum-based chemotherapy: The academic randomized TEDOVA/GINECO-OV244b/ENGOT-ov58 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world study, patients aged ≥65 years with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy achieved clinical outcomes and safety profiles comparable to those of younger patients, despite a higher burden of comorbidities and more frequent visceral disease. The findings suggest that chronological age alone should not limit immunochemotherapy use and that treatment decisions should be based on clinical fitness.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This study retrospectively analyzed female patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in routine clinical practice, stratified by age at treatment initiation as <65 versus ≥65 years.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness and safety of first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in patients aged ≥65 years with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Purinostat mesylate as a highly selective HDAC inhibitor in combination with pomalidomide and low-dose dexamethasone showed encouraging efficacy and safety in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Complicated cases with extramedullary disease, super high-risk characteristics, or heavy pretreatment may benefit from the PM triplet therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial phase 1b/2 study results of purinostat mesylate (PM) in combination with pomalidomide (POM) and low dexamethasone (DEX) in patients with RRMM.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients treated with first-line zongertinib reported rapid improvement followed by stability in physical functioning and NSCLC-SAQ total score, with high proportions qualifying as PRO responders. Zongertinib was well tolerated, reflected by low overall side effect burden and low incidence and mild nature of patient-reported symptomatic adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included treatment-naïve patients with HER2-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer who were given 120 mg zongertinib once daily as first-line treatment in Cohort 2.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PRO results from the Beamion LUNG-1 trial in treatment-naïve patients with HER2-mutant advanced NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: TSN1611 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and clinically meaningful antitumor activity in patients with KRAS G12D-mutated non-small cell lung cancer. Further development of TSN1611 as monotherapy and in combination regimens is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients
patients with advanced solid tumors harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of TSN1611, a highly selective oral KRAS G12D inhibitor, in solid tumors: Efficacy and safety in KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: Combining a promising pathological response with a more manageable toxicity profile, this regimen offers a well-tolerated and effective alternative for total neoadjuvant therapy in locally advanced rectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A novel regimen of liposomal irinotecan plus capecitabine as total neoadjuvant therapy for locally advanced rectal cancer (LipCap): A phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The use of a titrated infusion protocol for first lifetime dose taxanes did not significantly reduce the incidence or severity of immediate hypersensitivity reactions. These findings suggest that a titration protocol may not confer additional benefits over fixed-rate infusion in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients undergoing their first lifetime dose of taxanes, specifically docetaxel or paclitaxel, with one cohort receiving a fixed infusion rate and another cohort undergoing a three-step titration protocol.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparing the rates of hypersensitivity reactions in patients undergoing first-dose taxanes utilizing fixed-rate vs. stepwise-titration infusions.

T细胞炎性基因表达谱高
data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up, overall survival benefit was comparable across the four biomarker subgroups for the three pembrolizumab-based combination therapies, with no new safety signals. These data continue to show the feasibility of prospective biomarker assessment to evaluate pembrolizumab-based therapies in advanced non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants with previously untreated advanced non-small cell lung cancer were assessed for T-cell–inflamed gene expression profile and tumor mutational burden and assigned to one of four prospectively defined biomarker subgroups.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final analysis of the biomarker-directed, randomized, phase 2 KEYNOTE-495/KeyImPaCT study of pembrolizumab (P)–based combination therapy for non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Progression-free survival was longer with sacituzumab govitecan versus chemotherapy across all Trop-2 categories, tBRCA genotypes, and HER2 subgroups. These findings reinforce the significant and clinically meaningful benefit of sacituzumab govitecan as first-line treatment for this patient population across multiple biomarker subgroups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included participants with previously untreated locally advanced unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer who were not candidates for PD-(L)1 inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ASCENT-03: Efficacy by biomarker subgroup with sacituzumab govitecan (SG) vs chemotherapy (chemo) in participants (pts) with previously untreated advanced triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) who are not candidates for PD-(L)1 inhibitors (PD-[L]1i).

data.clinical_result_summary: The triple combination of adebrelimab, pyrotinib, and inetetamab represents a viable and active strategy for HER2-amplified metastatic colorectal cancer after prior therapy. The observed efficacy in patients refractory to prior HER2-targeted therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates, warrants further investigation in this population with limited options.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously treated HER2-amplified metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dual HER2-targeted therapy with pyrotinib plus inetetamab and adebrelimab in previously treated HER2-amplified metastatic colorectal cancer: A prospective, single-arm, phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Apatinib combined with adebrelimab and GEMOX regimen demonstrated promising efficacy and an acceptable safety profile as first-line treatment for advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. These findings support its potential as a preferred therapeutic option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults aged ≤75 years with pathologically confirmed advanced ICC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Apatinib combined with adebrelimab and GEMOX regimen as first-line treatment for advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: A multicenter, open-label, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of epcoritamab with R-mini-CVP demonstrated encouraging efficacy with a favorable tolerability profile in older, unfit or frail patients who may be unable to tolerate full-dose chemotherapy. Based on these promising early-phase results, the study is planned for expansion into a multicenter trial with a larger patient cohort.
clinical_result_indication_detail: older unfit/frail or anthracycline-ineligible adult patients with newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 trial of epcoritamab in combination with rituximab-mini CVP for older unfit/frail or anthracycline-ineligible adult patients with newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: Interim futility analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance, GLP-1RA use was associated with significantly lower all-cause mortality compared with sulfonylureas, whereas DPP-4i use was associated with increased mortality compared with SGLT2 inhibitors and thiazolidinediones. No significant effect on progression to multiple myeloma was observed, and the findings should be validated in future prospective studies.
clinical_result_indication_name: 意义未明单克隆免疫球蛋白血症
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance who had at least one year of treatment exposure to incretin-based therapies both before and after MGUS diagnosis were included, while individuals with a prior cancer diagnosis were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Incretin-based therapies and all-cause mortality and progression to multiple myeloma in patients with MGUS and type 2 diabetes: A real-world cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In locally advanced rectal cancer treated with neoadjuvant FOLFOX plus pembrolizumab, PD-L1 CPS strongly predicted radiological treatment response and pathological complete response. Metabolic imaging and liquid biopsy biomarkers provided complementary predictive value, and the regimen had a favorable safety profile supporting further investigation in larger prospective trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced rectal cancer, specifically T3–T4, N1–N3 rectal adenocarcinoma, received neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Integrating metabolic response and circulating tumor biomarkers as early indicators of therapy outcome in locally advanced inoperable rectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: For patients with stage III and high-risk stage II colorectal cancer, TPACD was a well-acceptable complementary therapy. CAPOX combined with TPACD reduced CAPOX-induced adverse reactions, improved quality of life, and further extended disease-free survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients from 4 departments of China-Japan Friendship Hospital with stage III or high-risk stage II colorectal cancer who were undergoing CAPOX.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of CAPOX combined with traditional Chinese medicine (TiaoPi AnChang Decoction) on disease-free survival in patients with stage III or high-risk stage II colorectal cancer: An updated report of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tumor-immune microenvironment remodeling was heterogeneous in patients with hormone receptor positive early breast cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy. Findings trended toward greater cytotoxic T-cell and antigen-presenting cell density and proximity to the tumor area in patients with residual cancer burden 0/I.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with hormone receptor positive early breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Spatial remodeling of the tumor-immune microenvironment (TIME) on neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy (NCIT) in patients (pts) with hormone receptor positive (HR+) early breast cancer (eBC) by multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of first-line therapy, pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib and nivolumab plus cabozantinib were associated with similar overall survival and comparable 1- and 2-year all-cause mortality, healthcare utilization, and immune-related adverse events. Treatment selection between these regimens may be guided by patient-specific factors, toxicity profiles, and cost considerations rather than anticipated differences in efficacy, although the findings should be interpreted in the context of a retrospective, real-world analysis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma diagnosed after January 2021 who received first-line pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib or nivolumab plus cabozantinib within 6 months of diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Metastatic renal cell carcinoma treated with pembrolizumab–lenvatinib versus nivolumab–cabozantinib: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Survival after leptomeningeal metastases diagnosis is increasing with novel therapy, and the findings highlight the role of trastuzumab-deruxtecan even in the setting of low HER2. This report provides a single-center experience using trastuzumab-deruxtecan for leptomeningeal metastases in breast cancer patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with breast cancer and cytology-proven leptomeningeal metastases who were treated with trastuzumab-deruxtecan after their leptomeningeal metastases diagnosis was made.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab-deruxtecan for the management of leptomeningeal metastases from breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: OBX-115 TIL cell therapy at the recommended phase 2 dose demonstrated encouraging efficacy in second- or third-line advanced non-uveal melanoma. The regimen’s low-dose lymphodepletion, acetazolamide-inducible mbIL15 expression, and core needle biopsy-enabled manufacturing were associated with manageable side effects and compare favorably with other adoptive TIL approaches. The data support continued investigation of OBX-115 in the ongoing phase 2 portion of Agni-01 and a planned registrational study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced melanoma that has progressed on/after immune checkpoint inhibitors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: OBX-115 engineered tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapy with regulatable membrane-bound IL15 (mbIL15) in patients with advanced melanoma that has progressed on/after immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI): Phase 2 results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary efficacy and safety data suggest that anlotinib plus carboplatin/paclitaxel induction therapy, followed by anlotinib maintenance, is a promising regimen for newly diagnosed advanced ovarian cancer. The regimen showed a median PFS of 20.76 months and a favorable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: first-line treatment for advanced OC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary efficacy and safety of first-line anlotinib plus carboplatin/paclitaxel induction therapy followed by anlotinib maintenance in advanced ovarian cancer: Results from the ALTER-GO-010 phase II multicenter trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of adults with primary brain malignancy and venous thromboembolism, DOAC treatment was associated with a lower intracranial hemorrhage risk and reduced mortality at 180 days compared with LMWH after propensity score matching. These findings support the safety of DOACs in patients with primary brain tumors and warrant further prospective evaluation of anticoagulant selection in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with primary malignant brain tumors who developed venous thromboembolism within one year of tumor diagnosis were included, while patients with secondary malignant neoplasms were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Direct oral anticoagulants versus low-molecular-weight heparin for venous thromboembolism in primary brain tumors: A TriNetX real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study demonstrated the feasibility of patient-specific mathematical modeling incorporating ctDNA and imaging to inform adaptive dosing of encorafenib plus binimetinib with concurrent nivolumab. The adaptive arm did not compromise efficacy and had lower toxicity, and confirmation in larger trials may favorably impact patient quality of life and reduce therapy costs.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced BRAF V600E mutant melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Novel adaptive versus continuous dosing of encorafenib and binimetinib in combination with nivolumab in advanced BRAF V600E mutant melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: I-124 PET identified persistent, iodine-avid disease in patients who would not routinely receive adjuvant radioiodine therapy pursuant to ATA Guidelines, while enabling individualized selection in others to minimize secondary malignancy risk. The impact on long-term oncological outcomes has yet to be determined, and three-year follow-up analyses evaluating recurrence rates and overall oncological safety are in progress.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled adult patients with differentiated thyroid carcinoma, excluding those with unifocal papillary microcarcinomas ≤ 10 mm limited to the thyroid.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CLERAD-PROBE: Dosimetric analysis of I-124 PET–guided remnant radioiodine ablation in differentiated thyroid carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: TSN1611 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and clinically meaningful antitumor activity in patients with KRAS G12D-mutated non-small cell lung cancer. Further development of TSN1611 as monotherapy and in combination regimens is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients
patients with advanced solid tumors harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of TSN1611, a highly selective oral KRAS G12D inhibitor, in solid tumors: Efficacy and safety in KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of avelumab to total neoadjuvant therapy in patients with microsatellite-stable locally advanced rectal cancer resulted in a statistically significant increase in pathologic complete response, notably among those with high ImmunoScore. The regimen was associated with continued improvement in survival outcomes at 5 years.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated 5-year survival outcomes of short-course radiation followed by mFOLFOX-6 plus avelumab in locally advanced microsatellite-stable rectal adenocarcinoma: The Averectal phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large propensity score–matched real-world cohort of immune checkpoint inhibitor–treated patients, COVID-19 vaccination within 100 days of immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation was associated with significant improvements in real-world overall survival and real-world progression-free survival, particularly in non-small cell lung cancer. Prospective validation and randomized clinical trials are warranted to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years at diagnosis with advanced/metastatic bladder cancer, melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, or renal cell carcinoma who initiated an immune checkpoint inhibitor between January 2021 and March 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination near immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation with outcomes: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In selected patients with peritoneal metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, HIPEC provided a substantial survival advantage over systemic therapy alone and more than doubled median overall survival. Germline mutation status did not preclude benefit, and the multimodal approach of HIPEC plus cytoreductive surgery appeared highly effective.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with peritoneal metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes of hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) with cytoreduction in peritoneal metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma: Survival benefit and impact of germline genetic mutations.

data.clinical_result_summary: BH-30643 is the first tyrosine kinase inhibitor monotherapy to demonstrate clinical responses against C797S both with and without T790M. High plasma exposures combined with super-potency, CNS activity, and favorable safety suggest potential for deep and durable EGFR inhibition, and enrollment into backfill and expansion cohorts is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer harboring any activating EGFR or HER2 mutation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human trial of BH-30643, a novel macrocyclic, non-covalent, mutant-selective OMNI-EGFR inhibitor, in EGFR-mutant (EGFRm) NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Responses to treatment with cosibelimab 800 mg every 2 weeks remained robust and durable, with stable objective response rate after continued follow-up in a larger cohort of patients with locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. No new safety signals were identified.
clinical_result_indication_detail: subjects with locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of cosibelimab 800 mg every 2 weeks for locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma: Updated follow-up from a pivotal study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, regorafenib demonstrated meaningful clinical activity and a favorable safety profile in patients with recurrent high-grade gliomas. Survival outcomes compared favorably with those reported in pivotal and observational studies, supporting regorafenib as an important therapeutic option in selected high-grade glioma cases and highlighting the need for broader Latin American real-world data.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with histologically confirmed high-grade gliomas treated at a tertiary referral center in Bogotá, Colombia, who had received standard first-line therapy consisting of maximal safe resection followed by IMRT/VMAT with concomitant and adjuvant temozolomide and subsequently progressed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Regorafenib in recurrent glioblastoma: Real-world outcomes from a Colombian cohort (REGOMA-COL).

data.clinical_result_summary: No new safety signals were observed for zongertinib in combination with T-DXd, and further dose escalation is ongoing. Encouraging clinical activity was observed in pretreated patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma who had disease progression following prior trastuzumab-based therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma (Cohort C)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zongertinib combined with T-DXd in HER2-positive metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal carcinoma (mGEAC): First results from a phase Ib/II dose-escalation trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Brenetafusp showed promising monotherapy activity in late-line melanoma, including difficult-to-treat populations, without causing ICI-like immune-related adverse events. It could be safely combined with pembrolizumab, and Phase 1 results support 160 mcg as the selected dose for the Phase 3 PRISM-MEL trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HLA-A*02:01+ unresectable/metastatic (m) CM patients (pts) previously treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 evaluation of the PRAME‑targeted ImmTAC brenetafusp in advanced melanoma (Mel).

data.clinical_result_summary: In a predominantly Hispanic, heavily pretreated real-world small cell lung cancer population with a high prevalence of brain metastases, tarlatamab demonstrated feasible administration, manageable immune-mediated toxicity, and clinically meaningful antitumor activity. These findings support the effectiveness of tarlatamab beyond clinical trial populations and highlight the importance of real-world evidence in informing care for underrepresented patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab at Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center between January 2024 and October 31, 2025, representing a predominantly Hispanic, heavily pretreated real-world population with a high prevalence of brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tarlatamab in small cell lung cancer with brain metastases: A real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of SHR-A2102 and adebrelimab as first-line therapy showed promising antitumor activity in patients with squamous or non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer. The results support further investigation of this treatment strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
patients with locally advanced or metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SHR-A2102 in combination with adebrelimab as first-line treatment in patients with locally advanced or metastatic squamous or non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Results from a phase 1b/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this nationwide prospective real-world study, selection of first-line chemotherapy for advanced pancreatic cancer was driven primarily by patient age and performance status. mFOLFIRINOX was associated with more favorable effectiveness outcomes than GnP, without clinically meaningful deterioration in quality of life, even in older patients. Fewer than 40% of patients received second-line palliative chemotherapy, underscoring the importance of optimal first-line treatment selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with advanced pancreatic cancer initiating first-line palliative chemotherapy at 25 centers in Korea.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effectiveness, safety, and patient-reported quality of life with first-line chemotherapy in advanced pancreatic cancer: A nationwide prospective multicenter observational study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The OCTAVA trial demonstrated a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival with first-line low-dose nurulimab plus prolgolimab followed by prolgolimab maintenance compared with prolgolimab monotherapy in patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma. The efficacy benefit was accompanied by a manageable rate of immune-related adverse events consistent with the known profile of CTLA-4/PD-1 combinations. These results support the regimen as a first-line treatment option for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: unresectable or metastatic melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of the phase III OCTAVA trial: Clinical benefit of low-dose anti–CTLA-4 plus anti–PD-1 combination vs anti–PD-1 monotherapy in unresectable or metastatic melanoma.

Prospective validation and randomized clinical trials are warranted to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years at diagnosis with advanced/metastatic bladder cancer, melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, or renal cell carcinoma who initiated an immune checkpoint inhibitor between January 2021 and March 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination near immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation with outcomes: A real-world analysis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: A single dose of prophylactic tocilizumab before step-up dose 1 of teclistamab or talquetamab reduced the incidence of cytokine release syndrome, with no impact on safety or efficacy. These findings support outpatient administration of these bispecific antibodies, and enrollment is ongoing with an added arm evaluating prophylactic oral dexamethasone.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Optec/Optal: A phase 2 study to evaluate outpatient (OP), step-up administration of teclistamab (Tec) or talquetamab (Tal) with prophylactic tocilizumab (prophyToci) in patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM).

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of camrelizumab to neoadjuvant docetaxel and carboplatin significantly improved pCR rates in patients with stage II-III triple-negative breast cancer with a manageable safety profile. This anthracycline-free regimen represents a promising neoadjuvant treatment option for early triple-negative breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: female patients aged 18-70 years with previously untreated stage II-III triple-negative breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of camrelizumab combined with docetaxel and carboplatin as neoadjuvant therapy for triple-negative breast cancer: The HELEN-Trio 011 randomized clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: SHR-1701 plus fuzuloparib and chemotherapy as first-line therapy demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced lung squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naïve patients with advanced lung squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SHR-1701 combined with fuzuloparib and chemotherapy as first-line therapy for advanced lung squamous cell carcinoma: Efficacy and safety results from a phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: TSN1611 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and clinically meaningful antitumor activity in patients with KRAS G12D-mutated non-small cell lung cancer. Further development of TSN1611 as monotherapy and in combination regimens is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients
patients with advanced solid tumors harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of TSN1611, a highly selective oral KRAS G12D inhibitor, in solid tumors: Efficacy and safety in KRAS G12D–mutated NSCLC patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: The Phase I/II studies provided clinical evidence of a favorable benefit-risk profile for EN002-gel as a novel topical therapy in patients with Bowen's disease, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, or actinic keratosis. Phase II drug treatment for actinic keratosis is expected to be completed in May 2026, and new results will be presented at the meeting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with actinic keratosis or non-melanoma skin cancer including basal cell carcinoma, Bowen's disease, and low-risk squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I/II study of EN002-gel, a first-in-class drip inhibitor, in non-melanoma skin cancer and actinic keratosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Exercise plus methylphenidate was not superior to exercise plus placebo in improving cancer-related fatigue. Methylphenidate-containing arms significantly improved cancer-related fatigue compared with their placebo arms, while all four treatment arms showed improvement over time, suggesting a strong placebo response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with prostate cancer receiving androgen deprivation therapy and/or radiation therapy and had cancer-related fatigue
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase III placebo controlled randomized controlled trial using combination therapy for treatment-related fatigue in patients with prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of radiotherapy, systemic therapy, and tislelizumab showed a high early tumor shrinkage rate and a manageable safety profile in first-line unresectable microsatellite-stable rectal cancer. Long-term outcomes require further follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable metastatic microsatellite-stable rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Radiotherapy followed by systemic therapy and tislelizumab in microsatellite-stable rectal cancer with synchronous unresectable metastases: Updated results of the MIRACLE-2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant AS therapy is feasible and demonstrates promising efficacy for stage III diffuse-type gastric cancer, with an acceptable safety profile. Molecular findings may help identify patients at higher risk of recurrence, supporting further evaluation in larger, randomized phase III trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage III diffuse-type gastric cancer who underwent D2 gastrectomy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of adjuvant nab-paclitaxel plus S-1 after D2 resection in stage III diffuse gastric cancer (NORDICA study).

data.clinical_result_summary: The quadruplet regimen of envafolimab, lenvatinib, gemcitabine, and cisplatin showed promising efficacy and was well tolerated as first-line therapy for advanced biliary tract cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced BTC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Envafolimab combined with lenvatinib and gemcitabine plus cisplatin in advanced biliary tract cancer as first-line treatment: A multicenter, single-arm, open-label, phase II study (ENLIGHTEN study).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of SHR-A2102 and adebrelimab as first-line therapy showed promising antitumor activity in patients with squamous or non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer. The results support further investigation of this treatment strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
patients with locally advanced or metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SHR-A2102 in combination with adebrelimab as first-line treatment in patients with locally advanced or metastatic squamous or non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Results from a phase 1b/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ateganosine demonstrated clinically meaningful PFS improvement in third-line patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer, independent of PD-L1 status. Improved PFS with THIO sequenced with an immune checkpoint inhibitor compared with standard chemotherapy supports its potential to expand treatment options for ICI-resistant advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Baseline LDH levels may provide prognostic information and help identify patients most likely to benefit from therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 study of PFS in third-line immune checkpoint inhibitor–resistant advanced NSCLC treated with the telomere-targeting agent ateganosine (THIO; 6-thio-2'-deoxyguanosine) sequenced with ICI.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world experience, systematic discussion within a standard weekly multidisciplinary team integrating molecular profiling was associated with optimized treatment allocation and favorable clinical outcomes in both localized and metastatic gastric cancer. These findings support the role of structured multidisciplinary discussion in routine clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated 172 consecutive patients with gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including 96 with localized disease managed in a neoadjuvant setting and 76 with metastatic disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of biomarker-guided multidisciplinary management in localized and metastatic gastric cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant ipilimumab-nivolumab-relatlimab demonstrated encouraging clinical activity in patients with resectable clinical stages IIIB/IIIC/IIID melanoma, warranting further investigation. The toxicity profile was consistent with reported data for ipilimumab-nivolumab-relatlimab and other combinations in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable clinical stages IIIB/IIIC/IIID melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of neoadjuvant ipilimumab-nivolumab-relatlimab (INR) combination immunotherapy in high-risk resectable melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Latin American patients in LIBERTAS were younger on average and had more advanced disease than the overall study population. Despite higher baseline PSA levels, Latin American patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer demonstrated rapid and deep PSA responses to apalutamide plus androgen deprivation therapy, consistent with the global analysis. The safety profile of apalutamide was consistent with previous studies, and the study remains on track for the primary readout.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Latin American patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer were eligible if they had ≤3 months of prior androgen deprivation therapy, ECOG performance status 0–1, and confirmed metastases by conventional or next-generation imaging; patients who achieved an undetectable PSA (<0.2 ng/mL) after 6 months on apalutamide plus androgen deprivation therapy could enter the main randomized treatment phase.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Validation of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) decline among the Latin American subgroup of LIBERTAS: A phase 3 study of apalutamide (APA) plus continuous versus intermittent androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) in metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Pemivibart was well tolerated in the CANOPY Cohort A oncology subset. The data showed limited events overall and no symptomatic COVID-19 in the oncology subset through Month 6.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with solid tumors or hematologic malignancies in the open-label, single-arm, immunocompromised Cohort A.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 药物相关严重不良事件
治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pemivibart for prevention of COVID-19: Subset analysis of CANOPY participants with solid tumor or hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: The findings support that reconstituting lymphocytes with orchestrated systemic immunotherapy using CAR-NK cells combined with an IL-15 agonist and bevacizumab can produce disease response, including complete response, in participants with recurrent glioblastoma multiform. The authors suggest that reversing standard-of-care-induced lymphopenia may have potential to prolong survival and improve prognosis across tumor types.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with Glioblastoma Multiform (IDH WT) who recurred after surgery and temozolomide/XRT.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Response in first-in-human chemotherapy-free combination immunotherapy targeting lymphopenia in recurrent glioblastoma multiform (GBM): Nogapendekin alfa inbakicept (NAI) and PD-L1 t-haNK plus bevacizumab (BEV).

data.clinical_result_summary: BL-M05D1 demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a tolerable safety profile in pretreated Claudin18.2-positive pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer, and biliary tract cancer. The 4.0 mg/kg Day 1 every 3 weeks dose was selected as the recommended phase 2 dose, supporting further development of BL-M05D1 in these tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing pancreatic cancer
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing BTC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing Gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJ)
patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2-expressing solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of BL-M05D1, a novel Claudin18.2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with locally advanced or metastatic Claudin18.2–expressing solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large retrospective real-world analysis, outcomes with tarlatamab in patients with intact performance status (ECOG 0-1) appeared similar to those reported in DeLLphi-304. ECOG performance status 2 or higher was associated with significantly shorter time to treatment discontinuation, progression-free survival, and overall survival. Line of therapy, race, sex, and age were not associated with outcomes in this cohort.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab between March 2024 and September 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Performance status and tarlatamab outcomes in a large, multi-institution real-world database of 2L+ ES-SCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with asciminib in newly diagnosed chronic myeloid leukemia showed a 71% major molecular response rate by 12 months of therapy with no new safety signals. Disease resistance was associated with the emergence of myristoyl pocket mutations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with newly diagnosed chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase or accelerated phase.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II trial of asciminib for newly diagnosed chronic myeloid leukemia.
