data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of SYS6043, a novel B7-H3–targeting antibody-drug conjugate, in patients with advanced pan-tumor malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line EIK1001 plus standard of care demonstrated encouraging efficacy in Stage 4 non-small cell lung cancer with evidence of durable effect. Adverse events were similar to standard of care alone, and cytokine release syndrome events were low grade. Cytokine data support the mechanism of action of EIK1001, and reduced IL6/IL8 inducibility by Cycle 4 may suggest that cytokine release syndrome likelihood diminishes over time.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed Stage 4 nonsquamous or squamous non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy, safety, and cytokine profiling with addition of the toll-like receptor (TLR) 7/8 dual agonist EIK1001 to standard of care (SOC) first-line (1L) therapy: The phase 2 TeLuRide-005 trial in stage 4 NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preoperative ripretinib effectively reduced tumor burden in patients with imatinib-resistant, potentially resectable advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors and facilitated successful surgical intervention. The approach achieved a high no evidence of disease rate and a low surgical complication rate, supporting ripretinib as a safe and effective preoperative treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with imatinib-resistant, potentially resectable advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Ripretinib as preoperative therapy in patients with potentially resectable advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors after imatinib failure: Final analysis of a prospective, multicenter study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of mesutoclax and azacitidine demonstrated a favorable safety profile and encouraging anti-tumor activity in patients with acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndromes. These preliminary results support continued development for the treatment of myeloid malignancies and warrant further investigation in larger, randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndromes
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, tolerability, and efficacy of mesutoclax (ICP-248) in combination with azacitidine in patients with myeloid malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: The SAKK 96/12 REDUSE trial demonstrated that denosumab every 12 weeks after a 3-month loading phase was non-inferior to every 4 weeks in patients with bone-metastatic breast cancer or castration-resistant prostate cancer. The every-12-weeks schedule showed lower rates of osteonecrosis of the jaw and hypocalcemia, suggesting a more favorable safety profile while maintaining comparable efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with metastatic breast cancer (BC) or castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) and at least three bone metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prevalence of symptomatic skeletal events (SSE) with reduced denosumab (Dmab) dose density (every 12 weeks versus every 4 weeks): A randomized phase III non-inferiority trial SAKK 96/12 REDUSE.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort from an underserved Southern state, Tarlatamab showed a manageable safety profile with meaningful representation of African American, rural, and female patients. Outpatient administration with structured monitoring was feasible, though vigilance for CRS and ICANS remains essential. The findings support broader evaluation in underrepresented populations and suggest that remote monitoring, outreach, and education may improve recognition and management of Tarlatamab-associated toxicities.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with previously treated extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated with Tarlatamab at a single academic center between May 2024 and January 2026, with attention to representation of underserved rural and minority populations.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world experience with tarlatamab in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer at an academic center in Mississippi.

data.clinical_result_summary: AiBW dosing effectively reduced pharmacokinetic variability compared with TBW dosing, providing more consistent exposure across body weight. Higher ADC exposure was associated with increased efficacy, but also with a higher incidence of manageable treatment-related adverse events. AiBW optimizes the risk-benefit profile across body weight.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced solid tumors, including patients with ovarian cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Consideration of adjusted ideal body weight dosing in BG-C9074 (B7-H4–targeting ADC) from pharmacokinetics, efficacy, and safety perspectives.

data.clinical_result_summary: TCHP showed comparable efficacy to anthracycline-containing regimens with similar cardiac safety but higher hematological toxicity. Anthracycline-free regimens may be preferred for patients with cardiac risks, while advanced lymph node involvement remains a poor prognostic factor.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed HER2-positive breast cancer patients treated between 2015 and 2025 with neoadjuvant anti-HER2 therapy and surgery, focusing on HER2-positive early-stage breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of anthracycline-containing and anthracycline-free neoadjuvant regimens in HER2-positive breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among older adults with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma, atezolizumab plus bevacizumab and durvalumab plus tremelimumab demonstrated comparable long-term survival in real-world practice. Atezolizumab plus bevacizumab showed improved early survival and numerically lower emergency department utilization, whereas durvalumab plus tremelimumab was associated with higher corticosteroid exposure.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients aged ≥65 years with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma who initiated first-line atezolizumab plus bevacizumab or durvalumab plus tremelimumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative effectiveness and healthcare utilization of atezolizumab plus bevacizumab versus durvalumab plus tremelimumab in older patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant biweekly gemcitabine, cisplatin, and nab-paclitaxel was safe, favorably tolerated, and had manageable toxicity in patients with resectable or borderline resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The regimen demonstrated promising clinical response and high rates of surgical resection, supporting the ongoing trial and further research.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with biopsy-proven resectable or borderline resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of a single-arm phase II clinical trial of gemcitabine, cisplatin, and nab-paclitaxel as neoadjuvant therapy for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Mitazalimab 900 μg/kg in combination with mFFX continued to demonstrate clinically meaningful survival benefits compared with historical controls in untreated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The robust duration of response and encouraging long-term survival support continued development of mitazalimab in a confirmatory Phase 3 study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults diagnosed with previously untreated metastatic PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CD40 agonist mitazalimab + mFOLFIRINOX (mFFX) in patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC): Final efficacy analysis of the OPTIMIZE-1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of extensive-stage small cell lung cancer with advanced metastatic disease, including brain metastases, first-line platinum–etoposide plus durvalumab was associated with markedly improved overall survival compared with platinum–etoposide alone. These findings support the effectiveness of durvalumab-based chemo-immunotherapy in routine clinical practice among high-risk extensive-stage small cell lung cancer populations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with documented extensive-stage small cell lung cancer and metastatic disease, including brain and extracranial metastases, who initiated first-line platinum–etoposide chemotherapy between March 2018 and January 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes with first-line platinum–etoposide plus durvalumab versus platinum–etoposide alone in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer with metastatic disease including brain metastases: A real world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, dose-modified inotuzumab ozogamicin, frequently combined with mini-HCVD, produced high response and MRD-negativity across high-risk B-ALL. Toxicity appeared context-dependent even at lower doses, with rare but severe SOS/VOD and a notable endothelial toxicity signal in post-allo settings. These findings support cautious dosing and timing-based integration of inotuzumab ozogamicin, particularly in transplant-exposed populations and regions with prevalent metabolic liver disease.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: Consecutive patients with B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia treated with inotuzumab ozogamicin at our center, including high-risk and relapsed/refractory disease, post-allo relapse therapy, post-allo maintenance, bridge to allo-HSCT, sequential use with blinatumomab, and pre-phase stabilization.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world experience with inotuzumab ozogamicin in high-risk and R/R B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

The absence of severe GT719-related toxicities and evidence of durable cellular persistence support further clinical investigation of this off-the-shelf CAR-NKT therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of multiple myeloma patients treated with bispecific antibodies, early immunoglobulin replacement was associated with lower risks of serious infection and early mortality. These findings suggest a potential role for immunoglobulin replacement in reducing early infectious risk among patients receiving bispecific antibodies and support further prospective evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years with multiple myeloma who initiated bispecific antibody therapy with teclistamab, elranatamab, or talquetamab were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of immunoglobulin replacement with infection and mortality outcomes in multiple myeloma patients receiving bispecific antibodies: A TriNetX analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first-in-human study targeting CDH17 in patients with gastrointestinal cancer showed a tolerable safety profile for cabotamig up to 0.32 mg/kg. Step-up dosing appeared to mitigate dose-responsive on-target tumor cytokine release syndrome, with minimal on-target normal gastrointestinal mucosal effects, and dose-responsive biomarker anti-tumor activity was observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts ≥18 years with locally advanced or metastatic CDH17+ GI cancers refractory to therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1, FIH study of cabotamig, a TCE CDH17 X CD3, in CDH17-expressing GI malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: HDCT plus PBSCT was reported to be an effective salvage therapy for patients with relapsed seminoma. HDCT as initial salvage chemotherapy provided high PFS and OS and remained effective as third-line or later therapy, suggesting that routine standard-dose salvage chemotherapy before HDCT may not be necessary in appropriately selected patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients with relapsed seminoma who received salvage high-dose chemotherapy and peripheral-blood stem-cell transplant at Indiana University as second-line or subsequent therapy between 2001 and 2026.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: High-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) and peripheral-blood stem-cell transplant (PBSCT) for relapsed seminoma: A single-center cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Oral erdafitinib demonstrated efficacy in reducing tumor burden in select patients with FGFR3-altered non-muscle invasive bladder cancer in this window-of-opportunity trial. No grade ≥3 toxicities were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent FGFR3-altered non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chemoablation with oral erdafitinib in recurrent FGFR3-altered non–muscle-invasive bladder cancer: A phase II window-of-opportunity trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: UCMYM802 demonstrated a manageable safety profile consistent with expected CAR-T-related toxicities, primarily cytokine release syndrome. Preliminary anti-tumor activity was observed in heavily pretreated patients with MSLN-positive advanced solid tumors, with encouraging signals in gynecologic or peritoneal origin adenocarcinoma and biliary tract cancers. The recommended dose for expansion is 1×10^9 CAR-T cells, supporting continued investigation of UCMYM802.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic or recurrent mesothelin-positive solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and preliminary efficacy of a novel armored mesothelin-targeted CAR-T therapy in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world, multicenter analysis of patients with relapsed/refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma treated with duvelisib-based regimens, the ORR of 51% was consistent with published trials. Duvelisib therapy was well tolerated and a minority required hospitalization for toxicity, suggesting that duvelisib is safe in patients with relapsed/refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma who have poor prognosis and limited treatment options.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with relapsed/refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma treated with duvelisib from 2012 to 2025 at 12 centers were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and tolerability of duvelisib in relapsed/refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma: A multicenter real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prolonged-release melatonin did not improve sleep quality compared with placebo in women with early breast cancer on adjuvant endocrine therapy. Although the trial did not meet its primary endpoint, the findings provide important insights into the management of sleep disturbance in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: women with early breast cancer on adjuvant endocrine therapy experiencing sleep disturbance
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II randomised placebo-controlled trial of melatonin for the management of sleep disturbance in women with early breast cancer on adjuvant endocrine therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Infectious complications are common after anti-CD19 CAR-T therapy for relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma and occur mainly beyond 30 days after infusion. Hypogammaglobulinemia was consistently associated with higher infection risk, and prospective studies are needed to define the role of immunoglobulin replacement in reducing late infections.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma, including transformed indolent lymphomas, treated with anti-CD19 CAR-T.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Late infectious complications after CD19-directed chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapy for large B-cell lymphomas (LCBL): Real-world predictors and outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line giredestrant plus palbociclib resulted in a numerical improvement in investigator-assessed progression-free survival compared with letrozole plus palbociclib in estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer, but it did not meet pre-defined statistical significance. The safety profile was tolerable and consistent with the individual agents, with no unexpected findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: people with oestrogen receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative, locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Giredestrant (GIRE) + palbociclib (PALBO) vs letrozole (LET) + PALBO as first-line (1L) therapy in patients (pts) with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer (ER+, HER2– LA/mBC): Primary analysis of the phase III persevERA BC trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Izalontamab in combination with paclitaxel showed encouraging antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma who were previously treated with anti-PD-(L)1 therapy.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of izalontamab (SI-B001) in combination with paclitaxel or docetaxel in patients with recurrent/metastatic (R/M) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Padeliporfin VTP demonstrates favorable preliminary efficacy, durable responses, and a safety profile consistent with prior experience in low-grade upper tract urothelial carcinoma. Enrollment is ongoing, and final outcomes are anticipated to support regulatory approval of an organ-preserving therapy for LG UTUC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with low-grade upper tract urothelial cancer (LG UTUC)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Advancing treatment of low-grade upper tract urothelial carcinoma (LG UTUC) with padeliporfin vascular-targeted photodynamic therapy (VTP): The ENLIGHTED phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Baseline 18F-FDG PET/CT-derived SUVmax is a strong prognostic biomarker in patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer treated with first-line pembrolizumab and chemotherapy. High SUVmax identifies a subgroup of patients with substantially poorer PFS and OS and may help guide risk-adapted therapeutic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Female patients in Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia with histologically confirmed metastatic triple-negative breast cancer who received first-line pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy outside of clinical trials and underwent baseline 18F-FDG PET/CT were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prognostic value of baseline 18F-FDG PET/CT in first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy for metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In addition to a progression-free survival benefit, ozekibart significantly improved disease control rate and delayed quality-of-life deterioration versus placebo in advanced chondrosarcoma. Ozekibart has the potential to become the first standard of care for a population with high unmet need.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic, unresectable chondrosarcoma
clinical_result_layer_factor: grade (2 vs 3), IDH mutation status, and prior systemic therapy (No vs Yes)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The tetravalent death receptor 5 (DR5) agonist ozekibart (INBRX-109) in conventional chondrosarcoma (CS): Secondary efficacy endpoints from the randomized, registrational, phase 2 ChonDRAgon study.

data.clinical_result_summary: SL105, an autologous dual-epitope nanobody CD5 CAR-T therapy, demonstrated a favorable safety profile and encouraging efficacy in patients with relapsed or refractory T-ALL/PTCL. The recommended phase 2 dose was established, supporting further evaluation in an ongoing phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of pembrolizumab and cytotoxic chemotherapy did not substantially change antitumor control activity relative to historical controls in patients with advanced salivary or thyroid cancers. patients with advanced salivary gland

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world cohort, toxicities persisting beyond two weeks after lifileucel were largely driven by lymphodepleting chemotherapy-associated immunosuppression and cytopenias. These findings highlight the importance of structured post-discharge monitoring and support ongoing efforts to de-intensify lymphodepleting chemotherapy to improve safety while maintaining clinical benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced melanoma treated with lifileucel were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world safety of adoptive cellular therapy with lifileucel in patients with advanced melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with STC-15 offers a new paradigm for the treatment of a broad range of sarcomas by halting the cell differentiation process from mesenchymal progenitors. Early biomarker data provide proof of mechanism in target engagement and changes in gene expression, consistent with pharmacological activity and clinical response. Further investigation of efficacy and biomarkers of STC-15 in a Phase 2 sarcoma study is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A subset analysis of clinical activity and pharmacodynamic biomarkers in patients with sarcomas in the phase 1 dose-escalation study of STC-15, a METTL3 inhibitor.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of mesutoclax and azacitidine demonstrated a favorable safety profile and encouraging anti-tumor activity in patients with acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndromes. These preliminary results support continued development for the treatment of myeloid malignancies and warrant further investigation in larger, randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndromes
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, tolerability, and efficacy of mesutoclax (ICP-248) in combination with azacitidine in patients with myeloid malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: CT-derived muscle quality, but not muscle quantity, independently predicts overall survival in non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. However, muscle status does not appear to influence androgen receptor signaling inhibitor treatment response or safety.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer treated with androgen receptor signaling inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prognostic significance of muscle quantity and quality for overall survival in non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this phase III randomized controlled trial, ramelteon did not reduce the incidence of postoperative delirium in older adults undergoing major cancer surgery. These findings do not support routine pharmacological prevention with ramelteon in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: cancer patients aged ≥65 years undergoing surgery under general anesthesia
clinical_result_layer_factor: age ≥75 years, surgical duration ≥6 h, benzodiazepine use, and study site
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Ramelteon for prevention of postoperative delirium in elderly cancer patients: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled multicenter trial, JORTC-PON02/J-SUPPORT2103/NCCH2103.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this phase 3 study, adjuvant cemiplimab demonstrated a disease-free survival benefit versus placebo across all high-risk features in patients with high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma after surgery and radiotherapy. The benefit was observed regardless of the interval between prior radiotherapy completion and randomization.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma after surgery and radiotherapy were included; all patients had nodal high-risk disease with extracapsular extension and at least 1 node of at least 20 mm or at least 3 nodes regardless of extracapsular extension, and/or non-nodal high-risk disease including in-transit metastases, perineural invasion, T4 lesions, or recurrent cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma with at least 1 other feature, with randomization occurring within 2-11 weeks after completion of radiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: C-POST study of adjuvant cemiplimab for high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC): Disease-free survival (DFS) analyses per high-risk criteria and per start time after radiotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ivonescimab combined with gemcitabine/cisplatin chemotherapy and stereotactic body radiotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced biliary tract cancer demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile. This combination regimen may represent a promising new treatment option for patients with advanced biliary tract cancer and warrants further validation in larger studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Ivonescimab plus gemcitabine/cisplatin and stereotactic body radiotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced biliary tract cancer: A single-arm, open-label, phase II exploratory study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose nivolumab demonstrated biological activity, with both anti-tumor responses and toxicities, in patients at high risk of immune-related adverse events. Compared with standard-dose immune checkpoint inhibitors, low-dose nivolumab may offer an advantage in toxicity management and could enable more consistent treatment delivery with fewer interruptions and reduced need for immunosuppressive interventions. Further evaluation in prospective clinical trials is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced skin cancers who received low-dose nivolumab 40 mg due to a high risk of immune-related adverse events, including patients with a previous history of immune-related adverse events from standard-dose immune checkpoint inhibitors and ICI-naïve patients with pre-existing autoimmune diseases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low‑dose nivolumab in patients at high risk of immune‑related adverse events: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this limited case series of patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2/neu-positive metastatic breast cancer, fulvestrant, abemaciclib, and trastuzumab were associated with systemic control after multiple prior lines of treatment. Prolonged CNS benefit was reported in two patients with CNS metastases, including stabilization for 20 months in one patient and 31 months of CNS free progression in another.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The case series included six patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2/neu-positive metastatic breast cancer, including two patients with CNS involvement.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Late line treatment in hormone receptor positive, her 2 neu positive metastatic breast cancer with fulvestrant, abemaciclib, and trastuzumab, including prolonged CNS control.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this phase 3, randomized, open-label trial, adagloxad simolenin/OBI-821 was well tolerated, with a safety profile similar to standard of care. However, invasive disease-free survival and overall survival were similar between the two arms, and the trial was terminated for futility.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk early-stage triple-negative breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 3 trial of adagloxad simolenin/OBI-821 in patients with high-risk early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up, palbociclib plus tamoxifen with or without goserelin provided durable progression-free survival benefit and a favorable overall survival trend with manageable safety. These findings support this regimen as an effective option regardless of menopausal status.
clinical_result_indication_detail: women with hormone receptor-positive (HR+)/HER2-negative (HER2−) advanced breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: line of therapy and menopausal status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Palbociclib plus tamoxifen ± goserelin in women with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer (BC): PATHWAY, an Asian international double-blind randomized phase 3 trial—Final overall survival (OS) analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this limited case series of patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2/neu-positive metastatic breast cancer, fulvestrant, abemaciclib, and trastuzumab were associated with systemic control after multiple prior lines of treatment. Prolonged CNS benefit was reported in two patients with CNS metastases, including stabilization for 20 months in one patient and 31 months of CNS free progression in another.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The case series included six patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2/neu-positive metastatic breast cancer, including two patients with CNS involvement.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Late line treatment in hormone receptor positive, her 2 neu positive metastatic breast cancer with fulvestrant, abemaciclib, and trastuzumab, including prolonged CNS control.

data.clinical_result_summary: High-dose chemotherapy with the ICE regimen followed by autologous stem cell transplantation was feasible in adults with relapsed or refractory medulloblastoma, with encouraging survival and manageable toxicity. Pretransplant intracranial residual disease clearance and achievement of complete response were major prognostic determinants, while non-complete response patients remained at high risk and may need treatment intensification.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory medulloblastoma who underwent high-dose chemotherapy with the ICE regimen followed by autologous stem cell transplantation were retrospectively analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of high-dose chemotherapy in adult patients with relapsed or refractory medulloblastoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this limited case series of patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2/neu-positive metastatic breast cancer, fulvestrant, abemaciclib, and trastuzumab were associated with systemic control after multiple prior lines of treatment. Prolonged CNS benefit was reported in two patients with CNS metastases, including stabilization for 20 months in one patient and 31 months of CNS free progression in another.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The case series included six patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2/neu-positive metastatic breast cancer, including two patients with CNS involvement.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Late line treatment in hormone receptor positive, her 2 neu positive metastatic breast cancer with fulvestrant, abemaciclib, and trastuzumab, including prolonged CNS control.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of extensive-stage small cell lung cancer with advanced metastatic disease, including brain metastases, first-line platinum–etoposide plus durvalumab was associated with markedly improved overall survival compared with platinum–etoposide alone. These findings support the effectiveness of durvalumab-based chemo-immunotherapy in routine clinical practice among high-risk extensive-stage small cell lung cancer populations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with documented extensive-stage small cell lung cancer and metastatic disease, including brain and extracranial metastases, who initiated first-line platinum–etoposide chemotherapy between March 2018 and January 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes with first-line platinum–etoposide plus durvalumab versus platinum–etoposide alone in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer with metastatic disease including brain metastases: A real world analysis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 无症状性骨事件发生存活率
data.clinical_result_summary: Radium-223 did not improve the primary endpoint of symptomatic skeletal event-free survival when added to cabozantinib in patients with renal cell carcinoma and bone metastases. The combination was safe, and a numerical prolongation in overall survival was observed, but alternative radiotherapeutics warrant investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma with osseous metastases
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 无症状性骨事件发生存活率
clinical_result_layer_factor: osteoclast-targeted therapy (OTT), prior therapy, baseline opioid use, and IMDC risk
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 randomized trial of radium-223 dichloride and cabozantinib in patients (pts) with renal cell carcinoma (RCC) with bone metastases (BM): RADICAL (Alliance A031801).

data.clinical_result_summary: Intraperitoneal intratumoral LPS delivery in peritoneal metastases was safe and biologically active. It induced reproducible innate-dominant immune and metabolic remodeling, supporting regional TLR4 agonism as a feasible strategy for peritoneal malignancies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with peritoneal metastases from gastrointestinal malignancies undergoing diagnostic laparoscopy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I window-of-opportunity trial of intraperitoneal, intratumoral lipopolysaccharide in peritoneal metastases: Safety and immune remodeling from the RIOT-1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This diverse real-world cohort of newly diagnosed patients with CML-CP treated with first-line asciminib demonstrated efficacy outcomes, including deep molecular responses, and discontinuation rates consistent with ASC4FIRST. The findings support asciminib’s favorable risk-benefit profile and its role as a standard of care in first-line CML management in US clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult, newly diagnosed patients with chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase without T315I mutation who initiated asciminib as first-line treatment in US clinical practice.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Asciminib in newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosom–positive chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase (Ph+ CML-CP): A retrospective chart review study in the US.

data.clinical_result_summary: Mirvetuximab soravtansine demonstrated manageable safety and progression-free survival outcomes consistent with those reported in clinical trials in folate receptor alpha-positive platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. High FRα expression (3+) correlated with improved clinical outcomes, and the association of the most severe treatment-related toxicity with exceptional response suggests a potential association between higher-grade adverse events and therapeutic benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Seventeen folate receptor alpha-positive platinum-resistant ovarian cancer patients treated with mirvetuximab soravtansine at the University Hospital of Florence were retrospectively analyzed, with FOLR1 positivity defined as at least 75% of viable tumor cells showing moderate (2+) or strong (3+) membrane staining.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: From trials to the clinic: Real-world experience with mirvetuximab soravtansine in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer and the "Lazarus effect.

data.clinical_result_summary: SYS6043 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and robust, cross-tumor antitumor activity in a large population of patients with advanced solid tumors. The magnitude and consistency of responses across multiple histologies, including treatment-refractory tumors such as small cell lung cancer, support SYS6043 as a promising therapeutic candidate warranting further clinical and translational investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients (18–75 years) had advanced solid tumors refractory to or progressing after standard therapies - OC
patients (18–75 years) had advanced solid tumors refractory to or progressing after standard therapies - CC
patients (18–75 years) had advanced solid tumors refractory to or progressing after standard therapies - BC
patients (18–75 years) had advanced solid tumors refractory to or progressing after standard therapies - EC
patients (18–75 years) had advanced solid tumors refractory to or progressing after standard therapies - nsq-NSCLC
patients (18–75 years) had advanced solid tumors refractory to or progressing after standard therapies - SCLC
patients (18–75 years) had advanced solid tumors refractory to or progressing after standard therapies - NPC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of SYS6043, a novel B7-H3–targeting antibody-drug conjugate, in patients with advanced pan-tumor malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients with colorectal cancer, concomitant GLP-1 receptor agonist use was associated with improved overall survival and reduced chemotherapy-related toxicity. These findings suggest a potential adjunctive therapeutic role for GLP-1 RAs during active cancer treatment, and prospective studies are warranted to confirm these observations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with colorectal cancer receiving standard first-line chemotherapy, specifically those initiating first-line FOLFOX or FOLFIRI between 2015 and 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of concomitant GLP-1 receptor agonist use on overall survival and chemotherapy-related adverse events in colorectal cancer: A real-world pharmacoepidemiologic cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study did not meet the predetermined threshold for efficacy for Stratum 1. Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy could warrant further exploration in poorly differentiated chordoma.
clinical_result_indication_name: 非典型畸胎横纹肌样瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients 6 months to 40 years with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers - extracranial solid tumors (Stratum 1)
patients 6 months to 40 years with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers - CNS tumors (Stratum 2)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Results of a phase II trial of nivolumab and ipilimumab in children and young adults with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic vedolizumab can facilitate successful, long-term immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment in high-risk patients with prior immune checkpoint inhibitor colitis or inflammatory bowel disease. It mitigated gastrointestinal symptoms, reduced corticosteroid usage, and preserved anti-tumor responses.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced skin cancers who were deemed high-risk due to prior severe immune checkpoint inhibitor colitis or inflammatory bowel disease received vedolizumab prophylaxis prior to immune checkpoint inhibitor retreatment or treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prophylactic vedolizumab to facilitate use of immune-checkpoint inhibitors in cancer patients at high risk of immune-mediated colitis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sacituzumab govitecan with adaptive radiation therapy is feasible and safe in localized muscle invasive bladder cancer. Efficacy and correlative analyses are ongoing, and this is reported as the first study to combine an antibody drug conjugate with radiation therapy in bladder cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with muscle invasive bladder cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RAD-SG: Adaptive radiation therapy with concurrent sacituzumab govitecan for bladder preservation in patients (pts) with muscle invasive bladder cancer (MIBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The study did not meet the predetermined threshold for efficacy for Stratum 1. Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy could warrant further exploration in poorly differentiated chordoma.
clinical_result_indication_name: 非典型畸胎横纹肌样瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients 6 months to 40 years with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers - extracranial solid tumors (Stratum 1)
patients 6 months to 40 years with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers - CNS tumors (Stratum 2)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Results of a phase II trial of nivolumab and ipilimumab in children and young adults with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: In US veterans with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, olaparib was associated with favorable outcomes in routine practice despite older age and frequent late-line use. The findings support its effectiveness in a more diverse real-world population than those represented in clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: US veterans with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who received olaparib between May 2020 and December 2023 in the Veteran’s Health Administration.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world use of olaparib in US veterans with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: Treatment patterns and outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: Darlifarnib 3 and 5 mg plus adagrasib were well tolerated and showed encouraging antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and colorectal cancer. These preliminary data support further investigation of darlifarnib plus KRAS inhibitors, such as adagrasib, to address mTORC1-mediated resistance and potentially improve clinical outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, or colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Farnesyl transferase inhibitor (FTI) darlifarnib (KO-2806) in combination with adagrasib in KRAS G12C mutated (mut) advanced solid tumors: Preliminary results from the FIT-001 phase 1 first-in-human trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: DM002 was safe and tolerable up to the 4.5 mg/kg dose level. In pancreatic cancer, prostate cancer, and ovarian cancer, DM002 demonstrated encouraging efficacy with a manageable safety profile. The putative recommended doses for expansion are 3.0 and 3.5 mg/kg and will be further evaluated in phase II trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of DM002, an anti-MUC1/HER3 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Radium-223 in biochemically recurrent prostate cancer was safe and associated with minimal grade 1/2 toxicities. Decreases in SUVmax on most NaF scans, improvements in PSMA imaging, and delayed but confirmed PSA declines in 33% of patients suggest that Radium-223 monotherapy may have therapeutic activity in biochemically recurrent prostate cancer with PET-positive bone findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients (Pts) with biochemically recurrent prostate cancer (BCR) and PET findings in the bones
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Radium-223 without androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) in patients (Pts) with biochemically recurrent prostate cancer (BCR) and PET findings in the bones.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world large database analysis, tarlatamab demonstrated clinically meaningful overall survival and a manageable toxicity profile in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. These findings support the clinical effectiveness of tarlatamab outside of trial settings, although longer-term follow-up is needed to assess durability of survival and late toxicities.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with small cell lung cancer, including extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, who were treated with tarlatamab were identified.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world survival and safety outcomes of tarlatamab in patients with extensive stage small cell lung cancer.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral IP-001 at a dose of 4 mL following thermal ablation was well tolerated, with mainly mild, transient immune-related events. Although the pre-specified activity endpoint was not met, the observed disease control rate and progression-free survival support further evaluation of this novel immuno-oncologic strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced melanoma and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intratumoral injection of IP-001 following thermal ablation in patients with advanced solid tumors: A multicenter phase Ib/IIa trial with expansion cohorts in melanoma and soft tissue sarcoma patients (SAKK 66/17).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor users had modestly higher rates of osteopenia and osteoporosis compared with steroidal aromatase inhibitor users, while time-to-event differences were minimal. Pathological fractures were slightly less frequent among non-steroidal users, and the authors noted that this paradoxical fracture result should be interpreted cautiously because of possible confounding.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included breast cancer patients initiating non-steroidal aromatase inhibitors (anastrozole/exemestane) versus steroidal aromatase inhibitors (letrozole/fadrozole), with index events defined by aromatase inhibitor initiation after cancer diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative risk of osteopenia, osteoporosis, and pathological fractures in breast cancer patients treated with steroidal versus non-steroidal aromatase inhibitors: A large-scale real-world data analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant apatinib plus camrelizumab demonstrated promising antitumor activity and acceptable safety in patients with renal cell carcinoma and inferior vena cava tumor thrombus. The regimen achieved meaningful tumor thrombus response and Mayo level downgrading, thereby facilitating surgical resection and supporting further investigation in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed, resectable renal cell carcinoma with inferior vena cava tumor thrombus
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant apatinib plus camrelizumab in renal cell carcinoma with inferior vena cava tumor thrombus: Results of a phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Zelenectide pevedotin monotherapy at 5 mg/m2 once weekly continued to demonstrate an encouraging efficacy profile and a promising safety profile in enfortumab vedotin-naïve patients with metastatic urothelial carcinoma. Antitumor activity was preserved in patients with exposure to taxanes, and treatment withdrawal due to zelenectide pevedotin-related adverse events of clinical interest was uncommon.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients had previously treated unresectable mUC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zelenectide pevedotin (BT8009) monotherapy in previously treated metastatic urothelial carcinoma (mUC): Update on Duravelo-1.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: SHR-A1904 showed tolerable safety and promising antitumor activity in pretreated patients with CLDN18.2-expressing advanced solid tumors. Exploratory subgroup analyses by race support global development of SHR-A1904 in both Asians and non-Asians.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with CLDN18.2-expressing advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A global phase 1/2a trial of SHR-A1904, a CLDN18.2-targeting ADC, in advanced solid tumors expressing CLDN18.2.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma and concomitant HIV or viral hepatitis treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors did not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in overall survival or healthcare utilization compared with matched patients without viral infection. These findings suggest that chronic viral infections should not necessarily preclude the use of immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with solid tumors, although prospective studies are warranted to further characterize safety and efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, including pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, atezolizumab, or durvalumab, were studied, comparing patients with documented HIV and/or viral hepatitis with patients without viral infection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in patients with advanced cancer and chronic viral infections: Real-world clinical experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Exploratory analyses from JAVELIN Bladder 100 showed that patients with low NECTIN4 and low or high HER2 RNA expression had pronounced overall survival with avelumab first-line maintenance versus best supportive care alone. The results are hypothesis-generating.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma without progression after 4-6 cycles of first-line platinum-based chemotherapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes with first-line (1L) platinum-based chemotherapy (PBC) and avelumab 1L maintenance in locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma (la/mUC) by NECTIN4 and HER2 RNA expression: Exploratory analyses from JAVELIN Bladder 100.

data.clinical_result_summary: Primary prophylaxis with empegfilgrastim during DCF induction chemotherapy was associated with a relatively low incidence of grade 3-4 neutropenia and febrile neutropenia in patients with advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, while allowing most patients to complete planned treatment. Further analyses are planned to compare empegfilgrastim administration on day 2 versus day 3 of the DCF regimen.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with unresectable stage III/IVA hypopharyngeal, laryngeal, or oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Empegfilgrastim for primary febrile neutropenia prophylaxis during induction chemotherapy with docetaxel, cisplatin, and 5-fluorouracil in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: ODM-212 administration to extensively treated patients with advanced cancer was well tolerated and resulted in some promising tumor responses, particularly in mesothelioma and epithelioid hemangioendothelioma. The phase 2 portion of TEADES is currently enrolling patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with various types of advanced, metastatic solid tumors where the Hippo pathway is implicated, with or without relevant genetic alterations
patients with mesothelioma
patients with epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human trial of the TEAD inhibitor ODM-212 in patients with advanced solid tumors (TEADES).

data.clinical_result_summary: In a heavily pre-treated, platinum-resistant ovarian cancer population, the combination of pembrolizumab, bevacizumab, and oral cyclophosphamide demonstrated clinically meaningful activity with manageable toxicity. These real-world findings support further exploration of immunotherapy-based combinations in ovarian cancer, particularly in settings where treatment options remain limited.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with recurrent, platinum-resistant, heavily pre-treated epithelial ovarian cancer who received pembrolizumab in combination with bevacizumab and oral cyclophosphamide at the Oncology Unit of Alexandra University Hospital from January 2021 onward.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pembrolizumab in combination with bevacizumab and oral cyclophosphamide in recurrent platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This case series highlights the limited evidence supporting imiquimod as an effective adjunct therapy for vulvar melanoma. Although there was a trend toward delayed regional progression, differences were not statistically significant, and side effects raise concerns about patient quality of life. The findings underscore the need for more effective and tolerable strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients had confirmed vulvar melanoma and were treated with imiquimod.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of imiquimod treatment outcomes in vulvar melanoma.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 无影像学疾病进展生存期（rPFS）
data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer and cardiometabolic comorbidities, enzalutamide remained efficacious and tolerable. No new safety signals were identified, and the findings support enzalutamide as a front-line option in these subgroups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer and cardiometabolic comorbidities and/or related concomitant medications, including a full CMD group with CMDs or concomitant CMD medications and a confirmed CMD group with CMD-related medications plus a confirmed CMD diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of enzalutamide (ENZA) in patients (pts) with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC) and cardiometabolic comorbidities (CMDs) and/or related concomitant medications (meds): ARCHES post hoc.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 完全缓解或更佳完全缓解
data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma, single-agent elranatamab was highly active, with a 92% objective response rate and 45% of patients achieving complete response or better. The safety profile was favorable, supporting further investigation of elranatamab as a therapeutic option for high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 完全缓解或更佳完全缓解
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of elranatamab as early intervention in patients with high-risk smoldering myeloma: First results from the phase 2 ERASMM (EMN34) study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This retrospective study demonstrates that the CAST regimen is effective in reducing the development of grades 2-4 acute GVHD after mismatch-unrelated donor peripheral blood allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients who underwent mismatch-unrelated donor allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant for graft-versus-host disease prophylaxis were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PTCy, abatacept, and short course of tacrolimus (CAST) therapy in GVHD prevention in mismatch-unrelated donors.

clinical_result_biomarker_cn: 微卫星稳定/无错配修复缺陷
data.clinical_result_summary: CTLA-4/PD-1 immunochemotherapy induced deep and durable responses in microsatellite-stable/proficient mismatch repair metastatic colorectal cancer. An early on-treatment plasma proteomic signature, the Inflammatory Niche Index, powerfully identified patients destined for durable benefit, offering a tool for ultra-early, biology-guided patient selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had microsatellite-stable/proficient mismatch repair (MSS/pMMR) metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An early on-treatment "coordinated inflammatory niche" plasma signature as a predictor of response in the SYLT026 trial: Cadonilimab combined with FOLFIRINOX and bevacizumab as first-line treatment for microsatellite-stable/proficient mismatch repair (MSS/pMMR) metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Long-term follow-up of high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma patients treated with vididencel confirmed safety, tolerability, and feasibility, with strong T-cell responses against tumor-associated antigens. Improved tumor-directed responses were associated with better progression-free survival, supporting vididencel as a safe immunotherapy and a basis for novel combination treatments for ovarian cancer patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma post-primary treatment were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Vididencel, an active immunotherapy in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma patients: Analysis of tumor-directed immune responses post-primary treatment.

data.clinical_result_summary: Triplet therapy with azacitidine, venetoclax, and ivosidenib demonstrated high measurable residual disease-negative response rates, durable remissions, and safety comparable to doublet regimens in patients with newly diagnosed IDH1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia in this multicenter study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed IDH1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter phase Ib/II trial of azacitidine, venetoclax, and ivosidenib in IDH1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

data.clinical_result_summary: In elderly RCC patients previously treated with ICI/VEGF therapy, cabozantinib and belzutifan were associated with similar overall survival and rates of serious adverse outcomes. Cabozantinib was linked to fewer early hospitalizations but a higher incidence of gastrointestinal toxicity, reflecting efficacy-tolerability trade-offs to individualize care in older adults.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included RCC patients aged ≥60 years who were initially treated with pembrolizumab/axitinib and subsequently treated with either cabozantinib or belzutifan ≥1 month later; patients with von Hippel-Lindau syndrome were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Balancing effectiveness and toxicity: Cabozantinib versus belzutifan after ICI/VEGF therapy in older adults with renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the first international, randomized, placebo-controlled trial in adults with NF1-PN, selumetinib achieved a sustained and durable, clinically meaningful reduction in plexiform neurofibroma volume per independent central review REiNS. No new safety concerns were identified, and adverse events were manageable.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with NF1 who have symptomatic, inoperable PNs
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final analysis of KOMET (NCT04924608), a phase 3 study of selumetinib in adults with NF1-PN.

data.clinical_result_summary: ODM-212 administration to extensively treated patients with advanced cancer was well tolerated and resulted in some promising tumor responses, particularly in mesothelioma and epithelioid hemangioendothelioma. The phase 2 portion of TEADES is currently enrolling patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with various types of advanced, metastatic solid tumors where the Hippo pathway is implicated, with or without relevant genetic alterations
patients with mesothelioma
patients with epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human trial of the TEAD inhibitor ODM-212 in patients with advanced solid tumors (TEADES).

data.clinical_result_summary: With extended follow-up, disitamab vedotin plus toripalimab and trastuzumab demonstrated sustained and clinically meaningful efficacy as a first-line treatment for HER2-high locally advanced or metastatic gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer. Disitamab vedotin plus toripalimab and dose-reduced CAPOX also showed sustained, clinically meaningful efficacy in HER2-intermediate/low disease, with no new safety signals; phase 3 confirmation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-expressing locally advanced or metastatic gastric cancer
patients with HER2-low locally advanced or metastatic gastric cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Disitamab vedotin (DV) plus toripalimab (Tor) and chemotherapy (Chemo)/trastuzumab (Tra) for first-line (1L) HER2-expressing locally advanced or metastatic (la/m) gastric cancer (GC): Updated results from the RC48-C027 trial.

patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic cancer - breast cancer

data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1b/2 study of JK06, a 5T4-targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: NbCD5 CAR-T cells demonstrated preliminary antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with refractory or relapsed T-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, with a day-30 objective response rate of 66.7%. Cytokine release syndrome was limited to grade 1-2 and no ICANS was reported, although EBV reactivation, including grade 3-5 events, warrants attention; longer follow-up is required.
clinical_result_indication_name: T细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: T lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma
pts with T-cell non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human novel bispecific epitope anti-CD5 nanobody CAR-T cells for refractory or relapsed T-cell malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: Culmerciclib combined with fulvestrant demonstrated promising antitumor activity in HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer after progression on previous CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy. The combination offered a potential targeted therapeutic strategy for this population, with no new safety signals observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: female pts with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer following disease progression on prior CDK4/6i + ET
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Culmerciclib (CDK2/4/6 inhibitor) plus fulvestrant in HR+/HER2− advanced breast cancer after progression on CDK4/6i: Preliminary results from a phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the CLOVER trial, leronlimab in combination with TAS-102 plus bevacizumab has been well tolerated, with no leronlimab-related dose-limiting toxicities. Rapid declines in ctDNA have been observed along with stable objective responses, and increases in PD-L1 on circulating tumor cells and/or cancer-associated macrophage-like cells support further investigation of immune checkpoint inhibitor strategies for patients who progress.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with refractory metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Leronlimab in combination with trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102) plus bevacizumab for patients with refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): The phase 2 CLOVER study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The 4P regimen, with high efficacy and manageable toxicity, achieved a 93.9% bladder preservation rate in patients undergoing TUPRBT. By retaining bladder function and reducing surgical morbidity, it is an attractive choice for bladder preservation and neoadjuvant optimization in high-risk non-muscle-invasive and muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with cT1-4N0M0 high-risk non-muscle-invasive or muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant PD-1 inhibitor plus paclitaxel, pingyangmycin, and platinum-based chemotherapy (4P therapy) as a bladder-sparing strategy for high-risk non–muscle-invasive/muscle-invasive bladder cancer: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This retrospective study demonstrates that the CAST regimen is effective in reducing the development of grades 2-4 acute GVHD after mismatch-unrelated donor peripheral blood allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients who underwent mismatch-unrelated donor allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant for graft-versus-host disease prophylaxis were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PTCy, abatacept, and short course of tacrolimus (CAST) therapy in GVHD prevention in mismatch-unrelated donors.

patients 6 months to 40 years with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers - CNS tumors (Stratum 2)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Results of a phase II trial of nivolumab and ipilimumab in children and young adults with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: 3HP-2827 was safe and tolerable, with encouraging anti-tumor activity observed in patients with FGFR2 alterations. Further clinical efficacy will be explored in the expansion stage and phase II stage.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with cholangiocarcinoma harboring FGFR2 alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I/II study of a highly selective FGFR2 inhibitor 3HP-2827 in patients with advanced solid tumors harboring FGFR2 alterations.

Disitamab vedotin plus toripalimab and dose-reduced CAPOX also showed sustained, clinically meaningful efficacy in HER2-intermediate/low disease, with no new safety signals; phase 3 confirmation is warranted.

data.clinical_result_summary: These results support the effectiveness of primary prophylaxis with empegfilgrastim in routine practice for elderly patients.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 65 years or older with cancer receiving chemotherapy and primary febrile neutropenia prophylaxis with prolonged G-CSF empegfilgrastim.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Febrile neutropenia prophylaxis with prolonged G-CSF in elderly cancer patients: Analysis from the EMPREREAL study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Data indicate promising safety, tolerability, and anti-tumor activity of MDX-124 in patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid malignancies. The recommended phase 2 dose for MDX-124 monotherapy was determined to be 20 mg/kg every 2 weeks, and Module 2 is currently enrolling.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid malignancies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: MDX-124, a first-in-class annexin-A1 targeting antibody, in patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid malignancies: Data supporting RP2D from the dose escalation stage of a first-in-human phase Ib trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Bispecific antibody therapy was associated with a diverse spectrum of cardiovascular toxicities, particularly dyspnea, elevated BNP, and cardiopulmonary compromise. Arrhythmias and troponin-defined myocardial injury were less frequent but clinically relevant, supporting active cardiovascular surveillance during bispecific antibody treatment, particularly in patients with underlying cardiovascular disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 49 adults who received outpatient bispecific antibody therapy for hematologic malignancies at the Stephenson Cancer Center between July 2023 and March 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of cardiovascular toxicities with bispecific antibody therapy in patients with hematologic malignancies: A single-center retrospective analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Combining VEGF and PD-1 inhibition showed favorable activity in unselected undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma compared with available evidence for each treatment as monotherapy. No new emerging toxicity was observed with the combination, and correlative immune biomarker studies are ongoing to identify biomarkers of response and resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PEMBROCABOSARC: A phase II trial combining pembrolizumab and cabozantinib in patients with advanced undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world study, the HP and HPy regimens achieved comparable pathologic complete response rates as neoadjuvant therapy for early HER2-positive breast cancer. Treatment choice can be individualized based on distinct toxicity profiles, with HPy associated more with diarrhea and HP with vomiting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with stage II-III HER2-positive breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative efficacy and safety of anti-HER2 neoadjuvant therapy in early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer: A real-world multicenter analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Add-on beta-sitosterol was safe and improved urinary symptoms but did not significantly reduce PSA levels. Larger trials are required to confirm efficacy and validate ceramide as a prognostic biomarker.
clinical_result_indication_detail: men with biopsy-proven metastatic prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot study of add-on beta-sitosterol supplementation on treatment response in metastatic prostate cancer patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: In high-risk patients with breast cancer and gastric cancer receiving anthracycline- and trastuzumab-containing therapy, primary cardioprotective therapy with perindopril, bisoprolol, and trimetazidine effectively prevented adverse cardiac remodeling, preserved myocardial systolic function, reduced cardiovascular complications, and was associated with lower one-year all-cause mortality.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high or very high risk of cardiotoxicity according to the Mayo Clinic risk score who were undergoing anthracycline- and/or trastuzumab-containing treatment, including patients with breast cancer and gastric cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of primary cardioprotection with perindopril, bisoprolol, and trimetazidine in high-risk patients with breast and gastric cancer receiving anthracycline- and trastuzumab-containing therapy.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral IP-001 at a dose of 4 mL following thermal ablation was well tolerated, with mainly mild, transient immune-related events. Although the pre-specified activity endpoint was not met, the observed disease control rate and progression-free survival support further evaluation of this novel immuno-oncologic strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced melanoma and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intratumoral injection of IP-001 following thermal ablation in patients with advanced solid tumors: A multicenter phase Ib/IIa trial with expansion cohorts in melanoma and soft tissue sarcoma patients (SAKK 66/17).

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan at 2.7 mg/kg every 3 weeks was reported to be as efficacious as the standard dose, including for central nervous system response rate. Treatment was well tolerated, and large randomized prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included north Indian women with stage 4 various cancers who received at least 1 dose of trastuzumab deruxtecan, including patients with brain metastases before trastuzumab deruxtecan initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose vs. standard-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan in north Indian patients: Balancing efficacy, toxicity, and cost.

data.clinical_result_summary: In high-risk patients with breast cancer and gastric cancer receiving anthracycline- and trastuzumab-containing therapy, primary cardioprotective therapy with perindopril, bisoprolol, and trimetazidine effectively prevented adverse cardiac remodeling, preserved myocardial systolic function, reduced cardiovascular complications, and was associated with lower one-year all-cause mortality.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high or very high risk of cardiotoxicity according to the Mayo Clinic risk score who were undergoing anthracycline- and/or trastuzumab-containing treatment, including patients with breast cancer and gastric cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of primary cardioprotection with perindopril, bisoprolol, and trimetazidine in high-risk patients with breast and gastric cancer receiving anthracycline- and trastuzumab-containing therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Darolutamide, particularly in doublet therapy, was associated with lower MACE risk than abiraterone in real-world patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer. A similar point estimate in triplet therapy warrants validation in larger cohorts, and these findings may inform treatment selection or prophylactic management to improve cardiovascular outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included real-world patients in the nationwide VA healthcare system initiating doublet or triplet abiraterone or darolutamide for newly diagnosed metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Major adverse cardiovascular events in androgen receptor signaling inhibitor–treated patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: YL205 demonstrated a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated ovarian cancer patients, with preliminary efficacy observed irrespective of NaPi2b expression intensity. The promising clinical data support further investigation of this antibody-drug conjugate in ovarian cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with heavily pretreated ovarian cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: YL205, a novel anti-Napi2b antibody drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with ovarian cancer: Preliminary result from a first-in-human trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This KRAS G12V/HLA-A*11:01-restricted TCR-T therapy demonstrated a favorable safety profile and encouraging preliminary antitumor activity in advanced solid tumors. A high response rate was observed in heavily pretreated pancreatic cancer patients, supporting further clinical development of this novel cellular therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 trial of a KRAS G12V/HLA-A*11:01–restricted TCR-engineered T-cell therapy in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan at 2.7 mg/kg every 3 weeks was reported to be as efficacious as the standard dose, including for central nervous system response rate. Treatment was well tolerated, and large randomized prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included north Indian women with stage 4 various cancers who received at least 1 dose of trastuzumab deruxtecan, including patients with brain metastases before trastuzumab deruxtecan initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose vs. standard-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan in north Indian patients: Balancing efficacy, toxicity, and cost.

data.clinical_result_summary: Anselamimab added to standard anti-plasma cell dyscrasia therapy did not significantly improve the primary hierarchical endpoint in the overall population. Prespecified analyses showed significant reductions in all-cause mortality and cardiovascular hospitalization among patients with κ involved free light chain, with safety comparable to placebo.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage IIIa/IIIb  light chain (AL) amyloidosis
patients with kappa predominant light chain isotype
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 3 randomized trial to evaluate the impact of anselamimab on all-cause mortality in κ light-chain amyloidosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Aderbrelimab and lenvatinib combined with gemcitabine and cisplatin showed promising efficacy with reasonable tolerability in advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. Survival data are still immature and will be updated in the future.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable and advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Combined therapy using gemcitabine and cisplatin chemotherapy, lenvatinib, and adebrelimab for patients with advanced and unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: A prospective, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, baseline SSRI use was not associated with improved overall survival, reduced discontinuation, or increased steroid use among metastatic melanoma patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors. Despite strong mechanistic rationale suggesting potential synergy, these findings highlight a disconnect between preclinical observations and real-world outcomes, and prospective studies are needed to identify subpopulations that may benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with metastatic melanoma treated with first-line pembrolizumab, nivolumab, or ipilimumab, including metastatic melanoma patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association between selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor use and outcomes in metastatic melanoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: A real-world cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Dose-dense mini hyper-CVD combined with inotuzumab ozogamicin and blinatumomab induced high rates of deep next-generation sequencing measurable residual disease-negative remission in patients with relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. This approach allowed consolidative strategies, including CAR T-cell therapy, and led to favorable survival outcomes at nearly 3 years of follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults (>18 years) with R/R Philadelphia (Ph) positive (+) or negative (-) B-ALL
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The impact of MRD and post-remission strategies on outcomes following dose-dense mini-hyper-CVD inotuzumab and blinatumomab in relapsed B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
