data.clinical_result_summary: This ongoing first-in-human, open-label, multicenter Phase 1/2 study is evaluating mRNA-2808 in participants with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Dose Levels 1 and 2 have been completed without dose-limiting toxicity, and dose escalation is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of mRNA-2808 in participants with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Silevertinib demonstrated robust antitumor activity in treatment-naïve patients with a broad spectrum of non-classical EGFR driver mutations, with high intracranial activity in patients with brain metastases. The safety profile was consistent with the known adverse events of the EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor class.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts with advanced EGFR NCM NSCLC who received no prior systemic therapy were enrolled (Cohort 3)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy results of the phase 2 study of silevertinib (BDTX-1535) in treatment-naïve patients with non-small cell lung cancer with non-classical EGFR mutations.

data.clinical_result_summary: KC1036 demonstrated promising antitumor efficacy in patients with advanced or recurrent thymoma or thymic carcinoma. KC1036 also exhibited a favorable safety profile and tolerability, supporting further evaluation in a forthcoming phase III trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced or recurrent thymoma or thymic carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of second or further line KC1036 in patients with thymoma and thymic carcinoma: A multicenter, single-arm phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intraperitoneal M701 was well tolerated when combined with systemic therapy. In patients with epithelial cancer-associated malignant ascites, M701 significantly prolonged puncture-free survival with comparable overall survival, supporting further clinical development and its potential therapeutic role in the management of malignant ascites.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients With Malignant Ascites Caused by Advanced Epithelial Solid Tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 3, multicenter, randomized, controlled open-label study: Efficacy and safety of M701 (EpCAM×CD3 bispecific antibody) intraperitoneal infusion in advanced epithelial solid tumor with malignant ascites vs paracentesis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Combined KIT inhibition with bezuclastinib plus sunitinib significantly improved median progression-free survival versus sunitinib monotherapy, reducing the risk of progression or death by 50% and increasing objective response rate from 26% to 46%. The combination was well tolerated with no new safety findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with imatinib-resistant or intolerant GIST
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Primary results of the phase 3 peak study of bezuclastinib + sunitinib vs sunitinib monotherapy in advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST).

data.clinical_result_summary: The TorHAIC regimen showed a favorable safety and efficacy profile in patients with non-high-risk, locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. The findings warrant validation in a phase III trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with non-high-risk, locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy plus either toripalimab or sorafenib as first-line therapy for non–high-risk, locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma: A non-comparative, randomized phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Radium-223 in biochemically recurrent prostate cancer was safe and associated with minimal grade 1/2 toxicities. Decreases in SUVmax on most NaF scans, improvements in PSMA imaging, and delayed but confirmed PSA declines in 33% of patients suggest that Radium-223 monotherapy may have therapeutic activity in biochemically recurrent prostate cancer with PET-positive bone findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients (Pts) with biochemically recurrent prostate cancer (BCR) and PET findings in the bones
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Radium-223 without androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) in patients (Pts) with biochemically recurrent prostate cancer (BCR) and PET findings in the bones.

data.clinical_result_summary: Interim results provided clinical proof-of-concept for genotype-directed targeted therapy combined with HAIC and tislelizumab as a viable salvage strategy for heavily pretreated microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer liver metastasis. The trial is ongoing, and results will be updated in the future.
clinical_result_indication_detail: colorectal cancer liver metastasis refractory to multiple-line systemic therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Genotype-directed targeted therapy combined with HAIC and tislelizumab for microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer liver metastasis refractory to multiple-line systemic therapy (proof-of-concept SALVLIVE trial): An interim analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Induction therapy with toripalimab combined with the GP regimen demonstrated a high tumor response rate and a manageable safety profile in patients with locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma. These findings support the rationale for de-escalating platinum-based chemotherapy in subsequent concurrent treatment phases to potentially reduce toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with World Health Organization type II/III, stage III-IVA nasopharyngeal carcinoma
clinical_result_layer_factor: treatment response: patients achieving partial response with ≥50% tumor reduction or a complete response received toripalimab concurrently with intensity-modulated radiotherapy for three cycles; patients with partial response <50%, stable disease, or disease progression received concurrent intensity-modulated radiotherapy with cisplatin and toripalimab
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II exploratory study of stratified therapy using toripalimab plus GP induction followed by concurrent immunoradiotherapy for locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab plus SOX chemotherapy showed an encouraging pathological complete response rate, favorable survival outcomes, and manageable safety as neoadjuvant treatment for patients with locally advanced gastric cancer. Targeting stromal and myeloid components may help overcome immune resistance and improve the therapeutic potential of immune checkpoint blockade.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant cadonilimab plus chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer: A single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this metastatic renal cell carcinoma cohort, immune checkpoint inhibitor administration before 2:00 PM was associated with significant improvements in both progression-free survival and overall survival, including a nearly two-fold increase in median overall survival compared with late-afternoon administration. These findings are hypothesis-generating and suggest that immunotherapy timing may be an actionable variable for optimizing metastatic renal cell carcinoma treatment, warranting prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma, specifically 97 patients with Stage IV metastatic renal cell carcinoma treated with first-line immune checkpoint inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of time-of-day of immune checkpoint inhibitor infusion on clinical outcomes in patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan at 2.7 mg/kg every 3 weeks was reported to be as efficacious as the standard dose, including for central nervous system response rate. Treatment was well tolerated, and large randomized prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included north Indian women with stage 4 various cancers who received at least 1 dose of trastuzumab deruxtecan, including patients with brain metastases before trastuzumab deruxtecan initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose vs. standard-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan in north Indian patients: Balancing efficacy, toxicity, and cost.

data.clinical_result_summary: ER-low HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer demonstrated very poor outcomes with CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy. The findings suggest that CDK4/6 inhibitor plus aromatase inhibitor/endocrine therapy should not be assumed to be an effective default standard HR+ approach for this subgroup, and ER-low–dedicated prospective trials and TNBC-oriented strategies are urgently needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included women with HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer who initiated CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy with palbociclib, ribociclib, or abemaciclib plus an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant, with a focus on ER-low (1–10%) HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Should CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy be standard of care for ER-low (1–10%) HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer? A multicenter registry cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary findings suggest that the combination of radiotherapy, temozolomide, and fluoxetine is feasible, has manageable toxicity, and demonstrates potential progression-free survival benefit in patients with newly diagnosed Grade 4 glioma. Further follow-up and investigation in larger cohorts are warranted to confirm these results.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed Grade 4 glioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Radiotherapy combined with temozolomide and fluoxetine for newly diagnosed grade 4 glioma: Preliminary report from a single-arm, prospective phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Imneskibart plus IL-2 showed compelling anti-tumor activity in patients with cutaneous melanoma refractory to doublet checkpoint inhibitor therapy. The addition of nivolumab showed an emerging signal of enhanced activity, while imneskibart plus IL-2 was described as well tolerated. The observed Treg reduction may contribute to the high disease control rate and support durable benefit with prolonged treatment exposure and progression-free survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced/metastatic cutaneous melanoma with objective progression after prior doublet checkpoint inhibitors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Imneskibart + low-dose subcutaneous IL-2 ± nivolumab in patients with CPI-refractory cutaneous melanoma: Promising results from an ongoing phase 1/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Frontline GemFLP achieved a 44% objective response rate, a median duration of response of 8.6 months, and a median overall survival of 21 months in advanced urachal and non-urachal adenocarcinoma. Survival did not differ between the disease subtypes, higher baseline CA125 was associated with inferior overall survival, and toxicity was manageable.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic or unresectable urachal or non-urachal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of frontline gemcitabine, 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin, and cisplatin (GemFLP) in advanced urachal and non-urachal urinary tract adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients aged ≥75 years with stage III colon cancer, adding oxaliplatin to adjuvant therapy increased health care utilization burden without providing a statistically significant survival benefit. These real-world findings support treatment de-escalation, with fluoropyrimidine monotherapy preserving efficacy while minimizing toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged ≥75 years with resected stage III colon cancer who initiated adjuvant chemotherapy within 4 months of colectomy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: De-escalation in the elderly: Adjuvant fluoropyrimidine monotherapy vs oxaliplatin-based regimens in stage 3 colon cancer patients aged ≥ 75.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic vedolizumab can facilitate successful, long-term immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment in high-risk patients with prior immune checkpoint inhibitor colitis or inflammatory bowel disease. It mitigated gastrointestinal symptoms, reduced corticosteroid usage, and preserved anti-tumor responses.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced skin cancers who were deemed high-risk due to prior severe immune checkpoint inhibitor colitis or inflammatory bowel disease received vedolizumab prophylaxis prior to immune checkpoint inhibitor retreatment or treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prophylactic vedolizumab to facilitate use of immune-checkpoint inhibitors in cancer patients at high risk of immune-mediated colitis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of AL amyloidosis patients with advanced renal dysfunction, daratumumab exposure was associated with differences in survival and cardiac outcomes, as well as an increased burden of hematologic abnormalities. These findings highlight the need for careful patient selection and close monitoring and support further prospective evaluation of daratumumab in renally impaired AL amyloidosis populations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with AL amyloidosis and advanced renal disease, including chronic kidney disease stage 4–5, end-stage renal disease, or dialysis dependence, diagnosed between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2025, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of daratumumab in light-chain amyloidosis patients with advanced renal failure: A TriNetX network study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Darlifarnib 3 and 5 mg plus adagrasib were well tolerated and showed encouraging antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and colorectal cancer. These preliminary data support further investigation of darlifarnib plus KRAS inhibitors, such as adagrasib, to address mTORC1-mediated resistance and potentially improve clinical outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, or colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Farnesyl transferase inhibitor (FTI) darlifarnib (KO-2806) in combination with adagrasib in KRAS G12C mutated (mut) advanced solid tumors: Preliminary results from the FIT-001 phase 1 first-in-human trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma and concomitant HIV or viral hepatitis treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors did not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in overall survival or healthcare utilization compared with matched patients without viral infection. These findings suggest that chronic viral infections should not necessarily preclude the use of immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with solid tumors, although prospective studies are warranted to further characterize safety and efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, including pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, atezolizumab, or durvalumab, were studied, comparing patients with documented HIV and/or viral hepatitis with patients without viral infection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in patients with advanced cancer and chronic viral infections: Real-world clinical experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan at 2.7 mg/kg every 3 weeks was reported to be as efficacious as the standard dose, including for central nervous system response rate. Treatment was well tolerated, and large randomized prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included north Indian women with stage 4 various cancers who received at least 1 dose of trastuzumab deruxtecan, including patients with brain metastases before trastuzumab deruxtecan initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose vs. standard-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan in north Indian patients: Balancing efficacy, toxicity, and cost.

data.clinical_result_summary: CRB-701 showed promising efficacy in patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer and had a favorable safety profile compared with other MMAE-based therapies. Ongoing evaluation will further define its potential as a new treatment option for this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of the next-generation nectin-4–targeting antibody-drug conjugate CRB-701 (SYS6002) in patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Darlifarnib 3 and 5 mg plus adagrasib were well tolerated and showed encouraging antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and colorectal cancer. These preliminary data support further investigation of darlifarnib plus KRAS inhibitors, such as adagrasib, to address mTORC1-mediated resistance and potentially improve clinical outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, or colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Farnesyl transferase inhibitor (FTI) darlifarnib (KO-2806) in combination with adagrasib in KRAS G12C mutated (mut) advanced solid tumors: Preliminary results from the FIT-001 phase 1 first-in-human trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: JMKX003948 was well tolerated in patients with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma, and the maximum tolerated dose was not reached. The treatment showed promising antitumor activity, with an objective response rate of 25% and median progression-free survival of 7.7 months.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma who had received at least 1 prior standard therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human phase 1 dose-escalation study of the oral HIF-2α inhibitor JMKX003948 in patients with renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: QLF31907 showed potential anti-tumor activity and an acceptable safety profile in heavily treated patients with advanced melanoma, including immunotherapy-exposed patients. These results warrant validation in further clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: previously-treated patients with advanced melanoma, including IO-exposed patients
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of a novel PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific antibody QLF31907 in previously-treated patients with advanced melanoma: Results from a phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study demonstrates the prognostic and predictive value of single-timepoint and longitudinal ctDNA status in the neoadjuvant and postsurgical management of patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Persistent ctDNA positivity following neoadjuvant chemotherapy and in the molecular residual disease window was strongly associated with inferior progression-free survival, while early ctDNA clearance conferred the most favorable outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with resectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma who received neoadjuvant FLOT followed by curative-intent surgery.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prognostic value of perioperative ctDNA monitoring in patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) undergoing neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) and surgery.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adding nogapendekin alfa inbakicept to checkpoint inhibitor-based standard of care increased absolute lymphocyte counts and improved progression-free survival in PD-L1 TPS ≥50% first-line non-small cell lung cancer, with manageable safety. In platinum chemo-immunotherapy cohorts, pooled efficacy showed improved response and a significant overall survival signal. Enrollment and follow-up are ongoing, supporting continued accrual in QUILT-2.023.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with first-line, stage III/IV non-small cell lung cancer who have PD-L1 expression of 1% or greater (cohort A)
Patients with first-line, stage III/IV non-small cell lung cancer who have PD-L1 expression of 1% or greater (cohort B&C)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy outcomes in first-line (1L) non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with maintenance of immune competence: QUILT‑2.023 randomized phase 3 study of IL‑15R agonist nogapendekin alfa inbakicept (NAI) with checkpoint inhibitor (CPI) ± chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Surufatinib plus KN046 and GnP demonstrated consistently encouraging efficacy and manageable safety as first-line treatment for advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Early and sharp decline in CA199 may predict more favorable survival benefit, and further analyses and investigations in larger populations are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer who were eligible for first-line treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Surufatinib plus KN046 and chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: Updated results and biomarker analysis from a phase 1b/2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The novel bladder-sparing modality of Disitamab Vedotin combined with Toripalimab plus pelvic lymph node dissection after maximal TURBT currently demonstrates favorable efficacy and safety. Long-term outcomes warrant further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with cT2-4aN0M0 stage bladder urothelial carcinoma who have HER2 overexpression (IHC ≥ 2+)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary results of a single-arm, muti-center, prospective clinical study of disitamab vedotin combined with toripalimab and pelvic lymph node dissection for bladder preservation in patients with cT2-4aN0M0 bladder urothelial carcinoma and HER2 expression ≥ 2+ after maximal TURBT.

data.clinical_result_summary: Heavily pretreated patients with metastatic breast cancer in Bria-ABC demonstrated stable global health and key functional domains, supporting sustained quality of life in advanced disease. TWiST showed meaningful benefit without significant toxicity, and ongoing follow-up will further characterize durability of patient-reported outcomes and clinical correlation. Results support decentralized care and potential home self-administration.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic breast cancer with no meaningful therapeutic options were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Quality of life and treatment tolerability of Bria-IMT + CPI in metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma and concomitant HIV or viral hepatitis treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors did not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in overall survival or healthcare utilization compared with matched patients without viral infection. These findings suggest that chronic viral infections should not necessarily preclude the use of immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with solid tumors, although prospective studies are warranted to further characterize safety and efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, including pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, atezolizumab, or durvalumab, were studied, comparing patients with documented HIV and/or viral hepatitis with patients without viral infection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in patients with advanced cancer and chronic viral infections: Real-world clinical experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Daraxonrasib demonstrated unprecedented improvements in overall survival and progression-free survival versus chemotherapy in patients with second-line metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma with or without an identified tumor RAS mutation. Daraxonrasib was generally well tolerated, with a manageable safety profile and no new safety signals. Results support daraxonrasib as the new standard of care for second-line metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) who had been previously treated - RAS G12 mutant
patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) who had been previously treated
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Daraxonrasib, a RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor vs chemotherapy in previously treated metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (mPDAC): Primary and final analysis from the phase 3 RASolute 302 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: NbCD5 CAR-T cells demonstrated preliminary antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with refractory or relapsed T-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, with a day-30 objective response rate of 66.7%. Cytokine release syndrome was limited to grade 1-2 and no ICANS was reported, although EBV reactivation, including grade 3-5 events, warrants attention; longer follow-up is required.
clinical_result_indication_name: T细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: T lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma
pts with T-cell non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human novel bispecific epitope anti-CD5 nanobody CAR-T cells for refractory or relapsed T-cell malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: 68Ga-FC516 demonstrated high ACP3-targeting specificity, low background uptake, and strong imaging performance in preclinical and first-in-human studies, with no adverse events observed. These findings support ACP3-targeted PET as a potential complementary approach to PSMA PET, particularly for patients with PSMA-low or PSMA-treated prostate cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: healthy volunteers and prostate cancer patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human PET imaging of 68Ga-FC516, a novel ACP3-targeted radiotracer for prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: REVO-U enables ultra-scalable manufacturing like biologic drugs. Early data in relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma showed no graft-versus-host disease, with expansion, cytokine release syndrome, and responses influenced by lymphodepletion, dose, and MPA exposure. Timely EC-MPS adjustment according to MPA AUC may be needed to assure efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: REVO-U: A next-generation, gene-editing–free universal CAR-T platform to enable ultra–high-yield manufacturing and identification of early clinical activity in relapsed/refractory DLBCL.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with locally advanced mismatch repair-deficient endometrial cancer, ctDNA detection after surgery correlated with visible disease. ctDNA levels declined during dostarlimab and radiation therapy for most patients, and ctDNA detection was correlated with distant but not local disease recurrence, suggesting potential as a non-invasive disease marker.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with locally advanced, newly diagnosed clinical stage III/IVA mismatch repair-deficient endometrial cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) from a phase II study of adjuvant dostarlimab with pelvic radiation in locally advanced, mismatch repair–deficient (MMR-D) endometrial cancer (D-RT study).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort analysis of elderly, frail, or highly comorbid veterans with de novo metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer, ADT plus enzalutamide was associated with prolonged survival compared with ADT alone. In patients with high-volume disease, ADT plus ARPI was also associated with longer survival versus ADT.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This study included veterans with de novo metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer who were aged at least 75 years or had a Veterans Affairs Frailty Index greater than 0.2 or a Charlson Comorbidity Index of at least 3. Subgroups included patients who initiated ADT plus enzalutamide with high-volume or low-volume disease, or patients with high-volume disease who received any ARPI.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes with androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) plus androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (ARPIs) in veterans with de novo metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC) who were elderly, frail, or had high comorbidity: A subgroup analysis of enzalutamide and high-volume disease.

data.clinical_result_summary: Both elisrasib monotherapy and elisrasib in combination with pembrolizumab showed strong efficacy and good tolerability as first-line treatments for G12C-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. These findings warrant a randomized study to evaluate elisrasib as a potential new standard of care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with G12C mutant advanced stage non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Elisrasib (D3S-001), a next-generation GDP-bound KRAS G12C inhibitor, as first-line therapy for KRAS G12C mutation–positive non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: SNC115 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging preliminary antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with small cell lung cancer. The absence of dose-limiting toxicities and ICANS, together with low-grade transient CRS, supports continued dose escalation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, pharmacokinetic, and preliminary efficacy of SNC115 in patients with relapsed/refractory small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC): A phase 1 study.

In platinum chemo-immunotherapy cohorts, pooled efficacy showed improved response and a significant overall survival signal. Enrollment and follow-up are ongoing, supporting continued accrual in QUILT-2.023.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with first-line, stage III/IV non-small cell lung cancer who have PD-L1 expression of 1% or greater (cohort A)
Patients with first-line, stage III/IV non-small cell lung cancer who have PD-L1 expression of 1% or greater (cohort B&C)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy outcomes in first-line (1L) non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with maintenance of immune competence: QUILT‑2.023 randomized phase 3 study of IL‑15R agonist nogapendekin alfa inbakicept (NAI) with checkpoint inhibitor (CPI) ± chemotherapy.

clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with AL amyloidosis and advanced renal disease, including chronic kidney disease stage 4–5, end-stage renal disease, or dialysis dependence, diagnosed between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2025, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of daratumumab in light-chain amyloidosis patients with advanced renal failure: A TriNetX network study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large-scale real-world cohort of patients aged ≧75 years with metastatic pancreatic cancer, first-line FOLFIRINOX demonstrated a significant survival advantage over gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel and improved early survival outcomes without a statistically significant increase in acute healthcare utilization. The study supports FOLFIRINOX as a viable front-line option for fit older adults.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients aged ≧75 years with metastatic pancreatic cancer who were receiving first-line FOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative effectiveness of first-line FOLFIRINOX versus gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel in patients aged ≧ 75 years with metastatic pancreatic cancer: A multinational real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: QLM2010 plus dexamethasone was non-inferior to fosaprepitant plus palonosetron plus dexamethasone for preventing chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting in cisplatin-based highly emetogenic chemotherapy patients and was well tolerated. It may offer a more convenient therapeutic alternative with the potential to reduce the impact of CINV on daily life.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with solid tumors receiving cisplatin-based highly emetogenic chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of mixed formulation aprepitant and palonosetron (QLM2010) for prevention of cisplatin-based highly emetogenic chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind, double-dummy, positive-controlled phase III study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ripretinib is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8, with no impact on absorption and a small, clinically insignificant increase in total repaglinide exposure. The safety profile of ripretinib was consistent with its established use in advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor, supporting approved concomitant use with CYP2C8 substrates.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effect of ripretinib on the pharmacokinetics (PK) of repaglinide, a sensitive CYP2C8 probe substrate, in adult patients (pts) with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST).

data.clinical_result_summary: In ARPI-exposed mCRPC, 177Lu-PSMA was associated with lower 180-day mortality risk and substantially fewer hospitalizations than docetaxel, with a lower risk of AKI. These findings highlight a potential short-term effectiveness and acute-care utilization advantage of 177Lu-PSMA in routine practice and support further prospective evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults > 18 years of age with metastatic prostate cancer and prior ARPI exposure who initiated 177Lu-PSMA or docetaxel.
clinical_result_layer_factor: demographics and baseline comorbidities
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-ARPI sequencing in mCRPC: A propensity-matched real-world comparison of 177Lu-PSMA-617 versus docetaxel for early clinical outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: Frontline GemFLP achieved a 44% objective response rate, a median duration of response of 8.6 months, and a median overall survival of 21 months in advanced urachal and non-urachal adenocarcinoma. Survival did not differ between the disease subtypes, higher baseline CA125 was associated with inferior overall survival, and toxicity was manageable.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic or unresectable urachal or non-urachal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of frontline gemcitabine, 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin, and cisplatin (GemFLP) in advanced urachal and non-urachal urinary tract adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Frontline GemFLP achieved a 44% objective response rate, a median duration of response of 8.6 months, and a median overall survival of 21 months in advanced urachal and non-urachal adenocarcinoma. Survival did not differ between the disease subtypes, higher baseline CA125 was associated with inferior overall survival, and toxicity was manageable.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic or unresectable urachal or non-urachal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of frontline gemcitabine, 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin, and cisplatin (GemFLP) in advanced urachal and non-urachal urinary tract adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prophylactic vedolizumab to facilitate use of immune-checkpoint inhibitors in cancer patients at high risk of immune-mediated colitis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adebrelimab was reported to be safe and effective for immune resumption after immune-related adverse events. In this real-world study, adebrelimab-based treatment showed antitumor activity and manageable safety after immune resumption.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with advanced solid tumors who developed immune-related adverse events during immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment without disease progression were enrolled when immune-related adverse events resolved to ≤ grade 1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world study of adebrelimab for immune resumption after immune-related adverse events (irAEs).

data.clinical_result_summary: Both neoadjuvant treatment regimens showed manageable safety profiles in patients with previously untreated, hormone receptor-negative, HER2-low early breast cancer. Disitamab vedotin plus toripalimab plus carboplatin showed numerically better efficacy than the sequential chemotherapy-containing regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HR-negative, HER2-low breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: PD-L1 status (positive or negative) and clinical staging (stage II or III)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant disitamab vedotin (DV) in combination with toripalimab (Tor) and concurrent/sequential chemotherapy (chemo) in patients with HR-negative, HER2-low breast cancer: A randomized multicenter phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Induction chemotherapy plus camrelizumab followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy showed improved long-term survival and acceptable late toxicity in unresectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Median progression-free survival exceeded three years and appeared superior to previous reports, supporting further evaluation in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: previously untreated patients with unresectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Induction chemotherapy plus camrelizumab followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy for unresectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ImpactCRT): Long-term outcomes of a single-arm phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Second-line immunotherapy provided modest disease control with a high primary progression rate in patients with BRAF-mutant advanced melanoma after targeted therapy failure. No significant efficacy difference was observed between anti–PD-1 monotherapy and ipilimumab/nivolumab combination, suggesting limited benefit from intensifying to combination immunotherapy in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with BRAF V600–mutant advanced melanoma who progressed after first-line combined targeted therapy with BRAF/MEK inhibitors and initiated second-line immunotherapy at two Russian centers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sequential therapy in BRAF-mutant melanoma: Comparison of combination immunotherapy anti-CTLA4 and anti–PD-1 versus anti–PD-1 monotherapy after targeted treatment failure.

data.clinical_result_summary: To date, JK06 demonstrates promising emerging clinical activity in refractory NSCLC and breast cancer at multiple dose levels while being well tolerated without significant drug-related toxicities. Updated safety and clinical activity data from both dose escalation and expansion cohorts, including the initial assessment of dose randomization, will be presented.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic cancer - NSCLC
patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic cancer - breast cancer
Patients (pts) with advanced relapsed/refractory solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1b/2 study of JK06, a 5T4-targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study did not meet the predetermined threshold for efficacy for Stratum 1. Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy could warrant further exploration in poorly differentiated chordoma.
clinical_result_indication_name: 非典型畸胎横纹肌样瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients 6 months to 40 years with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers - extracranial solid tumors (Stratum 1)
patients 6 months to 40 years with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers - CNS tumors (Stratum 2)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Results of a phase II trial of nivolumab and ipilimumab in children and young adults with relapsed or refractory INI1-deficient cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preoperative concurrent trabectedin and radiotherapy was feasible and safe for resectable retroperitoneal L-sarcomas, yielding density responses in over 25% of patients and promising survival outcomes. A phase III trial is warranted to compare this regimen against radiotherapy alone.
clinical_result_indication_detail: centrally confirmed resectable retroperitoneal L-sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trabectedin with concomitant radiotherapy in resectable retroperitoneal L-sarcoma: A multicenter, prospective, phase I/II trial—A collaborative study by the Spanish (GEIS), Italian (ISG), and French (FSG) groups.

data.clinical_result_summary: This final analysis of the TiNivo-2 study highlights sustained efficacy of tivozanib in metastatic renal cell carcinoma with a consistent safety profile. The findings support durable clinical benefit and tolerability of tivozanib in the post-ICI treatment setting in renal cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with advanced clear-cell RCC who had 1–2 prior lines of therapy, including an ICI
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final analysis of the TiNivo-2 phase 3 trial: Long-term outcome of tivozanib (Tivo) in patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis, GLP-1RA use in patients with stage I-III colorectal cancer was associated with improved recurrence-free survival and overall survival compared with nonusers. These findings were consistent across both 5-year and 15-year follow-up periods, demonstrating a sustained association with improved outcomes in colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients older than 18 years with a diagnosis of stage I-III colorectal cancer between April 1, 2005, and April 1, 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Relationship between GLP-1 receptor agonists on cancer recurrence and survival of patients with stage I-III colorectal cancer: A retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX database.

data.clinical_result_summary: Both palliative care approaches effectively halted disease progression in the majority of patients with advanced head and neck cancer. Adverse effects from chemotherapy remain a significant concern, affecting treatment adherence and quality of life, while gefitinib monotherapy demonstrated a favorable safety profile with fewer adverse events and represents a practical therapeutic option due to oral administration.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients older than 18 years with advanced head and neck cancer in a resource-limited setting were enrolled, while patients with stage I/II disease, pregnancy, lactation, medical unfitness for chemotherapy, or allergies to study drugs were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chemotherapy or targeted therapy?: Real-world comparative outcomes in advanced and recurrent head and neck cancer in resource-limited settings.

data.clinical_result_summary: AVANA demonstrates the feasibility and activity of adding ICIs to standard chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer. Computational pathology analyses suggest that dynamic changes in tumor microenvironment cellular composition could be associated with long-term outcomes, supporting its potential role for patient stratification.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant (NA) chemoradiotherapy (CTRT) plus avelumab (Ave) in locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC): 4-year outcomes of the phase II AVANA trial and their association with computational pathology.

data.clinical_result_summary: DISC-0974 was well tolerated and showed a favorable safety profile in patients with myelofibrosis and anemia. Anemia responses and fatigue scores improved across cohorts, including in participants receiving concomitant JAK inhibitor therapy, supporting hepcidin reduction as a promising approach for treating anemia in myelofibrosis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants with primary or secondary myelofibrosis and anemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RALLY-MF: Initial efficacy of a phase 2 study of DISC-0974, an anti-hemojuvelin antibody, to treat anemia in myelofibrosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of tislelizumab, bevacizumab, and trifluridine/tipiracil showed promising activity and manageable safety in late-line microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer. Patients without liver metastases had significantly longer progression-free survival and overall survival, and early neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio reduction may predict better outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: mCRC patients (ECOG PS 0/1) progressing after ≥2 prior therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tislelizumab combined with bevacizumab and trifluridine/tipiracil as third-line or later therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) : A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This large real-world analysis showed that tarlatamab had a median overall survival of 15.2 months and a safety profile that appeared lower than reported in clinical trials. Patients initiating tarlatamab after a chemotherapy-free interval of at least 90 days had a significant survival benefit, suggesting that treatment sequencing may influence efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer who received tarlatamab were included and stratified by chemotherapy-free interval into chemotherapy-free (≥ 90 days) or early chemotherapy (< 90 days) groups in a multi-center global electronic health record network.
clinical_result_layer_factor: chemotherapy-free interval (CFI): chemotherapy-free (≥ 90 days) or early chemotherapy (< 90 days)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A retrospective analysis of tarlatamab outcomes and safety in a global multicenter electronic health record network (TriNetX) database.

data.clinical_result_summary: Primary prophylaxis with empegfilgrastim during DCF induction chemotherapy was associated with a relatively low incidence of grade 3-4 neutropenia and febrile neutropenia in patients with advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, while allowing most patients to complete planned treatment. Further analyses are planned to compare empegfilgrastim administration on day 2 versus day 3 of the DCF regimen.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with unresectable stage III/IVA hypopharyngeal, laryngeal, or oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Empegfilgrastim for primary febrile neutropenia prophylaxis during induction chemotherapy with docetaxel, cisplatin, and 5-fluorouracil in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of patients with advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma progressing on anti-PD-1 therapy, overall survival did not significantly differ between patients treated with ipilimumab and those receiving cetuximab-based regimens. Comorbidity burden was the primary driver of survival outcome, and prospective studies are warranted to better define optimal sequencing in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The cohort included patients with advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma who progressed on or failed first-line anti-PD-1 therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world overall survival after PD-1 failure in advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tislelizumab plus pemetrexed met the primary endpoint and demonstrated encouraging outcomes in patients with relapsed or refractory primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system. The regimen showed an ORR of 71.4%, a CR rate of 50.0%, median PFS of 6.8 months, median DoR of 14.5 months, and manageable safety profiles.
clinical_result_indication_name: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with R/R primary DLBCL of the CNS
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SPECTRUM: Phase II study of tislelizumab plus pemetrexed in patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) of the central nervous system (CNS)—The Korean Cancer Study Group LY22-07.

data.clinical_result_summary: HRXG-K-1939 in combination with an immune checkpoint inhibitor demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging signs of efficacy and immunogenicity in patients with advanced pancreatic cancer. The findings support further development of personalized neoantigen vaccines in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with heavily pretreated advanced pancreatic cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A pilot study of a personalized cancer vaccine in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitor in advanced pancreatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The optimized nanobody-based bispecific epitope anti-CD5 CAR-T cells demonstrated preliminary antitumor activity in patients with refractory or relapsed T-ALL and T-NHL, with all T-ALL patients achieving complete response and a 66.7% objective response rate in T-NHL. The safety profile was preliminary, with generally low-grade cytokine release syndrome but notable EBV reactivation in the T-NHL cohort; longer follow-up is required to determine long-term efficacy and complications.
clinical_result_indication_name: T细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with refractory or relapsed T-ALL and T-cell non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human novel bispecific epitope anti-CD5 nanobody CAR-T cells for refractory or relapsed T-cell malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: ROSELLA met both dual primary endpoints. Relacorilant plus nab-paclitaxel demonstrated a statistically and clinically significant overall survival benefit in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer compared with weekly taxane therapy. Overall survival subgroup analyses showed a consistent benefit favoring the addition of relacorilant to nab-paclitaxel irrespective of prior taxane use.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival subgroup analyses for prior taxane use in the phase 3 ROSELLA trial of relacorilant plus nab-paclitaxel versus nab-paclitaxel monotherapy in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (GOG-3073, ENGOT-ov72, APGOT-Ov10, LACOG-0223, and ANZGOG-2221/2023).

data.clinical_result_summary: Responders had a significantly higher fraction of long-term survivors than the overall cohort, underscoring the importance of achieving objective response to lifileucel for long-term survival benefit. Estimated long-term survivor fractions from overall survival and duration of response were robust to model choice and consistent with each other. Results support the clinical potential of lifileucel for addressing unmet need in post-ICI advanced melanoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included previously treated advanced melanoma patients, specifically unresectable/metastatic melanoma patients who progressed on immune checkpoint inhibitors, and analyzed patients who achieved confirmed objective response by committee review after receiving lifileucel within commercial specifications in Cohorts 2 and 4.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term survivorship rates among previously treated advanced melanoma patients achieving objective response (OR) with lifileucel.

data.clinical_result_summary: The six BRAF-V600E-mutated pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma patients demonstrated meaningful antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile after treatment with encorafenib and binimetinib. Although the study was prematurely terminated due to limited accrual, observed objective responses and survival outcomes suggest that dual RAF/MEK inhibition may be a feasible therapeutic strategy in this rare molecular subgroup.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pancreatic malignancies and a somatic BRAFV600E mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial of binimetinib in combination with encorafenib in patients with pancreatic malignancies and a somatic BRAFV600E mutation.

data.clinical_result_summary: The tumor microenvironment before and after neoadjuvant treatment impacted event-free survival in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer, with an immune-suppressed phenotype associated with reduced benefit from perioperative durvalumab. Neoadjuvant durvalumab influenced the tumor microenvironment and may promote an immune-activated phenotype associated with prolonged event-free survival benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with treatment-naïve resectable non-small cell lung cancer, stage II–IIIB[N2], ECOG performance status 0 or 1, in a modified ITT population that excluded patients with known EGFR or ALK aberrations.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of neoadjuvant durvalumab (D) on tumor microenvironment (TME) features and their association with event-free survival (EFS) in patients with resectable NSCLC (R-NSCLC) from the phase 3 AEGEAN trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Interim results provided clinical proof-of-concept for genotype-directed targeted therapy combined with HAIC and tislelizumab as a viable salvage strategy for heavily pretreated microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer liver metastasis. The trial is ongoing, and results will be updated in the future.
clinical_result_indication_detail: colorectal cancer liver metastasis refractory to multiple-line systemic therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Genotype-directed targeted therapy combined with HAIC and tislelizumab for microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer liver metastasis refractory to multiple-line systemic therapy (proof-of-concept SALVLIVE trial): An interim analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this dose-escalation study, PFL-721 showed manageable toxicity with frequent local gastrointestinal adverse events but low systemic skin toxicity, consistent with its mutant EGFR selectivity. Antitumor activity was observed in a heavily pretreated population, and ctDNA clearance was seen in nearly half of evaluable patients. The randomized dose-optimization part is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer and EGFR/ERBB2 exon 20 alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human dose-escalation study of the selective EGFR/HER2 exon 20 inhibitor PFL-721 in patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: NEPA plus olanzapine with single-day low-dose or no dexamethasone was non-inferior to standard 4-day dexamethasone for prevention of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting in patients receiving highly emetogenic chemotherapy. These findings support steroid-sparing strategies relevant for chemo-immunotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults receiving highly emetogenic chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dexamethasone reduction or omission with NEPA and olanzapine for HEC: A phase III trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: WGc-043 combined with PD-1 antibody was well tolerated and showed an encouraging complete response rate with durable responses in patients with relapsed or refractory extranodal NK/T cell lymphoma. Further studies are warranted to validate these findings and explore the full potential of this regimen in larger studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with EBER1/2 positive relapsed or refractory extranodal NK/T cell lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An exploratory study to assess the safety, immunogenicity, and preliminary anti-tumor activity of the EBV mRNA vaccine (WGc-043 injection) combined with PD-1 antibody in patients with relapsed or refractory ENKTL.

data.clinical_result_summary: In US veterans with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, olaparib was associated with favorable outcomes in routine practice despite older age and frequent late-line use. The findings support its effectiveness in a more diverse real-world population than those represented in clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: US veterans with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who received olaparib between May 2020 and December 2023 in the Veteran’s Health Administration.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world use of olaparib in US veterans with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: Treatment patterns and outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this preliminary analysis of patients with HR+/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer progressing after CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, the addition of sintilimab to chidamide plus fulvestrant did not improve progression-free survival. Safety was manageable with no new toxicity signals identified, and further follow-up and enrollment are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HR+/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary results of a randomized phase II trial of chidamide plus fulvestrant with or without sintilimab in HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer after progression on CDK4/6 inhibitors (CISFORT).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma and concomitant HIV or viral hepatitis treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors did not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in overall survival or healthcare utilization compared with matched patients without viral infection. These findings suggest that chronic viral infections should not necessarily preclude the use of immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with solid tumors, although prospective studies are warranted to further characterize safety and efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, including pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, atezolizumab, or durvalumab, were studied, comparing patients with documented HIV and/or viral hepatitis with patients without viral infection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in patients with advanced cancer and chronic viral infections: Real-world clinical experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, pembrolizumab added to neoadjuvant chemotherapy significantly increased pathologic complete response and RCB 0–1 rates with acceptable safety. Platinum-based anthracycline- and immunotherapy-free chemotherapy showed encouraging activity and may represent a valid alternative for selected patients unfit for standard regimens. These findings warrant validation in prospective studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients with stage II–III triple-negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy between 2021 and 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Anthracycline- and immunotherapy-free neoadjuvant chemotherapy versus KEYNOTE-522 regimen in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Dinutuximab beta combined with temozolomide/irinotecan or GPOH chemotherapy showed high antitumor activity with acceptable and manageable toxicity in children with relapsed or refractory high-risk neuroblastoma. Response-adapted sequencing and individualized chemotherapy selection may improve disease control, including metastatic responses, in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: children with relapsed or refractory high-risk neuroblastoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dinutuximab beta in combination with chemotherapy in patients with refractory or relapsed neuroblastoma: A national prospective study (2020/ABM/01/00055).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of tislelizumab, bevacizumab, and trifluridine/tipiracil showed promising activity and manageable safety in late-line microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer. Patients without liver metastases had significantly longer progression-free survival and overall survival, and early neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio reduction may predict better outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: mCRC patients (ECOG PS 0/1) progressing after ≥2 prior therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tislelizumab combined with bevacizumab and trifluridine/tipiracil as third-line or later therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) : A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Temab-A had a manageable safety profile and showed encouraging antitumor activity in advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: ≥18 years with histologically/cytologically confirmed locally advanced or recurrent/metastatic, unresectable HNSCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 basket study of telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A, ABBV-400), a c-Met protein–targeting antibody-drug conjugate: Results from patients with head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Early direct-acting antiviral therapy after immune checkpoint therapy in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma was safe and resulted in enhanced CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell responses with excellent virologic control. However, it did not impact tumor response, and larger clinical trials are warranted to determine whether HCV clearance with direct-acting antiviral therapy enhances immune checkpoint therapy response in patients with HCV-related hepatocellular carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and chronic hepatitis C virus infection
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Improving immunotherapy response with direct-acting antiviral therapy in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and chronic hepatitis C virus infection.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab plus SOX chemotherapy showed an encouraging pathological complete response rate, favorable survival outcomes, and manageable safety as neoadjuvant treatment for patients with locally advanced gastric cancer. Targeting stromal and myeloid components may help overcome immune resistance and improve the therapeutic potential of immune checkpoint blockade.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant cadonilimab plus chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer: A single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan at 2.7 mg/kg every 3 weeks was reported to be as efficacious as the standard dose, including for central nervous system response rate. Treatment was well tolerated, and large randomized prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included north Indian women with stage 4 various cancers who received at least 1 dose of trastuzumab deruxtecan, including patients with brain metastases before trastuzumab deruxtecan initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose vs. standard-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan in north Indian patients: Balancing efficacy, toxicity, and cost.

data.clinical_result_summary: Vebreltinib demonstrated notable antitumor activity for advanced clear cell sarcoma, representing a marked improvement over existing therapeutic options. Attention should be paid to the risk of severe rash, particularly when combined with immunotherapy. Longer follow-up is required to further confirm the efficacy and safety.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histopathologically confirmed, unresectable or metastatic clear cell sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of vebreltinib in advanced clear cell sarcoma (VEBrant): A multicenter, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preoperative concurrent trabectedin and radiotherapy was feasible and safe for resectable retroperitoneal L-sarcomas, yielding density responses in over 25% of patients and promising survival outcomes. A phase III trial is warranted to compare this regimen against radiotherapy alone.
clinical_result_indication_detail: centrally confirmed resectable retroperitoneal L-sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trabectedin with concomitant radiotherapy in resectable retroperitoneal L-sarcoma: A multicenter, prospective, phase I/II trial—A collaborative study by the Spanish (GEIS), Italian (ISG), and French (FSG) groups.

data.clinical_result_summary: CS2009, a first-in-class trispecific antibody targeting PD-1, VEGF, and CTLA-4, demonstrated a favorable safety profile and clinically meaningful anti-tumor activity in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer without known actionable oncogenic alterations. These findings warrant further investigation of CS2009 in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer - heavily pre-treated later-line (≥2L)
patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer - treatment-naïve (1L)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of CS2009, a first-in-class PD-1/VEGF/CTLA-4 trispecific antibody, in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer: Results from a phase 1/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: No statistically significant differences in PFS, OS, or TTD were found between TAS-102-based regimens in this real-world study. TAS-102 plus regorafenib showed at least equivalent efficacy to TAS-102 plus bevacizumab and may offer potential advantages, but larger prospective studies are needed for confirmation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer initiating TAS-102-based third-line therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A bidirectional cohort study of chemotherapy-targeted alternating therapy on outcomes of third-line metastatic colorectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: A-FOLFOXIRI did not improve progression-free survival compared with A-FOLFOX/FOLFIRI in unresectable right-sided metastatic colorectal cancer. Although response rates were numerically higher and safety was acceptable, the study did not show a significant efficacy advantage for the intensified regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic right-sided colon cancer (cecum to splenic flexure)
clinical_result_layer_factor: ECOG performance status (0 vs 1–2), prior adjuvant chemotherapy (yes vs no), and participating center
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Bevacizumab-based triplet versus doublet chemotherapy as first-line treatment for metastatic right-sided colon cancer: Results of the KCSG CO19-18 phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: These results support the effectiveness of primary prophylaxis with empegfilgrastim in routine practice for elderly patients.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 65 years or older with cancer receiving chemotherapy and primary febrile neutropenia prophylaxis with prolonged G-CSF empegfilgrastim.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Febrile neutropenia prophylaxis with prolonged G-CSF in elderly cancer patients: Analysis from the EMPREREAL study.

data.clinical_result_summary: KC1036 demonstrated promising antitumor efficacy in patients with advanced or recurrent thymoma or thymic carcinoma. KC1036 also exhibited a favorable safety profile and tolerability, supporting further evaluation in a forthcoming phase III trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced or recurrent thymoma or thymic carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of second or further line KC1036 in patients with thymoma and thymic carcinoma: A multicenter, single-arm phase II trial.

The regimen showed an ORR of 71.4%, a CR rate of 50.0%, median PFS of 6.8 months, median DoR of 14.5 months, and manageable safety profiles.
