clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with R/R primary DLBCL of the CNS
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SPECTRUM: Phase II study of tislelizumab plus pemetrexed in patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) of the central nervous system (CNS)—The Korean Cancer Study Group LY22-07.

data.clinical_result_summary: LP-184 demonstrated a manageable safety profile with encouraging antitumor efficacy in tumors harboring key DDR alterations. The maximum tolerated dose was 0.49 mg/kg IV administered on days 1 and 8 every 21 days.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced relapsed or refractory solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human phase 1a study of LP-184, a tumor site–activated novel alkylating agent, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: ER-low HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer demonstrated very poor outcomes with CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy. The findings suggest that CDK4/6 inhibitor plus aromatase inhibitor/endocrine therapy should not be assumed to be an effective default standard HR+ approach for this subgroup, and ER-low–dedicated prospective trials and TNBC-oriented strategies are urgently needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included women with HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer who initiated CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy with palbociclib, ribociclib, or abemaciclib plus an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant, with a focus on ER-low (1–10%) HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Should CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy be standard of care for ER-low (1–10%) HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer? A multicenter registry cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: In ARPI-exposed mCRPC, 177Lu-PSMA was associated with lower 180-day mortality risk and substantially fewer hospitalizations than docetaxel, with a lower risk of AKI. These findings highlight a potential short-term effectiveness and acute-care utilization advantage of 177Lu-PSMA in routine practice and support further prospective evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults > 18 years of age with metastatic prostate cancer and prior ARPI exposure who initiated 177Lu-PSMA or docetaxel.
clinical_result_layer_factor: demographics and baseline comorbidities
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-ARPI sequencing in mCRPC: A propensity-matched real-world comparison of 177Lu-PSMA-617 versus docetaxel for early clinical outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: In premenopausal patients with stage II-III HR+/HER2-negative breast cancer who demonstrate suboptimal early response to intensive neoadjuvant chemotherapy, continued cytotoxic treatment may not be optimal for all patients. A response-adapted strategy integrating early functional assessment with genomic features, particularly TP53 and PI3K/AKT pathway status, may distinguish endocrine-sensitive from chemotherapy-sensitive disease and support biomarker-enriched randomized trials of chemotherapy-sparing strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: premenopausal women with stage II-III HR-positive, HER2-negative BC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A response-adapted and genomically informed strategy to optimize neoadjuvant chemotherapy versus endocrine therapy plus CDK4/6 inhibition in high-risk HR+/HER2− breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan at 2.7 mg/kg every 3 weeks was reported to be as efficacious as the standard dose, including for central nervous system response rate. Treatment was well tolerated, and large randomized prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included north Indian women with stage 4 various cancers who received at least 1 dose of trastuzumab deruxtecan, including patients with brain metastases before trastuzumab deruxtecan initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose vs. standard-dose trastuzumab deruxtecan in north Indian patients: Balancing efficacy, toxicity, and cost.

data.clinical_result_summary: Darolutamide, particularly in doublet therapy, was associated with lower MACE risk than abiraterone in real-world patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer. A similar point estimate in triplet therapy warrants validation in larger cohorts, and these findings may inform treatment selection or prophylactic management to improve cardiovascular outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included real-world patients in the nationwide VA healthcare system initiating doublet or triplet abiraterone or darolutamide for newly diagnosed metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Major adverse cardiovascular events in androgen receptor signaling inhibitor–treated patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world study, the HP and HPy regimens achieved comparable pathologic complete response rates as neoadjuvant therapy for early HER2-positive breast cancer. Treatment choice can be individualized based on distinct toxicity profiles, with HPy associated more with diarrhea and HP with vomiting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with stage II-III HER2-positive breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative efficacy and safety of anti-HER2 neoadjuvant therapy in early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer: A real-world multicenter analysis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral IP-001 at a dose of 4 mL following thermal ablation was well tolerated, with mainly mild, transient immune-related events. Although the pre-specified activity endpoint was not met, the observed disease control rate and progression-free survival support further evaluation of this novel immuno-oncologic strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced melanoma and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intratumoral injection of IP-001 following thermal ablation in patients with advanced solid tumors: A multicenter phase Ib/IIa trial with expansion cohorts in melanoma and soft tissue sarcoma patients (SAKK 66/17).

data.clinical_result_summary: DISC-0974 was well tolerated and showed a favorable safety profile in patients with myelofibrosis and anemia. Anemia responses and fatigue scores improved across cohorts, including in participants receiving concomitant JAK inhibitor therapy, supporting hepcidin reduction as a promising approach for treating anemia in myelofibrosis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants with primary or secondary myelofibrosis and anemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RALLY-MF: Initial efficacy of a phase 2 study of DISC-0974, an anti-hemojuvelin antibody, to treat anemia in myelofibrosis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Early direct-acting antiviral therapy after immune checkpoint therapy in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma was safe and resulted in enhanced CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell responses with excellent virologic control. However, it did not impact tumor response, and larger clinical trials are warranted to determine whether HCV clearance with direct-acting antiviral therapy enhances immune checkpoint therapy response in patients with HCV-related hepatocellular carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and chronic hepatitis C virus infection
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Improving immunotherapy response with direct-acting antiviral therapy in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and chronic hepatitis C virus infection.

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with [212Pb]VMT-α-NET showed a favorable safety profile across all treated participants and signs of sustained efficacy at the 2.5 mCi and 5 mCi dose levels. The study remained ongoing, with enrollment into Cohort 3 still active.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced SSTR2-expressing neuroendocrine tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cohort-level safety and efficacy results for [212Pb]VMT-α-NET in advanced somatostatin receptor subtype 2 (SSTR2+)–expressing neuroendocrine tumors (NETs): Cohorts 1–3.

data.clinical_result_summary: Disitamab vedotin demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging efficacy in patients with high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer and HER2 overexpression in both adjuvant and rescue settings. The trial is ongoing, following a Simon two-stage optimal design, with target enrollment of 52 patients in cohort A and 25 in cohort B.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer with HER2 overexpression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant or rescue disitamab vedotin for high-risk non–muscle invasive bladder cancer with HER2 overexpression: A phase II multi-center study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of dendritic cell vaccine and pembrolizumab was safe and demonstrated encouraging clinical activity in pretreated epithelioid mesothelioma. The observed PD-L1 induction at the tumor site supports the synergistic potential of this combinatorial immunotherapeutic strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pretreated epithelioid mesothelioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Combining immune checkpoint inhibition and dendritic cell vaccination in advanced pleural and peritoneal mesothelioma: The phase 1b MESOVAX trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this INAVO120 exploratory analysis, efficacy was improved with inavolisib versus placebo, regardless of lobular histology status at initial diagnosis and CDH1 alteration status. These findings further support the benefit of inavolisib plus palbociclib plus fulvestrant in patients with PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial had PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes by lobular (lob) histology status at initial diagnosis in patients (pts) in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial with PIK3CA-mutated (mut), hormone receptor-positive (HR+), HER2-negative (HER2–), endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer (aBC) treated with inavolisib (INAVO)/placebo (PBO) + palbociclib (PALBO) + fulvestrant (FULV).

data.clinical_result_summary: A dexamethasone-free antiemetic regimen was non-inferior to standard dexamethasone-based prophylaxis for prevention of vomiting in children and adolescents receiving highly emetogenic chemotherapy. These findings support the use of olanzapine as an effective steroid-sparing alternative.
clinical_result_indication_detail: children and adolescents receiving highly emetogenic chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dexamethasone-free antiemetic prophylaxis with olanzapine in children and adolescents receiving highly emetogenic chemotherapy: A multicenter, phase III non-inferiority randomized trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients treated with bispecific T-cell engagers, coded severe CRS and ICANS events were uncommon and plateaued early, whereas mortality and healthcare utilization continued to accrue over time. The findings suggest that ongoing risk over follow-up likely reflects a combination of treatment-related toxicity and underlying disease progression, highlighting the need for standardized toxicity ascertainment and strategies to identify patients at highest risk for early clinical deterioration.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with small cell carcinoma, B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, multiple myeloma, or acute lymphoblastic leukemia who received at least one bispecific T-cell engager were included, while patients with myeloid malignancies, non-small cell lung cancer, selected solid tumors without approved bispecific therapies, or prior chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early toxicity and temporal mortality patterns following bispecific T-cell engager therapy: A real-world multicenter analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: BXCL701 plus pembrolizumab in second-line advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma did not reach the preliminary efficacy endpoint required to trigger the second stage. However, the combination showed encouraging signs, including objective responses in 2 patients with microsatellite-stable disease and progression-free survival exceeding 6 months in 3 patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BXCL701 plus pembrolizumab in second-line advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: Final outcomes of the EXPEL PANC trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The short-course 12-week de-escalated neoadjuvant paclitaxel, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab regimen demonstrated high efficacy in patients with HER2-positive early breast cancer, particularly in the HR-negative/HER2-positive subgroup. The regimen showed a favorable safety and adherence profile, with no febrile neutropenia and a 100% completion rate, and may represent a promising chemo-light option for selected patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with histologically confirmed HER2-positive early breast cancer, defined as IHC 3+ or ISH+, with clinical stages T0-1N1M0 or T2-3N0-1M0.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of a short-course (12-week) de-escalated neoadjuvant regimen (weekly paclitaxel/trastuzumab/pertuzumab) in early HER2-positive breast cancer: Interim analysis of a prospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world, propensity-matched analysis, non-selective β-blocker use was associated with improved early survival and reduced healthcare utilization among melanoma and lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors. These findings suggest that non-selective β-blockers may represent a low-cost and available adjunct to immunotherapy and warrant prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged 18 years or older with melanoma or lung cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors were included and categorized by exposure to non-selective or selective β-blockers within two months before or at immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of β-blocker selectivity with survival and immune-related outcomes in melanoma and lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this international real-world cohort of premenopausal women with stage I HR+/HER2+ breast cancer, IDFS at 80 months was high across chemotherapy, endocrine therapy, and age subgroups. As de-escalated taxane-only regimens become more common and endocrine therapy strategies evolve, these data provide clinically relevant context for systemic therapy selection in young women with excellent-prognosis disease.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: De-escalated chemotherapy and endocrine therapy outcomes in young women with stage I HR+/HER2+ breast cancer: An international real-world study.

Further investigation of mevrometostat plus enzalutamide in this patient population is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (cohorts (2A and 2C) who received M 875 mg BID with food + E)

data.clinical_result_summary: Dose escalation from 20M to 60M and combination with checkpoint inhibitor therapy showed tolerable intradermal BC1 and potential clinical benefit in refractory metastatic breast cancer. One patient received 17 cycles with 12 months of disease control. Based on very early preliminary data, BC1 is a potential new option for late-stage cancer patients with minimal toxicity and potential home administration as a single agent.
clinical_result_indication_detail: metastatic recurrent breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cell-based second-generation immunotherapy BC1 in metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: With more than 18 months of median follow-up, intracerebroventricular delivery of CART-EGFR-IL13Rα2 cells in recurrent glioblastoma has not shown long-term or delayed toxicities and shows promising overall survival outcomes that support continued clinical development. Neurologic function worsens immediately after infusion but returns to baseline by one month after treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with EGFR-amplified GBM that was recurrent/progressive following front-line radiotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated overall survival, safety, and neurologic function outcomes from a phase 1 trial of bivalent chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy in recurrent glioblastoma (GBM).

data.clinical_result_summary: Plinabulin/docetaxel plus pembrolizumab showed promising efficacy in metastatic NSCLC with acquired resistance to anti-PD-1/L1, supported by immune activation after treatment. Treatment-related adverse events were manageable, and the findings support a global confirmatory study in EGFR/ALK wild-type non-squamous NSCLC following progression on anti-PD-1/L1-based therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: metastatic NSCLC after progression on first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor alone or combination therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of plinabulin (Plin)/docetaxel (Doc) plus pembrolizumab (Pemb) in metastatic NSCLC (mNSCLC) after acquired resistance (AR) to anti–PD-1/L1 alone or in chemotherapy combination: Efficacy and immunophenotyping.

data.clinical_result_summary: Hepatic, renal, and dermatologic toxicities associated with TMP-SMX prophylaxis among patients receiving temozolomide for glioblastoma are common, although usually not severe. These findings suggest that routine PCP prophylaxis with TMP-SMX may cause meaningful harm in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients 18 years or older with glioblastoma who were treated with concomitant and/or adjuvant temozolomide as part of first-line therapy between July 2019 and July 2024 and received TMP-SMX for pneumocystis jirovecii prophylaxis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Characterization of toxicities associated with sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim (TMP-SMX) for pneumocystis jirovecii prophylaxis in patients with glioblastoma (GBM).

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of 1 year of durvalumab to BCG induction and maintenance continued to show no detriment to overall survival at more than 5.5 years of follow-up. It had no major impact on patient-reported outcomes for patients with BCG-naive high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk, BCG-naïve NMIBC who have undergone TURBT prior to randomization
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Durvalumab (D) in combination with BCG induction and maintenance (I + M) therapy for BCG-naive, high-risk non–muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC): 5-year overall survival (OS) analysis and patient-reported outcomes (PROs) from POTOMAC.

data.clinical_result_summary: AI-assisted digital pathology classification identified SNF4 patients who were resistant to endocrine therapy combined with a CDK4/6 inhibitor. First-line apatinib combined with endocrine therapy and a CDK4/6 inhibitor significantly improved prognosis in these SNF4 patients with tolerated toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: SNF4 patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative untreated advanced breast cancer.
clinical_result_layer_factor: visceral metastasis, previous endocrine therapy in the adjuvant or neoadjuvant setting
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Influence of precision treatment with artificial intelligence–assisted subtyping on first-line therapeutic efficacy in HR+/HER2– breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adding subcutaneously administered envafolimab to GEMOX significantly improved overall survival with a manageable safety profile in advanced biliary tract cancer. The combination showed robust efficacy with a low rate of immune-related adverse events and was established as a new, effective, and convenient standard of care for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Chinese patients with advanced biliary tract cancer.
clinical_result_layer_factor: primary site, disease stage, prior therapy, and ECOG PS
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Envafolimab (KN035) plus gemcitabine and oxaliplatin (GEMOX) compared with GEMOX as first-line treatment for Chinese patients with advanced biliary tract cancer: A randomized, open-label, multi-center, phase III pivotal trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant therapy with the personalized neoantigen peptide vaccine iNeo-Vac-P01 demonstrated a substantial and durable survival benefit in high-risk postoperative esophageal carcinoma patients following surgery. The treatment was coupled with a favorable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Chinese patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma who have received prior neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy and radical surgery and are at high risk for recurrence.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Personalized neoantigen vaccine as adjuvant therapy in high-risk postoperative esophageal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Characterization of toxicities associated with sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim (TMP-SMX) for pneumocystis jirovecii prophylaxis in patients with glioblastoma (GBM).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this INAVO120 exploratory analysis, efficacy was improved with inavolisib versus placebo, regardless of lobular histology status at initial diagnosis and CDH1 alteration status. These findings further support the benefit of inavolisib plus palbociclib plus fulvestrant in patients with PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial had PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes by lobular (lob) histology status at initial diagnosis in patients (pts) in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial with PIK3CA-mutated (mut), hormone receptor-positive (HR+), HER2-negative (HER2–), endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer (aBC) treated with inavolisib (INAVO)/placebo (PBO) + palbociclib (PALBO) + fulvestrant (FULV).

data.clinical_result_summary: IBI363 plus platinum-based doublet-chemotherapy was well tolerated and showed encouraging efficacy in advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetic data supported 3-1.5 mg/kg as the recommended dose.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: squamous vs non-squamous, and PD-L1 TPS < 1% vs 1-49%
data.clinical_result_paper_title: IBI363 (TAK-928) plus chemotherapy as first-line (1L) treatment for advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Adding fovinaciclib to fulvestrant conferred a statistically significant and clinically meaningful progression-free survival benefit with consistent improvements in other survival outcomes, along with manageable safety. These findings support fovinaciclib as a later-line treatment option for advanced breast cancer after endocrine therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced breast cancer that relapsed or progressed on previous endocrine therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fovinaciclib versus placebo combined with fulvestrant for advanced breast cancer after endocrine therapy: A randomized, double-blind phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of bevacizumab to chemotherapy was associated with significant benefit in bevacizumab-naïve patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. In patients previously exposed to bevacizumab, re-exposure was not associated with a statistically significant improvement in outcomes, leaving uncertainty about the role of bevacizumab rechallenge in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer treated with chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Bevacizumab rechallenge in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: Evidence from a propensity score–matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: ACT001 combined with standard radiotherapy showed antitumor activity in newly diagnosed pediatric diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma, with improved overall survival compared with historical data. The regimen had a manageable safety profile and good tolerability, providing a potential new treatment option that warrants verification in larger randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_name: 弥漫性内因性脑桥神经胶质瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients with newly diagnosed diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II clinical study of ACT001 combined with radiotherapy in newly diagnosed pediatric diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma.

data.clinical_result_summary: After 3.5 years of median follow-up in the phase 3 EV-302 study, enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab continued to demonstrate superior efficacy versus chemotherapy in previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma, with no new safety signals. Two-thirds of patients achieving complete response converted from an initial partial response, suggesting that treatment duration is relevant in maximizing outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated la/mUC who may or may not be able to receive treatment with cisplatin-based chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab (EV+P) vs chemotherapy for previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma (la/mUC): 3.5-year follow-up and response analyses from the phase 3 EV-302 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Alterations in the WNT pathway had positive prognostic significance in patients with gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer who achieved disease control after 3 months of FOX. TP53 pathway alterations may help guide the choice of PTX+RAM switch maintenance, while HRDsig+ was not predictive of sensitivity to FOX in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer who achieved disease control after 3 months of induction FOX chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of molecular profile on switch maintenance to paclitaxel plus ramucirumab (PTX-RAM) versus continuation of first-line fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin (FOX) chemotherapy (ChT) in patients (pts) with advanced HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction (G/GEJ) cancer: An exploratory endpoint of the ARMANI phase 3 randomized trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: 68Ga-AKY-2519 PET/CT imaging of various malignancies was safe and demonstrated high tumor-to-background uptake and cancerous lesion detection at 120 min post injection. Normal tissue uptake was low, and robust tumor uptake was noted across different solid tumors, indicating therapeutic potential and warranting further clinical development of 225Ac-AKY-2519.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced solid tumors, including prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, small cell lung cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human PET/CT imaging with 68Ga-AKY-2519, a B7-H3 targeted miniprotein radioconjugate, to demonstrate tumor uptake and normal tissue exposure across various advanced solid tumors.

These findings support continued development, including investigation in the Phase 3 BLUESTAR-Endometrial01 study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/metastatic B7-H4-positive ovarian cancer
patients with relapsed/metastatic B7-H4-positive endometrial cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated safety and efficacy of puxitatug samrotecan (Puxi-Sam, AZD8205) in patients (pts) with endometrial cancer (EC) or ovarian cancer (OC): Phase 1/2a BLUESTAR study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Utidelone plus fruquintinib demonstrated encouraging efficacy for the treatment of platinum-resistant ovarian cancer with a tolerable safety profile. The study is still actively ongoing, and further data will be provided at the time of presentation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer, or primary peritoneal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of utidelone plus fruquintinib for the treatment of platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer (FRUTD trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with DRI cells demonstrated a manageable safety profile in newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme. The findings showed a positive trend in progression-free survival and overall survival.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: INB-200: Phase I study and characterization of gene-modified autologous gamma delta (γδ) T cells in newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM).

data.clinical_result_summary: In zanidatamab-treated patients, most diarrhea events were grade 1/2, and first-onset events tended to occur in cycle 1 and resolved in less than 3 weeks. Diarrhea rarely led to zanidatamab discontinuation. The safety of zanidatamab-containing regimens appears favorable given the survival benefits, and diarrhea should be managed with prophylactic loperamide and chemotherapy dose modifications as needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had previously untreated, first-line HER2-positive locally advanced or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Characterization and management of gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events (AEs) with zanidatamab + chemotherapy (CT) ± tislelizumab in first-line (1L) HER2-positive (HER2+) locally advanced or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (mGEA): Analysis from HERIZON-GEA-01.

data.clinical_result_summary: Following dose exploration, Group 3 achieved a 100% complete response rate. Intravesical YH01 injection showed promising preliminary efficacy and a favorable safety profile for BCG-unresponsive or failed intermediate/high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with BCG-unresponsive or failed intermediate/high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II clinical trial of intravesical YH01 for BCG-unresponsive high-risk non–muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: A modified two-day chemotherapy regimen combined with immunotherapy appears to offer comparable efficacy and acceptable safety to the standard approach in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. The regimen reduced chemotherapy treatment slot use in the center and may represent a feasible alternative to the standard schedule pending prospective evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated between January 2021 and December 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical impact of first-line platinum plus two-day etoposide combined with immunotherapy in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer: Retrospective monocentric study—E-twoposide.

data.clinical_result_summary: Even after propensity score matching, oral mucositis in monoclonal antibody-drug conjugate-treated breast cancer patients was linked to increased long-term risks. The findings underscore the importance of preventive strategies to enhance patient outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with breast cancer treated with monoclonal antibody-drug conjugates.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Oral mucositis as a predictor of differential long-term adverse events and mortality in breast cancer patients treated with monoclonal antibody-drug conjugates: Evidence from a propensity score-matched cohort comparison using real-world data from 88 U.S Healthcare organizations.

clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial had PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes by lobular (lob) histology status at initial diagnosis in patients (pts) in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial with PIK3CA-mutated (mut), hormone receptor-positive (HR+), HER2-negative (HER2–), endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer (aBC) treated with inavolisib (INAVO)/placebo (PBO) + palbociclib (PALBO) + fulvestrant (FULV).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of dendritic cell vaccine and pembrolizumab was safe and demonstrated encouraging clinical activity in pretreated epithelioid mesothelioma. The observed PD-L1 induction at the tumor site supports the synergistic potential of this combinatorial immunotherapeutic strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pretreated epithelioid mesothelioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Combining immune checkpoint inhibition and dendritic cell vaccination in advanced pleural and peritoneal mesothelioma: The phase 1b MESOVAX trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The immunohistochemistry assays assessing CLDN18.2 expression with EPR19202 and CLDN18 expression with 43-14A showed comparable analytical performance and high concordance. Efficacy outcomes were aligned across antibody-defined expression strata, supporting the use of either antibody to identify patient populations with similar clinical benefit during development of XNW27011 for gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated patients with gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma who were treated with XNW27011 at doses of 2.4–6.0 mg/kg administered intravenously every 3 weeks.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of CLDN18/CLDN18.2 IHC assays (43-14A vs EPR19202) and the correlation with clinical efficacy in patients with gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma treated by the novel antibody-drug conjugate XNW27011.

clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or follicular lymphoma treated with bispecific antibodies or CAR-T therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world toxicity of bispecific antibodies versus CAR-T cell therapy in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma.

The findings should be interpreted cautiously because of potential residual confounding and differences in clinical indications between agents.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with breast cancer who were treated with ribociclib or abemaciclib within the past 20 years.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative real-world survival outcomes of ribociclib and abemaciclib in breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world single-center experience, a subset of patients with metastatic prostate cancer on treatment holiday from doublet therapy had durable time off therapy without progression, including patients with synchronous metastatic disease and high-volume disease. Prospective studies are warranted to identify which patients are most likely to have durable time off therapy, and radiologic progression without PSA progression was observed in some patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in the hospital system had metastatic hormone sensitive prostate cancer, classified as M1b or M1c based on CT or MRI and bone scan, and had received androgen deprivation therapy and an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor for at least 6 months.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Treatment holiday for patients with metastatic hormone sensitive prostate cancer: Real-world experience at a single center.

data.clinical_result_summary: VRN110755 demonstrated favorable pharmacokinetics, a manageable safety profile, and encouraging systemic and CNS antitumor activity in heavily pretreated EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer, including C797S-positive disease. These findings support continued clinical development of VRN110755.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with non-small cell lung cancer harboring epithelial growth factor receptor mutants from Korea and Taiwan who have undergone prior systemic treatments.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and antitumor activity of VRN110755, a brain-penetrant, selective EGFR inhibitor, in patients with EGFR-driven non–small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Deulorlatinib produced robust and durable responses in patients with locally advanced or metastatic ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer who had progressed on second-generation inhibitors, including those with the G1202R mutation. The treatment had a low incidence of Grade ≥3 CNS treatment-related adverse events, suggesting a favorable risk-benefit ratio and supporting further development, particularly in the first-line setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced ALK-positive non-small-cell lung cancer after failure of second-generation ALK inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of deulorlatinib (TGRX-326) in patients with locally advanced or metastatic ALK+ non–small cell lung cancer: A multicenter, open-label, pivotal phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: 68Ga-AKY-2519 PET/CT imaging of various malignancies was safe and demonstrated high tumor-to-background uptake and cancerous lesion detection at 120 min post injection. Normal tissue uptake was low, and robust tumor uptake was noted across different solid tumors, indicating therapeutic potential and warranting further clinical development of 225Ac-AKY-2519.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced solid tumors, including prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, small cell lung cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human PET/CT imaging with 68Ga-AKY-2519, a B7-H3 targeted miniprotein radioconjugate, to demonstrate tumor uptake and normal tissue exposure across various advanced solid tumors.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: R-ISV-BM201 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging antitumor activity in patients with refractory or metastatic solid tumors. Combining the regimen with an anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody may trigger a systemic immune response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with refractory or metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical efficacy and safety of BM201 intra-tumoral injection and radiotherapy in advanced solid tumors: Results from the phase I/IIT study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this cohort, overall survival and cumulative incidence of nodal metastasis were comparable or better than the thick melanoma observation arm of MSLT-1. The data suggest that omission of sentinel lymph node biopsy is highly likely not to negatively impact outcomes and may be offered to patients with significant operative risk, although a larger sample with longer follow-up is needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with stage IIB/C cutaneous melanoma were treated with only wide local excision and adjuvant pembrolizumab and had at least 6 months of follow-up.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes of stage IIB/IIC cutaneous melanoma treated with wide local excision and adjuvant immunotherapy without sentinel lymph node biopsy.

data.clinical_result_summary: HC-7366, alone or in combination with belzutifan, was generally well tolerated in patients with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Preliminary efficacy analyses indicated favorable disease control, with high disease control rates and low primary progressive disease rates, particularly in the 40-60 mg combination dose range.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced ccRCC previously treated with ≥1 anti-PD/PD-L1 and ≥1 VEGF-TKI
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1b, open-label, safety, tolerability, and efficacy study of HC-7366 in combination with belzutifan in patients with locally advanced (inoperable) or metastatic renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: 68Ga-AKY-2519 PET/CT imaging of various malignancies was safe and demonstrated high tumor-to-background uptake and cancerous lesion detection at 120 min post injection. Normal tissue uptake was low, and robust tumor uptake was noted across different solid tumors, indicating therapeutic potential and warranting further clinical development of 225Ac-AKY-2519.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced solid tumors, including prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, small cell lung cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human PET/CT imaging with 68Ga-AKY-2519, a B7-H3 targeted miniprotein radioconjugate, to demonstrate tumor uptake and normal tissue exposure across various advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this INAVO120 exploratory analysis, efficacy was improved with inavolisib versus placebo, regardless of lobular histology status at initial diagnosis and CDH1 alteration status. These findings further support the benefit of inavolisib plus palbociclib plus fulvestrant in patients with PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial had PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes by lobular (lob) histology status at initial diagnosis in patients (pts) in the INAVO120 phase 3 trial with PIK3CA-mutated (mut), hormone receptor-positive (HR+), HER2-negative (HER2–), endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer (aBC) treated with inavolisib (INAVO)/placebo (PBO) + palbociclib (PALBO) + fulvestrant (FULV).

data.clinical_result_summary: Proglumide is safe in patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and the recommended phase 2 dose is 1200 mg PO daily with standard-dose gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel. Proglumide remodels the tumor microenvironment by decreasing fibrosis and immunosuppression while increasing T-cell infiltration, supporting further investigation in phase 2 trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Proglumide, gemcitabine (GEM), and nab-paclitaxel (NAB-P) in patients (pts) with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC): Results of the phase 1 PROGEM trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sacituzumab govitecan exhibits encouraging efficacy for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer with manageable toxicities. Future studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II evaluation of sacituzumab govitecan in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (NCT06028932).

data.clinical_result_summary: Final results supported the use of tislelizumab combined with radiotherapy as a promising bladder-preserving therapy for BCG-unresponsive high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients who were ineligible for or declined radical cystectomy. The regimen showed a 12-month DFS rate of 90.6% with no grade 4-5 treatment-related adverse events reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (HR NMIBC) unresponsive to bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results from a phase II study of tislelizumab combined with radiotherapy as bladder-preserving treatment for high-risk non–muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients unresponsive to Bacillus Calmette-Guerin.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tarlatamab demonstrated increased intracranial efficacy with longer CNS PFS and overall survival versus chemotherapy in patients with stable, treated and untreated asymptomatic brain metastases. These results support tarlatamab as the second-line standard of care for small cell lung cancer, including in patients with brain metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with small cell lung cancer following progression on or after platinum-based chemotherapy, with stable asymptomatic brain metastases; prior CNS treatment was required until protocol amendment 3.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial efficacy of tarlatamab versus chemotherapy (CTx) as second-line (2L) treatment for small cell lung cancer (SCLC): DeLLphi-304 phase 3 post hoc analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Aromatherapy using lavender and linalool during bone marrow aspiration and biopsy was feasible and safe. It was potentially associated with meaningful reductions in procedural anxiety and pain, supporting a larger randomized controlled trial to confirm efficacy and explore integration into routine supportive oncology care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with cancer receiving a bone marrow aspiration and biopsy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized controlled pilot study of aromatherapy to reduce anxiety and pain during bone marrow aspiration and biopsy.

data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up, GOLCA plus rituximab demonstrated promising efficacy with durable responses and no new safety signals in patients with relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma. The 0.4 mg group had higher overall and complete response rates than the 0.2 mg group, including in patients with prior lenalidomide-based and/or T-cell–redirecting treatment, with a manageable safety profile at both doses.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts with R/R FL with ≥2 prior lines of Tx (≥1 in Part B if prior anti-CD20 Tx)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Golcadomide (GOLCA), a potential, first-in-class, oral CELMoD ± rituximab (R) in patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory (R/R) follicular lymphoma (FL): Long-term follow-up (f/u) of the phase (Ph) 1/2 CC-99282-NHL-001 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Zidesamtinib demonstrated encouraging activity in patients with diverse ROS1-positive solid tumors, including those refractory to standard-of-care therapies. Safety was consistent with its ROS1-selective, TRK-sparing design.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced/metastatic ROS1-positive solid tumors other than non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zidesamtinib efficacy and safety in patients with advanced ROS1-positive solid tumors other than NSCLC in the ARROS-1 study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of dendritic cell vaccine and pembrolizumab was safe and demonstrated encouraging clinical activity in pretreated epithelioid mesothelioma. The observed PD-L1 induction at the tumor site supports the synergistic potential of this combinatorial immunotherapeutic strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pretreated epithelioid mesothelioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Combining immune checkpoint inhibition and dendritic cell vaccination in advanced pleural and peritoneal mesothelioma: The phase 1b MESOVAX trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: FF-10850 has demonstrated encouraging preliminary activity in both pre-treated and treatment-naive Merkel cell carcinoma. The regimen of 2 mg/m2 every 2 weeks is tolerable with manageable hematologic side effects, and further exploration in Merkel cell carcinoma may offer a novel treatment option for this rare disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced Merkel cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Anti-tumor activity of FF-10850 (liposomal topotecan) in patients with advanced Merkel cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: No significant difference in analgesic efficacy was observed between duloxetine and pregabalin in patients with opioid-refractory neuropathic cancer pain. Pain reduction and response rates suggested clinically meaningful analgesic effects for both drugs, but the relatively high incidence and distinct profiles of adverse events warrant careful, individualized treatment selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult cancer patients with opioid-refractory neuropathic cancer pain.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An international phase III randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial comparing duloxetine and pregabalin for opioid-refractory neuropathic cancer pain.

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage III locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I light-dose escalation study in locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: Intra-arterial (IA) padeliporfin vascular-targeted photodynamic therapy (VTP).

data.clinical_result_summary: Delayed administration of sodium thiosulfate significantly reduced cisplatin-induced ototoxicity without compromising antitumor efficacy in Japanese pediatric and adolescent patients. These findings confirmed the reproducibility of sodium thiosulfate otoprotection across populations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: cisplatin-induced ototoxicity in pediatric and adolescent patients with cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effects of delayed sodium thiosulfate on cisplatin-induced ototoxicity in pediatric and adolescent patients with cancer: Results from the Japanese Children’s Cancer Group STS-J01 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Early on-treatment body weight velocity was consistently associated with overall survival during pembrolizumab therapy in lung cancer patients. Weight-velocity metabotyping may complement tumor and host biomarkers for pragmatic risk stratification and supportive-care assessment, supporting scalable value-conscious care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with lung cancer (ICD-10 C34.x) who were treated with pembrolizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Metabotyping using early body weight velocity in lung cancer patients treated with pembrolizumab.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 影像学无进展生存率（rPFS rate）
data.clinical_result_summary: Dual PD-1/CTLA4 immune checkpoint blockade with platinum doublet chemotherapy was effective in patients with AVPC/NEPC, producing greater efficacy than expected with historic platinum chemotherapy alone. Toxicity was acceptable given disease risk, and the findings support randomized controlled clinical trials of chemoimmunotherapy in patients with NEPC/AVPC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with neuroendocrine or aggressive variant metastatic prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 multicenter trial of chemoimmunotherapy for patients with neuroendocrine or aggressive variant metastatic prostate cancer (CHAMP).

data.clinical_result_summary: The MTD of naI-IRI on days 1 and 15 combined with fruquintinib using a 3-week on/1-week off schedule every 4 weeks was 50 mg/m2. The combination regimen showed an acceptable safety profile and promising efficacy in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer who had progressed on at least 2 lines of standard therapies and failed irinotecan-based treatment, warranting further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer who progressed on ≥ 2L of standard therapies and failed irinotecan-based treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of liposomal irinotecan plus fruquintinib as third- or later-line therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: HSK41959 was well tolerated without unexpected safety issues in patients with MTAP-deleted solid tumors. Preliminary efficacy data demonstrated favorable antitumor activity, and the trial is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MTAP-deleted advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I study of HSK41959, an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in patients with MTAP-deleted advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In zanidatamab-treated patients, most diarrhea events were grade 1/2, and first-onset events tended to occur in cycle 1 and resolved in less than 3 weeks. Diarrhea rarely led to zanidatamab discontinuation. The safety of zanidatamab-containing regimens appears favorable given the survival benefits, and diarrhea should be managed with prophylactic loperamide and chemotherapy dose modifications as needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had previously untreated, first-line HER2-positive locally advanced or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Characterization and management of gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events (AEs) with zanidatamab + chemotherapy (CT) ± tislelizumab in first-line (1L) HER2-positive (HER2+) locally advanced or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (mGEA): Analysis from HERIZON-GEA-01.

These results support tarlatamab as the second-line standard of care for small cell lung cancer, including in patients with brain metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with small cell lung cancer following progression on or after platinum-based chemotherapy, with stable asymptomatic brain metastases; prior CNS treatment was required until protocol amendment 3.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial efficacy of tarlatamab versus chemotherapy (CTx) as second-line (2L) treatment for small cell lung cancer (SCLC): DeLLphi-304 phase 3 post hoc analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The short-course 12-week de-escalated neoadjuvant paclitaxel, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab regimen demonstrated high efficacy in patients with HER2-positive early breast cancer, particularly in the HR-negative/HER2-positive subgroup. The regimen showed a favorable safety and adherence profile, with no febrile neutropenia and a 100% completion rate, and may represent a promising chemo-light option for selected patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with histologically confirmed HER2-positive early breast cancer, defined as IHC 3+ or ISH+, with clinical stages T0-1N1M0 or T2-3N0-1M0.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of a short-course (12-week) de-escalated neoadjuvant regimen (weekly paclitaxel/trastuzumab/pertuzumab) in early HER2-positive breast cancer: Interim analysis of a prospective study.

clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with cancer receiving a bone marrow aspiration and biopsy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized controlled pilot study of aromatherapy to reduce anxiety and pain during bone marrow aspiration and biopsy.
