clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with histologically confirmed HER2-positive early breast cancer, defined as IHC 3+ or ISH+, with clinical stages T0-1N1M0 or T2-3N0-1M0.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of a short-course (12-week) de-escalated neoadjuvant regimen (weekly paclitaxel/trastuzumab/pertuzumab) in early HER2-positive breast cancer: Interim analysis of a prospective study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 下一线治疗的无进展生存期（PFS2）
首次后线治疗后无疾病进展生存时间（PFS2）
data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer who had completed 4–6 cycles of immunochemotherapy as induction therapy without disease progression subsequently received maintenance therapy with immunotherapy combined with anlotinib. This approach demonstrated favorable survival outcomes and manageable toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were 18 years or older in China with histologically or cytologically confirmed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer and had completed 4–6 cycles of first-line immunochemotherapy as induction therapy without disease progression.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A retrospective real-world study on the efficacy and safety of anlotinib in combination with immunotherapy as maintenance therapy after standard immunochemotherapy for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ALTER-L059).

data.clinical_result_summary: 68Ga-AKY-2519 PET/CT imaging of various malignancies was safe and demonstrated high tumor-to-background uptake and cancerous lesion detection at 120 min post injection. Normal tissue uptake was low, and robust tumor uptake was noted across different solid tumors, indicating therapeutic potential and warranting further clinical development of 225Ac-AKY-2519.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced solid tumors, including prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, small cell lung cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human PET/CT imaging with 68Ga-AKY-2519, a B7-H3 targeted miniprotein radioconjugate, to demonstrate tumor uptake and normal tissue exposure across various advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: TRK-950, as monotherapy and with nivolumab, was safe and tolerable in Japanese patients with advanced solid tumors. Durable antitumor activity with monotherapy supports continued development, and both weekly and every-2-week combination dosing regimens were safely administered.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Japanese patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I trial of the anti-CAPRIN1 antibody TRK-950 alone or with nivolumab in Japanese patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of FNC with PD-1 and VEGFR inhibitors was safe and well-tolerated, with encouraging clinical activity in advanced/metastatic pMMR/MSS colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors - CRC
patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of azvudine (FNC) in phase 1 investigator-initiated study in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, vorasidenib was used by both treatment-naive and previously treated patients with IDH-mutant glioma. Refill rates and treatment adherence were generally high across follow-up periods, but longer follow-up is needed to evaluate clinical outcomes and long-term adherence.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with a confirmed diagnosis of glioma, at least one vorasidenib prescription claim on or after August 2024, surgery or biopsy within ±90 days of first glioma diagnosis, at least 365 days of continuous enrollment before index glioma diagnosis through vorasidenib initiation, and no diagnosis of other cancers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world assessment of treatment adherence among vorasidenib-treated patients with IDH-mutant glioma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results from the DART-PCS trial demonstrate promising antitumor activity and an acceptable safety profile for pegylated liposomal doxorubicin, dacarbazine, and toripalimab in patients with advanced primary cardiac sarcoma. Further validation is warranted upon completion of the study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic primary cardiac sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary results of pegylated liposomal doxorubicin, dacarbazine, and toripalimab in patients with advanced primary cardiac sarcoma: An interim analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In treatment-naïve patients with advanced NSCLC, golidocitinib plus sintilimab following chemo-immunotherapy demonstrated encouraging and durable anti-tumor efficacy, particularly in those with high PD-L1 expression. A profound decrease in immune-related adverse effects was observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with PD-L1 positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer without driver mutations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Combination of golidocitinib (a JAK1 inhibitor) with anti–PD-1 antibody to improve tumor response and patient quality of life: Preliminary results from an ongoing JACKPOT 33 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Atebimetinib in combination with modified gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel demonstrated favorable safety and promising efficacy compared with historic standard-of-care gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel in advanced or metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. A phase 3 registrational trial evaluating atebimetinib plus modified gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel versus standard-of-care gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel is planned to start in mid-2026.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pancreatic Cancer Patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Results from a phase 2a study of atebimetinib in combination with mGnP in advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant pembrolizumab after radical surgery for patients with high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma improved disease-free survival without negatively affecting HRQOL. These HRQOL results add further support to adjuvant immune checkpoint blockade therapy in these patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma after radical surgery.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Health-related quality of life (HRQOL) with pembrolizumab or observation for high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma after surgery: Results from the AMBASSADOR randomized trial (Alliance A031501).

data.clinical_result_summary: 68Ga-AKY-2519 PET/CT imaging of various malignancies was safe and demonstrated high tumor-to-background uptake and cancerous lesion detection at 120 min post injection. Normal tissue uptake was low, and robust tumor uptake was noted across different solid tumors, indicating therapeutic potential and warranting further clinical development of 225Ac-AKY-2519.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced solid tumors, including prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, small cell lung cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human PET/CT imaging with 68Ga-AKY-2519, a B7-H3 targeted miniprotein radioconjugate, to demonstrate tumor uptake and normal tissue exposure across various advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this first window-of-opportunity study in adenoid cystic carcinoma, AL101 demonstrated biological target modulation. MYB overexpression and NOTCH signaling activity, rather than NICD1 modulation or NOTCH1 mutation, correlated with tumor shrinkage. These findings provide translational insights and support biomarker-driven development of rational combination strategies in NOTCH1-activated adenoid cystic carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with NOTCH1 pathway-activated adenoid cystic carcinoma were eligible, with Notch1 pathway activation required by cleaved Notch (NICD1) immunohistochemistry showing ≥ 70% nuclear staining; 8 patients were newly diagnosed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Window of opportunity study of the Notch inhibitor AL101 in Notch1 activated adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC): Biological effects and biomarker correlates.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of FNC with PD-1 and VEGFR inhibitors was safe and well-tolerated, with encouraging clinical activity in advanced/metastatic pMMR/MSS colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors - CRC
patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of azvudine (FNC) in phase 1 investigator-initiated study in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective cohort, outcomes with enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab were more modest than those reported in the pivotal trial, and treatment discontinuation due to toxicity was common. Lower dose intensity was associated with longer progression-free survival but not overall survival, suggesting that judicious dose adjustment may help balance efficacy and tolerability.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with urothelial carcinoma who received enfortumab vedotin with or without pembrolizumab at the Medical University of South Carolina in a retrospective, single-center study.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world retrospective analysis of outcomes, treatment duration, dose intensity, and safety of enfortumab vedotin with or without pembrolizumab in urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Utidelone plus fruquintinib demonstrated encouraging efficacy for the treatment of platinum-resistant ovarian cancer with a tolerable safety profile. The study is still actively ongoing, and further data will be provided at the time of presentation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer, or primary peritoneal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of utidelone plus fruquintinib for the treatment of platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer (FRUTD trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, durvalumab was associated with statistically superior overall survival compared with atezolizumab. COVID mRNA vaccination improved overall outcomes, but the survival advantage for durvalumab remained, including in patients with brain metastases. This real-world database analysis suggests significant outcome differences between PD-L1 inhibitors and warrants further prospective clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study compared first-line outcomes of atezolizumab versus durvalumab in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, including patients with brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival in patients with extensive stage small cell lung cancer treated with durvalumab instead of atezolizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: Alterations in the WNT pathway had positive prognostic significance in patients with gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer who achieved disease control after 3 months of FOX. TP53 pathway alterations may help guide the choice of PTX+RAM switch maintenance, while HRDsig+ was not predictive of sensitivity to FOX in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer who achieved disease control after 3 months of induction FOX chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of molecular profile on switch maintenance to paclitaxel plus ramucirumab (PTX-RAM) versus continuation of first-line fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin (FOX) chemotherapy (ChT) in patients (pts) with advanced HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction (G/GEJ) cancer: An exploratory endpoint of the ARMANI phase 3 randomized trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: IBI363 plus platinum-based doublet-chemotherapy was well tolerated and showed encouraging efficacy in advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetic data supported 3-1.5 mg/kg as the recommended dose.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: squamous vs non-squamous, and PD-L1 TPS < 1% vs 1-49%
data.clinical_result_paper_title: IBI363 (TAK-928) plus chemotherapy as first-line (1L) treatment for advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: This large real-world analysis provides a contemporary assessment of doxorubicin and paclitaxel in advanced Kaposi sarcoma. HIV+ status was associated with higher overall survival and estimated progression-free survival in the doxorubicin cohort, whereas HIV- status was associated with higher estimated progression-free survival in the paclitaxel cohort. Limitations include the retrospective design and imperfect reliability of time to next-line treatment or death as a surrogate for progression-free survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced Kaposi sarcoma, including HIV-associated Kaposi sarcoma, identified by ICD-10-CM code C46 and ICD-O-3 code 9140/3, who received doxorubicin or paclitaxel since 2010; patients with a history of lymphoma, cervical cancer, anal cancer, or solid organ transplantation were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of doxorubicin and paclitaxel in advanced Kaposi sarcoma: A TriNetX retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: V600E and V600K mutations do not appear to be associated with different outcomes after adjuvant dabrafenib and trametinib in resected stage III melanoma. The findings do not explain the differences seen in the Combi-AD trial, and longer follow-up is needed to confirm these results.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resected stage III BRAF V600-mutated melanoma who received adjuvant dabrafenib and trametinib therapy; only patients with V600E and V600K mutations were selected.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcome of adjuvant BRAF and MEK inhibition with dabrafenib and trametinib in BRAF V600K– compared to V600E-mutated melanoma.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 中位无颅内进展生存期
data.clinical_result_summary: Concurrent whole-brain radiotherapy and intrathecal PD-1 blockade demonstrated potent synergistic activity in melanoma leptomeningeal metastasis, producing unprecedented survival outcomes without amplifying toxicity. The findings suggest that radiotherapy may prime the cerebrospinal fluid microenvironment for enhanced immune checkpoint efficacy, and this multimodal strategy warrants validation in prospective randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients with melanoma leptomeningeal metastasis treated with intrathecal PD-1 antibodies at a single center between June 2022 and December 2024.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位无颅内进展生存期
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Synergistic efficacy of intrathecal PD-1 blockade combined with whole-brain radiotherapy for melanoma leptomeningeal metastases: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab combined with axitinib demonstrated encouraging efficacy and tolerability as first-line therapy in advanced non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma across subtypes in this multi-center phase Ib/II study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic nccRCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective, multi-center, phase Ib/II trial of first-line cadonilimab plus axitinib in advanced non–clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Aromatherapy using lavender and linalool during bone marrow aspiration and biopsy was feasible and safe. It was potentially associated with meaningful reductions in procedural anxiety and pain, supporting a larger randomized controlled trial to confirm efficacy and explore integration into routine supportive oncology care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with cancer receiving a bone marrow aspiration and biopsy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized controlled pilot study of aromatherapy to reduce anxiety and pain during bone marrow aspiration and biopsy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant radiotherapy combined with lenvatinib and sintilimab produced a high tumor response rate in patients with resectable hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus and had a favorable safety profile. Portal vein tumor thrombus demonstrated a higher response rate than primary hepatocellular carcinoma lesions, and these interim results support further investigation of this approach in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant radiotherapy combined with lenvatinib and sintilimab in patients with resectable hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus: An open-label, single-arm, multicenter, prospective phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Larotrectinib evoked long antitumor responses in solid tumours with NTRK fusion in the real world, regardless of tumor type. No safety concerns were reported, even after long-term administration. The authors stated that screening techniques such as NGS should be implemented and that broader access is required.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult and paediatric patients in Spain with a confirmed diagnosis of solid neoplasms bearing NTRK fusions who were treated with larotrectinib through a compassionate drug use program, excluding patients treated with larotrectinib in clinical trials.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of larotrectinib in solid tumors with tropomyosin receptor kinase fusion (GETNE S2411/SPAINTRK).

data.clinical_result_summary: Liver function test abnormalities were highly prevalent during temozolomide therapy for IDH-wildtype glioblastoma, and about one-fifth of patients experienced Grade ≥3 toxicity, most often with a mixed injury pattern. Higher-grade hepatotoxicity was not associated with compromised overall survival, supporting close monitoring and individualized management.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective study included IDH-wildtype glioblastoma patients treated with temozolomide.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Characterization and clinical impact of temozolomide-induced hepatotoxicity in IDH-wild type glioblastoma: A comprehensive analysis of injury patterns, CTCAE grade transitions, and survival outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adebrelimab in combination with anlotinib and chemotherapy as neoadjuvant therapy showed a high proportion of major pathological response and pathological complete response for resectable stage II-III non-small cell lung cancer. The safety profile was well tolerated, and larger future clinical studies are needed for validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable stage II-III non-small cell lung cancer without EGFR/ALK/ROS1 alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adebrelimab in combination with anlotinib and chemotherapy as neoadjuvant therapy for resectable stage II-III non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): A prospective, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Interim effectiveness results support niraparib as an effective first-line maintenance therapy for newly diagnosed advanced ovarian cancer patients in the Taiwanese population, with consistent benefit across genetic subgroups. Ongoing long-term follow-up will further substantiate the durability of niraparib's benefit in a real-world setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled Taiwanese patients with newly diagnosed FIGO stage III–IV epithelial ovarian cancer who achieved complete response or partial response to frontline platinum-based chemotherapy following either primary or interval debulking surgery, irrespective of residual disease status, and who initiated niraparib first-line maintenance therapy on or after January 1, 2022.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An observational study to investigate the effectiveness and safety of niraparib maintenance therapy after frontline chemotherapy for Taiwanese patients with advanced ovarian cancer: Interim results.

data.clinical_result_summary: BGB-43395, a CDK4-selective inhibitor, in combination with letrozole demonstrated a favorable safety profile with low hematologic and manageable gastrointestinal toxicity in first-line treatment of patients with advanced HR+/HER2− breast cancer. Antitumor activity was promising, and the 400 mg and 240 mg BID doses showed efficacy and safety supporting further development with letrozole.
clinical_result_indication_detail: CDK4/6i-naive patients with advanced/metastatic HR+/HER2− breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First disclosure of frontline treatment (1L tx) with the selective CDK4 inhibitor BGB-43395 in combination with letrozole for metastatic HR+/HER2− breast cancer (BC): A phase 1 safety expansion.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study used a lower total radiation dose delivered in larger fractions combined with intratumoral administration of immunotherapy and achieved comparable disease control with manageable toxicity in extremity soft tissue sarcoma. The approach may be clinically valuable for patients with recurrent disease after multiple surgeries or those with prior exposure to local radiotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with pathologically confirmed extremity soft tissue sarcoma without metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neo-adjuvant radiation and intratumoral immunotherapy followed by surgery: The NARIS trial for extremity soft tissue sarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this international real-world cohort of premenopausal women with stage I HR+/HER2+ breast cancer, IDFS at 80 months was high across chemotherapy, endocrine therapy, and age subgroups. As de-escalated taxane-only regimens become more common and endocrine therapy strategies evolve, these data provide clinically relevant context for systemic therapy selection in young women with excellent-prognosis disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with stage I breast cancer; premenopausal women (≤45 years) with HR+/HER2+ early breast cancer; and young women with stage I HR+/HER2+ breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: De-escalated chemotherapy and endocrine therapy outcomes in young women with stage I HR+/HER2+ breast cancer: An international real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Peri-dose troponin elevations are common during post-TIL high-dose IL-2, and higher post-dose troponin independently identifies clinically significant cardiac toxicity and predicts IL-2 interruption. Baseline troponin modestly predicts peak elevations, supporting standardized, risk-stratified troponin monitoring and prospective evaluation of toxicity-adaptive IL-2 delivery strategies in TIL therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic melanoma treated with TIL therapy followed by inpatient high-dose IL-2 at Mayo Clinic Rochester.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Influence of peri-dose high-sensitivity troponin on clinically significant cardiac events and IL-2 interruption during post-TIL high-dose IL-2 therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: ZG006 demonstrated a robust and durable response and a manageable safety profile in previously treated patients with neuroendocrine carcinoma, with superior efficacy observed at the 30 mg dose. The confirmed ORR of 56.3% and median PFS of 8.41 months in patients with ≥50% DLL3-positive tumor cells were particularly encouraging and support further development of ZG006 at the 30 mg dose.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced neuroendocrine carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase II dose optimization study for alveltamig (ZG006), a trispecific T-cell engager targeting DLL3/DLL3/CD3, as monotherapy in patients with refractory neuroendocrine carcinoma (ZG006-003).

data.clinical_result_summary: A single intratumoral injection of Zeta-BC-003 prevented skeletal-related events and fractures, reduced lytic defect volume, improved spinal stability, decreased pain and opioid use, improved quality of life, and showed complete tumor response in treated lesions. The treatment was well tolerated with no treatment-emergent serious adverse events or adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Female patients with spinal metastatic breast cancer lytic bone lesions
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的严重不良事件
治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Changes in metastatic breast cancer (MBC) bone lesions and SREs/fractures via a single intratumoral injection for a first-of-its-kind drug: Preliminary phase 2a results.

data.clinical_result_summary: HLX43 showed promising efficacy with a manageable safety profile in patients with recurrent/metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma who had progressed after second-line or later chemotherapy and PD-(L)1 inhibitors. Further investigation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent/metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of HLX43 (an anti–PD-L1 ADC) in previously treated recurrent/metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma: A multicenter, randomized phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In routine clinical practice, nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with chemotherapy demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy as first-line therapy for metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, independent of PD-L1 expression. Development of grade ≥3 toxicity was associated with improved progression-free survival and overall survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer without actionable driver mutations, particularly patients with PD-L1-negative disease, who received nivolumab plus ipilimumab with platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line systemic therapy at Moscow City Oncology Hospital No. 62.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab with chemotherapy as first-line therapy for NSCLC: A single-center real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma, bispecific antibodies were associated with substantially lower early immune-mediated toxicity and healthcare utilization compared with CAR-T therapy. Infectious and delayed immune complications were similar between groups, providing important safety data for newer bispecific agents.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or follicular lymphoma treated with bispecific antibodies or CAR-T therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world toxicity of bispecific antibodies versus CAR-T cell therapy in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: The immunohistochemistry assays assessing CLDN18.2 expression with EPR19202 and CLDN18 expression with 43-14A showed comparable analytical performance and high concordance. Efficacy outcomes were aligned across antibody-defined expression strata, supporting the use of either antibody to identify patient populations with similar clinical benefit during development of XNW27011 for gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated patients with gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma who were treated with XNW27011 at doses of 2.4–6.0 mg/kg administered intravenously every 3 weeks.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of CLDN18/CLDN18.2 IHC assays (43-14A vs EPR19202) and the correlation with clinical efficacy in patients with gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma treated by the novel antibody-drug conjugate XNW27011.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adding a PD-1 antibody to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy conferred a superior disease-free survival benefit compared with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy alone in patients with mismatch repair-proficient locally advanced rectal cancer, particularly in older patients and those with extramural venous invasion-positive tumors. The combination may have influenced the pattern of metastasis, and MUC16 mutations warrant further investigation as a potential predictive biomarker for sensitivity to the combination therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pMMR locally advanced rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term survival and biomarker analysis of neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy with or without PD-1 antibody sintilimab in pMMR locally advanced rectal cancer: A randomized clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this national cohort, pembrolizumab and nivolumab showed equivalent effectiveness as first-line therapies for advanced/unresectable or metastatic melanoma. The findings support interchangeability of the two anti-PD1 agents in real-world practice, with no clear safety difference detected by the corticosteroid-use proxy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced/unresectable or metastatic melanoma were included, while patients with known BRAF mutations at immunotherapy initiation and those treated with ipilimumab/nivolumab were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative effectiveness of pembrolizumab and nivolumab as first-line treatment for advanced/unresectable or metastatic melanoma: A propensity-score adjusted analysis from a US national health system.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world, propensity-matched analysis, non-selective β-blocker use was associated with improved early survival and reduced healthcare utilization among melanoma and lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors. These findings suggest that non-selective β-blockers may represent a low-cost and available adjunct to immunotherapy and warrant prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged 18 years or older with melanoma or lung cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors were included and categorized by exposure to non-selective or selective β-blockers within two months before or at immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of β-blocker selectivity with survival and immune-related outcomes in melanoma and lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tinengotinib demonstrated durable clinical anti-tumor activity and a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated patients with cholangiocarcinoma harboring FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement after prior chemotherapy and FGFR inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Chinese patients with advanced/metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tinengotinib (TT-00420) in advanced/metastatic FGFR2-altered cholangiocarcinoma following prior chemotherapy and FGFR inhibitor treatment: Results from a phase II study (FIRST-08).

data.clinical_result_summary: FIGHT-302 was the first phase 3 trial of a targeted therapy for untreated metastatic cholangiocarcinoma. Pemigatinib demonstrated superior activity and prolonged median progression-free survival compared with first-line chemotherapy, while safety was consistent with previous results. The results confirm the current management paradigm of pemigatinib administration after disease progression on chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated unresectable/metastatic cholangiocarcinoma with fibroblast growth factor receptor-2 rearrangement
clinical_result_layer_factor: previous receipt of 1 chemotherapy cycle, geographic region, and tumor burden
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pemigatinib for untreated unresectable/metastatic cholangiocarcinoma (mCCA) with fibroblast growth factor receptor-2 (FGFR2) rearrangement: Phase 3 FIGHT-302 results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Spevatamig 2 mg/kg QW or 3 mg/kg QW plus GnP was well tolerated, with no significant additive toxicity compared with the adverse event profile anticipated with GnP alone. Additional efficacy data from patients treated at the 2 mg/kg QW spevatamig plus GnP dose level continued to demonstrate promise in frontline metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, while enrollment into the 3 mg/kg QW dose level was ongoing with maturing efficacy data.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with first-line metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) exhibiting ≥ 10% moderate to strong tumor cell staining for CLDN18.2.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Spevatamig (PT886), a claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2)/CD47 bispecific antibody, in combination with gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (GnP) in frontline (1L) treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, durvalumab was associated with statistically superior overall survival compared with atezolizumab. COVID mRNA vaccination improved overall outcomes, but the survival advantage for durvalumab remained, including in patients with brain metastases. This real-world database analysis suggests significant outcome differences between PD-L1 inhibitors and warrants further prospective clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study compared first-line outcomes of atezolizumab versus durvalumab in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, including patients with brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival in patients with extensive stage small cell lung cancer treated with durvalumab instead of atezolizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: YL201 monotherapy showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in pretreated patients with advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. These results warrant further investigation of YL201 in a randomized controlled trial for patients with advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma in the 2L+ setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously treated advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1/2 study of YL201, an anti-B7H3 antibody–drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with previously treated advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Synergistic efficacy of intrathecal PD-1 blockade combined with whole-brain radiotherapy for melanoma leptomeningeal metastases: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Utidelone plus fruquintinib demonstrated encouraging efficacy for the treatment of platinum-resistant ovarian cancer with a tolerable safety profile. The study is still actively ongoing, and further data will be provided at the time of presentation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer, or primary peritoneal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of utidelone plus fruquintinib for the treatment of platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer (FRUTD trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: In participants with clear cell renal cell carcinoma treated with adjuvant pembrolizumab or placebo in KEYNOTE-564, ctDNA positivity was associated with worse disease-free survival regardless of assay used. ctDNA clearance was higher with pembrolizumab than with placebo, but the assays had low sensitivity for predicting outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants with clear cell renal cell carcinoma at increased risk of recurrence post nephrectomy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ctDNA analysis in participants with renal cell carcinoma treated with adjuvant pembrolizumab or placebo in the KEYNOTE-564 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: BRL-301 demonstrated promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile in patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, with no evidence of graft-versus-host disease or severe neurotoxicity. These results support further development of allogeneic CAR-T therapy as a viable treatment option for relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Allogeneic CD19-targeted CAR-T therapy (BRL-301) for relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (r/r B-ALL).

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary findings suggest Romiplostim N01 may be effective in promoting platelet recovery with a manageable safety profile in leukemia patients with cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia. Final results will provide further evidence for its clinical application.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的血小板减少
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with leukemia who developed cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia after antitumor therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II, single-arm study of romiplostim N01 for cancer treatment–induced thrombocytopenia in leukemia patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: SYS6010 combined with Enlonstobart showed promising clinical activity in patients with recurrent or metastatic esophageal cancer. The regimen had a manageable safety profile and may represent a novel effective treatment option, supporting further clinical development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic esophageal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary safety and efficacy of SYS6010 combined with enlonstobart in patients with recurrent or metastatic esophageal cancer: Results from a phase I/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Considering the limitations of the study data, the results support ASP-1929 photoimmunotherapy as a tolerable and clinically active treatment option for locoregional, recurrent head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The abstract also supports ongoing evaluation of ASP-1929 photoimmunotherapy in the current randomized global Phase 3 ASP-1929-381 study.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locoregional, recurrent head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world, heavily pretreated cutaneous T cell lymphoma cohort, mogamulizumab retreatment demonstrated meaningful clinical activity with durable responses despite prior exposure. Although rash was common, it was usually low to moderate grade, manageable with standard measures, and retreatment or rechallenge after resolution was feasible.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with cutaneous T cell lymphoma treated with mogamulizumab, with retreatment defined as reinitiation after a >90-day treatment-free interval.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of mogamulizumab retreatment in cutaneous T-cell lymphoma: A single-center retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Asciminib showed clinically meaningful activity in a heavily pretreated veteran population with chronic myeloid leukemia. BCR-ABL levels improved by 6 months and safety was favorable, with low rates of neutropenia and thrombocytopenia.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Veterans nationwide with chronic myeloid leukemia who were treated with asciminib prior to August 2025, including patients with chronic myeloid leukemia following failure of first- and second-generation TKIs.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of asciminib in veterans with chronic myeloid leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: HSK41959 was well tolerated without unexpected safety issues in patients with MTAP-deleted solid tumors. Preliminary efficacy data demonstrated favorable antitumor activity, and the trial is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MTAP-deleted advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase I study of HSK41959, an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in patients with MTAP-deleted advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched analysis, lenvatinib and sorafenib demonstrated equivalent median overall survival in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. However, lenvatinib was associated with significantly higher rates of hepatic encephalopathy, acute kidney injury, and new-onset hypertension, which may inform treatment selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma initiating first-line lenvatinib or sorafenib were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of first-line lenvatinib versus sorafenib in advanced HCC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Involved-field radiotherapy after effective systemic therapy significantly improved progression-free survival and overall survival with manageable toxicity. These findings highlight its potential role in the management of stage III follicular lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Stage III Follicular Lymphoma Patients Response to R-CHOP Chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Invasive-field radiotherapy plus rituximab versus rituximab alone after response to immunochemotherapy in stage III follicular lymphoma: An open-label, multicenter, randomized clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In real-world practice, approximately one in five previously treated patients with metastatic colorectal cancer achieve durable benefit with trifluridine/tipiracil plus bevacizumab. Identification of clinical factors associated with long-term response may support improved patient selection in later-line treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Consecutive patients with previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer receiving trifluridine/tipiracil plus bevacizumab after failure or intolerance to at least 2 prior regimens.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term responders to trifluridine/tipiracil plus bevacizumab in previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer: Results from the BeTAS real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: BRAF/MEK inhibitor induction prior to dual immune checkpoint inhibition did not improve response rates to immune checkpoint inhibitors and was associated with worse progression-free survival and overall survival in patients with BRAF V600E/K-mutated melanoma and elevated LDH compared with upfront dual immune checkpoint inhibition.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment naïve patients with unresectable stage III or stage IV BRAF V600E/K mutation-positive melanoma and elevated baseline LDH levels
clinical_result_layer_factor: LDH
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Combination of vemurafenib with cobimetinib in BRAF V600E/K mutated melanoma patients to normalize LDH and optimize immunotherapy with nivolumab and ipilimumab (COWBOY): A randomized, open-label phase 2 clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world Peruvian cohort of Luminal A early breast cancer, nodal involvement and higher stage were stronger prognostic factors. Lower 5-year RFS and OS than typically reported may reflect higher baseline anatomic risk and tertiary-center case mix. In stage IIA, the association between chemotherapy use and recurrence reflects treatment selection based on clinicopathological risk and chemotherapy prioritization for high-risk patients lacking genomic stratification.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with Luminal A early breast cancer, defined as ER/PgR-positive, HER2-negative, and ki-67≤20% by immunohistochemistry, were treated at a public cancer center in Peru from 2018 to 2022.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes and prognostic factors in luminal A (LumA) early breast cancer (EBC): Real-world evidence from a public cancer center in Peru.

data.clinical_result_summary: Dostarlimab and niraparib with chemoradiotherapy showed promising efficacy results in this preliminary analysis of patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. However, maintenance treatment after chemoradiotherapy was poorly tolerated and led to a high rate of discontinuation.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Niraparib and dostarlimab in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (LA-HNSCC) treated with (chemo)radiotherapy (CRT): Results from the phase IB-II TTCC-2022-01 RADIAN trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: KM1 showed selective replication, oncolysis, and immune activation in preclinical models. Early clinical data suggest favorable safety and promising antitumor activity of intravesical KM1 in non–muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: NMIBC patients who had failed prior BCG therapy or declined further BCG.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A novel oncolytic vaccinia virus armed with IL-21 and 4-1BBL for intravesical treatment of NMIBC: Preclinical efficacy and first-in-human safety evaluation.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, adjuvant nivolumab was associated with superior overall survival compared with platinum-based chemotherapy when initiated within comparable postoperative intervals after radical cystectomy. These findings support the effectiveness of adjuvant nivolumab in routine clinical practice and reinforce its role as a preferred postoperative systemic therapy in eligible patients, although results should be interpreted cautiously due to limited sample size.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with bladder cancer who underwent radical cystectomy followed by adjuvant nivolumab or platinum-based chemotherapy, excluding patients who underwent neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant nivolumab compared with platinum-based chemotherapy in bladder cancer: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of monalizumab to first-line platinum/etoposide plus durvalumab led to no new severe adverse events in patients with extensive stage small cell lung cancer. However, estimated 1-year progression-free survival was not statistically superior to historical control, although a subset of patients, including those with baseline brain metastasis, derived durable benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated extensive stage small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Monalizumab plus durvalumab plus platinum-based chemotherapy for first-line treatment of extensive stage small-cell lung cancer: Early efficacy results from MOZART trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: In this ongoing trial, continuous, oral once-daily APR-1051 had a manageable safety profile in patients with pretreated advanced solid tumors. Preliminary signals of antitumor activity were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced solid tumor and cancer-associated gene alterations, prior standard-of-care systemic treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early results from the first-in-human phase 1 study of WEE1 inhibitor APR-1051 in patients with advanced solid tumors (ACESOT-1051).

data.clinical_result_summary: Azeliragon at 50 mg/day in combination with standard radiotherapy and temozolomide was safe, with no dose-limiting toxicities reported. More mature overall survival data are needed, and further follow-up in a larger number of patients is required to assess preliminary efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed IDH wild-type glioblastoma with MGMT methylation locally available and with tumor resection
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Azeliragon, a RAGE inhibitor, plus temozolomide and radiotherapy in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma: Final results from a dose-finding phase in the CAN-201 NDG trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adebrelimab combined with nab-paclitaxel and carboplatin demonstrated promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile as first-line therapy for advanced or recurrent thymic carcinoma. The regimen offers a new potential treatment option for this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or recurrent thymic carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II, single-arm trial of adebrelimab plus nab-paclitaxel and carboplatin as first-line therapy for advanced thymic carcinoma: Interim efficacy and safety results.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of necitumumab to pembrolizumab and platinum-based chemotherapy demonstrated manageable toxicity and resulted in a high objective response rate in patients with untreated squamous non-small cell lung cancer. These findings support the potential activity of EGFR blockade-based immunochemotherapy and warrant further clinical investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated advanced squamous non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Necitumumab plus pembrolizumab and chemotherapy for untreated advanced squamous NSCLC: Phase I/II NEJ048A/NEXUS.
