data.clinical_result_summary: Proglumide is safe in patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and the recommended phase 2 dose is 1200 mg PO daily with standard-dose gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel. Proglumide remodels the tumor microenvironment by decreasing fibrosis and immunosuppression while increasing T-cell infiltration, supporting further investigation in phase 2 trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Proglumide, gemcitabine (GEM), and nab-paclitaxel (NAB-P) in patients (pts) with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC): Results of the phase 1 PROGEM trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world propensity-matched analysis, first-line enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab was associated with improved overall survival and lower healthcare utilization compared with platinum-based chemotherapy in metastatic urothelial carcinoma. These findings support the effectiveness of enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab in routine clinical practice and provide complementary evidence to randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients older than 18 years with metastatic urothelial carcinoma initiating first-line enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab or platinum-based chemotherapy between January 2020 and December 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab compared with platinum-based chemotherapy in metastatic urothelial carcinoma in a propensity-matched global analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world Peruvian cohort of Luminal A early breast cancer, nodal involvement and higher stage were stronger prognostic factors. Lower 5-year RFS and OS than typically reported may reflect higher baseline anatomic risk and tertiary-center case mix. In stage IIA, the association between chemotherapy use and recurrence reflects treatment selection based on clinicopathological risk and chemotherapy prioritization for high-risk patients lacking genomic stratification.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with Luminal A early breast cancer, defined as ER/PgR-positive, HER2-negative, and ki-67≤20% by immunohistochemistry, were treated at a public cancer center in Peru from 2018 to 2022.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes and prognostic factors in luminal A (LumA) early breast cancer (EBC): Real-world evidence from a public cancer center in Peru.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the FRUSICA-1 study, PPES and irAE hypothyroidism may be associated with higher ORR, longer PFS, and longer OS in previously treated advanced endometrial cancer patients with pMMR status. These adverse events could potentially be predictive of clinical outcomes during treatment with fruquintinib plus sintilimab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: EMC patients with centrally confirmed pMMR status who progressed after ≤ 2 platinum-based systemic therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of Palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia syndrome (PPES), hypothyroidism, and clinical outcomes in previously treated endometrial cancer (EMC) with pMMR status: A subgroup analysis of FRUSICA-1.

data.clinical_result_summary: 68Ga-AKY-2519 PET/CT imaging of various malignancies was safe and demonstrated high tumor-to-background uptake and cancerous lesion detection at 120 min post injection. Normal tissue uptake was low, and robust tumor uptake was noted across different solid tumors, indicating therapeutic potential and warranting further clinical development of 225Ac-AKY-2519.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced solid tumors, including prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, small cell lung cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human PET/CT imaging with 68Ga-AKY-2519, a B7-H3 targeted miniprotein radioconjugate, to demonstrate tumor uptake and normal tissue exposure across various advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Galeterone plus gemcitabine was overall well-tolerated but showed limited efficacy in an all-comer population with advanced pancreatic cancer. Two patients with prior progression on gemcitabine had prolonged disease control, suggesting a possible signal of activity in a subset of patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer who progressed after at least 1 prior line of systemic therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Galeterone and gemcitabine in advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large retrospective cohort, patients with advanced malignancies and poor performance status treated with ipilimumab plus nivolumab had markedly worse survival and response rates and substantially higher hospitalization despite fewer severe immune-related adverse events. Poor performance status was identified as a marker of limited clinical benefit from dual immune checkpoint blockade, underscoring the need for improved patient selection and alternative therapeutic strategies in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with advanced/metastatic solid tumors treated with ipilimumab plus nivolumab at an NCI-designated cancer center between January 2014 and January 2025, stratified by baseline ECOG performance status into good (0–1) and poor (≥2) groups.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of baseline performance status on survival and toxicity with ipilimumab plus nivolumab: A 10-year institutional experience across solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The insertion of platinum-doublet chemotherapy after the initial response to osimertinib could not improve progression-free survival or overall survival in patients with advanced EGFR-mutated non-squamous non-small-cell lung cancer. JCOG1404/WJOG8214L demonstrated that osimertinib-based first-line treatment achieved 5-year progression-free survival in approximately 15% of this population, providing a benchmark for emerging osimertinib-based strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had advanced or recurrent EGFR-mutated non-squamous non-small-cell lung cancer with exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R mutation, were aged 20 to 74 years, and had a performance status of 0 or 1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Five-year outcomes of osimertinib-based treatment in a phase III study comparing EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor (EGFR-TKI) monotherapy and EGFR-TKI with inserted cisplatin plus pemetrexed as a first-line treatment for advanced non-squamous non–small-cell lung cancer harboring EGFR mutation (JCOG1404/WJOG8214L).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients treated with bispecific T-cell engagers, coded severe CRS and ICANS events were uncommon and plateaued early, whereas mortality and healthcare utilization continued to accrue over time. The findings suggest that ongoing risk over follow-up likely reflects a combination of treatment-related toxicity and underlying disease progression, highlighting the need for standardized toxicity ascertainment and strategies to identify patients at highest risk for early clinical deterioration.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged ≥18 years with small cell carcinoma, B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, multiple myeloma, or acute lymphoblastic leukemia who received at least one bispecific T-cell engager were included, while patients with myeloid malignancies, non-small cell lung cancer, selected solid tumors without approved bispecific therapies, or prior chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early toxicity and temporal mortality patterns following bispecific T-cell engager therapy: A real-world multicenter analysis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral GO306 showed a favorable safety profile and manageable treatment-related adverse events in pretreated advanced soft tissue sarcomas. Preliminary efficacy supported phase I/II expansion and combination studies with other immunotherapies or targeted therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced soft tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The investigator-initiated trial (IIT) of GO306 injection, a recombinant oncolytic vaccinia virus, in patients with advanced soft tissue sarcomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: Zanzalintinib plus atezolizumab demonstrated progression-free survival and overall survival benefit regardless of atezolizumab treatment-emergent anti-drug antibody status, with greater efficacy observed in TEADA-negative patients. Exposure-response analyses showed that higher atezolizumab serum trough concentrations were associated with longer progression-free survival and overall survival, supporting the contribution of atezolizumab to the survival benefits of the combination in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer in STELLAR-303.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Contribution of atezolizumab (atezo) to the efficacy of the zanzalintinib (zanza) + atezo combination in patients (pts) with previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): Evidence from the phase 3 STELLAR-303 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This analysis confirmed the distinct and manageable safety profile of pimicotinib. Most treatment-emergent adverse events were low grade and managed through dose modifications and standard concomitant medications, enabling sustained dosing and minimal discontinuations. These findings support the longer-term tolerability of pimicotinib in tenosynovial giant cell tumor.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with symptomatic unresectable tenosynovial giant cell tumor were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adverse events and their management in patients with tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT) treated with pimicotinib, after longer-term follow-up from the global phase 3 MANEUVER trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This ongoing phase I first-in-human study is evaluating custom-manufactured chimeric antibodies targeting patient-specific Mutated cell Surface Proteins in patients with Stage IV refractory cancer. Three subjects have been enrolled, treatment has been completed for one subject with bladder cancer, and no dose-limiting toxicity has been reported to date.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with Stage IV refractory cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1, open-label clinical trial to treat stage IV cancer patients harboring multiple patient-specific mutated cell surface proteins with chimeric antibodies.

data.clinical_result_summary: Although the patient series was small, the results suggest that combining ibrutinib with high-dose methotrexate, rituximab, and cytarabine may yield good clinical results in primary and secondary central nervous system lymphoma. The combination appeared to have acceptable tolerance and an acceptable adverse effect profile.
clinical_result_indication_name: 继发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants were diagnosed with primary or secondary central nervous system lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: iMARIX for primary and secondary central nervous system lymphomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world analysis provides benchmark survival outcomes for patients with metastatic renal-cell carcinoma treated with first-line nivolumab and ipilimumab. Survival varied by sarcomatoid features, IMDC risk group, and response, and conditional survival offered additional prognostic insight over time.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic renal-cell carcinoma treated with first-line nivolumab and ipilimumab from the International mRCC Database Consortium.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab and Ipilimumab (NIVO IPI) as first-line (1L) treatment for patients with metastatic renal-cell carcinoma (mRCC): A real-world benchmarking analysis from the International mRCC Database Consortium (IMDC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant serplulimab combined with an intensified regimen of nab-paclitaxel and SOX showed promising efficacy in fit patients with locally advanced gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. This strategy significantly improved pathological complete response rates and promoted nodal downstaging, with a safety profile that did not compromise surgical feasibility. The study is ongoing, and long-term follow-up and exploratory analyses are required to further evaluate the durability and full potential of this strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant serplulimab plus nab-paclitaxel and SOX in locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: An interim analysis of a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ivonescimab combined with liposomal irinotecan demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile as second-line treatment for patients with small-cell lung cancer after platinum-based chemoimmunotherapy. These results support further investigation in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with small-cell lung cancer progressing after first-line chemoimmunotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of ivonescimab combined with liposomal irinotecan in patients with small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) progressing after first-line chemoimmunotherapy: A multicenter, phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy combined with donafenib showed encouraging efficacy and a well-tolerated safety profile in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma with a solitary large tumor and microvascular invasion. The findings suggest a potential new adjuvant treatment strategy for this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: hepatocellular carcinoma with solitary large tumor and microvascular invasion
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Postoperative adjuvant hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy combined with donafenib for hepatocellular carcinoma with solitary large tumor and microvascular invasion: A prospective, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this high-risk pN2-3 cohort with HR+/HER2- early breast cancer, adjuvant abemaciclib showed favorable real-world efficacy, with iDFS rates of 100.0%, 94.7%, and 93.5% at 12, 24, and 36 months. The safety profile was manageable with dose adjustments, supporting long-term treatment in most patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This multicenter retrospective observational study included 160 patients with HR+/HER2-negative breast cancer receiving adjuvant abemaciclib plus endocrine therapy across Moscow centers, including a pN2-3 subgroup of 135 patients.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant abemaciclib in pN2-3 patients with HR+/HER2− early breast cancer: Real-world outcomes from Moscow centers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal irinotecan combined with 5-FU/LV and bevacizumab showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile as second-line therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer. These results support this regimen as a valuable therapeutic option for patients progressing after oxaliplatin-based first-line treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic CRC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Liposomal irinotecan combined with 5-FU/LV and bevacizumab as second-line therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer: A multicenter, single-arm phase II study (IRIS).

data.clinical_result_summary: ZN-A-1041 showed manageable safety profiles and promising clinical activity when combined with standard anti-HER2 therapies in patients with HER2+ metastatic breast cancer, both with and without CNS metastases. High disease control in patients pretreated with T-DXd and notable continued responses in the PH maintenance setting support further clinical evaluation of these combinations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2+ mBC, with or without BMs (including leptomeningeal disease) (Phase Ic)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of ZN-A-1041, a highly blood-brain barrier (BBB)–permeable HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI), + trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) or pertuzumab-trastuzumab (PH) in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (HER2+ mBC): Phase Ic expansion results from the ZN-A-1041-101-US trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The use of empegfilgrastim allowed delivery of 96% relative dose intensity. Neoadjuvant TCHP with empegfilgrastim showed high efficacy in HER2-positive breast cancer across hormone receptor status and tumor stage, and HER2 expression level was a significant predictor of pathological complete response.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with HER2-positive early breast cancer treated with the neoadjuvant TCHP regimen.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of neoadjuvant TCHP with primary empegfilgrastim (E) prophylaxis in HER2-positive early breast cancer (HER2+ eBC): Final results of the DEFENDOR SPECIAL study.

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, breast cancer, penile cancer, and bone and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial evaluating an optimized B7-H3xCD3 T cell engager for treatment of solid cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: EIK1003 plus paclitaxel demonstrated a tolerable safety profile in a heavily pre-treated population, with hematologic toxicities comparable to historical paclitaxel use. The findings provide first clinical evidence that PARP1-selective inhibitors can be safely combined with chemotherapy. Extended follow-up of EIK1003 monotherapy confirmed durable tolerability with antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors, including platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer and HER2-negative breast cancer (Cohort 1C)
participants (pts) with advanced solid tumors (Cohort 1A)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EIK1003, a PARP1-selective inhibitor, in combination with paclitaxel (PTX): Initial combination and updated monotherapy results from a phase 1/2 study EIK1003-001 in advanced solid tumors.

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, breast cancer, penile cancer, and bone and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial evaluating an optimized B7-H3xCD3 T cell engager for treatment of solid cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Early initiation of adjuvant nivolumab within 60 days of radical cystectomy was associated with improved overall survival in real-world bladder cancer patients. The findings support timely postoperative initiation of immunotherapy when clinically feasible, but should be interpreted cautiously due to the limited sample size.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with bladder cancer who underwent radical cystectomy followed by adjuvant nivolumab were included, while patients who underwent neoadjuvant chemotherapy were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Timing of adjuvant nivolumab and survival outcomes in bladder cancer: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: BREAKWATER Cohort 3 demonstrated clinically meaningful and statistically significant improvements in confirmed ORR and PFS, with prolonged OS, for EC+FOLFIRI versus control in patients with BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer. The safety profile was consistent with that known for each agent, with no new safety signals. EC+FOLFIRI expands practice-changing standard-of-care options for these patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_layer_factor: ECOG PS (0 vs 1) at randomization
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BREAKWATER: Progression-free and overall survival analyses of first-line (1L) encorafenib + cetuximab (EC) + FOLFIRI in BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this exploratory analysis from ASCENT-07, sacituzumab govitecan showed numerical trends toward improved efficacy versus treatment of physician’s choice in patients with HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer and HER2 IHC0 status. The safety profile was manageable, supporting further investigation in patients who are candidates for first chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HR+/HER2−, locally advanced unresectable or metastatic breast cancer who had received prior endocrine therapy and were eligible for first chemotherapy, with HER2 IHC0 expression status.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Subgroup analysis of participants (pts) with HER2 IHC0 in the ASCENT-07 study of sacituzumab govitecan (SG) vs chemotherapy in HR+/ HER2− metastatic breast cancer (mBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Short-course radiotherapy followed by mFOLFOX-6 plus avelumab and total mesorectal excision resulted in acceptable surgical morbidity and favorable oncologic outcomes. These findings support the safety and feasibility of this chemo-immunotherapy approach in microsatellite stable locally advanced rectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced rectal cancer, specifically microsatellite stable (MSS) locally advanced rectal cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Surgical complications and perioperative outcomes following total mesorectal excision in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer treated with short-course radiotherapy and chemo-immunotherapy: Updated data from the phase II Averectal trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large, phase III, community-based trial, bupropion resulted in modest reductions in fatigue relative to placebo, particularly among women. Bupropion should be considered in the pharmacologic management of cancer-related fatigue.
clinical_result_indication_detail: moderate-to-severe CRF in adult cancer patients/survivors after completion of surgery, RT, and/or IV anticancer therapy ≥2 months prior.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nationwide randomized, phase III, placebo-controlled trial of bupropion for cancer-related fatigue: Primary outcome results.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, PCSK9 inhibitor use in patients with cancer and hyperlipidemia treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors was associated with improved overall survival and reduced healthcare utilization. The findings support ongoing prospective clinical trials evaluating potential synergistic effects of PCSK9 inhibition with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer, melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, or breast cancer who received concurrent immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy plus PCSK9 inhibitors or high-intensity statins alone for hyperlipidemia between 01/01/2011 and 01/01/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of PCSK9 inhibitors with clinical outcomes in patients with cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this target trial emulation, adding hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy to lenvatinib and PD-1 inhibitors significantly improved overall survival and progression-free survival in patients with high-risk hepatocellular carcinoma and portal vein tumor thrombus. The survival advantage was driven by rapid and profound locoregional control, particularly of the tumor thrombus, with a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma characterized by high tumor burden beyond up-to-seven criteria, BCLC stage C without extrahepatic spread, and portal vein tumor thrombus Vp1-4.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy plus lenvatinib and PD-1 inhibitors as first-line treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma with high tumor burden and portal vein tumor thrombus: A target trial emulation study (CHANCE 2416).

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, breast cancer, penile cancer, and bone and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial evaluating an optimized B7-H3xCD3 T cell engager for treatment of solid cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, PCSK9 inhibitor use in patients with cancer and hyperlipidemia treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors was associated with improved overall survival and reduced healthcare utilization. The findings support ongoing prospective clinical trials evaluating potential synergistic effects of PCSK9 inhibition with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer, melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, or breast cancer who received concurrent immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy plus PCSK9 inhibitors or high-intensity statins alone for hyperlipidemia between 01/01/2011 and 01/01/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of PCSK9 inhibitors with clinical outcomes in patients with cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal irinotecan plus capecitabine showed encouraging anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers. The regimen may represent a potential new therapeutic option in the second-line setting, while follow-up survival work is ongoing and additional data are expected.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial evaluating liposomal irinotecan combined with capecitabine as second-line therapy for biliary tract cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant serplulimab combined with an intensified regimen of nab-paclitaxel and SOX showed promising efficacy in fit patients with locally advanced gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. This strategy significantly improved pathological complete response rates and promoted nodal downstaging, with a safety profile that did not compromise surgical feasibility. The study is ongoing, and long-term follow-up and exploratory analyses are required to further evaluate the durability and full potential of this strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant serplulimab plus nab-paclitaxel and SOX in locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: An interim analysis of a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: ASKG915 demonstrated promising clinical efficacy in patients with microsatellite stable colorectal cancer and non-small cell lung cancer, with a well-tolerated safety profile. These results support further evaluation of ASKG915 as monotherapy and in combination therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors that were resistant/refractory to current standard treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy results from a first-in-human, phase 1/2 study of ASKG915, an anti-PD-1/pro-IL-15 bifunctional fusion protein, for patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, patients with endometrial cancer and comorbid obesity who received GLP-1 agonists had lower rates of overall mortality, peritoneal, lymph node, and visceral metastases, and sepsis with or without shock. Additional longitudinal cohort studies are needed to explore these associations and inform clinical practice guidelines in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 18 years and above with endometrial cancer and comorbid obesity were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes comparing the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with endometrial cancer and comorbid obesity: A propensity score matched analysis from a global federated health research network.

data.clinical_result_summary: These first clinical data showed concordance between PSMA and B7-H3 on PET-CT imaging in a substantial cohort of patients, supporting B7-H3 as a novel target in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The normal tissue to tumor dose ratios observed with AKY-2519 suggest a wide therapeutic window as an Ac-225 delivering therapeutic, and the low predicted dose to salivary glands supports its use as an actinium-delivering radioconjugate therapy for mCRPC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: mCRPC patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: AKY-2519, a novel B7-H3-targeted radioconjugate, and its biodistribution profile in patients with mCRPC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg-based regimens showed safety results generally consistent with the known safety profiles of the individual agents, with no new safety signals observed. The safety data support pembrolizumab or rilvegostomig as combination partners for trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The reported study parts enrolled patients with previously untreated advanced HER2-positive or HER2-expressing gastric cancer, gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, with HER2 status defined by the specified immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization categories.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd)–based regimens in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancer (GC), gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA), or esophageal adenocarcinoma (EA): Safety results from DESTINY-Gastric03 (DG-03) Part 2 arms D and F, and Part 4.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this post hoc analysis, efficacy outcomes for patients with microsatellite instability-high gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma suggested a consistent trend with a numerically more pronounced difference between treatment groups. The safety profile was manageable, and further studies in this population are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had untreated resectable locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including Siewert type 2 or 3 tumors, and this analysis focused on the microsatellite instability-high population.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant and adjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: Outcomes from the microsatellite instability-high population of the phase 3 KEYNOTE-585 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sigvotatug vedotin plus pembrolizumab continued to show manageable safety and encouraging antitumor activity in treatment-naive non-small cell lung cancer across PD-L1 TPS and histologies. These findings support the ongoing phase 3 SigVie-003 study of sigvotatug vedotin plus pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab for treatment-naive advanced non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 TPS ≥50%, as well as further investigation in phase 1 cohorts and future studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naive locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic NSCLC across PD-L1 scores
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sigvotatug vedotin (SV), an investigational integrin beta-6 (IB6)─directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), plus pembrolizumab: Updated results from the phase 1 study (SGNB6A-001).

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative cadonilimab demonstrated excellent antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with locally advanced microsatellite instability-high/deficient mismatch repair gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced microsatellite instability-high/deficient mismatch repair gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma or colorectal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative cadonilimab (AK104) in locally advanced MSI-H/dMMR gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal adenocarcinoma: A basket study.

data.clinical_result_summary: XP-004 combined with a PD-1 inhibitor demonstrated favorable safety and tolerability and induced robust neoantigen-specific T-cell responses in resected pancreatic cancer patients intolerant to chemotherapy. Early follow-up suggests potential recurrence-free survival benefit, supporting further investigation of this adjuvant immunotherapy strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: resected pancreatic cancer patients intolerant to chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An investigator-initiated phase I study evaluating the safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy of a personalized neoantigen mRNA vaccine (XP-004) combined with PD-1 inhibitor as adjuvant therapy in resected pancreatic cancer patients intolerant to chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with sorafenib, IBI310 plus sintilimab as first-line treatment for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma demonstrated survival benefits and a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effectiveness and safety of IBI310 combined with sintilimab versus sorafenib in the first-line treatment of advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (aHCC): A randomized, open-label, controlled, multicenter phase III clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Carfilzomib-based treatment regimens were effective with a favorable safety profile in this population of patients with Waldenström Macroglobulinemia. One patient experienced characteristic cardiac toxicity with full recovery of cardiac function, and peripheral neuropathy was attributable to carfilzomib in a small fraction of cases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with biopsy-confirmed Waldenström Macroglobulinemia treated with carfilzomib-based regimens at the John Theurer Cancer Center in Hackensack, NJ.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Carfilzomib-based combinations for Waldenström macroglobulinemia: Real-world experience from a single center.

data.clinical_result_summary: Durvalumab plus radiotherapy did not improve 3-year event-free survival in the overall population of intermediate-risk HPV-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma. No new safety signal was observed, and overall quality-of-life outcomes, including swallowing, were similar between arms and consistent with prior trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with intermediate-risk HPV-positive locally advanced oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final analysis of the investigator-initiated randomized study of anti–PD-L1 durvalumab (durva) with radiation versus chemoradiation (CRT) for intermediate-risk HPV-positive (HPV+) locally advanced oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (LA-OPSCC): Canadian Cancer Trials Group (CCTG) HN.9 (EORTC 1740-HNCG).

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of pembrolizumab to neoadjuvant chemotherapy significantly improved pathological complete response rates in triple-negative breast cancer. However, the data suggest a paradoxical risk of early and aggressive recurrence even after achieving pathological complete response, with recurrences in the pembrolizumab-treated cohort characterized by a high incidence of liver metastasis and rapid disease progression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with triple-negative breast cancer who underwent neoadjuvant chemotherapy at the institution between 2009 and 2025, including a subgroup of patients who achieved pathological complete response.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact and prognosis of pembrolizumab combination in neoadjuvant chemotherapy for triple-negative breast cancer: A single-center retrospective study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Rate of measurable residual disease negativity
data.clinical_result_summary: DA-EPOCH ± R plus tafasitamab yielded high rates of measurable residual disease negativity in adults with newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome-negative B lymphoblastic leukemia. Follow-up was immature, but early survival rates were comparable to more complex strategies, and the study was on pace to reach its primary endpoint.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly-diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome negative B lymphoblastic leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of dose-adjusted etoposide, prednisone, vincristine, cyclophosphamide, and doxorubicin (DA-EPOCH) ± rituximab (R) + tafasitamab (tafa) in adults with newly diagnosed (ND) Philadelphia chromosome–negative (Ph-) B lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched real-world analysis, mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccination was associated with significantly reduced all-cause mortality among patients receiving bispecific antibody therapy. Vaccination was not associated with an increased risk of CRS grade 1/2 or ICANS, supporting the safety of mRNA vaccination in this high-risk population and suggesting a potential survival benefit requiring prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with hematologic malignancies who received bispecific antibody therapy were included and stratified by receipt of mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccines, while patients with documented COVID-19 infection or post-COVID-19 conditions were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The impact of COVID‑19 mRNA vaccination on bispecific antibody outcomes in hematologic malignancies: A retrospective multicenter cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of RC48, tislelizumab, and S-1 as first-line therapy showed encouraging response rates and updated survival with manageable safety in HER2-overexpressing gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including patients with CPS <1. TCR clonal expansion may serve as a robust biomarker of antitumor immune activation, independent of PD-L1 expression levels.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-overexpressing metastatic or unresectable GC/GEJC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Disitamab vedotin (RC48), tislelizumab, and S-1 as first-line therapy for HER2-overexpressing advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GC/GEJC): Updated survival and exploratory biomarker results from the RCTS trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: EIK1003 plus paclitaxel demonstrated a tolerable safety profile in a heavily pre-treated population, with hematologic toxicities comparable to historical paclitaxel use. The findings provide first clinical evidence that PARP1-selective inhibitors can be safely combined with chemotherapy. Extended follow-up of EIK1003 monotherapy confirmed durable tolerability with antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors, including platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer and HER2-negative breast cancer (Cohort 1C)
participants (pts) with advanced solid tumors (Cohort 1A)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EIK1003, a PARP1-selective inhibitor, in combination with paclitaxel (PTX): Initial combination and updated monotherapy results from a phase 1/2 study EIK1003-001 in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: This large prospective real-world study supports the effectiveness and manageable safety of perioperative toripalimab in routine practice for stage II-III non-small cell lung cancer. The observed pathological response rates support the clinical benefit of this regimen across a broad spectrum of patients beyond randomized controlled trial settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in China with stage II-III non-small cell lung cancer planned for perioperative treatment containing toripalimab were consecutively enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative toripalimab in non-small cell lung cancer: Clinical outcomes and safety from a large prospective real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of toripalimab, dual anti-HER2 blockade with inetetamab and pertuzumab, and nab-paclitaxel showed promising efficacy and manageable toxicity in the neoadjuvant setting for HER2-positive breast cancer. These findings support further evaluation in randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with early or locally advanced HER2-positive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant toripalimab combined with inetetamab, pertuzumab, and nab‑paclitaxel in HER2‑positive breast cancer (TORCH): A phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Liso-cel was associated with high response rates in a broad population of heavily pretreated patients with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma, with early signs of durable benefit. The safety profile was consistent with TRANSCEND NHL 001, and the results support the potential of liso-cel to address critical gaps for patients with limited treatment options.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective study included patients in the US with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma who received commercial liso-cel from 05/2024 to 09/2025 and had at least 1 postinfusion assessment reported to CIBMTR.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes of lisocabtagene maraleucel (liso-cel) in patients (pt) with relapsed or refractory (R/R) mantle cell lymphoma (MCL): First real-world data from the CIBMTR.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, patients with endometrial cancer and comorbid obesity who received GLP-1 agonists had lower rates of overall mortality, peritoneal, lymph node, and visceral metastases, and sepsis with or without shock. Additional longitudinal cohort studies are needed to explore these associations and inform clinical practice guidelines in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 18 years and above with endometrial cancer and comorbid obesity were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes comparing the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with endometrial cancer and comorbid obesity: A propensity score matched analysis from a global federated health research network.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of RC48, tislelizumab, and S-1 as first-line therapy showed encouraging response rates and updated survival with manageable safety in HER2-overexpressing gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including patients with CPS <1. TCR clonal expansion may serve as a robust biomarker of antitumor immune activation, independent of PD-L1 expression levels.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-overexpressing metastatic or unresectable GC/GEJC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Disitamab vedotin (RC48), tislelizumab, and S-1 as first-line therapy for HER2-overexpressing advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GC/GEJC): Updated survival and exploratory biomarker results from the RCTS trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, longer duration of durvalumab following chemoradiation was associated with improved survival and reduced high-intensity healthcare utilization. These findings support maintaining durvalumab therapy when feasible and underscore the need for strategies to optimize treatment adherence in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with lung cancer who received concurrent chemoradiation followed by durvalumab consolidation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of durvalumab treatment duration on survival and healthcare utilization after chemoradiation for lung cancer: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this national real-world cohort, larotrectinib demonstrated high efficacy, durable disease control, and an excellent safety profile in pediatric patients with NTRK fusion–positive solid tumors, particularly infantile fibrosarcoma. These findings support early integration of molecular diagnostics and TRK inhibition into routine pediatric oncology practice and provide valuable real-world evidence from a middle-income country setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective multicenter study included pediatric patients aged 0–18 years in Türkiye with histologically confirmed solid tumors harboring NTRK gene fusions who were treated with larotrectinib for at least 1 month between August 2023 and April 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Precision oncology in practice: Real-world multicenter experience with larotrectinib in pediatric extracranial NTRK fusion–positive tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant mFOLFOX7 combined with camrelizumab and apatinib was effective and tolerable in patients with BCLC stage A/B hepatocellular carcinoma beyond Milan criteria. Preoperative neoadjuvant therapy reduced the rate of microvascular invasion, and more data will be further analyzed and reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with BCLC stage A/B hepatocellular carcinoma beyond Milan criteria
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant systemic chemotherapy combined with camrelizumab (CAM) and apatinib (APA) for BCLC stage A/B hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) beyond Milan criteria: An interim analysis of a phase 2 trial.

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, breast cancer, penile cancer, and bone and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial evaluating an optimized B7-H3xCD3 T cell engager for treatment of solid cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ficerafusp alfa plus pembrolizumab demonstrated deep responses across multiple dose levels in first-line recurrent/metastatic HPV-negative head and neck carcinoma. Deep responses were associated with improved long-term efficacy outcomes, including duration of response, progression-free survival, and overall survival, suggesting that depth of response may be a clinically meaningful surrogate for long-term efficacy outcomes in HPV-negative HNSCC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with first-line recurrent/metastatic HPV-negative head and neck carcinoma with PD-L1 CPS ≥1 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The impact of depth of response on long-term clinical outcomes: Exploratory analyses from multiple expansion cohorts of a phase 1/1b study of ficerafusp alfa plus pembrolizumab in first-line recurrent/metastatic (R/M) HPV-negative head and neck carcinoma (HNSCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The use of empegfilgrastim allowed delivery of 96% relative dose intensity. Neoadjuvant TCHP with empegfilgrastim showed high efficacy in HER2-positive breast cancer across hormone receptor status and tumor stage, and HER2 expression level was a significant predictor of pathological complete response.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with HER2-positive early breast cancer treated with the neoadjuvant TCHP regimen.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of neoadjuvant TCHP with primary empegfilgrastim (E) prophylaxis in HER2-positive early breast cancer (HER2+ eBC): Final results of the DEFENDOR SPECIAL study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results indicated that chidamide plus serplulimab with regorafenib or fruquintinib is a feasible and promising third-line treatment option for advanced colorectal cancer, with manageable toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chidamide combined with serplulimab and regorafenib or fruquintinib as third-line therapy for advanced colorectal cancer (C-ooperate/SCOG-C001): A single-arm, exploratory, multicenter, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In previously untreated PD-L1-positive recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, ramucirumab plus pembrolizumab did not improve objective response rate compared with pembrolizumab alone. The study did not proceed beyond stage 1 after the null hypothesis was accepted.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated PD-L1 positive, recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
clinical_result_layer_factor: HPV status (+ or -) and PD-L1 CPS (1-19 or ≥20)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An open-label, randomized phase 2 trial of ramucirumab and pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab as first-line therapy for PD-L1–positive, recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (RM-HNSCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Although the prespecified primary efficacy endpoint was not met, T-DXd demonstrated clinically meaningful antitumor activity in patients with HER2-low recurrent or metastatic salivary gland carcinoma, particularly in those with salivary duct carcinoma. The safety profile was generally consistent with the known profile of T-DXd in the Japanese population, with ILD/pneumonitis remaining an important identified risk requiring careful monitoring.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-low recurrent/metastatic salivary gland carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan in patients with HER2-low recurrent/metastatic salivary gland carcinoma: Results from the phase II MYTHOS trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: ctDNA-guided adjuvant atezolizumab provided clinically meaningful disease-free survival and overall survival benefit without negatively impacting patient-reported quality of life in patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer and no radiographic disease underwent serial ctDNA monitoring for up to 1 year after cystectomy, and those who tested ctDNA-positive and remained disease-free were randomized.
clinical_result_layer_factor: Nodal status (+ vs –); tumor stage (≤pT2 vs pT3/4); programmed death ligand-1 status (<5% vs ≥5% of immune cells); time from cystectomy to first ctDNA+ sample (≤20 vs >20 wk).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Patient-reported outcomes from IMvigor011: A phase 3 study of circulating tumor (ct)DNA–guided adjuvant atezolizumab vs placebo in muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma, nab-TP was non-inferior to TPF for the 3-year failure-free survival rate. Nab-TP was also associated with a significantly better safety and tolerability profile, supporting its use as a viable therapeutic alternative.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage III–IVA nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Induction chemotherapy with nab-paclitaxel and cisplatin versus docetaxel, cisplatin, and fluorouracil followed by chemoradiotherapy in patients with stage III–IVA nasopharyngeal carcinoma: An open-label, noninferiority, randomized, controlled, phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Asandeutertinib significantly improved intracranial objective response rate and intracranial progression-free survival compared with osimertinib in treatment-naïve patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and brain metastases. The safety profile was manageable, supporting its potential as a new first-line treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients With EGFR-Mutated Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With Brain Metastases
clinical_result_layer_factor: number of intracranial lesions (>3 or ≤3) and EGFR mutation type (L858R or 19Del)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of asandeutertinib versus osimertinib as first-line treatment in EGFR-mutated NSCLC patients with brain metastases: Interim analysis of an open-label, multicenter, randomized, pivotal phase II study (ESAONA).

data.clinical_result_summary: Sevabertinib demonstrated sustained efficacy with a manageable safety profile in treatment-naïve and pretreated patients with advanced HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. These data further support the rapid and durable responses of sevabertinib for patients with HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: cohort D: Asian patients with HER2-mutant NSCLC who experienced disease progression after at least 1 systemic therapy, but naïve to HER2-targeted therapy
cohort F: Asian patients with HER2-mutant NSCLC had not received any systemic therapy for locally advanced or metastatic disease cohort
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SOHO-01: Updated safety and efficacy of sevabertinib in patients with advanced HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Gedatolisib combination therapies significantly improved progression-free survival compared with alpelisib plus fulvestrant in patients with HR+/HER2- PIK3CA-mutant advanced breast cancer after prior CDK4/6 inhibitor plus aromatase inhibitor therapy. The safety profile was generally consistent with the individual agents, and the data suggest gedatolisib combinations may offer a potential new standard of care as second-line treatment of HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer irrespective of PIK3CA mutation status.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with hormone receptor positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative, PIK3CA mutant locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized, open-label, phase 3 study of gedatolisib + fulvestrant ± palbociclib vs standard of care in HR+/HER2−/PIK3CA-mutant (MT) advanced breast cancer (VIKTORIA-1 Study 2).

data.clinical_result_summary: Mosun SC showed promising efficacy with manageable safety in elderly/unfit patients with previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in an outpatient setting. Clinically meaningful improvements in lymphoma symptoms suggest that Mosun SC improves aspects of health-related quality of life in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma who were elderly/unfit or ineligible for chemoimmunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fixed-duration subcutaneous (SC) mosunetuzumab (Mosun) in elderly/unfit patients with previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL): Interim analysis and patient-reported outcomes (PROs) from the phase 2 MorningSun study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Thymosin α1 combined with toripalimab showed promising efficacy and excellent tolerability in elderly patients with advanced melanoma. The prespecified criteria for Stage II expansion were met, and enrollment of additional patients is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: elderly patients with advanced melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Stage I results of a phase II study evaluating thymosin α1 combined with toripalimab in elderly patients with advanced melanoma.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, pharmacokinetics, and immunogenicity of HLX6018, a monoclonal antibody targeting the GARP/TGF-β1 complex, in healthy subjects: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase I clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant serplulimab combined with PF chemotherapy demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity and a favorable safety profile in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The regimen was also associated with significant improvements across multiple patient-reported quality-of-life domains, supporting further investigation as a potential neoadjuvant approach.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pathologically confirmed treatment-naïve locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant serplulimab combined with cisplatin plus 5-fluorouracil in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: A phase II single-arm trial.

The findings provide first clinical evidence that PARP1-selective inhibitors can be safely combined with chemotherapy. Extended follow-up of EIK1003 monotherapy confirmed durable tolerability with antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors, including platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer and HER2-negative breast cancer (Cohort 1C)

data.clinical_result_paper_title: EIK1003, a PARP1-selective inhibitor, in combination with paclitaxel (PTX): Initial combination and updated monotherapy results from a phase 1/2 study EIK1003-001 in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world study of Veterans Health Administration patients on durvalumab for stage III unresectable non-small cell lung cancer, overall survival and cancer-related overall survival were similar for those with PD-L1 positive and PD-L1 negative tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with stage III unresectable non-small cell lung cancer on durvalumab following chemoradiotherapy at any Veterans Health Administration facility from January 1, 2017 to June 30, 2020 were included, including patients with PD-L1 positive tumors (1% or greater) and PD-L1 negative tumors (<1%).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cancer-related overall survival for patients on durvalumab for stage III unresectable non–small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 positive and negative tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pembrolizumab was effective and safe in a real-world setting for patients with PD-L1-high metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Outcomes were comparable to those observed in clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study assessed patients with PD-L1-high (PD-L1 expression ≥ 50%) metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, excluding patients with positive EGFR mutations, ALK rearrangements, and ROS1 fusions.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world evidence of pembrolizumab efficacy and safety in patients with NSCLC with high PD-L1 expression.

data.clinical_result_summary: This large real-world cohort analysis found that aromatase inhibitors were associated with a higher risk of osteopenia and pathological fractures than tamoxifen. The findings support bone density monitoring and early management of osteopenia in patients receiving endocrine therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with breast cancer starting tamoxifen or any aromatase inhibitor.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative bone health outcomes following tamoxifen and aromatase inhibitor therapy in breast cancer: A large-scale real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Disitamab Vedotin combined with Toripalimab demonstrated encouraging preliminary activity and a favorable safety profile in high-risk upper urinary tract urothelial carcinoma. Achieving 100% kidney retention in evaluable cases suggests this approach could provide a viable nephron-sparing alternative for patients ineligible for radical nephroureterectomy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with impaired renal function and high-risk upper urinary tract urothelial carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A kidney-sparing approach using disitamab vedotin plus toripalimab for high-risk upper urinary tract urothelial carcinoma in patients with impaired renal function: Preliminary results from a phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Aggressive pre-liver transplantation locoregional and systemic therapies aimed at minimizing disease burden assessed by PET scan and ctDNA may demonstrate improved outcomes for colorectal cancer liver metastasis, as may HAI pump therapy. A clinical trial testing these hypotheses has been designed with expected enrollment in 2026 at three sites.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients had advanced, unresectable, liver-confined colorectal cancer liver metastasis, with minimal or no detectable disease or irreversible treatment-induced liver injury before transplant, and disease control for at least 1 year after resection of the primary colorectal tumor.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Multimodality neoadjuvant downstaging therapy before liver transplantation for colorectal liver metastasis: Real-world data from the Cleveland Clinic.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, overall survival after belzutifan initiation mirrored the LITESPARK-005 trial, supporting its effectiveness in routine practice for advanced renal cell carcinoma. Baseline nutritional, hematologic, and immune markers were associated with improved survival, whereas systemic inflammation and metabolic dysfunction predicted worse outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with renal cell carcinoma who initiated belzutifan on or after the FDA approval date, in the context of advanced renal cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world overall survival outcomes of belzutifan treatment in advanced renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: BCG at Home was reported as the first prospective trial to administer intravesical Bacillus Calmette-Guérin in the home setting using a standardized pharmacy-to-home pathway. Early results supported feasibility, complete adherence, and an acceptable short-term safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled treatment-naïve patients with high-grade T1 and/or carcinoma in situ non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, described as high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BCG at home: A first-in-kind pilot trial of home-based intravesical Bacillus Calmette-Guérin delivery for high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Osimertinib plus chemotherapy significantly prolonged progression-free survival compared with osimertinib monotherapy in patients with persistent ctDNA EGFR mutation at 3 weeks after first-line osimertinib monotherapy. The study provides prospective evidence supporting individualized escalation to combination therapy based on dynamic molecular detection, with higher but manageable grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events and no new safety signals.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer with persistent plasma ctDNA EGFR mutations at 3 weeks after first-line osimertinib
clinical_result_layer_factor: CNS metastases (yes/no) and EGFRm subtype
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Osimertinib with/without chemotherapy in patients with persistent ctDNA EGFR mutant (EGFRm) NSCLC at 3 weeks after 1L osimertinib: A randomized phase II study (FLAME study).

data.clinical_result_summary: Ifebemtinib plus D-1553 showed robust and durable antitumor activity with a favorable safety profile in treatment-naive KRASG12C-mutant non-small cell lung cancer regardless of PD-L1 expression. The combination appeared particularly promising in TP53 wild-type tumors, supporting further study in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic KRAS G12C mutant non-small-cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of ifebemtinib (IN10018) combined with garsorasib (D-1553) in KRASG12C mutant solid tumors from a phase Ib/II study: 2-year follow-up from single-arm of non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic probiotics combined with glutamine compound had a preventive effect on severe radiation enteritis and diarrhea during concurrent chemoradiotherapy for rectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with locally advanced stage II-III rectal adenocarcinoma receiving preoperative chemoradiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of probiotics combined with glutamine compound for acute radiation enteritis during neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: A randomized controlled trial (NCT05406882).

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, breast cancer, penile cancer, and bone and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial evaluating an optimized B7-H3xCD3 T cell engager for treatment of solid cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, encorafenib/cetuximab outcomes aligned with pivotal trial data in patients with BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer. Composite clinical prognostic groups and simple inflammatory biomarkers, including NLR and PNI, provided meaningful prognostic information supporting improved risk stratification and personalized treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 100 adults with BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer receiving encorafenib/cetuximab between March 2020 and August 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Stratifying survival benefit of encorafenib/cetuximab (EC) in BRAF V600E–mutant mCRC using clinical and inflammatory biomarkers: Real-world experience from greater Manchester.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective muscle-invasive bladder cancer cohort, selected patients who refused radical cystectomy benefited from a multimodal bladder-sparing approach including maximal trans-urethral resection of bladder tumor, neoadjuvant systemic chemotherapy, and intravesical sequential immuno-chemotherapy to prevent disease recurrence. These results warrant further investigation in prospective bladder-sparing trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with non-metastatic urothelial muscle-invasive bladder cancer (cT2/3 - cN0 - cM0) who achieved a clinical complete response (pT0-Nx-MX) after trans-urethral resection of bladder tumor and neoadjuvant systemic chemotherapy and refused radical cystectomy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Bladder preservation in patients with urothelial muscle-invasive bladder cancer who refused radical cystectomy after clinical complete response to trans-urethral resection of bladder tumors and neoadjuvant systemic chemotherapy. A retrospective single-center experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: ABBV-969 demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Dose optimization is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, first-in-human (FIH) study evaluating the safety, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy of ABBV-969 in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multisite real-world cohort of patients with melanoma brain metastases, Ipi1+Nivo3 showed comparable efficacy, numerically longer survival, and a more favorable toxicity profile than standard Ipi3+Nivo1. No neurologic toxicity was observed with the Ipi1+Nivo3 regimen, supporting further prospective evaluation of lower-dose ipilimumab strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with melanoma brain metastases treated with ipilimumab plus nivolumab across three Mayo Clinic sites in a multisite real-world cohort between 2016 and 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparison of ipilimumab–nivolumab dosing strategies in melanoma brain metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Induction chemoimmunotherapy followed by eligibility-adapted hypofractionated radiotherapy showed promising survival and locoregional control with acceptable toxicity in unresectable locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer. These findings support its feasibility as an alternative strategy for selected patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with newly diagnosed unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer, without progression or grade ≥2 pneumonitis, underwent eligibility assessment for hypofractionated radiotherapy based on anatomical suitability and organ-at-risk constraints.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Induction chemoimmunotherapy followed by hypofractionated radiotherapy and consolidation immunotherapy for locally advanced unresectable non–small cell lung cancer: A prospective phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Abemaciclib demonstrated promising clinical activity in patients with low-grade serous ovarian cancer regardless of KRAS mutation status and in estrogen receptor positive endometrial cancer. The greatest activity in endometrial cancer was observed in the NSMP group and potentially in CTNNB1-mutated cases, but these exploratory subgroup findings require validation in larger studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with estrogen receptor positive endometrial cancer, low-grade serous ovarian cancer, and selected high-grade serous ovarian cancer with CDK4/6 molecular activation features
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy, safety, and exploratory biomarker analyses of a phase II trial of abemaciclib plus hormonal therapy in recurrent ovarian (OC) and endometrial cancer (EC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal irinotecan plus capecitabine showed encouraging anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers. The regimen may represent a potential new therapeutic option in the second-line setting, while follow-up survival work is ongoing and additional data are expected.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial evaluating liposomal irinotecan combined with capecitabine as second-line therapy for biliary tract cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this high-risk pN2-3 cohort with HR+/HER2- early breast cancer, adjuvant abemaciclib showed favorable real-world efficacy, with iDFS rates of 100.0%, 94.7%, and 93.5% at 12, 24, and 36 months. The safety profile was manageable with dose adjustments, supporting long-term treatment in most patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This multicenter retrospective observational study included 160 patients with HR+/HER2-negative breast cancer receiving adjuvant abemaciclib plus endocrine therapy across Moscow centers, including a pN2-3 subgroup of 135 patients.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant abemaciclib in pN2-3 patients with HR+/HER2− early breast cancer: Real-world outcomes from Moscow centers.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large cohort comparing ARPI doublet and triplet therapy, ARPI doublet was the most common regimen and was associated with more favorable outcomes, even after multivariable adjustment. Non-achievement of PSA nadir identified a population with poorer survival in whom docetaxel triplet therapy may be associated with improved outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with prostate cancer, specifically patients with metastatic prostate cancer initiating ARPI doublet, docetaxel doublet, or triplet therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PSA nadir–stratified outcomes of ARPI doublet and docetaxel triplet therapy in metastatic prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this prospective, biomarker-selected observational pilot cohort of heavily pretreated biliary tract cancer, zolbetuximab use was feasible and showed encouraging disease control. Zolbetuximab was also associated with clinically meaningful quality-of-life improvement, supporting further investigation of CLDN18.2-directed strategies in biliary tract cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with unresectable or metastatic CLDN18.2-positive biliary tract cancer, requiring CLDN18.2 expression in at least 50% of tumor cells with moderate or strong membranous staining after progression on at least 1 prior systemic therapy, who received zolbetuximab in the salvage setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zolbetuximab in CLDN18.2-positive biliary tract cancer after prior systemic therapy: A prospective observational pilot cohort study of early outcomes, safety, and patient-reported quality of life.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this target trial emulation, adding hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy to lenvatinib and PD-1 inhibitors significantly improved overall survival and progression-free survival in patients with high-risk hepatocellular carcinoma and portal vein tumor thrombus. The survival advantage was driven by rapid and profound locoregional control, particularly of the tumor thrombus, with a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma characterized by high tumor burden beyond up-to-seven criteria, BCLC stage C without extrahepatic spread, and portal vein tumor thrombus Vp1-4.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy plus lenvatinib and PD-1 inhibitors as first-line treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma with high tumor burden and portal vein tumor thrombus: A target trial emulation study (CHANCE 2416).

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal irinotecan plus capecitabine showed encouraging anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers. The regimen may represent a potential new therapeutic option in the second-line setting, while follow-up survival work is ongoing and additional data are expected.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial evaluating liposomal irinotecan combined with capecitabine as second-line therapy for biliary tract cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The use of empegfilgrastim allowed delivery of 96% relative dose intensity. Neoadjuvant TCHP with empegfilgrastim showed high efficacy in HER2-positive breast cancer across hormone receptor status and tumor stage, and HER2 expression level was a significant predictor of pathological complete response.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with HER2-positive early breast cancer treated with the neoadjuvant TCHP regimen.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of neoadjuvant TCHP with primary empegfilgrastim (E) prophylaxis in HER2-positive early breast cancer (HER2+ eBC): Final results of the DEFENDOR SPECIAL study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This observational study reflects real-world practice and has limitations due to non-standardized visit schedules and chart-abstracted responses without imaging re-read. Nevertheless, the findings were consistent with the trial that supported approval and provided complementary evidence on pembrolizumab effectiveness in tumor mutational burden-high cancers treated in routine care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with advanced/metastatic solid tumors, excluding melanoma and non-small cell lung cancer, who had tumor mutational burden-high disease based on FoundationOne CDx, were non-microsatellite instability high, received pembrolizumab monotherapy in second line or later, and had at least one real-world response assessment for the prespecified primary analysis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of pembrolizumab among patients with TMB-H advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW27011 demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity and a manageable safety profile in CLDN18.2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. A pivotal phase 3 study evaluating XNW27011 as a ≥3 line therapy in G/GEJA patients is currently ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts with CLDN18.2+ (TC≥5%, IHC ≥ 2+), advanced/metastatic GC/GEJC progressed on standard therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: XNW27011, a Claudin 18.2(CLDN18.2) targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with CLDN18.2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (G/GEJA): A phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: ASKG915 demonstrated promising clinical efficacy in patients with microsatellite stable colorectal cancer and non-small cell lung cancer, with a well-tolerated safety profile. These results support further evaluation of ASKG915 as monotherapy and in combination therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors that were resistant/refractory to current standard treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy results from a first-in-human, phase 1/2 study of ASKG915, an anti-PD-1/pro-IL-15 bifunctional fusion protein, for patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multisite real-world cohort of patients with melanoma brain metastases, Ipi1+Nivo3 showed comparable efficacy, numerically longer survival, and a more favorable toxicity profile than standard Ipi3+Nivo1. No neurologic toxicity was observed with the Ipi1+Nivo3 regimen, supporting further prospective evaluation of lower-dose ipilimumab strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with melanoma brain metastases treated with ipilimumab plus nivolumab across three Mayo Clinic sites in a multisite real-world cohort between 2016 and 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparison of ipilimumab–nivolumab dosing strategies in melanoma brain metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, FOLFIRINOX was associated with significantly improved overall survival compared with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel in metastatic pancreatic cancer. This benefit occurred without increased hospitalization or most toxicity-related outcomes, although FOLFIRINOX required greater hematologic support.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma treated with FOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival and treatment-related outcomes with FOLFIRINOX compared with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel in metastatic pancreatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Abemaciclib demonstrated promising clinical activity in patients with low-grade serous ovarian cancer regardless of KRAS mutation status and in estrogen receptor positive endometrial cancer. The greatest activity in endometrial cancer was observed in the NSMP group and potentially in CTNNB1-mutated cases, but these exploratory subgroup findings require validation in larger studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with estrogen receptor positive endometrial cancer, low-grade serous ovarian cancer, and selected high-grade serous ovarian cancer with CDK4/6 molecular activation features
