data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy, safety, and exploratory biomarker analyses of a phase II trial of abemaciclib plus hormonal therapy in recurrent ovarian (OC) and endometrial cancer (EC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this institutional experience with myoepithelial carcinoma, most patients were middle-aged and the head and neck was the most common primary site. Outcomes were generally worse for younger patients, although the survival comparison was limited by the small sample size and wide confidence interval. Outcomes with currently available systemic therapy for metastatic disease were uniformly poor, highlighting the need for novel treatment regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 70 patients with myoepithelial carcinoma seen at the institution from 1997 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Myoepithelial carcinoma: Defining natural history and therapeutic outcomes in a rare malignancy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Switching to camizestrant plus continued CDK4/6 inhibitor at ESR1 mutation emergence continued to result in progression-free survival benefit, with approximately one third of patients still progression-free at 30 months. The PFS benefit was maintained beyond first progression, with significantly improved PFS2 and prolonged chemotherapy/ADC-free survival versus continuing aromatase inhibitor plus CDK4/6 inhibitor. These results support switching to camizestrant plus CDK4/6 inhibitor for patients with ESR1 mutations during first-line therapy to delay disease progression and deterioration in quality of life.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced breast cancer with ER-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative tumors for ESR1 mutations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) camizestrant (CAMI) for emergent ESR1 mutations (ESR1m) in advanced breast cancer (ABC): Final progression-free survival 2 (PFS2) from the phase III SERENA-6 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this contemporary real-world acute myeloid leukemia induction cohort, prespecified fitness classification strongly aligned with induction intensity selection, supporting fitness-informed pathways in real-world decision making. Early mortality was low across fitness groups, and 1-year overall survival numerically favored fit patients but did not reach statistical significance. These data provide benchmarks for counseling and supportive care planning in adult acute myeloid leukemia patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included treatment-naïve adults aged 18 years or older with acute myeloid leukemia at a tertiary academic cancer center, with fitness classified using prespecified criteria including age 75 years or older, ECOG performance status of at least 2, history of treated congestive heart failure or stable angina, or chronic lung disease requiring baseline oxygen.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fitness classification and induction intensity selection in AML practice: A contemporary real-world cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, PCSK9 inhibitor use in patients with cancer and hyperlipidemia treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors was associated with improved overall survival and reduced healthcare utilization. The findings support ongoing prospective clinical trials evaluating potential synergistic effects of PCSK9 inhibition with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer, melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, or breast cancer who received concurrent immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy plus PCSK9 inhibitors or high-intensity statins alone for hyperlipidemia between 01/01/2011 and 01/01/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of PCSK9 inhibitors with clinical outcomes in patients with cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ga-68-NGUL and Lu-177-DGUL (Pocuvotide Satetraxetan) demonstrated promising survival benefits in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Clinical response was particularly robust in patients with lung or lymph node metastases and in those completing more treatment cycles. The significant difference in rPFS observed only under PCWG3-modified criteria highlights the importance of using PCWG3-specific assessments in bone-predominant metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients With Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcomes and subgroup efficacy analysis of Ga-68-NGUL and Lu-177-DGUL (pocuvotide satetraxetan) in patients with mCRPC: Results from a phase 1/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with stage III non-small cell lung cancer treated with chemoradiation followed by durvalumab, treatment completion rates were lower and toxicity rates higher than those reported in the PACIFIC trial. Immune-related adverse events, particularly pneumonitis, were common and frequently led to treatment discontinuation. These findings highlight the challenges of translating clinical trial results into routine practice and underscore the need for optimized toxicity monitoring and careful patient selection in real-world settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included all patients with stage II–III non-small cell lung cancer treated with concurrent chemoradiation followed by durvalumab at the institution between March 2018 and June 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world treatment patterns and toxicity of durvalumab after chemoradiation in stage III non-small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Epcoritamab plus salvage chemoimmunotherapy produced high complete response rates in ASCT-eligible patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma and enabled 57% of patients to proceed to ASCT. Responses were deep and durable among patients proceeding to ASCT or continuing epcoritamab monotherapy, with safety consistent with prior reports and no adverse effect on chemoimmunotherapy dose intensity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma (Arm 10)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Epcoritamab (epcor) + chemoimmunotherapy (CIT) in patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma (R/R LBCL) eligible for autologous stem cell transplant (ASCT): Pooled results from arms 4 and 10 of EPCORE NHL-2.

data.clinical_result_summary: JSKN016 demonstrated robust antitumor activity with a good safety profile in patients with HER2-negative breast cancer. The results support further development of JSKN016 as monotherapy or in combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
patients with metastatic HR+/HER2- BC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: JSKN016, a first-in-class anti-TROP2/HER3 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients (pts) with HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer: Results from a phase I study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Late clinically significant cytomegalovirus infection occurred in 12% of cytomegalovirus-seropositive hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients after prophylaxis discontinuation and may confer additional mortality risk. These findings support risk-adapted surveillance and extended prophylaxis in high-risk groups, particularly recipients who are older, female, and have chronic graft-versus-host disease requiring immunosuppression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult cytomegalovirus-seropositive hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients at Cleveland Clinic who received at least 45 days of letermovir primary prophylaxis between 1/1/2018 and 12/31/2024, excluding patients with clinically significant cytomegalovirus infection during standard prophylaxis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-prophylaxis CMV in the letermovir era: Incidence, risk factors, and outcomes following HCT.

data.clinical_result_summary: In TROPION-Breast02, secondary endpoints of PFS2, TFST, and TSST improved for patients receiving Dato-DXd compared with investigator’s choice of chemotherapy, consistent with the dual primary endpoints of OS and PFS by BICR. Alongside its manageable safety profile, these data support Dato-DXd as a new first-line standard of care in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic TNBC for whom immunotherapy was not an option
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd) vs chemotherapy in patients with locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) for whom immunotherapy was not an option: Additional efficacy endpoints from the TROPION-Breast02 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large, propensity-matched real-world cohort of lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, baseline SSRI/SNRI use was not associated with improved 5-year overall survival or reduced immune-related adverse event risk. These findings suggest that serotonergic antidepressants do not confer clinically meaningful survival or toxicity benefits in routine practice, and they may be continued when clinically indicated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors between January 2015 and January 2026, with baseline SSRI/SNRI exposure defined as use within 3 months prior to ICI initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical impact of baseline serotonergic antidepressant use on survival and immune-related adverse events in lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: A large multicenter matched cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In heavily pretreated metastatic breast cancer, Bria-IMT showed a tolerable safety profile and was associated with a durable long-term survivor cohort. Survival appeared better with the Ph3 formulation, delayed-type hypersensitivity positivity, lower baseline circulating tumor cell burden, and early CPI sequencing, supporting prospective validation of these biomarkers and continued use of the Ph3 formulation in the ongoing phase 3 study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Metastatic Breast Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival with Bria-IMT + CPI in advanced metastatic breast cancer at 12 and 24 months.

data.clinical_result_summary: Outcomes and effectiveness of adjuvant nivolumab in this large Spanish real-world cohort were consistent with the CheckMate-274 results, with a manageable safety profile despite an older population. These findings externally validate the pivotal trial and reinforce the role of adjuvant nivolumab in daily clinical practice for high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk PD-L1-positive muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma treated with adjuvant nivolumab in routine practice across 65 hospitals in 16 Spanish regions.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant nivolumab in high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma: Real-world evidence from the SOGUG-NIADY study of the Spanish Oncology Genitourinary Group (SOGUG).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this national real-world cohort, larotrectinib demonstrated high efficacy, durable disease control, and an excellent safety profile in pediatric patients with NTRK fusion–positive solid tumors, particularly infantile fibrosarcoma. These findings support early integration of molecular diagnostics and TRK inhibition into routine pediatric oncology practice and provide valuable real-world evidence from a middle-income country setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective multicenter study included pediatric patients aged 0–18 years in Türkiye with histologically confirmed solid tumors harboring NTRK gene fusions who were treated with larotrectinib for at least 1 month between August 2023 and April 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Precision oncology in practice: Real-world multicenter experience with larotrectinib in pediatric extracranial NTRK fusion–positive tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The neoadjuvant CKM regimen was safe and feasible in resectable metastatic colorectal cancer. It was associated with improved ratios of CD8+ CTLs to FoxP3+ Tregs in the tumor microenvironment, supporting further studies combining CKM with immune checkpoint inhibitors and/or chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant chemokine modulation of the tumor microenvironment (TME) in resectable metastatic colorectal cancer: Results from a phase I study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, PCSK9 inhibitor use in patients with cancer and hyperlipidemia treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors was associated with improved overall survival and reduced healthcare utilization. The findings support ongoing prospective clinical trials evaluating potential synergistic effects of PCSK9 inhibition with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer, melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, or breast cancer who received concurrent immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy plus PCSK9 inhibitors or high-intensity statins alone for hyperlipidemia between 01/01/2011 and 01/01/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of PCSK9 inhibitors with clinical outcomes in patients with cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Giving bispecific antibodies to patients in an outpatient setting during the first treatment cycle was safe and practical with structured monitoring. Treatment-related side effects were manageable, and this approach can lead to cost savings, decreased hospitalization, and possibly higher patient satisfaction, although larger studies are needed to further clarify safety and patient selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with hematologic malignancies who initiated cycle 1 of bispecific antibody therapy as outpatients at the Brown Cancer Center.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outpatient administration of cycle 1 of bispecific antibody therapy in hematologic malignancies: A real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: This observational study reflects real-world practice and has limitations due to non-standardized visit schedules and chart-abstracted responses without imaging re-read. Nevertheless, the findings were consistent with the trial that supported approval and provided complementary evidence on pembrolizumab effectiveness in tumor mutational burden-high cancers treated in routine care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with advanced/metastatic solid tumors, excluding melanoma and non-small cell lung cancer, who had tumor mutational burden-high disease based on FoundationOne CDx, were non-microsatellite instability high, received pembrolizumab monotherapy in second line or later, and had at least one real-world response assessment for the prespecified primary analysis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of pembrolizumab among patients with TMB-H advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic probiotics combined with glutamine compound had a preventive effect on severe radiation enteritis and diarrhea during concurrent chemoradiotherapy for rectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with locally advanced stage II-III rectal adenocarcinoma receiving preoperative chemoradiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of probiotics combined with glutamine compound for acute radiation enteritis during neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: A randomized controlled trial (NCT05406882).

clinical_result_indication_detail: Locally Advanced or Metastatic Squamous Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Ivonescimab plus chemotherapy versus tislelizumab plus chemotherapy in previously untreated advanced squamous non–small cell lung cancer: Overall survival results of the phase 3 HARMONi-6 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this post-hoc analysis of the phase 2 1801 Part 3B study, elraglusib plus gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel showed a consistent survival benefit over gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel alone in previously untreated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The authors attribute the high early mortality in the control arm to a heterogeneous real-world population and state that the findings support further phase 3 development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Previously untreated patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Post-hoc efficacy and biomarker analysis of elraglusib plus gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel versus chemotherapy alone in metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg-based regimens showed safety results generally consistent with the known safety profiles of the individual agents, with no new safety signals observed. The safety data support pembrolizumab or rilvegostomig as combination partners for trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The reported study parts enrolled patients with previously untreated advanced HER2-positive or HER2-expressing gastric cancer, gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, with HER2 status defined by the specified immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization categories.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd)–based regimens in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancer (GC), gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA), or esophageal adenocarcinoma (EA): Safety results from DESTINY-Gastric03 (DG-03) Part 2 arms D and F, and Part 4.

data.clinical_result_summary: HRS-5041 showed tolerable safety and promising antitumor activity in pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. A phase 3 study is currently underway in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer with AR-LBD mutation, using a recommended dose of 240 mg BID.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HRS-5041, an androgen receptor degrader, in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: A phase 1, multicenter, first-in-human study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant chemotherapy significantly improves relapse-free survival and overall survival in high-risk stage II microsatellite instability-high or DNA mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer, particularly in pT4 and perineural invasion patients. The absence of regimen-specific survival differences suggests that treatment administration itself, rather than specific agents, determines outcomes, supporting risk-stratified adjuvant chemotherapy in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with high-risk stage II microsatellite instability-high or DNA mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer who underwent curative resection, with high-risk features including pT4, grade 3-4, lymphovascular invasion, bowel obstruction or perforation, perineural invasion, inadequate lymph node sampling (<12), or close margins.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The role of adjuvant chemotherapy in high-risk stage II colon cancer with microsatellite instability-high or DNA mismatch repair deficiencies: A multicenter pooled analysis (KCSG-CO24-03).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of atezolizumab and bevacizumab in patients with recurrent endometrial cancer after cytotoxic chemotherapy showed efficacy in both dMMR and pMMR populations, with a toxicity profile that appeared more favorable than other treatments. The regimen could be considered as an alternative in the recurrent, metastatic setting among immune checkpoint inhibitor-naive patients, especially when there are concerns about treatment-related adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with second line and beyond, recurrent/metastatic endometrial cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2, open-label, multi-center, single-arm study of atezolizumab and bevacizumab in the treatment of second line and beyond, recurrent/metastatic endometrial cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In previously treated patients with ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer, vepdegestrant plus atirmociclib showed clinical activity in the full population and in patients with ESR1 mutations. The safety profile of the combination was consistent with each agent.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Vepdegestrant, a proteolysis-targeting chimera (PROTAC) estrogen receptor (ER) degrader, plus atirmociclib (ATI) in ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer (ABC): TACTIVE-K phase 1b/2 results.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched real-world analysis, mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccination was associated with significantly reduced all-cause mortality among patients receiving bispecific antibody therapy. Vaccination was not associated with an increased risk of CRS grade 1/2 or ICANS, supporting the safety of mRNA vaccination in this high-risk population and suggesting a potential survival benefit requiring prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with hematologic malignancies who received bispecific antibody therapy were included and stratified by receipt of mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccines, while patients with documented COVID-19 infection or post-COVID-19 conditions were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The impact of COVID‑19 mRNA vaccination on bispecific antibody outcomes in hematologic malignancies: A retrospective multicenter cohort study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with HPV-positive tumors, regorafenib plus avelumab showed a clinically meaningful efficacy signal and appeared to surpass historical outcomes seen with checkpoint inhibitor monotherapy. Biomarker analyses are ongoing to identify predictors of durable response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced/metastatic HPV-driven solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of the combination of regorafenib + avelumab in patients with HPV-associated cancer: The phase II REGOMUNE study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this extended two-year real-world analysis, CAR-T therapy was associated with superior overall survival compared with teclistamab in patients with multiple myeloma, but it was also associated with increased immune-mediated toxicities. The findings build upon prior short-term data and underscore the need for prospective studies directly comparing BCMA-targeted treatment strategies over longer follow-up intervals.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with multiple myeloma in the United States who were treated between 2021 and 2023 with either CAR-T therapy, specifically ciltacabtagene autoleucel or idecabtagene vicleucel, or teclistamab; patients who received other bispecific antibodies, including elranatamab, talquetamab, or linvoseltamab, were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated two-year overall survival and toxicity outcomes of BCMA CAR-T therapy compared with teclistamab in multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Entinostat plus pembrolizumab treatment in anti-PD(L)1-resistant metastatic melanoma was associated with durable clinical benefit in a subset of patients and was well tolerated. Correlative analysis showed that treatment increased inflammation across most analyzed tumors, with the greatest benefit observed in patients with pre-existing inflamed tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: melanoma progressing on or after a PD-1/L1 blocking antibody
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results and correlative analysis of entinostat (E) plus pembrolizumab (P) in patients (Pts) with metastatic melanoma (MM) previously treated with anti–PD-(L)1 therapy (Tx).

data.clinical_result_summary: This total neoadjuvant therapy regimen significantly enhanced complete response rates and anal preservation in patients with proficient mismatch repair locally advanced low rectal cancer compared with historical benchmarks, with an acceptable safety profile. The findings suggest that this approach may be an alternative treatment option for patients with locally advanced low rectal cancer who strongly desire anal preservation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with proficient mismatch repair locally advanced low rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II trial of anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody and FOLFOXIRI combined with long-course radiotherapy as the total neoadjuvant treatment for proficient, mismatch repair, locally advanced low rectal cancer (PANFORTE).

data.clinical_result_summary: Clinical responses and target modulation were observed in patients irrespective of baseline HER2 expression. Lesion-specific analyses provided evidence of antitumor activity and target engagement even in a baseline HER2-null lesion. Genomic analyses to identify additional molecular determinants of response or resistance to trastuzumab deruxtecan are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-expressing advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HER2-independent antitumor and pharmacodynamic responses to trastuzumab deruxtecan in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this exploratory analysis from ASCENT-07, sacituzumab govitecan showed numerical trends toward improved efficacy versus treatment of physician’s choice in patients with HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer and HER2 IHC0 status. The safety profile was manageable, supporting further investigation in patients who are candidates for first chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HR+/HER2−, locally advanced unresectable or metastatic breast cancer who had received prior endocrine therapy and were eligible for first chemotherapy, with HER2 IHC0 expression status.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Subgroup analysis of participants (pts) with HER2 IHC0 in the ASCENT-07 study of sacituzumab govitecan (SG) vs chemotherapy in HR+/ HER2− metastatic breast cancer (mBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world limited cohort of patients with TP53-mutated acute myeloid leukemia, outcomes remained dismal. Therapy was associated with prolonged overall survival, but the apparent survival advantage was likely confounded by baseline disease severity rather than treatment alone. Even among treated patients, survival remained limited and durable disease control was rare.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with TP53-mutated acute myeloid leukemia treated at Stony Brook University Hospital between 2020 and 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of TP53-mutated acute myeloid leukemia at a single institution.

data.clinical_result_summary: The CHEPA study met its primary endpoint with a 76% complete metabolic response rate. Despite limited follow-up, progression-free survival and overall survival results were promising, and toxicity was manageable with no treatment-related deaths.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with previously untreated CD30+ peripheral T-cell lymphomas eligible for autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Brentuximab vedotin plus cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, etoposide, and prednisone (CHEPA) in newly diagnosed CD30-positive peripheral T-cell lymphomas with integrated ctDNA analysis: Results of the phase 2 CHEPA trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative cadonilimab demonstrated excellent antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with locally advanced microsatellite instability-high/deficient mismatch repair gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced microsatellite instability-high/deficient mismatch repair gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma or colorectal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative cadonilimab (AK104) in locally advanced MSI-H/dMMR gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal adenocarcinoma: A basket study.

data.clinical_result_summary: ASKG915 demonstrated promising clinical efficacy in patients with microsatellite stable colorectal cancer and non-small cell lung cancer, with a well-tolerated safety profile. These results support further evaluation of ASKG915 as monotherapy and in combination therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors that were resistant/refractory to current standard treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy results from a first-in-human, phase 1/2 study of ASKG915, an anti-PD-1/pro-IL-15 bifunctional fusion protein, for patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: These first-in-human data establish the clinical feasibility of tri-specific Fc fusion immunotherapy, validating simultaneous targeting of innate, adaptive, and stromal immune resistance mechanisms within a single molecule. The favorable early safety profile, predictable pharmacokinetics, and initial biological and antitumor signals support continued dose escalation and cohort expansion of HCB301.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced solid tumors or relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase 1 evaluation of the world’s first tri-specific SIRPα–PD-1–TGF-β Fc fusion protein HCB301 in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal irinotecan plus capecitabine showed encouraging anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers. The regimen may represent a potential new therapeutic option in the second-line setting, while follow-up survival work is ongoing and additional data are expected.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with gemcitabine-pretreated advanced biliary tract cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial evaluating liposomal irinotecan combined with capecitabine as second-line therapy for biliary tract cancer.

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, breast cancer, penile cancer, and bone and soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial evaluating an optimized B7-H3xCD3 T cell engager for treatment of solid cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low dose systemic treatment in combination with quad-shot radiation therapy is a reasonable option in locally advanced head and neck cancer. However, a larger randomized trial is warranted to define its role before being routinely recommended.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with biopsy proven head and neck cancer with performance status of 2 or lower, primary tumor in the oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, or larynx, and TNM stage III to IVB.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Palliative quad-shot radiation therapy in combination with low dose systemic treatment in advanced head and neck cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary injection site reaction data comparing vaccination over time in GLSI-100 treated non-HLA-A*02 patients showed a significant increase in immune response. The study is ongoing, and final results may vary as data collection and cleaning continue.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HER2 positive breast cancer patients who had residual disease or high-risk pCR at surgery and who have completed both neoadjuvant and postoperative adjuvant trastuzumab based treatment, non-HLA-A*02
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary injection site reaction immune response results from open-label arm of ongoing phase III study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of GLSI-100 (GP2 + GM-CSF) in patients with breast cancer with residual disease or high-risk PCR after both neo-adjuvant and postoperative adjuvant anti-HER2 therapy (Flamingo-01).

data.clinical_result_summary: Osimertinib plus savolitinib had promising results in patients with non-small cell lung cancer with low MET GCN after osimertinib resistance. The authors suggest that the MET GCN threshold for MET TKI treatment of osimertinib-resistant NSCLC should be set to 3 to benefit most osimertinib-resistant patients, but this requires validation in a large cohort study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with EGFR-mutated advanced non-small cell lung cancer with low MET GCN after osimertinib resistance
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Osimertinib plus savolitinib in osimertinib-resistant non-small-cell lung cancer with low level gene copy number MET: A multi-center, open-label, and phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: APS03118 showed highly promising clinical activity in both treatment-naïve and selective RET inhibitor-failed non-small cell lung cancer patients harboring RET fusions. Its safety profile was manageable and characterized primarily by reversible enzyme elevations, supporting further development in non-small cell lung cancer patients harboring RET fusion.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of APS03118, a next-generation RET inhibitor, in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Results from a phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Aggressive pre-liver transplantation locoregional and systemic therapies aimed at minimizing disease burden assessed by PET scan and ctDNA may demonstrate improved outcomes for colorectal cancer liver metastasis, as may HAI pump therapy. A clinical trial testing these hypotheses has been designed with expected enrollment in 2026 at three sites.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients had advanced, unresectable, liver-confined colorectal cancer liver metastasis, with minimal or no detectable disease or irreversible treatment-induced liver injury before transplant, and disease control for at least 1 year after resection of the primary colorectal tumor.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Multimodality neoadjuvant downstaging therapy before liver transplantation for colorectal liver metastasis: Real-world data from the Cleveland Clinic.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this post hoc analysis, efficacy outcomes for patients with microsatellite instability-high gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma suggested a consistent trend with a numerically more pronounced difference between treatment groups. The safety profile was manageable, and further studies in this population are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had untreated resectable locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including Siewert type 2 or 3 tumors, and this analysis focused on the microsatellite instability-high population.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant and adjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: Outcomes from the microsatellite instability-high population of the phase 3 KEYNOTE-585 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative anlotinib plus cisplatin and doxorubicin shows promising efficacy in treatment-naive stage IIB classic extremity osteosarcoma, with manageable safety. It achieved favorable long-term overall survival and clinically acceptable local recurrence and lung metastasis rates, suggesting a potential new perioperative option for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage IIb classic osteosarcoma of the extremity
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of perioperative anlotinib combined with cisplatin and doxorubicin in treatment-naive stage IIB classic osteosarcoma of the extremity: Updated results from the ALTER-S002 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In microsatellite-stable rectal cancer patients with synchronous resectable metastases, radiotherapy combined with CAPOX plus tislelizumab demonstrated promising antitumor efficacy and a manageable safety profile. Longer follow-up is needed to assess durable outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MSS locally advanced rectal cancer with resectable metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Radiotherapy followed by CAPOX plus tislelizumab in microsatellite-stable rectal cancer with synchronous resectable metastases: Updated results of the MIRACLE-1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW27011 demonstrated promising anti-tumor activity and a manageable safety profile in CLDN18.2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. A pivotal phase 3 study evaluating XNW27011 as a ≥3 line therapy in G/GEJA patients is currently ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts with CLDN18.2+ (TC≥5%, IHC ≥ 2+), advanced/metastatic GC/GEJC progressed on standard therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: XNW27011, a Claudin 18.2(CLDN18.2) targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with CLDN18.2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (G/GEJA): A phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world retrospective cohort study found that olutasidenib was often used after venetoclax in patients with mutated IDH1 relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia, including as monotherapy in about half of patients. In this cohort, 58% of patients responded and 42% achieved composite complete remission, supporting olutasidenib as a viable post-venetoclax option, although additional data are needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were at least 18 years old with confirmed mutated IDH1 relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia, a prior venetoclax regimen, at least 25 days of olutasidenib, and a documented response assessment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world treatment patterns and outcomes with olutasidenib after venetoclax in IDH1-mutated AML using EHR data.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab or ivonescimab plus axitinib demonstrated a promising safety and efficacy profile in metastatic mucosal melanoma. These dual-antibody-based regimens may provide synergistic anti-tumor activity with an improved therapeutic index and warrant further clinical investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cadonilimab or ivonescimab plus axitinib in metastatic mucosal melanoma: Results from a phase Ib trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study achieved its primary objective in terms of the 12-month PFS and thus suggests efficacy of pembrolizumab in patients with platinum-sensitive recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: platinum-sensitive recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Primary analysis of pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in platinum-sensitive recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer: The NOGGO PERCEPTION phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adding atezolizumab to paclitaxel plus bevacizumab did not significantly improve progression-free survival in the frontline treatment of hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer. A numerical overall survival extension was observed, and the safety profile was consistent with known profiles.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: Disease status (de novo stage IV vs. recurrent), liver metastasis (presence vs. absence), and PD-L1 expression (negative vs. positive).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Paclitaxel plus bevacizumab with or without atezolizumab for hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer: JCOG1919E (AMBITION) phase III trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg-based regimens showed safety results generally consistent with the known safety profiles of the individual agents, with no new safety signals observed. The safety data support pembrolizumab or rilvegostomig as combination partners for trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The reported study parts enrolled patients with previously untreated advanced HER2-positive or HER2-expressing gastric cancer, gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, with HER2 status defined by the specified immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization categories.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd)–based regimens in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancer (GC), gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA), or esophageal adenocarcinoma (EA): Safety results from DESTINY-Gastric03 (DG-03) Part 2 arms D and F, and Part 4.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic probiotics combined with glutamine compound had a preventive effect on severe radiation enteritis and diarrhea during concurrent chemoradiotherapy for rectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with locally advanced stage II-III rectal adenocarcinoma receiving preoperative chemoradiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of probiotics combined with glutamine compound for acute radiation enteritis during neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: A randomized controlled trial (NCT05406882).

data.clinical_result_summary: A neoadjuvant strategy beginning with rilvegostomig plus trastuzumab deruxtecan achieved Block A estimated pathologic complete response rates above prespecified thresholds in immune-positive subtypes and had efficacy similar to the control strategy across the full treatment sequence. Many participants with a pathologic complete response avoided subsequent chemotherapy, although interstitial lung disease led to treatment discontinuation in some participants and required active monitoring.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk HER2-negative breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant rilvegostomig (R) + trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in high-risk HER2-negative breast cancer: Results from the I-SPY 2.2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this single-institution retrospective cohort, treatment with avutometinib plus defactinib was associated with a significantly longer median duration of therapy in patients with KRAS-mutant recurrent low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma compared with KRAS-wild type disease. Among patients who received both regimens, avutometinib plus defactinib appeared to provide longer treatment duration than prior single agent MEK inhibitors in the KRAS-mutant subset, although this was limited by small sample size. These findings support improved activity of avutometinib plus defactinib in KRAS-mutant low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma and warrant confirmation in larger prospective studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients were women with recurrent low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma treated with avutometinib plus defactinib between 2021 and 2025 and stratified by tumor KRAS mutation status.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Treatment duration with avutometinib/defactinib in recurrent low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma by KRAS mutation status.

data.clinical_result_summary: Glecirasib combined with second-line standard chemotherapy and bevacizumab demonstrated encouraging efficacy and tolerable safety in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12C mutation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12C mutation who failed first-line treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib, open-label, clinical trial of JAB21822 combined with second-line chemotherapy for metastatic colorectal cancer with KRAS G12C mutation.

data.clinical_result_summary: This observational study reflects real-world practice and has limitations due to non-standardized visit schedules and chart-abstracted responses without imaging re-read. Nevertheless, the findings were consistent with the trial that supported approval and provided complementary evidence on pembrolizumab effectiveness in tumor mutational burden-high cancers treated in routine care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with advanced/metastatic solid tumors, excluding melanoma and non-small cell lung cancer, who had tumor mutational burden-high disease based on FoundationOne CDx, were non-microsatellite instability high, received pembrolizumab monotherapy in second line or later, and had at least one real-world response assessment for the prespecified primary analysis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of pembrolizumab among patients with TMB-H advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative cadonilimab demonstrated excellent antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with locally advanced microsatellite instability-high/deficient mismatch repair gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced microsatellite instability-high/deficient mismatch repair gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma or colorectal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative cadonilimab (AK104) in locally advanced MSI-H/dMMR gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal adenocarcinoma: A basket study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Stage 2 results and the external control comparison confirmed a significant benefit of neoadjuvant camrelizumab, apatinib, and temozolomide in patients with resectable stage III acral melanoma. The regimen produced pathological responses and significantly improved EFS, RFS, and DMFS compared with upfront surgery and adjuvant PD-1 inhibition alone, with no new safety signal identified.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable stage II/III acral melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant camrelizumab plus apatinib and temozolomide for resectable stage III acral melanoma: Updated CAP 03-NEO trial results and external control comparison.

data.clinical_result_summary: JSKN016 demonstrated robust antitumor activity with a good safety profile in patients with HER2-negative breast cancer. The results support further development of JSKN016 as monotherapy or in combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
patients with metastatic HR+/HER2- BC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: JSKN016, a first-in-class anti-TROP2/HER3 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients (pts) with HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer: Results from a phase I study.

data.clinical_result_summary: These first-in-human data establish the clinical feasibility of tri-specific Fc fusion immunotherapy, validating simultaneous targeting of innate, adaptive, and stromal immune resistance mechanisms within a single molecule. The favorable early safety profile, predictable pharmacokinetics, and initial biological and antitumor signals support continued dose escalation and cohort expansion of HCB301.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced solid tumors or relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase 1 evaluation of the world’s first tri-specific SIRPα–PD-1–TGF-β Fc fusion protein HCB301 in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg-based regimens showed safety results generally consistent with the known safety profiles of the individual agents, with no new safety signals observed. The safety data support pembrolizumab or rilvegostomig as combination partners for trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The reported study parts enrolled patients with previously untreated advanced HER2-positive or HER2-expressing gastric cancer, gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, with HER2 status defined by the specified immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization categories.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd)–based regimens in advanced HER2-expressing gastric cancer (GC), gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA), or esophageal adenocarcinoma (EA): Safety results from DESTINY-Gastric03 (DG-03) Part 2 arms D and F, and Part 4.

data.clinical_result_summary: IMbrave251 did not meet its primary overall survival endpoint, but the addition of atezolizumab to TKIs had a manageable safety profile. The study provides clinically relevant Phase 3 evidence for second-line treatment sequencing after immunotherapy and establishes a new overall survival benchmark for second-line treatment in locally advanced or metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma previously treated with atezolizumab and bevacizumab
clinical_result_layer_factor: disease etiology (hepatitis B/C infection vs non-viral), ALBI score (1 vs 2/3), AFP (<400 vs ≥400 ng/mL), and TKI therapy (lenvatinib vs sorafenib)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: IMbrave251: Final analysis of atezolizumab (atezo) + lenvatinib (lenva) or sorafenib (sora) vs lenva or sora alone in locally advanced or metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma (LA/mHCC) previously treated with atezo and bevacizumab (bev).

data.clinical_result_summary: Percent reduction in primary tumor PET avidity after neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy in resectable gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma was not associated with surgical pathology outcomes in this cohort. PET combined with endoscopy may better select patients for non-operative management, but more accurate tools to assess residual disease are needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with localized MSS gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma treated with curative intent ICB plus chemotherapy at MSK, receiving neoadjuvant therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical and metabolic predictors of complete response after neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade in resectable gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, PCSK9 inhibitor use in patients with cancer and hyperlipidemia treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors was associated with improved overall survival and reduced healthcare utilization. The findings support ongoing prospective clinical trials evaluating potential synergistic effects of PCSK9 inhibition with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer, melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, or breast cancer who received concurrent immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy plus PCSK9 inhibitors or high-intensity statins alone for hyperlipidemia between 01/01/2011 and 01/01/2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of PCSK9 inhibitors with clinical outcomes in patients with cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The SCALE regimen demonstrated potent antitumor activity, achieving 56.7% pathological complete response and 91.7% major pathological response. Favorable 2-year overall survival and disease-free survival further highlight its potential to improve long-term outcomes for patients with resectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SCALE-2: A phase 2 trial evaluating neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy combined with chemotherapy and toripalimab in resectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Asandeutertinib significantly improved intracranial objective response rate and intracranial progression-free survival compared with osimertinib in treatment-naïve patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and brain metastases. The safety profile was manageable, supporting its potential as a new first-line treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients With EGFR-Mutated Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With Brain Metastases
clinical_result_layer_factor: number of intracranial lesions (>3 or ≤3) and EGFR mutation type (L858R or 19Del)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of asandeutertinib versus osimertinib as first-line treatment in EGFR-mutated NSCLC patients with brain metastases: Interim analysis of an open-label, multicenter, randomized, pivotal phase II study (ESAONA).

data.clinical_result_summary: Eribulin outcomes were significantly influenced by line of therapy, with superior median progression-free survival in earlier-line settings (L2-3). Clinical activity was robust after prior CDK4/6 inhibitor exposure, suggesting eribulin is an effective sequential option following targeted therapy failure in high-risk visceral disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Retrospective analysis of 99 patients with metastatic breast cancer treated with eribulin in India from 2019 to 2023.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world analysis of eribulin sequencing and outcomes in advanced breast cancer: An LMIC cohort study focusing on line of therapy and prior cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 inhibitor exposure.

data.clinical_result_summary: Aponermin monotherapy showed promising disease control and a favorable safety and tolerability profile in advanced chondrosarcoma. However, no objective responses were observed, and final efficacy and safety assessments await completion of the ongoing study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced chondrosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of DR4/DR5 agonist aponermin monotherapy in advanced chondrosarcoma: Preliminary report from a prospective, multicenter study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with historic chemotherapy-treated cohorts, the results support the safety and efficacy of molecularly guided combination therapies including a targeted agent plus an immune checkpoint inhibitor in patients with carcinoma of unknown primary. Larger prospective trials of biomarker-matched N-of-1 combinations in carcinoma of unknown primary are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients previously enrolled in the I-PREDICT study had carcinoma of unknown primary and were treated with a combination of targeted therapies and biomarker-driven immune checkpoint inhibitors based on comprehensive genomic profiling and recommendations by a Molecular Tumor Board.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Carcinomas of unknown primary treated with molecularly guided therapies and immune checkpoint inhibitors: A subset from the I-PREDICT N-of-1 Precision Oncology study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of the EZH2 inhibitor tazemetostat was associated with high clinical efficacy and peripheral immune remodeling in patients receiving CAR T-cell therapy for B-cell lymphomas. The regimen did not negatively affect CAR T transduction efficiency, activation, or expansion, and randomized studies are planned to validate this approach.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, or mantle cell lymphoma receiving standard-of-care CART therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune priming with the EZH2 inhibitor tazemetostat in B-cell lymphomas receiving CAR T-cell therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of SYS6010 and SYH2051 showed acceptable safety and tolerability in patients with advanced solid tumors. Promising antitumor activity was observed in patients with advanced gastric cancer, particularly among those receiving the regimen as ≥3rd-line therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced, EGFR-positive or EGFR-mutant solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SYS6010 combined with SYH2051 in advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase Ib/II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this ongoing blinded analysis of heavily treated patients with metastatic breast cancer, 65% of patients had stable or decreased CAML counts, which significantly correlated with better progression-free survival. Treatment arm-specific comparisons remain blinded until completion of the designated milestone of 144 mortalities.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with advanced, late-stage metastatic breast cancer who lacked approved therapies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Monitoring blood-based biomarkers as early predictors of progression-free survival in a randomized Bria-ABC phase 3 trial for advanced metastatic breast cancer: An ongoing analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with ICI-treated metastatic cancer, aspirin use was associated with longer progression-free survival and overall survival, as well as higher disease control rate. The findings require prospective validation to ascertain causality, patient selection, and the safety–benefit profile of aspirin with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic cancers treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Aspirin use and outcomes with immune checkpoint inhibitors in metastatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world propensity score-matched study demonstrated significantly reduced all-cause mortality with Pola-R-CHP compared with R-CHOP in patients with DLBCL. Many toxicities were similar between groups, although Pola-R-CHP was associated with a higher rate of peripheral neuropathy. The findings suggest that Pola-R-CHP is a better upfront option with improved survival benefits and no new safety concerns.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged 18 years or older with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma/high-grade lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative real-world safety outcomes of Pola-R-CHP versus R-CHOP in high-grade diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL): A TriNetX study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of low-dose Pembrolizumab to chemotherapy significantly improved overall survival and progression-free survival in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer. There were no new safety signals, and this regimen may improve access to immune checkpoint inhibitors in resource-limited settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer without actionable genomic alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Low-dose pembrolizumab with chemotherapy in advanced NSCLC: A phase 3 randomized trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line niraparib maintenance improved progression-free survival regardless of BRCA status. Overall survival benefit was observed in the matched cohort, particularly among BRCA wild-type patients with minimal crossover to post-progression PARP inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Korean patients with advanced ovarian cancer, specifically patients with newly diagnosed FIGO stage III–IV epithelial ovarian cancer who completed first-line platinum-based chemotherapy between December 2019 and October 2022 at nine tertiary institutions in South Korea.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of first-line niraparib maintenance therapy in Korean patients with advanced ovarian cancer: A multicenter retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Losartan added to gemcitabine and cisplatin was associated with improved survival in patients with advanced gallbladder cancer or cholangiocarcinoma. The study suggests that anti-inflammatory genomic signatures and variants such as SMARCA4 and ATRX may predict benefit from this tumor microenvironment-targeted approach, while pro-inflammatory profiles and angiogenesis-related mutations may identify resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with histologically confirmed, unresectable or metastatic gallbladder cancer or cholangiocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tumor microenvironment modulation by losartan in advanced gallbladder cancer (GBC): Results and genomic correlates from the phase 2 LAST study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy, tislelizumab, and apatinib demonstrated promising efficacy with a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The findings support further investigation in larger controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of tislelizumab and apatinib combined with hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy for advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: A single-arm, phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: EZ+TALA demonstrated promising antitumor activity in patients with high-volume metastatic hormone-naïve prostate cancer. The toxicity profile was consistent with prior AR+PARP trials, although two cases of acute myeloid leukemia were observed with prolonged talazoparib exposure. Paired tumor biopsies revealed mechanisms of tumor adaptation to ADT+EZ inhibition, supporting a biologically informed rationale for AR+PARP treatment intensification strategies in metastatic hormone-naïve prostate cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: men with high-volume metastatic hormone-naïve prostate cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: DDR mutation status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results from ZZFIRST: A randomized phase 2 trial of enzalutamide (EZ) and talazoparib (TALA) in metastatic hormone-naïve prostate cancer (mHNPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: PeptiCRAd-1 showed a favorable safety profile and induced coordinated systemic and intratumoral immune activation in patients with advanced solid tumors. Robust antigen-specific T-cell responses and enhanced tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte infiltration support its potential to strengthen antitumor immunity and justify continued evaluation, including combination with PD-1 blockade.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with injectable, advanced solid tumors expressing NY-ESO-1 and/or MAGE-A3.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical translation of PeptiCRAd-1: Interim clinical evaluation of a modular oncolytic adenovirus vaccine platform targeting NY-ESO-1 and MAGE-A3 in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preoperative radiotherapy added to pembrolizumab significantly increased 2-week tumor T-cell infiltration and produced high rates of nodal pathologic complete response and pathologic complete response after chemo-immunotherapy. The numerically highest nodal response was observed in the 9 Gy arm, and 2-week tumor T-cell infiltration was strongly associated with surgical ypN0 status.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with node-positive, triple-negative breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: cT stage (T1c vs. T2-4) and cN stage (N1 vs. N2-3)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Primary results from the triple-negative cohort of TBCRC-053 (P-RAD): A randomized trial of no, low, or high dose preoperative radiation with pembrolizumab and chemotherapy in node-positive breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: PET uptake measured by SUV of 68Ga-NODAGA-SNA014 correlated with CLDN18.2 expression. These findings support its potential as a noninvasive companion diagnostic to guide and optimize CLDN18.2-targeted therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pancreatic cancer imaged on a total-body (panoramic) PET/CT system
data.clinical_result_paper_title: 68Ga-NODAGA-SNA014 whole-body PET imaging to detect Claudin18.2–positive pancreatic cancer lesions.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients who developed grade 1-2 toxicity and did not receive immunosuppressants and/or corticosteroids experienced improved overall survival and progression-free survival when treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors. Patients with a greater number of different toxicities and those who did not use antibiotics experienced better progression-free survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with stage IV or advanced melanoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, including ipilimumab/nivolumab, nivolumab, or pembrolizumab, between 2014 and 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Relationship between immune-mediated adverse events and clinical outcomes in patients with metastatic melanoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs): A retrospective real-world analysis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: Larotrectinib continued to demonstrate rapid and durable responses, extended clinical benefit, and a favorable safety profile in patients with advanced TRK fusion lung cancer. These findings support wider adoption of NGS panels that include NTRK gene fusions to identify patients who may benefit from TRK inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with TRK fusion lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of larotrectinib in patients with TRK fusion lung cancer: An updated analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The median real-world progression-free survival of 10.55 months demonstrated the efficacy of tazemetostat in patients with advanced epithelioid sarcoma. Treatment-emergent adverse events were mostly mild, and updated data will be presented in the future.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Chinese patients with histologically confirmed advanced epithelioid sarcoma with loss of SMARCB1/INI1 who were treated with tazemetostat-based regimens at Ruijin Hainan Hospital between 2022 and 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world evidence of tazemetostat in epithelioid sarcoma patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with significantly longer 3-year overall survival and lower hazards of severe cytopenias and serious infections in diabetic patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia receiving BTK inhibitors, with no meaningful differences in major cardiovascular outcomes. Further studies are warranted to confirm the role of SGLT2 inhibitors in diabetic chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included diabetic patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia receiving BTK inhibitors, including ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, or zanubrutinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of SGLT2 inhibitors on clinical outcomes in diabetic patients with CLL receiving BTK inhibitors: A global propensity-matched study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Azer-cel in autologous CAR T-naive patients demonstrated promising clinical activity across a broad range of CD19+ B-cell malignancies, including marginal zone lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Encouraging response rates, robust CAR T-cell expansion, and a manageable safety profile support further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia not previously exposed to autologous CAR T therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of Azer-cel, an allogeneic CD19 CAR T for the treatment of patients with relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia not previously exposed to autologous CAR T therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients with RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer treated with anti-EGFR-based therapy, maintenance therapy was independently associated with clinically meaningful improvements in overall survival and progression-free survival across multiple lines of treatment. The findings should be interpreted cautiously because maintenance therapy was preferentially administered to patients with objective response and preserved performance status, and the non-randomized retrospective design remains vulnerable to selection bias and residual confounding.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with RAS-wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer treated with anti-EGFR therapy at Moscow City Oncology Hospital No. 62 between 2009 and 2024 were retrospectively analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Maintenance therapy after induction chemotherapy with anti-EGFR–antibody and survival in metastatic colorectal cancer: A retrospective real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: ST316 monotherapy was generally well tolerated, safe, and resulted in significant on-target suppression of tumor Wnt/ß-catenin transcriptional signatures. In second-line metastatic colorectal cancer, ST316 combined with FOLFIRI/bevacizumab reached a confirmed ORR of 46.7% and disease control rate of 93.4%, supporting a clinically meaningful combination effect. Liver enzyme elevations were reversible and asymptomatic, supporting further evaluation of ST316 in combination with standard of care in early-stage colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients (pts) with metastatic CRC who have progressed after first line chemotherapy-containing regimens
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of ST316, a first in class ß-catenin antagonist, in metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Zopapogene imadenovec-drba treatment demonstrated significant clinical benefit in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis, with the vast majority of complete-response patients experiencing ongoing durable complete responses for up to 4 years. Long-term safety was excellent, with no new safety events observed during follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_name: 复发性呼吸道乳头状瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with RRP
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zopapogene imadenovec-drba, a novel non-replicating adenoviral vector-based immunotherapy: Effects on complete and durable responses in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis pivotal trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cabozantinib used as maintenance therapy after prior treatment and achievement of stable disease or better appears feasible and has met the interim benchmark needed to support continued enrollment. The study supports ongoing evaluation of whether this approach can improve 1-year progression-free survival by at least 20%.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pediatric solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Interim analysis of CaboMain: A prospective, single-arm phase 2 clinical trial of cabozantinib as maintenance therapy for patients with “ultra-high-risk” pediatric solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Postoperative adjuvant Donafenib was associated with prolonged recurrence-free survival and overall survival in hepatocellular carcinoma patients at high risk of recurrence after radical resection, with a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HCC patients with a high risk of recurrence after radical resection, defined by tumor diameter > 5 cm, multiple lesions, microvascular invasion (MVI) grade 1 or 2, lesions complicated by tumor thrombus (TT), or alpha-fetoprotein (AFP)≥200 μg/L.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of postoperative adjuvant donafenib therapy for patients with high-risk recurrence hepatocellular carcinoma after radical resection: A multicenter retrospective study in China.

data.clinical_result_summary: Faridoxorubicin was active in salivary gland cancer and was well tolerated, delivering a high concentration of free doxorubicin to the tumor microenvironment relative to plasma. Responses and prolonged disease stabilization were observed in patients with salivary gland cancer, indicating activity of the peptide drug conjugate.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with Salivary Gland Cancers
patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors reported to be FAP-positive
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ia/Ib trial of FAP-Dox (AVA6000), a fibroblast activation protein (FAP)–released doxorubicin peptide drug conjugate in patients with FAP-positive solid tumors and activity against salivary gland cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sintilimab combined with nab-paclitaxel shows promising efficacy and acceptable safety in platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer. TILs ≥10% and a high CD8+/CD4+ ratio emerged as potential predictive biomarkers, while PD-L1 CPS showed limited utility. This regimen represents a potential new therapeutic option for this difficult-to-treat population and warrants further investigation in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of sintilimab combined with nab-paclitaxel in the treatment of platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world population, atezolizumab and durvalumab offered comparable real-world overall survival for patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer when used with platinum-based chemotherapy in the first-line setting or as monotherapy in first-line maintenance. Real-world overall survival was shorter than that reported in phase 3 clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated in first-line and first-line maintenance settings, including patients treated with atezolizumab or durvalumab plus platinum-based chemotherapy and a subset subsequently treated with atezolizumab or durvalumab monotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of real-world overall survival between atezolizumab- and durvalumab-containing first-line induction and maintenance regimens in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant adebrelimab combined with chemotherapy showed promising efficacy and manageable toxicity in patients with locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. The findings also suggest that myeloid-associated PD-L1 expression and treatment-induced T-cell redistribution may be potential immune correlates of response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant adebrelimab combined with chemotherapy in locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Corticosteroid and tocilizumab use following CAR-T therapy was independently associated with an increased risk of bacterial and fungal infections and higher infection-related mortality. These findings highlight the importance of antimicrobial prophylaxis and infection surveillance.
clinical_result_indication_name: 免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included CAR-T recipients who received axi-cel.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of corticosteroid and tocilizumab use on infection incidence and outcomes following CAR T-cell therapy with axicabtagene ciloleucel.

data.clinical_result_summary: With median PFS not yet reached after 7 years of follow-up in CROWN, lorlatinib continued to show unprecedented and highly durable benefit in treatment-naive patients with advanced ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer. Patients without a PFS event at 24 months had a 79% probability of survival without progressive disease at 7 years, and longer follow-up showed very few additional PFS events, no new intracranial progression, and no new treatment-related discontinuation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Asia people with previously untreated advanced NSCLC, CN subgroup
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Lorlatinib vs crizotinib as first-line treatment for advanced ALK+ non-small cell lung cancer: 7-year update from the phase 3 CROWN study.

data.clinical_result_summary: AZA+VEN in patients at high risk of induction mortality provided a valuable alternative with better safety and reduced financial burden and time toxicity. Although CR/CRi rates were lower than with 3+7, induction mortality was comparable between the two approaches.
clinical_result_indication_detail: De-novo acute myeloid leukemia patients aged 18 years or older who were planned for treatment by a multi-disciplinary joint clinic with either 3+7 or AZA+VEN.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective observational study to compare the efficacy, time toxicity, and cost of conventional 3+7 regimen versus azacitidine + venetoclax (AZA + VEN) as induction therapy in patients with acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

data.clinical_result_summary: Total neoadjuvant tislelizumab plus chemotherapy demonstrated promising efficacy and an acceptable safety profile in patients with Borrmann-IV gastric cancer. Lauren classification may serve as a potential predictive biomarker and warrants further study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with Borrmann-IV gastric cancer without distant metastasis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Total neoadjuvant immunotherapy plus chemotherapy in Borrmann type IV gastric cancer (PERISCOPE-01 study): An open-label, single-arm, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this supplementary analysis of JCOG1008, no prognostic disadvantage was observed when post-operative radiotherapy was initiated within the range observed in the trial, 6–10 weeks after surgery, among patients receiving post-operative chemoradiotherapy. The findings support individualized surgical-to-postoperative radiotherapy interval timing rather than rigid cutoff-based decision-making in contemporary standardized chemoradiotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with post-operative high-risk locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma receiving post-operative chemoradiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Timing of postoperative chemoradiotherapy and survival outcomes in high-risk locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: A supplementary analysis of JCOG1008.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of olaparib to pembrolizumab was well tolerated but did not result in any objective response in molecularly unselected metastatic uveal melanoma. Landmark survival results appeared clinically meaningful and likely related to disease control with stable metastatic burden. Ongoing biomarker studies may help determine which patients could benefit from this combination regimen.
