clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic uveal melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial of olaparib in combination with pembrolizumab in metastatic uveal melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: The successful use of a novel transposon-engineered BAFF ligand-based CAR-T cell product demonstrates the potential of a new direction in CAR-T cell development. Safety and efficacy were seen, including in patients with prior CAR-T failure and epitope loss.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory non-hodgkin lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Novel transposon BAFF CAR-T cells (LMY-920) for non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of transplant-ineligible adults aged 70 years or older with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, Dara-RD was associated with improved survival and a more favorable toxicity profile compared with VRD. Dara-VRD demonstrated comparable survival to Dara-RD but was associated with higher rates of cytopenias. Long-term follow-up is needed to further evaluate survival differences between Dara-VRD and Dara-RD and identify older patient subsets most likely to benefit from quadruplet therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 70 years or older with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who were transplant-ineligible or did not undergo autologous stem cell transplant and received frontline VRD, Dara-RD, or Dara-VRD between 2017 and 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparison of Dara-VRD, VRD, and Dara-RD in transplant-ineligible older adults with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this interim analysis, the combination of cadonilimab with liposomal irinotecan plus fluorouracil and leucovorin showed preliminary signs of efficacy and tolerable toxicity in later-line treatment of advanced biliary tract cancer. These findings warrant further investigation in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Later-line treatment of PD-1 and CTLA-4 blockade combined with liposomal irinotecan plus leucovorin and fluorouracil for advanced biliary tract cancer: A prospective, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The successful use of a novel transposon-engineered BAFF ligand-based CAR-T cell product demonstrates the potential of a new direction in CAR-T cell development. Safety and efficacy were seen, including in patients with prior CAR-T failure and epitope loss.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory non-hodgkin lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Novel transposon BAFF CAR-T cells (LMY-920) for non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL).

data.clinical_result_summary: ABSK061 combined with ABSK043, with or without CAPOX, showed a manageable safety profile and encouraging anti-tumor activity in both first-line and previously treated FGFR2-positive gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction cancer. These preliminary results support further clinical development of the doublet and quadruplet regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of ABSK061 (selective FGFR2/3 inhibitor) combined with ABSK043 (oral PD-L1 inhibitor) ± CAPOX in advanced FGFR2-positive gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJC): Preliminary results from ABSK061-201.

data.clinical_result_summary: This interim analysis suggests that adjuvant donafenib combined with a single session of postoperative transarterial chemoembolization demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with high-risk hepatocellular carcinoma after curative resection. Longer follow-up and larger studies are needed to confirm the durability of benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and high-risk features after curative resection
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Interim analysis of efficacy and safety of adjuvant donafenib plus transarterial chemoembolization in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and high-risk features after curative resection.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of donafenib and anti-PD-1 antibody as adjuvant therapy demonstrated promising efficacy and was well tolerated in hepatocellular carcinoma patients with high risks of recurrence.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled primary hepatocellular carcinoma patients at Hunan Provincial People's Hospital who had undergone R0 or radical resection and had high-risk recurrence factors, including microvascular invasion, tumor diameter ≥5 cm, ≥2 tumors, satellite lesions, or poor tumor differentiation (Edmondson stage III-IV).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Donafenib combined with anti–PD-1 antibody as adjuvant therapy for patients with hepatocellular carcinoma at high risk of recurrence after resection.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sintilimab combined with nab-paclitaxel shows promising efficacy and acceptable safety in platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer. TILs ≥10% and a high CD8+/CD4+ ratio emerged as potential predictive biomarkers, while PD-L1 CPS showed limited utility. This regimen represents a potential new therapeutic option for this difficult-to-treat population and warrants further investigation in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of sintilimab combined with nab-paclitaxel in the treatment of platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: SPJ-101CA was well tolerated and effective as maintenance therapy following multidisciplinary treatment for high-risk neuroblastoma. The pharmacokinetic findings were consistent with the known profile of isotretinoin and indicated good absorption of the formulation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients aged 1-18 years with newly diagnosed, high-risk neuroblastoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A study of the safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics of SPJ-101CA as maintenance therapy for newly diagnosed high-risk neuroblastoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant adebrelimab plus chemotherapy produced high response rates and promising organ preservation in untreated, resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Toxicity was manageable, and biomarker findings suggested better responses in p16-positive and PD-L1-high tumors.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated, resectable stage III-IVA/B locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant adebrelimab plus chemotherapy in untreated locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: Efficacy and biomarker insights from a single-arm phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fedratinib demonstrates promising clinical efficacy in patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia with proliferative features. The safety profile is consistent with prior experience, and its unique kinase inhibition profile may provide a mechanism for enhanced effectiveness in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_name: 慢性中性粒细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of fedratinib in patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicentric cohort of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma treated with atezolizumab-bevacizumab, concomitant ACE inhibitor or angiotensin receptor blocker therapy did not improve clinical outcomes and may have been associated with a negative survival trend. Further studies are needed to clarify the effect of concomitant medications and RAS inhibitors in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma treated from 2023 to 2025 with atezolizumab-bevacizumab in Italy, with concomitant ACE inhibitor or angiotensin receptor blocker use at atezolizumab-bevacizumab initiation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of ACE inhibitors (ACEi) and angiotensin receptor blockers (ARB) on outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma treated with atezolizumab–bevacizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: In HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients without baseline brain metastases after first-line THP, trastuzumab deruxtecan was associated with significantly lower incident brain metastases, delayed onset, and reduced CNS morbidity compared with tucatinib/trastuzumab/capecitabine. Overall survival did not differ significantly between the two regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer previously treated with first-line THP, without baseline brain metastases at index, in the second-line setting.
clinical_result_layer_factor: age, comorbidity burden, and lines of treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world brain metastasis outcomes with T-DXd versus tucatinib-based therapy in second-line HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of radium-223 and paclitaxel could be administered safely, with most adverse events being grade 1 to 2 except for a higher incidence of grade 3 or higher neutropenia. The trial did not meet the primary progression-free survival endpoint, although a numerical improvement in median overall survival was observed with the combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with ≥2 bone lesions and limited visceral metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ETCTN 10302: A randomized phase II trial of radium-223 dichloride in combination with paclitaxel in patients with bone metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of the EZH2 inhibitor tazemetostat was associated with high clinical efficacy and peripheral immune remodeling in patients receiving CAR T-cell therapy for B-cell lymphomas. The regimen did not negatively affect CAR T transduction efficiency, activation, or expansion, and randomized studies are planned to validate this approach.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, or mantle cell lymphoma receiving standard-of-care CART therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune priming with the EZH2 inhibitor tazemetostat in B-cell lymphomas receiving CAR T-cell therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: This preliminary analysis presented the first data evaluating PSMA-TV changes after enzalutamide in biochemically recurrent prostate cancer without androgen deprivation therapy. The lack of concordance between PSA and PSMA responses highlights the need for more data and caution when using PSMA imaging to define therapeutic benefit or lack thereof in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included biochemically recurrent prostate cancer patients with negative CT and bone scan, testosterone greater than 100, PSMA-positive biochemical recurrence, and paired PSMA scans before and after enzalutamide monotherapy for the analyzed group.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Short-course (3-month) enzalutamide monotherapy in biochemically recurrent prostate cancer (BCR): Preliminary prostate specific membrane antigen tumor volume (PSMA-TV) data.

data.clinical_result_summary: LINVO demonstrated generally manageable safety and rapid, meaningful clinical activity in relapsed or refractory systemic light chain amyloidosis, with most patients achieving hematologic objective response and iFLC <20 mg/L. These results support continued evaluation of LINVO in this population, and longer follow-up data including organ responses are being evaluated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory systemic light chain amyloidosis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First results from the phase 1/2 LINKER-AL2 trial of linvoseltamab (LINVO) in patients (pts) with relapsed or refractory (RR) systemic light chain (AL) amyloidosis.

data.clinical_result_summary: ANV600 as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab showed a favorable safety profile in patients with advanced solid tumors. Highly promising efficacy signals were reported, including one ongoing complete response, several long-lasting partial responses, and stable disease in CPI-naïve and CPI pre-treated patients, including CPI-resistant tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, PK/PD, and efficacy results from Expand-1: A phase 1 dose escalation study of the novel PD-1 targeted IL-2R-βγ agonist sunekafusp alpha (ANV600) as a single agent and in combination with pembrolizumab in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: KH617 showed significantly superior anti-tumor activity compared with historical median overall survival in patients with recurrent glioblastoma. KH617 was also well tolerated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with histologically confirmed advanced solid tumors (including diffuse gliomas of adulthood) no longer responding to standard therapies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I study to assess the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary antitumor activity of KH617 for patients with advanced solid tumors (including diffuse gliomas of adulthood).

data.clinical_result_summary: IBI363 was well tolerated with a manageable safety profile consistent with earlier reports. It continued to show strong and durable efficacy in patients with heavily pretreated non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: NSCLC, squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-class PD-1/IL-2α-bias bispecific antibody IBI363 (TAK-928) in patients (pts) with advanced immunotherapy-resistant non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Updated results from a phase I study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of patients with hormone-sensitive prostate cancer treated with androgen deprivation therapy plus an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor prior to chemotherapy, darolutamide was associated with lower rates of developing hormone-resistant disease and improved overall survival compared with abiraterone. The findings suggest meaningful differences in outcomes between androgen receptor pathway inhibitors in the pre-chemotherapy setting, although confirmation in prospective comparative studies is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients aged ≥18 years with hormone-sensitive prostate cancer defined using ICD-10 diagnosis codes, treated with androgen deprivation therapy plus an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor prior to chemotherapy, with prior exposure to docetaxel excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world data from the TriNetX database comparing abiraterone versus darolutamide in hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with resectable head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, induction DCU demonstrated acceptable efficacy and tolerability. The addition of pembrolizumab was feasible and was associated with higher pathologic complete response rates and increased conversion to surgery, warranting further prospective evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resectable head and neck squamous cell carcinoma who received DCU-based induction chemotherapy at Linkou Chang Gung Memorial Hospital between August 2024 and December 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pathologic response and surgical conversion after preoperative docetaxel, cisplatin, and oral 5-FU with or without PD-1 inhibitors in resectable HNSCC: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint therapy remains promising for cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma. However, the higher tremelimumab dose increased serious immune-related adverse events, underscoring the need for optimized dosing. Baseline tertiary lymphoid structure density may represent a predictive biomarker and warrants further validation with larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: muscle-Invasive, high-risk urothelial bladder carcinoma who are ineligible for cisplatin-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy - cohort1
pts with cisplatin-ineligible MIUC and high-risk features -  Cohort 2
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results from a pilot trial of neoadjuvant durvalumb in combination with tremelimuab for cisplatin-ineligible high-risk urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: EFS landmark rates were greatest for participants who completed the full adjuvant regimen compared with those who discontinued prematurely in both arms. The addition of durvalumab to FLOT improved EFS regardless of treatment periods started or completed. Safety was manageable and tolerable in the adjuvant monotherapy period.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants had histologically confirmed, resectable, untreated gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of durvalumab and safety by treatment period in MATTERHORN: A randomized, phase 3 study of durvalumab plus 5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, and docetaxel (FLOT) chemotherapy in resectable gastric/gastroesophageal junction (G/GEJ) cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with ICI-treated metastatic cancer, aspirin use was associated with longer progression-free survival and overall survival, as well as higher disease control rate. The findings require prospective validation to ascertain causality, patient selection, and the safety–benefit profile of aspirin with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic cancers treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Aspirin use and outcomes with immune checkpoint inhibitors in metastatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: A small but increasing fraction of patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer in the Veterans Health Administration received tarlatamab. Among the first 52 treated patients, outcomes and toxicity were numerically less favorable than those reported in the DeLLphi-304 study, with lower progression-free and overall survival and higher risks of immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome, grade 3 cytokine release syndrome, and fatal toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The retrospective cohort included patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer who were treated with tarlatamab from June 6, 2024 to January 13, 2026 in the Veterans Health Administration.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes associated with tarlatamab for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) in the Veterans Health Administration (VA).

data.clinical_result_summary: A-FMT showed an acceptable safety profile and feasibility when combined with immune checkpoint inhibitor-based regimens in patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. The findings supported progression to the expansion part for further efficacy evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including patients with unresectable or recurrent esophageal and gastric cancers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Gut microbiota dynamics of antibiotic fecal microbiota transplantation in esophageal and gastric cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: Preliminary results from the Biorich2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Interim findings from the A-PURC trial suggest that omission of postoperative antibiotic prophylaxis after radical cystectomy does not increase UTI or UTI-related readmission rates within 90 days. These results support a more selective, stewardship-driven approach to postoperative antibiotic use after radical cystectomy, and the trial remains ongoing to confirm non-inferiority in an expanded cohort.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer undergoing radical cystectomy at the University of Minnesota were included.
clinical_result_layer_factor: urinary diversion type—ileal conduit (IC) or neobladder (NB)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Omission of postoperative antibiotic prophylaxis after radical cystectomy: Interim results of the A-PURC phase III randomized non-inferiority trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: Larotrectinib continued to demonstrate rapid and durable responses, extended clinical benefit, and a favorable safety profile in patients with advanced TRK fusion lung cancer. These findings support wider adoption of NGS panels that include NTRK gene fusions to identify patients who may benefit from TRK inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with TRK fusion lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of larotrectinib in patients with TRK fusion lung cancer: An updated analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: A-FMT showed an acceptable safety profile and feasibility when combined with immune checkpoint inhibitor-based regimens in patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. The findings supported progression to the expansion part for further efficacy evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including patients with unresectable or recurrent esophageal and gastric cancers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Gut microbiota dynamics of antibiotic fecal microbiota transplantation in esophageal and gastric cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: Preliminary results from the Biorich2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab demonstrated potent and durable anti-tumor activity with a favorable safety profile in patients with MSI-H/dMMR locally advanced or metastatic gastrointestinal malignancies. Interleukins may serve as potential predictive biomarkers for cadonilimab efficacy, providing insights for precision medicine in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with MSI-H/dMMR unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastrointestinal malignancies who received cadonilimab since November 2022 at The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of cadonilimab in patients with MSI-H/dMMR locally advanced or metastatic gastrointestinal malignancies: A real-world retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Furmonertinib showed durable efficacy in EGFR-mutant NSCLC, unaffected by line of therapy. Risk stratification had time-dependent prognostic value, and furmonertinib demonstrated strong intracranial activity with an iORR of 79.5%. Furmonertinib was well tolerated with a favorable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective study included patients with locally advanced or metastatic EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer treated with furmonertinib as first- or later-line therapy, stratified into high-risk and non-high-risk groups based on brain or leptomeningeal metastases, high tumor burden, key co-mutations such as TP53, or acquired T790M.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety analysis of furmonertinib in the treatment of EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma: A single-center real-world study based on high-risk stratification.

data.clinical_result_summary: ABSK061 combined with ABSK043, with or without CAPOX, showed a manageable safety profile and encouraging anti-tumor activity in both first-line and previously treated FGFR2-positive gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction cancer. These preliminary results support further clinical development of the doublet and quadruplet regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of ABSK061 (selective FGFR2/3 inhibitor) combined with ABSK043 (oral PD-L1 inhibitor) ± CAPOX in advanced FGFR2-positive gastric cancer and gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJC): Preliminary results from ABSK061-201.

data.clinical_result_summary: GFH375 monotherapy showed promising antitumor activity in heavily treated patients with cholangiocarcinoma and colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12D mutations. Further development of GFH375 monotherapy in cholangiocarcinoma and combination strategies for colorectal cancer is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12D mutation
patients with advanced cholangiocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary efficacy of GFH375 in patients with advanced cholangiocarcinoma or colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12D mutation.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis, ESA therapy was associated with lower risks of sepsis and myocardial infarction, but a higher incidence of brain metastases compared with RBC transfusion in lung cancer patients with chemotherapy-induced anemia. These findings may inform individualized risk-benefit discussions when selecting anemia management strategies, and prospective studies are needed to validate these associations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged 18 years or older with lung cancer and chemotherapy-induced anemia, stratified by receipt of RBC transfusion or ESA therapy, while excluding participants who received both treatments to ensure mutually exclusive exposure groups.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of red blood cell transfusion versus erythropoiesis-stimulating agents in lung cancer patients with chemotherapy-induced anemia: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: This small series suggests that adjuvant nab-paclitaxel and sequential regional radiotherapy is a feasible strategy for patients with resected primary cardiac angiosarcoma. The addition of neoadjuvant nab-paclitaxel appears safe in selected cases, but multi-institutional collaboration and prospective studies are needed to validate the safety and efficacy of perioperative nab-paclitaxel in this ultra-rare malignancy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively included six patients at Peking Union Medical College Hospital between 2023 and 2025 with a definite diagnosis of primary cardiac angiosarcoma who underwent surgical resection followed by adjuvant nab-paclitaxel, with neoadjuvant nab-paclitaxel used in selected cases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Peri-operative nab-paclitaxel with sequential radiotherapy in cardiac angiosarcoma: A single-center retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant pegylated liposomal doxorubicin combined with anlotinib showed promising efficacy and acceptable toxicity in patients with locally advanced soft tissue sarcoma. Future multi-omics analyses may help identify suitable patients for this approach in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced, non-metastasis, treatment-naive soft tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant pegylated liposomal doxorubicin plus anlotinib in locally advanced soft tissue sarcoma: Clinical outcomes and multi-omics analysis from a phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study suggests that mirogabalin is effective and well-tolerated for the management of moderate-to-severe painful chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy during oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy. These findings warrant further evaluation in a confirmatory trial.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable advanced or recurrent gastrointestinal cancers who have oxaliplatin-associated chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of mirogabalin for oxaliplatin-associated chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy in gastrointestinal cancer: The SmiliNg trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: RNK08954 was well tolerated and displayed promising antitumor activity in patients with KRAS G12D-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. The study supports further evaluation of RNK08954 either as monotherapy or in combination with standard of care and/or novel agents.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical activity and safety of RNK08954 in advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with KRAS G12D mutation (NCT06667544).

data.clinical_result_summary: Corticosteroid and tocilizumab use following CAR-T therapy was independently associated with an increased risk of bacterial and fungal infections and higher infection-related mortality. These findings highlight the importance of antimicrobial prophylaxis and infection surveillance.
clinical_result_indication_name: 免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included CAR-T recipients who received axi-cel.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of corticosteroid and tocilizumab use on infection incidence and outcomes following CAR T-cell therapy with axicabtagene ciloleucel.

data.clinical_result_summary: Azer-cel in autologous CAR T-naive patients demonstrated promising clinical activity across a broad range of CD19+ B-cell malignancies, including marginal zone lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Encouraging response rates, robust CAR T-cell expansion, and a manageable safety profile support further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia not previously exposed to autologous CAR T therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of Azer-cel, an allogeneic CD19 CAR T for the treatment of patients with relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia not previously exposed to autologous CAR T therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary analysis indicates that the neoadjuvant combination of donafenib, hepatic artery infusion chemotherapy, and sintilimab demonstrates favorable efficacy and safety in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma. Enrollment and follow-up are continuing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with technically resectable CNLC IIb or IIIa hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of donafenib combined with hepatic artery infusion chemotherapy and sintilimab as neoadjuvant therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma: A prospective, single-arm phase II trial (Neo-DoHAICs study).

data.clinical_result_summary: Chemotherapy (SOX) plus tislelizumab as first-line treatment for gastric cancer with liver metastasis demonstrated clinically meaningful benefits in both treatment response and prolonged survival. Increased conversion surgery rate provided additional survival benefits.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated synchronous gastric cancer with liver metastasis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multi-center phase II study of chemotherapy (SOX) plus tislelizumab as first-line therapy for gastric cancer with liver metastasis.

data.clinical_result_summary: HRS-4642 combined with adebrelimab showed a manageable safety profile and promising anti-tumor activity in metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12D mutation. The RP2D group achieved a confirmed objective response rate of 48.5% and successfully met the primary endpoint.
clinical_result_indication_detail: previously treated patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HRS-4642 combined with adebrelimab in previously treated patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: VRN101099 was well tolerated across evaluated dose levels and demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity in heavily pretreated HER2-driven solid tumors, including patients previously treated with T-DXd. These findings support continued dose escalation and expansion to define the RP2D and further characterize the therapeutic potential of VRN101099.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive or HER2-mutant advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase Ia study of VRN101099, a brain-penetrant, highly selective covalent HER2 inhibitor, in HER2-positive or HER2-mutant advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study provides preliminary evidence of synergy between bevacizumab and antibody–drug conjugates, supporting a promising new strategy, especially for basal-like, immune-suppressed triple-negative breast cancer. Phase III trials are ongoing to confirm the efficacy and safety of this combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with basal-like immune-suppressed triple-negative breast cancer - arm C (HER2-low)
patients with basal-like immune-suppressed triple-negative breast cancer - arm D (HER2-zero)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of bevacizumab on the efficacy of antibody–drug conjugates as later-line treatment of basal-like immune-suppressed triple-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of the EZH2 inhibitor tazemetostat was associated with high clinical efficacy and peripheral immune remodeling in patients receiving CAR T-cell therapy for B-cell lymphomas. The regimen did not negatively affect CAR T transduction efficiency, activation, or expansion, and randomized studies are planned to validate this approach.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, or mantle cell lymphoma receiving standard-of-care CART therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune priming with the EZH2 inhibitor tazemetostat in B-cell lymphomas receiving CAR T-cell therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity-matched real-world cohort of anthracycline-treated women with breast cancer and diabetes, both GLP-1RA and SGLT2i were associated with improved survival and fewer cytopenias, infections, and venous thromboembolism versus no exposure. Compared with SGLT2i, GLP-1RA showed more favorable cardio-renal and survival outcomes, whereas SGLT2i was associated with fewer polyneuropathy and mood disorder diagnoses. Prospective validation is needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included women aged 18 years or older with breast cancer, diabetes mellitus, and anthracycline exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Beyond cardio-renal outcomes with GLP-1RA and SGLT2i in anthracycline-treated diabetic women with breast cancer: A propensity score–matched analysis from Global Federated Health Research Network.

data.clinical_result_summary: Baseline skeletal muscle index measured on C3 was a strong and independent prognostic factor for disease-free survival and overall survival in patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma treated with radiotherapy plus cisplatin, radiotherapy plus cetuximab, or radiotherapy plus cetuximab and avelumab. The association between skeletal muscle index and outcomes was linear, suggesting that arbitrary prognostic thresholds should not be used.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck who were either fit for cisplatin or ineligible for cisplatin.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Baseline skeletal muscle index as an independent prognostic factor in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: A post hoc analysis of the REACH trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The primary endpoint was met. Short-term fasting induced a favorable metabolic shift and was associated with improved pathological response and prolonged progression-free survival, alongside immune modulation. These findings provide a strong rationale for larger randomized trials evaluating short-term fasting in ovarian cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled women with advanced high-grade serous ovarian cancer receiving carboplatin/paclitaxel-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy, with eligibility requiring body mass index ≥ 19 kg/m2 and excluding patients with diabetes mellitus, food allergies, or eating disorders.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effects of short-term fasting compared to free diet in ovarian cancer patients: Results from a two-arm pilot randomized trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a real-world population of patients with metastatic breast cancer and CNS disease, sacituzumab govitecan demonstrated a modest intracranial response, with a 20% CNS objective response rate and median CNS progression-free survival of 4.5 months. All objective responses occurred in patients with prior radiation, and none occurred in patients with active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease. Larger prospective studies are needed to better characterize CNS response to sacituzumab govitecan and identify predictors of response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic breast cancer with central nervous system metastases, including brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or both, who were treated with sacituzumab govitecan from 2019 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of breast cancer central nervous system metastases treated with sacituzumab govitecan.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with type 2 diabetes, when NSAID use and background hypoglycemic medications were not excluded and anti-diabetic therapies were matched, GLP-1RA use was not associated with greater colorectal cancer risk reduction compared with aspirin. Given the inherent limitations of retrospective analyses, prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with type 2 diabetes between 2010 and 2023, comparing patients using any GLP-1RA without aspirin with patients using aspirin without any GLP-1RA, while excluding patients with a prior history of colorectal cancer or benign colorectal neoplasms.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Reevaluating the comparative effectiveness of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) vs aspirin for colorectal cancer prevention in type 2 diabetes.

data.clinical_result_summary: A-FMT showed an acceptable safety profile and feasibility when combined with immune checkpoint inhibitor-based regimens in patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. The findings supported progression to the expansion part for further efficacy evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including patients with unresectable or recurrent esophageal and gastric cancers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Gut microbiota dynamics of antibiotic fecal microbiota transplantation in esophageal and gastric cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: Preliminary results from the Biorich2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: CTX-8371 was well tolerated and demonstrated promising clinical activity as monotherapy in patients with advanced malignancies resistant to prior immune checkpoint inhibitors. Dose expansion in patients with non-small cell lung cancer and triple-negative breast cancer in 3 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg dosing cohorts is underway, and future development in treatment-refractory Hodgkin lymphoma is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with Solid Tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 dose escalation of CTX-8371, a novel PD-1×PD-L1 bispecific antibody, in patients with advanced malignancies post checkpoint inhibition.

data.clinical_result_summary: Losartan added to gemcitabine and cisplatin was associated with improved survival in patients with advanced gallbladder cancer or cholangiocarcinoma. The study suggests that anti-inflammatory genomic signatures and variants such as SMARCA4 and ATRX may predict benefit from this tumor microenvironment-targeted approach, while pro-inflammatory profiles and angiogenesis-related mutations may identify resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with histologically confirmed, unresectable or metastatic gallbladder cancer or cholangiocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tumor microenvironment modulation by losartan in advanced gallbladder cancer (GBC): Results and genomic correlates from the phase 2 LAST study.

data.clinical_result_summary: A planned erlotinib plus ramucirumab-to-osimertinib strategy did not improve time to failure of strategy compared with upfront osimertinib in EGFR L858R-mutated non-small cell lung cancer. Safety findings were consistent with known profiles, with higher discontinuation for tolerability in the strategy arm.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced/recurrent EGFR L858R–mutant non-small cell lung cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: clinical stage (IIIB/IIIC/IV vs postoperative recurrence), sex, and baseline brain metastasis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 3 clinical trial of the combination of erlotinib plus ramucirumab compared with osimertinib in untreated advanced or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer with EGFR L858R mutation: The REVOL858R trial (WJOG14420L).

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients receiving moderately emetogenic chemotherapy, a single dose of fixed-dose combination HR20013 plus dexamethasone was well tolerated and demonstrated superior efficacy in preventing chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting compared with palonosetron plus dexamethasone. The regimen also improved patient-reported outcomes and offers a more effective and convenient prophylactic option for moderately emetogenic chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: chemotherapy-naïve adults with solid tumors scheduled for single-day moderately emetogenic chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Randomized, double-blind phase 3 trial of the fixed-dose combination fosrolapitant/palonosetron (HR20013) plus dexamethasone for prevention of nausea and vomiting in patients receiving moderately emetogenic chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of SYS6010 and SYH2051 showed acceptable safety and tolerability in patients with advanced solid tumors. Promising antitumor activity was observed in patients with advanced gastric cancer, particularly among those receiving the regimen as ≥3rd-line therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced, EGFR-positive or EGFR-mutant solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SYS6010 combined with SYH2051 in advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase Ib/II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a real-world population of patients with metastatic breast cancer and CNS disease, sacituzumab govitecan demonstrated a modest intracranial response, with a 20% CNS objective response rate and median CNS progression-free survival of 4.5 months. All objective responses occurred in patients with prior radiation, and none occurred in patients with active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease. Larger prospective studies are needed to better characterize CNS response to sacituzumab govitecan and identify predictors of response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic breast cancer with central nervous system metastases, including brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or both, who were treated with sacituzumab govitecan from 2019 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of breast cancer central nervous system metastases treated with sacituzumab govitecan.

data.clinical_result_summary: Generic palbociclib combined with endocrine therapy demonstrated favorable efficacy and manageable tolerability in hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. Outcomes were comparable to global registration trials despite frequent upfront dose reductions and substantially lower drug acquisition cost, supporting its real-world effectiveness and value in resource-constrained settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer receiving generic palbociclib plus endocrine therapy were eligible.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy, tolerability, and outcomes of generic palbociclib in metastatic HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer: An ambispective study from a tertiary cancer center in South India.

data.clinical_result_summary: NeoVax generated durable T cell responses that trafficked to glioblastoma tumors, and circulating responses were associated with improved survival. The regimen was well tolerated, with no serious adverse events reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma - MGMT-unmethylated patients (Cohorts 1A-C)
Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma  MGMT-methylated patients (Cohort 1D)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A personalized neoantigen vaccine to reprogram the immune landscape of glioblastoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sintilimab combined with nab-paclitaxel shows promising efficacy and acceptable safety in platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer. TILs ≥10% and a high CD8+/CD4+ ratio emerged as potential predictive biomarkers, while PD-L1 CPS showed limited utility. This regimen represents a potential new therapeutic option for this difficult-to-treat population and warrants further investigation in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of sintilimab combined with nab-paclitaxel in the treatment of platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Chemotherapy (SOX) plus tislelizumab as first-line treatment for gastric cancer with liver metastasis demonstrated clinically meaningful benefits in both treatment response and prolonged survival. Increased conversion surgery rate provided additional survival benefits.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated synchronous gastric cancer with liver metastasis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multi-center phase II study of chemotherapy (SOX) plus tislelizumab as first-line therapy for gastric cancer with liver metastasis.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study met its primary endpoint, indicating that almonertinib followed by chemo-immunotherapy was a feasible neoadjuvant treatment in patients with resectable stage IIA-IIIB EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer, especially in patients with PD-L1 expression. Median EFS and OS were not reached, and Grade ≥3 adverse events occurred in 87.5% of patients during neoadjuvant therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated II–IIIB NSCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant almonertinib followed by chemo-immunotherapy in II-IIIb EGFR-mutant NSCLC: A single arm, phase II study (NEOVADE).

data.clinical_result_summary: Tazemetostat demonstrated clinically meaningful activity and a manageable safety profile in Japanese patients with advanced epithelioid sarcoma. These results were consistent with previous reports and support tazemetostat as a therapeutic option in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Japanese patients with advanced epithelioid sarcoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety results of tazemetostat in Japanese patients with advanced epithelioid sarcoma: The phase 2 TAZETTA trial (NCCH2107).

data.clinical_result_summary: BAT followed by sipuleucel-T was safe and effective in potentiating immune response to sipuleucel-T in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer. Encouraging clinical activity was observed, and the study is currently enrolling to the second stage of the Simon’s design.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with progressive metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of bipolar androgen therapy combined with sipuleucel-T for patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter retrospective cohort study of metastatic/advanced renal cell carcinoma, Pembrolizumab-Lenvatinib showed no significant change in overall survival or progression-free survival compared with Nivolumab-Ipilimumab. Nivolumab-Cabozantinib demonstrated superior overall survival compared with Nivolumab-Ipilimumab, although progression-free survival was not significantly different.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had metastatic or advanced renal cell carcinoma and received first-line therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of dual checkpoint blockade versus PD-1/VEGF inhibitor combination as first-line therapy in metastatic renal cell carcinoma.

中位影像学无进展生存期（median rPFS）
data.clinical_result_summary: Rucaparib demonstrated efficacy in patients with BRCA-mutated mCRPC, regardless of whether prior ARPI was administered in the mCSPC or mCRPC setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Men with BRCA mutations who were chemotherapy-naive in the mCRPC setting and had received one prior ARPI after progression on 1 prior second-generation ARPI in any setting.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位影像学无进展生存期
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of prior treatment setting on the efficacy of rucaparib vs physician’s choice in BRCA-mutated castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) in TRITON3.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with type 2 diabetes, when NSAID use and background hypoglycemic medications were not excluded and anti-diabetic therapies were matched, GLP-1RA use was not associated with greater colorectal cancer risk reduction compared with aspirin. Given the inherent limitations of retrospective analyses, prospective studies are warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with type 2 diabetes between 2010 and 2023, comparing patients using any GLP-1RA without aspirin with patients using aspirin without any GLP-1RA, while excluding patients with a prior history of colorectal cancer or benign colorectal neoplasms.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Reevaluating the comparative effectiveness of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) vs aspirin for colorectal cancer prevention in type 2 diabetes.

data.clinical_result_summary: For locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, induction chemoimmunotherapy followed by definitive chemoradiotherapy and subsequent maintenance immunotherapy may improve progression-free survival and overall survival. The treatment had a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced unresectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival outcome of sandwich therapy with induction chemoimmunotherapy followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy and sequential immune maintenance therapy in locally advanced unresectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) patients: A multi-center prospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: [212Pb]VMT01 as monotherapy and in combination with nivolumab was generally safe and well tolerated in 26 enrolled participants with MC1R-positive metastatic melanoma. Antitumor activity was observed at the 3 mCi dose level, and additional follow-up may be reported later.
clinical_result_indication_detail: subjects with previously treated unresectable or metastatic melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I/IIa, first-in-human, multicenter, monotherapy and combination therapy with nivolumab dose-finding study of [212Pb]VMT01 melanocortin-1-receptor–targeted, image-guided, alpha-particle therapy in subjects with previously treated unresectable or metastatic melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a real-world population of patients with metastatic breast cancer and CNS disease, sacituzumab govitecan demonstrated a modest intracranial response, with a 20% CNS objective response rate and median CNS progression-free survival of 4.5 months. All objective responses occurred in patients with prior radiation, and none occurred in patients with active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease. Larger prospective studies are needed to better characterize CNS response to sacituzumab govitecan and identify predictors of response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic breast cancer with central nervous system metastases, including brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or both, who were treated with sacituzumab govitecan from 2019 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of breast cancer central nervous system metastases treated with sacituzumab govitecan.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world propensity score-matched study demonstrated significantly reduced all-cause mortality with Pola-R-CHP compared with R-CHOP in patients with DLBCL. Many toxicities were similar between groups, although Pola-R-CHP was associated with a higher rate of peripheral neuropathy. The findings suggest that Pola-R-CHP is a better upfront option with improved survival benefits and no new safety concerns.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged 18 years or older with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma/high-grade lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative real-world safety outcomes of Pola-R-CHP versus R-CHOP in high-grade diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL): A TriNetX study.

data.clinical_result_summary: UGN-102 demonstrated robust complete response rates across all EORTC recurrence score subgroups, including patients with higher baseline recurrence risk. The majority of patients remained recurrence-free at 24 months, suggesting durable and clinically meaningful disease control in recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer despite the post-hoc design and small subgroup sizes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer who received at least one dose of UGN-102.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Assessing responses to UGN-102 across EORTC recurrence score groups in patients with recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk NMIBC (ENVISION trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: EFS landmark rates were greatest for participants who completed the full adjuvant regimen compared with those who discontinued prematurely in both arms. The addition of durvalumab to FLOT improved EFS regardless of treatment periods started or completed. Safety was manageable and tolerable in the adjuvant monotherapy period.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants had histologically confirmed, resectable, untreated gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of durvalumab and safety by treatment period in MATTERHORN: A randomized, phase 3 study of durvalumab plus 5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, and docetaxel (FLOT) chemotherapy in resectable gastric/gastroesophageal junction (G/GEJ) cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, chemotherapy following progression on PARP inhibitor maintenance demonstrated limited clinical benefit. Modest improvements were observed in patients with longer platinum-free intervals or progression after PARPi completion, while outcomes were not influenced by BRCA mutation status or treatment line. These findings highlight a substantial unmet need and support the urgent development of novel therapeutic strategies for patients progressing after PARPi therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included ovarian cancer patients treated with PARP inhibitors as maintenance therapy following platinum-based chemotherapy for newly diagnosed or recurrent disease at Alexandra Hospital, Greece.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of chemotherapy after PARP inhibitor progression in ovarian cancer: A large real-world cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Serial circulating tumor DNA analysis demonstrated applicability in predicting treatment response to chemoradiotherapy combined with immunotherapy in patients with proficient mismatch repair locally advanced rectal cancer. Dynamic changes in circulating tumor DNA may serve as a potential prognostic indicator in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The trial enrolled treatment-naïve patients with proficient mismatch repair locally advanced rectal cancer, specifically cT3-4N0M0 or cT1-4N1-2M0 disease, with an intermediate or high immunoscore.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dynamic circulating tumor DNA profiling for prediction of long-term clinical benefit in pMMR locally advanced rectal cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy plus sintilimab.

data.clinical_result_summary: LNP8701 was well tolerated in patients with metastatic solid tumors. It showed a desirable safety, pharmacokinetic, and preliminary efficacy profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1 study to evaluate safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of LNP8701 (SOS1 inhibitor) in subjects with metastatic solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab demonstrated clinical benefit versus nivolumab across subgroups, with improved progression-free survival and overall survival in patients with complete or partial response or stable disease and regardless of the number of metastatic sites. No defining characteristic was identified among long-term survivors compared with all randomized centrally confirmed patients, supporting nivolumab plus ipilimumab as a standard of care for MSI-H/dMMR metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with centrally confirmed microsatellite instability-high/mismatch repair-deficient metastatic colorectal cancer, with local testing used for enrollment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab + ipilimumab (NIVO + IPI) vs NIVO in microsatellite instability high/mismatch repair-deficient metastatic colorectal cancer (MSI-H/dMMR mCRC): CheckMate 8HW subgroup analyses including treatment-free status and outcomes in long-term survivors.

data.clinical_result_summary: YL201 showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. These findings support further development of YL201 in mCRPC, especially for patients who progressed after androgen receptor axis-targeted therapy with or without taxane-based chemotherapy and those with visceral metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: heavily pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位影像学无进展生存期
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 study of YL201, an anti-B7H3 antibody–drug conjugate (ADC), in heavily pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients who achieved long-term responses to tepotinib in VISION had similar clinical characteristics and safety outcomes to the overall VISION population. Ongoing biomarker analyses may help further characterize these patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced MET exon 14 skipping non-small cell lung cancer detected by liquid and/or tissue biopsy were included, and this subset analysis focused on patients with a long-term response, defined as a duration of response to tepotinib of >36 months.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Profiling patients with MET exon 14 (METex14) skipping NSCLC with a sustained clinical benefit to tepotinib in VISION.

data.clinical_result_summary: After a median 5 years of follow-up, intismeran plus pembrolizumab continued to prolong recurrence-free survival and distant metastasis-free survival, with a trend toward improved overall survival versus pembrolizumab alone in patients with high-risk resected melanoma. The treatment benefits were sustained and durable over time, and intismeran was well tolerated with a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk stage III/IV melanoma following complete resection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Individualized neoantigen therapy intismeran autogene (intismeran) plus pembrolizumab (pembro) in resected melanoma: 5-year update of the KEYNOTE-942 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sosimerasib monotherapy demonstrated clinically meaningful anti-tumor activity with an acceptable safety profile in patients with KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer. These findings support its potential for further development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pretreated colorectal cancer with KRAS G12C mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of sosimerasib monotherapy in pretreated colorectal cancer with KRAS G12C mutation: Results from a phase 1b study.

data.clinical_result_summary: PET uptake measured by SUV of 68Ga-NODAGA-SNA014 correlated with CLDN18.2 expression. These findings support its potential as a noninvasive companion diagnostic to guide and optimize CLDN18.2-targeted therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pancreatic cancer imaged on a total-body (panoramic) PET/CT system
data.clinical_result_paper_title: 68Ga-NODAGA-SNA014 whole-body PET imaging to detect Claudin18.2–positive pancreatic cancer lesions.

data.clinical_result_summary: Generic palbociclib combined with endocrine therapy demonstrated favorable efficacy and manageable tolerability in hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. Outcomes were comparable to global registration trials despite frequent upfront dose reductions and substantially lower drug acquisition cost, supporting its real-world effectiveness and value in resource-constrained settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer receiving generic palbociclib plus endocrine therapy were eligible.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy, tolerability, and outcomes of generic palbociclib in metastatic HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer: An ambispective study from a tertiary cancer center in South India.

data.clinical_result_summary: The phase I portion of the trial was completed and showed that CDX1140 plus pembrolizumab, capecitabine, and oxaliplatin was safe and tolerable in patients with biliary tract carcinoma. No new or unexpected toxicities were observed, and encouraging clinical responses were reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with biliary tract carcinoma previously treated with at least one line of systemic therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I/II study of CDX-1140, a CD40 agonist, in combination with capecitabine and oxaliplatin (CAPOX) and pembrolizumab in subjects with biliary tract carcinoma: Phase 1 results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint therapy remains promising for cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma. However, the higher tremelimumab dose increased serious immune-related adverse events, underscoring the need for optimized dosing. Baseline tertiary lymphoid structure density may represent a predictive biomarker and warrants further validation with larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: muscle-Invasive, high-risk urothelial bladder carcinoma who are ineligible for cisplatin-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy - cohort1
pts with cisplatin-ineligible MIUC and high-risk features -  Cohort 2
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results from a pilot trial of neoadjuvant durvalumb in combination with tremelimuab for cisplatin-ineligible high-risk urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of patients with hormone-sensitive prostate cancer treated with androgen deprivation therapy plus an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor prior to chemotherapy, darolutamide was associated with lower rates of developing hormone-resistant disease and improved overall survival compared with abiraterone. The findings suggest meaningful differences in outcomes between androgen receptor pathway inhibitors in the pre-chemotherapy setting, although confirmation in prospective comparative studies is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients aged ≥18 years with hormone-sensitive prostate cancer defined using ICD-10 diagnosis codes, treated with androgen deprivation therapy plus an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor prior to chemotherapy, with prior exposure to docetaxel excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world data from the TriNetX database comparing abiraterone versus darolutamide in hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fuzuloparib plus AA-P as first-line treatment significantly prolonged radiographic progression-free survival in patients with mCRPC. The combination showed acceptable safety and tolerability with no new safety signals identified.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位影像学无进展生存期
clinical_result_layer_factor: DNA-repair gene defect (DRD) status (positive vs negative/unknown) and other factors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fuzuloparib combined with abiraterone acetate and prednisone (AA-P) as first-line (1L) treatment for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC): Interim results from the FUZUPRO trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Faridoxorubicin was active in salivary gland cancer and was well tolerated, delivering a high concentration of free doxorubicin to the tumor microenvironment relative to plasma. Responses and prolonged disease stabilization were observed in patients with salivary gland cancer, indicating activity of the peptide drug conjugate.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with Salivary Gland Cancers
patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors reported to be FAP-positive
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ia/Ib trial of FAP-Dox (AVA6000), a fibroblast activation protein (FAP)–released doxorubicin peptide drug conjugate in patients with FAP-positive solid tumors and activity against salivary gland cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of radium-223 and paclitaxel could be administered safely, with most adverse events being grade 1 to 2 except for a higher incidence of grade 3 or higher neutropenia. The trial did not meet the primary progression-free survival endpoint, although a numerical improvement in median overall survival was observed with the combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with ≥2 bone lesions and limited visceral metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ETCTN 10302: A randomized phase II trial of radium-223 dichloride in combination with paclitaxel in patients with bone metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Brigatinib showed a high and durable response rate with manageable toxicity in non-NSCLC ALK fusion-positive solid tumors. The findings support brigatinib as a tumor-agnostic therapeutic agent for this rare molecular subset.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors other than non-small cell lung cancer with ALK fusions
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II basket trial of brigatinib for ALK fusion–positive solid tumors: ALLBREAK trial (WJOG15221M).

data.clinical_result_summary: Interim findings from the A-PURC trial suggest that omission of postoperative antibiotic prophylaxis after radical cystectomy does not increase UTI or UTI-related readmission rates within 90 days. These results support a more selective, stewardship-driven approach to postoperative antibiotic use after radical cystectomy, and the trial remains ongoing to confirm non-inferiority in an expanded cohort.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer undergoing radical cystectomy at the University of Minnesota were included.
clinical_result_layer_factor: urinary diversion type—ileal conduit (IC) or neobladder (NB)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Omission of postoperative antibiotic prophylaxis after radical cystectomy: Interim results of the A-PURC phase III randomized non-inferiority trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with perioperative chemotherapy alone, adding tislelizumab to chemotherapy significantly increased the proportions of major pathologic response and pathologic complete response in tsMHC-II-positive patients with gastric adenocarcinoma or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma only. The findings suggest that tsMHC-II could be a biomarker to guide selection of appropriate patients for perioperative immunotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced GC/GEJC
clinical_result_layer_factor: tsMHC-II expression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative tislelizumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy in MHC-II positive/MHC-II negative locally advanced GC/GEJC: A prospective, randomized, open-label, biomarker-driven, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this first-in-human study, GK01 plus IL-2 demonstrated a favorable safety profile with no DLTs and manageable toxicity. The TSCM-enriched product achieved a 67% ORR and 100% DCR, with product-derived clonotypes persisting at > 90% of the T-cell repertoire at 2 months. These findings validate the stemness-enriched T-cell platform and support expansion cohorts in selected solid tumor indications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: GK01 stemness-enriched tumor-reactive T-cell therapy plus IL-2 in advanced solid tumors: ORR and clonal persistence results in a first-in-human phase I study (GUARDIAN-01).

data.clinical_result_summary: In the IFCT-2203 TAXIO phase 2 trial, the PCD regimen showed a signal of improved 12-month overall survival and reached its statistical objective. Safety was consistent with the known profiles of the drugs used, with no new safety signal in this population. The regimen appears active and feasible in extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer and warrants further study in future trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with ES-SCLC, PS 0-1
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Paclitaxel, carboplatin, and durvalumab in extensive stage small-cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC; IFCT-2203 TAXIO phase II trial): Can we improve the chemotherapy (CT) immunotherapy combination in SCLC?

data.clinical_result_summary: Eganelisib demonstrated effective inhibition of PI3Kγ with single-agent activity in heavily treated, poor-risk patients, validating PI3Kγ as a key vulnerability in myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia. Eganelisib had no intrinsic hematologic toxicity. Combined therapy in previously untreated higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia patients at the recommended dose for expansion of 60 mg once daily is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome or relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of eganelisib in adults with higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome (HR-MDS) or relapsed/refractory (R/R) acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

data.clinical_result_summary: Fedratinib demonstrates promising clinical efficacy in patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia with proliferative features. The safety profile is consistent with prior experience, and its unique kinase inhibition profile may provide a mechanism for enhanced effectiveness in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_name: 慢性中性粒细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of fedratinib in patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this phase I study, E7777 plus pembrolizumab was well tolerated in patients with relapsed/refractory gynecologic malignancies and showed promising antitumor activity. The regimen produced an ORR of 24%, durable responses, and no new significant safety signals, supporting further phase II evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or refractory gynecologic cancers or recurrent or metastatic solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Depletion of T-regulatory cells by denileukin diftitox-cxdl (E7777) in combination with pembrolizumab in relapsed/refractory (r/r) gynecologic malignancies: Phase 1 study results.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with newly diagnosed locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma, TPF induction chemotherapy combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy did not improve 5-year PFS, OS, LRFS, or DMFS compared with CCRT followed by PF adjuvant chemotherapy. Both approaches had similar long-term toxicity profiles.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with newly diagnosed locally advanced (Stage III–IVA) nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter, randomized controlled phase III trial of TPF induction chemotherapy versus PF adjuvant chemotherapy combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma: Long-term follow-up analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Eganelisib demonstrated effective inhibition of PI3Kγ with single-agent activity in heavily treated, poor-risk patients, validating PI3Kγ as a key vulnerability in myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia. Eganelisib had no intrinsic hematologic toxicity. Combined therapy in previously untreated higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia patients at the recommended dose for expansion of 60 mg once daily is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome or relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of eganelisib in adults with higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome (HR-MDS) or relapsed/refractory (R/R) acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity-matched real-world cohort of anthracycline-treated women with breast cancer and diabetes, both GLP-1RA and SGLT2i were associated with improved survival and fewer cytopenias, infections, and venous thromboembolism versus no exposure. Compared with SGLT2i, GLP-1RA showed more favorable cardio-renal and survival outcomes, whereas SGLT2i was associated with fewer polyneuropathy and mood disorder diagnoses. Prospective validation is needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included women aged 18 years or older with breast cancer, diabetes mellitus, and anthracycline exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Beyond cardio-renal outcomes with GLP-1RA and SGLT2i in anthracycline-treated diabetic women with breast cancer: A propensity score–matched analysis from Global Federated Health Research Network.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fedratinib demonstrates promising clinical efficacy in patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia with proliferative features. The safety profile is consistent with prior experience, and its unique kinase inhibition profile may provide a mechanism for enhanced effectiveness in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_name: 慢性中性粒细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of fedratinib in patients with MDS/MPN and chronic neutrophilic leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: AZD3470 monotherapy was well tolerated up to dose level 8, with no dose-limiting toxicities and mainly low-grade adverse events. Grade ≥3 adverse events and serious adverse events were low, and ORR and CRR were dose-dependent and notably high in this heavily pretreated classic Hodgkin lymphoma population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory classic Hodgkin lymphoma
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1 study of the PRMT5 inhibitor AZD3470 in patients with relapsed/refractory classic Hodgkin lymphoma (PRIMAVERA).

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with perioperative chemotherapy alone, adding tislelizumab to chemotherapy significantly increased the proportions of major pathologic response and pathologic complete response in tsMHC-II-positive patients with gastric adenocarcinoma or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma only. The findings suggest that tsMHC-II could be a biomarker to guide selection of appropriate patients for perioperative immunotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced GC/GEJC
