data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative tislelizumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy in MHC-II positive/MHC-II negative locally advanced GC/GEJC: A prospective, randomized, open-label, biomarker-driven, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: KH617 showed significantly superior anti-tumor activity compared with historical median overall survival in patients with recurrent glioblastoma. KH617 was also well tolerated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with histologically confirmed advanced solid tumors (including diffuse gliomas of adulthood) no longer responding to standard therapies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I study to assess the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary antitumor activity of KH617 for patients with advanced solid tumors (including diffuse gliomas of adulthood).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis, ESA therapy was associated with lower risks of sepsis and myocardial infarction, but a higher incidence of brain metastases compared with RBC transfusion in lung cancer patients with chemotherapy-induced anemia. These findings may inform individualized risk-benefit discussions when selecting anemia management strategies, and prospective studies are needed to validate these associations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged 18 years or older with lung cancer and chemotherapy-induced anemia, stratified by receipt of RBC transfusion or ESA therapy, while excluding participants who received both treatments to ensure mutually exclusive exposure groups.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of red blood cell transfusion versus erythropoiesis-stimulating agents in lung cancer patients with chemotherapy-induced anemia: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: R-ISV-FOLactis showed a favorable safety profile and encouraging efficacy against both local and distant tumors in patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma who had failed standard therapies. The treatment induced systemic immune activation and metabolic remodeling, supporting further development as a novel in situ vaccination strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma who had failed standard therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An exploratory, single-center, single-arm trial of R-ISV-FOLactis in situ vaccination for advanced soft tissue sarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tislelizumab combined with chemotherapy appears to be a feasible and effective treatment strategy for unresectable recurrent locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma. The sequential approach showed promising efficacy with manageable toxicity, supporting further investigation of immunotherapy-based strategies in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable recurrent locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II clinical study of PD-1 inhibitor tislelizumab combined with chemotherapy for unresectable recurrent locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma (RETICULA-NPC trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world ES-SCLC cohort, approximately one-fifth of patients achieved durable benefit from atezolizumab beyond 12 months. Favorable ECOG performance status and non-elevated LDH may help identify patients more likely to benefit, while liver and bone metastases and elevated LDH were associated with lack of long-term response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective real-world study included 335 consecutive patients with extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer (stage III or IV) who received first-line treatment with atezolizumab in combination with platinum-etoposide chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical factors associated with durable response to atezolizumab in extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer: A real-world analysis in Moscow.

data.clinical_result_summary: DM005 was safe and tolerable up to 6.5 mg/kg. It showed encouraging efficacy in patients with EGFR-mutant NSCLC, EGFR-wild-type NSCLC, and SCLC with a manageable safety profile, and the putative recommended dose for expansion was 4.2 to 6.5 mg/kg for further phase II evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients (pts) with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of DM005, an anti-EGFR/c-MET bispecific antibody-drug conjugate, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: One cycle of CabCarb induction altered the tumor microenvironment in a subset of aggressive variant prostate cancer tumors, with reduction of suppressive myeloid and T cell populations and expansion of anti-tumor effector cells associated with clinical responses. These early tumor microenvironment changes may predict benefit from the addition of PD-1 blockade and help refine patient selection for immune checkpoint inhibition.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled men with aggressive variant prostate cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early chemo-induced TME alterations as a predictor of response to PD-1 blockade in AVPC: Single-cell data from C3NIRA.

data.clinical_result_summary: This phase 3 study demonstrated a significant progression-free survival benefit of sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab compared with pembrolizumab as first-line treatment for PD-L1-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer. The safety profile of the combination was generally manageable and consistent with the known safety profiles of the components, with no new safety signals. These results support sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab as a potential new treatment option for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: PD-L1 Positive Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: PD-L1 (TPS 1-49% vs ≥ 50%), histology (squamous vs non-squamous) and ECOG (0 vs 1)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) plus pembrolizumab (P) versus pembrolizumab (P) as first-line treatment for PD-L1–positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Results from the randomized phase 3 OptiTROP-Lung05 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this analysis, localized intra-arterial gemcitabine resulted in decreased systemic levels of gemcitabine compared with intravenous gemcitabine, along with increased levels of its inactive metabolite dFdU. The intra-arterial gemcitabine approach may provide increased local potency and may help decrease gemcitabine-related systemic side effects.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with locally advanced pancreatic cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The TIGeR-PaC phase 3 clinical trial examining intra-arterial gemcitabine versus intravenous gemcitabine: Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic sub-study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant lorlatinib showed an overwhelming pathological response and could lead to a high conversion surgery rate for unresectable stage III ALK-fusion non-small cell lung cancer. Further large-scale prospective trials are warranted to test this treatment modality.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage III ALK-fusion non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant lorlatinib in stage III NSCLC harboring ALK fusion: A phase 2 multicenter study (LORIN).

data.clinical_result_summary: Furmonertinib showed durable efficacy in EGFR-mutant NSCLC, unaffected by line of therapy. Risk stratification had time-dependent prognostic value, and furmonertinib demonstrated strong intracranial activity with an iORR of 79.5%. Furmonertinib was well tolerated with a favorable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective study included patients with locally advanced or metastatic EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer treated with furmonertinib as first- or later-line therapy, stratified into high-risk and non-high-risk groups based on brain or leptomeningeal metastases, high tumor burden, key co-mutations such as TP53, or acquired T790M.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety analysis of furmonertinib in the treatment of EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma: A single-center real-world study based on high-risk stratification.

data.clinical_result_summary: GFH375 monotherapy showed promising antitumor activity in heavily treated patients with cholangiocarcinoma and colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12D mutations. Further development of GFH375 monotherapy in cholangiocarcinoma and combination strategies for colorectal cancer is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12D mutation
patients with advanced cholangiocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary efficacy of GFH375 in patients with advanced cholangiocarcinoma or colorectal cancer harboring KRAS G12D mutation.

data.clinical_result_summary: Metronomic chemotherapy combined with cemiplimab demonstrated clinically meaningful antitumor activity in recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Alterations in plasma concentrations of select cytokines were associated with therapeutic response and overall survival, and the findings support prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma received first-line cemiplimab plus weekly carboplatin and paclitaxel.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cytokine dynamics in a phase II trial of metronomic carboplatin/paclitaxel combined with cemiplimab in recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with significantly longer 3-year overall survival and lower hazards of severe cytopenias and serious infections in diabetic patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia receiving BTK inhibitors, with no meaningful differences in major cardiovascular outcomes. Further studies are warranted to confirm the role of SGLT2 inhibitors in diabetic chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included diabetic patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia receiving BTK inhibitors, including ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, or zanubrutinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of SGLT2 inhibitors on clinical outcomes in diabetic patients with CLL receiving BTK inhibitors: A global propensity-matched study.

data.clinical_result_summary: EA6174 demonstrated that patients treated with pembrolizumab experienced significantly fewer Merkel cell carcinoma-related events than patients who received standard of care, and adjuvant pembrolizumab improved distant metastasis-free survival. The findings support a meaningful impact of pembrolizumab on MCC-specific outcomes, particularly for distant relapse, with possible particular benefit when radiation therapy is delivered sequentially rather than concurrently with pembrolizumab. Mature overall survival and MCC-specific survival data are needed to further guide the use of adjuvant immunotherapy for Merkel cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resected Merkel cell carcinoma (stage II-IV, stage I pts without sentinel lymph node biopsy).
clinical_result_layer_factor: stage (I/II vs III) and intended RT
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated outcomes from STAMP: Surgically treated adjuvant Merkel cell carcinoma with pembrolizumab, a phase III trial—ECOG-ACRIN EA6174.

data.clinical_result_summary: Selpercatinib achieved a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in event-free survival compared with placebo in patients with early-stage RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer. These findings support targeted therapy in the adjuvant non-small cell lung cancer setting and underscore the importance of comprehensive genomic testing at diagnosis across disease stages.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with early-stage (II-IIIA) rearranged during transfection (RET) fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Event-free survival with adjuvant selpercatinib in stage IB-IIIA RET fusion-positive NSCLC: Primary results of the phase 3 LIBRETTO-432 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sonrotoclax plus zanubrutinib was well tolerated and achieved undetectable minimal residual disease rates greater than 90%, including in patients with high-risk cytogenetics. The depth and kinetics of uMRD achieved with this combination highlight its improved potency and differentiated profile compared with available combination therapies in first-line chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-naive chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (320-mg)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effect of first-line treatment of CLL/SLL with the all-oral combination of sonrotoclax (sonro) and zanubrutinib (zanu) on minimal residual disease (uMRD) rates, including in patients with del(17p)/TP53.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant HB200 combined with chemotherapy resulted in high deep response rates, frequent treatment de-escalation, and excellent survival outcomes in locoregionally advanced HPV16+ oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma. These findings support further evaluation of HPV-directed immune therapy in the neoadjuvant setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with non-metastatic HPV16+ OPC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant HPV16-specific viral immunotherapy (HB200) plus chemotherapy with response-adapted de-escalation in HPV16+ oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma: TARGET-HPV trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with progressing brain metastases while receiving tucatinib had brain metastasis-to-serum tucatinib ratios similar to those of patients receiving tucatinib for the first time in the trial. These data indicate that intratumoral drug concentration alone is unlikely to account for intracranial acquired resistance, and correlative analyses investigating potential genomic and microenvironmental mechanisms of resistance are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients undergoing brain metastasis resection for HER2-positive or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, or gastroesophageal cancer, including HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients with progressing brain metastases while on tucatinib, tucatinib-naïve HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients, and patients with gastrointestinal malignancy, non-small cell lung cancer, or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).

data.clinical_result_summary: In real-world clinical practice, adding bevacizumab to olaparib in patients without prior bevacizumab exposure was associated with worse survival outcomes and earlier treatment switching. Prospective, controlled studies are needed to clarify whether this reflects confounding by disease severity or a lack of added benefit from combination therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult bevacizumab-naive patients from 2015-2024 with ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer who received platinum chemotherapy followed by olaparib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world outcomes of olaparib with versus without bevacizumab in bevacizumab‑naïve BRCA1/2‑mutated ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: SHR-A1811 plus chemotherapy and BP102 as first-line therapy for HER2 intermediate or high-expressing metastatic colorectal cancer demonstrated manageable safety and encouraging antitumor activity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-expressing metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SHR-A1811 plus chemotherapy and BP102 as 1L therapy for HER2-expressing mCRC: Data from a phase Ib/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant therapy with nivolumab plus relatlimab in resectable stage II melanoma was feasible and induced a high rate of pathologic complete response and major pathological response in the primary melanoma. No Grade 4 or 5 treatment-related adverse events were reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk stage II cutaneous melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of neoadjuvant nivolumab (nivo) + relatlimab (rela) in high-risk stage II cutaneous melanoma (NeoReNi).

data.clinical_result_summary: No new safety signals were observed with zongertinib plus T-DXd or T-DM1. Dose escalation was ongoing in Cohorts A and B at data cutoff, and efficacy analyses were still pending.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with confirmed, unresectable HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer who progressed following HER2-directed therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zongertinib combination therapy in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (mBC): First results from a phase Ib/II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fruquintinib combined with FOLFIRI demonstrated non-inferiority in progression-free survival compared with bevacizumab combined with FOLFIRI as second-line treatment for metastatic colorectal cancer. The regimen had a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: primary tumor location and RAS/BRAF status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of fruquintinib combined with chemotherapy versus bevacizumab combined with chemotherapy as second-line treatment for metastatic colorectal cancer: A prospective, multicenter, randomized controlled trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Rez plus ADT continued to show meaningful survival benefits with manageable toxicities after long-term follow-up. These results further support Rez plus ADT as frontline treatment for patients with high-volume metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients With Hormone Sensitive Prostate Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rezvilutamide (Rez) versus bicalutamide (Bic) plus androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) in high-volume, metastatic, hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC): 5-year outcomes of the phase 3 CHART trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a real-world propensity-matched cohort of lorlatinib-treated patients with non-small cell lung cancer, lipid-lowering therapy initiated within 30 days was associated with lower 1-year mortality, venous thromboembolism, and hospitalization. These findings support early lipid monitoring and timely lipid-lowering therapy initiation in practice, while prospective studies are needed to confirm the associations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with non-small cell lung cancer who received lorlatinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early lipid-lowering therapy initiation after lorlatinib and clinical outcomes in non–small cell lung cancer: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with progressing brain metastases while receiving tucatinib had brain metastasis-to-serum tucatinib ratios similar to those of patients receiving tucatinib for the first time in the trial. These data indicate that intratumoral drug concentration alone is unlikely to account for intracranial acquired resistance, and correlative analyses investigating potential genomic and microenvironmental mechanisms of resistance are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients undergoing brain metastasis resection for HER2-positive or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, or gastroesophageal cancer, including HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients with progressing brain metastases while on tucatinib, tucatinib-naïve HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients, and patients with gastrointestinal malignancy, non-small cell lung cancer, or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world analysis supports the use of dose-dense weekly paclitaxel combined with carboplatin for improved PFS, consistent with some regional studies. OS showed a non-significant trend favoring the dose-dense regimen, with some risk of neuropathy, highlighting the need for larger prospective regional studies to better define the patient populations most likely to benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included women aged ≥20 years with resectable FIGO stage II–IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma who were treated between January 2015 and December 2018.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dose-dense weekly versus standard three-weekly paclitaxel in combination with carboplatin for resectable stage II-IV epithelial ovarian carcinoma: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with hepatocellular carcinoma who received lenvatinib or cabozantinib as second-line therapy after first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor combination therapy, there were no significant differences in hospitalization rate or survival. Either option may be appropriate, with treatment choice potentially guided by side-effect profile and patient preference.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with a history of hepatocellular carcinoma who received atezolizumab plus bevacizumab or durvalumab plus tremelimumab as first-line treatment and then progressed on first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative clinical outcomes with lenvatinib versus cabozantinib post-progression on first-line immunotherapy in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In matched NSCLC patients receiving pembrolizumab, antibiotic exposure near treatment was associated with increased hazards of renal and endocrine immune-related toxicity, with weaker associations for colitis. These findings support a microbiome-mediated, organ-specific toxicity hypothesis and suggest the importance of antibiotic stewardship and enhanced renal and endocrine monitoring during ICI therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with non-small cell lung cancer treated with pembrolizumab; controls had no antibiotic exposure within 1 month of pembrolizumab and low ECOG performance status.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Antibiotics and immune-related toxicity during pembrolizumab therapy in NSCLC: Real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: CRB-701 has shown promising efficacy in patients with heavily pretreated recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, along with a favorable safety profile compared with other MMAE-based therapies. Further investigation of CRB-701 is warranted in this difficult-to-treat patient population.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of the next-generation nectin-4–targeting antibody-drug conjugate CRB-701 (SYS6002) in patients with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis, zanubrutinib monotherapy demonstrated significantly longer time to next treatment and improved overall survival compared with acalabrutinib monotherapy. These findings suggest that zanubrutinib may offer superior outcomes in the real-world setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older in the US with at least two diagnoses of chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma, who were treatment-naive for CLL and had an index claim for zanubrutinib or acalabrutinib monotherapy. Patients with evidence of clinical trial participation, prior CLL/SLL treatment, or two diagnoses of mantle cell lymphoma were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world treatment and survival outcomes for zanubrutinib (zanu) and acalabrutinib (acala) monotherapy among treatment-naive patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) in the United States.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large-scale, real-world analysis, concurrent metformin use was associated with significantly improved overall survival in patients with renal cell carcinoma treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors. The findings suggest that metformin may serve as a beneficial adjuvant to therapy, but prospective clinical trials are needed to validate these findings and clarify potential signaling mechanisms.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with renal cell carcinoma using ICD-10-CM C64 who were initiated on immune checkpoint inhibitors, including nivolumab, pembrolizumab, and avelumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of metformin on outcomes with immune checkpoint inhibitors in renal cell carcinoma: A large-scale retrospective analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with progressing brain metastases while receiving tucatinib had brain metastasis-to-serum tucatinib ratios similar to those of patients receiving tucatinib for the first time in the trial. These data indicate that intratumoral drug concentration alone is unlikely to account for intracranial acquired resistance, and correlative analyses investigating potential genomic and microenvironmental mechanisms of resistance are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients undergoing brain metastasis resection for HER2-positive or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, or gastroesophageal cancer, including HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients with progressing brain metastases while on tucatinib, tucatinib-naïve HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients, and patients with gastrointestinal malignancy, non-small cell lung cancer, or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this ALK TKI pre-treated data set, neladalkib demonstrated clinically meaningful activity, including in patients with CNS disease, ALK G1202R single or compound mutations, and prior lorlatinib. Encouraging preliminary activity was also observed in TKI-naïve patients, and neladalkib’s safety profile was consistent with its ALK-selective, TRK-sparing design.
clinical_result_indication_detail: TKI Pre-treated Patients with Advanced ALK-positive NSCLC
TKI-Naïve Patients with Advanced ALK-positive NSCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ALKOVE-1: Efficacy and safety of neladalkib in patients with advanced ALK+ NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Gemcitabine–oxaliplatin showed a manageable real-world toxicity profile in advanced gallbladder cancer, with treatment-limiting effects driven mainly by cumulative neuropathy and anemia. These data support the feasibility of GEMOX in routine practice in a high-burden setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults from north India with unresectable or metastatic gallbladder adenocarcinoma, described as patients with advanced and metastatic gallbladder cancer treated with GEMOX in routine clinical practice between January 2020 and June 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tolerance of gemcitabine–oxaliplatin (GEMOX) in advanced and metastatic gallbladder cancer: A real-world, single-center retrospective study from north India.

data.clinical_result_summary: An intermittent fruquintinib plus trifluridine/tipiracil schedule demonstrated encouraging activity with manageable toxicity in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: mCRC patients who had failed at least two standard treatment regimens
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intermittent fruquintinib plus trifluridine/tipiracil in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): A single-center, single-arm phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, longer duration of pembrolizumab following chemoradiation was associated with significantly improved overall survival without increased healthcare utilization. These findings support sustained immunotherapy exposure when clinically feasible and suggest a survival benefit without excess healthcare burden.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with non-small cell lung cancer who received chemoradiation followed by pembrolizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of prolonged versus shorter duration pembrolizumab following chemoradiation in non–small cell lung cancer: A propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sequential CAR T-cell therapy was reported as a highly effective and safe strategy that induced high rates of durable complete responses in patients with B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma who relapsed after initial CAR T-cell treatment. The activity observed in primary central nervous system lymphoma suggests this approach may overcome the blood-brain barrier and address a critical unmet need.
clinical_result_indication_name: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled heavily pre-treated patients with relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma who had progressed after at least one prior CAR T-cell infusion, including high-risk subtypes such as primary central nervous system lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overcoming resistance to prior CAR-T therapy: Efficacy and safety of a sequential, multi-antigen targeted CAR T-cell strategy in B-cell NHL.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: BAT8010 in combination with BAT1006 was well tolerated with manageable toxicity and showed promising preliminary antitumor activity in patients with HER2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer. Dose expansion studies are ongoing, and further confirmatory clinical trials are planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib/IIa study of BAT8010+BAT1006, an anti-HER2 monoclonal antibody-exatecan conjugate combined with an ADCC-enhanced HER2 mAb in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from the HER2-positive GC/GEJC cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with progressing brain metastases while receiving tucatinib had brain metastasis-to-serum tucatinib ratios similar to those of patients receiving tucatinib for the first time in the trial. These data indicate that intratumoral drug concentration alone is unlikely to account for intracranial acquired resistance, and correlative analyses investigating potential genomic and microenvironmental mechanisms of resistance are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients undergoing brain metastasis resection for HER2-positive or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, or gastroesophageal cancer, including HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients with progressing brain metastases while on tucatinib, tucatinib-naïve HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients, and patients with gastrointestinal malignancy, non-small cell lung cancer, or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this post hoc analysis, dual positivity from CDx MSI and CDx MMR assays did not offer greater PFS benefit with first-line nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus chemotherapy compared with positivity from a single CDx MSI or MMR assay. Single CDx MSI or CDx MMR assays provided similar PFS benefit with first-line nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus chemotherapy in patients with MSI-H/dMMR metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients had unresectable or metastatic colorectal cancer with microsatellite instability-high or mismatch repair-deficient status per local testing and were randomized to nivolumab plus ipilimumab or chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of progression-free survival (PFS) with microsatellite instability–high (MSI-H) or mismatch repair–deficient (dMMR) status determined by single vs dual validated companion diagnostic (CDx) assays: CheckMate-8HW post hoc analyses.

data.clinical_result_summary: Initial data showed a favorable safety profile for KD-496 CAR-T cells targeting NKG2DL and CLDN18.2 in patients with treatment-refractory advanced gastrointestinal cancers. Preliminary efficacy signals support further investigation of KD-496, particularly in gastric cancer and pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with refractory advanced digestive cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I clinical trial evaluating dual-targeting CAR-T cells (KD-496) against CLDN18.2 and NKG2DL in advanced gastrointestinal cancers and pancreatic cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: GT101 demonstrated a manageable safety profile with no treatment-related serious adverse events or dose-limiting toxicities. It showed clinically meaningful and durable antitumor activity in recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer, supporting further clinical development and an ongoing pivotal phase II study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: GT101 autologous TIL therapy in patients with recurrent and metastatic cervical cancer: A phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large, real-world, propensity-matched analysis of patients with resectable high-grade soft tissue sarcoma, survival outcomes were comparable between neoadjuvant and adjuvant chemotherapy cohorts across short-, intermediate-, and long-term follow-up intervals. The analysis suggests that the timing of chemotherapy does not adversely impact short- or long-term outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with resectable high-grade soft tissue sarcoma who underwent surgical resection and received combination chemotherapy with doxorubicin and ifosfamide either within 6 months before surgery or after surgery were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant versus adjuvant chemotherapy for resectable high-grade soft tissue sarcoma: A real-world propensity-matched survival analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Olanzapine improved weight gain with favorable changes in skeletal muscle and fat indices, suggesting true nutritional gain rather than fluid retention in patients with chemotherapy-related anorexia. The findings suggest that olanzapine may favorably modulate cancer-related anorexia and treatment outcomes, warranting further validation in larger focused studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with chemotherapy-related anorexia and untreated locally advanced or metastatic gastric, hepatopancreaticobiliary, or lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Olanzapine for chemotherapy-related anorexia: Impact on body composition.

data.clinical_result_summary: HRQoL, as measured by FACT-G and FACT-M, was maintained following commercial lifileucel in a real-world metastatic melanoma cohort, supporting the tolerability of TIL therapy. HRQoL outcomes varied according to clinical benefit, and larger studies with extended follow-up are warranted to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in a real-world metastatic melanoma cohort were treated with commercial lifileucel at Moffitt Cancer Center.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Health-related quality of life following tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy with commercial lifileucel in metastatic melanoma: Real-world longitudinal patient-reported outcomes.

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with MARIPOSA-2, subcutaneous amivantamab and dermatologic prophylaxis in COPERNICUS led to substantial reductions in administration-related reactions, dermatologic adverse events, and amivantamab interruptions. These interim data obtained using a pragmatic design support wide use of subcutaneous amivantamab every 3 weeks plus chemotherapy post-EGFR TKI progression in a diverse population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: US patients with EGFR Ex19del/L858R non-small-cell lung cancer on/after EGFR TKI progression. cohort 2
data.clinical_result_paper_title: COPERNICUS, a pragmatic phase 2b study of subcutaneous (SC) amivantamab (ami) + chemotherapy (chemo) with enhanced dermatologic adverse event (AE) prophylaxis in EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC: Interim results.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this US randomized trial comparing darolutamide with enzalutamide, the primary endpoint of differential cognitive effects was met. Enzalutamide showed significantly greater cognitive score decline than darolutamide at 24 weeks in the maximally changed cognitive domain after treatment initiation. Longer-term follow-up of cognitive change and patient-reported outcome measure analyses are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic hormone sensitive prostate cancer, metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer or non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cognitive effects of darolutamide vs enzalutamide: Results of ARACOG (AFT-47), a randomized clinical trial from the Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology.

data.clinical_result_summary: Analyzed retrospectively, responders outperformed non-responders in visual memory and executive function at baseline and throughout initial treatment, maintaining a cognitive advantage. The authors hypothesize that early cognitive performance could be considered with other clinical factors to prognosticate treatment response, support patient stratification, and personalize treatment strategies, although this was not tested.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed participants with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer, including 410 participants who received apalutamide and continuous androgen deprivation therapy during the initial treatment phase, of whom 144 had no prior androgen deprivation therapy exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cognition of apalutamide + ADT treatment responders versus non-responders.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tislelizumab plus POFI showed promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile as first-line treatment for HER2-negative, pMMR/MSS advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Further investigation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-negative, proficient mismatch repair (pMMR)/microsatellite stable (MSS) advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tislelizumab (Tisle) combined with POFI (irinotecan, paclitaxel, oxaliplatin, and 5-FU/levoleucovorin) as first-line treatment for advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (AGC): Update from a single-arm, open-label phase I/II trial (SYLT-023).

data.clinical_result_summary: Single-dose neoadjuvant PD-1 blockade combined with a CD40 agonist for HPV-negative HNSCC was safe, did not delay surgery, and produced modestly improved pathologic regressions that correlated with a cytokine-based baseline inflammatory score.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable HPV-negative HNSCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective trial of single-dose neoadjuvant PD-1 blockade with or without a CD40 agonist in HPV-negative HNSCC.

data.clinical_result_summary: In older, transplant-ineligible patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who remained on therapy at one year, Dara-RVd was associated with improved early survival and lower healthcare utilization compared with RVd, while outcomes were comparable to Dara-Rd. Despite the retrospective design and potential unmeasured confounding, these findings support daratumumab-based regimens in older patients, and prospective studies incorporating frailty and early treatment discontinuation are needed to better define optimal induction strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥70 years with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma after 2019 who initiated treatment within two months of diagnosis, did not undergo autologous stem cell transplantation, and were older, transplant-ineligible patients.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world one-year comparative outcomes of quadruplet and triplet induction regimens in older, transplant-ineligible multiple myeloma patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world analysis supports the use of dose-dense weekly paclitaxel combined with carboplatin for improved PFS, consistent with some regional studies. OS showed a non-significant trend favoring the dose-dense regimen, with some risk of neuropathy, highlighting the need for larger prospective regional studies to better define the patient populations most likely to benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included women aged ≥20 years with resectable FIGO stage II–IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma who were treated between January 2015 and December 2018.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dose-dense weekly versus standard three-weekly paclitaxel in combination with carboplatin for resectable stage II-IV epithelial ovarian carcinoma: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients with myelofibrosis and significant leukocytosis, hydroxyurea exposure was not associated with a statistically significant reduction in thrombotic events, including pulmonary embolism or venous thromboembolism, over short- or long-term follow-up. Thrombotic event rates were low and generally comparable between hydroxyurea-exposed and non-exposed patients, with no consistent pattern suggesting a protective effect of cytoreductive therapy. The role of hydroxyurea in modifying thrombotic risk among myelofibrosis patients with leukocytosis remains uncertain.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with myelofibrosis and leukocytosis, defined as white blood cell count ≥25×109/L, were included, while patients with prior allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hydroxyurea use and thrombotic outcomes in myelofibrosis patients with leukocytosis: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Systemic therapies provided limited but clinically relevant benefit in patients with anaplastic thyroid carcinoma. Survival outcomes remained poor, highlighting the need for improved therapeutic strategies for this aggressive disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with anaplastic thyroid carcinoma treated at a tertiary cancer center between 2019 and 2025 who received first-line systemic therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of systemic therapy in patients with anaplastic thyroid carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world, propensity-matched cohort of patients with B-cell lymphomas treated with R-CHOP, prophylactic G-CSF use was associated with improved early and long-term survival without a difference in septic shock or severe infectious complications. Apparent increases in neutropenia were not observed after accounting for baseline history, suggesting no excess risk of new-onset neutropenia. These findings support the routine use of G-CSF with R-CHOP and suggest a potential survival benefit beyond neutropenia prevention.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with aggressive B-cell lymphomas who received R-CHOP.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of prophylactic G-CSF use with survival outcomes in patients with aggressive B-cell lymphomas treated with R-CHOP.

data.clinical_result_summary: No new safety signals were observed with zongertinib plus T-DXd or T-DM1. Dose escalation was ongoing in Cohorts A and B at data cutoff, and efficacy analyses were still pending.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with confirmed, unresectable HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer who progressed following HER2-directed therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zongertinib combination therapy in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (mBC): First results from a phase Ib/II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant endocrine therapy plus CDK4/6 inhibitors achieved short-term objective response rates comparable to chemotherapy-sequenced regimens in HR+/HER2- early breast cancer, even in patients with high Ki-67. These findings support the feasibility of chemotherapy-free neoadjuvant strategies for clinically selected patients, potentially reducing toxicity without compromising initial treatment response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 18–70 years with HR+/HER2- early breast cancer across 11 tertiary hospitals in China were analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chemotherapy-free neoadjuvant strategy in HR+/HER2− early breast cancer: Efficacy of CDK4/6 inhibitors plus endocrine therapy compared to chemotherapy-sequenced approach.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line pyrotinib-based regimens showed favorable effectiveness and manageable safety profiles for patients with HER2-positive advanced breast cancer in the real-world setting, including those with trastuzumab-naïve and trastuzumab-sensitive disease. These findings support their use in routine clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-positive advanced breast cancer who planned to receive first-line pyrotinib-based therapy were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparable clinical efficacy of pyrotinib in trastuzumab-naive and trastuzumab-exposed HER2-positive advanced breast cancer patients: A prospective, multicenter, real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a resource-limited public system, INTERLACE implementation requires structured planning and close monitoring. High hematologic toxicity and transfusional needs highlight care delivery challenges, and suboptimal local treatment may affect long-term outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Women aged 18 years or older with cervical cancer stages IB3–IVA (FIGO 2018) in a low-resource population.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world feasibility and hematologic toxicity of induction chemotherapy in advanced cervical cancer in a resource-limited setting.

data.clinical_result_summary: SKB500 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in patients with treatment-refractory advanced solid tumors. Notable efficacy was observed in the small cell lung cancer and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cohorts, supporting further clinical development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic SCLC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic ESCC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An open-label, first-in-human study of SKB500 in patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In postmenopausal breast cancer patients on aromatase inhibitors and CDK4/6 inhibitors, palbociclib was associated with worse overall survival in the BMI <25 and BMI ≥30 groups, while ribociclib and abemaciclib showed similar outcomes across BMI groups. The observational design and baseline age differences may partially confound the findings, but the results suggest a potential interaction between BMI and drug choice and support the need for prospective confirmation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Postmenopausal women with breast cancer receiving palbociclib, ribociclib, or abemaciclib plus an aromatase inhibitor, excluding patients with prior use of fulvestrant, anthracyclines, radiation therapy, GnRH agonists, or a history of MACE, heart failure, myocardial infarction, or stroke before breast cancer diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Potential BMI-dependent overall survival differences in postmenopausal breast cancer patients treated with CDK4/6 inhibitors: A Mayo Clinic platform study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this adjuvant trial for patients aged over 60, participation rates for patient-reported outcome data collection were high. Global health-related quality of life was not impacted by T-DM1, and although patient-reported symptoms were frequent, the vast majority were mild.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included older adults aged 60 or older with stage I-III HER2-positive breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Patient-reported outcomes from the adjuvant ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) for older patients with HER2+ breast cancer (ATOP) trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events
data.clinical_result_summary: BAL0891 demonstrated a tolerable safety profile and consistent systemic exposure in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors. These interim data support continued clinical evaluation of BAL0891 as monotherapy and in combination with paclitaxel.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of BAL0891 as monotherapy and in combination with paclitaxel: Results from a phase I study in advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients with myelofibrosis and significant leukocytosis, hydroxyurea exposure was not associated with a statistically significant reduction in thrombotic events, including pulmonary embolism or venous thromboembolism, over short- or long-term follow-up. Thrombotic event rates were low and generally comparable between hydroxyurea-exposed and non-exposed patients, with no consistent pattern suggesting a protective effect of cytoreductive therapy. The role of hydroxyurea in modifying thrombotic risk among myelofibrosis patients with leukocytosis remains uncertain.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with myelofibrosis and leukocytosis, defined as white blood cell count ≥25×109/L, were included, while patients with prior allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hydroxyurea use and thrombotic outcomes in myelofibrosis patients with leukocytosis: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: CD19-CAR-CD34t hybrid T cells showed promising efficacy and durability in relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, with no relapses among patients who achieved complete response. The treatment had a promising toxicity profile, with no ICANS or grade 3+ CRS and limited CRS intervention needed; DL3 was selected for ongoing dose expansion.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 dose escalation study of CD34 selected CD19 directed CAR T with metabolic programming in relapsed/refractory B-cell lymphoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: [68Ga]Ga-OncoACP3 has an excellent safety profile and favourable pharmacokinetics, as well as promising tumour-targeting properties in prostate cancer. [68Ga]Ga-OncoACP3 may outperform current PSMA-targeting modalities across the whole natural history of the disease, particularly in theranostic applications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with a confirmed diagnosis of prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Diagnostic performance, safety, and biodistribution of [68Ga]Ga-OncoACP3 for PET imaging in prostate cancer: A phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Same-day administration of pegteograstim did not meet the prespecified criterion for noninferiority compared with next-day administration. The incidence of grade 4 chemotherapy-induced neutropenia favored next-day administration, supporting next-day pegteograstim as standard practice in multi-day regimens with day 1-intensive myelosuppression.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的中性粒细胞减少症
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients receiving adjuvant/neoadjuvant or first-line palliative chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of prophylactic effects for chemotherapy-induced neutropenia between same-day versus next-day administration of pegteograstim in chemotherapy regimen composed of day 1 intensive myleosuppressive agent: A randomized clinical trial (CONCISE, KCSG PC22-11).

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world analysis supports the use of dose-dense weekly paclitaxel combined with carboplatin for improved PFS, consistent with some regional studies. OS showed a non-significant trend favoring the dose-dense regimen, with some risk of neuropathy, highlighting the need for larger prospective regional studies to better define the patient populations most likely to benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included women aged ≥20 years with resectable FIGO stage II–IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma who were treated between January 2015 and December 2018.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dose-dense weekly versus standard three-weekly paclitaxel in combination with carboplatin for resectable stage II-IV epithelial ovarian carcinoma: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Perioperative treatment with SHR-A2102 plus adebrelimab showed promising efficacy and was well tolerated in patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer. The combination may provide benefit even for patients with renal impairment and warrants further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer scheduled for radical cystectomy and pelvic lymph node dissection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative SHR-A2102, a novel nectin-4–targeted antibody-drug conjugate, in combination with adebrelimab for patients (pts) with muscle-invasive bladder cancer: Results from a phase 2/3 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ozekibart plus FOLFIRI demonstrated encouraging preliminary efficacy in a heavily pretreated patient population with metastatic, unresectable colorectal cancer. The safety profile was manageable, with most adverse events being low grade, supporting further evaluation of this combination in advanced colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic, unresectable colorectal cancer (CRC)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 study of the tetravalent death receptor 5 agonist ozekibart (INBRX-109) combined with chemotherapy in locally advanced or metastatic, unresectable colorectal adenocarcinoma (CRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: BL0020 monotherapy demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in patients with advanced small cell lung cancer who progressed after at least one prior platinum-based chemotherapy. The therapy showed a high response rate and potential for prolonged progression-free survival compared with standard chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BL0020, a novel tumor microenvironment (TME)-targeting nano-mediated polypeptide-drug conjugate (NMPDC), in patients with advanced solid tumors: Updated results from the small cell lung cancer (SCLC) subset of a phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: REM-422 is the first small molecule MYB mRNA degrader to demonstrate clinical activity in recurrent or metastatic adenoid cystic carcinoma and was generally well tolerated. These findings support further evaluation of REM-422 in a biomarker-selected population, with accrual to the Phase 2 Confirmatory Cohort ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic adenoid cystic carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical activity of REM-422, a MYB mRNA degrader, in recurrent/metastatic adenoid cystic carcinoma: Final results from the phase 1/2 dose-escalation cohort.

Apparent increases in neutropenia were not observed after accounting for baseline history, suggesting no excess risk of new-onset neutropenia. These findings support the routine use of G-CSF with R-CHOP and suggest a potential survival benefit beyond neutropenia prevention.
clinical_result_indication_name: 中性粒细胞减少性发热
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with aggressive B-cell lymphomas who received R-CHOP.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of prophylactic G-CSF use with survival outcomes in patients with aggressive B-cell lymphomas treated with R-CHOP.

data.clinical_result_summary: Post-neoadjuvant T-DM1 showed excellent real-world effectiveness, with a low incidence of invasive disease recurrences in patients with HER2-positive early breast cancer and residual disease after neoadjuvant therapy. A large fraction of patients treated in routine practice would not have met DESTINY-Breast-05 or DESTINY-Breast-11 eligibility criteria, highlighting the value of real-world benchmarking to contextualize trial evidence and guide integration of antibody-drug conjugates in the curative setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan with HER2-positive early breast cancer and residual disease after trastuzumab-based neoadjuvant therapy who received at least 1 cycle of T-DM1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world data on post-neoadjuvant trastuzumab emtansine to benchmark DESTINY-Breast-05 and -11 emerging paradigms.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a landmark propensity-matched analysis, initiating bone marrow agents early after androgen deprivation therapy in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer with bone metastases did not improve time-to-event survival or reduce skeletal-related events. In a nested comparative-effectiveness analysis, zoledronic acid and denosumab showed similar survival and acute kidney injury risk, informing agent selection in routine practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer with bone metastases who were initiating first-line androgen deprivation therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Does BMA improve outcomes in mHSPC with bone metastases?: Landmark propensity-matched analysis and nested zoledronic acid vs denosumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: BAT8010 in combination with BAT1006 was well tolerated with manageable toxicity and showed promising preliminary antitumor activity in patients with HER2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer. Dose expansion studies are ongoing, and further confirmatory clinical trials are planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib/IIa study of BAT8010+BAT1006, an anti-HER2 monoclonal antibody-exatecan conjugate combined with an ADCC-enhanced HER2 mAb in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from the HER2-positive GC/GEJC cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: ALA-PDD appears to enhance intraoperative diagnostic accuracy compared with conventional white light inspection and demonstrates an acceptable safety profile in ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers. In patients undergoing interval debulking surgery, ALA-PDD may serve as a clinically meaningful adjunct to achieve precise cytoreduction and support surgical decision-making in the neoadjuvant chemotherapy setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers who were scheduled for cytoreductive surgery or exploratory laparotomy were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fluorescence-guided surgery with 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) in ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers: Efficacy and safety results from the GINGA study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Induction toripalimab combined with chemotherapy provided a promising and durable larynx preservation rate in this cohort of patients with extensively locally advanced laryngeal and hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Locally Advanced Laryngeal and Hypopharyngeal Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Induction toripalimab and chemotherapy for organ preservation in locally advanced laryngeal and hypopharyngeal cancer: 3-year follow-up of the INSIGHT study.

data.clinical_result_summary: GLP-1 RA use among lung cancer patients was associated with improved survival, reduced healthcare utilization, and fewer selected adverse events in patients receiving ICI therapy. These associations likely reflect established metabolic and cardiovascular benefits of GLP-1 RA and may also involve antitumor mechanisms suggested in prior studies, but residual confounding cannot be excluded.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with lung cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, including PD-1, PD-L1, or CTLA-4 inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist use in lung cancer patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of ifebemtinib and D-1553 exhibited favorable safety profiles and better efficacy in treating KRAS G12C mutant colorectal cancer, with median overall survival exceeding 16 months. The randomized study showed improved objective response rate, progression-free survival, duration of response, and overall survival benefit with the combination regimen, indicating that adding ifebemtinib to a RAS inhibitor can further improve clinical outcomes in colorectal cancer patients with RAS G12C mutation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Metastatic KRAS G12C mutant CRC pts with at least 1 prior line of systemic anticancer therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of ifebemtinib combined with garsorasib in KRAS G12C mutant colorectal cancer from a randomized part of a phase Ib/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world study, metastatic lung cancer patients with pre-existing autoimmune diseases receiving PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors demonstrated comparable overall survival to those without autoimmune diseases, supporting the use of immune checkpoint inhibitors in this population. However, higher rates of organ-specific immune-related adverse events, particularly gastrointestinal, endocrine, and pulmonary toxicities, and increased hospitalizations underscore the need for enhanced monitoring and multidisciplinary management.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with lung cancer and metastatic disease treated with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors between 2018 and 2025 were included, excluding patients with prior transplant, HIV, chronic viral hepatitis, or CTLA-4 inhibitor exposure; patients with pre-existing autoimmune diseases diagnosed before immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation were compared with those without autoimmune diseases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and survival outcomes of immune checkpoint inhibitors in metastatic lung cancer patients with pre-existing autoimmune disease: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: EBC-129 showed promising clinical activity in heavily treated patients with gastro-oesophageal adenocarcinoma and had a manageable tolerability profile. Further evaluation in second-line gastro-oesophageal adenocarcinoma is planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Previously treated patients with histologically confirmed, locally advanced or metastatic gastro-oesophageal adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical outcomes in phase 1 study of EBC-129, a first-in-class, anti–N256-glycosylated CEACAM5 and CEACAM6 antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with gastroesophageal adenocarcinomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line pyrotinib-based regimens showed favorable effectiveness and manageable safety profiles for patients with HER2-positive advanced breast cancer in the real-world setting, including those with trastuzumab-naïve and trastuzumab-sensitive disease. These findings support their use in routine clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-positive advanced breast cancer who planned to receive first-line pyrotinib-based therapy were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparable clinical efficacy of pyrotinib in trastuzumab-naive and trastuzumab-exposed HER2-positive advanced breast cancer patients: A prospective, multicenter, real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intermittent olaparib 100 mg Q12H D1-3 combined with the Stupp protocol appears to improve survival in poor-prognosis nonresected or partially resected glioblastoma patients. The safety profile was described as quite similar to standard chemoradiotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with unresectable high-grade gliomas.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1/2a study of concomitant radiotherapy with olaparib and temozolomide in unresectable high-grade glioma patients: Final results from the phase 2a step (OLA-TMZ-RTE-01).

In patients undergoing interval debulking surgery, ALA-PDD may serve as a clinically meaningful adjunct to achieve precise cytoreduction and support surgical decision-making in the neoadjuvant chemotherapy setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers who were scheduled for cytoreductive surgery or exploratory laparotomy were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fluorescence-guided surgery with 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) in ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers: Efficacy and safety results from the GINGA study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis, neurological immune-related adverse events were associated with substantially worse overall survival in patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors. Neurological complications appeared to confer significant morbidity and mortality that outweighed potential treatment benefit, highlighting the need for early recognition, multidisciplinary management, and careful risk–benefit assessment when neurological toxicity develops during immunotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with advanced solid tumors treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, including pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, atezolizumab, or durvalumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neurological immune-related adverse events and overall survival in patients with advanced solid tumors treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors in a global real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sonrotoclax plus zanubrutinib was well tolerated and achieved undetectable minimal residual disease rates greater than 90%, including in patients with high-risk cytogenetics. The depth and kinetics of uMRD achieved with this combination highlight its improved potency and differentiated profile compared with available combination therapies in first-line chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-naive chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (320-mg)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effect of first-line treatment of CLL/SLL with the all-oral combination of sonrotoclax (sonro) and zanubrutinib (zanu) on minimal residual disease (uMRD) rates, including in patients with del(17p)/TP53.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tislelizumab plus POFI showed promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile as first-line treatment for HER2-negative, pMMR/MSS advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Further investigation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HER2-negative, proficient mismatch repair (pMMR)/microsatellite stable (MSS) advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tislelizumab (Tisle) combined with POFI (irinotecan, paclitaxel, oxaliplatin, and 5-FU/levoleucovorin) as first-line treatment for advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (AGC): Update from a single-arm, open-label phase I/II trial (SYLT-023).

data.clinical_result_summary: Cetuximab-based chemotherapy provided meaningful clinical benefit in patients with recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, with survival outcomes comparable to those reported in real-world settings. These findings support the continued use of cetuximab in combination regimens as an effective therapeutic option.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma who were treated at the Instituto Nacional de Enfermedades Neoplásicas between 2020 and 2024, with survival analysis requiring receipt of at least three cycles of cetuximab in combination with chemotherapy as first-line treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real world efficacy of cetuximab plus chemotherapy as first-line treatment of recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with liver metastases and cancer-associated thrombosis, direct oral anticoagulant therapy was associated with a modestly increased risk of gastrointestinal bleeding but improved overall survival compared with low-molecular-weight heparin. The findings may support clinical equipoise between anticoagulation strategies, and individualized treatment decisions remain essential.
clinical_result_indication_name: 癌症相关静脉血栓栓塞症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with liver metastases and cancer-associated thrombosis who initiated a direct oral anticoagulant or low-molecular-weight heparin within 10 days of cancer-associated thrombosis diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Direct oral anticoagulants versus low-molecular-weight heparin in patients with liver metastases and cancer-associated thrombosis: A multi-center real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant DAN-222 plus niraparib showed insufficient activity and no treatment-strategy benefit in BRCA wild-type HER2-negative breast cancer. The regimen was not supported for further development in this setting, and the trial demonstrated I-SPY 2's ability to rapidly distinguish ineffective from promising therapeutic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant DAN-222 plus niraparib in high-risk HER2-negative breast cancer: Results from the I-SPY 2 adaptive platform trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sequential CAR T-cell therapy was reported as a highly effective and safe strategy that induced high rates of durable complete responses in patients with B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma who relapsed after initial CAR T-cell treatment. The activity observed in primary central nervous system lymphoma suggests this approach may overcome the blood-brain barrier and address a critical unmet need.
clinical_result_indication_name: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled heavily pre-treated patients with relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma who had progressed after at least one prior CAR T-cell infusion, including high-risk subtypes such as primary central nervous system lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overcoming resistance to prior CAR-T therapy: Efficacy and safety of a sequential, multi-antigen targeted CAR T-cell strategy in B-cell NHL.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large, real-world propensity-matched cohort of patients with newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, Pola-R-CHP demonstrated overall survival and safety outcomes comparable to R-CHOP in a population with substantial comorbidity burden. These findings support the feasibility of Pola-R-CHP in routine clinical practice and extend the external validity of POLARIX trial results.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma receiving Pola-R-CHP or R-CHOP were identified.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of polatuzumab vedotin plus R-CHP versus R-CHOP in newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: A propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pucotenlimab plus dose-intensified chemoradiotherapy achieved a high complete response rate with rapid tumor regression after two consolidation cycles in patients with pMMR/MSS locally advanced rectal cancer, including those with high-risk and ultra-low tumors. The regimen offered strong early tumor control and significant organ-preservation opportunity, particularly for very low rectal cancers, and warrants further validation in larger comparative trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pMMR/MSS locally advanced rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pucotenlimab plus dose-intensified radiotherapy and chemotherapy for locally advanced rectal cancer: Preliminary results from a prospective, single-arm phase II trial (PUCRT).

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hydroxyurea use and thrombotic outcomes in myelofibrosis patients with leukocytosis: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The preliminary safety profile of trastuzumab deruxtecan plus bevacizumab was consistent with the known safety profiles of the individual agents. No new safety signals were identified, supporting continued investigation of this combination in DO-01.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-expressing ovarian cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) + bevacizumab (BEV) as first-line (1L) maintenance therapy in patients (pts) with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)–expressing ovarian cancer (OC): Results from the DESTINY-Ovarian01 (DO-01/ENGOT-ov89/GOG-3112/APGOT-OV13) safety run-in (SRI).

data.clinical_result_summary: BG-C9074 demonstrated a tolerable safety profile in patients with advanced solid tumors. Encouraging antitumor activity was observed in ovarian cancer and triple negative breast cancer, and dose expansion and optimization are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
Pts with advanced solid tumors, irrespective of B7-H4 expression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of BG-C9074 (B7-H4–targeting ADC) in advanced solid tumors: Dose escalation and safety expansion.

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of SSTR2 targeted radiopharmaceutical therapy to maintenance immune checkpoint inhibition was well tolerated and demonstrated clinically meaningful anti-tumor activity. These findings support further investigation of SSTR2-targeted radiopharmaceutical therapy in combination with immune checkpoint inhibition in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with extensive stage small cell lung cancer on maintenance treatment with immune checkpoint inhibition
data.clinical_result_paper_title: LuSato-1: Phase I study of 177Lu-SSO110 with 68Ga-SSO120 companion imaging in patients with extensive stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) on maintenance treatment with immune checkpoint inhibition (ICI).
