clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with a confirmed diagnosis of prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Diagnostic performance, safety, and biodistribution of [68Ga]Ga-OncoACP3 for PET imaging in prostate cancer: A phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy did not improve long-term survival over surgery plus adjuvant therapy in an unselected esophageal squamous cell carcinoma population. However, patients achieving pathological complete response experienced substantial benefit. Recurrence remained common, was dominated by distant metastasis, and early recurrence was strongly associated with poor postrecurrence survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resectable, locally advanced thoracic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term survival, recurrence patterns, and postrecurrence outcomes after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy versus surgery plus adjuvant therapy in locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: Final results of a randomized phase III trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Apalutamide plus androgen deprivation therapy significantly increased the curative success of radical prostatectomy in patients with high-risk localized or locally advanced prostate cancer, with 10-fold higher odds of pathologic complete response/minimal residual disease and a clinically meaningful 20% reduction in the risk of distant metastasis or death. Secondary endpoints all favored apalutamide plus androgen deprivation therapy, supporting combined apalutamide plus androgen deprivation therapy and radical prostatectomy as a new standard of care for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed high-risk localized or locally advanced prostate cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: Gleason score (7, ≥8), nodal status, and geographic region (North America, European Union, rest of world)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative (neoadjuvant and adjuvant) apalutamide (APA) + androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) vs placebo (PBO) + ADT with radical prostatectomy (RP) in high-risk localized or locally advanced prostate cancer (HR LPC/LAPC): Final analysis of the PROTEUS phase 3 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In real-world clinical practice, adding bevacizumab to olaparib in patients without prior bevacizumab exposure was associated with worse survival outcomes and earlier treatment switching. Prospective, controlled studies are needed to clarify whether this reflects confounding by disease severity or a lack of added benefit from combination therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult bevacizumab-naive patients from 2015-2024 with ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer who received platinum chemotherapy followed by olaparib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world outcomes of olaparib with versus without bevacizumab in bevacizumab‑naïve BRCA1/2‑mutated ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In real-world clinical practice, adding bevacizumab to olaparib in patients without prior bevacizumab exposure was associated with worse survival outcomes and earlier treatment switching. Prospective, controlled studies are needed to clarify whether this reflects confounding by disease severity or a lack of added benefit from combination therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult bevacizumab-naive patients from 2015-2024 with ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer who received platinum chemotherapy followed by olaparib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world outcomes of olaparib with versus without bevacizumab in bevacizumab‑naïve BRCA1/2‑mutated ovarian cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients with acute myeloid leukemia treated with venetoclax, concomitant azole antifungal use was associated with higher mortality and increased hematologic toxicity compared with venetoclax monotherapy, without a reduction in sepsis risk. Invasive fungal infections were less frequent in patients treated without azole antifungals, although interpretation is limited by the observational design. These findings highlight the clinical impact of venetoclax-azole drug-drug interactions and support prospective studies to define optimal antifungal strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with acute myeloid leukemia treated with venetoclax.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical outcomes of venetoclax with and without azole antifungals in acute myeloid leukemia: A large real-world cohort study.

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors

data.clinical_result_summary: Bothersome gynecomastia occurred at low rates in men treated with neoadjuvant androgen deprivation therapy. Symptoms resolved in most patients within two years after treatment, suggesting that the temporary nature of gynecomastia should be discussed during counseling about hormone therapy side effects.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included localized prostate cancer patients at Georgetown University Hospital, including low-risk, intermediate-risk, and high-risk patients, who were treated with short-course androgen deprivation therapy for 3-6 months and stereotactic body radiotherapy at 35-36.25 Gy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of patient‑reported gynecomastia following neoadjuvant androgen deprivation therapy and stereotactic body radiotherapy for localized prostate cancer.

These findings highlight the clinical impact of venetoclax-azole drug-drug interactions and support prospective studies to define optimal antifungal strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with acute myeloid leukemia treated with venetoclax.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical outcomes of venetoclax with and without azole antifungals in acute myeloid leukemia: A large real-world cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: CHM-2101 demonstrated cellular expansion and persistence with clinical tolerability in study subjects with advanced gastrointestinal cancers at two dose levels. Enrollment of patients at Dose Level 3 is ongoing at US Cancer Centers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory gastrointestinal cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical and translational results from the phase 1 portion of the phase 1/2 study to evaluate CHM-2101, an autologous cadherin 17 (CDH17) chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy for the treatment of relapsed or refractory gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with metastatic colorectal cancer receiving cetuximab, concomitant use of Shengma Biejia Decoction-based TCM formula significantly lessened skin reactions. The regimen showed a favorable safety profile and contributed to better overall quality of life, providing TCM-based evidence for prevention and management of cetuximab-related skin reactions.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The analysis included patients with metastatic colorectal cancer who received cetuximab at Longhua Hospital, Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, from 2022 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for prevention and management of anti‑EGFR monoclonal antibody (mAb)–induced cutaneous adverse reactions in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): A retrospective analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of men receiving androgen deprivation therapy plus systemic therapy for metastatic prostate cancer, beta-blocker use at the time of systemic therapy initiation was not associated with an overall survival benefit. Overall, the results reassure that beta-blocker use is not associated with inferior overall survival in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included men with metastatic prostate cancer who initiated androgen deprivation therapy and subsequently started systemic therapy with an androgen receptor signaling inhibitor or docetaxel.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Beta-blockers and overall survival in men receiving ADT + systemic therapy for metastatic prostate cancer.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 缓解持续时间（Duration of response，DOR）
data.clinical_result_summary: Temab-A had a manageable safety profile and showed antitumor activity in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer. Objective response rate was 37%, and no treatment-related adverse events led to death.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 basket study of telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A, ABBV-400), a c-Met protein–targeting antibody-drug conjugate: Results from patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer (PROC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Varegacestat demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful antitumor activity and pain relief in adults with progressing desmoid tumors. It achieved the highest objective response rate reported in a Phase 3 trial of systemic desmoid tumor therapy, with no new safety signals.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with progressing desmoid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RINGSIDE: A phase 3 randomized, placebo-controlled trial of varegacestat for treatment of progressing desmoid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Zele monotherapy at 5 mg/m2 on Days 1/8/15 and 6 mg/m2 on Days 1/8 on a 21-day cycle demonstrated encouraging response rates and safety profiles in previously treated patients. The 6 mg/m2 Days 1/8 regimen provided a more favorable benefit-risk profile, with potential for improved tolerability, combinability, convenience, and fewer discontinuations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously treated locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Interim analysis results from Duravelo-2: Zelenectide pevedotin (zele; BT8009) in patients (pts) with previously treated locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma (la/mUC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant endocrine therapy plus CDK4/6 inhibitors achieved short-term objective response rates comparable to chemotherapy-sequenced regimens in HR+/HER2- early breast cancer, even in patients with high Ki-67. These findings support the feasibility of chemotherapy-free neoadjuvant strategies for clinically selected patients, potentially reducing toxicity without compromising initial treatment response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 18–70 years with HR+/HER2- early breast cancer across 11 tertiary hospitals in China were analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chemotherapy-free neoadjuvant strategy in HR+/HER2− early breast cancer: Efficacy of CDK4/6 inhibitors plus endocrine therapy compared to chemotherapy-sequenced approach.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world retrospective comparison, venetoclax plus obinutuzumab was associated with significantly better 3-year overall survival and higher complete response rates than continuous BTKi therapy in first-line chronic lymphocytic leukemia. VenG also had lower major bleeding rates, although tumor lysis syndrome occurred more often, supporting its use as an effective frontline treatment option with appropriate risk mitigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged ≥18 years diagnosed with chronic lymphocytic leukemia and receiving first-line therapy with either a BTKi or VenG.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitors versus venetoclax in chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: SKB500 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in patients with treatment-refractory advanced solid tumors. Notable efficacy was observed in the small cell lung cancer and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cohorts, supporting further clinical development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic SCLC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic ESCC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An open-label, first-in-human study of SKB500 in patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: M701 intrapleural infusion showed promising efficacy on re-accumulation of malignant pleural effusion compared with cisplatin infusion and was well tolerated. These findings support further clinical development, especially in patients with no actionable genomic alterations or patients who previously received intrapleural chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer and symptomatic malignant pleural effusion who had progressed after at least 1 line of systemic treatment.
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior intrapleural chemotherapy (yes/no)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An anti-EpCAM x anti-CD3 bispecific antibody, M701, for the treatment of malignant pleural effusion due to NSCLC: A prospective randomized controlled phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a landmark propensity-matched analysis, initiating bone marrow agents early after androgen deprivation therapy in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer with bone metastases did not improve time-to-event survival or reduce skeletal-related events. In a nested comparative-effectiveness analysis, zoledronic acid and denosumab showed similar survival and acute kidney injury risk, informing agent selection in routine practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer with bone metastases who were initiating first-line androgen deprivation therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Does BMA improve outcomes in mHSPC with bone metastases?: Landmark propensity-matched analysis and nested zoledronic acid vs denosumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: UGN-103 demonstrated a safety and efficacy profile similar to that observed with UGN-102 in patients with recurrent low-grade, intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer. These findings support continued evaluation of UGN-103 as an intravesical treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (LG-IR-NMIBC)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: UTOPIA: A phase 3 trial of UGN-103, an intravesical mitomycin reverse thermal hydrogel, in recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral Vidu injection significantly increased stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes in all treated patients and induced favorable immunological modulation of the tumor and its microenvironment. Vidu may potentially alter response to neo-/adjuvant treatments and patient outcomes, warranting further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Untreated patients with early triple-negative breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pre-operative intratumoral toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9) agonist vidutolimod (Vidu) and stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) in early triple-negative breast cancer (eTNBC): Randomized phase 2 CyberImmunoBreast trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with progressing brain metastases while receiving tucatinib had brain metastasis-to-serum tucatinib ratios similar to those of patients receiving tucatinib for the first time in the trial. These data indicate that intratumoral drug concentration alone is unlikely to account for intracranial acquired resistance, and correlative analyses investigating potential genomic and microenvironmental mechanisms of resistance are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients undergoing brain metastasis resection for HER2-positive or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, or gastroesophageal cancer, including HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients with progressing brain metastases while on tucatinib, tucatinib-naïve HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients, and patients with gastrointestinal malignancy, non-small cell lung cancer, or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).

data.clinical_result_summary: ETX-19477 was well tolerated and showed anti-tumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with BRCA-mutated, platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian cancer during dose escalation. These findings provide the first clinical proof-of-concept of PARG inhibition in high-grade serous ovarian cancer, and ETX-19477 is being further evaluated in the dose expansion phase.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase 1/2 study of ETX-19477, an oral, potent, and selective PARG inhibitor, in patients with advanced solid tumors (ERADIC8).

data.clinical_result_summary: Tegavivint demonstrated monotherapy clinical activity and a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and Wnt pathway mutations. Observed partial responses, durable disease control, and on-target pharmacodynamic effects in second- and third-line patients support further development of tegavivint as monotherapy or in combination with other treatments for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tegavivint, a downstream Wnt/β-catenin inhibitor: Dose-finding results from a phase 1/2 trial in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (aHCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world study showed sustained survival at 5 years among patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma treated with axi-cel after at least 2 lines of therapy, consistent with ZUMA-1. Infection and organ failure were common causes of non-relapse mortality. These results continue to support the use of axi-cel with curative intent in relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults from 79 US centers with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma receiving commercial axi-cel after at least 2 lines of therapy were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term real-world outcomes of axicabtagene ciloleucel (axi-cel) in relapsed/refractory (R/R) large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL).

data.clinical_result_summary: In a real-world propensity-matched cohort of lorlatinib-treated patients with non-small cell lung cancer, lipid-lowering therapy initiated within 30 days was associated with lower 1-year mortality, venous thromboembolism, and hospitalization. These findings support early lipid monitoring and timely lipid-lowering therapy initiation in practice, while prospective studies are needed to confirm the associations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with non-small cell lung cancer who received lorlatinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early lipid-lowering therapy initiation after lorlatinib and clinical outcomes in non–small cell lung cancer: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Gemcitabine–oxaliplatin showed a manageable real-world toxicity profile in advanced gallbladder cancer, with treatment-limiting effects driven mainly by cumulative neuropathy and anemia. These data support the feasibility of GEMOX in routine practice in a high-burden setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults from north India with unresectable or metastatic gallbladder adenocarcinoma, described as patients with advanced and metastatic gallbladder cancer treated with GEMOX in routine clinical practice between January 2020 and June 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tolerance of gemcitabine–oxaliplatin (GEMOX) in advanced and metastatic gallbladder cancer: A real-world, single-center retrospective study from north India.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with completely resected metachronous colorectal cancer metastases, omission of adjuvant chemotherapy did not compromise disease-free survival and was associated with longer second disease-free survival. These findings support a more individualized approach to adjuvant treatment selection, although prospective randomized studies are warranted to confirm the observations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged ≥18 years with histologically confirmed colorectal cancer and resectable metachronous metastases at any site, with a disease-free interval of ≥6 months, including patients with completely resected metachronous colorectal cancer metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated analysis of adjuvant chemotherapy after radical resection of metachronous colorectal cancer metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Anthracycline-containing and anthracycline-free dual anti-HER2 neoadjuvant therapy achieved comparable pCR in routine practice. Post-neoadjuvant escalation with T-DM1 was common, and discontinuation was mainly toxicity-driven with rare cardiac discontinuation. Larger cohorts with longer follow-up are needed to clarify comparative recurrence and safety outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with stage I–III HER2-positive breast cancer treated with dual anti-HER2 neoadjuvant therapy followed by surgery.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Anthracycline-free vs anthracycline-containing dual anti-HER2 neoadjuvant therapy: Real-world outcomes.

clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with stage I–III HER2-positive breast cancer treated with dual anti-HER2 neoadjuvant therapy followed by surgery.

data.clinical_result_summary: Post-neoadjuvant T-DM1 showed excellent real-world effectiveness, with a low incidence of invasive disease recurrences in patients with HER2-positive early breast cancer and residual disease after neoadjuvant therapy. A large fraction of patients treated in routine practice would not have met DESTINY-Breast-05 or DESTINY-Breast-11 eligibility criteria, highlighting the value of real-world benchmarking to contextualize trial evidence and guide integration of antibody-drug conjugates in the curative setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan with HER2-positive early breast cancer and residual disease after trastuzumab-based neoadjuvant therapy who received at least 1 cycle of T-DM1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world data on post-neoadjuvant trastuzumab emtansine to benchmark DESTINY-Breast-05 and -11 emerging paradigms.

data.clinical_result_summary: QL1706 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging antitumor activity in patients with advanced solid tumors as 2nd-line and beyond treatment. QL1706 could be a potential treatment regimen for patients receiving immunotherapy rechallenge after prior PD-(L)1 failure.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with histologically confirmed advanced solid tumors received QL1706 as monotherapy or combination therapy as 2nd-line and beyond treatment across six clinical centers, including patients in the immunotherapy rechallenge setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Iparomlimab and tuvonralimab (PD-1/CTLA-4 bifunctional antibody) monotherapy or combination therapy in patients with advanced solid tumors treated.

data.clinical_result_summary: In gastric cancer cachexia, anamorelin did not achieve a statistically significant increase in lean body mass at 8 weeks but significantly improved body weight and appetite-related quality of life with a favorable safety profile. Anamorelin represents a feasible supportive option during chemotherapy in multimodal gastric cancer care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients from Japan with unresectable or recurrent gastric cancer and cachexia receiving chemotherapy (1st-3rd line).
clinical_result_layer_factor: institution and gastrectomy status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized controlled trial evaluating anamorelin hydrochloride in patients with gastric cancer cachexia (TEAM-GUSTO).

data.clinical_result_summary: Anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody with chemotherapy may be effective for NeoRAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer. The benefit appeared especially notable for patients hyper-selected for absence of gene mutations related to anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with NeoRAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter single-arm phase II trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of panitumumab and irinotecan in patients with NeoRAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer (C-PROWESS trial).

clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 18–70 years with HR+/HER2- early breast cancer across 11 tertiary hospitals in China were analyzed.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Chemotherapy-free neoadjuvant strategy in HR+/HER2− early breast cancer: Efficacy of CDK4/6 inhibitors plus endocrine therapy compared to chemotherapy-sequenced approach.

data.clinical_result_summary: The efficacy of neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy in hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma is determined by a baseline immune architecture characterized by a CCL3+ neutrophil subset. The Neu_CCL3 gene signature may serve as a clinically useful biomarker for patient selection in precision immunotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with resectable locally advanced hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CCL3+ neutrophil signature as a predictor of response to neoadjuvant toripalimab plus chemotherapy in hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma: A phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among adults with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma treated with glofitamab or epcoritamab, chemotherapy within 90 days of bispecific antibody initiation was associated with inferior 3-year overall survival and increased risk of cytokine release syndrome and immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome. These findings may inform practice, therapy sequencing, and future bispecific antibody clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older diagnosed with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma identified via ICD-10-CM or ICD-O codes and receiving glofitamab and/or epcoritamab were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of recent chemotherapy exposure on overall survival in patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma receiving bispecific antibody therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: TKI combined with ICI demonstrated favorable efficacy and safety in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. FMT post-progression achieved a 61% disease control rate with tolerable toxicity, supporting its potential to overcome TKI-ICI resistance. Bacteroides caccae and Phocaeicola plebeius may be biomarkers of efficacy, and larger randomized controlled trials are needed to validate these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The trial enrolled patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma or HCC with Child-Pugh A, BCLC-B/C, and ECOG PS 0-1, including treatment-naïve patients and previously treated patients.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fecal microbiota transplantation to reverse resistance to TKI plus PD‑1 inhibitors in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: A phase 2 clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study preliminarily indicates that donafenib plus sintilimab combined with TACE, HAIC, or TACE-HAIC shows encouraging efficacy and acceptable toxicity in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma. Enrollment and follow-up are continuing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pts with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma who had not received any previous systemic treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Donafenib plus sintilimab combined with TACE or HAIC for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: A prospective single-arm phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: HLX43 exhibited promising antitumor activity in patients with heavily pretreated advanced non-small-cell lung cancer, regardless of histologic subtype or PD-L1 expression. Its tolerability was considered manageable, supporting further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: heavily pretreated NSCLC patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of HLX43 (anti–PD-L1 ADC) in patients with advanced non–small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).
