data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of pemetrexed and cisplatin was well tolerated and demonstrated promising activity in patients with relapsed, advanced soft tissue sarcoma, particularly in the leiomyosarcoma cohort. The observed efficacy exceeded historical outcomes for standard-of-care second-line therapies, supporting further investigation in future histology-specific studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory advanced soft tissue sarcoma - Cohort 1 (leiomyosarcoma, LMS)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II, multi-cohort study with pemetrexed plus cisplatin combination in patients with relapsed or refractory advanced soft tissue sarcoma: Leiomyosarcoma cohort (ALBATROSS-SARC-LMS01).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world propensity score-matched analysis, pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy showed higher 205-day mortality than nivolumab plus chemotherapy, while 2- to 5-year survival was similar. Pembrolizumab was associated with lower noninfective colitis rates and fewer recurrent sepsis episodes. The early survival difference warrants evaluation for confounding, and prospective head-to-head trials are needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults (>=18) with advanced/metastatic gastric cancer, including first-line HER2-negative advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, treated with pembrolizumab or nivolumab plus platinum-fluoropyrimidine.
clinical_result_layer_factor: demographics, comorbidities (hypertension, diabetes, CKD, cardiovascular disease), baseline hemoglobin, and TNM stage
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pembrolizumab vs nivolumab plus chemotherapy in metastatic gastric cancer: TriNetX propensity score–matched analysis..

data.clinical_result_summary: Nab-paclitaxel plus S-1 showed favorable efficacy for locally advanced pancreatic cancer. The results also supported the possibility of converting unresectable disease into surgically resectable disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated locally advanced pancreatic cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nab-paclitaxel plus S-1 induction chemotherapy for patients with locally advanced pancreatic cancer: A multicenter, open-label phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Combining SBRT with GM-CSF and Peg-IFNα was well tolerated with acceptable toxicity and may represent a promising salvage therapy for previously treated patients with metastatic thymic tumors. The occurrence of abscopal effects is likely to improve patient outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage IV thymic tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Combining SBRT with GM-CSF and Peg-IFNα to induce abscopal effects in previously treated patients with metastatic thymic tumors: A single-institution, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant Ivonescimab plus chemotherapy demonstrated unprecedented radiological response depth and pathological remission rates in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. This novel PD-1/VEGF-based dual blockade may redefine neoadjuvant standards for head and neck cancer. High CPS and MRD negativity were robust predictors of deep pathological response.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable stage III-IVa locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant ivonescimab (AK112, a PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody) combined with nab-paclitaxel and cisplatin (AP) for resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (LA-HNSCC): An exploratory phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with liver metastases and cancer-associated thrombosis, direct oral anticoagulant therapy was associated with a modestly increased risk of gastrointestinal bleeding but improved overall survival compared with low-molecular-weight heparin. The findings may support clinical equipoise between anticoagulation strategies, and individualized treatment decisions remain essential.
clinical_result_indication_name: 癌症相关静脉血栓栓塞症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with liver metastases and cancer-associated thrombosis who initiated a direct oral anticoagulant or low-molecular-weight heparin within 10 days of cancer-associated thrombosis diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Direct oral anticoagulants versus low-molecular-weight heparin in patients with liver metastases and cancer-associated thrombosis: A multi-center real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: MeziKd showed a clinically meaningful progression-free survival benefit as early as first relapse in predominantly triple-class-exposed, anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody- and lenalidomide-refractory patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. These data support mezigdomide, a potent oral therapy with a predictable and manageable safety profile, as a readily accessible potential new standard of care for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma across multiple settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Mezigdomide, carfilzomib, and dexamethasone (MeziKd) vs carfilzomib and dexamethasone (Kd) in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM): Results from the phase 3 SUCCESSOR-2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: ALA-PDD appears to enhance intraoperative diagnostic accuracy compared with conventional white light inspection and demonstrates an acceptable safety profile in ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers. In patients undergoing interval debulking surgery, ALA-PDD may serve as a clinically meaningful adjunct to achieve precise cytoreduction and support surgical decision-making in the neoadjuvant chemotherapy setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers who were scheduled for cytoreductive surgery or exploratory laparotomy were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fluorescence-guided surgery with 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) in ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers: Efficacy and safety results from the GINGA study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 缓解持续时间（Duration of response，DOR）
data.clinical_result_summary: Temab-A had a manageable safety profile and showed antitumor activity in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer. Objective response rate was 37%, and no treatment-related adverse events led to death.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 basket study of telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A, ABBV-400), a c-Met protein–targeting antibody-drug conjugate: Results from patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer (PROC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results supported the use of disitamab vedotin combined with tislelizumab and BCG as a bladder-preserving therapy for patients with Her2-positive high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer. The bladder-preservation rate was high, and no Grade 3-5 treatment-related adverse events were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with Her2-positive high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PUNCH03: Preliminary results from a phase II study of disitamab vedotin combined with tislelizumab and Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) in Her2-positive high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (HR NMIBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Initial data showed a favorable safety profile for KD-496 CAR-T cells targeting NKG2DL and CLDN18.2 in patients with treatment-refractory advanced gastrointestinal cancers. Preliminary efficacy signals support further investigation of KD-496, particularly in gastric cancer and pancreatic cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with refractory advanced digestive cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I clinical trial evaluating dual-targeting CAR-T cells (KD-496) against CLDN18.2 and NKG2DL in advanced gastrointestinal cancers and pancreatic cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nirogacestat showed a higher tumor response rate than other systemic therapies, including sorafenib, pazopanib, or tamoxifen plus sulindac, in this real-world analysis of desmoid tumors. However, no significant PFS improvement was observed, likely due to the small sample size and shorter follow-up for the nirogacestat group. These findings support the activity of nirogacestat in desmoid tumors and warrant validation in larger, long-term studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively analyzed UCI Health patients treated from 2019 to 2025 for desmoid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy of nirogacestat compared to prior standard-of-care (SOC) systemic agents in desmoid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Early TVI-AST-008 data suggest adoptive neoantigen-specific immunotherapy is feasible and safe, with early signals of possible improved survival in MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma. High post-randomization withdrawal in the control arm highlights challenges of SOC-controlled trials in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: newly diagnosed MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma patients
clinical_result_layer_factor: age, residual tumor, and sex
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial analysis of adoptive neoantigen-specific T-cell immunotherapy for MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma (TVI-AST-008): Signals amid control arm attrition.

data.clinical_result_summary: M701 intrapleural infusion showed promising efficacy on re-accumulation of malignant pleural effusion compared with cisplatin infusion and was well tolerated. These findings support further clinical development, especially in patients with no actionable genomic alterations or patients who previously received intrapleural chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer and symptomatic malignant pleural effusion who had progressed after at least 1 line of systemic treatment.
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior intrapleural chemotherapy (yes/no)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An anti-EpCAM x anti-CD3 bispecific antibody, M701, for the treatment of malignant pleural effusion due to NSCLC: A prospective randomized controlled phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective cohort study, mRNA COVID vaccination within a year of the first pembrolizumab infusion did not affect survival in stage IV colon cancer. Previous positive findings of vaccination during pembrolizumab therapy in other cancers may not extend to colon cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Stage IV colon cancer patients treated with pembrolizumab, excluding patients with synchronous skin or respiratory malignancies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination on survival in pembrolizumab-treated stage IV colon cancer: A multi-institutional propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Induction chemoimmunotherapy with cemiplimab combined with cisplatin and docetaxel was feasible and demonstrated an acceptable safety profile in patients with locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck. The regimen showed a high overall response rate and disease control rate, supporting further investigation in larger studies.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated stage IV locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 study of induction chemoimmunotherapy (ICI) with cemiplimab in combination with cisplatin and docetaxel (TPI) in locally advanced squaous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (LA SCCHN).

data.clinical_result_summary: Analyzed retrospectively, responders outperformed non-responders in visual memory and executive function at baseline and throughout initial treatment, maintaining a cognitive advantage. The authors hypothesize that early cognitive performance could be considered with other clinical factors to prognosticate treatment response, support patient stratification, and personalize treatment strategies, although this was not tested.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed participants with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer, including 410 participants who received apalutamide and continuous androgen deprivation therapy during the initial treatment phase, of whom 144 had no prior androgen deprivation therapy exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cognition of apalutamide + ADT treatment responders versus non-responders.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this adjuvant trial for patients aged over 60, participation rates for patient-reported outcome data collection were high. Global health-related quality of life was not impacted by T-DM1, and although patient-reported symptoms were frequent, the vast majority were mild.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included older adults aged 60 or older with stage I-III HER2-positive breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Patient-reported outcomes from the adjuvant ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) for older patients with HER2+ breast cancer (ATOP) trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Induction toripalimab combined with chemotherapy provided a promising and durable larynx preservation rate in this cohort of patients with extensively locally advanced laryngeal and hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Locally Advanced Laryngeal and Hypopharyngeal Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Induction toripalimab and chemotherapy for organ preservation in locally advanced laryngeal and hypopharyngeal cancer: 3-year follow-up of the INSIGHT study.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 缓解持续时间（Duration of response，DOR）
data.clinical_result_summary: Temab-A had a manageable safety profile and showed antitumor activity in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer. Objective response rate was 37%, and no treatment-related adverse events led to death.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 basket study of telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A, ABBV-400), a c-Met protein–targeting antibody-drug conjugate: Results from patients with platinum-resistant ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer (PROC).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant cemiplimab had an acceptable safety profile and showed promising efficacy in patients with advanced, surgically resectable basal cell carcinoma of the head and neck. This approach may reduce the morbidity of subsequent surgical resection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: anti-PD1 and HHI-naive patients with resectable basal cell carcinoma of the head and neck
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of neoadjuvant cemiplimab in hedgehog inhibitor (HHI)–naive basal cell carcinoma of the head and neck.

data.clinical_result_summary: A 10-day decitabine plus venetoclax regimen is feasible in high-risk acute myeloid leukemia, with myelosuppression being the major dose-limiting toxicity. The recommended phase 2 dose is venetoclax 400 mg, although responses were also seen at 200 mg. The immune profile of responders showed intriguing patterns that merit investigation in a larger hypomethylating agent plus venetoclax cohort.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with high-risk acute myeloid leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 study of venetoclax combined with a 10-day regimen of decitabine in subjects with high-risk acute myeloid leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: BAT8010 in combination with BAT1006 was well tolerated with manageable toxicity and showed promising preliminary antitumor activity in HER2-positive breast cancer. Dose expansion studies are ongoing, and further confirmatory clinical trials are planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib/IIa study of BAT8010+BAT1006, an anti-HER2 monoclonal antibody-exatecan conjugate combined with an ADCC-enhanced HER2 mAb in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from the 1L HER2-positive breast cancer cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: SKB500 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in patients with treatment-refractory advanced solid tumors. Notable efficacy was observed in the small cell lung cancer and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cohorts, supporting further clinical development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic SCLC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic ESCC
patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An open-label, first-in-human study of SKB500 in patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis, zanubrutinib monotherapy demonstrated significantly longer time to next treatment and improved overall survival compared with acalabrutinib monotherapy. These findings suggest that zanubrutinib may offer superior outcomes in the real-world setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older in the US with at least two diagnoses of chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma, who were treatment-naive for CLL and had an index claim for zanubrutinib or acalabrutinib monotherapy. Patients with evidence of clinical trial participation, prior CLL/SLL treatment, or two diagnoses of mantle cell lymphoma were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world treatment and survival outcomes for zanubrutinib (zanu) and acalabrutinib (acala) monotherapy among treatment-naive patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) in the United States.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: Across two phase 1 studies, the predicted mean change from baseline in QTcF and its 90% confidence interval upper bound remained below 10 ms at E7386 concentrations up to 2650 ng/mL. No significant cardiac safety concerns were identified at the studied dose levels, supporting dose selection and cardiac monitoring strategies for further development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients (pts) with solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Leveraging E7386 phase 1 trials for cardiac safety: Gaining concentration-QTc insights to inform early-stage oncology development.

data.clinical_result_summary: ALA-PDD appears to enhance intraoperative diagnostic accuracy compared with conventional white light inspection and demonstrates an acceptable safety profile in ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers. In patients undergoing interval debulking surgery, ALA-PDD may serve as a clinically meaningful adjunct to achieve precise cytoreduction and support surgical decision-making in the neoadjuvant chemotherapy setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers who were scheduled for cytoreductive surgery or exploratory laparotomy were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fluorescence-guided surgery with 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) in ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancers: Efficacy and safety results from the GINGA study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In gastric cancer cachexia, anamorelin did not achieve a statistically significant increase in lean body mass at 8 weeks but significantly improved body weight and appetite-related quality of life with a favorable safety profile. Anamorelin represents a feasible supportive option during chemotherapy in multimodal gastric cancer care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients from Japan with unresectable or recurrent gastric cancer and cachexia receiving chemotherapy (1st-3rd line).
clinical_result_layer_factor: institution and gastrectomy status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized controlled trial evaluating anamorelin hydrochloride in patients with gastric cancer cachexia (TEAM-GUSTO).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world study, metastatic lung cancer patients with pre-existing autoimmune diseases receiving PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors demonstrated comparable overall survival to those without autoimmune diseases, supporting the use of immune checkpoint inhibitors in this population. However, higher rates of organ-specific immune-related adverse events, particularly gastrointestinal, endocrine, and pulmonary toxicities, and increased hospitalizations underscore the need for enhanced monitoring and multidisciplinary management.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with lung cancer and metastatic disease treated with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors between 2018 and 2025 were included, excluding patients with prior transplant, HIV, chronic viral hepatitis, or CTLA-4 inhibitor exposure; patients with pre-existing autoimmune diseases diagnosed before immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation were compared with those without autoimmune diseases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and survival outcomes of immune checkpoint inhibitors in metastatic lung cancer patients with pre-existing autoimmune disease: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter Y-90 SIRT study, treatment with Y-90 Carbon Microspheres demonstrated favorable safety and efficacy in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma. The study suggests Y-90 Carbon Microspheres may provide a highly promising treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/II, first-in-human study of yttrium-90 carbon microspheres in patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: Safety and early efficacy profiles.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with progressing brain metastases while receiving tucatinib had brain metastasis-to-serum tucatinib ratios similar to those of patients receiving tucatinib for the first time in the trial. These data indicate that intratumoral drug concentration alone is unlikely to account for intracranial acquired resistance, and correlative analyses investigating potential genomic and microenvironmental mechanisms of resistance are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients undergoing brain metastasis resection for HER2-positive or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, or gastroesophageal cancer, including HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients with progressing brain metastases while on tucatinib, tucatinib-naïve HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer patients, and patients with gastrointestinal malignancy, non-small cell lung cancer, or HER2-mutant metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intracranial pharmacokinetics and resistance mechanisms of tucatinib in patients with HER2+/mutant solid tumors and brain metastasis: Results from the WinHER2 study (NCT05892068).

data.clinical_result_summary: FOLFIRINOX delivered real-world survival outcomes comparable to historic phase III data in pancreatic cancer patients treated at a regional centre across a broader patient population. Integration of surgery, stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy, and concurrent chemo-radiotherapy supported favourable outcomes in earlier-stage disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 32 consecutive pancreatic cancer patients across all stages who were treated with FOLFIRINOX in routine practice between 2020–2025 at a regional UK cancer centre.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Delivering complex pancreatic cancer care locally: Five-year FOLFIRINOX outcomes from Northern Ireland.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adults with relapsed, resistant/refractory, or treatment-intolerant Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia achieved high rates of complete hematologic remission or complete hematologic remission with incomplete count recovery with asciminib as monotherapy or in combination with chemotherapy/immunotherapy. The safety profile was consistent with previous studies, but the positive results should be interpreted cautiously because of the retrospective study design and heterogeneous population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged 18 years or older with Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia who were relapsed, refractory/resistant, or intolerant to available or previous treatment and who received at least one dose of asciminib within the managed access program.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ASCERTAIN: Real-world asciminib (ASC) effectiveness in patients (pts) with Philadelphia chromosome–positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (Ph+ ALL).

data.clinical_result_summary: A safe and low-cost lifestyle program with low-glycemic index Mediterranean diet, daily brisk walking, and oral vitamin D supplementation resulted in weight loss and reduced metabolic syndrome prevalence. It was significantly associated with lower recurrences in women with hormone-positive breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Women aged 30-74 years within 12 months of their primary breast cancer diagnosis, stages I-III, were enrolled in 7 oncologic centres in Italy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The effects of Mediterranean diet, physical activity, and vitamin D on breast cancer recurrence and cardiometabolic health: A multicenter randomized trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up, AVZO-021 as monotherapy and in combination with fulvestrant continues to show an encouraging tolerability profile and clinically meaningful efficacy. Gastrointestinal and hematologic adverse events remained generally low in incidence and severity, supporting prolonged treatment and potential safe combination development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2, first-in-human study of AVZO-021, a selective cyclin-dependent kinase 2 inhibitor (CDK2i), as monotherapy and in combination for patients with advanced solid tumors, including hormone receptor–positive (HR+)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–negative (HER2−) breast cancer (BC) and cyclin E1 (CCNE1)–amplified solid tumors: Updated safety and efficacy results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Advanced IDH-mutant cholangiocarcinoma harbors an immune-excluded phenotype, which may underlie primary resistance to immunotherapy. Plasma cfDNA methylome signature can accurately discriminate cholangiocarcinoma with IDH mutations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with unresectable or metastatic IDH-mutant cholangiocarcinoma who had received no more than 2 prior lines of systemic therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Correlative analysis of phase II trial of olaparib and durvalumab in patients with IDH-mutated cholangiocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world propensity score-matched analysis, pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy showed higher 205-day mortality than nivolumab plus chemotherapy, while 2- to 5-year survival was similar. Pembrolizumab was associated with lower noninfective colitis rates and fewer recurrent sepsis episodes. The early survival difference warrants evaluation for confounding, and prospective head-to-head trials are needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults (>=18) with advanced/metastatic gastric cancer, including first-line HER2-negative advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, treated with pembrolizumab or nivolumab plus platinum-fluoropyrimidine.
clinical_result_layer_factor: demographics, comorbidities (hypertension, diabetes, CKD, cardiovascular disease), baseline hemoglobin, and TNM stage
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pembrolizumab vs nivolumab plus chemotherapy in metastatic gastric cancer: TriNetX propensity score–matched analysis..

data.clinical_result_summary: Anbenitamab plus nab-docetaxel ± carboplatin significantly improved total pathological complete response rate compared with standard of care as neoadjuvant therapy in patients with early or locally advanced HER2-positive breast cancer, with a manageable safety profile. These results support the Anbenitamab-based regimen as a potential new standard of care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Neoadjuvant Treatment of Early or Locally Advanced HER2-positive Breast Cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: clinical stage, hormone receptor status, and planned carboplatin use
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Anbenitamab plus albumin-bound docetaxel (nab-docetaxel) ± carboplatin (Cb) versus trastuzumab and pertuzumab plus docetaxel (THP) ± Cb as neoadjuvant therapy for HER2-positive early or locally advanced breast cancer: A randomized, open-label, multicenter, phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this randomized Phase 3 trial of targeted therapy in grade 2 mIDH1/2 glioma, over 3 years of follow-up in patients randomized to vorasidenib supported the robustness of progression-free survival and time-to-next-intervention results. The findings confirmed a durable and sustained treatment benefit with vorasidenib, with no new safety signals reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants with residual or recurrent grade 2 glioma with an IDH1 or IDH2 mutation who have undergone surgery as their only treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A global, randomized, double-blinded, phase 3 trial of vorasidenib vs placebo in patients with grade 2 glioma with an IDH1/2 mutation (INDIGO): Updated efficacy and safety.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this study, adjuvant avelumab was associated with a reduced risk of Merkel cell carcinoma relapse in patients with lymph node metastases. High Merkel cell carcinoma-specific survival in both arms points to the effectiveness of PD-(L)1 blockade in adjuvant and metastatic settings, and these data will inform future discussions regarding adjuvant therapy in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with Merkel cell carcinoma and lymph node metastases
clinical_result_layer_factor: primary tumor/LN status and RT status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ADAM trial: A multicenter, randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial of adjuvant avelumab (anti-PD-L1 antibody) in patients with Merkel cell carcinoma and lymph node metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of tucatinib to first-line trastuzumab and pertuzumab maintenance therapy may be an effective option for patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer. The safety profile was described as clinically manageable, despite higher incidences of hepatic events and diarrhea with tucatinib.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2+ metastatic breast cancer (MBC) following induction therapy in the first-line setting
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tucatinib (TUC) combined with trastuzumab and pertuzumab (HP) as first-line (1L) maintenance therapy for HER2+ metastatic breast cancer (MBC): An in-depth safety analysis of HER2CLIMB-05.

data.clinical_result_summary: Romiplostim N01 showed promising efficacy for cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gastrointestinal cancers, with most patients achieving rapid platelet recovery and no need for transfusions. Its manageable safety profile suggests that it may be a viable supportive care option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study aims to enroll adult patients with gastrointestinal cancers who developed cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia following anticancer therapy, with platelet count <50×10^9/L.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective, single-arm, exploratory study on the efficacy and safety of romiplostim N01 for cancer treatment–induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: BL0175 demonstrated promising efficacy in patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer, including those with prior progression on fulvestrant injection and CDK4/6 inhibitor-based therapy and those with brain metastases. Preliminary results supported its tumor-targeted delivery design rationale and potential for enhanced efficacy at lower doses, warranting further investigation in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Postmenopausal patients with hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BL0175, a novel nano-mediated polypeptide conjugate of protein degrader, in patients (pts) with locally advanced/metastatic HR+/HER2− breast cancer (HR+, HER2- LA/mBC): Initial results from a phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sintilimab plus anlotinib and chemotherapy demonstrated superior objective response rate compared with historical controls and had a manageable safety profile in first-line advanced malignant pleural mesothelioma. The study met its primary endpoint, and the high 12-month progression-free survival rate suggests a potential survival benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic malignant pleural mesothelioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sintilimab plus anlotinib and chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced malignant pleural mesothelioma (SACH-MPM): A prospective, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Repeated low-dose glucarpidase does not appear to adversely impact long-term outcomes in patients with central nervous system lymphoma treated with methotrexate. Outcomes were superior in primary central nervous system lymphoma and newly diagnosed disease compared with secondary central nervous system lymphoma and relapsed/refractory disease, supporting further exploration of glucarpidase to facilitate methotrexate clearance without compromising efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with primary or secondary central nervous system lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term outcomes of CNS lymphoma patients treated with glucarpidase.
clinical_result_pathology_cn: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤

data.clinical_result_summary: Abemaciclib-based CDK4/6 inhibitor rechallenge was associated with improved survival compared with endocrine therapy monotherapy following progression on prior palbociclib or ribociclib. Abemaciclib maintained a relative survival benefit among patients with poor performance status, supporting its potential utility including in patients with reduced performance status.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer who received second-line or later treatment with either abemaciclib with or without endocrine therapy or endocrine therapy monotherapy during 2020-2025, following documented progression on first-line palbociclib- or ribociclib-based therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of CDK4/6 inhibitor re-treatment in HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 中位影像学无进展生存期
中位影像学无进展生存期（median rPFS）
data.clinical_result_summary: In this prematurely terminated phase III study, enzalutamide plus rucaparib was generally well tolerated, with a safety profile consistent with prior PARP inhibitor/androgen receptor pathway inhibitor combinations. Efficacy outcomes for radiographic progression-free survival and overall survival were inconclusive due to the limited sample size, and definitive conclusions regarding clinical benefit could not be determined.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位影像学无进展生存期
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of Alliance A031902: A phase III trial of enzalutamide plus rucaparib as first-line therapy in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (CASPAR).

data.clinical_result_summary: Pomalidomide plus nivolumab is a chemotherapy-sparing regimen with acceptable safety in advanced virus-associated cancers and promising activity in Kaposi sarcoma. Based on these results, an expanded Kaposi sarcoma cohort will be added to the trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants (pts) with advanced virus-associated malignancies (EBV, KSHV, HPV)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I study of pomalidomide and nivolumab (Pom/Nivo) in patients with virus-associated malignancies with and without HIV.

data.clinical_result_summary: The LiViT regimen was feasible and had a manageable safety profile in pediatric patients with relapsed/refractory solid tumors. The maximum tolerated dose was not reached, and liposomal irinotecan 100 mg/m2 was established as the recommended phase II dose. Promising preliminary antitumor activity supports phase II evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients with relapsed/refractory solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of the LiViT regimen (liposomal irinotecan, vincristine, and temozolomide) in pediatric patients with relapsed/refractory solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: After extended follow-up of the phase 1/2a study, prifetrastat at the recommended phase 3 dose of 5 mg once daily maintained a manageable safety profile when dose modifications and supportive care measures were implemented for adverse events such as neutropenia and dysgeusia. These adverse event management strategies have been incorporated into the ongoing phase 3 KATSIS-1 study in patients with HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer after progression on CDK4/6 inhibitor-based therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced ER+/HER2- mBC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term safety results and adverse event (AE) management recommendations in patients with ER+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer (mBC) receiving prifetrastat, a first-in-class KAT6 inhibitor, at the recommended phase 3 dose (RP3D) of 5 mg once-daily (QD).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of encorafenib, binimetinib, and cetuximab demonstrated favorable efficacy and a manageable safety profile in patients with BRAF V600E-mutated colorectal cancer who relapsed early after adjuvant chemotherapy. This triplet regimen may be a promising treatment strategy for this poor-prognosis population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with BRAF V600E-mutated colorectal cancer who relapsed during or within 6 months after completing adjuvant chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter phase II trial of encorafenib, binimetinib, and cetuximab for early relapsed stage II/III BRAFV600E-mutated colorectal cancer: TRESBIEN trial (OGSG 2101).

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant nivolumab and ipilimumab before surgery and adjuvant nivolumab in localized MSI/dMMR oeso-gastric adenocarcinoma achieved a high curative rate. The findings support further investigation of a watch-and-wait approach in patients with clinical complete response after immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: localized MSI/dMMR oeso-gastric adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant nivolumab plus ipilimumab and adjuvant nivolumab in patients with localized microsatellite instability-high (MSI)/mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) oeso-gastric adenocarcinoma: Long-term follow-up of the GERCOR NEONIPIGA phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Overall survival did not differ significantly by race or age, although response patterns varied. Kaplan-Meier curves suggested a trend toward decreased overall survival among non-Hispanic black and younger patients, while older patients showed numerically superior overall survival and non-Hispanic black patients showed significantly superior complete remission rates. The limited single-institution sample size prevents definitive conclusions, and larger multi-institutional studies are needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included newly diagnosed adults with acute myeloid leukemia treated with hypomethylating agents and venetoclax, in the context of older or cytotoxic chemotherapy-ineligible AML patients.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Assessment of racial and age disparities in response and survival among acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients treated with hypomethylating agents (HMA) and venetoclax.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of nimotuzumab to analgesics and concurrent chemoradiotherapy showed a promising survival profile and tolerable toxicity in patients with advanced head and neck cancer. Nimotuzumab was also associated with cancer pain alleviation.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with clinical stage III-IVb head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival and pain treatment de-escalation of concurrent chemoradiotherapy combined with nimotuzumab and analgesics for patients with advanced head and neck cancer: A randomized, controlled clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: FAPI PET/CT-guided radiotherapy combined with second-line systemic treatment and cadonilimab significantly improved ORR in patients with peritoneal metastasis from colorectal cancer compared with standard second-line treatment alone. The regimen had manageable toxicity profiles and represents a promising therapeutic strategy for this challenging patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with peritoneal metastasis from colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective randomized controlled trial of FAPI PET/CT-guided radiotherapy combined with second-line standard systemic treatment and cadonilimab versus second-line standard systemic treatment alone in patients with peritoneal metastasis from colorectal cancer (TORCH-PM01).

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant HAIC (GEMOX) combined with adebrelimab and lenvatinib showed good feasibility, acceptable safety, and promising pathological responses in high-risk resectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. Perioperative safety was not compromised, but long-term survival outcomes require ongoing follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with high-risk recurrence factors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: NEO-ERA-01(CLEAP2507): A multi-center, single-arm, phase II study with neoadjuvant therapy of HAIC (GEMOX) combined with adebrelimab and lenvatinib for resectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with high-risk recurrence factors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The trial achieved its positive primary endpoint, showing meaningful efficacy of dalpiciclib plus nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors in estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms. No new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer, uterine endometrioid carcinoma, or uterine sarcoma, having received a median of one prior therapy for advanced disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy of dalpiciclib and nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors (NSAIs) in estrogen receptor–positive (ER+) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab demonstrated encouraging anti-tumor activity and an acceptable safety profile in patients with recurrent, resectable head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Cadonilimab may change the therapeutic approach for recurrent, resectable head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent, resectable squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of perioperative cadonilimab (AK104) in patients with recurrent resectable head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world study, immune-related adverse events were prevalent among patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors and varied in timing and organ involvement. Patients who experienced immune-related adverse events demonstrated prolonged progression-free survival, while overall survival was numerically prolonged but did not reach statistical significance. These findings highlight the clinical importance of recognizing and monitoring immune-related adverse events during immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment in routine practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included cancer patients aged 18 years and older who received at least one dose of an immune checkpoint inhibitor between January 2017 and January 2023.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune-related adverse events and associated clinical outcomes in cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: A multicenter real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: OP-3136 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and favorable pharmacokinetics, both as monotherapy and in combination with fulvestrant. Preliminary evidence of antitumor activity was observed in ER+ HER2− advanced breast cancer and metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer in heavily pretreated patients. Dose escalation and enrollment in combination with fulvestrant or palazestrant are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, first-in-human study of OP-3136, a novel oral selective KAT6A/B inhibitor, as monotherapy in advanced solid tumors and in combination with endocrine therapy in ER+, HER2− advanced breast cancer (ABC): Preliminary results.

data.clinical_result_summary: The preliminary results indicate that bTAE-HAIC combined with lenvatinib and sintilimab was safe and effective for infiltrative hepatocellular carcinoma. Adverse events and complications were controllable and tolerable, and the study provides a reference for further phase III clinical research and a novel treatment option for infiltrative HCC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with primary infiltrative hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sequential bTAE-HAIC combined with lenvatinib and sintilimab for infiltrative hepatocellular carcinoma: A single-center perspective.

data.clinical_result_summary: TILScore-guided selection of metastases for TIL manufacturing was feasible and enabled consistent generation of clinically active TIL in patients with immunotherapy-resistant cancers. Promising clinical activity in pancreatic adenocarcinoma and peritoneal mesothelioma supports further evaluation of this biomarker-driven TIL adoptive cell therapy approach in larger, histology-specific cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-refractory, locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 basket trial of precision TIL therapy for immunotherapy-resistant advanced cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: PD-1 inhibitors combined with metronomic oral vinorelbine as first-line therapy provided significant survival benefits and acceptable tolerability in elderly patients with driver gene-negative metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, particularly those with high PD-L1 expression. Similar efficacy and safety were observed in patients aged 80 years or older.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Elderly patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer lacking driver mutations.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy and safety of first-line PD-1 inhibitors plus metronomic oral vinorelbine in elderly patients with advanced NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: NALIRIFOX in combination with adebrelimab demonstrated promising antitumor activity and an acceptable safety profile as first-line treatment for patients with advanced biliary tract cancer. Further validation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with previously untreated, unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: NALIRIFOX in combination with adebrelimab for advanced biliary tract cancer: A phase 2 NIOFA-01 clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: SGN1 exhibited a manageable safety profile and showed encouraging clinical benefit in advanced bone and soft-tissue sarcoma, as evidenced by median progression-free survival and disease control rate. The promising data from this Phase I study support further testing of SGN1 in Phase II studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced bone and soft-tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human dose escalation trial of an engineered salmonella delivering L-methioninase in advanced bone and soft tissue sarcomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of olanzapine to standard dietary counseling did not increase the proportion of children achieving clinically meaningful weight gain over 12 weeks. Olanzapine was well tolerated, providing reassurance regarding its short-term safety for other supportive care indications in pediatric oncology.
clinical_result_indication_detail: children with newly diagnosed solid-organ malignancies undergoing chemotherapy
clinical_result_layer_factor: nutritional status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Olanzapine for weight gain in children undergoing chemotherapy for solid-organ malignancies: An investigator-initiated, open-label, multicenter, phase III randomized controlled trial (SNOWMAN).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of galunisertib and capecitabine did not result in objective responses or long-term stable disease in chemotherapy-resistant colorectal cancer patients with peritoneal metastases. The treatment was well tolerated, and pharmacokinetic results for both compounds were similar to those described in the literature.
clinical_result_indication_detail: chemotherapy-resistant colorectal cancer patients with peritoneal metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II combination study of galunisertib and capecitabine in patients with chemotherapy-resistant colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, immunotherapy was associated with a substantially increased risk of musculoskeletal and rheumatologic immune-related adverse events, driven primarily by inflammatory arthritis, although events were uncommon and consistent with prior reports. These toxicities often required immunosuppressive therapy and were associated with immunotherapy interruption or discontinuation, underscoring the need for multidisciplinary management.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult cancer patients aged ≥18 years with cancers eligible for first-line immunotherapy were included, based on patients treated between 2010–2022 at Cleveland Clinic Ohio centers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Incidence and risk of musculoskeletal and rheumatologic (MSK-R) immune-related adverse events (irAEs) in a large real-world cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intrathecal PD-1/CTLA-4 antibody combined with pemetrexed was feasible and had manageable safety, with no unexpected systemic or neurological toxicities. Preliminary activity included a 41.2% clinical response rate and an 82.4% disease control rate, suggesting potential clinical benefit in leptomeningeal metastases from solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: leptomeningeal metastases (LM) from solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intrathecal (IT) PD-1/CTLA-4 antibody combined with pemetrexed (PM) for leptomeningeal metastases (LM) from solid tumors: Preliminary results of two single-center phase I studies.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ceralasertib plus durvalumab is efficacious and well-tolerated in IO-refractory advanced gastric cancer. The higher efficacy observed in patients treated immediately after prior IO failure suggests that ATR inhibition may help reverse acquired resistance to PD-1 blockade, and the approach warrants further validation in a larger cohort.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic gastric adenocarcinoma who progressed on prior anti-PD-(L)1 therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of ceralasertib (ATR inhibitor) plus durvalumab in patients with advanced gastric cancer (AGC) who progressed on prior anti-PD-(L)1 therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Q-1802 plus XELOX showed manageable safety and promising antitumor activity as first-line therapy for CLDN18.2-positive/HER2-negative advanced gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer. These results support a phase III trial using Q-1802 10 mg/kg as the recommended dose.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/II trial of anti-CLDN18.2/PD-L1 recombinant humanized bispecific antibody Q-1802 plus XELOX in treatment-naive CLDN18.2-positive advanced GC/GEJ.

data.clinical_result_summary: Early temozolomide did not improve overall survival in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma. Extended adjuvant temozolomide beyond 6 cycles was safe, but the primary analysis provided insufficient evidence of improved overall survival, although moderate effects remain plausible.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants with newly diagnosed glioblastoma according to CNS WHO 2016 criteria were included.
clinical_result_layer_factor: extent of resection and IDH status (Q1 and Q2) and MGMT methylation (Q2 only)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: MAGMA: Multi-arm glioblastoma Australasia phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: TMC-I significantly improved survival outcomes and response rates while reducing severe toxicity and preserving QoL compared with PBC. At approximately USD 230 per month, TMC-I represents a promising and cost-effective first-line treatment option for patients with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with platinum-sensitive recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Ultra-low-dose immunotherapy plus oral metronomic chemotherapy versus paclitaxel-carboplatin in platinum-sensitive recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: A randomized phase III trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Presence of any of the 4 microRNAs, miR30a-3p, miR141, miR-200a, and miR200b, seemed related to the risk of recurrence or progression of simple hyperplasia or complex hyperplasia without atypia. PTEN expression, metformin, exercise, and weight control were not related to recurrence or progression in this prospective cohort.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled women with endometrial hyperplasia without atypia, specifically patients with simple hyperplasia or complex hyperplasia without atypia.
clinical_result_layer_factor: body mass index
data.clinical_result_paper_title: MicroRNAs as surrogate biomarkers of future endometrial malignancy in women with endometrial hyperplasia without atypia and an open-label randomized trial of metformin, weight control, and exercise intervention.

data.clinical_result_summary: Belzutifan plus lenvatinib showed similar time to deterioration and similar changes from baseline in HRQoL and disease-specific symptoms compared with cabozantinib through week 45. These HRQoL findings, together with efficacy and safety data, support belzutifan plus lenvatinib as a treatment option for advanced renal cell carcinoma after anti–PD-(L)1 therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with advanced renal cell carcinoma that progressed on or after anti–PD-(L)1 therapy as the immediate prior treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Belzutifan plus lenvatinib versus cabozantinib in post–PD-(L)1 renal cell carcinoma (RCC): Health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL) outcomes in the phase 3 LITESPARK-011 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Benmelstobart in combination with chemotherapy followed by sequential combination with anlotinib significantly improved progression-free survival compared with tislelizumab in combination with chemotherapy followed by sequential tislelizumab, with a manageable safety profile. It might be a new first-line treatment for non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced (stage IIIB/C, unfit for surgery or curative-intent chemoradiotherapy) or metastatic nsq-NSCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized, open-label, parallel-controlled phase 3 trial of benmelstobart plus chemotherapy and anlotinib for first-line treatment of advanced non-squamous non–small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: PFS2 remained superior with zanubrutinib despite broad use of novel subsequent therapies, including crossover, in bendamustine-rituximab patients. BCL2 inhibitor-based salvage after initial zanubrutinib achieved high PFS rates at almost 3 years of follow-up, supporting that initial zanubrutinib provides durable benefit while preserving sensitivity to effective subsequent therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-naïve CLL/SLL whose tumor did not exhibit del[17p]
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Subsequent therapies and time to second progression-free survival events (PFS2) in treatment-naive chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (TN CLL/SLL) previously treated with zanubrutinib (zanu) or bendamustine-rituximab (BR) in SEQUOIA.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pomalidomide plus nivolumab is a chemotherapy-sparing regimen with acceptable safety in advanced virus-associated cancers and promising activity in Kaposi sarcoma. Based on these results, an expanded Kaposi sarcoma cohort will be added to the trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants (pts) with advanced virus-associated malignancies (EBV, KSHV, HPV)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I study of pomalidomide and nivolumab (Pom/Nivo) in patients with virus-associated malignancies with and without HIV.

data.clinical_result_summary: OP-3136 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and favorable pharmacokinetics, both as monotherapy and in combination with fulvestrant. Preliminary evidence of antitumor activity was observed in ER+ HER2− advanced breast cancer and metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer in heavily pretreated patients. Dose escalation and enrollment in combination with fulvestrant or palazestrant are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, first-in-human study of OP-3136, a novel oral selective KAT6A/B inhibitor, as monotherapy in advanced solid tumors and in combination with endocrine therapy in ER+, HER2− advanced breast cancer (ABC): Preliminary results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Camrelizumab in combination with apatinib as neoadjuvant therapy showed excellent efficacy in recurrent high-grade gliomas. The combination was reported to be superior to PD-1 inhibitor monotherapy neoadjuvant treatment in patients with recurrent glioblastoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with Recurrent High-Grade Glioma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant treatment of recurrent high-grade gliomas with camrelizumab in combination with apatinib: A prospective phase II clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world retrospective study demonstrated that first-line ribociclib plus aromatase inhibitor, compared with aromatase inhibitor alone, led to longer rwPFS2 and rwCFS in African American patients and patients with low socioeconomic status with HR+/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. These findings support first-line ribociclib plus aromatase inhibitor as an effective treatment choice for these patient groups and highlight the importance of access to optimal treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included US women with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer who began first-line ribociclib plus aromatase inhibitor or aromatase inhibitor monotherapy, including African American patients and patients with low socioeconomic status index defined by area-level SES in the lowest two quintiles.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: (RW) post-progression outcomes following first-line (1L) ribociclib (RIB) + aromatase inhibitor (AI) versus AI alone in African American and low socio-economic status (SES) patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HR+/HER2–) metastatic breast cancer (MBC) in US.

data.clinical_result_summary: Savolitinib showed clinical efficacy and a tolerable safety profile in patients with MET-amplified gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma who had received ≥2 lines of prior therapy. These results support savolitinib as a future treatment option for this genetically defined population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MET-amplified gastroesophogeal junction adenocarcinomas or gastric cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 pivotal study of savolitinib in patients with MET-amplified gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective analysis of real-world patients, the type of BRAF/MEK inhibitor combination used was not a significant prognostic factor, suggesting similar clinical activity among dabrafenib + trametinib, encorafenib + binimetinib, and vemurafenib + cobimetinib. These results require validation in randomized, prospective studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included BRAF-mutant melanoma patients treated in routine clinical practice in major melanoma centres in Poland, receiving first-line systemic therapy in an advanced metastatic or unresectable setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of real-world effectiveness of all approved BRAF/MEK inhibitor combinations in BRAF-mutant melanoma patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: TILScore-guided selection of metastases for TIL manufacturing was feasible and enabled consistent generation of clinically active TIL in patients with immunotherapy-resistant cancers. Promising clinical activity in pancreatic adenocarcinoma and peritoneal mesothelioma supports further evaluation of this biomarker-driven TIL adoptive cell therapy approach in larger, histology-specific cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-refractory, locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 basket trial of precision TIL therapy for immunotherapy-resistant advanced cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: Clinical outcomes and safety profiles of aflibercept plus FOLFIRI were comparable regardless of prior bevacizumab or cetuximab exposure. Elevated baseline PlGF, IL-8, TIMP-1 and VEGF-A levels were associated with shorter PFS and OS. Exploratory plasma proteomics identified dynamic PIGR expression as a response-associated biomarker linked to inferior OS.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced colorectal cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior BEV or CET exposure
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and circulating protein biomarkers of second-line aflibercept plus FOLFIRI according to prior bevacizumab or cetuximab treatment in advanced colorectal cancer (KCSG CO21-21).

data.clinical_result_summary: TILScore-guided selection of metastases for TIL manufacturing was feasible and enabled consistent generation of clinically active TIL in patients with immunotherapy-resistant cancers. Promising clinical activity in pancreatic adenocarcinoma and peritoneal mesothelioma supports further evaluation of this biomarker-driven TIL adoptive cell therapy approach in larger, histology-specific cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-refractory, locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 basket trial of precision TIL therapy for immunotherapy-resistant advanced cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: SHR-A2102 combined with HRS-4642 showed a tolerable safety profile and promising preliminary anti-tumor activity in advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12D mutation. The activity was observed irrespective of Nectin-4 expression.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously treated advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12D mutation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SHR-A2102, a Nectin-4 targeted antibody-drug conjugate, combined with HRS-4642 in previously treated pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma harboring KRAS G12D mutation.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intravenous IDOV-Safe demonstrated a favorable safety profile and encouraging preliminary antitumor activity when combined with toripalimab and fruquintinib. The activity was particularly notable using a sequential combination strategy in heavily pretreated patients with proficient mismatch repair/microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pMMR/MSS metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intravenous oncolytic virus IDOV-Safe in pMMR/MSS metastatic colorectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study provides real-world evidence on the efficacy, dosing, and tolerability of enfortumab vedotin therapy in older adults with advanced urothelial carcinoma. Older patients receiving enfortumab vedotin achieved similar outcomes to younger patients, supporting individualized dosing strategies in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma who received at least one dose of enfortumab vedotin, alone or with pembrolizumab, in any line of treatment between December 1, 2019 and August 1, 2025 at the Huntsman Cancer Institute were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety outcomes of older adult patients on enfortumab vedotin for urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Toripalimab in combination with anlotinib as maintenance therapy demonstrated promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma following first-line anthracycline-based chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Maintenance treatment with toripalimab and anlotinib after anthracycline-based chemotherapy in patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma (TORANS): A single-arm, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pola-R-CHP utilization is increasing, but R-CHOP remained the most used first-line regimen in the US community setting. Time to next treatment or death was favorable for Pola-R-CHP, but relapse rates remained high, highlighting the need to further optimize frontline therapy and supportive care pathways.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients newly diagnosed with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (not otherwise specified) who initiated a first-line regimen within the US Oncology Network in the US community oncology practice setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real‑world characteristics, treatment patterns, and outcomes of newly diagnosed diffuse large B‑cell lymphoma (DLBCL) patients treated in first-line (1L) in the United States (US) community oncology setting.

data.clinical_result_summary: Silevertinib demonstrated antitumor activity at 200 mg orally once daily in patients with recurrent non-small cell lung cancer, EGFR non-classical mutations, and acquired resistance C797S mutation. Its safety profile was consistent with the EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor class.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent non-small cell lung cancer with non-classical and C797S EGFR mutations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy results of the phase 2 study of silevertinib (BDTX-1535) in previously treated patients with non-small cell lung cancer with non-classical and C797S EGFR mutations.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with metastatic and/or relapsed ovarian cancer, IMA203CD8 demonstrated a tolerability profile consistent with prior experience in other solid tumors and encouraging dose-dependent antitumor activity, including durable objective responses according to RECIST. Dose escalation with and without IL-2 at higher doses is ongoing to determine the recommended phase 2 dose and unlock the full potential of IMA203CD8 in ovarian cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with HLA-A*02:01+ and PRAME+ platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1a study results for IMA203CD8, a PRAME-directed T-cell receptor (TCR) T-cell therapy, in ovarian cancer.

Preliminary evidence of antitumor activity was observed in ER+ HER2− advanced breast cancer and metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer in heavily pretreated patients. Dose escalation and enrollment in combination with fulvestrant or palazestrant are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, first-in-human study of OP-3136, a novel oral selective KAT6A/B inhibitor, as monotherapy in advanced solid tumors and in combination with endocrine therapy in ER+, HER2− advanced breast cancer (ABC): Preliminary results.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of ZG005 and bevacizumab as first-line treatment in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma demonstrated early encouraging efficacy with an acceptable safety profile. Higher response rates and prolonged PFS were observed with the ZG005-based regimens, and longer follow-up plus phase 3 trials are warranted to validate these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma
clinical_result_layer_factor: baseline AFP level (< 400 vs. ≥400 ng/mL), macrovascular invasion or extrahepatic metastasis (presence vs. absence)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nilvanstomig (ZG005), an anti-PD-1/TIGIT bispecific antibody, plus bevacizumab vs. sintilimab plus bevacizumab biosimilar as first-line therapy for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma: A randomized, multi-center, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Real-world rates of hyperglycemia with inavolisib in this single-center cohort underscore the importance of baseline metabolic assessment, proactive glucose monitoring, and management to minimize inavolisib interruptions. Fasting status was not uniformly documented, so some glucose values may have been non-fasting, affecting hyperglycemia grading.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective single-center study included 40 female patients with metastatic hormone receptor-positive breast cancer who received inavolisib as standard care at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center from 10/2024 to 1/2026 and had at least 1 on-treatment glucose measurement.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Characterization of inavolisib-associated hyperglycemia in metastatic hormone receptor–positive (HR+) breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world retrospective study found that age and brain metastases did not significantly affect overall survival among patients with small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab. ICANS and CRS were infrequent, and supportive care requirements were similar across age groups, suggesting favorable safety, tolerability, and effectiveness in older adults.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with lung cancer treated with Tarlatamab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Age-based differences in outcomes among small cell lung cancer patients treated with tarlatamab.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of disitamab vedotin and toripalimab showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in cisplatin-refractory advanced penile cancer patients, independent of HER-2 or PD-L1 status. These findings support further evaluation in this patient population with high unmet clinical need.
clinical_result_indication_detail: cisplatin-refractory advanced penile cancer patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of disitamab vedotin combined with toripalimab for cisplatin-refractory advanced penile cancer: A prospective single-center study (SAVE).

data.clinical_result_summary: Real-world rates of hyperglycemia with inavolisib in this single-center cohort underscore the importance of baseline metabolic assessment, proactive glucose monitoring, and management to minimize inavolisib interruptions. Fasting status was not uniformly documented, so some glucose values may have been non-fasting, affecting hyperglycemia grading.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective single-center study included 40 female patients with metastatic hormone receptor-positive breast cancer who received inavolisib as standard care at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center from 10/2024 to 1/2026 and had at least 1 on-treatment glucose measurement.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Characterization of inavolisib-associated hyperglycemia in metastatic hormone receptor–positive (HR+) breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with hematologic malignancies, dapsone was associated with a significantly lower risk of Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and reduced all-cause mortality compared with atovaquone. However, these benefits were accompanied by higher rates of hematologic, gastrointestinal, and hepatic adverse events, supporting individualized selection of PJP prophylaxis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with hematologic malignancies or multiple myeloma who received either dapsone or atovaquone for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia prophylaxis, excluding patients with HIV.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The trade-offs between efficacy and toxicity: Real-world outcomes of dapsone vs atovaquone for pneumocystis prophylaxis in hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intrathecal PD-1/CTLA-4 antibody combined with pemetrexed was feasible and had manageable safety, with no unexpected systemic or neurological toxicities. Preliminary activity included a 41.2% clinical response rate and an 82.4% disease control rate, suggesting potential clinical benefit in leptomeningeal metastases from solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: leptomeningeal metastases (LM) from solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intrathecal (IT) PD-1/CTLA-4 antibody combined with pemetrexed (PM) for leptomeningeal metastases (LM) from solid tumors: Preliminary results of two single-center phase I studies.

data.clinical_result_summary: With extended follow-up exceeding 4.5 years, the addition of low-dose nivolumab to triple metronomic chemotherapy demonstrated a clinically meaningful, durable, and statistically significant survival advantage at a 4-year landmark in a predominantly relapsed/refractory advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma population compared with triple metronomic chemotherapy alone. These findings confirm the long-term clinical benefit of this strategy in the palliative setting.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: relapsed -recurrent or newly diagnosed advanced HNSCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Four-year landmark survival analysis of low-dose nivolumab added to metronomic chemotherapy in advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: A phase III randomized trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, GLP1 use was most frequently observed among younger patients with obesity and was commonly prescribed after cancer diagnosis, with semaglutide accounting for the majority of prescriptions. GLP1 use was associated with improved overall survival compared with nonuse, supporting the need for future studies using robust causal inference approaches.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included GLP1 users and nonusers diagnosed with breast, prostate, lung, hepatocellular, or renal cancer between January 2021 and October 2024, with follow-up through October 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: GLP-1 receptor agonist utilization and survival outcomes in a large U.S. community oncology cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: This single-institution real-world retrospective review evaluated the efficacy and safety of 177-Lu PSMA-617 in metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer. Chemotherapy-naive patients had a longer progression-free survival, while overall survival was not reached in either chemotherapy-naive or chemotherapy-exposed subgroup.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively reviewed patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer who had received 177-Lu PSMA-617 from 2022 to 2025 at a single institution.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of 177Lu-PSMA-617 in metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC): Single-institution, real-world data.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, GLP1 use was most frequently observed among younger patients with obesity and was commonly prescribed after cancer diagnosis, with semaglutide accounting for the majority of prescriptions. GLP1 use was associated with improved overall survival compared with nonuse, supporting the need for future studies using robust causal inference approaches.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included GLP1 users and nonusers diagnosed with breast, prostate, lung, hepatocellular, or renal cancer between January 2021 and October 2024, with follow-up through October 2025.
