data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis of stage IV EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer treated with osimertinib, pleural effusion was associated with persistently higher mortality and hospitalization rates at 1, 3, and 5 years. Pleural effusion appears to identify a high-risk clinical phenotype despite targeted therapy and may warrant closer monitoring and intensified supportive and oncologic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with stage IV EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer treated with osimertinib; patients with non-malignant causes of pleural effusion, end-stage renal disease, heart failure, or prior exposure to other EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors were excluded. Patients were stratified by presence versus absence of pleural effusion.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of pleural effusion on mortality and hospitalization in stage IV EGFR-mutated NSCLC treated with osimertinib: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Iopofosine I 131 demonstrated significant efficacy in patients with Waldenström Macroglobulinemia after BTKi therapy, with 100% CBR, 86.4% ORR, 68.2% MRR, and median PFS of 12 months. The treatment was well tolerated with a manageable toxicity profile, with cytopenias as the only Grade 3 or greater treatment-emergent adverse events. Based on this pivotal trial, iopofosine I 131 could be a promising novel treatment for Waldenström Macroglobulinemia after BTKi therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: relapsed/refractory Waldenstrom’s macroglobulinemia (subgroup, treated with a BTKi immediately)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Iopofosine I-131 after BTK inhibitors in Waldenström macroglobulinemia: CLOVER-WaM subgroup efficacy and safety.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective real-world study of first-line chemoimmunotherapy for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, atezolizumab demonstrated improved overall survival and a trend toward improved progression-free survival compared with durvalumab. The authors noted that ECOG performance status, thoracic radiotherapy use, geographic differences, and ethnic distributions may confound comparisons across real-world studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients diagnosed with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer in the Indiana University Health System from 2018 to 2024 who received either atezolizumab or durvalumab for first-line chemoimmunotherapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison by immunotherapy agent of real-world outcomes with chemoimmunotherapy in first-line extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Abemaciclib-based CDK4/6 inhibitor rechallenge was associated with improved survival compared with endocrine therapy monotherapy following progression on prior palbociclib or ribociclib. Abemaciclib maintained a relative survival benefit among patients with poor performance status, supporting its potential utility including in patients with reduced performance status.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer who received second-line or later treatment with either abemaciclib with or without endocrine therapy or endocrine therapy monotherapy during 2020-2025, following documented progression on first-line palbociclib- or ribociclib-based therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of CDK4/6 inhibitor re-treatment in HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: NTX1088 demonstrated favorable tolerability and encouraging clinical activity in heavily pretreated patients who had progressed on prior PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors. These findings support further evaluation of NTX1088 in Phase 2 studies, incorporating less heavily pretreated patients and biomarker selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced solid malignancies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 study of NTX1088, a first-in-class anti-PVR monoclonal antibody, as monotherapy and combined with pembrolizumab, in patients with advanced solid malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: The intensified multi-agent immunochemotherapy regimen demonstrated encouraging survival outcomes and manageable toxicity as conversion therapy for initially unresectable locally advanced gallbladder cancer. These findings support its potential as a therapeutic strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This single-center real-world retrospective study enrolled patients with locally advanced, initially unresectable gallbladder cancer, and baseline unresectability was confirmed by a multidisciplinary team for all patients.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Conversion therapy with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors plus gemcitabine-based chemotherapy for initially unresectable locally advanced gallbladder cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: RGT-61159 was well tolerated at doses at or below the provisional recommended Phase 2 dose. Robust peripheral knockdown of MYB was observed in a dose-dependent fashion at clinically relevant doses, and clinical activity was seen as prolonged stable disease and partial responses primarily in patients with adenoid cystic carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced, relapsed or refractory adenoid cystic carcinoma or colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1a/b study of RGT-61159, an oral MYB splicing modulator, in patients with advanced adenoid cystic carcinoma and colorectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Afatinib re-challenge showed limited efficacy in patients with EGFR-mutated non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer pretreated with osimertinib and chemotherapy. The safety profile was consistent with previous reports, but the findings suggest that alternative therapeutic strategies should be prioritized in this clinical setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with EGFR-mutated non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer previously treated with osimertinib
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter pilot study of afatinib re-challenge in patients with EGFR-mutated non-squamous non–small cell lung cancer previously treated with osimertinib.

data.clinical_result_summary: SGN1 exhibited a manageable safety profile and showed encouraging clinical benefit in advanced bone and soft-tissue sarcoma, as evidenced by median progression-free survival and disease control rate. The promising data from this Phase I study support further testing of SGN1 in Phase II studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced bone and soft-tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human dose escalation trial of an engineered salmonella delivering L-methioninase in advanced bone and soft tissue sarcomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with advanced hepatobiliary and pancreatic malignancies, increasing the dosing frequency of high-dose vitamin C to every 12 hours under the same total daily dose more effectively maintained plasma vitamin C concentrations with a favorable safety profile. Further dose increase to 0.75 g/kg every 12 hours did not demonstrate additional pharmacokinetic benefits in this study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with advanced hepatobiliary and pancreatic malignancies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I pharmacokinetic study of high-dose vitamin C dosing regimens in patients with advanced hepatobiliary-pancreatic cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: The trial achieved its positive primary endpoint, showing meaningful efficacy of dalpiciclib plus nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors in estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms. No new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer, uterine endometrioid carcinoma, or uterine sarcoma, having received a median of one prior therapy for advanced disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy of dalpiciclib and nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors (NSAIs) in estrogen receptor–positive (ER+) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: Savolitinib showed clinical efficacy and a tolerable safety profile in patients with MET-amplified gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma who had received ≥2 lines of prior therapy. These results support savolitinib as a future treatment option for this genetically defined population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with MET-amplified gastroesophogeal junction adenocarcinomas or gastric cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 pivotal study of savolitinib in patients with MET-amplified gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinomas.

data.clinical_result_summary: CLAD/LDAC/VEN was feasible and effective in a high-risk, older patient population, including patients with prior treatment, who were able to achieve meaningful disease control and use the regimen as a bridge to transplant. The regimen translated well to a community setting, with relatively low 28-day mortality and good tolerability.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high risk myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia treated at the institution from January 13, 2023 to November 18, 2025 were included, including patients with prior treatment such as hypomethylating agents for prior myelodysplastic syndrome transforming to acute myeloid leukemia.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cladribine (CLAD) + low-dose AraC (LDAC) + venetoclax (VEN) in patients with acute myeloid leukemia and high-risk myelodysplastic syndrome: Real-world analysis from a large community-based oncology practice.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large multicenter observational study, CAR-T therapy in patients with primary or secondary CNS lymphoma was associated with meaningful survival and an acceptable safety profile. The findings support CAR-T as a promising therapeutic option for this unmet clinical need.
clinical_result_indication_name: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
继发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with a diagnosis of primary or secondary central nervous system lymphoma prior to receiving CAR T therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes of CD-19–directed CAR-T therapy in patients with primary and secondary central nervous system lymphoma: A multi-center observational study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The results inform clinical decision-making for patients receiving first-line adebrelimab plus capecitabine and oxaliplatin for advanced gastric cancer. The regimen showed objective responses in both Phase Ib and Phase II cohorts, with no dose-limiting toxicities, no immune-related adverse events, and no treatment-related deaths reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib/II clinical study of adebrelimab in combination with capecitabine and oxaliplatin for previously untreated patients with advanced or metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of patients with multiple myeloma receiving IMiD-based therapy, DOAC prophylaxis was associated with lower 1-year all-cause mortality compared with LMWH. There were no significant differences in venous thromboembolism or major bleeding, supporting further prospective studies to define optimal thromboprophylaxis strategies in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with multiple myeloma initiating immunomodulatory drug-based therapy who received prophylactic anticoagulation with a direct oral anticoagulant or low-molecular-weight heparin within one month of diagnosis and immunomodulatory drug initiation, excluding patients with prior venous thromboembolism.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of prophylactic anticoagulation in patients with multiple myeloma receiving immunomodulatory therapy.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: FL115 monotherapy demonstrated a favorable safety profile and promising signs of durable antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors. Treatment also produced significant and sustained expansion of NK and T-cell populations and robust transient induction of interferon-γ.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD), and antitumor activities of FL115, a novel IL-15 superagonist, from the first-in-human study in patients with locally advanced/metastatic solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of nimotuzumab to neoadjuvant AG chemotherapy demonstrated promising efficacy, particularly in patients with high EGFR expression, and was well tolerated. These results support further investigation in prospective randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with borderline resectable or locally advanced pancreatic cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant chemotherapy with AG regimen with or without nimotuzumab in borderline resectable or locally advanced pancreatic cancer: A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: GLP-1 receptor agonist utilization and survival outcomes in a large U.S. community oncology cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: FF-10832 alone or in combination with pembrolizumab in platinum-CPI refractory patients was tolerable, with a safety profile matching previous experience. No objective responses were observed, but most evaluable patients had stable disease at the first assessment, some with tumor shrinkage, and aggregate median PFS was 2.7 months.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced non–small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: FF-10832 liposomal gemcitabine monotherapy or combination with pembrolizumab in patients with advanced non–small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Consistent with the overall COMPETE outcomes, this quality-of-life analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful and durable HRQoL benefits for 177Lu-edotreotide compared with everolimus in patients with gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
clinical_result_indication_name: 胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with Grade 1/2, well-differentiated, gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Quality of life in patients with gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors receiving 177Lu-edotreotide or everolimus: Results from the COMPETE study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tosposertib in combination with pembrolizumab demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging antitumor activity in patients with recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Efficacy appeared particularly robust in the first-line setting, with a favorable trend in PD-L1-high tumors.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with either anti PD-(L)1 inhibitor-naïve metastatic or unresectable recurrent head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC)
head and neck cancer (HNSCC) cohort

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase IIa study of tosposertib, a dual TGFβRI and VEGFR2 inhibitor, in combination with pembrolizumab in recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The observed safety profile of [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE in combination with standard of care was consistent with expected toxicity in patients with newly diagnosed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. The recommended dosage for Phase II was determined to be 7.4 GBq.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed SSTR+ extensive-stage small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase Ib results from the phase Ib/II study of [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE in combination with standard of care as a first-line treatment for pts with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: CD40.HVac showed a favorable safety profile with no dose-limiting toxicities or grade 3-5 adverse events reported. The vaccine induced HPV-specific CD4+ and CD8+ T cell responses, supporting further clinical development of this strategy in patients with HPV16-positive oropharyngeal carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HPV16-positive oropharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Randomized phase I/II trial adjuvant CD40.HVAC, an immunotherapy engaging dendritic cells (DC), in patients with HPV16+ oropharyngeal carcinoma (OPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Deeper and more durable tumor responses were observed with ficerafusp alfa 1500 mg plus pembrolizumab compared with ficerafusp alfa 750 mg plus pembrolizumab in patients with HPV-negative HNSCC. Exposure and pharmacodynamic markers of TGF-β inhibition showed dose-related trends consistent with the mechanism of action, supporting the rationale for further evaluation of this combination.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with 1L R/M HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma with PD-L1 CPS ≥1
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Depth and durability of response with TGF-β trapping in recurrent or metastatic (R/M) HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC): Long-term results from two expansion cohorts of a phase 1/1b study of ficerafusp alfa plus pembrolizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: YL201 showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with relapsed or refractory Ewing sarcoma and chondrosarcoma, with a particularly encouraging objective response rate in Ewing sarcoma. These findings support further evaluation of YL201 in pediatric populations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory Ewing sarcoma and chondrosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1/2 study of YL201, an anti-B7H3 antibody–drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) Ewing sarcoma and chondrosarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: YL201 showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with relapsed or refractory Ewing sarcoma and chondrosarcoma, with a particularly encouraging objective response rate in Ewing sarcoma. These findings support further evaluation of YL201 in pediatric populations.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory Ewing sarcoma and chondrosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1/2 study of YL201, an anti-B7H3 antibody–drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) Ewing sarcoma and chondrosarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: This retrospective real-world study reported a high objective response rate of 32.3% with cetuximab after immunotherapy and platinum failure in recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, exceeding historical data. No impact of the interval between immunotherapy and cetuximab was observed, and prior taxane use and response to immunotherapy were favorable prognostic markers. Cetuximab was confirmed as a standard treatment after platinum and immunotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients treated with cetuximab at a single institution, the Centre Leon Berard in France, had recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, had failed prior immunotherapy and platinum treatment, and were naive to anti-EGFR therapy for recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy of cetuximab after immune checkpoint inhibitor and platin failure in recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC): A 10-year retrospective study in 124 patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up from the phase 1 study, ZG006 continued to demonstrate robust antitumor activity in dose expansion cohorts, including high objective response rate, longer duration of response and progression-free survival, and clinically meaningful survival benefits in patients with refractory small cell lung cancer. No new safety signal was encountered. These data support ongoing development of ZG006 as monotherapy and in combination with other modalities in small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with SCLC who failed or were intolerant to the standard therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of the phase 1 dose escalation and expansion study of alveltamig (ZG006), a trispecific T cell engager targeting DLL3/DLL3/CD3, as monotherapy in patients with refractory small cell lung cancer or neuroendocrine carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: TILScore-guided selection of metastases for TIL manufacturing was feasible and enabled consistent generation of clinically active TIL in patients with immunotherapy-resistant cancers. Promising clinical activity in pancreatic adenocarcinoma and peritoneal mesothelioma supports further evaluation of this biomarker-driven TIL adoptive cell therapy approach in larger, histology-specific cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-refractory, locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 2 basket trial of precision TIL therapy for immunotherapy-resistant advanced cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: SPH4336 plus endocrine therapy demonstrated clinically meaningful intracranial antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile in HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with brain metastases. These findings warrant further investigation in randomized studies for this patient population with high unmet medical need.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with brain metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of SPH4336 plus endocrine therapy in HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with brain metastases: A multicenter, single-arm, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant serplulimab plus chemotherapy followed by adjuvant serplulimab monotherapy significantly prolonged event-free survival in patients with PD-L1-positive, resectable gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Other efficacy endpoints also improved, and the regimen showed a favorable safety profile compared with neoadjuvant/adjuvant chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with early-stage gastric cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant/adjuvant serplulimab vs. placebo combined with chemotherapy for PD-L1–positive gastric cancer: A randomized, double-blind, multicenter phase 3 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pomalidomide plus nivolumab is a chemotherapy-sparing regimen with acceptable safety in advanced virus-associated cancers and promising activity in Kaposi sarcoma. Based on these results, an expanded Kaposi sarcoma cohort will be added to the trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants (pts) with advanced virus-associated malignancies (EBV, KSHV, HPV)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I study of pomalidomide and nivolumab (Pom/Nivo) in patients with virus-associated malignancies with and without HIV.

data.clinical_result_summary: Transdermal delivery of breast cancer prevention drugs is a viable strategy. A higher dose achieved a proportional increase in tissue concentration without increased leakage into the circulation, and further work should pursue formulations of highly active drug metabolites with excellent permeation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Women with unilateral breast cancer treated with breast conservation and radiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Transdermal drug delivery to the normal and the radiated breast: Determinants of individual variation in skin permeation.

data.clinical_result_summary: Yttrium-90 SIRT followed by lenvatinib plus sintilimab demonstrated encouraging activity with manageable toxicity in unresectable intermediate-to-advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. The cytokine-integrated baseline risk score is hypothesis-generating and warrants external validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable BCLC B/C hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Yttrium-90 SIRT followed by lenvatinib plus sintilimab for unresectable intermediate-to-advanced hepatocellular carcinoma: Phase II SIRLENS-90 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large-scale, real-world analysis, GLP-1 RA use was associated with a profound 63% reduction in the risk of post-mastectomy lymphedema. These findings suggest that GLP-1 RAs may serve a potent primary preventive role in breast cancer survivorship, and prospective randomized controlled trials are warranted to validate these results.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included breast cancer patients who underwent mastectomy, comparing those who received GLP-1 receptor agonists with mastectomy patients without GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure, with a focus on high-risk breast cancer patients for primary prevention of post-mastectomy lymphedema.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: GLP-1 RA for primary prevention of post-mastectomy lymphedema in breast cancer patients: A multicenter real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: COVID-19 mRNA vaccination among patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors was associated with a modest increase in immune-related adverse events, particularly ocular toxicities, but may offer survival and critical illness benefits. The findings support continued vaccination in eligible immune checkpoint inhibitor-treated patients with enhanced immune-related adverse event monitoring, including ophthalmologic surveillance in higher-risk groups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with metastatic cancer initiating their first immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, excluding patients with prior immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, active immune-related adverse events within 30 days before immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation, or immunosuppressive conditions; vaccinated patients received COVID-19 mRNA vaccination within 100 days before immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation and were matched to unvaccinated controls.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: COVID-19 mRNA vaccination and risk of immune-related adverse events in ICI-treated cancer patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of galunisertib and capecitabine did not result in objective responses or long-term stable disease in chemotherapy-resistant colorectal cancer patients with peritoneal metastases. The treatment was well tolerated, and pharmacokinetic results for both compounds were similar to those described in the literature.
clinical_result_indication_detail: chemotherapy-resistant colorectal cancer patients with peritoneal metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II combination study of galunisertib and capecitabine in patients with chemotherapy-resistant colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant treatment with QL1706 showed a promising pathological complete response rate and manageable safety in patients with microsatellite instability-high/mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer. A phase 3 trial is ongoing to further confirm the efficacy and safety of QL1706 as neoadjuvant treatment in patients with resectable MSI-H/dMMR colon cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable microsatellite instability-high/mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant treatment of QL1706 in patients with resectable microsatellite instability-high/mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer: Results from a phase 1b trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant treatment with QL1706 showed a promising pathological complete response rate and manageable safety in patients with microsatellite instability-high/mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer. A phase 3 trial is ongoing to further confirm the efficacy and safety of QL1706 as neoadjuvant treatment in patients with resectable MSI-H/dMMR colon cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable microsatellite instability-high/mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant treatment of QL1706 in patients with resectable microsatellite instability-high/mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer: Results from a phase 1b trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: COVID-19 mRNA vaccination among patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors was associated with a modest increase in immune-related adverse events, particularly ocular toxicities, but may offer survival and critical illness benefits. The findings support continued vaccination in eligible immune checkpoint inhibitor-treated patients with enhanced immune-related adverse event monitoring, including ophthalmologic surveillance in higher-risk groups.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with metastatic cancer initiating their first immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, excluding patients with prior immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, active immune-related adverse events within 30 days before immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation, or immunosuppressive conditions; vaccinated patients received COVID-19 mRNA vaccination within 100 days before immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation and were matched to unvaccinated controls.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: COVID-19 mRNA vaccination and risk of immune-related adverse events in ICI-treated cancer patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: Iberdomide demonstrated promising activity as post-ASCT maintenance in patients with multiple myeloma, with dose reductions and discontinuations mainly due to neutropenia. Lower starting doses, growth factor support, and more flexible neutropenia management may help more patients remain on treatment, and longer follow-up will allow evaluation of sustained MRD negativity and progression-free survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Iberdomide (Iber) maintenance following upfront autologous stem cell transplant (ASCT) in multiple myeloma (MM).

data.clinical_result_summary: MIROVA/AGO-OVAR 2.34 was the first randomized trial evaluating carboplatin combined with an antibody-drug conjugate in platinum-eligible relapsed ovarian cancer. The primary endpoint of improved progression-free survival was not met, and further analysis will be presented.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with folate receptor alpha (FRα)-high recurrent ovarian cancer eligible for platinum-based chemotherapy
clinical_result_layer_factor: BRCA-Status, TFIp and number of prior lines of chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase II trial of mirvetuximab soravtansine in folate receptor alpha (FRα)–high recurrent ovarian cancer eligible for platinum-based chemotherapy (MIROVA/AGO-OVAR 2.34).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large-scale, real-world analysis, GLP-1 RA use was associated with a profound 63% reduction in the risk of post-mastectomy lymphedema. These findings suggest that GLP-1 RAs may serve a potent primary preventive role in breast cancer survivorship, and prospective randomized controlled trials are warranted to validate these results.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included breast cancer patients who underwent mastectomy, comparing those who received GLP-1 receptor agonists with mastectomy patients without GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure, with a focus on high-risk breast cancer patients for primary prevention of post-mastectomy lymphedema.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: GLP-1 RA for primary prevention of post-mastectomy lymphedema in breast cancer patients: A multicenter real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Polymeric micellar paclitaxel plus cisplatin demonstrated promising antitumor activity, high disease control, and favorable tolerability in patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The regimen may be particularly relevant for elderly or TPF-intolerant individuals.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial of a novel induction regimen: Polymeric micellar paclitaxel plus cisplatin for locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tislelizumab plus cetuximab and irinotecan as third- or later-line therapy appeared feasible and safe for patients with relapsed/refractory RAS/BRAF wild-type and microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer. The regimen significantly extended progression-free survival versus investigator-selected standard of care, with comparable rates of grade ≥3 treatment-related adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory RAS/BRAF wild-type and microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tislelizumab plus cetuximab and irinotecan in relapsed/refractory RAS/BRAF wild-type and microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer: A randomized, controlled, multicenter study (TEC2).

data.clinical_result_summary: The triplet regimen of inetetamab, pyrotinib, and utidelone demonstrated clinically meaningful activity for first- or second-line treatment of HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer, with high ORR, durable median PFS, and an encouraging 35-month OS rate. Predominant toxicities, including diarrhea and neuropathy, were controllable through supportive measures and dose adjustments. These data support phase III evaluation of this combination strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HER2-positive MBC patients for first- or second-line therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety results of a prospective phase II study (IPUtrial) of inetetamab and pyrotinib in combination with utidelone for first- or second-line treatment of HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of NAL-IRI/5-FU/LV, benmelstobart, and anlotinib showed manageable toxicity and promising efficacy in second-line metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The addition of SBRT in patients with limited or clustered metastases significantly improved disease control and provided sustained PFS benefit, supporting further randomized validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with confirmed metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who progressed after first line therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Integrated NAL-IRI/5-FU/LV, benmelstobart, anlotinib with or without immunoradiotherapy for second-line metastatic pancreatic cancer: A phase II dual-cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Alirocumab plus cemiplimab provided clinical proof-of-principle that PCSK9 inhibition can overcome immunotherapy resistance in a subset of patients with non-small cell lung cancer. The PIK3CA/PTEN/AKT1 pathway may play a significant role in PCSK9-mediated immune evasion and could be a biomarker of response, warranting further investigation in a larger confirmatory study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced immunorefractory metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Alirocumab plus cemiplimab in immuno-refractory metastatic NSCLC: A single-arm, multi-center, phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Staged escalation of adjuvant abemaciclib therapy was reported to be effective and safe in high-risk HR+/HER2- early breast cancer in routine Russian clinical practice. The regimen preserved a high quality of life and reduced the incidence of severe diarrhea and treatment discontinuation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 64 women from a Russian cohort with high-risk HR+/HER2- early breast cancer who met high-risk recurrence criteria consistent with the monarchE trial and had undergone radical surgery with or without radiotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Staged dose escalation of adjuvant abemaciclib in high-risk HR+/HER2- early breast cancer: First safety and efficacy data from a Russian cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large multicenter observational study, CAR-T therapy in patients with primary or secondary CNS lymphoma was associated with meaningful survival and an acceptable safety profile. The findings support CAR-T as a promising therapeutic option for this unmet clinical need.
clinical_result_indication_name: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
继发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with a diagnosis of primary or secondary central nervous system lymphoma prior to receiving CAR T therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes of CD-19–directed CAR-T therapy in patients with primary and secondary central nervous system lymphoma: A multi-center observational study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of olanzapine to standard dietary counseling did not increase the proportion of children achieving clinically meaningful weight gain over 12 weeks. Olanzapine was well tolerated, providing reassurance regarding its short-term safety for other supportive care indications in pediatric oncology.
clinical_result_indication_detail: children with newly diagnosed solid-organ malignancies undergoing chemotherapy
clinical_result_layer_factor: nutritional status
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Olanzapine for weight gain in children undergoing chemotherapy for solid-organ malignancies: An investigator-initiated, open-label, multicenter, phase III randomized controlled trial (SNOWMAN).

data.clinical_result_summary: PFS2 remained superior with zanubrutinib despite broad use of novel subsequent therapies, including crossover, in bendamustine-rituximab patients. BCL2 inhibitor-based salvage after initial zanubrutinib achieved high PFS rates at almost 3 years of follow-up, supporting that initial zanubrutinib provides durable benefit while preserving sensitivity to effective subsequent therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-naïve CLL/SLL whose tumor did not exhibit del[17p]
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Subsequent therapies and time to second progression-free survival events (PFS2) in treatment-naive chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (TN CLL/SLL) previously treated with zanubrutinib (zanu) or bendamustine-rituximab (BR) in SEQUOIA.

data.clinical_result_summary: The trial achieved its positive primary endpoint, showing meaningful efficacy of dalpiciclib plus nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors in estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms. No new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer, uterine endometrioid carcinoma, or uterine sarcoma, having received a median of one prior therapy for advanced disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy of dalpiciclib and nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors (NSAIs) in estrogen receptor–positive (ER+) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: Gabapentinoid exposure at initiation and/or during neurotoxic chemotherapy was associated with higher rates of documented chemotherapy-associated peripheral neuropathy, particularly among taxane-treated patients. Secondary analyses also showed higher neuropathy rates among gabapentinoid-exposed patients. Because the timing of gabapentinoid initiation relative to neuropathy onset cannot be determined, causal inference is limited, and prospective studies are needed to assess preventive or disease-modifying effects.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults receiving neurotoxic chemotherapy with paclitaxel, docetaxel, oxaliplatin, cisplatin, or vincristine between July 2025 and January 2026 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association between gabapentinoid exposure and chemotherapy-associated peripheral neuropathy among adults starting new neurotoxic chemotherapy in a multi-hospital health system.

data.clinical_result_summary: The selection of CM9LA in real-world practice is influenced by patient fitness, disease burden, practical considerations, and clinician decision-making. Survey responses aligned with observed practice and outcomes, supporting individualized treatment decisions.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with AGA-negative advanced non-small cell lung cancer treated with first-line CM9LA at a tertiary care centre in Canada between May 2020 and July 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Factors influencing the selection of CheckMate-9LA (nivolumab, ipilimumab, and chemotherapy) regimen in AGA-negative advanced NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: SPH4336 plus endocrine therapy demonstrated clinically meaningful intracranial antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile in HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with brain metastases. These findings warrant further investigation in randomized studies for this patient population with high unmet medical need.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with brain metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of SPH4336 plus endocrine therapy in HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with brain metastases: A multicenter, single-arm, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Abemaciclib-based CDK4/6 inhibitor rechallenge was associated with improved survival compared with endocrine therapy monotherapy following progression on prior palbociclib or ribociclib. Abemaciclib maintained a relative survival benefit among patients with poor performance status, supporting its potential utility including in patients with reduced performance status.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer who received second-line or later treatment with either abemaciclib with or without endocrine therapy or endocrine therapy monotherapy during 2020-2025, following documented progression on first-line palbociclib- or ribociclib-based therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of CDK4/6 inhibitor re-treatment in HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study reported global characteristics of the systemic immune response induced by multimodal thermal therapy combined with preoperative chemoimmunotherapy in early-stage HER2-negative breast cancer. These findings provide an opportunity to identify potential targets to improve the efficacy of combined chemoimmunotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Twelve patients with early-stage HER2-negative breast cancer were recruited to preoperatively receive multimodal thermal therapy followed by chemoimmunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Landscape of peripheral immune response induced by multimodal thermal therapy combined with chemoimmunotherapy in patients with early-stage HER2-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, no significant differences in overall survival, progression-free survival, or immune-related adverse events were observed between atezolizumab- and durvalumab-based first-line therapy. The findings support clinical equivalence between the regimens and suggest that treatment selection may be guided by institutional preference, access, or patient-specific factors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer who received at least 1 cycle of first-line platinum-etoposide with atezolizumab or durvalumab at the University of Vermont Medical Center and affiliate community centers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of atezolizumab versus durvalumab in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients receiving talquetamab had higher odds of developing cytokine release syndrome but also showed better overall survival than patients receiving teclistamab, even after matching covariates including CAR-T receipt. Further studies are needed to determine whether pharmacodynamic differences between BCMA- and GPRC5D-directed bispecific T-cell engagers explain these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma who had received either teclistamab or talquetamab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of talquetamab vs teclistamab in relapsed refractory multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant nivolumab and ipilimumab before surgery and adjuvant nivolumab in localized MSI/dMMR oeso-gastric adenocarcinoma achieved a high curative rate. The findings support further investigation of a watch-and-wait approach in patients with clinical complete response after immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: localized MSI/dMMR oeso-gastric adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant nivolumab plus ipilimumab and adjuvant nivolumab in patients with localized microsatellite instability-high (MSI)/mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) oeso-gastric adenocarcinoma: Long-term follow-up of the GERCOR NEONIPIGA phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: BVRd had high response rates across all cohorts, highlighting the promising efficacy of the regimen. Regimens with higher belamaf induction median dose intensity had the deepest responses, while lower induction median dose intensity was associated with milder ophthalmic exam findings. Higher induction dose intensity may achieve deeper responses, and lower maintenance dose intensity using longer schedules may improve tolerability, patient-reported outcomes, and maintain responses.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Transplant-Ineligible Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DREAMM-9 final analysis: Belantamab mafodotin (belamaf), bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone (BVRd) for transplant-ineligible (TI) newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM).

data.clinical_result_summary: The trial achieved its positive primary endpoint, showing meaningful efficacy of dalpiciclib plus nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors in estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms. No new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with estrogen receptor-positive recurrent/metastatic ovarian cancer, uterine endometrioid carcinoma, or uterine sarcoma, having received a median of one prior therapy for advanced disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy of dalpiciclib and nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors (NSAIs) in estrogen receptor–positive (ER+) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) ovarian cancer and uterine neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: FAPI PET/CT-guided radiotherapy combined with second-line systemic treatment and cadonilimab significantly improved ORR in patients with peritoneal metastasis from colorectal cancer compared with standard second-line treatment alone. The regimen had manageable toxicity profiles and represents a promising therapeutic strategy for this challenging patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with peritoneal metastasis from colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective randomized controlled trial of FAPI PET/CT-guided radiotherapy combined with second-line standard systemic treatment and cadonilimab versus second-line standard systemic treatment alone in patients with peritoneal metastasis from colorectal cancer (TORCH-PM01).

data.clinical_result_summary: The recommended Phase II dose of single-agent CCI-001 was 6.75 mg/m2. CCI-001 was well tolerated at all dose levels tested, with adverse events typical for this drug class, and early safety and response data suggest a potential role for CCI-001 in combination with other anticancer drugs.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic solid tumours
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PMH-001: A first-in-human phase I study of the novel microtubule disruptor CCI-001 in patients with advanced cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cetuximab rechallenge showed promising clinical activity with acceptable toxicity in patients with RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer. These findings support further investigation of rechallenge strategies and biomarker-guided approaches to optimize outcomes in advanced colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with microsatellite-stable, RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer who had initially responded to cetuximab-based therapy but subsequently progressed on a cetuximab-free regimen, with conclusions referring to RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of cetuximab-irinotecan rechallenge versus regorafenib in RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Addition of cabozantinib to avelumab did not improve overall survival or progression-free survival compared with avelumab alone in this underpowered, prematurely closed phase III trial. Safety was consistent with known profiles.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced/metastatic urothelial cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: response to first-line platinum-based chemotherapy (complete response vs partial response vs stable disease) and visceral metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: MAIN-CAV: Phase III randomized trial of maintenance cabozantinib and avelumab versus avelumab after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy (PBC) in patients (pts) with locally advanced/metastatic urothelial cancer (la/mUC; Alliance A032001).

data.clinical_result_summary: STRIDE plus lenvatinib and TACE significantly improved progression-free survival compared with TACE in participants with unresectable embolization-eligible hepatocellular carcinoma. At interim analysis, a positive overall survival trend was observed with STRIDE with or without lenvatinib plus TACE versus TACE, and adverse events were aligned with known safety profiles of the individual therapies. These results support STRIDE with or without lenvatinib plus TACE as a potential new treatment option in unresectable embolization-eligible hepatocellular carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable HCC eligible for embolization
clinical_result_layer_factor: region, any prior palliative embolization, and baseline tumor burden by the Up-To-Seven criteria
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety results from EMERALD-3: A phase 3, randomized study of tremelimumab plus durvalumab with or without lenvatinib combined with transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) in participants (pts) with unresectable embolization-eligible hepatocellular carcinoma (eeHCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In older adults with pancreatic cancer, chemotherapy was associated with significantly worse survival and substantially higher treatment-related morbidity and healthcare utilization. These findings highlight the need for careful patient selection and shared decision-making when considering chemotherapy in this vulnerable population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged ≥70 years with a diagnosis of pancreatic cancer were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of survival after chemotherapy vs no chemotherapy in elderly patients with pancreatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Q-1802 plus XELOX showed manageable safety and promising antitumor activity as first-line therapy for CLDN18.2-positive/HER2-negative advanced gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer. These results support a phase III trial using Q-1802 10 mg/kg as the recommended dose.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with CLDN18.2-positive advanced gastric cancer/gastroesophageal junction cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/II trial of anti-CLDN18.2/PD-L1 recombinant humanized bispecific antibody Q-1802 plus XELOX in treatment-naive CLDN18.2-positive advanced GC/GEJ.

data.clinical_result_summary: This single-institution real-world retrospective review evaluated the efficacy and safety of 177-Lu PSMA-617 in metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer. Chemotherapy-naive patients had a longer progression-free survival, while overall survival was not reached in either chemotherapy-naive or chemotherapy-exposed subgroup.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively reviewed patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer who had received 177-Lu PSMA-617 from 2022 to 2025 at a single institution.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy and safety of 177Lu-PSMA-617 in metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC): Single-institution, real-world data.

data.clinical_result_summary: The addition of nimotuzumab to analgesics and concurrent chemoradiotherapy showed a promising survival profile and tolerable toxicity in patients with advanced head and neck cancer. Nimotuzumab was also associated with cancer pain alleviation.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with clinical stage III-IVb head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Survival and pain treatment de-escalation of concurrent chemoradiotherapy combined with nimotuzumab and analgesics for patients with advanced head and neck cancer: A randomized, controlled clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In a propensity-matched real-world cohort, levetiracetam use in combination with temozolamide was not associated with improved overall survival and was linked to a higher rate of severe cytopenia compared with temozolamide alone. These findings add real-world evidence to the existing literature and support the need for additional prospective studies to clarify the impact of levetiracetam on glioblastoma multiforme outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated adult patients with glioblastoma multiforme.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparative outcomes of including levetiracetam with standard treatment in glioblastoma multiforme: A multi-center retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with hematologic malignancies, dapsone was associated with a significantly lower risk of Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and reduced all-cause mortality compared with atovaquone. However, these benefits were accompanied by higher rates of hematologic, gastrointestinal, and hepatic adverse events, supporting individualized selection of PJP prophylaxis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with hematologic malignancies or multiple myeloma who received either dapsone or atovaquone for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia prophylaxis, excluding patients with HIV.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The trade-offs between efficacy and toxicity: Real-world outcomes of dapsone vs atovaquone for pneumocystis prophylaxis in hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: <sup>225</sup>Ac-PSMA-617 demonstrated an acceptable safety profile and promising anti-tumor activity up to 10 MBq in patients with mCRPC regardless of prior <sup>177</sup>Lu-PSMA RLT. Two phase 3 trials, AcTFirst and PSMAcTION, are currently recruiting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer - A: Prior ChT + ARPI but no prior 177Lu-PSMA RLT
men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer - B: no prior ChT, ARPI, or 177Lu-PSMA RLT (ChT/ARPI-naive)
men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer - C: prior 177Lu-PSMA RLT
data.clinical_result_paper_title: AcTION: Phase 1 study of [225Ac]Ac-PSMA-617 (225Ac-PSMA-617) in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) with or without prior [177Lu]Lu-PSMA (177Lu-PSMA) radioligand therapy (RLT).

data.clinical_result_summary: The results inform clinical decision-making for patients receiving first-line adebrelimab plus capecitabine and oxaliplatin for advanced gastric cancer. The regimen showed objective responses in both Phase Ib and Phase II cohorts, with no dose-limiting toxicities, no immune-related adverse events, and no treatment-related deaths reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib/II clinical study of adebrelimab in combination with capecitabine and oxaliplatin for previously untreated patients with advanced or metastatic gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world retrospective study demonstrated that first-line ribociclib plus aromatase inhibitor, compared with aromatase inhibitor alone, led to longer rwPFS2 and rwCFS in African American patients and patients with low socioeconomic status with HR+/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. These findings support first-line ribociclib plus aromatase inhibitor as an effective treatment choice for these patient groups and highlight the importance of access to optimal treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included US women with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer who began first-line ribociclib plus aromatase inhibitor or aromatase inhibitor monotherapy, including African American patients and patients with low socioeconomic status index defined by area-level SES in the lowest two quintiles.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: (RW) post-progression outcomes following first-line (1L) ribociclib (RIB) + aromatase inhibitor (AI) versus AI alone in African American and low socio-economic status (SES) patients with hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HR+/HER2–) metastatic breast cancer (MBC) in US.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, GLP1 use was most frequently observed among younger patients with obesity and was commonly prescribed after cancer diagnosis, with semaglutide accounting for the majority of prescriptions. GLP1 use was associated with improved overall survival compared with nonuse, supporting the need for future studies using robust causal inference approaches.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included GLP1 users and nonusers diagnosed with breast, prostate, lung, hepatocellular, or renal cancer between January 2021 and October 2024, with follow-up through October 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: GLP-1 receptor agonist utilization and survival outcomes in a large U.S. community oncology cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, adding consolidative durvalumab after concurrent chemoradiation significantly improved progression-free survival and showed a trend toward higher overall survival in patients with limited-stage small cell lung cancer. Carboplatin and once-daily radiotherapy for 60-66 Gy were commonly used, while prophylactic cranial irradiation was administered in a minority of patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients diagnosed with limited-stage small cell lung cancer who received concurrent chemoradiation from January 1 to December 31, 2024 in the Indiana University Health System.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A new era of immunotherapy: Comparison of real-world outcomes in limited-stage small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Romiplostim N01 showed promising efficacy for cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gastrointestinal cancers, with most patients achieving rapid platelet recovery and no need for transfusions. Its manageable safety profile suggests that it may be a viable supportive care option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study aims to enroll adult patients with gastrointestinal cancers who developed cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia following anticancer therapy, with platelet count <50×10^9/L.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective, single-arm, exploratory study on the efficacy and safety of romiplostim N01 for cancer treatment–induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: SSGJ-707 plus chemotherapy demonstrated promising efficacy with a manageable safety profile in treatment-naive patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer. These findings support further investigation of SSGJ-707 in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with first-line advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study evaluating SSGJ-707 (PF-08634404), a PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody, + chemotherapy (chemo) in patients (pts) with first-line (1L) advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer (EC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Romiplostim N01 showed promising efficacy for cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gastrointestinal cancers, with most patients achieving rapid platelet recovery and no need for transfusions. Its manageable safety profile suggests that it may be a viable supportive care option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study aims to enroll adult patients with gastrointestinal cancers who developed cancer treatment-induced thrombocytopenia following anticancer therapy, with platelet count <50×10^9/L.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective, single-arm, exploratory study on the efficacy and safety of romiplostim N01 for cancer treatment–induced thrombocytopenia in patients with gastrointestinal cancers.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched real-world analysis, tarlatamab demonstrated a significant and durable overall survival advantage over lurbinectedin in patients receiving second-line therapy. Although tarlatamab was associated with higher rates of expected immune-mediated toxicities, including cytokine release syndrome and ICANS, these events were predominantly low grade, supporting a favorable benefit-risk profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with lung cancer who had received platinum-based chemotherapy or immunotherapy as first-line treatment and subsequently initiated tarlatamab or lurbinectedin as second-line therapy between January 1, 2020 and November 1, 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative real-world outcomes of tarlatamab and lurbinectedin in relapsed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pomalidomide plus nivolumab is a chemotherapy-sparing regimen with acceptable safety in advanced virus-associated cancers and promising activity in Kaposi sarcoma. Based on these results, an expanded Kaposi sarcoma cohort will be added to the trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: participants (pts) with advanced virus-associated malignancies (EBV, KSHV, HPV)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I study of pomalidomide and nivolumab (Pom/Nivo) in patients with virus-associated malignancies with and without HIV.
