data.clinical_result_summary: HRS-1167 combined with abiraterone acetate and prednisone showed promising efficacy in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, especially those with BRCA mutations. The combination was well tolerated, with no new safety signals identified.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Chinese adult metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients with homologous recombination repair mutations who were previously treated.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的严重不良事件
治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HRS-1167 (M9466), a PARP1 inhibitor, combined with abiraterone acetate and prednisone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: A phase 1b/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis of stage IV EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer treated with osimertinib, pleural effusion was associated with persistently higher mortality and hospitalization rates at 1, 3, and 5 years. Pleural effusion appears to identify a high-risk clinical phenotype despite targeted therapy and may warrant closer monitoring and intensified supportive and oncologic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with stage IV EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer treated with osimertinib; patients with non-malignant causes of pleural effusion, end-stage renal disease, heart failure, or prior exposure to other EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors were excluded. Patients were stratified by presence versus absence of pleural effusion.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of pleural effusion on mortality and hospitalization in stage IV EGFR-mutated NSCLC treated with osimertinib: A real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: OP-3136 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and favorable pharmacokinetics, both as monotherapy and in combination with fulvestrant. Preliminary evidence of antitumor activity was observed in ER+ HER2− advanced breast cancer and metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer in heavily pretreated patients. Dose escalation and enrollment in combination with fulvestrant or palazestrant are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, first-in-human study of OP-3136, a novel oral selective KAT6A/B inhibitor, as monotherapy in advanced solid tumors and in combination with endocrine therapy in ER+, HER2− advanced breast cancer (ABC): Preliminary results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lunbotinib demonstrated robust efficacy in patients with advanced RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer, with high objective response rates and prolonged progression-free survival in both pre-treated and treatment-naïve populations, as well as notable intracranial activity. The safety profile was manageable, with no new signals identified, supporting lunbotinib as a potential therapeutic option for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment naïve NSCLC
pts with systemic pretreated NSCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of lunbotinib (A400/EP0031), a next-generation selective RET inhibitor (SRI), from a pivotal phase II study in patients with advanced RET fusion–positive non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Gabapentinoid exposure at initiation and/or during neurotoxic chemotherapy was associated with higher rates of documented chemotherapy-associated peripheral neuropathy, particularly among taxane-treated patients. Secondary analyses also showed higher neuropathy rates among gabapentinoid-exposed patients. Because the timing of gabapentinoid initiation relative to neuropathy onset cannot be determined, causal inference is limited, and prospective studies are needed to assess preventive or disease-modifying effects.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults receiving neurotoxic chemotherapy with paclitaxel, docetaxel, oxaliplatin, cisplatin, or vincristine between July 2025 and January 2026 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association between gabapentinoid exposure and chemotherapy-associated peripheral neuropathy among adults starting new neurotoxic chemotherapy in a multi-hospital health system.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with hematologic malignancies, dapsone was associated with a significantly lower risk of Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and reduced all-cause mortality compared with atovaquone. However, these benefits were accompanied by higher rates of hematologic, gastrointestinal, and hepatic adverse events, supporting individualized selection of PJP prophylaxis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with hematologic malignancies or multiple myeloma who received either dapsone or atovaquone for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia prophylaxis, excluding patients with HIV.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The trade-offs between efficacy and toxicity: Real-world outcomes of dapsone vs atovaquone for pneumocystis prophylaxis in hematologic malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: Clinical experience at a single academic center suggests that zongertinib is safe and effective in a diverse, urban U.S. population with previously treated HER2-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer, including patients previously treated with a HER2-targeted agent. Subsequent treatment with another HER2-targeted agent after either trastuzumab deruxtecan or zongertinib still yielded objective responses, and patients with HER2 non-YVMA mutations may respond to zongertinib with greater efficacy than those with a YVMA mutation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included all patients with next generation sequencing-confirmed HER2-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer who were previously treated and received zongertinib from January 1, 2022 through January 23, 2026.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zongertinib in previously treated advanced HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer: A single-center study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study met its primary endpoints. Radium-223 plus nivolumab appears to be safe, and ctDNA variant allele frequency was decreased in 60% of patients tested. Survival outcomes and clinical correlation data with VAF will be presented at the meeting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with symptomatic bone-metastatic metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer without visceral metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rad2Nivo: Phase IB study of radium-223 (Rad) with nivolumab (Nivo) in patients (pts) with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: BC3195 demonstrated a manageable safety profile, favorable pharmacokinetic characteristics, and preliminary antitumor activity across several heavily pretreated advanced solid malignancies. Enrollment in the US and China studies is converging on the 2.1 mg/kg dose level based on shared safety data.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid malignancies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BC3195, a novel ADC targeting cadherin-3 (CDH3): Preliminary results of a phase I study in patients with advanced solid malignancies (study BC3195-102).

data.clinical_result_summary: The study met its primary endpoints. Radium-223 plus nivolumab appears to be safe, and ctDNA variant allele frequency was decreased in 60% of patients tested. Survival outcomes and clinical correlation data with VAF will be presented at the meeting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with symptomatic bone-metastatic metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer without visceral metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rad2Nivo: Phase IB study of radium-223 (Rad) with nivolumab (Nivo) in patients (pts) with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Single-agent FASN inhibition with TVB-2640 in heavily pretreated KRAS-mutant non-small cell lung cancer did not meet the primary endpoint of response. The trial highlights a novel therapy targeting energy metabolism in lung cancer, and future combination regimens with KRAS inhibitors may be considered.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously treated, advanced KRAS mutant non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 multi-center pharmacodynamic study of the fatty acid synthase (FASN) inhibitor TVB-2640 in advanced KRAS-mutant non–small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Camrelizumab combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma from non-endemic areas. These findings warrant validation in prospective randomized trials, with limitations including the retrospective design and small sample size.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with stage III-IVa locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma from Central China, a non-endemic region.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Camrelizumab combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy versus chemoradiotherapy alone in locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma: A retrospective cohort study in central China.

data.clinical_result_summary: Consistent with contemporary approvals, trastuzumab emtansine was largely used for HER2-positive breast cancer in the adjuvant setting. Trastuzumab deruxtecan use became more frequent and nearly equal to trastuzumab emtansine for HER2-positive breast cancer in first metastatic regimen and dominated in later regimens, while trastuzumab deruxtecan was dominant for HR+/HER2− breast cancer across metastatic regimens. Survival outcomes among patients receiving at least two metastatic regimens showed meaningful differences by subtype and established contemporary real-world overall survival reference points for clinical practice and future real-world comparative effectiveness studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with breast cancer in a US community setting who initiated a first antibody-drug conjugate between January 2020 and August 2024 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world (rw) study of the treatment journey following antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) initiation and overall survival (OS) in breast cancer (BC) in a US community setting.

data.clinical_result_summary: CCRT with the ELF regimen conferred relapse-free survival and overall survival benefit in locally advanced gastric cancer patients after gastrectomy plus D2 lymph node dissection. However, CCRT was not superior to TS-1 in terms of survival outcome or loco-regional control.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with gastric cancer, specifically locally advanced gastric cancer, who underwent gastrectomy plus D2 lymph node dissection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative analysis of adjuvant chemoradiotherapy vs. tegafur/gimeracil/oteracil monotherapy vs. observation alone in gastric cancer patients after gastrectomy plus D2 lymph node dissection: A single-center 15-year retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: T-DXd showed antitumor activity in patients from China with metastatic HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer with and without baseline CNS metastases, and promising CNS activity was observed. No new safety signals were reported. The results support T-DXd use in pretreated patients with HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer, including those with CNS metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients from China with metastatic HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer with disease progression on or after at least 1 prior anticancer therapy, including patients with pretreated asymptomatic or neurologically stable CNS metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in patients (pts) with HER2-mutant (HER2m) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and central nervous system (CNS) metastases (mets): Results from DESTINY-Lung05 (DL-05).

data.clinical_result_summary: This retrospective observational evaluation highlights brentuximab vedotin-associated alopecia as an under-recognised toxicity with prolonged psychosocial consequences. Nearly 40% of patients reported persistent alopecia more than two years after treatment, underscoring the need for further research into mechanisms, prevention, counselling, and supportive interventions.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients diagnosed with Hodgkin’s Lymphoma, aged 16 years or above, who received Brentuximab Vedotin along with AVD (Adriamycin, Vinblastine, Dacarbazine) and had a minimum follow-up of 12 months after completion of chemotherapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term hair loss associated with brentuximab vedotin–containing chemotherapy and its psychosocial impact: A retrospective observational study conducted at the Royal Marsden Hospital.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of patients with breast cancer, denosumab and zoledronic acid showed similar time-to-event outcomes for hypercalcemia, severe hypercalcemia, pathological fracture, and bone pain. Zoledronic acid was associated with a significantly lower risk of hypocalcemia, suggesting important differences in toxicity profiles that may inform individualized bone-modifying therapy selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with breast cancer, excluding those with underlying osteoporosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Denosumab versus zoledronic acid in patients with breast cancer: A propensity-matched real-world time-to-event analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Delayed serplulimab combined with nab-paclitaxel and epirubicin showed promising anti-tumour activity and manageable safety in patients with HR+/HER2− breast cancer. The pCR rate was higher in PD-L1 expression tumor, supporting further evaluation of this regimen in randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated early HR+/HER2- breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Delayed serplulimab combined with nab-paclitaxel and epirubicin in high-risk, early HR+/HER2− breast cancer (HELEN-B 018): A multicenter, single-arm, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, adding bevacizumab to FOLFOX was not associated with improved survival in patients with small bowel adenocarcinoma or ampullary adenocarcinoma. The combination was associated with higher healthcare utilization, and prospective disease-specific studies are needed to define its role in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with small bowel adenocarcinoma or ampullary adenocarcinoma treated with FOLFOX with or without bevacizumab were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of FOLFOX with or without bevacizumab in small bowel and ampullary adenocarcinoma: A propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Definitive bladder-pelvic radiation therapy after enfortumab vedotin-pembrolizumab was well tolerated and showed promising disease control, particularly in patients treated for residual non-progressing disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma receiving definitive bladder or pelvic radiation therapy after enfortumab vedotin-pembrolizumab, including those with residual or oligoprogressive bladder disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Definitive bladder/pelvic radiation after enfortumab vedotin–pembrolizumab for advanced urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cla/Cy demonstrated comparable efficacy to Flu/Cy with lower toxicity, including fewer late infections and severe cytopenias. These findings suggest Cla/Cy may represent a safer alternative lymphodepletion strategy, although prospective studies are warranted to validate these observations.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia who received CD19-directed CAR-T therapy between January 2018 and April 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cladribine/cyclophosphamide lymphodepletion efficacy and toxicity in CD19 CAR-T therapy for B-ALL.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world study demonstrates that first-line third-generation EGFR-TKI monotherapy is associated with significantly improved progression-free survival compared with first-/second-generation EGFR-TKI combination therapy in EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. No overall survival difference was observed, possibly due to subsequent later-line use of third-generation TKIs in the combination group. The findings support third-generation EGFR-TKIs as the recommended first-line treatment while indicating that first-/second-generation EGFR-TKI combination therapy remains a viable real-world alternative.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Previously untreated patients in China with stage III/IV EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative effectiveness of first-/second-generation EGFR-TKI combination therapy versus third-generation EGFR-TKI monotherapy in previously untreated advanced EGFR-mutant NSCLC: A real-world, retrospective study in China.

data.clinical_result_summary: The induction-to-maintenance approach demonstrated meaningful activity and feasibility in patients with isolated peritoneal metastatic colorectal cancer, even within a resource-limited setting. Continued analyses will help determine which patients benefit most.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients in Vietnam with isolated peritoneal metastatic colorectal cancer treated between 2019 and 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line induction oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy followed by maintenance in isolated peritoneal metastatic colorectal cancer: Real-world outcomes from Vietnam.

data.clinical_result_summary: Becotarug plus osimertinib demonstrated significantly greater objective response and longer progression-free survival than the matched real-world osimertinib cohort. These findings support the efficacy and tolerability of the combination in platinum-refractory, EGFR exon 20 insertion-positive NSCLC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring EGFR ex20ins mutations, who had failed prior platinum-based chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparing becotarug plus osimertinib with a real-world osimertinib therapy cohort in platinum-refractory, advanced non–small cell lung cancer with EGFR exon 20 insertion.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 中位无颅内进展生存期
data.clinical_result_summary: High-dose furmonertinib demonstrated encouraging intracranial efficacy in previously EGFR-TKI-treated patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and brain metastases. The treatment showed a manageable safety profile and supports further investigation in randomized studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: previously EGFR-TKI-treated patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and brain metastases.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位无颅内进展生存期
data.clinical_result_paper_title: High-dose furmonertinib in EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC with brain metastases after EGFR-TKI resistance: The iFORCE phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world cohort of patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, tarlatamab continued to demonstrate anticancer activity with similar overall response rate and 6-month progression-free survival compared with existing DeLLphi-304 data. Dysgeusia appeared to be a marker of treatment response and was associated with improved progression-free and overall survival. Cytokine release syndrome and immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome were associated with several baseline patient and disease characteristics, and validated predictive models are still needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ES-SCLC receiving tarla at three NCI-designated comprehensive cancer centers.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Predictive markers of response and toxicity to tarlatamab in patients with extensive stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC): A multi-institutional real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Consistent with the primary analysis, pazopanib generally showed favorable PFS, OS, and DCR among the three agents. Based on these results, pazopanib was identified as the most appropriate candidate to be compared with gemcitabine plus docetaxel in a phase III trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable or metastatic STS refractory to doxorubicin-based first-line chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of a randomized phase II trial of second-line treatment for advanced soft tissue sarcoma comparing trabectedin, eribulin, and pazopanib: 2ND-STEP study, JCOG1802.

data.clinical_result_summary: Final results from this phase 2 trial in non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma confirm efficacy and acceptable safety of cabozantinib plus nivolumab in patients with metastatic papillary, unclassified, or translocation-associated renal cell carcinoma, with a particularly high ORR in FH-deficient RCC. These results justify cabozantinib plus nivolumab as a standard first-line treatment option for these patients. In contrast, objective responses were not observed in chromophobe RCC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: papillary, unclassified, or translocation associated RCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of a phase 2 trial of cabozantinib plus nivolumab (CaboNivo) in patients with non–clear cell renal cell carcinoma (nccRCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of patients with breast cancer, denosumab and zoledronic acid showed similar time-to-event outcomes for hypercalcemia, severe hypercalcemia, pathological fracture, and bone pain. Zoledronic acid was associated with a significantly lower risk of hypocalcemia, suggesting important differences in toxicity profiles that may inform individualized bone-modifying therapy selection.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with breast cancer, excluding those with underlying osteoporosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Denosumab versus zoledronic acid in patients with breast cancer: A propensity-matched real-world time-to-event analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant donafenib-based therapy showed promise for reducing recurrence in patients with high-risk hepatocellular carcinoma after radical resection. The treatment was associated with an acceptable safety profile in this retrospective study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with hepatocellular carcinoma who had undergone surgical resection and had high-risk recurrence factors, defined as one or more of multiple tumors, tumor diameter greater than 5 cm, satellite nodules, microvascular invasion, Edmondson-Steiner grade III–IV, or a pathological margin less than 1 cm.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Postoperative adjuvant donafenib-based therapy for patients with hepatocellular carcinoma at high risk of recurrence.

data.clinical_result_summary: The QoL benefits of shorter chemotherapy appeared more marked in patients receiving cisplatin than carboplatin. The efficacy results for 3 cycles of cisplatin were described as impressive, but the study was not powered for non-inferiority.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients receiving first-line treatment for metastatic urothelial cancer were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparison of cisplatin/gemcitabine or carboplatin/gemcitabine on efficacy, toxicity, and quality of life from the randomized DISCUS trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Emiltatug ledadotin appeared to demonstrate favorable tolerability and promising antitumor activity in patients with aggressive adenoid cystic carcinoma who have no available treatments and a poor prognosis. Further clinical development is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult pts with select advanced or metastatic solid tumors, including aggressive ACC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Emiltatug ledadotin (Emi-Le), a B7-H4–directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with aggressive adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC): Phase 1 interim analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world analysis of Tarlatamab demonstrated slightly worse clinical outcomes with respect to PFS and OS, although tolerability was similar compared with the clinical trial. Transformed and non-lung primary small cell carcinoma patients showed promising outcomes with Tarlatamab, supporting further studies in this unique patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients who received at least one dose of Tarlatamab at the institution between June 2024 and January 2026 were included and were identified as having small cell lung cancer or transformed and non-lung primary small cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of tarlatamab across small cell carcinoma subtypes, including transformed and non-lung primary.

data.clinical_result_summary: Despite not meeting the prespecified first-stage endpoint and without radiotherapy dose reduction, BEN plus cCRT showed potential efficacy as neoadjuvant therapy for resectable ESCC, with an encouraging pCR rate, MPR rate, and manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC)
clinical_result_layer_factor: cT stage (T1-2 vs T3)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Update results of benmelstobart (BEN) combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy (cCRT) versus cCRT alone as neoadjuvant therapy for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC): A multicentre, randomised study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral ruxotemitide plus pembrolizumab demonstrated durable antitumor activity and manageable safety in heavily pretreated patients with advanced or metastatic melanoma or triple-negative breast cancer with injectable disease. The findings support further clinical evaluation of this combination in melanoma and triple-negative breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic melanoma or TNBC with injectable disease
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of intratumoral (IT) ruxotemitide (LTX 315) in combination with pembrolizumab in patients with unresectable advanced melanoma or triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, ivonescimab plus chemotherapy demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy and a manageable safety profile when administered both immediately after EGFR-TKI resistance and following multiple prior lines of therapy. These findings support its use across diverse treatment sequences in patients with EGFR-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with EGFR-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer who received ivonescimab plus chemotherapy following progression on or resistance to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of bispecific antibody ivonescimab-based regimens in EGFR-TKI–resistant advanced NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: FU/LV/nal-IRI was reported to be an effective second-line regimen for advanced biliary tract cancer in US patients, meeting the primary 4-month progression-free survival endpoint. However, early toxicity was significant, with 21% of patients discontinuing the study due to adverse events before 4 months.
clinical_result_indication_detail: US patients with second-line advanced biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final results of a phase II study of fluorouracil (FU), leucovorin (LV), and nanoliposomal irinotecan (nal-IRI) in previously treated biliary tract cancer (NAPOLI-2).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, tarlatamab demonstrated meaningful clinical activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with small cell lung cancer and extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma. The observed efficacy and toxicity rates were consistent with those reported in the pivotal DeLLphi-301 trial, supporting its use outside of a clinical trial setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included all adult patients with advanced small cell lung cancer or extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma who received at least one dose of tarlatamab at the center between May 16, 2024, and September 30, 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of tarlatamab in small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma (EPSCC): A single-center experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of benmelstobart, anlotinib, and SOX demonstrated promising efficacy with a manageable safety profile as first-line therapy for advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma with low PD-L1 expression. These findings warrant validation in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma with low PD-L1 expression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of benmelstobart plus anlotinib combined with SOX in the first-line treatment of advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction (G/GEJ) adenocarcinoma with low PD-L1 expression: A single-arm, multicenter phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched analysis of hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer, ribociclib was associated with significantly lower all-cause mortality compared with palbociclib. Rates of hospitalization, emergency department visits, prolonged QT, and cardiac arrest were not significantly different. These real-world findings support clinically meaningful heterogeneity across CDK4/6 inhibitors and highlight the importance of individualized agent selection, balancing survival, hepatic toxicity, and healthcare utilization.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer treated with ribociclib or palbociclib were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparative safety and outcomes of ribociclib versus palbociclib in hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer: A propensity score–matched sensitivity analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: BelaDRd demonstrated robust clinical activity with rapid and deep responses in transplant-ineligible newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. Low rates of grade 3 or higher ocular adverse events were observed, and these events resolved quickly. The results support further evaluation of this quadruplet in a phase 3 study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: transplant-ineligible (TI) newly diagnosed multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Belantamab mafodotin with daratumumab, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone in transplant-ineligible, newly diagnosed multiple myeloma patients: Phase 1/2 BelaDRd study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched analysis of hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer, ribociclib was associated with significantly lower all-cause mortality compared with palbociclib. Rates of hospitalization, emergency department visits, prolonged QT, and cardiac arrest were not significantly different. These real-world findings support clinically meaningful heterogeneity across CDK4/6 inhibitors and highlight the importance of individualized agent selection, balancing survival, hepatic toxicity, and healthcare utilization.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer treated with ribociclib or palbociclib were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparative safety and outcomes of ribociclib versus palbociclib in hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer: A propensity score–matched sensitivity analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large multicenter real-world cohort of patients with colorectal cancer and type 2 diabetes, GLP-1 receptor agonist use was associated with significantly improved short- and long-term overall survival. These findings support further investigation of GLP-1 RAs as potential prognostic modifiers in colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with incident colorectal cancer and type 2 diabetes mellitus were identified.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of GLP-1 receptor agonist use with overall survival in patients with colorectal cancer and type 2 diabetes: A multicenter real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first-in-class trial demonstrates that intralesional PD-1 blockade safely reprograms premalignant tissue immunity without systemic toxicity, establishing lesion-directed checkpoint inhibition as a viable cancer interception strategy. The findings support broader applicability to accessible epithelial precancers and have established the foundation for a randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed oral epithelial dysplasia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intralesional PD-1 blockade for oral cancer prevention: First-in-class phase 1 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Molecular-based recommended therapy identified by comprehensive genomic profiling in the first-line setting improved access to targeted therapies and was associated with superior survival outcomes compared with standard of care in advanced solid tumors. The data suggest that comprehensive genomic profiling in Japan should be available before initiation of standard of care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study registered chemotherapy-naïve adult patients in Japan with advanced solid tumors, including gastrointestinal, lung, breast, gynecologic cancers and melanoma, and ECOG performance status of 0-1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of first-line comprehensive genomic profiling on survival outcomes for patients with advanced solid tumors who received molecularly-matched therapies: 3-year follow-up of the prospective FIRST-Dx study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Enzalutamide and darolutamide showed comparable safety and oncological outcomes in patients with non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The findings support the use of either agent as an appropriate first androgen receptor signaling inhibitor treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who received enzalutamide or darolutamide as their first androgen receptor signaling inhibitor during treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparison of enzalutamide and darolutamide for non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: A multicenter retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant disitamab vedotin plus carboplatin demonstrated exceptional surgical outcomes, with a 91.6% complete resection rate and complete elimination of neurotoxicity in HER2-expressing advanced ovarian cancer. The regimen induced substantial pathological regression with a favorable safety profile, supporting RC48-carboplatin as a promising neurotoxicity-sparing alternative to standard paclitaxel-based therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed FIGO stage III-IV high-grade serous ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer expressing HER2
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant disitamab vedotin plus carboplatin in HER2-expressing advanced ovarian cancer: A prospective, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intrathecal toripalimab combined with pemetrexed showed a manageable safety profile and promising clinical activity in patients with leptomeningeal metastases from solid tumors. Based on the encouraging interim overall survival observed, further clinical investigation of intrathecal immunotherapy is warranted for patients with leptomeningeal metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with leptomeningeal metastases from solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/II study of concurrent intrathecal toripalimab and pemetrexed (PM) for leptomeningeal metastases (LM) from solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The primary analysis of this Phase III trial confirmed Soxataltinib as a highly effective and well-tolerated therapeutic agent for patients with RET fusion–positive non-small cell lung cancer in the first-line setting. High response rates and durable disease control supported its potential as a best-in-class RET inhibitor. Its adverse event profile was predictable and manageable, supporting feasibility for long-term administration.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced RET fusion–positive non-small cell lung cancer who were previously untreated for advanced disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical efficacy and tolerability of the selective RET inhibitor soxataltinib (SY-5007) in advanced RET fusion–positive non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Primary findings from a confirmatory phase III trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This Phase 1 study demonstrated that treatment of recurrent glioblastoma with fb-PMT was safe and well tolerated, with a predictable pharmacokinetic profile. Two patients remained on therapy beyond 24 months, and future studies are planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent glioblastoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I trial to evaluate the safety and tolerability of fb-PMT in patients with recurrent glioblastoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results showed that the short-term metabolic intervention combining prolonged nightly fasting and metformin was feasible, safe, highly compliant, and inexpensive in operable hormone receptor-positive breast cancer or DCIS. The intervention was associated with favorable antiproliferative and metabolic changes that warrant further investigation in breast cancer prevention and treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Women with hormone receptor-positive operable invasive breast cancer or DCIS.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Time-restricted eating and metformin (TEAM) in invasive breast cancer or DCIS: A randomized, phase IIb, window-of-opportunity presurgical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Dose-adapted trastuzumab deruxtecan demonstrated clinically meaningful activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with HER2-positive and HER2-low metastatic breast cancer in a real-world setting. The shorter median progression-free survival likely reflects reduced dose intensity, limited follow-up, and real-world heterogeneity rather than loss of intrinsic drug activity. These findings support further prospective evaluation of dose-adapted strategies to improve treatment accessibility in resource-limited settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective analysis included patients with HER2-positive or HER2-low metastatic breast cancer treated with dose-adapted trastuzumab deruxtecan across multiple Indian centers, with an evaluable cohort defined as patients receiving at least 2 cycles of therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ADAPT-T-DXd: Multi-institutional real-world study of dose-adapted trastuzumab deruxtecan in HER2-positive and HER2-low metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results indicate that the triple therapy of fruquintinib, sintilimab, and chidamide demonstrates promising response rate, disease control, and a manageable safety profile in patients with refractory microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer. This combination strategy represents a potential therapeutic option for this population, although further follow-up with a larger sample size and longer duration is needed to confirm survival benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with refractory microsatellite stable metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of fruquintinib combined with sintilimab and chidamide in refractory MSS metastatic colorectal cancer: Preliminary efficacy and safety.

data.clinical_result_summary: Topical betamethasone ointment substantially reduced the incidence of severe oral mucositis during cisplatin-based chemoradiotherapy without increasing oral candidiasis. This simple, low-cost, and widely accessible intervention could be rapidly implemented in routine clinical practice to mitigate chemoradiotherapy-induced toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with head and neck cancer receiving chemoradiotherapy with the oral cavity included in the radiation field at six institutions in Japan were enrolled and randomized upon development of grade 1 oral mucositis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multicenter randomized phase II trial of topical betamethasone ointment for preventing severe chemoradiotherapy-induced oral mucositis in head and neck cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Feasibility and safety of resection plus tile-based radiation therapy followed by external beam radiation therapy with concurrent and adjuvant temozolomide were in line with standard of care in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma. Rapid early progression was notably reduced compared with literature, and overall survival was encouraging. These data support a phase 3 randomized trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcomes of a feasibility and safety trial of tile-based radiation therapy with cesium-131 followed by external beam radiation therapy with concurrent and adjuvant temozolomide in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma (NCT05342883).

data.clinical_result_summary: Tecotabart vedotin plus toripalimab, with or without chemotherapy, demonstrated encouraging anti-tumor activity and manageable safety as first-line treatment for CLDN18.2-positive advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer. The doublet showed comparable efficacy to the triplet with enhanced tolerability, supporting further large-scale clinical investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed, previously untreated, unresectable, HER2-negative  gastric, GEJ, or EAC - pooled analysis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of tecotabart vedotin plus toripalimab with or without chemotherapy as first-line treatment for CLDN18.2-positive advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: Phase II study results.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study is the first comparative analysis of two immunotherapy-based total neoadjuvant therapy regimens in locally advanced rectal cancer. Neoadjuvant CAPOX plus PD-1 inhibitor achieved a promising complete response rate in proficient mismatch repair locally advanced rectal cancer, and the complete response rate was further enhanced by adding short-course radiotherapy before immunochemotherapy. Further follow-up is needed to assess long-term efficacy and functional endpoints.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with proficient mismatch repair locally advanced rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immunotherapy-based total neoadjuvant therapy with or without short-course radiotherapy for locally advanced rectal cancer: Preliminary results of TORCH-iTNT.

data.clinical_result_summary: ONO-4578 combined with nivolumab and chemotherapy significantly improved progression-free survival compared with placebo combined with nivolumab and chemotherapy in treatment-naive patients with HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer. No new safety concerns were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated, HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: PD-L1 expression level (CPS < 5 vs CPS≥5), ECOG performance status (0 vs 1), presence of peritoneal metastasis (yes vs no)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ONO-4578 combined with nivolumab (NIVO) and chemotherapy (chemo) as first-line (1L) treatment for patients with HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent (adv/rec) gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer (G/GEJ): A randomized, double-blind, phase 2 trial (ONO-4578-08).

data.clinical_result_summary: Receipt of immunotherapy was associated with a significantly increased risk of pulmonary adverse events, primarily clinically significant pneumonitis. These toxicities were common by 24 months, frequently severe, and often led to irreversible damage and treatment cessation, highlighting the need for vigilant monitoring, early recognition, multidisciplinary management, and prompt intervention.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 5,556 adult cancer patients treated at the Cleveland Clinic between 2010 and 2022, including patients with bladder cancer, endometrial cancer, esophageal/gastric cancer, head and neck cancer, renal cancer, metastatic melanoma, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, and small cell lung cancer across specified stages.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pulmonary immune-related adverse events post-immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI): Real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Enzalutamide and darolutamide showed comparable safety and oncological outcomes in patients with non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The findings support the use of either agent as an appropriate first androgen receptor signaling inhibitor treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients with non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who received enzalutamide or darolutamide as their first androgen receptor signaling inhibitor during treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparison of enzalutamide and darolutamide for non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: A multicenter retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intratumoral ruxotemitide plus pembrolizumab demonstrated durable antitumor activity and manageable safety in heavily pretreated patients with advanced or metastatic melanoma or triple-negative breast cancer with injectable disease. These findings support further clinical evaluation of the combination in melanoma and triple-negative breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage IIIB-stage IVm1b (without liver metastases) metastatic melanoma refractory to prior PD-1/PD-L1 therapy
TNBC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of intratumoral (IT) ruxotemitide (LTX 315) in combination with pembrolizumab in patients with unresectable advanced melanoma or triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Hetrombopag plus caffeic acid tablets demonstrated outstanding therapeutic efficacy in chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia while maintaining a well-tolerated safety profile. This oral regimen may fulfill an unmet clinical need and provide a practical, non-invasive therapeutic option for chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia management.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的血小板减少
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hetrombopag plus caffeic acid tablets for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia in solid tumors: A single-center, open-label, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: A first-in-human, open-label, dose-escalation phase 1 trial of Gamitrinib was initiated in adult patients with advanced solid tumors or lymphoma for whom no standard therapy is available. As of 2026, 18 evaluable patients had been accrued across 5 escalating dose levels with no dose-limiting toxicities, and the study remained open with enrollment ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with advanced solid tumors or lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, first-in-human, open-label, dose-escalation and -expansion study of gamitrinib, a first-in-class, mitochondria-directed inhibitor of the molecular chaperone heat shock protein-90 (Hsp90) in patients with advanced cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, tarlatamab was associated with early-onset CRS and ICANS that were predominantly low-grade, although rare high-grade events occurred. Toxicities were generally manageable with standard supportive measures, supporting the feasibility of tarlatamab in diverse clinical populations when appropriate clinical and oncology pharmacy-driven interventions are available.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer or extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma who received at least 1 dose of tarlatamab between October 2024 and October 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of tarlatamab in small cell lung cancer and extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Phase Ib results demonstrate that OVM-200 is safe and immunogenic, achieving both the primary safety and secondary immunogenicity endpoints. OVM-200 overcomes immune tolerance to survivin and induces durable humoral and cellular immune responses. The observed association between stronger immune responses and best overall response of stable disease supports further clinical evaluation and rational combination strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced NSCLC, ovarian, or prostate cancer who had progressed on standard therapies (Phase Ib)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase Ib evaluation of a recombinant overlapping peptide survivin immunotherapy: Safety, immunogenicity, and immune–clinical associations in advanced solid tumours.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the ATTRACTION-6 study, nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with chemotherapy did not improve overall survival compared with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for patients with HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer. Toxicity increased with the addition of nivolumab and ipilimumab, but no new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: PD-L1 (CPS≥5 or CPS < 5, indeterminate), ECOG PS (0 or 1), countries (Japan or Korea/Taiwan), and disease status (advanced or recurrent)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer: A randomized phase 3 trial (ATTRACTION-6).

data.clinical_result_summary: This study demonstrated PK bioequivalence between Bmab 1000 and originator denosumab in healthy male participants. Pharmacodynamics, safety, and immunogenicity were also comparable between Bmab 1000 and DENO.
clinical_result_indication_detail: healthy male participants
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized, double-blind, two-arm, single-dose, parallel study to compare the pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, safety, and immunogenicity of Bmab 1000 and originator denosumab in healthy male participants.

data.clinical_result_summary: Chemoimmunotherapy demonstrated superior outcomes compared with chemotherapy alone in MSI-H locally advanced gastric cancer. Major pathological response, conversion to operable status, and 6-month disease-free survival were higher with FLOT plus pembrolizumab, while median overall survival was not reached in the chemoimmunotherapy group versus 14.2 months with chemotherapy alone.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced gastric cancer underwent routine MSI testing, and MSI-H patients received either standard perioperative FLOT chemotherapy or FLOT combined with pembrolizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immunotherapy for advanced gastric cancer: Experience from Uzbekistan.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort of patients with neuroendocrine tumors treated with 177Lu-Dotatate, therapy-related myeloid neoplasms were uncommon but clinically significant. Older age and chronic kidney disease were associated with increased risk, whereas repeat 177Lu-Dotatate and alkylating chemotherapy exposure were not associated with increased therapy-related myeloid neoplasm incidence.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with neuroendocrine tumors who received 177Lu-Dotatate.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasms after radioligand therapy in neuroendocrine tumors: A multicenter real-world analysis.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 中位无颅内进展生存期
data.clinical_result_summary: High-dose furmonertinib demonstrated encouraging intracranial efficacy in previously EGFR-TKI-treated patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and brain metastases. The treatment showed a manageable safety profile and supports further investigation in randomized studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: previously EGFR-TKI-treated patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and brain metastases.
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 中位无颅内进展生存期
data.clinical_result_paper_title: High-dose furmonertinib in EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC with brain metastases after EGFR-TKI resistance: The iFORCE phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world analysis of Tarlatamab demonstrated slightly worse clinical outcomes with respect to PFS and OS, although tolerability was similar compared with the clinical trial. Transformed and non-lung primary small cell carcinoma patients showed promising outcomes with Tarlatamab, supporting further studies in this unique patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients who received at least one dose of Tarlatamab at the institution between June 2024 and January 2026 were included and were identified as having small cell lung cancer or transformed and non-lung primary small cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of tarlatamab across small cell carcinoma subtypes, including transformed and non-lung primary.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with HER2-positive, hormone receptor-negative locally advanced breast cancer, the biosimilar BCD-178 demonstrated equivalent efficacy, safety, immunogenicity, and pharmacokinetics to the originator pertuzumab within a neoadjuvant TCHP regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-positive locally advanced breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of the pertuzumab biosimilar BCD‑178 versus the originator pertuzumab in patients with HER2-positive locally advanced breast cancer: Results from the international, double-blind, randomized, phase III PREFER trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性综合征
data.clinical_result_summary: iPSC-NK cells combined with the Stupp regimen demonstrated a favorable safety profile and induced early immune activation within the central nervous system. The regimen showed encouraging preliminary efficacy in patients with WHO grade 4 glioma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: newly diagnosed WHO grade 4 glioma patients
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性综合征
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Intrathecal iPSC-derived natural killer cells combined with the Stupp regimen for newly diagnosed WHO grade 4 glioma: A phase I trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, tarlatamab demonstrated meaningful clinical activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with small cell lung cancer and extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma. The observed efficacy and toxicity rates were consistent with those reported in the pivotal DeLLphi-301 trial, supporting its use outside of a clinical trial setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included all adult patients with advanced small cell lung cancer or extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma who received at least one dose of tarlatamab at the center between May 16, 2024, and September 30, 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of tarlatamab in small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and extrapulmonary small cell carcinoma (EPSCC): A single-center experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world single-center cohort, most early discontinuations of 177Lu-PSMA-617 after ≤3 doses were due to disease progression, while grade ≥3 cytopenias accounted for nearly one-fifth of discontinuations and were predominantly thrombocytopenia. Earlier identification of patients at high risk for progression or marrow toxicity may help optimize patient selection, supportive care, and treatment completion.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This single-center retrospective cohort study at Indiana University included prostate cancer patients treated with 177Lu-PSMA-617 from March 23, 2022 to December 17, 2025 who received ≤3 doses.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early discontinuation of 177Lu-PSMA-617 after ≤ 3 doses in prostate cancer: A single-center retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pertuzumab biosimilar demonstrated therapeutic equivalence to reference pertuzumab when combined with trastuzumab and docetaxel for first-line HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer. Efficacy, safety, pharmacokinetic similarity, and comparable immunogenicity support biosimilarity and its potential as an effective treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of pertuzumab biosimilar versus reference pertuzumab in combination with trastuzumab and docetaxel in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer: A randomized, double-blind, multicenter, parallel group, phase III clinical trial.

首次后线治疗后无疾病进展生存时间（PFS2）
data.clinical_result_summary: In this national real-world cohort of HER2-low advanced breast cancer, clinical benefit from a second antibody-drug conjugate was limited, with shorter progression-free survival and frequent early progression, irrespective of sequencing order. No baseline clinical factors predicted PFS2, and the findings may suggest clinically relevant cross-resistance between antibody-drug conjugates with similar payloads.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with HER2-low advanced breast cancer across 14 Portuguese centers who were treated sequentially with sacituzumab govitecan and trastuzumab deruxtecan, regardless of sequence, initiated the first antibody-drug conjugate between 2023 and 2025, and received at least 1 cycle of both antibody-drug conjugates.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sequence of similar-payload ADCs: Does it make sense in real-world HER2-low advanced breast cancer?—The Portuguese national study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nivolumab plus lenvatinib demonstrated a clinically meaningful objective response rate, meeting the primary endpoint in patients with unresectable anaplastic thyroid cancer. The combination also achieved favorable progression-free survival and overall survival with manageable toxicity under appropriate supportive care, suggesting that this regimen may represent a new treatment option for this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable anaplastic thyroid cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab plus lenvatinib for unresectable anaplastic thyroid cancer: Results of the phase 2 NAVIGATION study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This prospective randomized trial demonstrated that ctDNA-guided adjuvant chemotherapy improved time to recurrence and disease-free survival in stage II colon cancer patients without clinical risk factors. The findings support ctDNA testing for adjuvant decision making in clinical practice, although limitations included the low number of randomized ctDNA-positive patients, the sensitivity of the academic test, and reliance on per-protocol analysis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage II colon cancer without clinical risk factors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Disease-free survival (DFS) and time to recurrence (TTR) with circulating tumor (ct) DNA–based decision for adjuvant treatment in colon cancer stage II (CIRCULATE): An AIO (KRK-0217)/ABCSG trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Dato-DXd showed clinically meaningful activity in heavily pretreated metastatic breast cancer irrespective of prior T-DXd exposure, supporting its use as a subsequent-line option and the feasibility of sequencing payload-sharing ADCs. Longer follow-up and accumulation of cases are warranted to further characterize PFS outcomes in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic hormone receptor-positive HER2-negative breast cancer who initiated Dato-DXd between March and September 2025, classified according to whether they had received at least one prior dose of T-DXd or were T-DXd-naïve.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of datopotamab deruxtecan after trastuzumab deruxtecan in metastatic hormone receptor–positive HER2-negative breast cancer: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Frontline blinatumomab with ponatinib induced deep, durable remission in Philadelphia-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, allowing most patients to avoid stem cell transplant. Relapses were seen with high presenting WBC, supporting baseline-risk intensified strategies including increased intrathecal chemotherapy, high-dose chemotherapy in consolidation, and CAR T-cell therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed Ph + ALL
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of the chemotherapy-free regimen of blinatumomab and ponatinib in patients with newly diagnosed Philadelphia-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: The PSA flare phenomenon is not rare in mCRPC patients treated with Lu-177. Clinical outcomes appeared consistent regardless of PSA flare, suggesting Lu-177 should not be withdrawn early or prematurely in mCRPC patients who have an initial but isolated PSA rise following therapy. Further studies are warranted to validate these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included mCRPC patients treated with Lu-177 between June 2022 and March 2025 at University of Kansas Cancer Center.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Transient prostate-specific antigen flare induced by lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer.

clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 5,556 adult cancer patients treated at the Cleveland Clinic between 2010 and 2022, including patients with bladder cancer, endometrial cancer, esophageal/gastric cancer, head and neck cancer, renal cancer, metastatic melanoma, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, and small cell lung cancer across specified stages.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pulmonary immune-related adverse events post-immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI): Real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia, frontline intensive induction with 7+3+Mido was associated with superior overall survival compared with Aza+Ven+Gilt. These findings support continued use of intensive FLT3-directed induction in appropriate patients and highlight the need for larger studies to define the role and sequencing of venetoclax-based triplet regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with primary FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia receiving frontline therapy with either intensive induction using cytarabine plus anthracycline and midostaurin only or azacitidine, venetoclax, and gilteritinib only.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparative outcomes of intensive induction with 7+3 plus midostaurin versus azacitidine, venetoclax, and gilteritinib in FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of surufatinib and toripalimab exhibited potential clinical activity and tolerable toxicity in patients with recurrent ovarian clear cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: histologically confirmed recurrent OCCC patients, aged 18-75, with an ECOG PS of 0-2 will be enrolled. They should have failed first or subsequent-line therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Surufatinib combined with toripalimab for the treatment of recurrent ovarian clear cell carcinoma: Update of a prospective single center, single-arm phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Quizartinib plus decitabine and venetoclax resulted in high CR/CRi rates, deep measurable residual disease responses, and encouraging survival in older patients with newly diagnosed FLT3-ITD acute myeloid leukemia.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with relapsed/refractory (R/R) FLT3-ITD m AML
patients with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Quizartinib in combination with decitabine and venetoclax for newly diagnosed and relapsed/refractory FLT3-mutated AML.

data.clinical_result_summary: The 2-year survival of remarkable response patients treated with definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy after induction immunochemotherapy appears promising compared with historical data. This stratified induction immunochemotherapy strategy was effective in identifying patients with resectable cervical esophageal squamous cell carcinoma who were suitable candidates for definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with clinical stage T2-4NanyM0 (AJCC TNM 8th) resectable CESCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Interim results from a prospective phase II study of stratified treatment of localized cervical esophageal squamous cell carcinoma by induction immunochemotherapy (SCENIC trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this total neoadjuvant therapy-treated locally advanced rectal cancer cohort, continuous 100 mg aspirin use throughout therapy independently predicted pathological complete response. The findings support aspirin as a pragmatic adjunct candidate to intensify treatment response and warrant prospective confirmation, particularly for maximizing complete response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma treated with total neoadjuvant therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The impact of aspirin use on pathological outcomes in locally advanced rectal cancer patients undergoing total neoadjuvant therapy: Real-world data from the Ankara University Colorectal Cancer study group.

data.clinical_result_summary: Atirmociclib plus letrozole demonstrated substantially greater antiproliferative effects than letrozole alone in patients with HR+/HER2− breast cancer. The combination had a tolerable safety profile, suggesting potential value in early breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Postmenopausal women with HR+/HER2− breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant atirmociclib plus letrozole versus letrozole alone in HR+/HER2− breast cancer: Results from FourLight-2, a randomized phase 2 window of opportunity study.

data.clinical_result_summary: SWOG S2001 was the first randomized controlled trial evaluating the addition of pembrolizumab to olaparib in pancreas cancer. Although ORR doubled and DCR and PFS improved numerically in the experimental arm, the target improvement in PFS to 11.7 months was not met. Further follow-up for mature survival outcomes and translational analyses are planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: metastatic pancreatic cancer patients with germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations
clinical_result_layer_factor: first line platinum-based chemotherapy, Zubrod PS, and disease status after first line treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Randomized phase II trial of olaparib and pembrolizumab vs olaparib alone as maintenance therapy in metastatic pancreatic cancer patients with germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 (gBRCA1/2) mutations: SWOG S2001.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with oligometastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma who received SBRT for metastatic lesions combined with GP chemotherapy and a PD-1 inhibitor achieved good therapeutic effects with acceptable toxicities.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with oligometastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Stereotactic body radiotherapy combined with chemotherapy and PD-1 inhibitor in oligometastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma (STOMP): A prospective phase II clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Fruquintinib combined with either FOLFIRI or mFOLFOX6 as second-line therapy for patients with RAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer demonstrated promising efficacy and a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with RAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Fruquintinib plus FOLFIRI or mFOLFOX6 as second-line therapy for patients with RAS-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC): A phase II, multicenter, open-label study.

data.clinical_result_summary: T-DXd showed antitumor activity in patients from China with metastatic HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer with and without baseline CNS metastases, and promising CNS activity was observed. No new safety signals were reported. The results support T-DXd use in pretreated patients with HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer, including those with CNS metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients from China with metastatic HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer with disease progression on or after at least 1 prior anticancer therapy, including patients with pretreated asymptomatic or neurologically stable CNS metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in patients (pts) with HER2-mutant (HER2m) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and central nervous system (CNS) metastases (mets): Results from DESTINY-Lung05 (DL-05).

data.clinical_result_summary: Survival outcomes were comparable across venetoclax 7-, 14-, 21-, and 28-day schedules in newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia, with outcomes driven more by Mayo Genetic and ELN risk than by venetoclax duration. Higher early mortality with shorter venetoclax durations likely reflects treatment selection, and prospective trials are needed to define risk-adapted dosing strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia patients receiving venetoclax plus a hypomethylating agent at the Mayo Clinic.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: HMA plus venetoclax for 7- vs 14- vs 21- vs 28-day cycles in newly-diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia: ELN- and Mayo Genetic Risk–stratified analysis in 540 patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: Receipt of immunotherapy was associated with a significantly increased risk of pulmonary adverse events, primarily clinically significant pneumonitis. These toxicities were common by 24 months, frequently severe, and often led to irreversible damage and treatment cessation, highlighting the need for vigilant monitoring, early recognition, multidisciplinary management, and prompt intervention.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 5,556 adult cancer patients treated at the Cleveland Clinic between 2010 and 2022, including patients with bladder cancer, endometrial cancer, esophageal/gastric cancer, head and neck cancer, renal cancer, metastatic melanoma, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, and small cell lung cancer across specified stages.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pulmonary immune-related adverse events post-immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI): Real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this preliminary Phase 1/2 report, PTT-4256 was well tolerated in adults with advanced/metastatic solid malignancies, with no dose-limiting toxicities reported. Tumor shrinkage and stable disease were observed at doses of 40 mg/day and above, and biomarker analyses showed dose-dependent immune-related changes consistent with the drug's proposed mechanism. Enrollment at higher dose levels is ongoing, and Phase 2 evaluation as monotherapy or in combination with anti-PD1 is planned after RP2D identification.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed advanced or metastatic solid malignancies who have previously received standard of care therapies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: RAISIC-1: A phase 1/2 clinical trial of the GPR65 inhibitor PTT-4256—Preliminary safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic results.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched analysis of hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer, ribociclib was associated with significantly lower all-cause mortality compared with palbociclib. Rates of hospitalization, emergency department visits, prolonged QT, and cardiac arrest were not significantly different. These real-world findings support clinically meaningful heterogeneity across CDK4/6 inhibitors and highlight the importance of individualized agent selection, balancing survival, hepatic toxicity, and healthcare utilization.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with hormone receptor-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer treated with ribociclib or palbociclib were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparative safety and outcomes of ribociclib versus palbociclib in hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer: A propensity score–matched sensitivity analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The 2.5 and 5 mCi dose levels of [212Pb]Pb-PSV359 were found to be safe, with no dose-limiting toxicities reported. Dose escalation is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with solid tumors that are known to be fibroblast activation protein-positive
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I/IIa, image-guided, alpha-particle therapy study of [203Pb]Pb-PSV359 and [212Pb]Pb-PSV359 in patients with solid tumors that are known to be fibroblast activation protein (FAP)–positive.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the ATTRACTION-6 study, nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with chemotherapy did not improve overall survival compared with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for patients with HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer. Toxicity increased with the addition of nivolumab and ipilimumab, but no new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: PD-L1 (CPS≥5 or CPS < 5, indeterminate), ECOG PS (0 or 1), countries (Japan or Korea/Taiwan), and disease status (advanced or recurrent)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for HER2-negative unresectable advanced or recurrent gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer: A randomized phase 3 trial (ATTRACTION-6).

data.clinical_result_summary: Lurbinectedin had a manageable safety profile, predictable pharmacokinetic properties, and encouraging preliminary clinical activity in patients with relapsed/refractory Ewing sarcoma. Phase 2 expansion in patients aged ≤30 years with relapsed/refractory Ewing sarcoma is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric and young adult pts with relapsed/refractory solid tumors including Ewing sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and pharmacokinetics (PK) of lurbinectedin (lurbi) in pediatric patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory (R/R) solid tumors and preliminary antitumor activity in pediatric and young adult pts with R/R Ewing sarcoma (EwS): Results from a phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Immunotherapy-based total neoadjuvant therapy achieved an encouraging pathological complete response rate in locally advanced esophageal squamous cancer. The regimen also showed a tolerable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with thoracic locally advanced esophageal squamous cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immunotherapy-based total neoadjuvant therapy versus neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced esophageal squamous cancer: Interim results of a randomized phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy and targeted therapy for Clinical Stage III melanoma can lead to durable recurrence-free survival. Higher pretreatment fraction productive of T cells and higher post-treatment involved lymph node T-cell receptor clonality were associated with improved recurrence-free survival, suggesting T-cell receptor repertoire characteristics may inform future biomarker studies and therapy personalization.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The trial included Clinical Stage III melanoma patients who were treated based on BRAF status, with BRAF-mutated patients assigned to Arm A and BRAF wildtype patients assigned to Arm B.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Linking T-cell receptor dynamics to outcomes in neoadjuvant-treated melanoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In the real-world setting, mirvetuximab soravtansine monotherapy in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer patients showed progression-free survival comparable to MIRASOL. These results support the generalizability of trial findings to routine clinical practice and potentially to a broader patient spectrum, and demonstrate a consistent mirvetuximab soravtansine safety profile in real-world patients beyond the MIRASOL trial population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included platinum-resistant ovarian cancer patients who received either mirvetuximab soravtansine monotherapy after November 2022 or single-agent chemotherapy with topotecan, paclitaxel, or doxorubicin after January 2020, including primary platinum-refractory patients and patients with a wider range of 1-11 prior lines of therapy; a subgroup included patients with 1-3 prior lines of therapy and no primary platinum-refractory disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world (RW) characteristics and outcomes in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC) patients treated with mirvetuximab soravtansine (MIRV) monotherapy or single-agent chemotherapy (CTx).

data.clinical_result_summary: In elderly patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, first-line FOLFIRINOX was associated with improved survival without increased short-term toxicity or healthcare utilization, including among patients with poor prognostic CA19-9 levels. These findings support FOLFIRINOX as a viable option for carefully selected elderly patients, although lack of functional status matching suggests possible selection of fitter individuals.
