clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included elderly patients aged ≥75 years with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who were treated with first-line FOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel, including a subgroup of patients with CA19-9 > 1000 U/mL.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: FOLFIRINOX vs gem/pac in the elderly: Is the survival benefit worth the risk?

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort, tarlatamab was associated with early-onset CRS and ICANS that were predominantly low-grade, although rare high-grade events occurred. Toxicities were generally manageable with standard supportive measures, supporting the feasibility of tarlatamab in diverse clinical populations when appropriate clinical and oncology pharmacy-driven interventions are available.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer or extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma who received at least 1 dose of tarlatamab between October 2024 and October 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of tarlatamab in small cell lung cancer and extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Selected patients with neuroendocrine prostate cancer and PSMA-avid disease may derive clinical benefit from 177Lu-PSMA-617, although presentation is heterogeneous and overall prognosis is poor. Benefit appears greatest in patients with limited neuroendocrine differentiation and prior sensitivity to NEPC-directed therapy. Prospective evaluation in larger cohorts is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with histologic or pathologic evidence of neuroendocrine prostate cancer who demonstrated PSMA-avid disease on PET/CT and received at least 1 cycle of 177Lu-PSMA-617 monotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Lutetium-177-PSMA-617 (177Lu-PSMA-617) in neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of patients with small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab, CRS or ICANS was documented in around half of the study population, with a higher incidence of ICANS compared to clinical trials. Occurrence of this toxicity was associated with worse overall survival, and subsequent therapies after tarlatamab discontinuation reflected contemporary treatment patterns in this setting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab were identified.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world analysis of CRS and ICANS following tarlatamab and its association with survival in patients with SCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Second-generation H1 antihistamine use was associated with improved early survival and reduced healthcare utilization among melanoma and lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, without a significant increase in immune-related adverse events. Despite the retrospective design and potential confounding, prospective validation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged 18 years or older with melanoma or lung cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors, including pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, atezolizumab, durvalumab, cemiplimab, or avelumab, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Second-generation H1 antihistamine use with survival and immune-related outcomes in lung cancer and melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors.

data.clinical_result_summary: ILKN421H was generally well tolerated at the current dose level and demonstrated high and prolonged plasma IL-2 levels with robust immune stimulatory activity promoting CD8 T cell and NK cell proliferation. Initial signs of antitumor efficacy were seen when ILKN421H was used in combination with pembrolizumab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced NSCLC
patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human (FIH), phase I/II open-label, dose-escalation and -expansion study of ILKN421H, an LNP mRNA encoding an IL2Rβγ selective IL-2v, as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first-in-human study demonstrates the feasibility and early clinical activity of in vivo CAR T-cell generation using a CD8-targeted LNP platform in patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell lymphoma. The approach enabled rapid, transient CAR T-cell expression, repeatable dosing, and a favorable safety profile without lymphocyte clearance and complex ex vivo CAR T-cell manufacturing. These findings provide clinical proof of concept for a scalable, off-the-shelf CAR T-cell therapy and support further clinical evaluation in hematologic malignancies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human in vivo CAR T-cell generation using a CD8-targeted lipid nanoparticle platform in relapsed/refractory B-cell lymphoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Use of adjuvant capecitabine in routine practice was strongly influenced by residual disease burden and pathologic stage, suggesting treatment selection was driven primarily by perceived recurrence risk rather than standardized criteria. Inferior outcomes in unadjusted analyses most likely reflected confounding by indication rather than treatment harm or lack of efficacy. Future integration of molecular phenotype data may refine post-neoadjuvant risk stratification and help identify biologically defined subgroups most likely to benefit from adjuvant capecitabine.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with triple-negative breast cancer (ER/PR ≤10%, HER2-) who had received at least 1 cycle of neoadjuvant therapy between 2014 and 2024 and had at least 6 months of follow-up after surgery were included; patients with inflammatory disease or prior anti-HER2/endocrine therapy were excluded, with a focus on patients with residual triple-negative breast cancer after neoadjuvant therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes in triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) in patients with residual disease after neoadjuvant therapy (NEOCAPE).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Emiltatug ledadotin appeared to demonstrate favorable tolerability and promising antitumor activity in patients with aggressive adenoid cystic carcinoma who have no available treatments and a poor prognosis. Further clinical development is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult pts with select advanced or metastatic solid tumors, including aggressive ACC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Emiltatug ledadotin (Emi-Le), a B7-H4–directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in patients with aggressive adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC): Phase 1 interim analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant therapy with tislelizumab in combination with oxaliplatin and S-1 for locally advanced Siewert type II esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma yielded a favorable pathologic complete response rate. The regimen also showed a good safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced Siewert type II adenocarcinoma of the esophagogastric junction
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant tislelizumab plus oxaliplatin and S-1 for locally advanced Siewert type II esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma: A prospective multicenter phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The efficacy of SIRT plus nivolumab in hepatocellular carcinoma does not appear to be primarily determined by baseline T-cell infiltration and may instead be influenced by fibroblast-driven stromal features and oncofetal CAF-associated immunosuppression. Better outcomes are expected in the presence of high-affinity Class II clonal neoantigens and sustained systemic T-cell diversification. Stromal remodeling and fibroblast reprogramming could be promising approaches to enhance responses to SIRT-immunotherapy combinations, although further validation is required.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Stromal remodeling and neoantigen clonality as used to evaluate benefit from SIRT–nivolumab in HCC.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this molecularly selected cohort of patients with salivary gland cancer, darolutamide plus androgen-deprivation therapy showed significant clinical activity, validating androgen receptor as a relevant therapeutic target in a subset of salivary gland cancers. Analysis of serial research biopsies will be performed to identify biomarker and/or drug combination strategies to enhance the efficacy of androgen receptor-targeting.
clinical_result_indication_detail: hormone-therapy naïve patients with locally advanced/unresectable or recurrent/metastatic androgen receptor-positive salivary gland cancers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of darolutamide plus leuprolide acetate in hormone therapy–naïve recurrent and/or metastatic androgen receptor (AR)–positive salivary gland cancer (ETCTN 10553).

data.clinical_result_summary: Liposomal irinotecan combined with cisplatin/carboplatin showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in platinum-sensitive relapsed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. These interim results support further investigation of this regimen as a potential second-line option, with longer follow-up needed for survival and response durability.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pathologically confirmed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer who had progressed ≥6 months after first-line platinum-based chemoradiotherapy (with or without immunotherapy)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Liposomal irinotecan plus cisplatin/carboplatin as second-line therapy for platinum-sensitive relapsed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer: Interim results of a phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: HRD-positive status has become a routine biomarker at high-grade ovarian cancer diagnosis and substantially influences first-line and maintenance treatment selection. Bevacizumab-containing regimens were more often chosen in BRCAwt patients, while olaparib-based maintenance was widely used in both subgroups in real-world practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients at 29 Russian sites with newly diagnosed HRD-positive high-grade ovarian cancer (FIGO IC–IV), including HRD+BRCAm and HRD+BRCAwt subgroups, who completed surgery and first-line carboplatin/paclitaxel with or without bevacizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Primary treatment approaches in advanced HRD‑positive (BRCAm and BRCAwt) ovarian cancer in the Russian non‑interventional OVARD study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world cohort, adding carboplatin to cabazitaxel was associated with higher rates of deep PSA response but no overall survival benefit. The combination also increased hematologic toxicity, suggesting that better patient selection and prospective studies are needed to define its role in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult men aged 18 years or older with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer treated with cabazitaxel, excluding patients with hematologic malignancies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of cabazitaxel plus carboplatin versus cabazitaxel alone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The PSA flare phenomenon is not rare in mCRPC patients treated with Lu-177. Clinical outcomes appeared consistent regardless of PSA flare, suggesting Lu-177 should not be withdrawn early or prematurely in mCRPC patients who have an initial but isolated PSA rise following therapy. Further studies are warranted to validate these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included mCRPC patients treated with Lu-177 between June 2022 and March 2025 at University of Kansas Cancer Center.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Transient prostate-specific antigen flare induced by lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Dato-DXd showed clinically meaningful activity in heavily pretreated metastatic breast cancer irrespective of prior T-DXd exposure, supporting its use as a subsequent-line option and the feasibility of sequencing payload-sharing ADCs. Longer follow-up and accumulation of cases are warranted to further characterize PFS outcomes in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic hormone receptor-positive HER2-negative breast cancer who initiated Dato-DXd between March and September 2025, classified according to whether they had received at least one prior dose of T-DXd or were T-DXd-naïve.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy of datopotamab deruxtecan after trastuzumab deruxtecan in metastatic hormone receptor–positive HER2-negative breast cancer: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this elderly and frail population with high-risk diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, Pola-R2 was feasible and showed encouraging early disease control, including PET-defined complete responses and MRD negativity. The findings compare favorably with historical outcomes for attenuated chemoimmunotherapy regimens and support further prospective evaluation of chemotherapy-sparing strategies for anthracycline-ineligible patients with aggressive lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma treated with Pola-R2 at a single institution, focusing on elderly or frail patients and those with cardiac comorbidities or anthracycline ineligibility with aggressive lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of polatuzumab, rituximab, and lenalidomide in frail pts with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: DN022150 demonstrated favorable safety and tolerability in patients with KRAS G12D-mutated advanced solid tumors, with no dose-limiting toxicities and manageable treatment-related adverse events. The agent showed potent antitumor activity and was considered a promising novel therapy for this molecularly defined population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced KRAS G12D-mutant solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/IIa study of DN022150, a novel selective noncovalent small molecule KRAS G12D inhibitor in patients with advanced KRAS G12D–mutant solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Receipt of immunotherapy was associated with a significantly increased risk of pulmonary adverse events, primarily clinically significant pneumonitis. These toxicities were common by 24 months, frequently severe, and often led to irreversible damage and treatment cessation, highlighting the need for vigilant monitoring, early recognition, multidisciplinary management, and prompt intervention.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 5,556 adult cancer patients treated at the Cleveland Clinic between 2010 and 2022, including patients with bladder cancer, endometrial cancer, esophageal/gastric cancer, head and neck cancer, renal cancer, metastatic melanoma, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, and small cell lung cancer across specified stages.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pulmonary immune-related adverse events post-immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI): Real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this heavily pretreated real-world cohort, amivantamab monotherapy demonstrated meaningful antitumor activity across diverse EGFR mutation subtypes, with outcomes comparable to prior trials and real-world experiences. These findings support consideration of amivantamab monotherapy beyond exon 20 insertions and warrant prospective evaluation in defined clinical settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with advanced EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer treated with amivantamab monotherapy in the second line or later, categorized by EGFR mutation subtype as classical, atypical, exon 20 insertion, or unspecified variants.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of amivantamab monotherapy in advanced EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The BT-NICE regimen demonstrated promising efficacy and was feasible with a manageable safety profile in patients with locally advanced, resectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. This study provides the first clinical evidence supporting incorporation of a BTLA inhibitor into a perioperative treatment paradigm for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced resectable thoracic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Perioperative therapy with tifcemailmab plus toripalimab and chemotherapy for resectable thoracic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (BT-NICE trial): A prospective phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Phase Ib results demonstrate that OVM-200 is safe and immunogenic, achieving both the primary safety and secondary immunogenicity endpoints. OVM-200 overcomes immune tolerance to survivin and induces durable humoral and cellular immune responses. The observed association between stronger immune responses and best overall response of stable disease supports further clinical evaluation and rational combination strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced NSCLC, ovarian, or prostate cancer who had progressed on standard therapies (Phase Ib)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase Ib evaluation of a recombinant overlapping peptide survivin immunotherapy: Safety, immunogenicity, and immune–clinical associations in advanced solid tumours.

data.clinical_result_summary: At Mayo Clinic sites, the incidence of any-grade adverse events associated with first-line metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma treatment was similar to or higher than rates reported in the literature. Nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea were the most commonly treated adverse events for both FFX and Gem+NabP regimens, while neutropenia and neuropathy were less commonly treated. FFX dose reductions were commonly attempted before switching regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with stage IV and/or TNM staging of M1 who received at least 1 dose of first-line FOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine plus Nab-paclitaxel were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Incidence, severity, and management of severe adverse events in first-line (1L) treatments for metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC): A retrospective observational study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of benmelstobart, anlotinib, and SOX demonstrated promising efficacy with a manageable safety profile as first-line therapy for advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma with low PD-L1 expression. These findings warrant validation in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma with low PD-L1 expression
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of benmelstobart plus anlotinib combined with SOX in the first-line treatment of advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction (G/GEJ) adenocarcinoma with low PD-L1 expression: A single-arm, multicenter phase II clinical trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 下一线治疗的无进展生存期（PFS2）
首次后线治疗后无疾病进展生存时间（PFS2）
data.clinical_result_summary: In this national real-world cohort of HER2-low advanced breast cancer, clinical benefit from a second antibody-drug conjugate was limited, with shorter progression-free survival and frequent early progression, irrespective of sequencing order. No baseline clinical factors predicted PFS2, and the findings may suggest clinically relevant cross-resistance between antibody-drug conjugates with similar payloads.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with HER2-low advanced breast cancer across 14 Portuguese centers who were treated sequentially with sacituzumab govitecan and trastuzumab deruxtecan, regardless of sequence, initiated the first antibody-drug conjugate between 2023 and 2025, and received at least 1 cycle of both antibody-drug conjugates.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sequence of similar-payload ADCs: Does it make sense in real-world HER2-low advanced breast cancer?—The Portuguese national study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sintilimab plus gemcitabine and docetaxel showed promising efficacy in chemotherapy-naïve patients with advanced epithelioid sarcoma, with an ORR of 35.71% and a high disease control rate. The safety profile was manageable, with no new safety signals identified.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced epithelioid sarcoma that has not been treated by chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sintilimab (PD-1 antibody) plus gemcitabine and docetaxel (GT) as first-line or later-line therapy in patients with advanced epithelioid sarcoma: A prospective, multicenter, single-arm, phase II clinical study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pembrolizumab did not increase the proportion of patients with post-treatment complete pathologic necrosis after neoadjuvant radiation therapy in high-risk soft tissue sarcoma. Unexpectedly, increased post-treatment tumoral necrosis was associated with inferior event-free survival, suggesting it may identify patients less likely to benefit from PEM/nRT or with more aggressive tumor biology.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with localized high-risk soft tissue sarcomas.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II pilot study of pembrolizumab (PEM) and neoadjuvant radiation therapy (nRT) in high-risk soft tissue sarcomas (STS).

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with standard of care, trastuzumab rezetecan prolonged progression-free survival and improved objective response rate in chemotherapy-refractory HER2-positive advanced colorectal cancer. The safety profile was described as tolerable.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with chemotherapy-refractory, HER2-positive, RAS and RAF wild-type advanced colorectal cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: HER2 status (IHC 3+ vs IHC 2+/ISH+) and ECOG PS (0 vs 1)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 3 trial of trastuzumab rezetecan vs standard of care (SOC) for chemotherapy-refractory, HER2-positive, advanced colorectal cancer (CRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Overall survival benefit and lower and less frequent treatment initiation after 177Lu-DOTATATE versus everolimus treatment suggest a clinical benefit of 177Lu-DOTATATE versus everolimus with lower therapy burden in patients with gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
clinical_result_indication_name: 胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors were treated with 177Lu-DOTATATE or everolimus.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical outcomes of [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE (177Lu-DOTATATE) vs everolimus (EVE) in managing patients (pts) with gastroenteropancreatic-neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs): Real-world analysis of the PRIME initiative.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective single-center study, romiplostim was effective at achieving a platelet goal of >100 ×10^9/L in the majority of patients with chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia. The study was limited by its single-center design, heterogeneous patient population, and lack of a comparator group; further studies are needed to determine effects on overall survival and optimal dosing strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia were included if they received romiplostim within 6 months following chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Retrospective evaluation of romiplostim use for patients with chemotherapy-induced thrombocytopenia.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large multicenter real-world cohort of patients with colorectal cancer and type 2 diabetes, GLP-1 receptor agonist use was associated with significantly improved short- and long-term overall survival. These findings support further investigation of GLP-1 RAs as potential prognostic modifiers in colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with incident colorectal cancer and type 2 diabetes mellitus were identified.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of GLP-1 receptor agonist use with overall survival in patients with colorectal cancer and type 2 diabetes: A multicenter real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Receipt of immunotherapy was associated with a significantly increased risk of pulmonary adverse events, primarily clinically significant pneumonitis. These toxicities were common by 24 months, frequently severe, and often led to irreversible damage and treatment cessation, highlighting the need for vigilant monitoring, early recognition, multidisciplinary management, and prompt intervention.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 5,556 adult cancer patients treated at the Cleveland Clinic between 2010 and 2022, including patients with bladder cancer, endometrial cancer, esophageal/gastric cancer, head and neck cancer, renal cancer, metastatic melanoma, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, and small cell lung cancer across specified stages.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pulmonary immune-related adverse events post-immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI): Real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: The final analysis of ARROW confirms that pralsetinib yielded clinically meaningful and durable responses in patients with RET-altered thyroid cancer and medullary thyroid cancer. Safety was manageable and consistent with prior reports.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with previously treated RET fusion-positive TC (RET-fp TC)
patients with RET-mutant Medullary Thyroid Cancer who were naïve to systemic treatment
patients with RET-mutant Medullary Thyroid Cancer who were previously treated with vandetanib or cabozantinib
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of pralsetinib in advanced or metastatic RET-altered thyroid cancer (TC): Final analysis of the phase 1/2 ARROW study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sustained disease control beyond 6 months with cetuximab is uncommon, but this multi-institutional series identified a subset of patients with exceptionally durable responses exceeding historical expectations. Deep and durable responses to platinum-cetuximab combinations suggest a biologically distinct subgroup, supporting further molecular and tumor microenvironment profiling to define cetuximab super-responders.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included relapsed or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck patients treated with cetuximab for at least 6 months at two academic centers across two academic health systems.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A retrospective cohort study evaluating cetuximab super-responders with recurrent or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world cohort of patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and central nervous system metastases treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy, median overall survival and median progression-free survival were markedly shorter than those reported for the overall population in the KEYNOTE-355 trial. These findings underscore a persistent unmet clinical need in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer with central nervous system involvement and support further prospective evaluation and optimization of multimodal treatment strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated treated women with PD-L1-positive metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and central nervous system metastases, including brain metastases present at treatment initiation that were stable following prior local therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer with central nervous system metastases: A multicenter cohort from Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia.

data.clinical_result_summary: Dose-adapted trastuzumab deruxtecan demonstrated clinically meaningful activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with HER2-positive and HER2-low metastatic breast cancer in a real-world setting. The shorter median progression-free survival likely reflects reduced dose intensity, limited follow-up, and real-world heterogeneity rather than loss of intrinsic drug activity. These findings support further prospective evaluation of dose-adapted strategies to improve treatment accessibility in resource-limited settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: This retrospective analysis included patients with HER2-positive or HER2-low metastatic breast cancer treated with dose-adapted trastuzumab deruxtecan across multiple Indian centers, with an evaluable cohort defined as patients receiving at least 2 cycles of therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ADAPT-T-DXd: Multi-institutional real-world study of dose-adapted trastuzumab deruxtecan in HER2-positive and HER2-low metastatic breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Efdelikofusp alfa was well tolerated as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab in patients with advanced solid tumors. Antitumor activity was observed with a favorable benefit-risk profile, supporting continued development in selected tumors, including ccRCC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors (Part E)
patients with advanced solid tumors (Part F)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: KEYNOTE-B59: An open-label, multicenter, phase 1/2 study of efdelikofusp alfa (GI-101A; CD80-IgG4 Fc-IL2v2) in advanced solid tumors (part E & F of GII-101-P101).

data.clinical_result_summary: Lurbinectedin had a manageable safety profile, predictable pharmacokinetic properties, and encouraging preliminary clinical activity in patients with relapsed/refractory Ewing sarcoma. Phase 2 expansion in patients aged ≤30 years with relapsed/refractory Ewing sarcoma is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric and young adult pts with relapsed/refractory solid tumors including Ewing sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and pharmacokinetics (PK) of lurbinectedin (lurbi) in pediatric patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory (R/R) solid tumors and preliminary antitumor activity in pediatric and young adult pts with R/R Ewing sarcoma (EwS): Results from a phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In early-stage triple-negative breast cancer, the time of immunotherapy administration may influence efficacy, with opposite effects depending on the baseline immune milieu. Immune-informed circadian alignment may be an important determinant of immunotherapy benefit in TNBC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Time-of-day administration of immunotherapy in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer: Immune-dependent chronotherapy effects in the phase III A-BRAVE trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: A first-in-human, open-label, dose-escalation phase 1 trial of Gamitrinib was initiated in adult patients with advanced solid tumors or lymphoma for whom no standard therapy is available. As of 2026, 18 evaluable patients had been accrued across 5 escalating dose levels with no dose-limiting toxicities, and the study remained open with enrollment ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with advanced solid tumors or lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1, first-in-human, open-label, dose-escalation and -expansion study of gamitrinib, a first-in-class, mitochondria-directed inhibitor of the molecular chaperone heat shock protein-90 (Hsp90) in patients with advanced cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The TRAP-OLIGO study met its primary endpoint, demonstrating that multimodal therapy combining platinum-based chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab and local ablative therapy provides favorable efficacy for patients with synchronous oligometastatic non-small cell lung cancer. The integrated approach was described as a promising treatment strategy for this population, with no treatment-related deaths observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage IV NSCLC who had 3 or fewer metastatic lesions
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of multidisciplinary therapy combined with pembrolizumab for patients with synchronous oligometastatic non-small cell lung cancer: TRAP-OLIGO study (WJOG11118L).

data.clinical_result_summary: Second-generation H1 antihistamine use was associated with improved early survival and reduced healthcare utilization among melanoma and lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, without a significant increase in immune-related adverse events. Despite the retrospective design and potential confounding, prospective validation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients aged 18 years or older with melanoma or lung cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors, including pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, atezolizumab, durvalumab, cemiplimab, or avelumab, were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Second-generation H1 antihistamine use with survival and immune-related outcomes in lung cancer and melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors.

data.clinical_result_summary: ILKN421H was generally well tolerated at the current dose level and demonstrated high and prolonged plasma IL-2 levels with robust immune stimulatory activity promoting CD8 T cell and NK cell proliferation. Initial signs of antitumor efficacy were seen when ILKN421H was used in combination with pembrolizumab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced NSCLC
patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human (FIH), phase I/II open-label, dose-escalation and -expansion study of ILKN421H, an LNP mRNA encoding an IL2Rβγ selective IL-2v, as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world analysis of Tarlatamab demonstrated slightly worse clinical outcomes with respect to PFS and OS, although tolerability was similar compared with the clinical trial. Transformed and non-lung primary small cell carcinoma patients showed promising outcomes with Tarlatamab, supporting further studies in this unique patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients who received at least one dose of Tarlatamab at the institution between June 2024 and January 2026 were included and were identified as having small cell lung cancer or transformed and non-lung primary small cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of tarlatamab across small cell carcinoma subtypes, including transformed and non-lung primary.

data.clinical_result_summary: Incorporation of inotuzumab ozogamicin into frontline HCVAD with sequential blinatumomab was associated with improved survival and durable remission in adults with newly diagnosed Philadelphia-negative B-ALL. These findings support its role in the frontline setting, and a confirmatory randomized trial comparing HCVAD-blinatumomab with HCVAD-blinatumomab-inotuzumab ozogamicin is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts age 14-59 with newly diagnosed Ph-negative B-ALL
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long-term outcomes with addition of inotuzumab ozogamicin to HCVAD and sequential blinatumomab in adults with newly diagnosed B-ALL.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lenalidomide-induced eosinophilia was significantly associated with higher rates of complete response, deep response, and overall response following VRd induction in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. Early treatment-emergent eosinophilia may represent a simple, cost-effective biomarker of immune-mediated treatment efficacy and warrants further prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma patients treated with standard weekly VRd were included, while patients with baseline eosinophilia, active infection or allergy, renal dysfunction, or liver dysfunction were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: LEN-EOS study: Lenalidomide-associated eosinophilia as a marker of response to induction therapy in multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective study, yttrium-90 radiation segmentectomy demonstrated favorable safety and efficacy in Chinese patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma, achieving a high objective response rate and substantial downstaging rate. A tumor dose threshold of 215.5 Gy was identified as a predictor of treatment response.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively analyzed Chinese patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma who received 90Y radiation segmentectomy at a single center between June 2022 and October 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and dosimetry of yttrium-90 radiation segmentectomy for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: A retrospective study in China.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tecotabart vedotin plus toripalimab, with or without chemotherapy, demonstrated encouraging anti-tumor activity and manageable safety as first-line treatment for CLDN18.2-positive advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer. The doublet showed comparable efficacy to the triplet with enhanced tolerability, supporting further large-scale clinical investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed, previously untreated, unresectable, HER2-negative  gastric, GEJ, or EAC - pooled analysis
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of tecotabart vedotin plus toripalimab with or without chemotherapy as first-line treatment for CLDN18.2-positive advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: Phase II study results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy plus sintilimab significantly improved pathological complete response compared with neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus sintilimab in resectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Preoperative circulating tumor DNA clearance closely tracked pathological response, supporting circulating tumor DNA as a promising early molecular marker of treatment effect. Event-free survival will be reported with longer follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with thoracic ESCC and had not received any prior treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pathological complete response and ctDNA analyses in SCIENCE: Results from a randomized, phase III trial of neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus sintilimab and chemoradiotherapy plus sintilimab versus chemoradiotherapy in resectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this elderly and frail population with high-risk diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, Pola-R2 was feasible and showed encouraging early disease control, including PET-defined complete responses and MRD negativity. The findings compare favorably with historical outcomes for attenuated chemoimmunotherapy regimens and support further prospective evaluation of chemotherapy-sparing strategies for anthracycline-ineligible patients with aggressive lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma treated with Pola-R2 at a single institution, focusing on elderly or frail patients and those with cardiac comorbidities or anthracycline ineligibility with aggressive lymphoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of polatuzumab, rituximab, and lenalidomide in frail pts with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In heavily pretreated, platinum-resistant/refractory patients, TumoCure treatment was safe and well tolerated. Early signals of tumor regression and improvement in tumor bulk-related symptoms were observed, supported by markedly reduced systemic platinum exposure. These findings support continued development of TumoCure as treatment for refractory locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with chemo and/or radio resistant locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary efficacy and safety of intratumoral long-acting cisplatin-SRGel (TumoCure) in refractory locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: Phase Ib CLPR-001.

data.clinical_result_summary: Molecular-based recommended therapy identified by comprehensive genomic profiling in the first-line setting improved access to targeted therapies and was associated with superior survival outcomes compared with standard of care in advanced solid tumors. The data suggest that comprehensive genomic profiling in Japan should be available before initiation of standard of care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study registered chemotherapy-naïve adult patients in Japan with advanced solid tumors, including gastrointestinal, lung, breast, gynecologic cancers and melanoma, and ECOG performance status of 0-1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of first-line comprehensive genomic profiling on survival outcomes for patients with advanced solid tumors who received molecularly-matched therapies: 3-year follow-up of the prospective FIRST-Dx study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Receipt of immunotherapy was associated with a significantly increased risk of pulmonary adverse events, primarily clinically significant pneumonitis. These toxicities were common by 24 months, frequently severe, and often led to irreversible damage and treatment cessation, highlighting the need for vigilant monitoring, early recognition, multidisciplinary management, and prompt intervention.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 5,556 adult cancer patients treated at the Cleveland Clinic between 2010 and 2022, including patients with bladder cancer, endometrial cancer, esophageal/gastric cancer, head and neck cancer, renal cancer, metastatic melanoma, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, and small cell lung cancer across specified stages.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pulmonary immune-related adverse events post-immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI): Real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tersolisib, alone or combined with fulvestrant with or without a CDK4/6 inhibitor, continued to be well tolerated, with lower incidence of PI3K inhibitor-class toxicities and no Grade 3 hyperglycemia in patients with normal baseline glycemic control. Target engagement was robust and clinical benefit continued to mature favorably in heavily pretreated patients with PIK3CA-mutant HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer, supporting further study in the Phase 3 PIKALO-2 trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HR+, HER2- PIK3CA-mutated Advanced Breast Cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 trial of tersolisib (LY4064809/STX-478), a pan-mutant-selective PI3Kα inhibitor (PI3Kαi), in PIK3CA-mutant advanced solid tumors: Updated results from PIKALO-1.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intrathecal toripalimab combined with pemetrexed showed a manageable safety profile and promising clinical activity in patients with leptomeningeal metastases from solid tumors. Based on the encouraging interim overall survival observed, further clinical investigation of intrathecal immunotherapy is warranted for patients with leptomeningeal metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with leptomeningeal metastases from solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/II study of concurrent intrathecal toripalimab and pemetrexed (PM) for leptomeningeal metastases (LM) from solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results showed that the short-term metabolic intervention combining prolonged nightly fasting and metformin was feasible, safe, highly compliant, and inexpensive in operable hormone receptor-positive breast cancer or DCIS. The intervention was associated with favorable antiproliferative and metabolic changes that warrant further investigation in breast cancer prevention and treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Women with hormone receptor-positive operable invasive breast cancer or DCIS.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Time-restricted eating and metformin (TEAM) in invasive breast cancer or DCIS: A randomized, phase IIb, window-of-opportunity presurgical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line therapy of penpulimab plus oral anlotinib and capecitabine provided promising antitumor efficacy, low toxicity, and favorable quality of life for patients with recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Penpulimab plus oral anlotinib and capecitabine as first-line treatment for recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma (R/M NPC): A multicenter, single-arm, phase 2 clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world cohort of patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and central nervous system metastases treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy, median overall survival and median progression-free survival were markedly shorter than those reported for the overall population in the KEYNOTE-355 trial. These findings underscore a persistent unmet clinical need in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer with central nervous system involvement and support further prospective evaluation and optimization of multimodal treatment strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated treated women with PD-L1-positive metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and central nervous system metastases, including brain metastases present at treatment initiation that were stable following prior local therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer with central nervous system metastases: A multicenter cohort from Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia.

data.clinical_result_summary: Long-term adverse events with dabrafenib and/or trametinib were consistent with the established safety profiles. Except for a greater-than-normal increase in weight, treatment had no significant impact on growth, sexual maturation, or skeletal development, and the benefit-risk profile remained favorable in pediatric patients with MAPK pathway-activated tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric patients with MAPK pathway-activated tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Long term effects of treatment with dabrafenib (D) and/or trametinib (T) in pediatric patients with MAPK pathway-activated tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Pembrolizumab plus radiotherapy met the pre-specified significance criterion for improvement in progression-free survival compared with cisplatin plus radiotherapy in this phase II trial. A phase III trial of radiotherapy with pembrolizumab for unfavorable-risk p16+ head and neck squamous cell carcinoma is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed unresected p16+ head and neck squamous cell carcinoma with unfavorable risk
clinical_result_layer_factor: Age, ECOG status, and oropharynx site
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II randomized trial of radiotherapy with pembrolizumab vs. cisplatin for unfavorable-risk p16+ head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (KEYCHAIN).

data.clinical_result_summary: Long-term follow-up demonstrated improved overall survival trends and sustained transfusion-independence and hemoglobin responses with luspatercept versus epoetin alfa in erythropoiesis-stimulating agent-naive patients with lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes. No new safety concerns emerged, reinforcing the superior clinical benefit of luspatercept as first-line treatment in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: erythropoiesis stimulating agent (ESA)–naive patients (pts) with very low-, low-, or intermediate-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS)
clinical_result_layer_factor: baseline transfusion burden, ring sideroblasts, and serum erythropoietin
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated overall survival (OS) and long-term transfusion-independence (TI) from the phase 3 COMMANDS trial in erythropoiesis-stimulating agent (ESA)–naive patients (pts) with lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (LR-MDS).

data.clinical_result_summary: Use of adjuvant capecitabine in routine practice was strongly influenced by residual disease burden and pathologic stage, suggesting treatment selection was driven primarily by perceived recurrence risk rather than standardized criteria. Inferior outcomes in unadjusted analyses most likely reflected confounding by indication rather than treatment harm or lack of efficacy. Future integration of molecular phenotype data may refine post-neoadjuvant risk stratification and help identify biologically defined subgroups most likely to benefit from adjuvant capecitabine.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with triple-negative breast cancer (ER/PR ≤10%, HER2-) who had received at least 1 cycle of neoadjuvant therapy between 2014 and 2024 and had at least 6 months of follow-up after surgery were included; patients with inflammatory disease or prior anti-HER2/endocrine therapy were excluded, with a focus on patients with residual triple-negative breast cancer after neoadjuvant therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes in triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) in patients with residual disease after neoadjuvant therapy (NEOCAPE).

data.clinical_result_summary: The final analysis of ARROW confirms that pralsetinib yielded clinically meaningful and durable responses in patients with RET-altered thyroid cancer and medullary thyroid cancer. Safety was manageable and consistent with prior reports.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with previously treated RET fusion-positive TC (RET-fp TC)
patients with RET-mutant Medullary Thyroid Cancer who were naïve to systemic treatment
patients with RET-mutant Medullary Thyroid Cancer who were previously treated with vandetanib or cabozantinib
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of pralsetinib in advanced or metastatic RET-altered thyroid cancer (TC): Final analysis of the phase 1/2 ARROW study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab combined with AK117 and chemotherapy showed encouraging efficacy and manageable safety as first-line treatment for advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer. Updated follow-up continued to support clinical activity, with no treatment-related deaths reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced gastric (G) or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) cadonilimab plus AK117 and chemotherapy (chemo) in advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJC): Updated results from a phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ipatasertib plus pembrolizumab demonstrated an acceptable safety profile and promising clinical activity in relapsed/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 2 study of ipatasertib in combination with pembrolizumab for first-line treatment of recurrent or metastatic squamous cell cancer of the head and neck.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this phase 1b/2 study of patients with ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer, vepdegestrant plus abemaciclib demonstrated antitumor activity. The safety profile was generally consistent with the known profiles of each agent.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic ER+/HER2- breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Vepdegestrant, a proteolysis targeting chimera (PROTAC) estrogen receptor (ER) degrader, plus abemaciclib (ABE) in ER+/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2−) advanced breast cancer (ABC): TACTIVE-U phase 1b/2 results.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: Tucatinib plus subcutaneous trastuzumab and hyaluronidase demonstrated antitumor activity in patients with advanced solid tumors with ERBB2 alterations, warranting additional study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with solid tumors with ERBB2 alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tucatinib + subcutaneous (SC) trastuzumab (Tuc + Trast SC) in patients (pts) with solid tumors with ERBB2 alterations (alts): Results from the targeted agent and profiling utilization registry (TAPUR) study.

data.clinical_result_summary: IOS-1002 plus pembrolizumab demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy in pretreated anti-PD-1/PD-L1-relapsed/refractory patients. Biomarker-driven patient selection using dual-high TIS and target receptor expression enhanced ORR to 75% and strongly predicted response depth, durability, and survival benefit. The combination had a favorable safety profile with no incremental immune-related toxicity, supporting Phase 1b expansion in biomarker-selected PD-1/PD-L1-refractory solid tumors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors progressing on prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Re-sensitizing PD-1/PD-L1 relapsed/refractory solid tumors: Phase 1a results of IOS-1002, a LILRB1/2 and KIR3DL1 checkpoint inhibitor, in combination with pembrolizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this prospective cohort, new keratinocyte cancers occurred at approximately twice the rate after discontinuation of pembrolizumab compared with during active therapy. These findings support the hypothesis that immune checkpoint inhibitors may suppress carcinogenesis within chronically damaged skin fields, although larger studies are needed to clarify the potential immunopreventative effect.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study evaluated patients with resectable cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, in the context of patients with advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma or basal cell carcinoma who frequently develop new primary keratinocyte cancers due to field cancerisation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Incidence of new keratinocyte cancers during pembrolizumab in resectable cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma: The De-Squamate study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lorlatinib demonstrated potent efficacy as first-line treatment for Chinese patients with ALK-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer, achieving a 12-month PFS rate of 96.1% regardless of baseline brain metastasis status. Its safety profile was consistent with the CROWN study, with the most common grade 3–4 adverse events being hypertriglyceridemia and hypercholesterolemia. The study is ongoing, with plans to expand the sample size and conduct long-term follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled adult Chinese patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed ALK-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer receiving first-line lorlatinib therapy from 2022 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Lorlatinib as first-line therapy for ALK-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer: A retrospective, multicenter, real-world study from China.

data.clinical_result_summary: Catequentinib hydrochloride demonstrated meaningful antitumor activity and durable responses in adults with advanced alveolar soft part sarcoma. Although the ORR of 26.8% was slightly below the predefined 31% threshold, prolonged disease control, favorable PFS and OS outcomes, and a manageable safety profile supported its clinical benefit in this ultra-rare sarcoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adults with advanced or metastatic alveolar soft part sarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 3 study (APROMISS) of catequentinib hydrochloride (AL3818) monotherapy in patients with advanced alveolar soft part sarcoma (ASPS).

data.clinical_result_summary: FZ-AD004 demonstrated a manageable safety profile with no dose-limiting toxicities observed up to 12.0 mg/kg. It showed promising antitumor activity in heavily pretreated non-small-cell lung cancer patients, particularly at doses of 8.0 and 10.0 mg/kg, which are being further explored in the expansion phase.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable, treatment-refractory or relapsed solid tumors, mainly non-small-cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dose-escalation results from a phase I study of FZ-AD004, a TROP2-directed ADC, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world cohort, the cumulative incidence of T-DXd-related interstitial lung disease was approximately 19% when accounting for competing risks. Baseline renal impairment, prior lung radiotherapy, and systemic inflammatory status identified patients at increased risk and may support risk-adapted monitoring and earlier clinical intervention during T-DXd treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively collected data from 406 patients with metastatic breast cancer, including 223 HER2-positive and 162 HER2-low patients, who were treated with T-DXd between October 2024 and January 2026 in 16 Italian institutions.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cumulative incidence and risk factors of trastuzumab deruxtecan–related interstitial lung disease in a multicenter real-world cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among adults with asthma and cancer, ICI exposure was associated with increased risks of hospitalization, respiratory failure, drug-induced interstitial lung disorders, and mortality compared with non-ICI systemic therapy. These findings support close pulmonary monitoring and risk mitigation when initiating ICIs in patients with asthma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years with asthma and malignancy, comparing patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors after cancer diagnosis with patients receiving non-ICI systemic therapy and no ICI exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitors and respiratory outcomes in cancer patients with pre-existing asthma: A TriNetX propensity-matched cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: 64Cu-SARTATE was safe and well tolerated in patients with gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors. SARTATE had higher lesion detection than DOTATATE and detected additional true-positive lesions, which may help inform treatment decisions.
clinical_result_indication_name: 胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with known or suspected gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DISCO update: Diagnostic performance of 64Cu-SARTATE compared to 68Ga-DOTATATE in patients with known or suspected neuroendocrine tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Encouraging efficacy and durable responses were observed in patients with endometrial and ovarian carcinosarcoma treated with lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab, regardless of MMR status or primary site. The study met its predefined interim analysis endpoint, and no new safety signals were identified.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with endometrial or ovarian carcinosarcoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II trial of lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab in patients (pts) with endometrial or ovarian carcinosarcoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: T-Bren demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated patients with recurrent or metastatic ovarian cancer. The 3.8 mg/kg dose administered on day 1 every 3 weeks was selected as the recommended phase 3 dose.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent or metastatic (R/M) ovarian cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: T-Bren (BL-M07D1) in patients with recurrent or metastatic (R/M) ovarian cancer: Results from two phase II studies.

data.clinical_result_summary: Nivolumab was well tolerated and showed efficacy in patients with recurrent IDH-mutant gliomas with low TMB. Ongoing clinical, PRO, and immune monitoring may help determine whether tumor TMB correlates with response to ICI therapy in IDH-mutant gliomas.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent IDH-mutant gliomas with and without hypermutation phenotype
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II trial evaluating nivolumab in patients with recurrent IDH-mutant gliomas with and without hypermutation phenotype.

data.clinical_result_summary: Molecular ctDNA profiling showed that first-line zanidatamab plus chemotherapy in HER2-positive metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma could markedly reduce total ctDNA levels and ERBB2 amplification detection early in treatment. Antitumor activity was observed among patients whose tumors harbored ERBB2 and PIK3CA mutations, which are associated with resistance to standard HER2-targeted therapies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients had first-line HER2-positive advanced or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma; part 1 included patients with HER2-expressing disease (IHC 3+ or 2+), and part 2 included patients with centrally assessed HER2-positive disease (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/FISH+).
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Molecular circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) profiling from patients (pts) treated with zanidatamab + chemotherapy (CT) in first-line (1L) HER2-positive (HER2+) advanced or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (mGEA).

data.clinical_result_summary: This first-in-human, multicenter Phase 1/2 trial is evaluating REGN5668-based combinations in patients with platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer or endometrial cancer. Module 1 dose expansion has opened with the first two patients enrolled, and Module 2 dose escalation has progressed through multiple dose levels with enrollment ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study includes patients with platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer or endometrial cancer; ovarian cancer patients must have histologically confirmed advanced epithelial ovarian cancer except carcinosarcoma, at least 1 prior line of platinum-based systemic therapy, and relapse or progression during the most recent therapy, while endometrial cancer patients must have histologically confirmed endometrial cancer with recurrence or progression after anti–PD-1 therapy and platinum-based chemotherapy, no more than 4 prior lines of systemic therapy, at least 30 days since anti–PD-1 therapy administration, and at least 25% MUC16-positive tumor cells.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of REGN5668, a MUC16×CD28 costimulatory bispecific antibody, in combination with other targeted therapies, in patients with recurrent ovarian or endometrial cancer: Trial in progress update.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination treatment of RGL-270 and adebrelimab demonstrated a favorable safety profile, promising efficacy, and robust immunogenicity. These preliminary results support further development of PCV-based anti-tumor therapy in the adjuvant setting for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity of adjuvant therapy with personalized cancer vaccine (PCV) RGL-270 in combination with adebrelimab and mFOLFIRINOX in resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this Central European cohort, the observed real-world survival outcomes are consistent with those reported in the registration trial. These findings support the effectiveness of pembrolizumab-chemotherapy in routine practice and suggest the prognostic relevance of metastatic pattern and disease-free interval in patients with advanced TNBC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced triple-negative breast cancer with programmed death-ligand 1 combined positive score ≥10 treated with first-line pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in routine practice.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world survival outcomes with pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in advanced triple-negative breast cancer: Multicenter evidence from Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia.

data.clinical_result_summary: In EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer patients with metachronous brain metastases after earlier-generation tyrosine kinase inhibitor failure, targeted escalation with osimertinib was associated with significantly lower 180-day mortality compared with chemotherapy. IO-based approaches showed intermediate, directionally favorable but non-significant outcomes relative to both osimertinib and chemotherapy. These real-world findings support guideline recommendations prioritizing next-generation tyrosine kinase inhibitors and inform systemic treatment sequencing in a CNS-enriched population where prospective data remain limited.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer patients treated with first- or second-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors who subsequently developed metachronous brain metastases and initiated next-line systemic therapy between 2015 and 2025, excluding patients with leptomeningeal disease prior to earlier-generation TKI exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of systemic therapy sequencing after earlier-generation EGFR TKI failure in NSCLC with brain metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Low-dose chemotherapy may safely prolong survival in a majority of patients with treatment-naïve advanced pancreatic cancer identified by favorable prognostic blood tests, as well as in select patients with resistant advanced pancreatic cancer and A.L.A.N. scores of 0–2. Future trials integrating independent prognostic blood tests and interactive biomarkers may refine patient selection, support lower-dose strategies, and improve understanding of host-cell–associated resistance mechanisms.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with treatment-naïve or resistant stage IV advanced pancreatic cancer and ECOG performance status 0–2 were enrolled; resistant advanced pancreatic cancer tumors had progressed after FOLFIRINOX, gemcitabine with nab-paclitaxel, or both.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Routine prognostic blood tests to compare survival outcomes with low-dose therapy in treatment-naïve and resistant advanced pancreatic cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: This preliminary analysis suggests that cadonilimab combined with anlotinib shows promising antitumor activity and manageable safety in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer after systemic therapy failure and resistance to anti–PD-(L)1 antibody treatment. Enrollment is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer refractory to prior systemic therapy including anti–PD-(L)1 antibodies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cadonilimab combined with anlotinib in patients with advanced NSCLC refractory to prior systemic therapy and anti–PD-(L)1 antibodies: A phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This exploratory study demonstrates that a tumor-naive, methylation-based ctDNA approach may be a viable tool for monitoring CDK4/6 pathway response in advanced E/GEJ cancers. Early molecular progressive disease detection at one month by ctDNA kinetics strongly correlated with shorter progression-free survival, offering a rapid signal of efficacy. Distinct baseline methylation patterns in rapid progressors suggest the potential of upfront epigenetic profiling to risk-stratify patients before treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic or recurrent esophageal and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma who had progressed after frontline therapy, including heavily pretreated patients with advanced metastatic E/GEJ disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Epigenetic ctDNA kinetics as a predictor of early progression in advanced E/GEJ cancers treated with CDK4/6 and VEGF inhibition therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Durvalumab plus amrubicin showed favorable efficacy and tolerable safety in patients with relapsed small cell lung cancer, particularly in the refractory relapsed group. The combination also appeared active even in patients who had previously received immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with sensitive relapsed or refractory relapsed small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A multi-institutional, single-arm, phase 2 study of durvalumab plus amrubicin in patients with relapsed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (Aphrodite trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this single-institution study, patients with pancreatic and unknown primary neuroendocrine tumors had a higher overall response rate to 177Lu-PRRT than patients with other primary sites. Response to PRRT was commonly seen in liver metastases, while peritoneal and bone metastases had lower response rates but stable disease was achieved in most patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with histologically confirmed metastatic neuroendocrine tumor who received at least one cycle of 177Lu-PRRT and had baseline and post-treatment imaging available for response assessment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world evidence of response to 177Lu-DOTATATE peptide receptor radionuclide therapy (PRRT) based on primary and metastatic sites in patients (pts) with neuroendocrine tumor (NET).

data.clinical_result_summary: In EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer patients with metachronous brain metastases after earlier-generation tyrosine kinase inhibitor failure, targeted escalation with osimertinib was associated with significantly lower 180-day mortality compared with chemotherapy. IO-based approaches showed intermediate, directionally favorable but non-significant outcomes relative to both osimertinib and chemotherapy. These real-world findings support guideline recommendations prioritizing next-generation tyrosine kinase inhibitors and inform systemic treatment sequencing in a CNS-enriched population where prospective data remain limited.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer patients treated with first- or second-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors who subsequently developed metachronous brain metastases and initiated next-line systemic therapy between 2015 and 2025, excluding patients with leptomeningeal disease prior to earlier-generation TKI exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of systemic therapy sequencing after earlier-generation EGFR TKI failure in NSCLC with brain metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of LB1410 and LB4330 showed a manageable safety profile consistent with each monotherapy. Early clinical data in patients with favorable-risk clear cell renal cell carcinoma support the potential efficacy of LB4330 as an immune-enhancing agent, and efficacy expansion studies are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I/II study of LB1410, a bivalent TIM-3/PD-1 bispecific antibody, in combination with LB4330, a long-acting IL-10, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line treatment of atypical EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC with amivantamab plus lazertinib resulted in a clinically meaningful median overall survival of nearly 3.5 years. Many patients were able to remain on first-line treatment long term, with 20% still ongoing, and no additional safety signals were identified with longer-term follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with atypical EGFR mutations, excluding Ex20ins, who were treatment-naïve (cohort C)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overall survival of first-line amivantamab plus lazertinib in atypical EGFR-mutated advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Updated results from the CHRYSALIS-2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Olverembatinib combined with blinatumomab showed promising clinical activity in patients with relapsed/refractory Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia or lymphoid blast phase chronic myeloid leukemia outside China, with encouraging response rates and minimal residual disease clearance. The regimen was generally well tolerated, with a safety profile consistent with the individual agent toxicities, supporting further investigation of this chemotherapy-free approach.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory Ph+ B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia or CML-LBP outside China
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Olverembatinib (HQP1351) combined with blinatumomab in patients with lymphoid blast phase chronic myeloid leukemia (CML-LBP) or Philadelphia chromosome–positive B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (Ph+ BCP-ALL).

data.clinical_result_summary: During belzutifan treatment holiday, most evaluable CNS lesions demonstrated mild volumetric increase over time, although lesion behavior was heterogeneous and occurred over several months rather than immediately after treatment withholding. These findings provide early lesion-level insight into CNS hemangioblastoma dynamics during belzutifan holidays and support cautious clinical monitoring during treatment interruption.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included von Hippel–Lindau disease patients with central nervous system hemangioblastomas treated with belzutifan at Massachusetts General Brigham Cancer Institute between September 2018 and January 2026 who experienced a treatment interruption of at least 3 months, with treatment holiday offered after at least 9 months of sustained maximal response.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Volumetric analysis of central nervous system hemangioblastomas during belzutifan treatment holiday in von Hippel–Lindau (VHL) disease patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: Gefitinib plasma levels were comparable between morning and evening dosing, but morning administration was associated with greater EGFR reduction, suggesting potential chrono-efficacy advantages. Low adherence highlights the need for interventions, and larger trials are needed to validate optimal timing to enhance outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer patients aged ≥18 years with ECOG ≤2 and no CYP3A4 modulators or steroids were included, described in the results as EGFR-sensitized non-small cell lung cancer patients starting gefitinib 250 mg daily.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Pilot RCT to study the effect of chronotherapy on gefitinib plasma concentrations and adherence in lung cancer patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: SIM0505, a first-in-class CDH6 CPT116 payload ADC, showed manageable safety and tolerability, including at higher dose levels, with encouraging efficacy in ovarian cancer and uterine serous cancer and a favorable pharmacokinetic profile. These data support initiating the dose optimization portion of the study in gynecological cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced OC
patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I, multicenter, first-in-human (FIH) global study of SIM0505, an anti-CDH6 (CDH6) antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Belzutifan showed comparable survival and healthcare utilization outcomes regardless of prior immune checkpoint inhibitor exposure, supporting the premise that its efficacy is independent of immune priming. These findings suggest that belzutifan may be an appropriate therapeutic option for immune checkpoint inhibitor-ineligible patients who have received VEGF-targeted TKIs.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged 18 years or older with renal cell carcinoma who received belzutifan, excluding patients with Von Hippel–Lindau syndrome.
clinical_result_layer_factor: demographic variables, laboratory parameters, prior nephrectomy, and cardiovascular/cerebrovascular/autoimmune comorbidities
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of prior immune checkpoint inhibition on the clinical efficacy of belzutifan in advanced renal cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: LY4052031 demonstrated promising clinical activity at multiple dose levels, including in enfortumab vedotin-pretreated metastatic urothelial carcinoma. CYP2D6 activity score-specific dose optimization is ongoing, and updated results will be presented.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma or other selected solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial results from NEXUS-01, a phase 1 study of LY4052031, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4, in participants with advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of hepatocellular carcinoma progressing on systemic and local therapies, nivolumab plus ipilimumab demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy and manageable toxicity as later-line therapy. These findings support nivolumab plus ipilimumab as a viable salvage option in the later-line setting and warrant prospective evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HCC patients who received nivolumab plus ipilimumab as later-line treatment, including patients with hepatocellular carcinoma progressing on systemic and local therapies.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Nivolumab and ipilimumab as second or later line therapy in hepatocellular carcinoma: A retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: CS2009 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors. These findings warrant further clinical development in an ongoing phase 2 study in nine tumor types.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CS2009, a novel PD-1/VEGF/CTLA-4 trispecific antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Updated results from an open-label, multicenter, phase 1 first-in-human study.
