data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and hepatocellular carcinoma treated with atezolizumab plus bevacizumab, prior GLP-1RA exposure was associated with significantly improved overall survival and a reduced risk of major adverse cardiovascular events compared with alternative antihyperglycemic therapies. These findings suggest a potential synergistic role for GLP-1RAs in this population and support prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and type 2 diabetes mellitus initiating atezolizumab plus bevacizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of GLP-1 receptor agonists on outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma patients treated with atezolizumab plus bevacizumab: A multicenter propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: LB-LR1109 is being evaluated in an ongoing first-in-human phase 1 study as monotherapy in advanced solid tumors and in combination with atezolizumab in advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Early escalation to DL7 reported no dose-limiting toxicities and supports continued clinical development.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced/metastatic renal cell carcinoma, non-small cell lung cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, urothelial carcinoma, or melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase 1a/1b study of LB-LR1109, an anti-LILRB1 monoclonal antibody, as monotherapy in advanced solid tumors and in combination with atezolizumab in advanced NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: The first stage of this response-guided study met its predefined efficacy threshold of at least 6 pathologic complete responses in 20 patients. The neoadjuvant regimen combining dalpiciclib, an aromatase inhibitor, and dual HER2 blockade showed promising pathologic complete response rates and a favorable safety profile in triple-positive breast cancer, supporting continued evaluation in the second stage of the trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage II–IIIa HR+/HER2+ invasive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant dalpiciclib combined with letrozole and dual HER2 blockade in HR+/HER2+ breast cancer: First-stage results of the HELEN HER2 017 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of PD-1 inhibitor, SCRT, and chemotherapy showed promising efficacy and significantly improved pCR rates in patients with MSS/pMMR high-risk locally advanced colon cancer. This regimen may provide a new therapeutic option to achieve R0 resection and improve long-term survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with microsatellite stable or mismatch-repair proficient locally advanced colon cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy combined with radiochemotherapy vs chemotherapy alone in pMMR colon cancers: The TORCH-C randomized phase 2 clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: PIM use in geriatric patients undergoing treatment for prostate cancer was associated with worse performance status, functional status, and overall survival. These findings raise the question of whether PIM use reduces patients' eligibility to receive prostate cancer-directed treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients aged 65 to 90 who were being treated for prostate cancer were divided into those receiving potentially inappropriate medications and those not receiving potentially inappropriate medications.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The impact of potentially inappropriate medications on performance status, functional status, and overall survival in older adults with prostate cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant tislelizumab combined with platinum-doublet chemotherapy achieved a high mandibular preservation rate and a favorable pathological response profile with manageable toxicity in patients with locally advanced, resectable oral squamous cell carcinoma. This strategy represents a promising organ-preserving approach, and longer follow-up is ongoing to determine long-term survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced, resectable oral squamous cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Mandibular preservation with neoadjuvant tislelizumab plus platinum-doublet chemotherapy in locally advanced resectable oral squamous cell carcinoma: A prospective phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: CS2009 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors. These findings warrant further clinical development in an ongoing phase 2 study in nine tumor types.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CS2009, a novel PD-1/VEGF/CTLA-4 trispecific antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Updated results from an open-label, multicenter, phase 1 first-in-human study.

data.clinical_result_summary: SHR-1826 demonstrated encouraging activity with manageable safety in heavily pretreated patients with MET-altered EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma. Multiple trials are ongoing to assess SHR-1826 combined with other anti-tumor therapies in non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors harboring MET alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SHR-1826, a c-MET directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), in advanced solid tumors: Updates from a phase 1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: With nearly 6 years of follow-up, DaraKPd in lenalidomide-exposed and anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody-naïve relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma showed deep and durable responses, with a median progression-free survival of 38.3 months and 36-month overall survival of 75%. These long-term follow-up data support DaraKPd as a safe and effective treatment in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Final analysis of daratumumab, carfilzomib, pomalidomide, and dexamethasone in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results show that mezigdomide induced a decrease in suppressive cells, a shift in T cells from an exhausted to an activated phenotype, and expansion of highly activated HLA-DR+/CD38+ CAR T cells after idecabtagene vicleucel infusion. Future studies should investigate whether these changes correlate with efficacy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after idecabtagene vicleucel infusion.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Expansion of a highly activated (HLA-DR+/CD38+) CAR T cell population after mezigdomide exposure post–idecabtagene vicleucel infusion in relapsed multiple myeloma.

data.clinical_result_summary: rhTPO exhibits significant efficacy and a favorable safety profile in managing thrombocytopenia associated with combinatorial interventional therapy with targeted and immunotherapy in HCC. A minimum treatment duration of 7 days may be pivotal for maximizing platelet recovery and facilitating treatment continuity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included HCC patients in China who developed thrombocytopenia, defined as platelets ≤80×109/L, after combined interventional, targeted, and immunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of recombinant human thrombopoietin (rhTPO) for thrombocytopenia induced by combinatorial interventional, targeted, and immunotherapy in hepatocellular carcinoma (SYNERGY-TPOACT): A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: QL1706 combined with nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine demonstrated promising antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile as first-line treatment for advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: QL1706 combined with nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine as first-line treatment for locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma: A prospective, multicenter, single-arm phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first-in-human trial of META 10-19, an IL-10-expressing anti-CD19 CAR T-cell product, for relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma showed a manageable safety profile and durable efficacy at ultra-low doses in patients with high-risk features. Larger cohorts and longer follow-up are ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with r/r DLBCL
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1 study of META 10-19, an IL-10-expressing, anti-CD19 CAR T cell product in patients with high-risk DLBCL.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant adebrelimab combined with cisplatin and docetaxel achieved a high pathological response rate in patients with stage IVB oral squamous cell carcinoma. Adverse events were manageable, and the safety profile was favorable.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with clinical stage IVB oral squamous cell carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A prospective, single-arm, phase II exploratory clinical study on the efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant adebrelimab combined with cisplatin and docetaxel in patients with clinical stage IVB oral squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: The four-drug regimen anchored by osimertinib was well tolerated and active in patients with EGFR-mutated metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer harboring concurrent mutations. The regimen showed high objective response and disease control rates, with no toxicity-related deaths reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with EGFRm metastatic nsq NSCLC harboring concurrent mutations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Osimertinib combined with bevacizumab and chemotherapy as 1L treatment in EGFR-mutated metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (nsq NSCLC) with concurrent mutations.

data.clinical_result_summary: This exploratory study demonstrates that a tumor-naive, methylation-based ctDNA approach may be a viable tool for monitoring CDK4/6 pathway response in advanced E/GEJ cancers. Early molecular progressive disease detection at one month by ctDNA kinetics strongly correlated with shorter progression-free survival, offering a rapid signal of efficacy. Distinct baseline methylation patterns in rapid progressors suggest the potential of upfront epigenetic profiling to risk-stratify patients before treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic or recurrent esophageal and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma who had progressed after frontline therapy, including heavily pretreated patients with advanced metastatic E/GEJ disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Epigenetic ctDNA kinetics as a predictor of early progression in advanced E/GEJ cancers treated with CDK4/6 and VEGF inhibition therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: After neoadjuvant therapy, preoperative MRI accurately predicted pathologic complete response in 86% of patients with HER2-positive/ER-negative disease and may help identify patients who can proceed directly to surgery. MRI was insufficient to predict pathologic complete response for patients with HER2-positive/ER-positive disease, although MRI-indicated residual disease was accurate in 80% of these patients. Combining MRI with biomarkers such as tissue-based markers or circulating tumor DNA may improve prediction of pathologic complete response and personalize treatment decisions in HER2-positive breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with stage II-IIIA HER2-positive breast cancer, including HER2-positive/ER-negative and HER2-positive/ER-positive disease subsets.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EA1181: Accuracy of pre-surgery MRI to predict pathologic complete response after taxane, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab (THP) in HER2-positive breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant GIRE improved invasive disease-free survival and distant recurrence-free interval versus standard-of-care endocrine therapy, with benefit consistent regardless of menopausal status. Safety was comparable between menopausal groups, with few treatment discontinuations, and GIRE was associated with fewer discontinuations than aromatase inhibitor or tamoxifen therapy in the respective menopausal settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with estrogen receptor-positive, HER2-negative, Stage I–III early breast cancer who had breast cancer surgery and received neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy if indicated were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of giredestrant (GIRE) in patients (pts) with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer (ER+, HER2– eBC) in the phase III lidERA BC clinical trial: Results by menopausal status.

data.clinical_result_summary: At this safety interim analysis, no recurrent or new severe immune-related adverse events were observed, indicating an encouraging signal for the efficacy of siltuximab to reduce the severity of immune-related adverse events from anti-PD-1 therapy. Disease stabilization was observed in 40% of patients, and enrollment is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_name: 免疫检查点抑制剂相关毒性
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with any advanced cancer who had prior severe immune-related adverse events (irAEs) that warranted stopping immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) but have recovered to Grade ≤1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Siltuximab for the prevention of severe immune-related adverse events during immune checkpoint inhibitor rechallenge in advanced cancer: First interim analysis of the CIRES trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this updated analysis, iruplinalkib demonstrated durable clinical efficacy in heavily pretreated ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma patients progressing on lorlatinib, including those with a high burden of brain metastases. The median PFS of 12.4 months and OS of 22.1 months in a ≥4th-line setting supports iruplinalkib as a promising salvage option, with safety profiles consistent with previous reports and no new safety signals observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ALK-positive advanced lung adenocarcinoma who were heavily pretreated and received iruplinalkib after progression on or intolerance to lorlatinib were included, including patients with a high burden of brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of iruplinalkib in ALK-positive advanced lung adenocarcinoma patients previously treated with lorlatinib.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with solid tumors, BAL0891 demonstrated linear and dose-proportional pharmacokinetics. Model-based simulations predict that repeated dosing will result in consistent plasma exposure, with no evidence of clinically relevant inter-occasional variability. Neutropenia risk was quantitatively described in a dose-dependent manner, enabling characterization of the exposure-toxicity relationship.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical pharmacokinetics and neutropenia-related pharmacodynamics of BAL0891 in patients with solid tumors.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 3-4级治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_summary: GOLCA plus Pola-RCHP demonstrated a predictable and manageable safety profile, and adding GOLCA did not compromise median dose intensity of Pola-RCHP. The 0.4 mg dose produced a high rate of durable complete metabolic responses, high MRD negativity, and a promising 12-month PFS rate in newly diagnosed aggressive B-cell lymphoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients (pts) with newly diagnosed aggressive B-cell lymphoma (a-BCL):
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 3-4级治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Golcadomide (GOLCA), a potential, first-in-class, oral CELMoD, + Pola-RCHP in patients (pts) with newly diagnosed aggressive B-cell lymphoma (a-BCL): Safety and 12-month (mo) efficacy results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Durable remissions with very low rates of severe cytokine release syndrome and immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome were achieved with tisa-cel in a very high-risk population with persistent minimal residual disease during frontline therapy. Nearly 50% of patients received new anticancer therapy, including stem cell transplant, without prior relapse, and longer follow-up is needed to confirm 5-year disease-free survival.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: pediatric and young adult patients with high-risk B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia and minimal residual disease at the end of frontline consolidation
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Tisagenlecleucel (tisa-cel) in pediatric and young adult patients with high-risk (HR) B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) and minimal residual disease (MRD) at the end of frontline consolidation (EOC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Cohort 1 of this ongoing first-in-human study was completed without dose-limiting toxicity. Enrollment and dose escalation are continuing, and efficacy conclusions are not yet available.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with progressive, locally advanced (unresectable), or metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human phase 1 dose escalation and expansion study of PIN-5018, a CK1α-selective molecular glue degrader, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study demonstrates real-world evidence regarding the ease and safety of initiating single-agent venetoclax in the outpatient setting across a heterogeneous CLL population. Venetoclax-based therapy should be considered a safe, easy-to-initiate viable option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in the CLL population initiated venetoclax when absolute lymphocyte count was <20,000 K/mL, adenopathy was <5 cm by exam, splenomegaly had resolved if present by exam, and CrCl was >45 mL/min.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcome of low-frequency outpatient monitoring for venetoclax initiation in CLL: Single-center experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: The recommended phase 2 dose is LB-100 1.75 mg/m2 plus doxorubicin 75 mg/m2 based on tolerance and activity. The combination showed preliminary activity in advanced soft tissue sarcomas and warrants testing in phase II trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with advanced soft tissue sarcomas
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I trial of LB-100 plus doxorubicin as first-line of advanced soft tissue sarcomas: A Spanish Sarcoma Group (GEIS) study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Lorlatinib demonstrated potent efficacy as first-line treatment for Chinese patients with ALK-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer, achieving a 12-month PFS rate of 96.1% regardless of baseline brain metastasis status. Its safety profile was consistent with the CROWN study, with the most common grade 3–4 adverse events being hypertriglyceridemia and hypercholesterolemia. The study is ongoing, with plans to expand the sample size and conduct long-term follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled adult Chinese patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed ALK-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer receiving first-line lorlatinib therapy from 2022 to 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Lorlatinib as first-line therapy for ALK-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer: A retrospective, multicenter, real-world study from China.

data.clinical_result_summary: MACE following definitive local therapy did not significantly improve overall survival in locally advanced oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma. However, a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival was observed, driven by a reduction in distant metastases and second primary malignancies. These findings suggest that selected high-risk subgroups, particularly patients with extranodal extension and advanced-stage disease, may derive benefit from this low-cost and well-tolerated strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage II–IV oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma who were clinico-radiologically disease-free 1–2 months after completion of definitive surgery with adjuvant treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Metronomic adjuvant chemotherapy (MACE) in locally advanced oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma post-surgery and adjuvant treatment (MACE postop): A phase III randomized controlled trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: QL1706 plus bevacizumab demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and lung metastases. The high response rate observed in lung lesions highlights the potential of intensified immunotherapy combined with anti-VEGF therapy for this subgroup, warranting further validation in phase III trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had unresectable, advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and confirmed lung metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: QL1706 (PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific antibody) plus bevacizumab specific for patients with hepatocellular carcinoma combined with lung metastasis: A secondary analysis of a prospective, single-arm, phase Ib/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ripretinib did not alter the pharmacokinetics of midazolam and was not a clinically relevant CYP3A modulator. Ripretinib exhibited a manageable safety profile consistent with its established use in advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor.
clinical_result_indication_detail: adult patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effect of ripretinib on the pharmacokinetics (PK) of midazolam (MDZ), a sensitive CYP3A probe substrate, in adult patients (pts) with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST).

data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up, both ZG006 10 mg Q2W and 30 mg Q2W continued to demonstrate robust antitumor activity, with a trend of longer duration of response and overall survival in patients with relapsed or refractory small cell lung cancer. Subgroup analyses demonstrated consistent antitumor activity across key prognostic subgroups, supporting further development of ZG006 in small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results of the randomized phase 2 dose optimization study of alveltamig (ZG006), a trispecific T cell engager targeting DLL3/DLL3/CD3, as monotherapy in patients with advanced small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: BGB-B2033 was generally well tolerated, with limited immune-mediated adverse events in this predominantly second-line or later hepatocellular carcinoma population. Durable responses were observed in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma, including patients with prior PD-(L)1-based treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with selected advanced or metastatic solid tumors (part A)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1 study of BGB-B2033 (GPC3 x 4-1BB bispecific antibody) monotherapy in patients with selected advanced or metastatic solid tumors: First disclosure of clinical data.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant GIRE improved invasive disease-free survival and distant recurrence-free interval versus standard-of-care endocrine therapy, with benefit consistent regardless of menopausal status. Safety was comparable between menopausal groups, with few treatment discontinuations, and GIRE was associated with fewer discontinuations than aromatase inhibitor or tamoxifen therapy in the respective menopausal settings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with estrogen receptor-positive, HER2-negative, Stage I–III early breast cancer who had breast cancer surgery and received neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy if indicated were enrolled.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of giredestrant (GIRE) in patients (pts) with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer (ER+, HER2– eBC) in the phase III lidERA BC clinical trial: Results by menopausal status.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this updated analysis, iruplinalkib demonstrated durable clinical efficacy in heavily pretreated ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma patients progressing on lorlatinib, including those with a high burden of brain metastases. The median PFS of 12.4 months and OS of 22.1 months in a ≥4th-line setting supports iruplinalkib as a promising salvage option, with safety profiles consistent with previous reports and no new safety signals observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with ALK-positive advanced lung adenocarcinoma who were heavily pretreated and received iruplinalkib after progression on or intolerance to lorlatinib were included, including patients with a high burden of brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world efficacy and safety of iruplinalkib in ALK-positive advanced lung adenocarcinoma patients previously treated with lorlatinib.

data.clinical_result_summary: rhTPO exhibits significant efficacy and a favorable safety profile in managing thrombocytopenia associated with combinatorial interventional therapy with targeted and immunotherapy in HCC. A minimum treatment duration of 7 days may be pivotal for maximizing platelet recovery and facilitating treatment continuity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included HCC patients in China who developed thrombocytopenia, defined as platelets ≤80×109/L, after combined interventional, targeted, and immunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of recombinant human thrombopoietin (rhTPO) for thrombocytopenia induced by combinatorial interventional, targeted, and immunotherapy in hepatocellular carcinoma (SYNERGY-TPOACT): A retrospective cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic tocilizumab substantially reduced cytokine release syndrome incidence among patients with small cell lung cancer receiving tarlatamab, suggesting a feasible and safe mitigation strategy. Compared with historical DeLLphi-301 data, this cohort had markedly lower toxicity rates with prophylactic IL-6 blockade, and larger prospective studies are warranted to confirm safety, efficacy, and cost-effectiveness.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively analyzed 32 consecutive patients with small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab at a single center.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prophylactic tocilizumab to mitigate cytokine release syndrome in patients receiving tarlatamab: A single‑center exploratory experience informed by bispecific antibody safety data.

data.clinical_result_summary: Olverembatinib combined with blinatumomab showed promising clinical activity in patients with relapsed/refractory Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia or lymphoid blast phase chronic myeloid leukemia outside China, with encouraging response rates and minimal residual disease clearance. The regimen was generally well tolerated, with a safety profile consistent with the individual agent toxicities, supporting further investigation of this chemotherapy-free approach.
clinical_result_indication_name: B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory Ph+ B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia or CML-LBP outside China
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Olverembatinib (HQP1351) combined with blinatumomab in patients with lymphoid blast phase chronic myeloid leukemia (CML-LBP) or Philadelphia chromosome–positive B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (Ph+ BCP-ALL).

data.clinical_result_summary: Camrelizumab plus rivoceranib with TACE provided statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival versus TACE alone in TACE-eligible unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma. Safety was manageable, supporting this regimen as a potential new treatment option, and follow-up for overall survival is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with TACE-eligible unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Camrelizumab (C) plus rivoceranib (R) with transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) vs TACE alone in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (uHCC): A randomized, phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among breast cancer patients receiving paclitaxel chemotherapy, co-treatment with lithium was not superior to placebo for the development of polyneuropathy as measured by total neuropathy score reduced. However, lithium was associated with better patient-reported outcomes, including quality of life and pain, as well as lower rates of adverse events. These observations warrant confirmation in a larger phase 3 interventional trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: breast cancer patients aged 18-70 years, with no pre-existing polyneuropathy and to be treated with paclitaxel
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prevention of paclitaxel-induced neurotoxicity with lithium: Results from a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial (PREPARE).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of olaparib plus ceralasertib is well tolerated and demonstrates clinical activity in patients with metastatic breast cancer with germline BRCA1/2 pathogenic variants who have progressed on prior PARP inhibitor therapy. A first-line study may help determine whether ATR inhibition can overcome or delay PARP inhibitor resistance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic breast cancer and germline BRCA1/2 pathogenic variants
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of olaparib plus ATR inhibitor ceralasertib in patients with metastatic breast cancer and germline BRCA1/2 pathogenic variants who progressed on prior PARP inhibitor therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world cohort, the cumulative incidence of T-DXd-related interstitial lung disease was approximately 19% when accounting for competing risks. Baseline renal impairment, prior lung radiotherapy, and systemic inflammatory status identified patients at increased risk and may support risk-adapted monitoring and earlier clinical intervention during T-DXd treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively collected data from 406 patients with metastatic breast cancer, including 223 HER2-positive and 162 HER2-low patients, who were treated with T-DXd between October 2024 and January 2026 in 16 Italian institutions.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cumulative incidence and risk factors of trastuzumab deruxtecan–related interstitial lung disease in a multicenter real-world cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: LY4052031 demonstrated promising clinical activity at multiple dose levels, including in enfortumab vedotin-pretreated metastatic urothelial carcinoma. CYP2D6 activity score-specific dose optimization is ongoing, and updated results will be presented.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma or other selected solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Initial results from NEXUS-01, a phase 1 study of LY4052031, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4, in participants with advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Early intravenous immunoglobulin administration following talquetamab initiation was associated with reduced infection risk and improved survival in a large real-world cohort of patients with multiple myeloma. These findings support consideration of early intravenous immunoglobulin as part of routine supportive care for patients receiving talquetamab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with multiple myeloma treated with talquetamab, comparing patients who received intravenous immunoglobulin within 4 weeks of talquetamab initiation with those who did not.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early intravenous immunoglobulin use in multiple myeloma patients treated with talquetamab: Effect on risk of infections and mortality.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma who had a suboptimal response to induction chemotherapy, intensification of adjuvant therapy with the addition of sintilimab to capecitabine did not significantly improve progression-free survival. Future studies should focus on biomarker-driven patient selection and optimization of immunotherapy sequencing with conventional treatments.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated, non-keratinising, stage II–IVA locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma with suboptimal response to induction chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant sintilimab-capecitabine versus capecitabine alone in locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma with suboptimal response to induction chemotherapy: An open-label, randomized, controlled, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Risk-stratified adjuvant concurrent chemoradiotherapy with or without nimotuzumab demonstrated promising efficacy and acceptable safety in high-risk postoperative locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio and hemoglobin-albumin-lymphocyte-platelet score may serve as prognostic biomarkers in intermediate-risk patients, aiding postoperative surveillance.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma harboring high-risk pathological features after radical surgery, including those with extranodal extension or positive/insufficient margins and those with other high-risk factors such as pT3–4 or N2–3 disease.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The efficacy of concurrent chemoradiotherapy with/without nimotuzumab in high-risk patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma after surgery: A real-world study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Daraxonrasib 300 mg QD in 3L+ PDAC demonstrated a manageable safety profile consistent with earlier-line experience. A majority of patients achieved disease control, supported by encouraging survival.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Previously Treated Advanced RAS -Mutated Pancreatic Cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of daraxonrasib monotherapy as later-line (3L+) treatment for patients (pts) with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The timing of biologic therapy initiation for immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated colitis was not associated with statistically significant differences in mortality, hospitalization, immune checkpoint inhibitor reinitiation, colonic perforation, or long-term corticosteroid therapy. Early biologic initiation showed numerically favorable outcomes across several endpoints, but the study may have been underpowered, and the findings should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, specifically pembrolizumab, nivolumab, or ipilimumab, who subsequently developed colitis and initiated biologic therapy with infliximab or vedolizumab either within 3 days or between days 3 and 14 of colitis diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early versus delayed biologic therapy for immune checkpoint inhibitor–associated colitis: A propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: LB2102 demonstrated consistent CAR-T expansion and encouraging anti-tumor activity at doses ≥2x10^6 CAR+T cells/kg. LB2102 was well tolerated with no dose-limiting toxicities and manageable cytokine-release syndrome and ICANS.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory small cell lung cancer and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary results from an ongoing phase 1 study of LB2102, a dnTGFBR2-armored DLL3-targeted autologous CAR-T cell therapy, in patients with relapsed or refractory SCLC or LCNEC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Age significantly influenced immune-related adverse event risk, timing, and the feasibility of pembrolizumab treatment. Younger patients maintained similar pathological complete response and overall survival despite reduced treatment exposure, suggesting adequate immune activation may occur with shorter therapy. Older patients derived greater survival benefit from completing the full regimen, and age-adapted immunotherapy strategies in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer should be evaluated.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included consecutive patients with triple-negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant with or without adjuvant pembrolizumab using the KEYNOTE-522 regimen from 2020–2025 at a multicenter single academic healthcare network, in the context of early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Age-related immune toxicity and treatment outcomes in triple-negative breast cancer treated with pembrolizumab.

data.clinical_result_summary: This single-center study reported a high incidence of acral malignant melanoma among Peruvian patients with stage III disease. Clinical characteristics, 1-year recurrence-free survival, and recurrence patterns were comparable between acral and non-acral subtypes. Adjuvant immunotherapy with pembrolizumab demonstrated clinical benefit in Peruvian patients with acral melanoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Peruvian patients with clinical stage III malignant melanoma treated between 2021 and 2024, with a focus on the acral subtype.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of adjuvant immunotherapy on stage III acral malignant melanoma (ALM) in a Peruvian cancer center: A real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: AB248 demonstrated robust anti-tumor activity across heavily IO-pretreated patients with metastatic melanoma, including mucosal melanoma. Combined with an acceptable safety profile, favorable pharmacokinetics, and differentiated pharmacodynamics, its anti-cancer activity merits further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: subjects with locally advanced/metastatic solid tumors who failed prior therapies
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1A/B study of AB248, a CD8+ selective IL-2 mutein fusion protein, alone or in combination with pembrolizumab, in patients with advanced solid tumor malignancies.

data.clinical_result_summary: T-DXd (4.4 mg/kg) combined with nivolumab and CAPOX showed encouraging antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile as first-line treatment for HER2-low gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, supporting further evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HER2-low gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: An open-label phase Ib/II study of trastuzumab deruxtecan combined with nivolumab and CAPOX in patients with HER2-low gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (EPOC2203).

data.clinical_result_summary: Penpulimab combined with platinum-based chemotherapy showed promising antitumour activity in previously untreated thymic carcinoma. Vigilance is required for immune-mediated myocarditis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with newly diagnosed thymic carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Penpulimab (PD-1 inhibitor) combined with platinum-based chemotherapy as induction therapy for newly diagnosed thymic carcinoma: A multicenter, single-arm, phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The first stage of this response-guided study met its predefined efficacy threshold of at least 6 pathologic complete responses in 20 patients. The neoadjuvant regimen combining dalpiciclib, an aromatase inhibitor, and dual HER2 blockade showed promising pathologic complete response rates and a favorable safety profile in triple-positive breast cancer, supporting continued evaluation in the second stage of the trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with stage II–IIIa HR+/HER2+ invasive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant dalpiciclib combined with letrozole and dual HER2 blockade in HR+/HER2+ breast cancer: First-stage results of the HELEN HER2 017 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective real-world cohort, maintenance liposomal doxorubicin appeared feasible, durable, and well tolerated, with encouraging disease control in selected patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma. These findings provide the first dedicated real-world evidence describing maintenance liposomal doxorubicin following induction doxorubicin and support prospective evaluation of anthracycline-maintenance strategies in soft tissue sarcoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had histologically confirmed soft tissue sarcoma, had received doxorubicin-based induction therapy, achieved disease control defined as stable disease, partial response, or complete response, and were subsequently treated with maintenance liposomal doxorubicin.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Maintenance liposomal doxorubicin following induction doxorubicin in soft tissue sarcoma: A single-center observational study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Early nationwide implementation of neoadjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in patients with resectable cutaneous melanoma resulted in favorable outcomes that closely mirror those reported in randomized clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with macroscopic, resectable cutaneous melanoma treated with neoadjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitor(s) across all academic melanoma centers in Sweden.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Outcome of neoadjuvant immunotherapy for patients with resectable stage III/IV cutaneous melanoma: A Swedish nationwide population-based study (NEO-MEL).

data.clinical_result_summary: After 6 years of follow-up, belzutifan continued to show durable antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with VHL-associated RCC, CNS HB, and pNETs who did not require immediate surgery. These results continue to support the use of belzutifan in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with germline VHL alterations, ≥1 measurable nonmetastatic RCC tumor
pts with VHL-associated CNS HB who do not require immediate surgery
pts with VHL-associated pNETs who do not require immediate surgery
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Extended follow-up (6 years) of the phase 2 LITESPARK-004 study of belzutifan in participants with von Hippel-Lindau disease–associated neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world study of patients with acute leukemia, severe thrombocytopenia, and NSTEMI, early unfractionated heparin administration within 24 hours was associated with improved survival without an increased risk of major bleeding. The findings address an evidence gap in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years with acute leukemia who experienced a first non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction following leukemia diagnosis and had severe thrombocytopenia, defined as a platelet count <50×10^3/μL measured within 24 hours of NSTEMI; patients with prior intracranial hemorrhage or chronic anticoagulation were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of early unfractionated heparin use in NSTEMI patients with acute leukemia and severe thrombocytopenia.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant SF-SBRT combined with toripalimab-based immunochemotherapy was feasible, safe, and achieved high pathological response rates in resectable stage II–III non-small cell lung cancer. These findings suggest that SF-SBRT may function as an immune-reprogramming strategy that amplifies neoadjuvant immunotherapy efficacy and warrants further validation in randomized clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with resectable stage IIA–IIIB non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Influence of neoadjuvant spatially fractionated stereotactic body radiotherapy on antitumor immunity and pathological response to toripalimab-based immunochemotherapy in resectable stage IIA-IIIB non-small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Revumenib maintenance post-SCT was feasible in this heavily pretreated cohort. Thrombocytopenia was common and often required dose modification, but no other significant toxicities were observed. Outcomes appeared favorable compared with historical cohorts, supporting prospective evaluation of menin inhibition as maintenance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult and pediatric patients with NPM1mt, KMT2Ar, or NUP98r acute myeloid leukemia at the institution could continue post-SCT revumenib maintenance following response pre-SCT to revumenib monotherapy or combination on a clinical trial.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Revumenib as maintenance for AML following allogeneic stem cell transplantation.

data.clinical_result_summary: Dostarlimab monotherapy showed encouraging antitumor activity, particularly in patients with a CPS ≥20, in first-line recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The safety profile was consistent and comparable to other immune checkpoint inhibitors in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants With PD-L1 Positive Recurrent/​Metastatic Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of dostarlimab monotherapy as first-line treatment in programmed cell death-ligand 1–positive recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: Results from a phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This first-in-human, multicenter Phase 1/2 trial is evaluating REGN5668-based combinations in patients with platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer or endometrial cancer. Module 1 dose expansion has opened with the first two patients enrolled, and Module 2 dose escalation has progressed through multiple dose levels with enrollment ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study includes patients with platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer or endometrial cancer; ovarian cancer patients must have histologically confirmed advanced epithelial ovarian cancer except carcinosarcoma, at least 1 prior line of platinum-based systemic therapy, and relapse or progression during the most recent therapy, while endometrial cancer patients must have histologically confirmed endometrial cancer with recurrence or progression after anti–PD-1 therapy and platinum-based chemotherapy, no more than 4 prior lines of systemic therapy, at least 30 days since anti–PD-1 therapy administration, and at least 25% MUC16-positive tumor cells.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1/2 study of REGN5668, a MUC16×CD28 costimulatory bispecific antibody, in combination with other targeted therapies, in patients with recurrent ovarian or endometrial cancer: Trial in progress update.

data.clinical_result_summary: CS2009 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors. These findings warrant further clinical development in an ongoing phase 2 study in nine tumor types.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CS2009, a novel PD-1/VEGF/CTLA-4 trispecific antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Updated results from an open-label, multicenter, phase 1 first-in-human study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multi-institutional real-world cohort of patients with NSCLC receiving osimertinib or lorlatinib who developed brain metastases, receipt of local CNS-directed therapy within 3 months was associated with lower 6-month mortality compared with continuation of targeted therapy alone. The findings were consistent in an osimertinib-only sensitivity analysis and suggest a potential survival benefit of local CNS intervention in selected patients, while acknowledging residual confounding related to intracranial disease burden and clinical indication.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with non-small cell lung cancer treated with osimertinib or lorlatinib who subsequently had a coded diagnosis of brain metastases at least 1 month after tyrosine kinase inhibitor initiation and evidence of continued tyrosine kinase inhibitor use were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Continued CNS-penetrant TKI therapy with or without local CNS therapy after brain metastasis diagnosis in NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: After neoadjuvant therapy, preoperative MRI accurately predicted pathologic complete response in 86% of patients with HER2-positive/ER-negative disease and may help identify patients who can proceed directly to surgery. MRI was insufficient to predict pathologic complete response for patients with HER2-positive/ER-positive disease, although MRI-indicated residual disease was accurate in 80% of these patients. Combining MRI with biomarkers such as tissue-based markers or circulating tumor DNA may improve prediction of pathologic complete response and personalize treatment decisions in HER2-positive breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with stage II-IIIA HER2-positive breast cancer, including HER2-positive/ER-negative and HER2-positive/ER-positive disease subsets.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EA1181: Accuracy of pre-surgery MRI to predict pathologic complete response after taxane, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab (THP) in HER2-positive breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: The orelabrutinib, lenalidomide, and rituximab regimen provided encouraging clinical and molecular responses with favorable safety in untreated mantle cell lymphoma. It may represent a highly active and less toxic chemotherapy-free frontline treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: frontline therapy for mantle cell lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Novel triplet combination of orelabrutinib, lenalidomide, and rituximab as frontline therapy for mantle cell lymphoma: Final results of POLARIS multicenter phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this Phase 3 study, pralsetinib met the primary PFS endpoint and showed significantly greater and more durable objective responses than standard of care in RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer. Safety was generally consistent with the known pralsetinib profile, but monitoring for infections with pralsetinib is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with RET fusion-positive advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of pralsetinib as first-line treatment of RET fusion–positive advanced or metastatic non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): The phase 3 AcceleRET-Lung study.

data.clinical_result_summary: At this safety interim analysis, no recurrent or new severe immune-related adverse events were observed, indicating an encouraging signal for the efficacy of siltuximab to reduce the severity of immune-related adverse events from anti-PD-1 therapy. Disease stabilization was observed in 40% of patients, and enrollment is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_name: 免疫检查点抑制剂相关毒性
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with any advanced cancer who had prior severe immune-related adverse events (irAEs) that warranted stopping immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) but have recovered to Grade ≤1.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Siltuximab for the prevention of severe immune-related adverse events during immune checkpoint inhibitor rechallenge in advanced cancer: First interim analysis of the CIRES trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: 64Cu-SARTATE was safe and well tolerated in patients with gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors. SARTATE had higher lesion detection than DOTATATE and detected additional true-positive lesions, which may help inform treatment decisions.
clinical_result_indication_name: 胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with known or suspected gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DISCO update: Diagnostic performance of 64Cu-SARTATE compared to 68Ga-DOTATATE in patients with known or suspected neuroendocrine tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world study of patients with acute leukemia, severe thrombocytopenia, and NSTEMI, early unfractionated heparin administration within 24 hours was associated with improved survival without an increased risk of major bleeding. The findings address an evidence gap in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years with acute leukemia who experienced a first non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction following leukemia diagnosis and had severe thrombocytopenia, defined as a platelet count <50×10^3/μL measured within 24 hours of NSTEMI; patients with prior intracranial hemorrhage or chronic anticoagulation were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of early unfractionated heparin use in NSTEMI patients with acute leukemia and severe thrombocytopenia.

data.clinical_result_summary: FZ-AD004 demonstrated a manageable safety profile with no dose-limiting toxicities observed up to 12.0 mg/kg. It showed promising antitumor activity in heavily pretreated non-small-cell lung cancer patients, particularly at doses of 8.0 and 10.0 mg/kg, which are being further explored in the expansion phase.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable, treatment-refractory or relapsed solid tumors, mainly non-small-cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Dose-escalation results from a phase I study of FZ-AD004, a TROP2-directed ADC, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Sotorasib was associated with slightly longer time to treatment discontinuation compared with adagrasib, which may suggest better tolerability, but there was no difference in progression-free survival or overall survival. Sotorasib was more likely to be used in patients with poor performance status, whereas adagrasib was more likely to be used in patients with CNS metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with KRAS G12C-mutated metastatic non-small cell lung cancer who started treatment with either sotorasib or adagrasib in the second-line or later setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sotorasib vs adagrasib in the 2L+ setting: Outcomes in a large, multi-institutional, real-world database of KRAS-G12C mutated mNSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: TRC003 was safe and well-tolerated and showed efficacy in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who were resistant to ARPI or chemotherapy. Overall, TRC003 appears to be a promising radiopharmaceutical agent for the treatment of mCRPC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of the safety, efficacy and dosimetry of TRC003 in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: A prospective, open-label, single-arm study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Integrin αvβ3-targeted radionuclide therapy with 177Lu-AB-3PRGD2 demonstrated promising efficacy in disease control and tumor response and was generally well tolerated in patients with advanced metastatic solid tumors. These findings justify further investigation in prospective, multicenter, randomized clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed advanced metastatic solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Integrin αvβ3-targeted radionuclide therapy with 177Lu-AB-3PRGD2 in multiple advanced metastatic solid tumors: A prospective, single-arm, single-center, investigator-initiated clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: QL1706 plus bevacizumab demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and lung metastases. The high response rate observed in lung lesions highlights the potential of intensified immunotherapy combined with anti-VEGF therapy for this subgroup, warranting further validation in phase III trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had unresectable, advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and confirmed lung metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: QL1706 (PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific antibody) plus bevacizumab specific for patients with hepatocellular carcinoma combined with lung metastasis: A secondary analysis of a prospective, single-arm, phase Ib/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: LB2102 demonstrated consistent CAR-T expansion and encouraging anti-tumor activity at doses ≥2x10^6 CAR+T cells/kg. LB2102 was well tolerated with no dose-limiting toxicities and manageable cytokine-release syndrome and ICANS.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed or refractory small cell lung cancer and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary results from an ongoing phase 1 study of LB2102, a dnTGFBR2-armored DLL3-targeted autologous CAR-T cell therapy, in patients with relapsed or refractory SCLC or LCNEC.

data.clinical_result_summary: Progression-free survival was significantly prolonged and objective response rate was improved in metastatic colorectal cancer patients treated with fruquintinib plus capecitabine as first-line maintenance treatment. The safety profile of the combination regimen was manageable and aligned with the expected toxicity patterns of the individual agents.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A randomized phase II trial of fruquintinib plus capecitabine versus capecitabine alone as maintenance therapy following first-line chemotherapy in metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of orelabrutinib and rituximab showed significant activity in marginal zone lymphoma. The regimen had a manageable toxicity profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated marginal zone lymphoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy, safety, and genetic analysis of orelabrutinib combined with rituximab as first-line systemic treatment for marginal zone lymphoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Compared with conventional short-course preoperative chemoradiotherapy, node-sparing modified radiotherapy combined with CAPOX and PD-1 blockade significantly improved pathological complete response rates in patients with pMMR/MSS locally advanced rectal cancer, with a manageable safety profile. This regimen represents a promising and highly effective neoadjuvant strategy for MSS rectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pMMR/MSS locally advanced rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Node-sparing modified short-course radiotherapy combined with CAPOX and tislelizumab versus conventional short-course preoperative chemoradiotherapy for proficient mismatch repair or microsatellite stable locally advanced rectal cancer (mRCAT-III): A multicenter, randomized, open-label, phase 3 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy provides durable survival benefit in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, and pCR is associated with minimal local recurrence. With prolonged survival, the risk of second primary tumors becomes significant, and late radiation toxicities can impact outcomes, emphasizing the need for lifelong surveillance and management of late toxicities.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: resectable, L/A HNSCC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Five-year follow-up of neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: After 6 years of follow-up, belzutifan continued to show durable antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with VHL-associated RCC, CNS HB, and pNETs who did not require immediate surgery. These results continue to support the use of belzutifan in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with germline VHL alterations, ≥1 measurable nonmetastatic RCC tumor
pts with VHL-associated CNS HB who do not require immediate surgery
pts with VHL-associated pNETs who do not require immediate surgery
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Extended follow-up (6 years) of the phase 2 LITESPARK-004 study of belzutifan in participants with von Hippel-Lindau disease–associated neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: Olutasidenib demonstrated robust real-world effectiveness in adults with relapsed/refractory IDH1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia previously treated with venetoclax, with a CR/CRh rate of 60.8% and median response duration of 30.3 months. Substantial reductions in transfusion dependence further support olutasidenib as a viable post-venetoclax therapeutic option, and earlier sequencing may optimize outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients were adults aged ≥18 years with relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia with an IDH1 mutation, prior venetoclax treatment, initiation of olutasidenib between December 2022 and March 2025, and response assessment; patients were excluded if they had received prior IDH1 targeted therapy or more than 1 additional therapy between venetoclax and olutasidenib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Treatment patterns and outcomes with olutasidenib after venetoclax in IDH1-mutated AML using real-world data from a chart review.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world study of patients with acute leukemia, severe thrombocytopenia, and NSTEMI, early unfractionated heparin administration within 24 hours was associated with improved survival without an increased risk of major bleeding. The findings address an evidence gap in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years with acute leukemia who experienced a first non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction following leukemia diagnosis and had severe thrombocytopenia, defined as a platelet count <50×10^3/μL measured within 24 hours of NSTEMI; patients with prior intracranial hemorrhage or chronic anticoagulation were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of early unfractionated heparin use in NSTEMI patients with acute leukemia and severe thrombocytopenia.

data.clinical_result_summary: This pre-planned interim analysis met both dual-primary endpoints of PFS by BICR and OS. Iza-bren demonstrated a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in both PFS and OS compared with chemotherapy, with a manageable safety profile in heavily pre-treated TNBC patients, supporting iza-bren as a new standard of care in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer who have failed prior taxane therapy.
clinical_result_layer_factor: prior lines of therapy (1 vs. 2), prior anti-PD-(L)1 (yes vs. no), and HER2 IHC (0 vs. 1+/2+ ISH-)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Izalontamab brengitecan (iza-bren) versus physician’s choice of chemotherapy in patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): A randomized phase III study.

data.clinical_result_summary: BXQ-350 was safe and well tolerated in combination with mFOLFOX7 and bevacizumab. The data suggest potential added clinical benefit, including reduced or delayed chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy and lower grade 3 or higher neutropenia, with improved oxaliplatin dose delivery in first-line metastatic colorectal cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: newly diagnosed metastatic colorectal carcinoma patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: BXQ-350 in combination with FOLFOX7 and bevacizumab: Evaluation of effect on oxaliplatin-induced CIPN and neutropenia—A phase 1b/2a trial to assess the efficacy and safety of BXQ-350, a first-in-class sphingolipid metabolism modulator, in newly diagnosed metastatic colorectal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multi-institutional real-world cohort of patients with NSCLC receiving osimertinib or lorlatinib who developed brain metastases, receipt of local CNS-directed therapy within 3 months was associated with lower 6-month mortality compared with continuation of targeted therapy alone. The findings were consistent in an osimertinib-only sensitivity analysis and suggest a potential survival benefit of local CNS intervention in selected patients, while acknowledging residual confounding related to intracranial disease burden and clinical indication.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with non-small cell lung cancer treated with osimertinib or lorlatinib who subsequently had a coded diagnosis of brain metastases at least 1 month after tyrosine kinase inhibitor initiation and evidence of continued tyrosine kinase inhibitor use were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Continued CNS-penetrant TKI therapy with or without local CNS therapy after brain metastasis diagnosis in NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: T-Bren as monotherapy or in combination with pertuzumab demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with treatment-naïve HER2-positive unresectable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. A phase III study assessing T-Bren in this population is in preparation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment-naïve HER2-positive unresectable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of T-Bren (BL-M07D1) monotherapy or in combination with pertuzumab in patients with treatment-naïve HER2-positive unresectable locally advanced or metastatic (LA/M) breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: After neoadjuvant therapy, preoperative MRI accurately predicted pathologic complete response in 86% of patients with HER2-positive/ER-negative disease and may help identify patients who can proceed directly to surgery. MRI was insufficient to predict pathologic complete response for patients with HER2-positive/ER-positive disease, although MRI-indicated residual disease was accurate in 80% of these patients. Combining MRI with biomarkers such as tissue-based markers or circulating tumor DNA may improve prediction of pathologic complete response and personalize treatment decisions in HER2-positive breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with stage II-IIIA HER2-positive breast cancer, including HER2-positive/ER-negative and HER2-positive/ER-positive disease subsets.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EA1181: Accuracy of pre-surgery MRI to predict pathologic complete response after taxane, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab (THP) in HER2-positive breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: 177Lu-NYM032 demonstrated a favorable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. These findings support further evaluation of 177Lu-NYM032 in Phase II studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with progressive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I dose-escalation results of 177Lu-NYM032 in patients with progressive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Early intravenous immunoglobulin administration following talquetamab initiation was associated with reduced infection risk and improved survival in a large real-world cohort of patients with multiple myeloma. These findings support consideration of early intravenous immunoglobulin as part of routine supportive care for patients receiving talquetamab.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with multiple myeloma treated with talquetamab, comparing patients who received intravenous immunoglobulin within 4 weeks of talquetamab initiation with those who did not.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Early intravenous immunoglobulin use in multiple myeloma patients treated with talquetamab: Effect on risk of infections and mortality.

data.clinical_result_summary: The study demonstrates real-world evidence regarding the ease and safety of initiating single-agent venetoclax in the outpatient setting across a heterogeneous CLL population. Venetoclax-based therapy should be considered a safe, easy-to-initiate viable option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in the CLL population initiated venetoclax when absolute lymphocyte count was <20,000 K/mL, adenopathy was <5 cm by exam, splenomegaly had resolved if present by exam, and CrCl was >45 mL/min.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcome of low-frequency outpatient monitoring for venetoclax initiation in CLL: Single-center experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Taletrectinib was associated with improved or stable health-related quality of life in the majority of patients and rapid relief of disease-related symptoms. In contrast to other ROS1 tyrosine kinase inhibitors, taletrectinib demonstrated preservation of cognitive function over time. Together with efficacy and safety results, these data support the use of taletrectinib for patients with ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer, including patients from North America and Europe for questionnaire distribution, were treated with taletrectinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Patient-reported outcomes (PROs) and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) with taletrectinib in advanced ROS1+ non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) from the TRUST-II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: TPC chemotherapy combined with cadonilimab demonstrated a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival compared with TPC alone in heavily pretreated, ICI-refractory recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients. The combination had a manageable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with immunotherapy-refractory recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cadonilimab in combination with chemotherapy versus chemotherapy alone in patients with immunotherapy-refractory recurrent or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma: A multicenter, randomized, phase III trial the CONQUEST trial).

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated design of INVOKE: A phase 1 study of OKN4395, a first-in-class EP2/EP4/DP1 triple prostanoid receptor antagonist, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: DSC3-targeted immunotherapy with CADI-05 was reported as safe and associated with improved outcomes in pre-treated recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma expressing DSC3. The study reported a disease control rate of 45%, an overall response rate of 35%, median duration of response of 332 days, median progression-free survival of 115 days, and median overall survival of 155 days.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pre-treated recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma expressing DSC3
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Desmocolin-3–directed immunotherapy in recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: B cell immunogenicity may play a role in mediating clinical responses to DNA immunotherapy INO-3107 for the treatment of recurrent respiratory papillomatosis. INO-3107 induced expansion and emergence of B cells in the blood of patients, which trafficked to and infiltrated papilloma tissue by the end of study, and these immune responses were associated with improved clinical outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_name: 复发性呼吸道乳头状瘤
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis treated with DNA immunotherapy INO-3107.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: B cell responses in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis patients treated with DNA immunotherapy INO-3107.

data.clinical_result_summary: With longer follow-up, SSGJ-707 monotherapy continued to show promising efficacy with a manageable safety profile in patients with treatment-naive advanced non-small cell lung cancer across histology and PD-L1 expression subgroups. These results supported initiation of the phase 3 Symbiotic-Lung-01 study of SSGJ-707 with platinum-based chemotherapy in first-line squamous and nonsquamous non-small cell lung cancer irrespective of tumor proportion score.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with treatment naive advanced non-small cell lung cancer (without actionable genomic alterations and PD-L1 expression≥1%)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results from a phase 2 trial of SSGJ-707 (PF-08634404), a PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody, as monotherapy in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Utidelone monotherapy showed promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, including those who had progressed on androgen receptor pathway inhibitors, abiraterone, and docetaxel. The results support further investigation of this regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: heavily pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer after failing docetaxel treatment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Utidelone in heavily pretreated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer progressing after docetaxel and novel hormonal agents: Results of a completed phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: BCMA-directed therapy with BPd resulted in improved PFS2 outcomes compared with PVd, demonstrating sustained clinical benefit beyond initial belantamab mafodotin therapy. The benefit was observed regardless of prior treatment, including an almost 3-fold PFS2 benefit in LEN-refractory patients, supporting early sequencing of belantamab mafodotin combinations before anti-CD38 agents.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with at least 1 prior line of therapy including lenalidomide were included, and patients could not have received prior BCMA-targeted therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: PFS2 outcomes by prior therapy from DREAMM-8: A phase 3 study assessing belantamab mafodotin (belamaf), pomalidomide, and dexamethasone (BPd) vs pomalidomide, bortezomib, and dexamethasone (PVd) in patients (pts) with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM).

data.clinical_result_summary: SIR2501 was well tolerated in healthy volunteers and demonstrated pharmacokinetics compatible with once-daily dosing and dose-dependent SARM1 target engagement. Together with the preclinical evidence of protection against paclitaxel-induced neuropathy without impairment of antitumor activity, these findings support further clinical development of SARM1 inhibition as a disease-modifying approach for chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的周围神经病变
clinical_result_indication_detail: healthy volunteers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SARM1 inhibition to prevent chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy: Translational and early clinical evaluation of SIR2501.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cadonilimab combined with AK117 and chemotherapy showed encouraging efficacy and manageable safety as first-line treatment for advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer. Updated follow-up continued to support clinical activity, with no treatment-related deaths reported.
clinical_result_indication_detail: advanced gastric (G) or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line (1L) cadonilimab plus AK117 and chemotherapy (chemo) in advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer (GC/GEJC): Updated results from a phase 2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: CD3xCD20 bispecific antibodies were associated with predominantly low-grade cytokine release syndrome and a low incidence of immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome, with agent-specific differences. Severe CRS/ICANS requiring escalation was associated with ICU utilization and mortality, supporting standardized management pathways.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult lymphoma patients treated with CD3xCD20 bispecific antibodies at Mount Sinai Hospital between January 2021 and December 2024.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world experience with management of CRS and ICANS following CD3xCD20 bispecific antibody therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and hepatocellular carcinoma treated with atezolizumab plus bevacizumab, prior GLP-1RA exposure was associated with significantly improved overall survival and a reduced risk of major adverse cardiovascular events compared with alternative antihyperglycemic therapies. These findings suggest a potential synergistic role for GLP-1RAs in this population and support prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and type 2 diabetes mellitus initiating atezolizumab plus bevacizumab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of GLP-1 receptor agonists on outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma patients treated with atezolizumab plus bevacizumab: A multicenter propensity-matched real-world analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: After neoadjuvant therapy, preoperative MRI accurately predicted pathologic complete response in 86% of patients with HER2-positive/ER-negative disease and may help identify patients who can proceed directly to surgery. MRI was insufficient to predict pathologic complete response for patients with HER2-positive/ER-positive disease, although MRI-indicated residual disease was accurate in 80% of these patients. Combining MRI with biomarkers such as tissue-based markers or circulating tumor DNA may improve prediction of pathologic complete response and personalize treatment decisions in HER2-positive breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with stage II-IIIA HER2-positive breast cancer, including HER2-positive/ER-negative and HER2-positive/ER-positive disease subsets.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: EA1181: Accuracy of pre-surgery MRI to predict pathologic complete response after taxane, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab (THP) in HER2-positive breast cancer.
