data.clinical_result_summary: During belzutifan treatment holiday, most evaluable CNS lesions demonstrated mild volumetric increase over time, although lesion behavior was heterogeneous and occurred over several months rather than immediately after treatment withholding. These findings provide early lesion-level insight into CNS hemangioblastoma dynamics during belzutifan holidays and support cautious clinical monitoring during treatment interruption.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included von Hippel–Lindau disease patients with central nervous system hemangioblastomas treated with belzutifan at Massachusetts General Brigham Cancer Institute between September 2018 and January 2026 who experienced a treatment interruption of at least 3 months, with treatment holiday offered after at least 9 months of sustained maximal response.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Volumetric analysis of central nervous system hemangioblastomas during belzutifan treatment holiday in von Hippel–Lindau (VHL) disease patients.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world cohort, the cumulative incidence of T-DXd-related interstitial lung disease was approximately 19% when accounting for competing risks. Baseline renal impairment, prior lung radiotherapy, and systemic inflammatory status identified patients at increased risk and may support risk-adapted monitoring and earlier clinical intervention during T-DXd treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively collected data from 406 patients with metastatic breast cancer, including 223 HER2-positive and 162 HER2-low patients, who were treated with T-DXd between October 2024 and January 2026 in 16 Italian institutions.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cumulative incidence and risk factors of trastuzumab deruxtecan–related interstitial lung disease in a multicenter real-world cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: The use of proton pump inhibitors during neoadjuvant therapy was associated with a higher pathological complete response rate in luminal breast cancer, with the greatest benefit observed in the Luminal B/HER2+ subtype. These findings suggest a potential role for proton pump inhibitors as therapeutic sensitizers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with luminal breast cancer stages IIa–IIIb who received neoadjuvant therapy with or without continuous proton pump inhibitors were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of proton pump inhibitors on the pathological complete response rate in luminal breast cancer during neoadjuvant therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adding fovinaciclib to first-line aromatase inhibitor therapy provided a significant and clinically meaningful progression-free survival benefit, with consistent improvements in other survival outcomes and a manageable safety profile. These findings support fovinaciclib as a first-line treatment option for patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult women with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-line fovinaciclib versus placebo combined with aromatase inhibitor for advanced breast cancer: A randomized, double-blind phase 3 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: First-line nivolumab plus ipilimumab continued to show sustained efficacy benefit versus lenvatinib/sorafenib in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma, with no new safety concerns at the 4-year follow-up. Deeper responses with nivolumab plus ipilimumab may be associated with improved survival outcomes, and long-term survivors had higher objective response and complete response rates and were more likely to remain free of subsequent treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled adults with previously untreated unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CheckMate-9DW 4-year follow-up: Overall survival by depth of response and outcomes in long-term survivors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Prophylactic tocilizumab substantially reduced cytokine release syndrome incidence among patients with small cell lung cancer receiving tarlatamab, suggesting a feasible and safe mitigation strategy. Compared with historical DeLLphi-301 data, this cohort had markedly lower toxicity rates with prophylactic IL-6 blockade, and larger prospective studies are warranted to confirm safety, efficacy, and cost-effectiveness.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study retrospectively analyzed 32 consecutive patients with small cell lung cancer treated with tarlatamab at a single center.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prophylactic tocilizumab to mitigate cytokine release syndrome in patients receiving tarlatamab: A single‑center exploratory experience informed by bispecific antibody safety data.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of adults with type 2 diabetes and breast cancer treated with pembrolizumab, metformin use was associated with improved outcomes among individuals with metastatic breast cancer. Prospective studies with larger sample sizes and longer follow-up are needed to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included females/adults with type 2 diabetes and breast cancer who received immune checkpoint blockade with pembrolizumab for breast cancer, including patients with stage I-III disease and metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Metformin use and outcomes among breast cancer patients on immunotherapy: Insights from a real-world cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: After 6 years of follow-up, belzutifan continued to show durable antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with VHL-associated RCC, CNS HB, and pNETs who did not require immediate surgery. These results continue to support the use of belzutifan in this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with germline VHL alterations, ≥1 measurable nonmetastatic RCC tumor
pts with VHL-associated CNS HB who do not require immediate surgery
pts with VHL-associated pNETs who do not require immediate surgery
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Extended follow-up (6 years) of the phase 2 LITESPARK-004 study of belzutifan in participants with von Hippel-Lindau disease–associated neoplasms.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world study of patients with acute leukemia, severe thrombocytopenia, and NSTEMI, early unfractionated heparin administration within 24 hours was associated with improved survival without an increased risk of major bleeding. The findings address an evidence gap in this high-risk population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years with acute leukemia who experienced a first non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction following leukemia diagnosis and had severe thrombocytopenia, defined as a platelet count <50×10^3/μL measured within 24 hours of NSTEMI; patients with prior intracranial hemorrhage or chronic anticoagulation were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of early unfractionated heparin use in NSTEMI patients with acute leukemia and severe thrombocytopenia.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ceralasertib was well tolerated in women with recurrent platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian cancer with cyclin E1 overexpression. However, responses did not appear to be enriched in this biomarker-selected population, and future studies should consider rational combinations with ceralasertib.
clinical_result_indication_detail: women with recurrent platinum resistant HGSC with cyclin E1 over-expression, with and without gene amplification
data.clinical_result_paper_title: IGNITE-Cerala: A phase II signal-seeking trial of ceralasertib targeting recurrent high-grade serous ovarian cancer with cyclin E1 overexpression with and without gene amplification.

data.clinical_result_summary: Dual radioligand therapy with 3 cycles of [223Ra]Radium-dichloride and 2 cycles of [177Lu]Lutetium-PSMA in patients with metachronous oligorecurrent osseous metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer was safe, feasible, and had hardly any impact on health-related quality of life. It showed a promising biochemical response and a mixed radiological response with stable disease in some patients on follow-up.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metachronous oligorecurrent osseus hormone sensitive prostate cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: The DUET-1 trial: Feasibility and toxicity outcomes and early oncological outcomes of 177lutetium-PSMA radioligand therapy (RLT) alternated with 233radium-dichloride in patients with metachronous oligorecurrent osseus hormone sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC).

data.clinical_result_summary: FT836 Regimen C dose level 1 was well tolerated, with no dose-limiting toxicities or major FT836-related safety events reported among the first three treated patients. Early clinical data support anti-tumor activity in highly refractory metastatic colorectal cancer, and the trial remains actively enrolling.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preliminary phase 1 results of a MICA/B-targeted CAR T cell designed to overcome solid tumor escape mechanisms and avoid the requirement for conditioning chemotherapy.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 治疗期间发生的不良事件（TEAE）
治疗后出现的不良事件（TEAE）
治疗期间出现的不良事件（TEAEs）
治疗中出现的不良事件（TEAE）
治疗期出现的不良事件（TEAE）
治疗期间出现的不良事件
治疗期间出现的不良事件（TEAE）
data.clinical_result_summary: KP-483 is a potent EP4 antagonist with preliminary antitumor activity mediated through modulation of the tumor immune microenvironment. Its favorable safety and pharmacokinetic profiles support further development, including combination strategies with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with solid tumors who had progressed after standard treatments
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_cn: 治疗期间出现的不良事件
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Preclinical investigations and first-in-human phase I trial of KP-483 in solid tumors: Safety, antitumor activity, and preliminary efficacy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort of adults with type 2 diabetes and breast cancer treated with pembrolizumab, metformin use was associated with improved outcomes among individuals with metastatic breast cancer. Prospective studies with larger sample sizes and longer follow-up are needed to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included females/adults with type 2 diabetes and breast cancer who received immune checkpoint blockade with pembrolizumab for breast cancer, including patients with stage I-III disease and metastatic breast cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Metformin use and outcomes among breast cancer patients on immunotherapy: Insights from a real-world cohort.

data.clinical_result_summary: This single-center study reported a high incidence of acral malignant melanoma among Peruvian patients with stage III disease. Clinical characteristics, 1-year recurrence-free survival, and recurrence patterns were comparable between acral and non-acral subtypes. Adjuvant immunotherapy with pembrolizumab demonstrated clinical benefit in Peruvian patients with acral melanoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Peruvian patients with clinical stage III malignant melanoma treated between 2021 and 2024, with a focus on the acral subtype.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Impact of adjuvant immunotherapy on stage III acral malignant melanoma (ALM) in a Peruvian cancer center: A real-world experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among adults with asthma and cancer, ICI exposure was associated with increased risks of hospitalization, respiratory failure, drug-induced interstitial lung disorders, and mortality compared with non-ICI systemic therapy. These findings support close pulmonary monitoring and risk mitigation when initiating ICIs in patients with asthma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged ≥18 years with asthma and malignancy, comparing patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors after cancer diagnosis with patients receiving non-ICI systemic therapy and no ICI exposure.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitors and respiratory outcomes in cancer patients with pre-existing asthma: A TriNetX propensity-matched cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: SIM0505, a first-in-class CDH6 CPT116 payload ADC, showed manageable safety and tolerability, including at higher dose levels, with encouraging efficacy in ovarian cancer and uterine serous cancer and a favorable pharmacokinetic profile. These data support initiating the dose optimization portion of the study in gynecological cancers.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced OC
patients with advanced solid tumors
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I, multicenter, first-in-human (FIH) global study of SIM0505, an anti-CDH6 (CDH6) antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) in patients with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among breast cancer patients receiving paclitaxel chemotherapy, co-treatment with lithium was not superior to placebo for the development of polyneuropathy as measured by total neuropathy score reduced. However, lithium was associated with better patient-reported outcomes, including quality of life and pain, as well as lower rates of adverse events. These observations warrant confirmation in a larger phase 3 interventional trial.
clinical_result_indication_detail: breast cancer patients aged 18-70 years, with no pre-existing polyneuropathy and to be treated with paclitaxel
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prevention of paclitaxel-induced neurotoxicity with lithium: Results from a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial (PREPARE).

data.clinical_result_summary: Combining radiotherapy with immune checkpoint inhibitors appears to be a promising strategy to overcome immunotherapy resistance in advanced melanoma. In this interim analysis, the small cohort showed evidence of clinical benefit, with stabilization or reduction of both irradiated and non-irradiated lesions, although most patients later developed new metastatic lesions.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with metastatic melanoma receiving standard of care immunotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Overcoming immunotherapy resistance in advanced melanoma through radiotherapy: A prospective observational study.

data.clinical_result_summary: CS2009 demonstrated a manageable safety profile and promising antitumor activity in heavily pretreated patients with advanced solid tumors. These findings warrant further clinical development in an ongoing phase 2 study in nine tumor types.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: CS2009, a novel PD-1/VEGF/CTLA-4 trispecific antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Updated results from an open-label, multicenter, phase 1 first-in-human study.

data.clinical_result_summary: This largest real-world cohort of Veterans with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer demonstrated a significant overall survival benefit with chemo-immunotherapy. The benefit was particularly pronounced among patients with brain metastases, and elevated ANC/ALC was identified as a potential prognostic biomarker associated with poor outcomes regardless of treatment. Overall survival in the Veteran cohort remained substantially lower than in registrational trials, highlighting the need for future studies with broader eligibility criteria.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Veterans with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated with first-line chemotherapy alone or chemo-immunotherapy within the Veterans Affairs health system, including patients with brain metastases at diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of survival after chemo-immunotherapy in veterans with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer and brain metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary findings indicate that this 4-cycle de-escalation neoadjuvant strategy with toripalimab plus abbreviated chemotherapy is effective and safe for early-stage triple-negative breast cancer. The results warrant further investigation in randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: early-stage triple-negative breast cancer patients with stage II–III triple-negative breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with toripalimab for triple-negative breast cancer: A prospective, single-arm, multi-center study (NEOTORCH-BREAST02).

data.clinical_result_summary: GLP-1 RA initiation was associated with a reduced risk of hematologic malignancies compared with DPP-4i use among real-world patients with type 2 diabetes. These findings suggest a potential protective effect of GLP-1 RAs on hematologic cancer risk and warrant further mechanistic and prospective investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included older adults with type 2 diabetes from 15% random samples of Medicare Part D beneficiaries from 2013 to 2022 who initiated GLP-1 RA or DPP-4i.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) and hematologic cancer risk among older adults with type 2 diabetes.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intraperitoneal administration of fast-manufactured Th9/Tc9-like CEACAM5-targeted CAR-T cells demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging antitumor activity in heavily pretreated colorectal cancer peritoneal metastasis patients. These findings support further development of fitness-enhanced, regionally delivered CAR-T strategies for peritoneal malignancies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with advanced colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of intraperitoneal fast-manufactured IL-9-secreting CEACAM5-targeted CAR-T cells in advanced colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Telpegfilgrastim effectively prevented the occurrence of grade 3/4 neutropenia in breast cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy, reduced the incidence of infections and the use of antibiotics, with good safety. These data support Telpegfilgrastim as a feasible option for chemotherapy-induced neutropenia prevention in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的中性粒细胞减少症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included breast cancer patients who used Telpegfilgrastim the day after chemotherapy for the prevention of chemotherapy-induced neutropenia.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of telpegfilgrastim in the prophylaxis of chemotherapy-induced neutropenia in breast cancer patients: A retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this expanded cohort, early cancer-related cognitive impairment was associated with reduced relative dose intensity and higher rates of treatment discontinuation. Beyond its impact on quality of life, early cancer-related cognitive impairment identified a vulnerable subgroup of patients at risk for compromised treatment delivery and may represent a clinically actionable target for risk-adapted supportive strategies aimed at preserving curative-intent treatment intensity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Greek-fluent individuals aged >45 years, including patients with early stage breast or colorectal cancer scheduled to receive adjuvant chemotherapy containing taxanes or oxaliplatin, early stage cancer patients not eligible for adjuvant chemotherapy, and age-matched healthy controls, excluding patients with pre-existing dementia or anxiety disorders.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of early cognitive decline with compromised delivery of adjuvant chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Updated results of the IZALCO study continue to show the efficacy and safety of subcutaneous isatuximab plus carfilzomib and dexamethasone delivered either by manual injection or via wearable on-body injector in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. The study also demonstrated high patient satisfaction and preference for isatuximab subcutaneous administration via wearable on-body injector.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated results from the phase 2 IZALCO study: Efficacy and safety of isatuximab subcutaneous plus carfilzomib and dexamethasone in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: AFN0328 demonstrated favorable safety and tolerability with robust immune responses in patients with HPV16/18-associated high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. These findings support further clinical development of AFN0328 as an immunotherapy for HPV-driven precancerous disease.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with HPV16- and/or HPV18-associated high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions (CIN2/3)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1 dose-escalation and -expansion study of AFN0328, a novel mRNA-based immunotherapy, in patients with HPV16/18-associated high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions.

data.clinical_result_summary: This ongoing Phase 1 study of intracavitary FOLactis injection in patients with malignant pleural effusion preliminarily confirmed safety and clinical efficacy. The findings suggest that FOLactis may be a promising immunotherapeutic strategy for effective control of malignant pleural effusion.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors complicated with malignant pleural effusion
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial on the safety, tolerance, and preliminary efficacy of intracavitary injection of in situ vaccines (FOLactis) in patients with advanced solid tumors complicated with malignant pleural effusion.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this expanded cohort, early cancer-related cognitive impairment was associated with reduced relative dose intensity and higher rates of treatment discontinuation. Beyond its impact on quality of life, early cancer-related cognitive impairment identified a vulnerable subgroup of patients at risk for compromised treatment delivery and may represent a clinically actionable target for risk-adapted supportive strategies aimed at preserving curative-intent treatment intensity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Greek-fluent individuals aged >45 years, including patients with early stage breast or colorectal cancer scheduled to receive adjuvant chemotherapy containing taxanes or oxaliplatin, early stage cancer patients not eligible for adjuvant chemotherapy, and age-matched healthy controls, excluding patients with pre-existing dementia or anxiety disorders.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of early cognitive decline with compromised delivery of adjuvant chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis of FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia, triplet therapy incorporating a FLT3 inhibitor was associated with a significant improvement in 1-year overall survival compared with HMA plus venetoclax alone, without an apparent increase in toxicity. These findings support the real-world feasibility and potential benefit of FLT3 inhibitor-based triplet regimens, particularly in older or unfit populations underrepresented in clinical trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults aged 18 years or older with FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia who were treated between January 2017 and January 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of triplet therapy with hypomethylating agent, venetoclax, and FLT3 inhibitor versus doublet therapy in FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia.

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW28012 demonstrated a manageable safety profile in heavily treated patients with advanced solid tumors and promising anti-tumor activity in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The data support further development of XNW28012 in a broad range of solid tumors, including pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
patients with advanced solid tumors - PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics of XNW28012, a tissue factor antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) with topoisomerase 1 inhibitor (TOP1i) payload, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective analysis, early immune checkpoint inhibitor infusion timing was associated with significantly lower recurrence risk, particularly distant recurrence. Pathologic complete response rates were not statistically significant between early and late infusion timing, but a numerical difference favored early infusion. These hypothesis-generating findings suggest that circadian timing of immunotherapy may influence long-term outcomes beyond pathologic response and warrant prospective validation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with early-stage triple-negative breast cancer treated at Manhattan and Mineola campuses and four sites in Queens, Brooklyn, and Long Island using a KEYNOTE-522-based neoadjuvant regimen including pembrolizumab, chemotherapy, and surgery between July 2021 and June 2025.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of immunotherapy infusion timing with outcomes in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Brigatinib showed clinically meaningful activity with a manageable safety profile, providing durable disease control in a subset of patients previously treated with alectinib followed by lorlatinib and/or chemotherapy. Outcomes appeared less favorable after prior lorlatinib, although some patients derived benefit. Exploratory plasma ctDNA analyses suggested that detectable ALK mutations after prior lorlatinib were associated with less favorable outcomes and should be validated in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with ALK-rearranged non-small cell lung cancer who received brigatinib after lorlatinib and/or chemotherapy following first-line alectinib.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Brigatinib after lorlatinib and/or chemotherapy following first-line alectinib in ALK-rearranged NSCLC: Cohort B of the WJOG11919L/ABRAID study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort from a high-incidence region, adding trastuzumab to chemotherapy resulted in clinically and statistically significant improvements in progression-free survival and overall survival in patients with HER2-positive biliary tract cancer. These data support routine HER2 testing and integration of HER2-targeted therapy into standard treatment algorithms for this molecularly defined subgroup.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 67 consecutive patients with HER2-positive biliary tract cancer, defined as IHC 3+ or IHC 2+ with amplification, treated between 2019 and 2024; most cases were gallbladder carcinoma, and many had metastatic disease at presentation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of trastuzumab plus chemotherapy in HER2-positive biliary tract cancers from a high-incidence region.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis, glofitamab and epcoritamab had similar safety profiles, with glofitamab showing lower early mortality and higher overall survival. Hematologic adverse events, CRS, ICANS, and ICU admissions were comparable, while infections were significantly lower with glofitamab. Selection of CD20×CD3 bispecific antibodies should consider infection risk and early survival outcomes until longer follow-up clarifies durability and late toxicities.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adult patients with confirmed relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma who were treated with glofitamab or epcoritamab and had received at least 2 prior systemic therapies with at least 30 days of follow-up.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of epcoritamab vs glofitamab in relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: A TriNetX retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Encouraging clinical activity was observed for trastuzumab deruxtecan plus durvalumab as first-line treatment for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer. Safety profiles were consistent with the known profiles of each therapy, with no fatal interstitial lung disease events, supporting further investigation of this combination.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated HER2+ unresectable/metastatic breast cancer
clinical_result_layer_factor: HR (positive vs negative), disease (recurrent vs de novo), and PD-L1 status (positive vs negative; positive defined as ≥1% IHC)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) + durvalumab (D) in patients (pts) with previously untreated HER2+ unresectable/metastatic breast cancer (mBC): Final analysis from DESTINY-Breast07.

data.clinical_result_summary: IMC-002 in combination with gemcitabine plus carboplatin or paclitaxel demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity with a manageable safety profile in heavily pretreated patients with advanced triple-negative breast cancer. Exploratory baseline ctDNA analyses did not identify molecular features clearly associated with clinical benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced triple-negative breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase 1b dose-expansion study of IMC-002, a anti-CD47 monoclonal antibody, in patients with advanced triple negative breast cancer (TNBC).

data.clinical_result_summary: Similar to clinical trials, patients with myelofibrosis and higher platelet counts treated with pacritinib in the real world experienced reduction or stabilization in spleen size category, decreased myelofibrosis-symptom burden, platelet stability, and improved hemoglobin.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with myelofibrosis and platelet counts ≥50 x10^9/L at pacritinib initiation who were treated with pacritinib for at least 1 month and had at least 6 months of follow-up.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Treatment patterns and outcomes in pacritinib-treated patients with MF and higher platelet count: MY-PAC study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Immunotherapy combined with oral immune nutritional supplementation can significantly increase the postoperative pathological complete response rate of neoadjuvant treatment for locally advanced gastric cancer and achieve tumor downstaging. Immunonutrition therapy can reshape the tumor immune microenvironment, further enhancing the immunotherapy effect in advanced gastric cancer. The specific mechanism needs further study.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced gastric cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy combined with immunonutrition therapy for gastric cancer: A single-center, randomized clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW28012 demonstrated a manageable safety profile in heavily treated patients with advanced solid tumors and promising anti-tumor activity in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The data support further development of XNW28012 in a broad range of solid tumors, including pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
patients with advanced solid tumors - PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics of XNW28012, a tissue factor antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) with topoisomerase 1 inhibitor (TOP1i) payload, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cavitation with sonosensitive particle infusion demonstrated a favourable safety profile, increased intratumoural antibody delivery, and showed early signals of enhanced anti-tumour activity. These findings support further clinical development of this cavitation-enhanced drug delivery approach.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with colorectal liver metastases, including patients undergoing surgical resection after receiving subtherapeutic irinotecan and cetuximab and patients receiving standard of care FOLFIRI and cetuximab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of cavitation-enhanced drug delivery (CEeDD) by sonosensitive particles and focused ultrasound applied to colorectal metastases in the liver.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intermittent weekly oral dosing of PRTX007 demonstrated a favorable safety profile with controlled, statistically significant induction of interferon-pathway pharmacodynamic markers in healthy volunteers and minimal pro-inflammatory cytokine activation. These findings informed dosing regimen selection for a subsequent Phase 2 study evaluating PRTX007 in combination with pembrolizumab as neoadjuvant therapy for resectable stage III melanoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: healthy volunteers
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase 1 study of the safety, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics of intermittent oral PRTX007, an IRF7-biased TLR7 agonist prodrug.

data.clinical_result_summary: This phase III randomized controlled trial demonstrated that tunlametinib plus vemurafenib significantly improved progression-free survival and objective response rate compared with conventional chemotherapy-based regimens in previously treated BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer. The combination had a manageable safety profile and offered the convenience of an all-oral regimen.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously treated BRAFV600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase III, randomized, open-label study of tunlametinib plus vemurafenib versus investigator's choice of therapy in patients with previously treated BRAFV600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intraventricular CARv3-TEAM-E infusions were well tolerated after LDC+R pre-conditioning, with no dose-limiting toxicities noted. The addition of rituximab abrogated anti-therapy antibody formation and prolonged CAR T-cell persistence in 3/3 patients. Survival data suggest continued promise of CARv3-TEAM-E in patients with recurrent glioblastoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent glioblastoma with EGFRvIII mutation and/or EGFR amplification
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Rituximab pre-conditioning in a phase I study of CARv3-TEAM-E for recurrent glioblastoma (GBM): The INCIPIENT trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world study showed no significant difference in mortality, toxicities, infectious outcomes, or healthcare outcomes between talquetamab and sequential BCMA-directed therapy in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients with prior BCMA exposure. The findings suggest that antigen escape may be less common than anticipated, but further prospective evaluation is needed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included multiple myeloma patients aged ≥18 years with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma who had received prior BCMA-directed therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world comparison of anti-GPRC5D bispecific therapy versus anti-BCMA treatment in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after prior BCMA-directed therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Donafenib plus immune checkpoint inhibitors with or without oral fluorouracil chemotherapy drugs appeared to be a promising adjuvant therapy for patients with high-risk biliary tract tumor after resection. No significant safety concerns were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled biliary tract cancer patients with high-risk recurrence factors after radical surgical resection, including at least one of macrovascular invasion, lymph node metastasis, satellite lesion, nerve invasion, or a maximum tumor diameter of at least 5 cm.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Donafenib plus immune checkpoint inhibitors with or without oral fluorouracil chemotherapy drugs (S-1/capecitabine) for patients with resected high-risk biliary tract tumor: A multi-center retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The experience suggests that intratumoural 32P associated with gemcitabine-based chemotherapy is safe in patients with locally advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Patients after 32P injection achieved long overall survival, and surgical rescue was achieved in a high percentage of initially unresectable cases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients in thirteen centres in Spain with unresectable locally advanced pancreatic cancer signed consent to receive intratumoural 32P by echoendoscopy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Experience of Spanish centers with echoendoscopically implanted 32P microparticles associated with chemotherapy in locally advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Preliminary results of this prospective phase II study indicate that nab-paclitaxel and S-1 combined with tislelizumab as first-line treatment demonstrates promising efficacy and manageable safety in patients with advanced gallbladder cancer. These findings warrant further investigation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gallbladder cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of nab-paclitaxel and S-1 combined with tislelizumab as first-line treatment for advanced gallbladder cancer: Preliminary results.

data.clinical_result_summary: NP-G2-044 plus anti-PD-1 demonstrated pan-tumor activity in ICI-resistant advanced/metastatic solid tumors with durable benefit, including responses persisting after treatment cessation. In advanced/metastatic ICI-resistant cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, the regimen achieved 50% ORR and 100% disease control with durable complete responses, supporting fascin inhibition as a novel dendritic-cell-activating immunotherapy backbone for immune-resistant CSCC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors resistant to prior anti-PD-1 therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Activity of NP-G2-044 (fascin inhibitor) + anti–PD-1 in ICI-resistant advanced/metastatic solid tumors with expansion in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: The maximum tolerated dose was determined to be gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 with nab-sirolimus 100 mg/m2 on Days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Based on preliminary safety and efficacy, expansion with an additional 6 patients at this dose level is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced leiomyosarcomas or advanced soft-tissue sarcomas with TSC1/2 alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I trial of combination gemcitabine (gem) and nab-sirolimus (nab-S) in advanced leiomyosarcomas (LMS) or advanced soft-tissue sarcomas (STS) with TSC1/2 alterations: Preliminary results.

data.clinical_result_summary: Amivantamab monotherapy demonstrated consistent antitumor activity in both canonical, EGFR-dependent (CMS2) and mesenchymal, EGFR-independent (CMS4) tumors. This activity was observed in refractory RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer, unlike traditional EGFR inhibitors.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Participants had metastatic colorectal cancer harboring wild-type KRAS, NRAS, BRAF, and EGFR ectodomain and without ERBB2/HER2 amplification; they included patients with left-sided metastatic colorectal cancer without prior anti-EGFR therapy, left-sided metastatic colorectal cancer with prior anti-EGFR therapy, or right-sided disease, and all had received 2-3 prior lines of therapy in the metastatic setting.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Antitumor activity of amivantamab by consensus molecular subtypes in RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer: Secondary analyses from the phase 1b/2 OrigAMI‑1 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this early real-world experience, lifileucel demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity with ongoing responses in heavily pretreated patients despite high-risk features such as elevated LDH and liver and brain metastases. Additional studies and longer follow-up are warranted to optimize patient selection and define durability of benefit and survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with unresectable/metastatic melanoma who had progressed on immune checkpoint inhibitors, and BRAF ± MEK therapy if applicable, received lifileucel per standard protocol at a single institution, received an in-specification TIL product, and had evaluable imaging at least 12 weeks post-infusion unless progression was detected sooner; all patients had Stage IV disease, including liver and brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of lifileucel in advanced melanoma: A single-institution experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: At week 144, ASC had consistently higher molecular response rates and favorable safety/tolerability compared with all investigator-selected TKIs, with no new treatment-emergent mutations. Together with week 48 and week 96 findings, this analysis reinforces ASC’s improved benefit-risk profile and supports ASC as a treatment option for newly diagnosed chronic myeloid leukemia.
clinical_result_indication_detail: newly diagnosed patients with Philadelphia chromosome-positive chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase
clinical_result_layer_factor: ELTS risk category and prerandomization-selected TKI (imatinib or a second generation TKI)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: ASC4FIRST wk 144 analysis: Efficacy and safety and tolerability with asciminib (ASC) vs investigator-selected tyrosine kinase inhibitors (IS TKIs) in newly diagnosed (ND) chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase (CML-CP).

data.clinical_result_summary: Beta-blocker exposure at immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation was associated with inferior survival and reduced treatment durability in adults with advanced solid tumors. The authors suggest caution when extrapolating preclinical hypotheses regarding β blockade and emphasize the need for prospective subtype-specific evaluation of beta-blockers as immunomodulatory agents, while noting that residual confounding and selection bias cannot be fully excluded given the retrospective real-world design.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years with advanced solid tumors initiating PD-1/PD-L1/CTLA-4 therapy between 2014 and 2024 were identified from the TriNetX Research Network.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Beta-blocker use at immune checkpoint inhibitor initiation and survival in advanced solid tumors: A multi-institutional real-world cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Delayed response beyond 1 cycle in patients receiving hypomethylating agents plus venetoclax identifies acute myeloid leukemia patients at higher risk of relapse and inferior survival. Time to response may inform early risk-adapted strategies, including venetoclax optimization.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with acute myeloid leukemia who achieved complete remission or complete remission with incomplete hematologic recovery with hypomethylating agents plus venetoclax at the University of Kentucky from 2016 to 2025 were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Time to response with HMA/venetoclax as a predictor of survival in acute myeloid leukemia: Analysis of 1- vs 2-cycle responders.

data.clinical_result_summary: Four cycles of tislelizumab plus GP regimen as neoadjuvant therapy demonstrated promising tumor response, long-term survival benefit, and a manageable safety profile in high-risk locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with high-risk locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Four cycles of tislelizumab plus GP regimen as neoadjuvant therapy for high-risk (T4/N3) locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: Treatment with zelenectide pevedotin plus pembrolizumab showed promising clinical benefits in patients with locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma, including median progression-free survival of 13.0 months, 50% confirmed objective response rate, and median duration of response not reached. The combination demonstrated a safety profile with potential differentiation from antibody-drug conjugate combinations, including no skin-related serious adverse events.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated, cisplatin-ineligible locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Zelenectide pevedotin (BT8009) plus pembrolizumab in 1L cisplatin-ineligible locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma: Update on Duravelo-1 B7.

data.clinical_result_summary: DC-CIK combined with HD-IFN was associated with significantly prolonged recurrence-free survival compared with HD-IFN alone in resected stage IIB–IIID melanoma. The combination also demonstrated a significant overall survival benefit in patients with stage III disease, while severe adverse events were numerically similar and no treatment-related deaths were reported. Prospective studies are warranted to confirm these findings and better define DC-CIK–based adjuvant strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with completely resected stage IIB–IIID melanoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant DC-CIK plus high-dose interferon-α versus high-dose interferon-α alone in resected stage IIB–IIID melanoma: A propensity score–matched real-world study with long-term follow-up.

data.clinical_result_summary: Telpegfilgrastim effectively prevented the occurrence of grade 3/4 neutropenia in breast cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy, reduced the incidence of infections and the use of antibiotics, with good safety. These data support Telpegfilgrastim as a feasible option for chemotherapy-induced neutropenia prevention in clinical practice.
clinical_result_indication_name: 化疗引起的中性粒细胞减少症
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included breast cancer patients who used Telpegfilgrastim the day after chemotherapy for the prevention of chemotherapy-induced neutropenia.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of telpegfilgrastim in the prophylaxis of chemotherapy-induced neutropenia in breast cancer patients: A retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort from a high-incidence region, adding trastuzumab to chemotherapy resulted in clinically and statistically significant improvements in progression-free survival and overall survival in patients with HER2-positive biliary tract cancer. These data support routine HER2 testing and integration of HER2-targeted therapy into standard treatment algorithms for this molecularly defined subgroup.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included 67 consecutive patients with HER2-positive biliary tract cancer, defined as IHC 3+ or IHC 2+ with amplification, treated between 2019 and 2024; most cases were gallbladder carcinoma, and many had metastatic disease at presentation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of trastuzumab plus chemotherapy in HER2-positive biliary tract cancers from a high-incidence region.

data.clinical_result_summary: The NeoTAPPL trial demonstrates that an anthracycline-free neoadjuvant regimen is an effective and tolerable treatment strategy for patients with triple-negative breast cancer. The regimen achieved a high pCR rate that remained consistent across key prognostic subgroups, including disease stage and nodal status, and had a manageable safety profile with no new safety signals identified.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated, histologically confirmed triple-negative breast cancer in stage II-III
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant penpulimab combined with taxanes and carboplatin in triple-negative breast cancer: Updated efficacy and safety results from the phase II NeoTAPPL study.

data.clinical_result_summary: An efficacy benefit was observed with darolutamide, irrespective of age, number of comorbidities, or concomitant medications reported at baseline in patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, including those with cardiovascular or metabolic disorders. These results support the use of darolutamide in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, even in patients with older age, substantial comorbidities, and greater use of concomitant medications.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer were included in the study.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Prostate-specific antigen outcomes of darolutamide and androgen deprivation therapy in patient subgroups by age, comorbidities, and concomitant medications: ARANOTE post hoc analyses.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients receiving lurbinectedin plus atezolizumab had more time without toxicity before disease progression than those receiving atezolizumab alone. The combination showed a clinically important improvement in quality-adjusted survival, further supporting a favorable benefit-risk profile as first-line maintenance treatment for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Eligible patients had extensive-stage small cell lung cancer and were progression free after induction with atezolizumab, carboplatin, and etoposide.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: IMforte: Quality-adjusted time without symptoms or toxicity (Q-TWiST) analysis of first-line maintenance (1Lm) treatment (Tx) with lurbinectedin (lurbi) + atezolizumab (atezo) vs atezo in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC).

data.clinical_result_summary: ICI-combined chemotherapy demonstrated efficacy comparable to that in existing studies, but greater caution was required regarding safety in older patients. G8 status did not affect survival in patients with small cell lung cancer, while bone or brain metastasis at diagnosis was identified as an independent prognostic factor.
clinical_result_indication_detail: older patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer who underwent geriatric assessment
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Multicenter phase II trial of atezolizumab plus carboplatin and etoposide for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer older patients who underwent geriatric assessment (OLCSG2002 EPAS Trial).

data.clinical_result_summary: In PRIMA, GIS existed along a spectrum, and niraparib first-line maintenance resulted in a PFS benefit versus placebo across all GIS cutoffs. Patients with higher GIS experienced greater PFS benefit than patients with lower GIS, and the GIS ≥33 cutoff identified more long-term PFS responders than the GIS ≥42 cutoff. Results suggest that GIS cutoffs of ≥33 for HRD status determination may optimize identification of patients with advanced ovarian cancer who may benefit from niraparib first-line maintenance.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced ovarian cancer were randomized 2:1 to receive niraparib or placebo as first-line maintenance therapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy prediction for progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) by genomic instability score (GIS) cutoffs in patients (pts) with advanced ovarian cancer (aOC): Post hoc results from the phase 3 PRIMA/ENGOT-OV26/GOG-3012 trial.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: Puxi-Sam demonstrated a favorable safety profile in patients with nonresectable, recurrent, or metastatic biliary tract cancer. It showed modest clinical activity, with prolonged disease stabilization observed in a subset of heavily pretreated patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with nonresectable, recurrent, or metastatic B7-H4-positive biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety and efficacy of puxitatug samrotecan (Puxi-Sam, AZD8205) in patients with biliary tract cancer (BTC): A first-in-human phase 1/2a study (BLUESTAR).

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Percentage of Participants With Disease Control
data.clinical_result_summary: DEB-TACE combined with Apatinib and Camrelizumab as second-line therapy for unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma demonstrated promising efficacy and an acceptable safety profile. This regimen provides a viable treatment option for patients with unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma progressing after first-line gemcitabine-containing chemotherapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma who had progressed after first-line gemcitabine-containing chemotherapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: DEB-TACE combined with apatinib and camrelizumab as second-line therapy for unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: A prospective, single-arm, phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Intraperitoneal administration of fast-manufactured Th9/Tc9-like CEACAM5-targeted CAR-T cells demonstrated a manageable safety profile and encouraging antitumor activity in heavily pretreated colorectal cancer peritoneal metastasis patients. These findings support further development of fitness-enhanced, regionally delivered CAR-T strategies for peritoneal malignancies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: pts with advanced colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of intraperitoneal fast-manufactured IL-9-secreting CEACAM5-targeted CAR-T cells in advanced colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: The data confirm the clinical benefit of encorafenib plus binimetinib in Chinese patients with BRAF V600E mutant metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, a population with distinct genomic and disease characteristics. No new safety concern was identified in the Chinese population, and these data can support regulatory decisions and clinical practice guidelines in China.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Chinese patients with BRAF V600E mutant metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Results from OCEAN II: A phase II study of encorafenib + binimetinib combination in Chinese patients with BRAFV600E mutated metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this cohort, discontinuation of one enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab component with continuation of the other agent as monotherapy was associated with improved survival compared with uninterrupted combination therapy. Toxicity-guided treatment de-escalation may achieve durable disease control in selected patients.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with metastatic urothelial carcinoma receiving enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Clinical outcomes of enfortumab vedotin (EV) or pembrolizumab (P) interruption in metastatic urothelial carcinoma (mUC).

clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with unresectable or metastatic solid tumors that have progressed through standard therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A first-in-human phase I clinical trial evaluating the safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy of the novel fas ligand (FasL) inhibitor M3T01 in adults with advanced solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: This ongoing Phase 1 study of intracavitary FOLactis injection in patients with malignant pleural effusion preliminarily confirmed safety and clinical efficacy. The findings suggest that FOLactis may be a promising immunotherapeutic strategy for effective control of malignant pleural effusion.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors complicated with malignant pleural effusion
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase I trial on the safety, tolerance, and preliminary efficacy of intracavitary injection of in situ vaccines (FOLactis) in patients with advanced solid tumors complicated with malignant pleural effusion.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with advanced IO-treated squamous non-small cell lung cancer, IMM2510 provided clinically meaningful benefit and supported a favorable benefit-risk profile. The phase III clinical study is being planned.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Advanced IO-treated SQ-NSCLC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of IMM2510, a PD-L1/ VEGF bispecific antibody, in participants with advanced IO-treated SQ-NSCLC.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this retrospective study, preoperative cetuximab combined with immunotherapy and chemotherapy produced a favorable surgical downstaging effect without increasing surgical complications. The regimen showed encouraging efficacy and tolerability in locally advanced HNSCC.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with locally advanced HNSCC who had no previous drug treatment and received cetuximab plus immunotherapy plus chemotherapy before surgery.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cetuximab in combination with immunotherapy and chemotherapy as preoperative induction therapy for locally advanced HNSCC: A retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Ubenimex 120 mg/day combined with pembrolizumab, nab-paclitaxel, and carboplatin was feasible and showed encouraging antitumor activity with manageable safety in previously untreated advanced squamous NSCLC. The findings support further randomized evaluation.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated advanced squamous non-small cell lung cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase II study of ubenimex combined with pembrolizumab, nab-paclitaxel, and carboplatin for previously untreated advanced squamous non–small cell lung cancer: TORG2241(UBE-Q).

data.clinical_result_summary: In this expanded cohort, early cancer-related cognitive impairment was associated with reduced relative dose intensity and higher rates of treatment discontinuation. Beyond its impact on quality of life, early cancer-related cognitive impairment identified a vulnerable subgroup of patients at risk for compromised treatment delivery and may represent a clinically actionable target for risk-adapted supportive strategies aimed at preserving curative-intent treatment intensity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Greek-fluent individuals aged >45 years, including patients with early stage breast or colorectal cancer scheduled to receive adjuvant chemotherapy containing taxanes or oxaliplatin, early stage cancer patients not eligible for adjuvant chemotherapy, and age-matched healthy controls, excluding patients with pre-existing dementia or anxiety disorders.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of early cognitive decline with compromised delivery of adjuvant chemotherapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW28012 demonstrated a manageable safety profile in heavily treated patients with advanced solid tumors and promising anti-tumor activity in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The data support further development of XNW28012 in a broad range of solid tumors, including pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
patients with advanced solid tumors - PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics of XNW28012, a tissue factor antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) with topoisomerase 1 inhibitor (TOP1i) payload, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched real-world cohort of women with non-metastatic breast cancer and type 2 diabetes, GLP-1 RA use initiated within one year of breast cancer diagnosis was associated with a significantly lower risk of hospitalization and a trend toward improved overall survival. These findings warrant further prospective investigation into the potential role of GLP-1 RA therapy in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult women with non-metastatic breast cancer and type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosed between January 1, 2010, and January 1, 2020, were included, while patients with metastatic disease or other primary malignancies were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of GLP-1 receptor agonist use with mortality and hospitalization in women with breast cancer and type 2 diabetes: A propensity score–matched cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this multicenter real-world Chinese cohort, adjuvant pembrolizumab was associated with improved disease-free survival and a manageable safety profile in patients with high-risk clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Larger studies with longer follow-up are warranted to further validate these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study recruited 18–80-year-old Chinese patients with high-risk clear cell renal cell carcinoma, defined as either M0 disease with adverse pathological features or M1 oligometastatic disease achieving no evidence of disease after complete resection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant pembrolizumab in clear cell renal cell carcinoma with high recurrence risk: A multicenter real-world study.

clinical_result_biomarker_cn: 微卫星稳定/无错配修复缺陷
clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of sintilimab with cetuximab and chemotherapy showed manageable safety and efficacy in advanced pMMR/MSS and RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer. The overall ORR was 76.0%, and 40.0% of patients achieved surgical resectability. Further clinical data are needed to confirm these findings.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pMMR/MSS and RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sintilimab in combination with cetuximab and chemotherapy as first-line treatment for microsatellite stable/pMMR and RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer (CALLIOPSIS): An open-label, non-comparative, phase Ib/II dose escalation and expansion trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: GC-HAIC combined with anti-PD-1 immunotherapy showed promising efficacy in patients with unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The regimen had manageable adverse events and complications and may offer a potential novel first-line treatment option for this patient population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study enrolled patients with unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy combined with immunotherapy for unresectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: A single-arm, open-label, prospective clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of donafenib, PD-1 inhibitors, and TACE demonstrated robust antitumor activity and a favorable safety profile in patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma, both in first- and second-line settings. These encouraging results warrant validation in prospective, randomized controlled trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma who received donafenib plus PD-1 inhibitor and TACE at The First Affiliated Hospital of Bengbu Medical University between February 2022 and July 2025, and eligible patients had at least one measurable lesion per modified Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of donafenib combined with PD-1 inhibitors and transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (uHCC): A retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this early real-world experience, lifileucel demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity with ongoing responses in heavily pretreated patients despite high-risk features such as elevated LDH and liver and brain metastases. Additional studies and longer follow-up are warranted to optimize patient selection and define durability of benefit and survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with unresectable/metastatic melanoma who had progressed on immune checkpoint inhibitors, and BRAF ± MEK therapy if applicable, received lifileucel per standard protocol at a single institution, received an in-specification TIL product, and had evaluable imaging at least 12 weeks post-infusion unless progression was detected sooner; all patients had Stage IV disease, including liver and brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of lifileucel in advanced melanoma: A single-institution experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: Adjuvant anlotinib demonstrated a highly favorable safety profile and promising preliminary efficacy in patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma with residual disease. Despite the limited sample size, it may represent a viable chemotherapy-free adjuvant option that could complement current immunotherapy strategies, although further investigation is warranted.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma harboring residual disease following neoadjuvant therapy and R0 resection.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II study of adjuvant anlotinib for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma with residual disease following neoadjuvant therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: Anzu-cel demonstrated favorable tolerability and induced clinically meaningful and durable responses in melanoma patients treated at RP2D. Exploratory analyses suggested that the central nervous system was not a common site for relapse, and future analyses will further characterize response dynamics and progression patterns.
clinical_result_indication_detail: heavily pretreated patients with metastatic melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Patient-level clinical response dynamics in advanced melanoma with anzutresgene autoleucel (anzu-cel), a PRAME-directed T-cell receptor (TCR) T-cell therapy.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world multicenter analysis, ipilimumab plus nivolumab did not demonstrate a significant overall survival advantage compared with platinum–pemetrexed after propensity score matching. Outcomes were comparable across early and long-term time points. Prospective, peritoneal mesothelioma-specific trials are needed to define optimal first-line therapy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults with peritoneal mesothelioma who received first-line platinum–pemetrexed or ipilimumab plus nivolumab were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world overall survival with platinum–pemetrexed chemotherapy versus ipilimumab–nivolumab in peritoneal mesothelioma: A propensity-matched multicenter analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The primary endpoint of frontMIND was met; Tafa-Len-R-CHOP significantly reduced the risk of disease progression or death compared with R-CHOP in patients with high-risk diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or high-grade B-cell lymphoma. Treatment-emergent adverse events were manageable and consistent with the expected safety profile, supporting Tafa-Len-R-CHOP as a potential new first-line standard of care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: frontMIND: Phase 3 study of tafasitamab (Tafa) plus lenalidomide (Len) and R-CHOP for patients (pts) with newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL).

data.clinical_result_summary: The neoadjuvant regimen of pyrotinib plus trastuzumab combined with chemotherapy showed promising efficacy and manageable safety in HER2-positive/hormone receptor-positive early breast cancer, even with the low pyrotinib dose. This study is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated, histologically confirmed stage II-III HER2-positive/hormone receptor-positive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant pyrotinib plus trastuzumab combined with chemotherapy for HER2+/HR+ early breast cancer: A multicenter phase 2 trail.

data.clinical_result_summary: NeoRay Phase IIa data at the 177Lu-NeoB recommended Phase II dose of 9.25 GBq reinforced Phase I dosimetry and safety results and support further clinical evaluation. Most adverse events were mild or moderate, no new safety signals were identified, and preliminary signs of antitumor activity were observed despite the limited sample size.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors overexpressing gastrin-releasing peptide receptor
data.clinical_result_paper_title: NeoRay phase IIa results: A study of [177Lu]Lu-NeoB (177Lu-NeoB) in pts with advanced solid tumors overexpressing gastrin-releasing peptide receptor (GRPR).

data.clinical_result_summary: Pralsetinib demonstrated robust and durable activity against RET fusion-positive solid tumors, with an ORR of 67%. The safety profile was consistent with prior experience and no new safety signals were observed.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic RET fusion-positive solid tumors - Thyroid
Patients with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic RET fusion-positive solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of pralsetinib in RET fusion–positive solid tumors: Data from the TAPISTRY trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this propensity score-matched real-world cohort of women with non-metastatic breast cancer and type 2 diabetes, GLP-1 RA use initiated within one year of breast cancer diagnosis was associated with a significantly lower risk of hospitalization and a trend toward improved overall survival. These findings warrant further prospective investigation into the potential role of GLP-1 RA therapy in this population.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult women with non-metastatic breast cancer and type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosed between January 1, 2010, and January 1, 2020, were included, while patients with metastatic disease or other primary malignancies were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Association of GLP-1 receptor agonist use with mortality and hospitalization in women with breast cancer and type 2 diabetes: A propensity score–matched cohort study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this large real-world analysis of patients with pancreatic and colon cancer, intravenous push followed by infusion 5-fluorouracil demonstrated comparable safety outcomes and a trend toward improved survival compared with continuous infusion alone. Differences did not reach statistical significance, and prospective studies are needed to clarify the optimal 5-fluorouracil administration strategy.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years with pancreatic or colon cancer who received injectable 5-fluorouracil between January 2000 and January 2026 were included, and patients with capecitabine exposure were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of continuous infusion versus intravenous push followed by infusion 5-fluorouracil in patients with pancreatic and colon cancer: A propensity-matched analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: This study demonstrates that MSC/CD therapy is a feasible, safe, and potentially effective treatment for recurrent glioblastoma. The identification of distinct molecular subtypes and candidate genes offers potential biomarkers for patient selection and therapeutic targeting, and further studies are warranted to validate these findings and optimize therapeutic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with recurrent glioblastoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Suicide gene therapy for recurrent glioblastoma using allogeneic bone marrow–derived mesenchymal stem cell gene delivery (MSC/CD): A first-in-human, dose-escalation phase I clinical trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Interpretation of the trial is limited by early termination, small sample size, and fewer-than-expected disease-free survival events. Adjuvant nivolumab added to standard postoperative radiotherapy numerically, but not significantly, improved disease-free survival in locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. No new safety signals were identified.

data.clinical_result_paper_title: Adjuvant nivolumab in addition to postoperative radiation therapy in locally advanced head and neck cancer: Results of the phase II NadiHN trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In patients with HLA-A2-negative metastatic uveal melanoma treated in the first-line setting, darovasertib plus crizotinib demonstrated clinically and significantly longer progression-free survival, and improved objective response rate and disease control rate compared with investigator's choice treatment. Adverse events were consistent with previously reported safety profiles in each arm. These results support a potential new therapeutic standard for a disease with limited treatment options and poor prognosis.
clinical_result_indication_detail: HLA-A2 Negative Metastatic Uveal Melanoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Darovasertib plus crizotinib vs investigator’s choice as first-line treatment for patients with HLA-A2 negative metastatic uveal melanoma: Primary results from the OptimUM-02 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Updated results demonstrated that AK104 combined with AK112 and chemotherapy as first-line treatment continued to show highly encouraging anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including those with liver or peritoneal metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cadonilimab in combination with ivonescimab and chemotherapy as first-line (1L) therapy in patients with advanced gastric (G) or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA): Updated results from an open-label phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world cohort with long-term follow-up, induction CAPOX as part of total neoadjuvant therapy was associated with survival and response outcomes comparable to contemporary TNT studies. Post-treatment nodal response appears to be a dominant prognostic biomarker and may inform future risk-adapted sequencing, escalation and de-escalation strategies. This approach may be particularly relevant for patients unsuitable for intensive triplet chemotherapy regimens.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Consecutive patients treated at two oncology centres had MRI-defined high-risk non-metastatic locally advanced rectal cancer with threatened circumferential resection margin, including patients with T4 disease considered potentially unresectable at baseline.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Induction CAPOX as part of total neoadjuvant therapy for high-risk locally advanced rectal cancer: Long-term real-world outcomes from two centers.

data.clinical_result_summary: The HERBOT trial demonstrates that adding trastuzumab to first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor plus gemcitabine/cisplatin provides robust antitumor activity and manageable safety in HER2-positive biliary tract cancer. This first report of a HER2-targeted quadruplet regimen in the first-line setting provides strong clinical rationale for integrating HER2-targeted strategies into first-line treatment for this molecularly defined subgroup.
clinical_result_indication_detail: treatment-naïve patients with HER2-positive biliary tract cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: A phase Ib/II trial of first-line trastuzumab, nivolumab, gemcitabine, and cisplatin in HER2-positive biliary tract cancer (HERBOT): A multi-institutional study from the Korean Cancer Study Group.

clinical_result_indication_detail: Adults aged ≥18 years with pancreatic or colon cancer who received injectable 5-fluorouracil between January 2000 and January 2026 were included, and patients with capecitabine exposure were excluded.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Comparative outcomes of continuous infusion versus intravenous push followed by infusion 5-fluorouracil in patients with pancreatic and colon cancer: A propensity-matched analysis.
