Patients with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic RET fusion-positive solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of pralsetinib in RET fusion–positive solid tumors: Data from the TAPISTRY trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: This updated analysis confirms the promising efficacy and manageable safety profile of SHR-1501 monotherapy or in combination with BCG in BCG-naive and BCG-unresponsive high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer patients. Two randomized, controlled phase 3 trials are underway in both BCG-unresponsive and BCG-naive high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer populations, using the recommended dose of 600 μg SHR-1501 plus BCG.
clinical_result_indication_detail: BCG-unresponsive high-grade Ta/T1 NMIBC without CIS (cohort C)
BCG-unresponsive NMIBC carcinoma in situ (CIS; cohort B)
BCG-naive NMIBC (cohort A)
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Updated efficacy and safety of SHR-1501, an IL-15RαFc superagonist, with or without Bacille Calmette Guerin (BCG) for high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC): A phase 1/2 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Teclistamab monotherapy significantly improved progression-free survival and overall survival versus standard of care in patients with relapsed refractory multiple myeloma and prior anti-CD38 and lenalidomide exposure. Cytokine release syndrome and infections were managed with established protocols, supporting teclistamab-based regimens as a standard of care as early as second line.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with relapsed refractory multiple myeloma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: MajesTEC-9: A phase 3 randomized study of teclistamab monotherapy vs investigator’s choice of pomalidomide, bortezomib, and dexamethasone or carfilzomib and dexamethasone (PVd/Kd) in patients (pts) with relapsed refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM).

data.clinical_result_summary: Disitamab vedotin combined with PD-1 inhibitor immunotherapy might improve disease-free survival compared with standard chemotherapy as adjuvant therapy for upper tract urothelial carcinoma. Supported by favorable efficacy and safety outcomes, this combination represents a promising postoperative treatment option.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included high-risk upper tract urothelial carcinoma patients at Peking University Cancer Hospital, diagnosed as pT2–4aN0M0 following radical surgery, who received either 4–6 cycles of disitamab vedotin combined with PD-1 inhibitors or gemcitabine–platinum chemotherapy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness of disitamab vedotin plus PD-1 inhibitor versus platinum-based chemotherapy as postoperative adjuvant therapy in high-risk upper tract urothelial carcinoma: A comparative study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Expansion and clonal amplification of circulating NKG7+ cytotoxic CD4+ T cells were identified as key immune correlates of favorable outcomes with nivolumab in refractory recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. These findings suggest that this immune subset may serve as a predictive biomarker of durable response to PD-1 blockade and a potential target for future immunotherapeutic strategies.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma who had prior failure of or intolerance to platinum-based chemotherapy were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Expansion of circulating NKG7⁺ cytotoxic CD4⁺ T cells as a predictor of response to PD-1 blockade in recurrent and/or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC): A prospective phase II study with translational analysis.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of GEMOX, anlotinib, and sintilimab demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma, including those who had progressed on prior therapies. These results support further investigation in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of anlotinib and sintilimab combined with GEMOX in advanced combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma (cHCC-CCA): A prospective phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The neoadjuvant regimen of pyrotinib plus trastuzumab combined with chemotherapy showed promising efficacy and manageable safety in HER2-positive/hormone receptor-positive early breast cancer, even with the low pyrotinib dose. This study is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with untreated, histologically confirmed stage II-III HER2-positive/hormone receptor-positive breast cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant pyrotinib plus trastuzumab combined with chemotherapy for HER2+/HR+ early breast cancer: A multicenter phase 2 trail.

data.clinical_result_summary: Among patients with non-small cell lung cancer without prior heart failure, myocarditis, or arrhythmia, immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy was associated with a significantly increased risk of atrial and ventricular arrhythmias. These findings support proactive cardiovascular surveillance during treatment.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Adult patients with non-small cell lung cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, excluding those with prior cardiac arrest, implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation, myocarditis, or any atrial or ventricular arrhythmia before the index date, and excluding patients who developed myocarditis during follow-up.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Arrhythmic outcomes following immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy in patients with non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) without heart failure or myocarditis.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this very high-risk, resected thyroid cancer cohort, the addition of adjuvant external beam radiotherapy to surgery and radioactive iodine did not significantly decrease locoregional recurrence. The overall acute toxicity was low, and if adjuvant external beam radiotherapy is indicated, it can be delivered with acceptable toxicity.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with high-risk resected non-medullary, non-anaplastic thyroid cancer were included.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase II randomised controlled trial on postoperative radiotherapy, in high-risk, resected, non-medullary, non-anaplastic thyroid cancers (THYRO-RT).

data.clinical_result_summary: This largest real-world cohort of Veterans with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer demonstrated a significant overall survival benefit with chemo-immunotherapy. The benefit was particularly pronounced among patients with brain metastases, and elevated ANC/ALC was identified as a potential prognostic biomarker associated with poor outcomes regardless of treatment. Overall survival in the Veteran cohort remained substantially lower than in registrational trials, highlighting the need for future studies with broader eligibility criteria.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included Veterans with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer treated with first-line chemotherapy alone or chemo-immunotherapy within the Veterans Affairs health system, including patients with brain metastases at diagnosis.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Evaluation of survival after chemo-immunotherapy in veterans with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer and brain metastases.

data.clinical_result_summary: Cavitation with sonosensitive particle infusion demonstrated a favourable safety profile, increased intratumoural antibody delivery, and showed early signals of enhanced anti-tumour activity. These findings support further clinical development of this cavitation-enhanced drug delivery approach.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with colorectal liver metastases, including patients undergoing surgical resection after receiving subtherapeutic irinotecan and cetuximab and patients receiving standard of care FOLFIRI and cetuximab.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: First-in-human study of cavitation-enhanced drug delivery (CEeDD) by sonosensitive particles and focused ultrasound applied to colorectal metastases in the liver.

clinical_result_primary_endpoint_all_nam: 下一线治疗的无进展生存期（PFS2）
首次后线治疗后无疾病进展生存时间（PFS2）
data.clinical_result_summary: Sintilimab plus short-course intensified chemotherapy regimen Nab-POF demonstrated a high response and complete response rate, with remarkable long-term effects in metastatic gastric cancer. This approach may represent a feasible first-line treatment strategy and warrants further evaluation in randomized trials.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with metastatic gastric cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Sintilimab combined with short-course intensified chemotherapy regimen nab-POF in the treatment of metastatic gastric cancer (FDZL-GC002): A single-arm, phase 2 trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW28012 demonstrated a manageable safety profile in heavily treated patients with advanced solid tumors and promising anti-tumor activity in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The data support further development of XNW28012 in a broad range of solid tumors, including pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
patients with advanced solid tumors - PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics of XNW28012, a tissue factor antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) with topoisomerase 1 inhibitor (TOP1i) payload, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I/II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this real-world analysis of first-line therapy for metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma with high AFP, durvalumab plus tremelimumab demonstrated a trend toward improved overall survival, although the difference was not statistically significant. The findings suggest AFP may be clinically informative for first-line treatment decision-making but require verification in larger studies.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included adults with metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma who received first-line atezolizumab plus bevacizumab or durvalumab plus tremelimumab after January 2022 and had AFP > 1000 ng/ml, with analyses focused on patients with high baseline AFP.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Alpha-fetoprotein as a biomarker of response to first-line chemoimmunotherapy in metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: This ongoing phase I study is evaluating escalating doses of zeaxanthin monotherapy or zeaxanthin plus pembrolizumab in standard therapy refractory metastatic solid tumor patients. Cohort 1 of zeaxanthin monotherapy at 2 mg/kg daily completed without dose-limiting toxicity, while additional monotherapy and combination cohorts are actively accruing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: standard therapy refractory metastatic solid tumor patients
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I study of zeaxanthin alone or in combination with pembrolizumab in metastatic solid tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this trial, nCRT combined with sintilimab significantly improved the clinical complete response rate in patients with pMMR/MSS low rectal cancer. The regimen had a tolerable safety profile.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with pMMR/MSS low rectal cancer
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy with or without PD-1 blockade in pMMR/MSS low rectal cancer patients (CHOICE II): A multi-center, open-label, randomized controlled trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: The combination of GEMOX, anlotinib, and sintilimab demonstrated promising antitumor activity and a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma, including those who had progressed on prior therapies. These results support further investigation in larger cohorts.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced or metastatic combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of anlotinib and sintilimab combined with GEMOX in advanced combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma (cHCC-CCA): A prospective phase II study.

data.clinical_result_summary: Tuvusertib with avelumab demonstrated antitumor activity in anti-PD-(L)1-refractory Merkel cell carcinoma, inducing durable clinical benefit in ICI-resistant metastatic patients with limited salvage options. No signal of anticancer efficacy was observed with ATR inhibitor monotherapy. These findings warrant further investigation of ATR inhibitor therapy in combination with immunotherapy in ICI-refractory Merkel cell carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Patients with advanced anti-PD-(L)1-refractory Merkel cell carcinoma.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: MATRiX: A randomized phase II trial of tuvusertib (ATR inhibitor) with or without avelumab in advanced anti-PD(L)-1 refractory Merkel cell carcinoma.

data.clinical_result_summary: The maximum tolerated dose was determined to be gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 with nab-sirolimus 100 mg/m2 on Days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Based on preliminary safety and efficacy, expansion with an additional 6 patients at this dose level is ongoing.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced leiomyosarcomas or advanced soft-tissue sarcomas with TSC1/2 alterations
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Phase I trial of combination gemcitabine (gem) and nab-sirolimus (nab-S) in advanced leiomyosarcomas (LMS) or advanced soft-tissue sarcomas (STS) with TSC1/2 alterations: Preliminary results.

data.clinical_result_summary: This interim analysis provides an early look at a real-world primary data collection study of elranatamab in a heavily pre-treated relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma population. Real-world effectiveness and safety data for elranatamab will be presented at the congress.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study includes patients aged ≥18 years with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma treated in real-world settings, recruited from hematology/oncology clinics, primary care settings, and academic centers in the United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, and Italy.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world effectiveness and safety of elranatamab in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma: Preliminary results from the prospective, non-interventional MagnetisMM-16 study.

data.clinical_result_summary: The Rapid Drug Desensitization protocol was safe and permitted maintenance of the original treatment schedule in most cancer patients who had a major allergic reaction during chemotherapy. Further trials are needed to better define the role of Rapid Drug Desensitization and identify the drugs most suitable for the desensitization protocol.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included cancer patients with infusion-related allergic reactions at the Rimini Oncology Unit after allergological evaluation.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Assessment of the role of rapid drug desensitization to treat cancer patient with infusion-related allergic reactions.

data.clinical_result_summary: Updated results demonstrated that AK104 combined with AK112 and chemotherapy as first-line treatment continued to show highly encouraging anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, including those with liver or peritoneal metastases.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Cadonilimab in combination with ivonescimab and chemotherapy as first-line (1L) therapy in patients with advanced gastric (G) or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJA): Updated results from an open-label phase II trial.

data.clinical_result_summary: Patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with no targetable mutations and no PD-L1 expression who received dual immunotherapy in the first-line setting had superior survival compared with those treated with chemotherapy-immunotherapy. Dual immunotherapy was associated with higher rates of healthcare utilization, suggesting a need for proactive recognition and management of possible side effects.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with no targetable mutations, including HER2, MET variant, EGFR, ALK, RET, BRAF, ROS1, and NTRK1/2/3, and no PD-L1 expression, who received first-line treatment.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Effects of upfront dual immunotherapy on overall survival in patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with no targetable mutations or PD-L1 expression.

data.clinical_result_summary: Spartalizumab combined with low-dose pazopanib was well tolerated and led to a recommended phase 2 dose of 4 mg/kg/q4w. The regimen showed evidence of anti-tumor activity in pediatric sarcoma, especially osteosarcoma, and further investigations are ongoing to identify the subpopulation most likely to benefit.
clinical_result_indication_detail: Pediatric patients with recurrent/refractory solid tumors.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: SPARTO: A phase I study of PD-1 inhibitor spartalizumab (PDR001) in combination with low dose of pazopanib in pediatric relapsed/refractory tumors.

data.clinical_result_summary: In this early real-world experience, lifileucel demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity with ongoing responses in heavily pretreated patients despite high-risk features such as elevated LDH and liver and brain metastases. Additional studies and longer follow-up are warranted to optimize patient selection and define durability of benefit and survival outcomes.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study included patients with unresectable/metastatic melanoma who had progressed on immune checkpoint inhibitors, and BRAF ± MEK therapy if applicable, received lifileucel per standard protocol at a single institution, received an in-specification TIL product, and had evaluable imaging at least 12 weeks post-infusion unless progression was detected sooner; all patients had Stage IV disease, including liver and brain metastases.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Real-world outcomes of lifileucel in advanced melanoma: A single-institution experience.

data.clinical_result_summary: This real-world study demonstrates that transarterial therapy combined with donafenib and PD-1 inhibitors provides encouraging survival outcomes and a manageable safety profile for patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_detail: The study analyzed patients diagnosed with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma who had received at least one cycle of first-line triple combination therapy comprising transarterial therapy, donafenib, and PD-1 inhibitors in a real-world cohort.
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Efficacy and safety of transarterial therapy combined with donafenib plus PD-1 inhibitors for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: A multicenter retrospective study.

data.clinical_result_summary: PFS2 was improved in the sacituzumab govitecan plus pembrolizumab group versus the chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab group despite crossover treatment, with most participants who initiated subsequent treatment in the chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab group receiving sacituzumab govitecan. In participants with previously untreated PD-L1+ metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, sacituzumab govitecan plus pembrolizumab provided clinically relevant continued benefit beyond first progression, further supporting this regimen as a potential new standard of care.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with previously untreated, PD-L1–positive, locally advanced unresectable or mTNBC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Progression-free survival after next line of treatment (PFS2) and subsequent therapies (subs tx) in the ASCENT-04 study of participants (pts) with previously untreated PD-L1+ metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (mTNBC) treated with sacituzumab govitecan (SG) plus pembrolizumab (pembro) vs chemotherapy (chemo) plus pembro.

data.clinical_result_summary: NP-G2-044 plus anti-PD-1 demonstrated pan-tumor activity in ICI-resistant advanced/metastatic solid tumors with durable benefit, including responses persisting after treatment cessation. In advanced/metastatic ICI-resistant cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, the regimen achieved 50% ORR and 100% disease control with durable complete responses, supporting fascin inhibition as a novel dendritic-cell-activating immunotherapy backbone for immune-resistant CSCC.
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors resistant to prior anti-PD-1 therapy
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Activity of NP-G2-044 (fascin inhibitor) + anti–PD-1 in ICI-resistant advanced/metastatic solid tumors with expansion in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC).

data.clinical_result_summary: XNW28012 demonstrated a manageable safety profile in heavily treated patients with advanced solid tumors and promising anti-tumor activity in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The data support further development of XNW28012 in a broad range of solid tumors, including pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
clinical_result_indication_name_en: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck (SCCHN)
clinical_result_indication_detail: patients with advanced solid tumors
patients with advanced solid tumors - PDAC
data.clinical_result_paper_title: Safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics of XNW28012, a tissue factor antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) with topoisomerase 1 inhibitor (TOP1i) payload, in patients with advanced solid tumors: Results from a phase I/II study.
